### [1] [Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09949)
*Dongwu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Video LLM在物体跨越/消失重现计数任务上失败，并非缺少object permanence；线性探针显示计数信号存在但未被读出，提出episode定位监督与离散事件符号侧信道两种读出修复，same-object计数从46.7%提升到65.0%（oracle 66.7%，随机33%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解释将Video LLM计数失败归因于缺乏object permanence。作者认为该归因不完整，需通过可控合成测试床与独立验证标签，进一步诊断失败究竟来自表征缺失还是读出环节断裂。

Method: 构造grounded合成测试床并做标签校验；用线性探针做逐窗口存在性解码与全局计数解码以定位表征-输出分离；提出两种readout-directed修复：episode-localization监督与离散事件符号side channel；在7B-30B模型上评测，并做独立场景迁移、测量装置审计（发现4处数据完整性缺陷）、REALCOUNT真实视频盲审（n=18）、1-epoch与3-epoch域内适配对比、冻结特征边界探针（AUC 0.62 vs 0.51置换控制）分析残差来源。

Result: 逐窗口presence解码达93%，而全局count解码塌缩为时长混淆；两种修复将same-object计数从46.7%提升到65.0%（oracle 66.7%）；迁移到独立工厂零成本；真实视频上边界仍存在（最佳55.6%，随机33.3%），符号通道零样本迁移失败；1-epoch适配为负（六种手段28-50%），3-epoch+sequence-disjoint oracle时间线下达94.4%，部署检测器时间线下2-epoch达72.2%；残差主要来自检测器证据与reader对检测器噪声的匹配，而非reader容量。

Conclusion: 计数失败是"信号存在但读不出"的表征-输出分离问题，可通过读出层修复显著缓解；残差瓶颈在检测器证据质量与噪声对齐，而非模型容量。附带揭示测量装置本身存在数据完整性问题，需审计。

Abstract: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

</details>


### [2] [Video-DCI: How Far Are VLM Agents from Human Viewers in Direct Video Corpus Interaction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09951)
*Garry Yang,Yuqiao Liu,Hao Lin,Luohao Pan,Xinru Chen,Wanqi Ren,Zhikang Xu,Yizhan Huang,Huaixiao Tou,James Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Video-DCI 诊断基准与人类对齐协议（DCI-Loc 时序证据定位 + DCI-QA 跨视频端到端证据发现/保持/组合），揭示前沿 VLM 存在"检索—落地"鸿沟：能检索到关键片段但难以转化为精确引用，迭代检索虽优于一次性检索，但多轮搜索"必要而不充分"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视频基准要么直接给出相关视频、要么只评最终答案或孤立定位、或允许文本捷径，导致"多轮视觉证据搜寻"这一人类核心能力未被系统评测。

Method: 构建 Video-DCI 基准：DCI-Loc 评时序证据定位；DCI-QA 中同池视频主题相关但答案需跨多个视频的隐式时序证据，人与智能体在有限局部窗口内迭代检视、保留证据并以带时间跨度引用的方式作答；用人类轨迹提供证据获取与使用的参考曲线；并做一次性检索 vs 迭代检索的消融。

Result: DCI-Loc 上前沿 VLM 常能检索并暴露参考时刻，但转化为精确最终引用的比例远低于人类；DCI-QA 中性能损失更早出现并跨视频累积；消融显示迭代搜索优于一次性检索。

Conclusion: 多轮搜索是必要条件但不充分：现有智能体更擅长累积候选与观测，而非获取精确且联合充分的证据；为视频语料直接交互式智能体研究提供了诊断性评测框架。

Abstract: Humans answer complex visual questions by inspecting short moments, updating what they know, and redirecting attention toward missing evidence. Existing video benchmarks, however, often provide the relevant video, evaluate only final answers or isolated localization, or permit textual shortcuts, leaving multi-round visual evidence seeking underexplored. We introduce Video-DCI, a diagnostic benchmark and functionally matched human-agent protocol for Direct Video-Corpus Interaction. It comprises DCI-Loc for temporal evidence localization and DCI-QA for end-to-end discovery, retention, and composition of cross-video evidence. In DCI-QA, videos within each pool are topically related, yet every answer requires hidden temporal evidence from multiple videos. Given only the question and video pool, humans and agents iteratively inspect bounded local windows, retain supporting evidence, and answer with cited temporal spans. Human trajectories provide reference curves for evidence acquisition and use across rounds. Experiments reveal a consistent retrieval-to-grounding gap. On DCI-Loc, frontier VLMs often retrieve and expose the reference moment, yet convert far less of this exposure into precise final citations than the human reference. On DCI-QA, the loss begins earlier and compounds across videos. Ablation studies further confirm that iterative search outperforms one-shot retrieval. Multi-round search is therefore necessary but insufficient: current agents accumulate candidates and observations more readily than precise, jointly sufficient evidence.

</details>


### [3] [Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning for Handwritten Letter Recognition: A Controlled Study on EMNIST Letters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09953)
*Azam Nouri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAML在留出的发现划分上构建稀疏加权混淆图，对易混淆字母对(I/L、G/Q、U/V等)施加成对余弦分离约束，不增加任何推理开销；与严格匹配的交叉熵CNN相比，EMNIST Letters上全局仅微幅提升且不显著，主要作用是改变局部错误结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前期基于几何的手写字符识别中仍残留特定的相似字母混淆（如I/L、G/Q），作者希望从训练目标（损失函数）层面而非增加模块来直接干预这些残余错误。

Method: Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning：先在试点训练的留出"发现划分"上统计混淆对，构建稀疏加权混淆图；再在最终训练中对这些配对施加特定于类对的余弦间隔（cosine-separation）约束。无额外分类器、路由规则或推理期参数。对照实验与基线共享架构、最终训练数据、确定性增强、优化器与checkpoint选择，目标为8个混淆对。

Result: 干净测试集准确率95.6346%→95.6731%，macro-F1 0.956326→0.956724；10种预设扰动条件下均值准确率约95.3812%→95.4303%；目标对内对称错误614→605（1.47%）。但全局差异小且统计不可靠：干净数据修复124个基线错误同时引入116个新错误（精确McNemar p=0.6515），Holm校正后扰动条件无显著差异。

Conclusion: CAML未能确立全局优越性，但表明在防泄漏（leakage-controlled）设置下，成对特异的间隔目标可在几乎不损害整体性能的前提下改变目标错误结构；对已很强的分类器而言收益有限。

Abstract: Handwritten character recognition systems can achieve high accuracy while retaining concentrated errors among visually similar classes. Motivated by residual letter confusions in earlier geometry-based recognition work, we investigate whether these errors can be addressed through the training objective. We introduce Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning (CAML), which constructs a sparse weighted confusion graph from a discovery partition held out from pilot training and applies pair-specific cosine-separation constraints during final training. CAML adds no classifier, routing rule, or inference-time parameters. We evaluate CAML on EMNIST Letters against a strictly matched cross-entropy CNN baseline, using the same architecture, final training data, deterministic augmentation, optimizer, and checkpoint selection. Eight confusion pairs are targeted: I/L, G/Q, U/V, R/V, D/O, C/E, I/J, and H/N. On the official clean test set, accuracy changes from 95.6346% to 95.6731%, and macro-F1 from 0.956326 to 0.956724. Mean accuracy across ten predefined corrupted conditions increases from approximately 95.3812% to 95.4303%; symmetric errors within targeted pairs decrease from 614 to 605 (1.47%). The global differences are small and not statistically reliable. CAML fixes 124 baseline errors but introduces 116 new errors on clean data (exact McNemar p=0.6515), and no corruption-specific difference remains significant after Holm correction. Thus, CAML does not establish global superiority, but shows that a leakage-controlled, pair-specific margin objective can alter targeted error structure with limited overall benefit for an already strong classifier.

</details>


### [4] [DiffusedSplitFed: Latent Diffusion-based Obfuscation for Reconstruction-Resilient Split Federated Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09954)
*Chamani Shiranthika,Parvaneh Saeedi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffusedSplitFed在客户端-服务器切分点插入潜在去噪扩散模型(LDDM)，对SplitFed传输的中间特征/梯度做表征混淆，以抵抗重建攻击并保持分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SplitFed训练中交换的中间特征与梯度可被重建攻击还原患者隐私信息，需在保持分割精度的前提下增强抗重建能力。

Method: 三个架构变体V1–V3，采用不同的双重条件(dual conditioning)与全局特征融合组合，在切分点用LDDM混淆表征；在HAM10K、Blastocysts、FHPsAOPMSB三数据集上多次独立运行与配对统计检验，并给出条件收敛性分析刻画梯度扰动与本地优化的影响。

Result: 相较Baseline SplitFed显著提升对所评估重建攻击的抵抗能力，分割性能保持竞争性；与现有基于扩散的分割方法相比精度相当。

Conclusion: 潜在扩散表征混淆是实现抗重建协同医学图像分割的可行路径，为隐私-效用权衡提供架构级设计依据。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and Split Federated Learning (SplitFed) enable collaborative medical image analysis without sharing raw patient data. However, intermediate features and gradients exchanged during SplitFed training may reveal sensitive information through reconstruction attacks. To address this vulnerability, we propose \textbf{DiffusedSplitFed}, a SplitFed framework that integrates Latent Denoising Diffusion Models (LDDMs) at client--server split points to obfuscate transmitted representations while preserving segmentation performance. Three architectural variants (V1--V3) are developed using different combinations of dual conditioning and global feature fusion to investigate trade-offs among reconstruction resistance, segmentation accuracy, and computational complexity. Experiments on three medical imaging datasets (HAM10K, Blastocysts, and FHPsAOPMSB), supported by multiple independent runs and paired statistical analyses, demonstrate improved resistance to the evaluated image reconstruction attacks compared with Baseline SplitFed, while maintaining competitive segmentation performance. Comparisons with existing diffusion-based segmentation methods further demonstrate competitive segmentation accuracy under the evaluated settings. A conditional convergence analysis is also provided to characterize the effects of LDDM-induced gradient perturbations and local optimization on training. These findings highlight the potential of latent diffusion-based representation obfuscation for reconstruction-resilient collaborative medical image segmentation. The implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [5] [RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09955)
*Kavish Mehta,Yuvan Siddharth Katamaneni,Akash Awasthi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadAI：首个端到端框架，由胸片和报告预测放射科医师的注视序列，将注视区间与诊断发现关联、裁剪对应图像区域，并以合成语音旁白渲染成 EMME 式教学视频，免去采集新眼动数据，实现可扩展的注视引导训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片判读错误常源于视觉搜索失败：受训者被告知异常位置后能识别，但自身扫描时常未注视相关区域；而专家的搜索策略（看哪里、按何顺序、看多久）基本是隐性的。已有眼动建模示例（EMME）可提升新手检出率，但每个病例都需专家眼动采集，导致教学集规模受限。

Method: 由胸部X光片与报告预测专家注视序列→将序列各时间区间与所追诊的发现关联→提取对应图像区域→渲染为 EMME 风格视频，并为每个高亮发现配上合成语音解说。

Result: 在 EGD-CXR 数据集 97 个病例上评估，检验高亮区域是否与标注的异常位置对应（摘要未给出具体定量指标）。

Conclusion: 定位为面向放射科住院医师与医学生的可扩展教学内容生成框架；属医学影像教育应用，缺乏机器人/3D/具身等核心方向的通用方法洞见。

Abstract: Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

</details>


### [6] [MAPA: Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation for Latent Dataset Distillation in 3D Medical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09956)
*Weiqi Zhang,Hiroyuki Kubo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAPA：在冻结自编码器潜空间做3D医学分类数据集蒸馏，用聚类锚点+软分配把原型分散到类内多模态区域，缓解"原型集中"问题，五个3D医学任务平衡准确率+4.2点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜空间蒸馏比体素空间更省内存、可容纳更多原型，但类级匹配（如分布匹配）会把原型挤进潜空间稠密区，稀疏的类内区域被欠代表，形成"原型集中"偏差。

Method: 用真实潜特征聚类得到固定锚点标记类内模态；通过软分配把原型铺到各锚点上，同时保留类级匹配损失；附加轻量抗坍塌正则与课程式加权稳定优化。

Result: 五个3D医学分类任务上，同原型数量下聚合平衡准确率较最强潜空间基线+4.2点；MosMedData探索性严重度分析显示最差层召回提升且正常例特异度未降。

Conclusion: 类内模态覆盖是潜空间数据集蒸馏的关键，模态感知原型分配可在不增预算下提升稀有/稀疏子群表现。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) synthesizes a small training set from a large one, but applying it to 3D medical classification is constrained by the memory and optimization costs of synthesizing full volumetric samples. Under a storage-equivalent budget, distilling in the latent space of a frozen autoencoder reduces this cost and fits more synthetic samples (prototypes) than in voxel space. However, class-level matching, such as distribution matching, causes prototypes to concentrate in dense latent regions while underrepresenting sparser intra-class regions, a consistent imbalance that we term prototype concentration. To address this, we propose MAPA (Mode-Aware Prototype Allocation), a latent distillation method that spreads prototypes across intra-class modes while preserving class-level matching. MAPA marks these modes with fixed anchors estimated by clustering the real latents and distributes prototypes over them through a soft assignment, together with a lightweight anti-collapse regularizer and curriculum weighting that stabilize the optimization. Across five 3D medical classification tasks, MAPA improves the aggregate balanced accuracy by +4.2 points over the strongest latent baseline while using the same number of prototypes. An exploratory severity analysis on MosMedData suggests improved worst-stratum recall without loss of normal-case specificity.

</details>


### [7] [HALMES: Knowing When to Intervene in LVLM Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09957)
*Ruining Hu,Jiaqi Lu,Xiao Liu,Ying Shen,Yu Wang,Lin Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HALMES：基于内部注意力特征在生成早期识别"幻觉前兆片段"，仅在需要时触发对比解码，将全阶段无差别干预转为按需定向纠错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 training-free 对比解码在每个解码步都干预输出分布，会破坏原本正确的生成、甚至诱发新的幻觉，缺乏对"何时该干预"的判断。

Method: 先分析 LVLM 内部注意力特征与幻觉 token 片段的关系，发现幻觉相关异常在前序 token 片段中逐步显现；据此设计轻量 plug-and-play 模块，从生成过程中的注意力特征检测幻觉前兆并选择性触发对比解码，可与多种全阶段对比解码方法组合。

Result: 在多种 LVLM 架构与多个基准上，HALMES 在提升现有对比解码方法幻觉抑制效果的同时，降低了全阶段干预对正常输出的负面影响。

Conclusion: 对易幻觉片段进行建模并选择性干预是有效方向；幻觉缓解不必依赖全程干预。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in multimodal tasks. Nevertheless, their outputs remain prone to object hallucinations that are inconsistent with visual content. Contrastive decoding, as a training-free inference-time mitigation approach, typically intervenes in the output distribution at every decoding step. However, such indiscriminate full-stage intervention may disrupt originally correct generations and even induce new hallucinations. To address this issue, we first analyze the relationship between internal attention features and hallucinated token segments in LVLMs, revealing that hallucination-related abnormalities already emerge progressively in preceding token segments. Based on this observation, we propose HALMES, a lightweight plug-and-play module that identifies hallucination precursor segments from attention features during generation and selectively triggers contrastive decoding. HALMES can be integrated with various full-stage contrastive decoding methods, transforming indiscriminate intervention into on-demand targeted correction. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and multiple benchmarks show that HALMES further improves the hallucination mitigation performance of existing contrastive decoding methods while reducing the negative impact of full-stage intervention on normal outputs, validating the importance of modeling and selectively intervening on hallucination-prone segments.

</details>


### [8] [HippoMamba: A Mamba-augmented network for hippocampal segmentation and serial volumetry in Alzheimers disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09958)
*Dawa Chyophel Lepcha,Sophie A. Martin,Pierrick Coupe,Shabbir Syed-Abdul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HippoMamba将3D卷积编解码器与瓶颈处的Mamba选择性状态空间模块结合，用于多访次MRI海马体分割，Dice达0.8861，显著优于对比方法，并可用于队列内海马体积排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海马体萎缩是阿尔茨海默病最早的结构标志之一，系列MRI随访中的可靠海马分割是测量萎缩率的前提，需要兼顾精度与跨访次一致性的分割网络。

Method: 提出HippoMamba：3D卷积编码器/解码器 + 瓶颈处Mamba选择性状态空间块，可处理同一受试者一次或多次MRI访次；在MSD海马数据集（260例，五折交叉验证）与六种卷积/Transformer方法在相同折与patch尺寸下对比；五折集成不重训直接用于OASIS-3的600次T1扫描（150人），与FreeSurfer体积及相关性比较。

Result: 平均Dice 0.8861±0.0094，为对比方法中最高，逐受试者Dice显著优于每种方法（Holm校正Wilcoxon，p≤0.013）；95%HD 1.45 mm、ASD 0.44 mm最低，但与Attention U-Net差异不显著，HD与SegResNet亦不显著。OASIS-3上预测体积与FreeSurfer排序一致（r=0.778，ICC=0.772），但系统性偏小约27%；年化变化率中等相关（r=0.503）且均值偏大。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. Abstract: Language models are widely used as synthetic respondents in surveys, behavioral experiments, and market research. Most of these respondents read text, whereas shoppers in a store choose by looking at shelves, which makes vision-language models (VLMs) natural synthetic shoppers. We test whether VLM shoppers follow real consumers at two levels. At the purchase level, VLM shoppers built from household records plan their trips from a store directory and select products from shelf images, and we compare their purchases with six public datasets from three countries. The synthetic baskets hit held-out purchases as often as the households' own past trips, and synthetic group differences correlate with real ones twice as strongly as those of a trained regression. Without fitting, VLM shoppers reproduce alcohol purchases by gender and age in Russia and trip sizes by store distance in Taiwan, and respond to situations, prices, and displays within measured ranges. At the level of a single shelf choice, a model's answer confounds the product with its position and letter label. We therefore introduce ShelfSight, shelf renderings that vary products, positions, labels, viewpoints, and prices independently, together with a factor model that separates product preferences from the effects of label and position, which we call answer effects. On ShelfSight, hosted VLMs read the shelf, follow stated needs, keep their product preferences across views, and respond to price as budget shoppers. These answer effects, a preference for the letter A and for positions in the image, are estimated once per image type and removed. VLMs are thus good synthetic shoppers whose corrected shelf choices reflect product preferences.

Abstract: We introduce P-IMLA, a preconditioned implicit-midpoint Langevin sampler for high-dimensional log-concave targets with non-smooth regularization. Implicit midpoint removes this surplus via a Cayley-transform identity, making P-IMLA Gaussian-exact at any step size. Beyond Gaussians, whitening transfers the sharp IMLA contraction rate to $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$, and backward-error analysis gives drift-only rather than Euler-type diffusion bias under explicit smoothness assumptions. An $M$-norm Moreau envelope yields a proximal non-smooth variant with a three-term error budget. Controlled Gaussian and TV-regularized imaging experiments confirm the predicted separation: the unpreconditioned midpoint scheme retains long transients as $\kappa_f$ grows, whereas P-IMLA remains $\kappa_{\mathrm{eff}}$-governed and near variance-exact.

</details>


### [16] [QCVS: Question-Contrastive Visual Steering for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09982)
*Tong Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCVS：通过双差分激活探针（目标查询下的空间布局扰动 vs. 通用描述参考）分离任务特定干预方向，并用双阈值门控仅在必要时施加单次有界隐状态更新，实现推理时视觉引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型推理时的引导干预往往混杂了查询相关推理动态与低层感知噪声，导致对原本正确预测的附带性能退化。

Method: 无真值监督的双差分激活探针对比：在目标查询下对空间布局做扰动，并与通用描述参考对比，抵消任务无关的视觉伪影；再用相对交互强度与信号幅度双阈值门控决定是否施加一次有界隐藏状态更新。

Result: 在Qwen3.5（2B–9B）与DeepSeek-VL2上，于DynaMath、We-Math基准取得SOTA精度提升（稀疏覆盖约22%–30%）；修复率最高13.98%，附带损伤降至0.41%。

Conclusion: QCVS以极稀疏且精确的干预实现高修复率与低附带损害，验证了任务特定方向分离对推理时引导精度与效率的价值。

Abstract: Inference-time steering in vision-language models often entangles query-relevant reasoning dynamics with low-level perceptual noise, causing collateral degradation on correct predictions. We propose Question-Contrastive Visual Steering (QCVS) to isolate task-specific intervention directions via double-differential activation probing. By contrasting spatial layout perturbations under the target query against a generic description reference, QCVS cancels task-agnostic visual artifacts without ground-truth supervision. A dual-threshold gating mechanism then evaluates relative interaction strength and signal amplitude, selectively applying a single bounded hidden-state update only when necessary. Empirical evaluations across multiple scales of Qwen3.5 (2B to 9B) and DeepSeek-VL2 on DynaMath and We-Math demonstrate that QCVS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy gains under sparse coverage (approximately 22%-30%). Crucially, QCVS yields repair rates up to 13.98% while suppressing collateral damage down to 0.41%, proving high intervention precision and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [17] [Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09987)
*Guray Ozgur,Tahar Chettaoui,Eduarda Caldeira,Naser Damer,Fadi Boutros*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SD-ViT：在人脸识别ViT每个block后加共享embedding head的随机深度监督，使任意深度输出可用的身份embedding，支持固定深度提前退出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT固定深度推理难以部署在资源受限场景；标准ViT的中间层仅靠反向传播间接监督，中间表征未被直接优化为可用身份embedding，故早退输出与全深度gallery不可直接比对。

Method: 训练框架：每次迭代随机选一个中间block，经与最后一层相同的embedding head与分类器，施加加权margin-penalty softmax损失，形成"随机采样的深度监督"；共享head与分类器迫使中间token映射到最终层同一embedding空间。

Result: IJB-C上与常规全深度训练同backbone差距≤0.4点；50%计算量下早退探针恢复自身全深度性能96%以上，且无需重算或改造参考gallery；全深度校准的单一验证阈值从1/4深度起即可用。

Conclusion: 共享分类器的随机深度监督为ViT人脸识别提供无需gallery适配的多深度可退出推理，兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) perform strongly in face recognition (FR), yet their fixed-depth inference limits deployment in resource-constrained settings. We propose SD-ViT, a training framework that gives a usable exit at every block depth by making every depth produce discriminative embeddings, for budget-selected fixed-depth exits. Standard ViTs supervise intermediate layers only through backpropagation, so their intermediate representations are not directly optimized to form usable identity embeddings. SD-ViT adds a stochastic auxiliary signal: at each iteration a randomly selected intermediate block is passed through the same embedding head as the final layer and trained with a weighted margin-penalty softmax loss. The objective is thus stochastically sampled deep supervision through a shared classifier. Because both loss terms share that head and classifier, intermediate tokens are trained to map into the same embedding space as final-layer tokens. This matters for FR, where matching is by similarity: a probe processed at an early exit can be compared directly against full-depth gallery embeddings, with no gallery recomputation or adaptation layers. On established benchmarks, SD-ViT stays within 0.4 IJB-C points of the same backbone trained conventionally at full depth, while its early-exit probes recover over 96% of their own full-depth performance at 50% of the computational cost without modifying the reference gallery. A single verification threshold calibrated at full depth remains usable from quarter depth onward.

</details>


### [18] [Retrieval-Grounded Multi-View Reasoning for Clinically Reliable Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09993)
*Wanshu Fan,Zeyu Wang,Zheng Tong,Qi Ai,Wencai Weng,Haifan Gong,Congyu Liao,Guoliang You,Xiaofeng Liu,Dongsheng Zhou,Cong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RG-MVR：检索增强证据接地 + 自适应多视图证据推理 + 临床提示学习器，用于胸片报告生成，缓解检索报告与图像临床不一致及诊断标签不平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片报告生成中，检索到的相似报告常与当前图像在临床上不一致；同时诊断标签的长尾/不平衡问题严重。作者希望让检索证据"可控、可加权、可结构化"，而非简单拼接检索报告。

Method: 提出 RG-MVR 框架，含三模块：(1) Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding，将稠密记忆摘要与视觉门控的稀疏检索证据结合；(2) Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning，逐病例对图像、记忆、检索证据进行证据加权融合；(3) Clinical Prompt Learner，将"发现是否被提及"与"阳性/阴性/不确定状态"解耦建模，以缓解标签不平衡。

Result: MIMIC-CXR 上临床标签 F1 0.483、BLEU-4 0.118；IU X-ray 上 0.202 / 0.110。在 22 例外部探索性队列中临床标签一致性显著下降（F1 0.071），无依据陈述仍常见；但医生认为相比基线，无依据的时间对比陈述（9 vs 20 例）与器械相关陈述（7 vs 15 例）更少。

Conclusion: 证据感知检索与结构化诊断提示可减少特定类型报告错误，但跨中心外部泛化仍明显不足，需更大规模外部验证。

Abstract: Chest radiograph report generation is hampered by retrieved reports that resemble the current image but are clinically inconsistent with it, and by diagnostic-label imbalance. We present RG-MVR, a retrieval-grounded framework comprising Retrieval-Augmented Evidence Grounding, which combines dense memory summaries with visually gated sparse retrieved evidence; Adaptive Multi-view Evidential Reasoning, which weights image, memory, and retrieved evidence per case; and a Clinical Prompt Learner, which models finding mention separately from positive, negative, or uncertain status. On MIMIC-CXR, RG-MVR achieved a clinical-label F1 of 0.483 and a BLEU-4 of 0.118 (IU X-ray: 0.202 and 0.110). In an exploratory external cohort of 22 examinations, clinical-label agreement declined markedly (F1, 0.071) and unsupported statements remained common, although physicians found fewer unsupported temporal comparisons (9 vs. 20 cases) and device-related statements (7 vs. 15) than with the baseline. Evidence-aware retrieval and structured diagnostic prompting may reduce specific reporting errors, but broader external validation is required.

</details>


### [19] [SurvAD: How Anomalies Survive Diffusion Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09997)
*Lexing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究扩散式异常检测器"异常泄漏"问题：证明一阶确定性采样器沿异常方向满足精确递推，其连续极限为"生存定律"，异常随噪声指数衰减，衰减率由模型在访问状态上的保留率 r 决定；r 只依赖噪声水平而非步数，因而单条实测轨迹可预测其他步数、采样器与调度下的泄漏。基于此提出 SurvAD：在类推理起点微调重建器，并训练比较器在残差图上增强证据而不破坏全局排序；仅增 <2% 推理时间，MVTec AD P-AP 76.8→80.7，VisA 57.5→60.0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散异常检测依赖"重建趋向正常"来暴露缺陷，但异常残留在重建中多少（leak）缺乏理论刻画，导致阈值、步数、采样器选择缺乏依据，且难以判断残差反映的是真缺陷还是暴露偏差。

Method: (1) 对一阶确定性采样器给出沿异常方向的精确递推证明，取连续极限得到生存定律：泄漏 ~ exp(-r·(噪声衰减))，r 为模型对访问状态的保留率，仅与噪声水平相关；(2) 用四类扩散模型与真实缺陷验证跨步数/采样器/调度的可预测性（误差百分之几量级）；(3) 提出 SurvAD：在接近推理分布的起点微调重建器，并拟合残差比较器，以额外证据增强缺陷分数同时保持其余区域排序；(4) 在 MVTec AD、VisA 上评估 P-AP 与参数量、推理开销。

Result: 单条测得轨迹可在邻近起点上以几个百分点的误差预测其他步数、采样器与调度的泄漏；分析表明步数上的泄漏增长本质是暴露偏差，正常细节亦遵循同一规律，即改路径或改训练是在"泄漏"与"细节误差"间权衡。SurvAD 在 <2% 额外推理时间下，DeCo-Diff 的 P-AP 由 76.8 升至 80.7（MVTec AD）、57.5 升至 60.0（VisA）；在相同重建器上以 1/9 可训练参数匹配 CostFilter-AD；在 Dinomaly 协议下于两基准上超越其报告 P-AP。

Conclusion: 异常泄漏被刻画为指数生存定律，可作为采样器/步数/调度选择的预测性设计原则；泄漏与细节误差存在内在权衡；SurvAD 以极低额外开销和更少可训练参数实现竞争性至领先的像素级异常定位性能。

Abstract: Diffusion-based anomaly detectors reconstruct a test image towards normality, yet how much of an anomaly survives, its leak, remains uncharacterized. We show that a first-order deterministic sampler obeys an exact recursion along the anomaly, whose continuous limit is a survival law. The anomaly decays exponentially as the noise falls, at a rate set by the retention $r$, the share the model keeps on the states it visits. Because $r$ depends on the noise level and not on the step count, one measured path predicts the leak of other step counts, samplers and schedules from a nearby start to within a few hundredths, on four diffusion models and real defects. The law also shows that the leak's growth over steps is exposure bias and that normal details obey the same law, so changing the path or the training trades leak for detail error. We introduce SurvAD, which fine-tunes the reconstructor on inference-like starts and fits a comparator that adds evidence to the residual map without suppressing its ranking elsewhere. For under $2\%$ more inference time, SurvAD raises the multi-class pixel average precision (P-AP) of DeCo-Diff from $76.8$ to $80.7$ on MVTec AD and from $57.5$ to $60.0$ on VisA. It matches CostFilter-AD on the same reconstructor with $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters and, under Dinomaly's protocol, exceeds its reported P-AP on Dinomaly on both benchmarks.

</details>


### [20] [Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network for Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09998)
*Asifiqbal Saiyed,Nitesh Chilakala,Jimmy Joseph,Praneetha Goli,Rohini Maskar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出QGDL-Net，用可学习的“质量门控”根据FLAIR切片的对比度与SNR统计量预测切片质量，并在解码前对编码器特征进行微调，用于脑肿瘤二值分割，在BraTS 2021上Dice达0.9747并优于U-Net与Attention U-Net。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: U-Net类编码器-解码器在肿瘤边界异质、对比度弱或噪声大的区域，跳跃连接会产生弱对比或噪声响应，从而损害分割质量。作者希望利用逐切片的质量先验来抑制这类退化。

Method: QGDL-Net：以对比度与信噪比统计量预测每个切片的“质量”分数，并据此构造可学习的质量门（fine-tune把门控），在编码器特征送入解码器之前对其进行重加权/调节；在BraTS 2021上按80:20划分训练/验证，任务为FLAIR二值肿瘤分割；用EigenCAM做可解释性可视化。

Result: Dice 0.9747、IoU 0.9506、Precision 0.9755、Recall 0.9739、F1 0.9747、Accuracy 0.9982，均优于U-Net与Attention U-Net；EigenCAM热力图与分割叠加显示更好的肿瘤定位与可解释激活。

Conclusion: 将切片质量评估与门控特征调节结合可有效改善弱对比/噪声条件下的分割，但该工作属于医学影像分割的模型改进，未提供代码或跨数据集泛化证据，对本领域（Physical AI/VLA/世界模型/3D重建等）的直接借鉴价值有限，仅有“质量感知门控”思路可作为一般模态可用性加权技巧参考。

Abstract: The segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential step for computer-aided neuro-oncology, treatment planning and follow-up. While effective encoder-decoder representations are achieved by U-Net and Attention U-Net, the skip sections of the network can generate weak-contrast or noisy responses in the case of heterogeneous boundaries of the tumor. In this paper, we introduce a Quality-Governed Deep Learning Network (QGDL-Net) that can be used for binary tumor segmentation from FLAIR MRI slices. The proposed model is able to predict the slice quality based on contrast and SNR statistics and to fine-tune the encoder features prior to decoding by learnable quality gates. We used the 80:20 train-validation split for experiments with BraTS 2021. QGDL-Net achieved a Dice of 0.9747, IoU of 0.9506, precision of 0.9755, recall of 0.9739, F1 of 0.9747 and accuracy of 0.9982, outperforming U-Net and Attention U-Net. The EigenCAM maps and segmentation overlays provide better tumor localization and interpretable activation around the lesion regions.

</details>


### [21] [Optimized Car Damage Detection Using CNN and Object Detection Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10001)
*Sania Ejaz,Jaison Shajan Thomas,Zaheeruddin Ahmed,Sushma Hans*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两级流水线：先用CNN将输入图像二分为"完好/受损"以过滤无效样本，再交由目标检测层定位并分类 Scratch、Dent、Glass Shatter、Smash 四类损伤，并采用迁移学习统一多场景模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆损伤检测在保险理赔、事故上报、车库进出登记等场景需求明显，作者希望通过"先筛选后检测"的串联结构减少对无损伤图像的计算开销，并用统一模型+迁移学习替代针对单一用例的定制模型。

Method: 两阶段架构：(1) CNN 分类器做 clear/damaged 二分类；(2) 目标检测模块对损伤区域进行定位与四类细分类；训练中应用迁移学习，两个模块串联以简化输入样本处理流程。

Result: CNN 分类准确率约 98%，目标检测层 mAP 约 0.5；作者认为该 mAP 指标低估了实际检测效果，并在文中讨论了原因。

Conclusion: 工程化两级方案可行且分类环节表现良好，但检测精度偏低且缺乏对指标异常的系统分析，整体更偏应用型工作，对核心物理AI/机器人方向参考价值有限。

Abstract: Car damage detection systems play a vital role in scenarios, like the insurance claims process, accident reporting systems, or a documented write-up of the various damages a vehicle in a car garage exhibits upon entry and exit. This paper presents a two-fold model architecture encompassing a convolutional neural network used to classify the collected input samples as clear or damaged, thereby filtering out the undamaged images, before the input is passed on to the object detection layer for further localization and classification of defects into Scratch, Dent, Glass Shatter, and Smash. A deviation from the focus of related work, this paper poses the use of unified models while applying transfer learning techniques to augment performance that caters to multiple use cases. The design of this model has been made to optimize performance by incorporating the two models to streamline the processing of input samples. The model boasts significant performance with accuracies of 98% for the CNN layer and 0.5 mAP for the object detection layer. However, the metric for the object detection layer seems to understate its performance due to reasons discussed within the paper.

</details>


### [22] [Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Self-Supervised Learning in Histopathology Under 1-10% Label Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10003)
*Alicem Koyun,Pranjali Changadeo Pingale,Sachin Mote,Gianluca Pizzuti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对 SimCLR、BYOL 和 MAE 式掩码重建在 PCam 与 PANDA 低标签（1%/5%/10%）设定下进行可靠性感知基准评测，除 AUROC/F1 外还报告 ECE、Brier 分数与跨数据集 OOD 置信度诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理图像专家标注昂贵，自监督学习虽能利用无标签数据学习可迁移表征，但仅用性能指标评测会掩盖域偏移下置信度不可靠的问题，需要同时衡量校准性与鲁棒性。

Method: 冻结编码器 + 线性探测；ResNet-18 采用 3 划分×3 种子（n=9），ViT-B/16 采用 1 划分×3 种子（n=3）；指标包括 AUROC、准确率、F1、ECE、Brier；并做 PCam↔PANDA 跨集 OOD 置信度诊断、联邦 vs 集中式 SimCLR 对比、向结直肠组织学切片的跨域迁移。

Result: SSL 在较可控的 PCam 任务上提升标签效率；PANDA 的噪声更大的 patch 级代理任务上性能可能接近随机水平且方差更大；校准与 OOD 置信度行为与排序性能并不一致。

Conclusion: 病理自监督学习在进入临床解读前，应同时以校准性、鲁棒性与可复现诊断为依据进行评估，而不仅看排序性能。

Abstract: Expert annotation in digital pathology is expensive, and low-label regimes remain common in realistic histopathology workflows. Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a practical way to learn transferable representations from unlabeled pathology images, but performance-only evaluation can hide unreliable confidence behavior under domain shift. We present a reliability-aware benchmark of SimCLR, BYOL, and an MAE-inspired masked-reconstruction baseline on PatchCamelyon (PCam; 96x96) and PANDA (prostate cancer) under 1%, 5%, and 10% labeled regimes with frozen-encoder linear probing. To address common single-run concerns, ResNet-18 results are repeated over 3 splits x 3 seeds (n=9) and ViT-B/16 over 1 split x 3 seeds (n=3) under practical compute constraints, with mean+/-std reporting and per-run logs. Beyond AUROC, accuracy, and F1-score, we report Expected Calibration Error and Brier score, OOD confidence diagnostics for cross-dataset PCam<->PANDA scoring, federated-vs-centralized SimCLR comparisons on PCam, and cross-dataset transfer to colorectal histology tiles. SSL improves label efficiency on the more controlled PCam task, while PANDA's noisier patch-level proxy can remain near coin-flip with higher variance. The study highlights that histopathology SSL should be assessed not only by ranking performance but also by calibration, robustness, and transparent reproducibility diagnostics before clinical interpretation.

</details>


### [23] [MATA: Motion-aligned Temporal Adapter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10004)
*Ashish Kumar Singh,Prakash Chandra Chhipa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MATA——在冻结CLIP骨干上叠加的参数高效时序适配器，通过可学习时序位置嵌入做相位对齐、深度可分离卷积做工运动迁移建模，仅约3.6M可调参数即在少样本细粒度视频动作识别上达到SOTA，并对视觉损坏与丢帧扰动鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本细粒度视频动作识别的难点在于：视觉上高度相似的动作往往共享人物、场景、姿态与物体，仅靠运动的顺序、时序和短暂的运动变化区分。作者希望在三个实际约束下解决该问题：可调参数少、计算开销低、仅使用视频模态（不依赖光流/骨架等额外输入）。

Method: 在冻结的CLIP骨干之上构建参数高效适配器。核心包含两个组件：（1）时序相位对齐——使用可学习的时序位置嵌入，将CLIP特征在时间维度上对齐到动作相位；（2）局部运动迁移算子——使用深度可分离卷积（depth-wise convolution）沿时间维捕捉短时局部运动变化。整个方法仅训练约3.6M参数。

Result: 在多个细粒度动作识别基准上取得SOTA，且参数量仅约3.6M；对视觉损坏以及丢帧导致的时序中断均表现出鲁棒性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 细粒度动作判别信号主要蕴含在短时、局部、有序的运动变化中，因此无需全模型微调或重型时序建模，仅靠轻量的时序相位对齐与局部运动算子即可在冻结视觉语言模型上高效获得强性能，为低算力场景下的时序适配提供了简洁范式。

Abstract: Few-shot fine-grained video action recognition requires recognizing novel action classes from only a few labeled examples. The difficulty is that visually similar actions often share actors, scenes, poses, and objects, differing only in the order, timing, and short duration of motion changes. We study this problem under three practical constraints: few tunable parameters, low compute cost, and use of the video modality alone.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires locating fine-grained evidence in large scenes under limited visual input budgets. Active observation addresses this challenge through selective exploration, but repeated generative judgments can make region search costly. Its decisions also concern distinct prediction targets: spatial pointer validity, evidence presence, and reasoning correctness. We propose EarthJev, a framework that separates region scoring from answer generation and uses target-specific decision signals while keeping the answering model frozen. A spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search. An evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches using a lightweight head on frozen representations, without generating textual region judgments. Format-specific confidence calibration then guides selection between candidate answers generated from memory and overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks, EarthJev achieves a mean accuracy of 53.06% with Qwen3.5-9B, outperforming ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33 to 14.73 percentage points per benchmark while reducing mean latency from 11.30 - 1.67 seconds per question. ### [25] [Representation Learning for 3D Brain Imaging: A Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10007)
*Pierre Falconnier,Robin Trombetta,Nicolas Duchateau,Carole Lartizien*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究系统对比了18个预训练视觉编码器（8个基于自然图像的监督/自监督模型如ResNet、DINO、CLIP，10个医学图像训练的骨干如RadImageNet、BiomedCLIP、SimCLR）在3D脑部MRI下游任务（ADNI/PPMI上的年龄、性别预测与疾病分类）上的表征能力，发现2D自然图像预训练编码器表现最佳，甚至优于在10万+脑MRI体数据上训练的模型。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 2D自然图像预训练编码器表现最优，即便与在超过10万个脑MRI体数据上预训练的模型相比仍具优势，说明当前3D医学影像表征学习方法仍不够稳健有效。

Abstract: Many deep learning architectures for computer vision tasks rely on features extracted by a pre-trained encoder on large databases of natural 2D RGB images. However, the wide domain gap with medical images hampers the direct transfer of optimized deep learning models from computer vision to clinical applications. Recently, self-supervised pre-training and foundation models emerged as promising alternatives to mitigate these limitations. Yet, constructing such models for medical imaging faces critical challenges, including designing and adapting training strategies for large 3D volume datasets, and the need for standardized benchmarks to evaluate feature extraction performance. In this study, we propose an extensive comparison of vision encoders with a focus on 3D brain MRI. First, we consider 8 fully and self-supervised models pretrained on natural images (e.g. ResNet, DINO, CLIP) and 10 backbone architectures trained on medical images, either based on supervised (e.g. RadImageNet) or self-supervised (e.g. BiomedCLIP, SimCLR) tasks. All pre-trained encoders are evaluated on various downstream tasks to assess the representation power of their latent representations, including age and sex prediction as well as disease classification on the ADNI and PPMI datasets. Our study shows that 2D encoders pre-trained on natural images perform the most favorably, even compared to models pre-trained on more than 100k brain MRI volumes, highlighting the need for more suitable and robust methods for representation learning in 3D medical imaging. The source code for this study is publicly available at: https: //github.com/PierreFalconnier/brain-representation-benchmark.

</details>

*Somesh Mohapatra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用一段公开的食品仓库新闻走拍视频（无扫描/测绘）作为唯一输入，评估商业世界模型（20 帧恢复位姿与度量深度，融合成约 74.7 万高斯）与本地 CPU 训练的高斯泼溅在野外不可控素材上的几何恢复能力，并给出转为 OpenUSD 资产的修正流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式世界模型与 3DGS 宣称可将普通视频转为可探索 3D 场景，但缺乏在其未整理的野外footage 上的实证研究；作者希望回答这类模型在只有新闻走拍素材时究竟能恢复什么，并检验其能否直接作为数字孪生几何基础。

Method: 以商业世界模型处理 20 帧输入，恢复相机位姿与三个区域的度量深度，融合为约 747k 高斯泼溅（成本约 0.20 美元）；同时在 CPU 上本地优化 splat 模型（64 帧/43 帧/仅 8 帧三种条件）对比；在剔除行人的像素上计算 held-out PSNR；消融背景补全与人体凸包剔除；尝试让世界模型外推未拍摄区域（两次供应商侧失败，改用脚本模型填充）；并给出将世界模型输出转为带原生 splat schema 的度量 OpenUSD 资产所需的修正步骤。

Result: 本地 splat 在拍摄路径附近照片级真实但偏离即迅速退化；held-out 帧 PSNR 分别为 21.2 dB（64 帧）与 23.1 dB（43 帧），仅用世界模型可接受的 8 帧时下降 3.8 与 5.4 dB；移除背景补全与人体凸包剔除反而提升 held-out PSNR，说明清理运动人体后方的空间以损失可观测像素保真度为代价，其收益仅存在于无真值区域；未观测区域生成无法评估；成功构建可对接数据层、浏览器查看器、Blender 与 Omniverse 的 OpenUSD 资产管线。

Conclusion: 现有模型能以极低成本、度量尺度恢复真实场景的可观测部分，但少视角保真度与外推未观测空间仍是开放问题；工作属于方法探索而非落地产品。

Abstract: Generative world models and 3D Gaussian Splatting promise to turn ordinary video into explorable 3D scenes, but little is reported on how they behave on uncurated, in-the-wild footage. We study what these models recover when the only input is a publicly available news walkthrough of a food bank warehouse, with presenters walking through every shot and no drawings, scans or site visit, and we use the result as the geometry of a digital twin. A commercial world model given 20 frames recovered camera poses and metric depth for three areas, which we fused into about 747,000 Gaussian splats for 200 credits (20 US cents). Splat models optimized locally on a CPU, at no credit cost, were photorealistic near the filmed path but degraded quickly away from it. On held-out frames, scored in pixels not covered by people, they reached 21.2 and 23.1 dB PSNR from 64 and 43 training frames, and lost 3.8 and 5.4 dB when given only the 8 frames a world model accepts. Removing the trainer's background fill and person-hull carving raised held-out PSNR, showing that cleaning the space behind moving people costs fidelity in observed pixels while its gain lies where no ground truth exists. Asking the world model to generate views of areas the video never showed failed on the provider's side twice, so extrapolation could not be evaluated and unseen space was filled by a scripted model instead. We also describe the corrections needed to turn world-model output into a valid, metric Universal Scene Description (OpenUSD) asset with its native splat schema, which serves as the only interface to a data layer, a browser viewer, Blender and NVIDIA Omniverse. The findings suggest that today's models recover the observed parts of a real scene cheaply and at metric scale, while few-view fidelity and extrapolating unobserved space remain open. The work is an exploration of these methods, not a deployed product.

</details>


### [27] [Nanopath: Fast, Fair, Open Experimentation for Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10014)
*Paul S. Scotti,Hassan Muhammad,Ryan Kim,Nima Ashjaee,Ratna Sagari Grandhi,Saman Rahbar,Raymond Biju,Anish Dulal,Chao Feng,Connor Lane,Benjamin Warner,Tanishq Mathew Abraham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: nanopath：开源小规模病理基础模型训练与评测框架/基准，单张H100上约1小时训练（≤100万TCGA tile）、25分钟内完成tile级与slide级评测；固定数据/算力预算与下游协议以保证可比性，并用Labless实验台账记录1269个实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理基础模型的训练与评测门槛高、成本大，不利于快速验证研究想法；同时缺乏公平可比的小规模实验平台，使想法难以被系统比较与迭代。

Method: 构建端到端开源框架：自动下载数据、可复现训练配方、固定数据与算力预算（单H100、≤1M TCGA tile）、固定下游评测协议；配套公开实验台账Labless（支持人和AI agent检索历史实验）；并评估其快速评测套件与THUNDER、HEST、PathoBench（CPTAC）等标准化基准的一致性（6个nanopath模型 vs 14个参考基础模型）。

Result: 快速评测与三大标准化基准高度一致；部分22M参数的小模型在部分下游任务上超过1.1B参数大模型；上线以来收到20位贡献者的1,269个实验；后续已进一步优化评测套件以更贴近外部基准。

Conclusion: nanopath为探索病理基础模型提供了一个低成本、可复现、公平透明的实验测试平台，适合小规模快速迭代后再放大验证；但属于医学影像领域的基准/工具工作，与具身智能、VLA、3D重建等核心方向无直接方法关联。

Abstract: We introduce nanopath, an open-source framework and benchmark for rapidly training and evaluating small-scale pathology foundation models. Using a single H100 GPU, a typical nanopath model trains in a little over an hour on up to one million TCGA pathology tile presentations and evaluates within 25 minutes on a broad suite of tile-level and slide-level tasks. Nanopath enables rapid exploration of research ideas at small scale, so promising training recipes can subsequently be tested with more data and compute. To enable fair comparisons between ideas, we constrain submissions to fixed data and compute budgets while keeping the downstream evaluation protocol fixed. Anyone may clone the codebase, automatically download the data, reproduce or modify existing models, and submit a run to Labless, our public experiment ledger where researchers and AI agents can search through prior attempts. Since its public release in June 2026, nanopath has received 1,269 experiments from 20 contributors. Here, we detail its design and assess how well its rapid evaluation tracks standardized THUNDER, HEST, and PathoBench (CPTAC) benchmarks across six nanopath and 14 reference foundation models. Nanopath's fast evaluation suite strongly tracked these standardized benchmarks, and a few 22M parameter nanopath models even outperformed giant 1.1B parameter models on a subset of downstream tasks. We subsequently discuss how we have since optimized nanopath's evaluation suite to be an even more faithful, quick proxy for external benchmarking. Nanopath provides an accessible testbed for students, researchers, and AI agents to explore pathology foundation modeling through fair, transparent, and directly comparable experiments.

</details>


### [28] [Beyond Hash Matching: AI-Based Detection of Previously Unidentified CSAM and its Legal Implications in the EU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10028)
*Emmanouela Kokolaki,Georgios Samaritakis,Paraskevi Fragopoulou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 综述AI技术如何补充哈希匹配以检测未识别的CSAM，比较通用云视觉平台与专用工具，并实验评估Google Cloud Vision AI与Sightengine的色情分类与年龄估计性能及局限，最后讨论EU AI Act/GDPR合规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统哈希匹配只能识别已确证的CSAM，无法发现新内容；执法机构、在线服务商与儿童保护组织需要可补充的分析、分类与优先级排序手段，同时需明确AI判定的法律边界。

Method: 文献综述与技术分类（实时图像/视频分析、分类与标注、行为监测三类）；对通用计算机视觉平台、内容审核服务与专用CSAM检测工具做对比分析；以Google Cloud Vision AI和Sightengine进行性内容分类与儿童-成人年龄估计实验；并对EU AI Act、GDPR、透明度与人机监督等监管框架做法律分析。

Result: 不同厂商的分类体系与输出差异明显；年龄分类能力存在显著局限，尤其对青少年；监管义务因部署场景不同而不一致，可能造成互联检测与上报流程间的合规不一致。

Conclusion: AI评估应定位为分析与优先级排序的辅助工具，而非CSAM的确定性判定；需结合人机监督与明确的合规框架使用。

Abstract: The detection of previously unidentified Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) remains a significant challenge for law enforcement authorities, online service providers, and child protection organizations, as traditional hash-matching technologies are primarily designed to identify previously verified material. This paper reviews and classifies existing AI-based technologies that could complement hash-based approaches and support the detection, analysis, and prioritization of potentially harmful content. The reviewed approaches are organized into three categories: real-time image and video analysis, image and video classification and tagging, and AI-based behavioral monitoring. A comparative analysis examines the capabilities, limitations, and potential integration of general-purpose computer vision platforms, content moderation services, and specialized CSAM detection tools within existing detection workflows. An experimental evaluation was conducted using Google Cloud Vision AI and Sightengine to investigate sexual-content classification and child-adult age estimation. The results highlight differences in classification taxonomies and outputs across providers, as well as significant limitations in age classification, particularly for adolescents. These findings highlight the importance of using AI-based assessments as complementary tools for analysis and prioritization, rather than as definitive determination of CSAM. Finally, the paper examines the relevant European Union regulatory framework, with particular attention to the EU AI Act, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), fundamental rights, transparency, accountability, and human oversight. The legal analysis highlights how regulatory obligations and safeguards may differ depending on the deployment context, potentially creating inconsistencies across interconnected detection and reporting workflows.

</details>


### [29] [GMD-Mamba: Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation Using a Grouped Multi-Directional Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10032)
*Rahim Ullah,Hasan Abbas,Hazrat Ali,Syed Waqar Nabi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba：将通道分组并在一次扫描中沿不同方向展平各组，把多方向上下文成本从O(K·C²)降到O(C²/G)；仅在编码器最深层使用Mamba，BRA TS2023达92.0% Dice、HD95=2.7，参数仅19.2M（约为SegMamba-V2的1/7）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学分割方法在每个分辨率层级都做全通道宽度的多方向Mamba扫描，导致模型庞大（64–138M参数、高FLOPs），需要更轻量的多方向全局上下文建模方案。

Method: GMD scan：将输入通道C划分为G组，每组沿不同方向展平并在单次扫描中完成，实现多方向上下文且复杂度为O(C²/G)；同时只在最深编码器阶段部署Mamba以进一步压缩规模。

Conclusion: 分组多方向扫描可在显著降低参数与计算量的同时保持甚至提升3D医学分割精度，为轻量化Mamba分割网络提供有效设计。

Abstract: Mamba has the capability to capture global context in linear time for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing methods employ Mamba with full-width directional scans at every resolution, keeping the model large (64-138M parameters and high FLOPs). We propose Grouped Multi-Directional (GMD) Mamba, a lightweight network based on the GMD scan that divides input channels $C$ into groups $G$ and flattens each group in different directions in one pass. This gives multi-directional context at $O(C^2/G)$ instead of $O(K \cdot C^2)$, where $K$ is the number of scan directions. Additionally, we employ Mamba only at the deepest encoder stages, resulting in 19.2M parameters. On BraTS2023, it achieves the best average Dice of 92.0% and the lowest HD95 of 2.7 at $\sim$1/7 the parameters of SegMamba-V2. For model validation, we also ran experiments on the MSD Spleen dataset, achieving competitive performance. The implementation details and code are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [30] [Ultra-Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation in Label-Scarce Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10033)
*Rahim Ullah,Hasan Abbas,Syed Waqar Nabi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过知识蒸馏将139M参数的SegMamba-V2教师模型压缩为约0.96M参数的TinyUNet3D学生模型，实现约145倍压缩，Dice仅下降一个点以上；并系统研究蒸馏在不同数据标注量下的价值，发现数据稀缺时优势最显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba架构虽降低3D医学图像分割的计算复杂度，但现有模型参数量与计算开销仍然很高，难以满足轻量化部署需求。

Method: 知识蒸馏：以SegMamba-V2（139M）为教师模型，训练轻量级TinyUNet3D（约0.96M）学生模型；在相同实验设置下考察不同数据标注规模下蒸馏的作用；在BraTS 2023、MSD Spleen、MSD Hippocampus三个数据集上验证泛化性。

Result: 约145倍参数压缩，Dice仅下降略超1个百分点；蒸馏优势在标注数据稀缺场景下最为突出；三个数据集结果一致，方法具泛化性。

Abstract: Mamba is a neural network architecture that reduces computational complexity, and has been shown to be effective for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing models still remain computationally expensive. We propose compressing Mamba by distillation while achieving competitive performance. Specifically, we demonstrate compression of a 139M-parameter SegMamba-V2 teacher into a lightweight TinyUNet3D student with about 0.96M parameters, achieving about 145$\times$ compression with a performance drop of just over one Dice point. We further investigate the utility of knowledge distillation in a range of data-labeling scenarios under identical experimental settings, and show that its advantage is most prominent when labeled data is scarce. To demonstrate the generalizability of our approach, experiments are conducted on three datasets: BraTS 2023, MSD Spleen and MSD Hippocampus. The code for TinyUNet3D is publicly available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [31] [REFORM-3D: A Representation-Centric Evaluation Framework for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10062)
*Maregu Assefa,Muzammal Naseer,Divya Velayudhan,Gedamu Alemu Kumie,Naoufel Werghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出REFORM-3D以表征为中心的三维医学基础模型评测框架，考察采集鲁棒性、跨模态解剖对齐与解剖迁移，并提出按三种几何假设预训练的Med3DINO编码器族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D医学基础模型评测以下游任务分数为主导，将表征质量与适配策略纠缠在一起；而体数据中间距与各向异性会显著改变图像统计量但解剖结构不变，需要解耦的表征评测。

Method: 构建REFORM-3D框架，在冻结编码器上评估三个维度：固定解剖下的间距变化鲁棒性、平衡双向检索下的跨模态解剖对齐、case-disjoint设定下少样本解剖迁移。同时基于62.6K无标注MR/CT/PET/CTA/CBCT体数据，以各向同性归一化、体素相对采样、间距感知重采样三种几何假设预训练Med3DINO编码器族。

Result: 不同编码器呈现模块特定优势而非单一排序；受控比较中体素相对采样降低嵌入漂移，间距感知重采样更利于解剖迁移，语义迁移优势依赖数据集与特征类型。

Conclusion: 几何呈现方式本身构成预训练设计变量，REFORM-3D可作为冻结3D医学表征的多维诊断工具，但不提供下游任务统一排名。

Abstract: Evaluation of 3D medical foundation models is typically dominated by downstream task scores, which entangle representation quality with adaptation choices. This is especially critical in volumetric imaging, where spacing and anisotropy can substantially alter image statistics while the anatomy itself remains unchanged. We therefore introduce \textbf{REFORM-3D}, a \textbf{R}epresentation-centric \textbf{E}valuation \textbf{F}ramew\textbf{OR}k for benchmarking frozen 3D medical vision foundation \textbf{M}odels across three questions: Acquisition Robustness, asking whether features remain stable when spacing varies while anatomy is fixed; Cross-Modal Anatomical Alignment, asking whether labeled anatomical structures remain recoverable across modalities under balanced bidirectional retrieval; and Anatomical Transfer, asking whether organ identity remains recoverable from limited labeled support under case-disjoint evaluation. These are also pretraining questions, because what a 3D encoder learns depends on how volumes are geometrically presented during self-supervised pretraining. We further introduce Med3DINO encoder family, pretrained on $62.6$K unlabeled MR, CT, PET, CTA, and CBCT volumes under three explicit geometric assumptions: isotropic normalization, voxel-relative sampling, and spacing-aware resampling. Across Med3DINO and heterogeneous external encoders, REFORM-3D reveals module-specific strengths rather than a single model ordering. Within the controlled Med3DINO comparison, voxel-relative sampling yields lower embedding drift, whereas spacing-aware resampling favors anatomical transfer; semantic-transfer advantages depend on the dataset and feature type. Project link: \href{ this https URL }{\highlightLR{REFORM-3D}}.

*Kuan-Shen Chiu,Jia-Wei Liao,Yu-Chieh Chao,Li-Xuan Peng,Wei-Yun Ma,Cheng-Fu Chou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: V2C-Edit：免训练的VLM引导速度控制框架，通过构建多组耦合强度互补的速度场并用指令级相似度(ILS)动态选择，缓解FlowEdit的零编辑问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlowEdit的免反演文本编辑虽高效，但其源锚定耦合过强，常在需要大幅编辑时退化为零编辑；作者观察到源耦合强度直接决定保真-编辑权衡，而固定耦合调度无法适配不同时间步的编辑需求。

Conclusion: 动态、指令感知的速度耦合选择可有效缓解零编辑，是无需训练即可提升flow-based图像编辑可控性的实用方案。

Abstract: Text-guided image editing requires realizing the requested semantic change while preserving content unrelated to the instruction. FlowEdit provides an efficient inversion-free solution, but its source-anchored coupling can become overly restrictive, causing zero-edit, where the output remains close to the source and the requested change fails to emerge. We find that source coupling directly governs the preservation--editing trade-off, while a fixed coupling schedule cannot adapt to timestep-specific editing needs. Motivated by this observation, we propose V2C-Edit, a training-free VLM-steered velocity control framework. V2C-Edit constructs complementary coupling-controlled velocities and dynamically selects among them using Instruction-Level Similarity (ILS), which evaluates whether the predicted transformation follows the editing instruction. Adaptive spatial masking further preserves regions unrelated to the edit. Experiments on MagicBrush and PIE-Bench with FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 show that V2C-Edit consistently improves instruction alignment over FlowEdit while maintaining competitive structural preservation, and that ILS better reflects editing effectiveness than target-caption CLIP similarity. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>

*Boheng Zhu,Zehua Wang,Wei Chen,Ming-Hao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Pass@k 编辑感知评估：在指定交互模型下，检验规定编辑能否通过 k 次点击可选对象完成，并用 8 项文档诊断、结构扰动、设计师操作与替代绘制来评估 12 种矢量化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像矢量化评估以渲染保真度为主，无法区分渲染相同但可编辑性不同的文档；基于编辑的评估只看结果，oracle 可自动聚合部件碎片，从而掩盖了选择成本。

Method: 定义 Pass@k 指标（k 次点击内可选中对象完成指定编辑），提出 8 项文档诊断特征；在 211 个参考样本上评估 12 种开源与商业方法，其中 93 个样本上设 635 个编辑任务，并通过受控扰动、设计师实际操作与替代绘制分别考察结构敏感性、实用相关性与参照依赖性。

Conclusion: 渲染保真度不足以表征可编辑性，应以交互成本敏感的 Pass@k 与文档诊断共同评价矢量化；碎片化对象是编辑成本的主要来源。

Abstract: Image vectorization is often evaluated by rendering fidelity, which cannot distinguish documents that render identically but support different edits. Edit-based evaluation tests outcomes, but an oracle that gathers a part's fragments can conceal the cost of selecting them. We introduce Pass@k, which tests whether a prescribed edit can succeed using objects selectable within k clicks under a specified interaction model. Eight document diagnostics characterize properties relevant to editing beyond these tasks. We assess structural sensitivity through controlled perturbations, practical relevance through designer operations, and reference dependence through alternative drawings. We evaluate twelve open and commercial methods on 211 references, with 635 edit tasks on 93 of them. In each of four reference sets, including two drawn by designers, 64-88% of oracle-passed tasks on parts composed of multiple shapes fail at Pass@1, against 6-40% for single shapes, pooling counts over configurations. Higher fidelity does not guarantee higher Pass@1, while selected diagnostics are associated with designers' effort in our study.

</details>


### [34] [Adapting Frozen Promptable Segmenters to User-Defined Taxonomies via Few-Shot Proposal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10092)
*Khayrul Islam,Christopher Frederic Miller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SNAP：利用冻结SAM2.1的proposal特征，用项目自身少量标签快速拟合每项目分类头SnapHead，学习项目自定义的类边界，并可选地在类级别与SAM 3边界融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM类可提示分割器已解决"实例掩码"成本，剩余昂贵部分是类别标注；但每个标注项目的类边界不同（如人/车、轿车/卡车），通用模型的类边界被其训练词表固定，无法匹配项目定义。

Method: 每张图像只做一次冻结SAM2.1前向得到proposal；在proposal特征上训练项目级分类头SnapHead，每标注一张图后数秒内重拟合；若有SAM 3，则用同一批标注按类别决定采用SAM 3边界还是SnapHead边界。

Result: 8个外观相似的细胞系真值掩码上，60张标注图像：SAM 3 kappa=0.038，SnapHead=0.754；仅改类名时SAM 3降至随机水平而SnapHead不变。20张标注图像端到端在5个显微项目上F1 0.484 vs 调过评测标签的SAM 3 oracle 0.441；原样迁移到5个留出数据集，4个上优于出厂SAM 3。

Conclusion: 冻结基础模型特征已隐含通用词表遗漏的项目类边界，项目自身少量标签即可读出，形成高效交互式标注流水线。

Abstract: Promptable segmenters of the SAM family turn a click or a phrase into an instance mask, so the costly part of a label is now its class. However, each annotation project draws its own class boundary, often through objects these models already know: people from cars, sedans from trucks, one sedan model from another. A generic model's boundary is fixed by its training vocabulary. We present SNAP, an annotation pipeline that learns the project's boundary from the labels the annotator draws anyway. On one frozen SAM2.1 pass per image, we fit a per-project head, SnapHead, that classifies every proposal and refits in seconds after each labeled image. Where SAM 3 is available, the same labels decide class by class whether to keep its boundary or ours. Given the true masks of eight look-alike cell lines, SAM 3 assigns classes at Cohen's kappa = 0.038 and SnapHead at 0.754 (60 labeled images), and when only the class names change, SAM 3 falls to chance and SnapHead's score is unchanged. End to end, with 20 labeled images, SNAP beats a SAM 3 oracle tuned on the evaluation labels on five microscopy projects (0.484 against 0.441 F1), and run unchanged on five held-out datasets, it beats SAM 3 as shipped on four. Our results suggest that frozen foundation features already encode the class boundaries a generic vocabulary misses, and that a project's own labels are enough to read them out.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: SPECTRA为模型无关的对比式后训练框架：在PLISM配对的多扫描仪、多染色全切片图像上训练参数高效LoRA适配器；将跨采集条件的空间对应区域作为正样本，将同一条件下其他位置作为负样本，进行跨条件对齐。

Abstract: Histopathology foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse downstream tasks, yet their representations have been shown to encode scanner- and site-specific biases, creating generalization gaps and potentially limiting real-world utility. We introduce SPECTRA (Scanner and Pathology Embedding Contrastive Tuning for Robust Alignment), a model-agnostic contrastive learning post-training framework which explicitly encourages scanner- and stain-robust representations, to optimize performance and generalization on downstream applications. Using parameter-efficient LoRA adapters trained on matched multi-scanner and multi-stain whole-slide images sourced from the PLISM dataset, our method aligns spatially corresponding regions across acquisition conditions (scanner, stain), using other locations within each candidate condition as negatives. SPECTRA improved PathoROB robustness index, gene-expression prediction on HEST, slide-level classification AUC on CPTAC, and held-out PLISM retrieval for every model. Overall tile-level classification on THUNDER also improved, with exceptions for segmentation and calibration tasks. </details>


### [36] [A Privacy-Aware Deep Learning Benchmark for Facial Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10097)
*Larissa Palhares,Maria Machado,Hudson Bruno,Raphael Ramos,Andrew Vale,Barbara Barbosa,Inara Souza,Fabio Grassiotto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出仅用几何表征（478点人脸关键点 + 52维ARKit blendshape）的轻量隐私友好表情识别流水线，六种从头训练的模型在CREMA-D+RAVDESS融合数据上以5折跨被试验证超越ImageNet预训练ResNet50基线，参数量少12-124倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始RGB表情识别存在隐私泄露风险、对光照敏感，且易被身份等无关视觉线索走捷径（shortcut）；希望在不存储原始视频的前提下保留情感语义。

Method: 以人脸关键点(478)与blendshape(52, ARKit标准)的几何融合表征替代像素输入；设计6种从零训练的神经架构，与ImageNet预训练ResNet50在同等5折subject-independent交叉验证下对比；并通过消融实验分别考察关键点与blendshape的贡献。

Conclusion: 紧凑几何表征可保留情感语义、摆脱对视觉骨干的迁移学习依赖，实现高效且隐私友好的情绪识别。

Abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) traditionally relies on raw RGB images, introducing privacy risks, sensitivity to illumination variations, and susceptibility to identity-confounding visual shortcuts. As an alternative, this work proposes a lightweight, privacy-aware pipeline using exclusively geometric representations-facial landmarks (478 points) and blendshapes (52 coefficients, ARKit standard)-eliminating persistent raw video storage. Six neural architectures trained from scratch on fused CREMA-D and RAVDESS datasets were benchmarked against an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 baseline under a 5-fold subject-independent cross-validation protocol. Geometric models consistently outperformed the pixel baseline on unseen subjects with 12-124 times fewer parameters, while demonstrating superior robustness on subtle emotional expressions such as sadness. Ablation studies reveal that blendshapes capture the primary discriminative signal, while landmarks provide essential complementary spatial topology. These results demonstrate that compact geometric representations preserve affective semantics, eliminate downstream transfer learning dependency on visual backbones, and enable efficient, privacy-aware emotion recognition.

</details>


### [37] [Improving the Diffusability of Motion Tokenizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10160)
*Guanhe Huang,Songqiao Han,Tangzheng Lian,Oya Celiktutan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiMoT 提出"可扩散性"更好的运动 tokenizer：用 Critic Spectral Adaptation 抑制潜空间高频能量，用 Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder 以平均速度预测实现一步生成式解码，从而缓解 VAE tokenizer 的生成-重建权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜空间运动扩散存在生成-重建权衡：单纯增大 tokenizer 容量能提升重建，却不同比例地提升文本条件生成质量。作者假设根源是 VAE tokenizer 内部频谱失配——编码器产生的高频偏置潜空间，解码器引入时序伪影。

Method: 不放大扩散主干，而提升 tokenizer 的可扩散性。Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) 以预训练扩散模型作为 critic，引导抑制潜空间高频能量以改善文本条件优化；Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) 通过平均速度预测做生成式解码，支持高效单步解码并保持运动动力学。

Result: 在多个人体运动生成基准上取得 SOTA，运动保真度与文本-运动对齐均优于基线。

Conclusion: tokenizer 的频谱特性（而非扩散骨干规模）是潜空间运动扩散质量的关键瓶颈，改进 tokenizer 的可扩散性是更有效的优化方向。

Abstract: Latent diffusion models paired with a variational auto-encoder (VAE) tokenizer have shown promising performance for efficient text-driven human motion generation. However, motion latent diffusion suffers from a generation-reconstruction trade-off: simply increasing tokenizer capacity enhances reconstruction but fails to proportionally improve text-conditioned generation quality. We assume this trade-off stems from a spectral mismatch inside the VAE tokenizer: the encoder yields a latent space biased toward high frequencies, and the decoder introduces temporal artifacts. In this paper, we propose the Diffusable Motion Tokenizer (DiMoT) to improve the diffusability of the tokenizer, rather than scaling up the diffusion backbone. To improve text-conditioned optimization, Critic Spectral Adaptation (CSA) leverages a pretrained diffusion model as the critic to suppress high-frequency latent energy. To preserve motion dynamics, the Alpha-Flow Motion Decoder (AMD) performs generative decoding via average-velocity prediction, enabling efficient one-step decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMoT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various challenging text-to-motion benchmarks, yielding superior motion fidelity and text-motion alignment. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [38] [CXR-CMFA: A Cross-Modal Feature Aggregation Network for Chest X-Ray Pathology Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10174)
*Talukder Hasnat Zadid,Jahin Sultana,Felipe Bochini Brisola,Kishore Roy,Mysha Rahman,Syeda Asrafa Islam,Md. Abdullah-Al-Jubair*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单模态影像模型丢弃放射报告中的互补诊断上下文，而大型视觉语言模型部署成本高，需要轻量化的报告条件化跨模态融合方案。

Method: 双流视觉编码器（EfficientNet-B0 捕获全局解剖结构、DenseNet-121 捕获局部病理细节）+ TF-IDF-MLP 文本编码器；DMSAM 用报告嵌入对全局/局部视觉特征做门控式空间注意力，CGFF 学习样本级视觉与文本贡献权重。

Result: MIMIC-CXR 官方划分下测试集准确率 93.45%、精确率 99.88%、召回率 91.8%、F1 95.7%、AUC 99.19%；984 例正常样本仅 4 例假阳性；消融显示相比纯全局图像变体 AUC 提升 22.47 个百分点。

Conclusion: 紧凑的报告条件化融合即可获得强判别性能，无需依赖大型预训练语言模型，适用于高特异性筛查场景。

Abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation remains challenging because subtle pathology can be obscured by overlapping anatomy, image-quality variation, and limited visual evidence in isolated radiographs. Although image-only deep learning models provide useful baselines, they discard the complementary diagnostic context available in radiology reports, while large vision-language models can be computationally expensive for practical deployment. This paper presents CXR-CMFA, a lightweight cross-modal feature aggregation network for binary CXR pathology classification. The proposed framework combines a dual-stream visual encoder, using EfficientNet-B0 for global anatomical representation and DenseNet-121 for local pathological detail, with a TF-IDF-MLP report encoder. Two fusion modules integrate these modalities: the Dual-Modal Spatial Attention Module (DMSAM) uses the report embedding to gate global and local visual features, and the Cross-Modal Gated Feature Fusion (CGFF) module learns per-instance weights for visual and textual contributions. Experiments on the MIMIC-CXR benchmark, using the provided train, validation, and test splits, show that CXR-CMFA achieves 93.45% accuracy, 99.88% precision, 91.8% recall, 95.7% F1-score, and 99.19% AUC on the held-out test set. The model produces only four false positives among 984 normal test cases, supporting its suitability for high-specificity screening workflows. An ablation study further demonstrates a 22.47 percentage-point AUC improvement over the global-image-only variant, confirming the value of adaptive cross-modal fusion. These results indicate that compact report-conditioned fusion can provide strong discriminative performance without relying on large pretrained language models.

</details>


### [39] [ATLAS: A Multi-Procedure Benchmark and Context-Aware Model for Surgical Anatomy Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10182)
*Ronald L. P. D. de Jong,Tim J. M. Jaspers,Raf A. H. Vervoort,Aron F. H. A. Bakker,Anna L. Dijk,Yiping Li,Jip L. Tolenaar,Jelle P. Ruurda,Willem M. Brinkman,Daan de Geus,Fons van der Sommen,Josien P. W. Pluim,Marcel Breeuwer*

Abstract: Recognizing anatomical structures during minimally invasive surgery (MIS) could support intraoperative navigation and improve patient safety, but progress is limited by small, single-procedure datasets and by segmentation methods developed for natural scenes. This work addresses both limitations through a new dataset and model. Abstract: Unpaired medical image-to-image translation requires synthesizing target-modality images from source-modality images without aligned supervision. In the first stage, we learn a shared structure space by training a structure encoder-decoder on source images, target images, and structural masks jointly, using mask reconstruction to anchor the latent space to modality-agnostic anatomy. For source images without mask annotations, a target-domain memory bank provides soft structural supervision via prototype retrieval. In the second stage, a conditional flow model learns to render target-domain appearance under fixed structural conditions. This ensures the generator inherits target appearance statistics and can focus entirely on structural conditioning rather than learning appearance from scratch. We validate our framework on OCT-to-OCTA synthesis and brain MR-to-CT translation. Our method outperforms all unpaired baselines on both tasks and, despite requiring no paired supervision, also surpasses paired baselines, improving PSNR by up to 11.2% and SSIM by up to 26.4% on OCT-to-OCTA, and achieving consistent gains across whole-image, soft-tissue, and bone regions on MR-to-CT. At the event level, we present an evaluation protocol for video understanding pipelines, which describe a video as events and a transcript, that scores transcription, speaker attribution, event detection, temporal localisation and unsupported events. Whether each event is supported by the recording is labelled by a judge validated against blinded human labels. We apply it to complete pipelines, three 2026 omni-modal models and our hybrid NarrativeBridge-PAL-GPT-5 pipeline, on UKBWV-27, a pilot stress-test set of 27 publicly released UK BWV recordings (118 minutes). On this set the hybrid pipeline leads on five of six measures, yet it leaves 13.6% of predicted events unsupported and misattributes 27.7% of utterances, and every pipeline degrades on recordings from edited releases, long recordings and noisy audio.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 全局自注意力（ViT）在域内提升鲁棒性与视频级稳定性，但域内稳定不等于跨域可迁移；跨域泛化仍是开放问题，需进一步研究，同时说明统一协议对公平架构比较的必要性。

Abstract: Deepfake videos generated by advanced generative models pose serious threats to digital security, misinformation control, and media forensics. Although numerous detection methods have been proposed, their reported performances are often based on heterogeneous preprocessing pipelines, inconsistent data splits, and model-specific training protocols, hindering fair architectural comparison. This work presents a controlled and reproducible comparative study of convolutional neural networks (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0) and a transformer-based architecture (ViT-B/16) within a unified, face-centric deepfake detection framework. In contrast, ViT-B/16 demonstrates more stable video-level performance, achieving 92.8\% [95\% CI: 91.7--94.0] video-level accuracy and an AUC of 0.950 [95\% CI: 0.934--0.964] on Celeb-DF v2 (3-seed bootstrapped). <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度展开网络在每个级联都试图估计全部未采样谱，计算负担重且未区分频域难度；作者希望让早期级联只处理低频/低维子问题，逐步扩展到全谱，从而降低中间误差并提升重建质量。

Conclusion: 支撑（子问题）分配与正则化器设计互补，是展开式MRI重建中一个正交且低成本的设计维度；跨数据集实验验证了双向泛化。

Abstract: Accelerated magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) forms images from incomplete Fourier measurements, shifting acquisition burden to computational reconstruction. Deep unrolled networks interleave learned regularization and data consistency, yet typically estimate the full unmeasured spectrum at every cascade. We propose STAIRS (Staging the Inverse Problem via Admissible-Support Scheduling), which projects intermediate reconstructions onto nested Fourier supports that expand to the full spectrum and conditions each update on its support transition. Conditional increments of a regularized log-determinant score of training covariance define a normalized spectral coordinate, accounting for dependencies between newly and previously admitted frequencies. Dyadic targets allocate larger coordinate increments to earlier cascades and are mapped to fixed supports before training, enabling coarse-to-fine reconstruction with unchanged sampling masks and data consistency. On fastMRI and Stanford2D, STAIRS improves matched Transformer (HUMUSNet) and convolutional (NAFNet) backbones in single- and multi-coil reconstruction, including radiologist-annotated pathology regions. It also outperforms predictor-based progression with lower parameter overhead and inference latency. Stage-wise analysis shows repeated error correction by projection and lower intermediate reconstruction errors than the backbones alone throughout support expansion. Ablations favor dyadic allocation over uniform expansion for square and line-band supports and over manual front-loading for square windows. Support projection alone improves reconstruction, and transition conditioning strengthens the gain. Cross-dataset evaluation shows improvements for both backbones in both directions. Support allocation thus complements regularizer design in unrolled MRI reconstruction.

</details>

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) for object detection aims to improve model performance on unseen target domains. Existing detectors, however, suffer substantial degradation on visually distinct unseen domains, as models confined to limited training styles tend to overfit superficial statistical cues rather than object-level semantics. Motivated by human perception, which attends primarily to semantically relevant features while ignoring irrelevant style cues, we propose Origin-Anchored Multi-Style Consistency (OAMSC), a source-only framework that couples multi-style data synthesis with cross-style consistency learning to suppress style-sensitive shortcut learning. For data preparation, we leverage off-the-shelf diffusion models to expand the source datasets into 20 distinct styles, with all generated images manually verified to ensure that object instances and annotations remain consistent across style variants. During training, we impose Origin-anchored consistency constraints at scene and object levels to reinforce the learning of domain-stable features while suppressing the influence of style-sensitive cues. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on multiple challenging DG benchmarks demonstrate the consistent effectiveness and strong generalization performance of OAMSC across diverse domain shifts. Notably, our approach applies to both one-stage and two-stage detectors, while its data-centric design is complementary in principle to other DG methods. </details>

*Dingying Fan,Mingkai Liu,Haohua Que,Haojia Gao,Xianliang Huang,Qian Zhang,Xueqian Wang,Fei Qiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DAC-MACE 改进 MoE 式场景坐标回归（SCR）的路由：用残差上下文适配器（RCA）重校准冻结编码器特征、全局上下文编码器（GCE）做多尺度自注意力混合，并把图像级池化描述子加入路由器输入，使软专家路由不再依赖局部描述子；配双阈值 RANSAC-LM 位姿估计器。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MoE-SCR 中路由器与专家共享同一局部描述子作为输入，重复立面/窗户在不同位置得到相似路由输入，导致专家分配错误、大场景精度受限；同时移动端/AR 需要小而快构建的地图。

Method: RCA 通道与位置重加权 + GCE 多尺度自注意力上下文混合 + 图像级池化描述子拼接进路由器输入（soft routing）+ 双阈值 RANSAC–Levenberg–Marquardt 位姿求解。

Abstract: A camera becomes an absolute pose sensor when its images can be relocalized against a prebuilt map of the scene. On mobile robots and augmented-reality devices, that map must be small and quick to build. Scene coordinate regression (SCR) stores the scene in a compact network that predicts a 3D coordinate for every pixel, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants extend its capacity to larger outdoor scenes. In existing MoE-based SCR, however, the router assigns each pixel to an expert from the same local descriptor that the experts regress from, so repeated facades and windows at different locations receive similar routing inputs. We present DAC-MACE, which conditions soft expert routing on recalibrated and contextualized features. A residual context adapter (RCA) reweights the channels and locations of frozen encoder features, a global context encoder (GCE) mixes them with multi-scale self-attention, and an image-level pooled descriptor is added to the router input. A dual-threshold RANSAC--Levenberg--Marquardt estimator recovers the pose. On Cambridge Landmarks, DAC-MACE attains a mean per-scene median translation error of 13.0 cm over three seeds, the lowest among the RGB-only SCR methods compared (GLACE 13.6 cm, MACE 14.4 cm), and reduces the error on the largest scene from 24 to 19 cm relative to MACE. In a cumulative study, the MoE head, GCE, RCA, and the dual-threshold estimator lower the mean error from 17.0 cm to 14.4, 14.0, 13.6, and 13.0 cm. On 7-Scenes, adding GCE to a single ACE head raises Recall@(5 cm, 5$^\circ$) from 86.56% to 87.60%.

</details>

*Mohamed I. Eldagla,Zeyad H. ElShafei,Ahmed M. Anter*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出三部分诊断（表征探针、激活引导、二选一强制选择）检验医疗VLM是否"内部检测到X光与报告的冲突但故意隐瞒"，结论是四款指令微调VLM存在矛盾抑制，但并非隐瞒而是被门控的不确定性，跨模态注意力在错配样本上下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗检索增强生成中的VLM需在检索报告与X光相矛盾时明确指出冲突，这关系到安全部署；"谄媚掩蔽假说"认为模型内部已检测到冲突却拒绝报告，需区分"隐瞒"与"不确定"。

Method: 构建三部分诊断流程：隐藏层线性探针用于区分匹配/错配输入；沿学到的冲突方向做激活引导（activation steering）；以及二选一强制选择任务；并分析跨模态注意力在错配样本上的变化，在四个指令微调VLM的胸片数据上验证。

Result: 确认行为层面存在矛盾抑制；线性探针能区分匹配与错配输入（优于简单CLIP模型）；激活引导无法引出矛盾表述，强制二选一也无法恢复；错配时模型对图像的跨模态注意力下降。

Conclusion: 模型不给矛盾并非因为知识被掩盖，而是错配被表征为"模糊化、门控的不确定性"；作者据此呼吁重新对齐视觉证据（re-grounding）与显式化不确定性表达。属医疗领域VLM可解释性研究，非具身/3D/机器人核心方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) in medical retrieval-augmented generation must be able to say when a retrieved report contradicts the X-ray, so understanding whether they can detect such conflicts is important for safe deployment. The sycophancy mask hypothesis holds that these models internally detect conflicts but refuse to report them, concealing a detected contradiction. We introduce a three-part diagnostic that separates concealment from uncertainty: representation probing, activation steering, and two-way forced choice. Across four instruction-tuned VLMs on chest X-rays, we confirm behavioral suppression of contradiction and find that a linear probe separates matched from mismatched inputs, beyond what a simple CLIP model achieves. Steering the learned conflict direction never elicits contradiction, and forcing a binary choice does not recover one; instead, cross-modal attention to the image drops on mismatched pairs. We conclude that these models fail to contradict because the mismatch registers as hedged, gated uncertainty rather than concealed knowledge, calling for re-grounding and uncertainty surfacing. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>
