### [48] [AI-Driven Repair of Missing Automotive Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10318)
*Kazim Abbas,Zheng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于多视角体素重建与深度差分缺失区域检测的汽车零件缺损几何修复管道，并用DINOv2验证缺失候选，在20个CAD模型160次试验中109次满足IoU>0.85且体积误差<15%，仅打印修补块可省料93%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆受损部件整体更换成本高、耗时长，而大部分几何仍可用，存在"只修补缺失部分"的需求，因此需要判断缺失几何能否被可靠重建为可打印的修复补丁。

Method: 构建配对（完整模型 vs 合成缺损模型）的渲染观测流程，生成无噪声的彩色、深度与轮廓图像；用深度差异定位潜在缺失区域，再用多视角体素重建估计缺失体积；额外引入预训练DINOv2特征用于候选验证并考察其是否能提升重建；在20个汽车CAD模型、4种条件×2种方法共160次试验中，以体素IoU>0.85与绝对相对体积误差<15%双阈值评估。

Result: 160次试验中109次同时满足双阈值；仅几何重建在8视角下20个部件通过16个，4视角下仅通过10个；37次失败中24次源于在应为空区域错误添加多余材料；引入DINOv2未提升精度且使预测变慢；13个验证案例中仅打印修复段相较整件打印，中位数减少线材93.08%、打印时间89.39%。

Conclusion: 多视角体素几何重建在足够视角数下可支撑修复补丁生成，但视角稀疏时易过度添加材料；通用视觉特征（DINOv2）对该几何补全任务无增益；局部打印修复具有显著材料与时间收益。

Abstract: Due to supply constraints, replacing damaged automotive components can be expensive and time-consuming, while replacing the entire component can be wasteful when much of it remains usable. This paper presents a pipeline to investigate whether missing geometry can be reconstructed as a repair patch using paired observations of the intact models and synthetically damaged components. Noise-free color, depth, and silhouette images were produced using the camera viewpoints. Depth differences were then used to identify the potential missing regions, while multi-view voxel reconstruction was used to estimate the missing portion. A pretrained DINOv2 model was also added to validate missing candidates and determine whether pretrained visual features could improve reconstruction. We tested the pipeline on 20 automotive CAD models, each with a synthetically removed portion. Each model was tested under four different conditions using two reconstruction methods for a total of 160 trials. The predictions were compared with the missing geometry of the unchanged ground-truth using predefined thresholds of the voxel intersection-over-union over 0.85 and the absolute relative volume error less than 15%. Of the 160 experimental trials, 109 of them satisfied both thresholds. Geometry-only reconstruction passed 16 of 20 components with eight views but only 10 of 20 with four adjacent views. Further analysis showed that 24 out of the 37 failed reconstructions could be categorized as unsuccessful because extra material was incorrectly added to areas that should have been empty. The implementation of DINOv2 into the pipeline did not improve the overall reconstruction accuracy and made prediction generation slower. For 13 verified tests, printing only the repaired sections instead of the entire parts reduced filament use by 93.08% and printing time by 89.39% based on the median results.

</details>


### [49] [LoCo: Selective Local Competition for Discriminative Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10321)
*Zhuoming Li,Bo Han,Xiaoyu Wang,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LoCo 框架，将 OV-MLR 的重心从全局图文匹配转向局部预测，通过空间一致视觉编码器与 Selective Softmax 处理局部语义稀疏性，并配合多尺度推理与全局预测器集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开词汇多标签识别方法主要改进全局图文匹配或文本端表征，局部预测分支被严重忽视；作者观察到局部语义具有稀疏性——每个图像区域仅与少量概念相关，但不同粒度/类型的兼容概念可局部共存，因此若能处理好局部特征的空间一致性与兼容感知的局部竞争，局部预测可成为强判别分支。

Method: LoCo：空间一致的视觉编码器以降低局部特征纠缠；Selective Softmax 仅在局部不兼容类别间施加竞争、保留兼容响应；多尺度推理提升不同尺度的局部预测；可与现有全局预测器（如 DualPrompt）集成形成互补的图像级上下文。

Result: 在四个多标签基准上，独立 LoCo 相比 TagCLIP 平均 F1 与 mAP 分别提升 3.4% 和 3.8%；LoCo + DualPrompt 在对比方法中取得最高平均，较 TagCLIP 增益 4.8% 和 5.2%。

Conclusion: 局部语义稀疏性为设计更具判别力的开放词汇多标签识别方法提供了有效基础，局部预测分支具有被低估的潜力。

Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Multi-Label Recognition (OV-MLR) aims to identify all queried semantic concepts present in an image. Existing methods mainly improve global image-text matching or text-side representations, leaving local prediction largely under-explored. In this paper, we revisit local prediction and reveal that it can serve as a strong discriminative branch once two properties are properly handled: spatial consistency of local visual features and compatibility-aware local competition. This perspective is motivated by local semantic sparsity: each image region is related to only a small subset of queried concepts, while compatible concepts of different granularities or types may still coexist locally. We instantiate this perspective with LoCo, a selective Local Competition framework for OV-MLR. LoCo adopts a spatially consistent visual encoder to reduce local feature entanglement, and introduces Selective Softmax to impose competition only among locally incompatible categories while preserving compatible responses. Multi-scale inference further improves local prediction at different scales. LoCo can also be ensembled with an existing global predictor to provide complementary image-level context. Experiments on four multi-label benchmarks show that standalone LoCo improves average F1-score and mAP over TagCLIP by 3.4% and 3.8%, respectively. LoCo + DualPrompt achieves the highest averages among the compared methods, with gains of 4.8% and 5.2% over TagCLIP. Our results suggest that local semantic sparsity offers a useful basis for developing more discriminative open-vocabulary multi-label recognition methods. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [50] [TimeTraveler: Temporal Strategy Planning with Time Dictionary for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10337)
*Minkuk Kim,Junho Kim,Seong Tae Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TimeTraveler：用时间戳索引的结构化字幕构建"时间字典"，作为可查询的显式证据库，先对查询做时间策略规划（回忆过去／读取当前／等待未来），再执行策略化证据获取，用于流式视频问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解（SVU）需回答证据可能在过去、当前或未来的查询。现有流式系统依赖紧凑视觉记忆或固定证据访问机制，易丢失细粒度细节，且无法按每个查询的时间意图自适应调整答题过程。

Method: 将每个观测时刻存为时间戳索引的结构化字幕，形成可查询的"时间字典"；给定查询先判定时间策略（回溯过去／读取当前／等待未来），再执行策略专属的证据获取流程，最后由模型基于取回证据生成答案。

Result: 在流式视频 QA 基准上，对比实验显示该方法通过保留细粒度时间证据并为每个查询选择合适的时间策略，提升了流式问答性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 显式时间索引证据库＋查询级时间策略规划，是缓解流式视频记忆压缩与固定访问机制缺陷的有效范式，但其有效性仍主要在受限基准上验证。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires models to answer user queries over continuously evolving video streams. Unlike offline video QA, SVU must handle queries whose evidence may lie in the past, appear in the current scene, or emerge only after future observations. Existing streaming video systems often rely on compact visual memories or fixed evidence-access schemes, which can lose fine-grained details and fail to adapt the answering process to the temporal intent of each query. In this paper, we propose TimeTraveler, a streaming VQA framework that performs temporal strategy planning with a Time Dictionary. Inspired by the need to search across different temporal regions of a stream, TimeTraveler stores each observed moment as a timestamp-indexed structured caption and uses this dictionary as an explicit source of queryable evidence. Given a query, TimeTraveler determines whether to recall past evidence, read the present context, or wait for future observations, and then applies a strategy-specific evidence acquisition process. Comparative experiments on streaming video QA benchmarks show that TimeTraveler improves streaming question answering by preserving fine-grained temporal evidence and selecting the appropriate temporal strategy for each query. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [51] [MaRiO: Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning via Shared Observations in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10344)
*Nathaniel Redmond,Fidel Omar Tito Cruz,Devansh Sharma,Shehreen Azad,Sirshapan Mitra,Shruti Vyas,Yogesh S. Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MaRiO 基准，评测 23 个 MLLM 在独立视角多智能体协作推理上的能力，发现跨视角对应与几何线索利用是主要瓶颈，并尝试几何引导的合成视角增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 评测集中于单视角或共享相机参数的多视角设定，缺乏对多智能体从各自独立视角观测同一环境并进行协作推理这一具身场景的评估。

Method: 构建 MaRiO 多智能体协作推理基准，在 23 个 SOTA MLLM 上进行系统评测；分析任务类型（静态感知 vs. 变换事件序列）、跨智能体对应求解与几何线索利用；并初步探索基于几何的合成视角增强，在智能体观测之间生成中间过渡帧以提供辅助空间上下文。

Result: 静态感知任务普遍易于变换事件序列任务；多数模型难以建立跨智能体对应，错误率随场景复杂度上升；模型对场景中几何线索利用不足；合成视角增强在部分任务类别上带来性能提升。

Conclusion: 多智能体协作推理仍是开放难题，是面向多模态具身系统的重要方向；几何引导的视角增强是可行的初步改进手段。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong visual perception capabilities, but existing evaluations largely focus on single-view or multi-view settings with shared camera parameters, leaving the challenge of multi-agent collaborative scenarios underexplored. In such settings, multiple agents observe a shared environment from independent viewpoints, and reliable decisions require reasoning across these independent observations of the same environment. To study this problem, we introduce MaRiO, a benchmark for evaluating multi-agent collaborative reasoning, and evaluate 23 state-of-the-art MLLMs on it. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) tasks governed by static perception are generally easier than tasks that require transformational event sequences; (2) most models struggle to resolve cross-agent correspondences, with errors increasing with scene complexity; and (3) models show limited ability to leverage geometric cues present in the scene. As an initial step toward addressing these challenges, we explore geometry-guided synthetic view augmentation that generates intermediate transition frames between agent observations, providing auxiliary spatial context that improves performance in certain categories. Overall, our results highlight that multi-agent collaborative reasoning remains an open challenge and an important direction for multimodal embodied systems. The code is available on the project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [52] [PoseBench: Probing Pose Awareness in Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10347)
*Most Nilufa Yeasmin,Draix Wyatt,Ruyi Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PoseBench系统评测31个2D视觉基础模型检查点的位姿感知，发现其为隐式但非均匀属性，位姿图精化可稳定挖掘该结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大规模预训练的2D视觉基础模型在缺乏显式3D/位姿监督的情况下，其特征空间是否隐式呈现与物体位姿流形对齐的“位姿感知”结构，以判断此类特征能否用于位姿敏感的3D视觉任务。

Method: 提出PoseBench基准：采用渐进式评测设计，先用留出渲染视图在受控条件下探测内在位姿感知结构，再用真实图像查询评估该结构在真实变化下的可访问稳健性；并引入基于位姿图的特征精化作为辅助探针，检验特征邻域与底层层位姿流形的一致性。共评估10个预训练家族、31个公开检查点。

Result: 位姿感知是2D视觉基础模型的隐式但非均匀属性；位姿图精化在各检查点上带来一致增益，说明特征空间保留了与位姿流形兼容的结构。

Conclusion: PoseBench为理解并选择位姿敏感3D视觉任务所需的预训练特征提供了系统化依据，但本身为分析型基准，未提出新的训练或推理方法。

Abstract: Pose awareness characterizes the extent to which a learned feature space aligns with the underlying object-pose manifold, such that observations with similar poses exhibit greater feature similarity than those with increasingly different poses. While such structure is desirable for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks, visual foundation models pre-trained on individual 2D images typically lack explicit 3D or pose supervision. This raises a fundamental question: Do 2D visual foundation models exhibit pose awareness after large-scale pretraining? To answer this question, we introduce PoseBench, a systematic benchmark to probe pose awareness in pretrained visual features. Our evaluation follows a progressive design: held-out rendered views probe intrinsic pose-aware structure under controlled conditions, while real-image queries evaluate how robustly this structure remains accessible under real-world variations. We further introduce pose-graph-based refinement as a complementary probe of compatibility between feature neighborhoods and the underlying pose manifold. Across 31 publicly available checkpoints from 10 pretraining families, PoseBench reveals that pose awareness is an implicit but non-uniform property of 2D visual foundation models, and consistent gains from pose-graph refinement suggest that feature spaces retain structure compatible with the underlying pose manifold. PoseBench therefore provides a systematic basis for understanding and selecting pretrained features for pose-sensitive 3D vision tasks.

</details>


### [53] [Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating for Multimodal Medical Data Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10348)
*Muntaqim Ahmed Raju,Priyanka Siddappa,Md Shifat Haider Al Amin,Ruizhe Ma,Md Ripon Ahammed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating多模态融合框架：token级引导 + 双向交叉注意力 + 样本自适应门控，在胸片-报告配对数据上做二分类达96.05%准确率、98.37% AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态融合不仅要跨模态交换信息，还需确定哪些表征参与交互、以及互补的跨模态视角如何组合；作者认为交互方向、token相关性与样本依赖的整合方式需要被显式建模。

Method: 构造两个方向性表征：文本token查询视觉特征的image-conditioned text表征，以及反向的text-conditioned image表征；在交叉注意力前用token级引导调制表征；再用自适应门控为每个样本学习两路方向表征的相对权重。

Result: 两个交叉注意力方向性能特征不同，说明交换query与source模态并非可互换；消融显示双向交互、自适应门控与token引导收益互补；整体取得96.05% Acc、96.10% F1、98.37% AUC、95.60% Sens@95Spec、96.51% Spec@95Sens，全部指标平均最高。

Conclusion: 构建多模态表征时应显式建模交互方向、token相关性与样本相关的融合权重。

Abstract: Multimodal fusion requires not only exchanging information across modalities but also determining which representations should participate in the interaction and how complementary cross-modal views should be combined. We introduce Guided Co-Attention with Adaptive Gating, a fusion framework that integrates token-wise guidance, bidirectional cross-attention, and sample-specific fusion. The proposed method constructs two directional representations: an image-conditioned text representation, obtained by allowing textual tokens to query visual features, and a text-conditioned image representation formed in the reverse direction. Token-wise guidance modulates the representations before cross-attention, while an adaptive gate learns the relative contribution of the two resulting directional representations for each sample. We evaluate the approach using paired chest radiographs and radiology reports as an image-text test bed for binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification. The two cross-attention directions exhibit distinct performance characteristics, demonstrating that reversing the query and source modalities does not produce interchangeable representations. Ablation experiments further show that bidirectional interaction, adaptive gating, and token guidance provide complementary benefits. The proposed model achieves 96.05% accuracy, 96.10% F1-score, 98.37% AUC, 95.60% Sens@95Spec, and 96.51% Spec@95Sens, yielding the highest mean performance across all evaluated metrics. These findings support explicitly modeling interaction direction, token relevance, and sample-dependent integration when constructing multimodal representations.

</details>


### [54] [DAPointRWKV: Domain Adaptive Vision RWKV for Point Cloud Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10353)
*Yinghui Li,Qianyu Zhou,Hao Yang,Richard Dazeley,Ye Zhu,Xuequan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DAPointRWKV：将 RWKV 线性复杂度序列建模引入域自适应点云补全（DA PCC），由几何感知 RWKV 主干、渐进式解码器与双结构正则三部分组成，在合成与真实基准上超越 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DA PCC 方法（CNN/Transformer/Mamba 类）存在感受野有限、计算复杂度高、几何偏置不足、序列化敏感等问题；RWKV 虽具线性复杂度长程建模能力，但直接迁移到 DA PCC 面临三大障碍：缺乏显式几何先验、循环建模与由粗到细生成过程不匹配、目标域自适应不稳定。

Method: 三模块框架：(1) GA-RWKV 主干，引入几何感知的循环表示学习；(2) RWKV-PD 渐进式解码器，通过局部 token 引导的细化把 RWKV 序列 token 表示与由粗到细重建相衔接；(3) DSR 双结构正则，用可见结构锚定与完整形状假设稳定化来约束目标域迁移。

Result: 在合成与真实世界点云补全基准上，DAPointRWKV 一致优于现有 SOTA 方法（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: 以几何偏置注入 + 渐进解码 + 对比/假设式正则的组合，可有效将线性复杂度 RWKV 用于跨域点云补全，为无需目标域标签的形状补全提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Domain adaptive point cloud completion (DA PCC) aims to bridge the geometric discrepancy between labeled source domains and unlabeled target domains for accurate 3D shape completion. Existing methods based on CNNs, Transformers, and Mamba-like sequence models still face challenges from limited receptive fields, high computational complexity, insufficient geometric bias, and serialization sensitivity. Recently, Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) provides a linear-complexity alternative for long-range sequence modeling. However, adapting RWKV to DA PCC remains challenging due to the lack of explicit geometric priors, the mismatch between recurrent modeling and coarse-to-fine generation, and unstable target-domain adaptation. To address these challenges, we propose DAPointRWKV, a novel RWKV-based framework for DA PCC. DAPointRWKV consists of three components: Geometry-Aware RWKV (GA-RWKV) Backbone, RWKV-Oriented Progressive Decoder (RWKV-PD), and Dual Structural Regularization (DSR). Specifically, GA-RWKV introduces geometry-aware recurrent representation learning, RWKV-PD bridges RWKV token representations with coarse-to-fine reconstruction through local token-guided refinement, and DSR stabilizes target-domain transfer through visible-structure anchoring and complete-shape hypothesis stabilization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DAPointRWKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [55] [ClearForm: Shared-Surface Gaussian Splatting for Transparent and Opaque Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10370)
*Hajeong Lee,Jong-Il Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ClearForm：基于共享平面高斯（shared planar Gaussian）的透明界面重建方法，显式分析并缓解"几何-外观合成困境"（GACD），通过双不透明度合成与 Dual-Evidence Lifecycle 同时恢复玻璃界面几何与透过它的场景外观。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透明界面重建需在大部分观测颜色来自背后场景的情况下恢复玻璃表面。作者指出同一依赖透明度的 alpha 同时控制颜色与几何，导致"看到背景"会削弱透明表面对几何重建的贡献，从而损害基于平面的深度估计与界面支撑。

Method: 1) 形式化分析 GACD 对平面深度估计的影响并做受控对比量化界面支撑损失；2) 提出几何保持的双不透明度表面重建：共享平面高斯在几何合成中保留界面贡献，在 RGB 中建模透射与稀疏反射，并加入透明度感知几何约束；3) 引入 Dual-Evidence Lifecycle（DEL），保留由多视图几何或 RGB 证据支撑的高斯图元，以适配两种合成器对图元可见性的不同需求。

Result: 3D-FRONT-T 上 CD 27.05 mm、F1 0.928（对比自复现 PGSR 的 59.18 mm CD、GLINT 的 34 mm/0.836）；TransLab 上 CD 1.65 mm、F1 0.963、PSNR 40.14 dB。匹配消融中双不透明度合成将 CD 从 59.25 降至 27.09 mm，DEL 提升 PSNR 2.06 dB。

Conclusion: 显式分离几何与外观的透明合成是解决透明界面重建中证据冲突的关键，双不透明度合成与证据生命周期机制在合成与真实透明场景上均带来显著几何与外观增益。

Abstract: Transparent-interface reconstruction must recover glass surfaces even when most observed color comes from the scene behind them. We present ClearForm, a shared-planar-Gaussian method for jointly reconstructing transparent interfaces and the appearance seen through them. We identify and analyze the Geometry-Appearance Compositing Dilemma (GACD): when the same transparency-dependent alpha controls both color and geometry, revealing the background can weaken a transparent surface's contribution to geometric reconstruction. We derive its effect on plane-based depth estimation, identify a mechanism that can weaken geometric learning, and quantify the loss of interface support through controlled comparisons. To address this conflict, we develop geometry-preserving dual-opacity surface reconstruction. Shared planar Gaussians retain interface contributions in geometry compositing while modeling transmission and sparse reflection in RGB, supported by transparency-aware geometric constraints. To manage the different primitive-visibility requirements of these compositors, we introduce Dual-Evidence Lifecycle (DEL), which retains Gaussians supported by multi-view geometry or RGB reconstruction evidence. On 3D-FRONT-T, ClearForm achieves 27.05 mm Chamfer distance (CD) and 0.928 F1, compared with 59.18 mm CD for our PGSR reproduction and the reported 34 mm CD and 0.836 F1 for GLINT. On TransLab, it achieves 1.65 mm CD, 0.963 F1, and 40.14 dB PSNR. In matched ablations, dual-opacity compositing reduces CD from 59.25 to 27.09 mm, while DEL improves PSNR by 2.06 dB. Our project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [56] [PhysDNet: Physics-Driven Gradient Amplification for Real-Time Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10376)
*Rayen Dhahri,Lei Sun,Victor Javier Kartsch Morinigo,Alice Pagnoux,Luca Benini,Danda Pani Paudel,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDNet：融合NIR与稀疏LiDAR深度的轻量多模态去雾网络，通过可微Koschmieder逆变换的物理约束双头训练实现密度自适应梯度放大，在保证实时边缘部署的同时提升去雾与恢复检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去雾网络计算开销大且过拟合合成雾，难以在资源受限的边缘设备上实时部署，需要高效高保真的恢复方法。

Method: 轻量多模态架构，融合近红外图像与稀疏LiDAR深度；采用物理约束双头目标训练；对固定Koschmieder反演进行可微求导，产生密度自适应梯度放大，作为隐式资源分配机制把学习集中到重度退化区域而不增加推理成本。提供S/M/L多规格变体。

Result: 在Seeing Through Fog基准上比竞争者高1.67 dB，计算量低5.2倍，恢复54.9%的雾致检测损失；消融与跨域评估显示物理引导训练提升泛化（包括违背Koschmieder假设的非均匀雾）；兼容固定功能NPU，S/M/L在<4W功耗下分别达29/45/99 FPS；开源代码与权重。

Conclusion: 物理引导的多模态轻量去雾可在边缘端实时部署，兼顾精度、泛化与能效，但并非机器人操控/3D重建核心方向。

Abstract: Modern dehazing networks are often computationally expensive and overfit to synthetic haze, limiting real-time deployment. This underscores an urgent demand for efficient, high-fidelity restoration methods that can operate on resource-constrained edge devices in practical, dynamic environments. We introduce PhysDNet, a lightweight multimodal architecture that fuses NIR imagery with sparse LiDAR depth and is trained with a physics-constrained dual-head objective. Differentiating through a fixed Koschmieder inversion induces density-adaptive gradient amplification, acting as an implicit resource allocation mechanism that concentrates learning on heavily degraded regions without increasing inference cost. PhysDNet delivers superior restoration with minimal capacity and enhanced training efficiency, facilitating real-time deployment on edge devices without increasing inference overhead. On the Seeing Through Fog benchmark, PhysDNet outperforms competitors by 1.67 dB at 5.2 times lower compute while recovering 54.9% of fog-induced detection loss. Ablations and cross-domain evaluations show that physics-guided training improves generalization, including under non-homogeneous haze that violates the Koschmieder assumption. PhysDNet further demonstrates compatibility with fixed-function NPUs, running at 29/45/99 FPS at <4 W across L/M/S variants. Code, deployment scripts and pre-trained checkpoints are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [57] [Vision Language Models for Primary Structure Threat Identification in Wildland Urban Interface Fires](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10377)
*Zhangding Liu,Neda Mohammadi,John E. Taylor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct zero-shot for structure-level fire threat identification during active WUI fires on two tracks (1,824 synthetic images from 491 designed scenarios; 45 controlled-burn frames), reporting 94.0% and 69.2% accuracy among valid outputs.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WUI fires threaten communities, but prior VLM work focuses on fire detection and post-event damage assessment; structure-level threat identification during active fire events is underexplored and needs rapid visual assessment.

Method: Dual-track zero-shot evaluation protocol: synthetic WUI scenario images plus controlled-burn frames collected with Columbus Fire & EMS, scored separately, compared against a random-selection baseline, with error analysis of spatial-relation failures.

Result: Valid fields on 1,808/1,824 synthetic images and 39/45 controlled-burn frames; 94.0% vs 69.2% accuracy among valid outputs; 16.0% random baseline on controlled-burn. Errors concentrate on spatial relations in complex scenes.

Conclusion: VLM-based active-fire threat decisions are promising but degrade in real scenes; synthetic data may serve for post-training, followed by evaluation on larger, more diverse real WUI datasets.

Abstract: Wildland urban interface (WUI) fires increasingly threaten communities and infrastructure, motivating the need for rapid visual assessment. Recent research has focused primarily on detecting fire and assessing post-event damage. However, structure-level fire threat identification during active WUI fire events remains underexplored. This study evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for this active-fire decision using two separately scored tracks: 1,824 synthetic images from 491 designed WUI scenarios and 45 frames from a controlled-burn experiment conducted in collaboration with Columbus Fire & EMS Department. Under zero-shot prompting, the model returned valid target fields for 1,808 synthetic images and 39 controlled-burn frames. Accuracy among valid outputs was 94.0% for the synthetic track and 69.2% for the controlled-burn track, compared with a 16.0% random-selection baseline for the latter. On the synthetic track, the model generally identified the intended target across varied designed WUI scenarios when the relevant fire-spread cues were visually distinct. Controlled-burn performance was well above random selection, but errors showed difficulty interpreting spatial relations in complex scenes. The dual-track protocol provides scalable stress testing in designed scenarios and a controlled-burn reference for assessing model behavior under physical fire conditions. Future work can use the synthetic data for VLM post-training and then evaluate the adapted models on larger and more diverse real WUI fire datasets.

</details>


### [58] [RefineSplat: Reconstruction-Guided Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10379)
*Yiren Lu,Disheng Liu,Sreya Srinidhi,Yunlai Zhou,Yiran Qiao,Chaoda Song,Tuo Liang,Jing Ma,Huan Wang,Yu Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineSplat extends the Segment-then-Splat paradigm for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by tracking objects in 2D, reconstructing each with dedicated 3D Gaussians (explicit object-Gaussian correspondence), adding a reconstruction-guided feedback loop to refine tracker masks via rendered masks and multi-view consistency, and using view-clustered per-object language embeddings; also introduces Blender-OVS benchmark.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 splat-then-segment 流程存在视角不一致、物体边界模糊、物体级对应弱的问题，尤其在复杂静态与动态场景中。

Method: 在 Segment-then-Splat 基础上：先 2D 跟踪物体，再为每个物体用一组独立 3D Gaussians 重建，保持物体-Gaussian 显式对应；引入重建引导反馈，用渲染掩码与多视角一致性修正不可靠的跟踪掩码；提出视角感知嵌入分配，为每个物体维护多视角聚类语言嵌入；构建含精确网格与点云的静态/动态合成基准 Blender-OVS。

Result: 静态与动态基准上渲染视角分割提升、物体级 Chamfer 距离降低，场景重建质量具竞争力。

Conclusion: 闭环 2D 跟踪与 3D 重建的物体中心范式可提升开放词汇 3D 分割/检索的鲁棒性与几何精度，但仍以基准评测为主，缺少真实场景泛化与机器人应用验证。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment and retrieve arbitrary objects in 3D scenes using natural language queries. Most existing methods typically follow a splat-then-segment paradigm, where 3D Gaussian Splatting is first reconstructed and then augmented with labels or language features for subsequent segmentation. However, this pipeline often suffers from view inconsistency, ambiguous object boundaries, and weak object-level correspondence, especially in complex static and dynamic scenes. Building on our prior Segment-then-Splat framework, we present RefineSplat, a reconstruction-guided extension that retains its object-centric paradigm: it first tracks objects in 2D and then reconstructs each object with a dedicated set of 3D Gaussians, preserving explicit object-Gaussian correspondence for unified open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval. To improve robustness, we further close the loop between 2D tracking and 3D reconstruction. Since off-the-shelf video trackers can produce unreliable masks that propagate errors into object reconstruction, we introduce a reconstruction-guided feedback mechanism that refines object tracking using rendered masks and multi-view consistency. Moreover, instead of assigning each object a single language embedding, we propose a viewpoint-aware embedding assignment strategy, where each object maintains multiple view-clustered embeddings to capture view-dependent semantic cues. We also introduce Blender-OVS, a synthetic benchmark of static and dynamic sequences with exact object meshes and point clouds, enabling direct evaluation of extracted geometry. Experiments on static and dynamic benchmarks show improved rendered-view segmentation and lower object-level Chamfer distances, with competitive scene reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [59] [From Reflection to Co-Evolution: Self-Evolving Agents with Locally Verified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10382)
*Xinxiang Yin,Xinglang Zhang,Haodong Chen,Zhiqing Cui,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Wang,Junrui Wang,Jingyi Zhang,Jianfeng Zhang,Jian Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Anchor：通过"回放源决策"测试候选记忆的分布偏移幅度与源动作角色对齐（成功/失败），过滤后引导冻结策略的LLM智能体，ALFWorld/WebShop成功率最高提升19.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程交互中学到的记忆常冗余，甚至强化不当动作；需要一种实用判据决定记忆是否值得保留。

Method: 定位轨迹中关键步骤并抽取候选记忆；在同一上下文下对该源决策做有/无候选记忆的对比回放，得到两个观察：多数候选几乎不改变被探测分布；成功与失败的源动作都可能被强化或抑制。据此Anchor在保留前同时检验偏移幅度与源角色对齐。

Result: 在留出的ALFWorld与WebShop上，相对各骨干最强基线成功率与平均分分别提升至多19.9%与17.2%；Qwen3.5-27B下ALFWorld保留的记忆卡减少41%，WebShop以更少token超越全部四个成本对比基线。

Conclusion: 以"源决策回放"作为记忆保留的实用检验，可在冻结策略下实现经验驱动的持续改进，且更节省记忆与token。

Abstract: LLM agents have made impressive progress in coding and mathematical reasoning, motivating growing interest in learning from long-horizon interaction. Memory supports this process, but plausible lessons can be redundant or reinforce inappropriate actions. Can a memory's source decision provide a practical test for whether to retain it? We localize consequential trajectory steps, extract candidate memories, and replay each source decision with and without its candidate under the same context. This reveals two properties: most candidates barely shift the probed distribution, and both successful and failed source actions can be reinforced or suppressed. These observations motivate Anchor, which tests shift magnitude and source-role alignment before retention. Admitted memories guide later trajectories, enabling experience-driven improvement under a frozen policy. On held-out ALFWorld and WebShop tasks, Anchor improves success rate and mean score by up to 19.9% and 17.2%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for each backbone. With Qwen3.5-27B, it retains 41% fewer ALFWorld cards than unfiltered retention and outperforms all four WebShop cost-comparison baselines while using fewer tokens.

</details>


### [60] [Tiresias: Towards Language-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10392)
*Fengyi Wu,Yifei Dong,Yetong Sha,Lingdong Kong,Qiyu Hu,Bohan Xiong,Qi Dai,Alexander G. Hauptmann,Zhi-Qi Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一任务LCWM（语言指令+初始视角观测→动作序列），构建集成15个数据集、14.3万条轨迹、42.9万条指令的跨域基准LCWM-Bench（导航/机器人/3D游戏/驾驶），并提出Tiresias智能体：扩散策略生成候选轨迹→轨迹排序器初筛→视频预训练世界模型想象视觉后果→视觉排序器复评选优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言条件的的世界模型研究在不同动作空间、数据集和评测协议下高度碎片化，缺乏统一的任务定义与可比评测平台。

Method: Tiresias采用"选择性想象"式规划：语言条件扩散策略产生候选轨迹；轨迹排序器shortlist；视频预训练世界模型对候选进行视觉rollout想象；视觉排序器结合轨迹分数联合评估，选出最终规划。

Result: 在LCWM-Bench上取得有竞争力的规划与想象性能；消融实验表明轨迹排序与视觉验证互补；替换候选生成方法后训练好的排序器仍有效，具备一定泛化性。

Conclusion: LCWM-Bench与Tiresias为语言引导的世界模型规划提供了统一评测环境与有效起点，推动了跨域语言条件世界建模的标准化研究。

Abstract: World models enable planning through internal simulation, while natural language provides intuitive task specification. Yet, language-conditioned world modeling remains fragmented across domains with disparate action spaces, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce LCWM, a shared task that maps an initial agent-view observation and a language instruction to an action sequence that fulfills the instruction. Its accompanying benchmark, LCWM-Bench, integrates 15 datasets across navigation, robotics, 3D gaming, and driving under a shared action interface and evaluation protocol, pairing 142,987 episodes with 428,961 instructions in three styles. We further propose Tiresias, an agent that plans via selective imagination: a language-conditioned diffusion policy generates candidate trajectories, a trajectory ranker shortlists them, and a video-pretrained world model imagines their visual consequences. A visual ranker evaluates these rollouts, complementing trajectory scores to select the final plan. Tiresias achieves competitive planning and imagination performance on LCWM-Bench. Ablations demonstrate the complementary benefits of trajectory ranking and visual verification, while experiments with alternative proposal methods show that the trained rankers remain effective beyond our diffusion policy. Together, LCWM-Bench and Tiresias provide a unified evaluation setting and an effective starting point for studying language-guided planning through world models.

</details>


### [61] [Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling for Hyperspectral Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10413)
*Song Qiya,Tian Siyu,Li Shutao,Dian Renwei,Sun Long,Liu Jinyang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频率-结构互补建模网络FSCM-Net，用傅里叶交互注意力做空谱频域校准、用结构张量引导动态卷积做局部细化，多尺度编解码融合高光谱与多光谱图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HSI-MSI融合方法依赖卷积聚合或注意力空间-光谱交互：特征域注意力难以显式刻画沿空间token与潜通道坐标的变化模式，而空间共享的局部算子无法按异质结构自适应调整邻域聚合。

Method: SSFCA模块：由傅里叶交互的query-key表示构建空间token亲和度，并在学习到的通道坐标上做输入条件频率滤波后构建潜通道亲和度，再用共享增益校准并与空间响应融合；SC-DFF模块：用MSI结构张量正则化线索与上下文调制的HSI细节表示生成通道与位置相关的聚合核；两模块在多尺度编解码器中渐进集成。

Result: 在两个模拟基准和一个真实遥感数据集上，相比代表性融合方法在空间细节重建与光谱保真方面取得更好性能。

Conclusion: 频率感知依赖学习与结构自适应局部细化的互补设计可有效提升HSI-MSI融合质量；但仅验证遥感场景，缺乏代码与真实部署证据。

Abstract: Existing methods mainly rely on convolutional aggregation or attention-based spatial-spectral interaction. However, conventional feature-domain attention does not explicitly characterize variation patterns along spatial-token and learned latent-channel coordinates, while spatially shared local operators lack the flexibility to adapt neighborhood aggregation to heterogeneous structures. To address these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Structure Complementary Modeling Network (FSCM-Net), which couples frequency-aware dependency learning with structure-adaptive local refinement. Specifically, a Spatial-Spectral Frequency Calibration Attention (SSFCA) module constructs spatial-token affinities from Fourier-interacted query-key representations and builds latent-channel affinities after input-conditioned frequency filtering along learned channel coordinates. The latent-channel response is then calibrated by a learned shared gain and combined with the spatial-token response. Complementarily, a Structure-Coherent Dynamic Feature Fusion (SC-DFF) module combines regularized structure-tensor cues from MSI features with context-modulated HSI detail representations to generate channel- and position-dependent aggregation kernels. This design makes local HSI refinement responsive to smooth regions, edges, and textures while maintaining spectral fidelity. The two modules are progressively integrated within a multiscale encoder-decoder to coordinate representation-level interaction and structure-adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on two simulated benchmarks and one real remote-sensing dataset demonstrate favorable performance against representative fusion methods in spatial detail reconstruction and spectral preservation.

</details>


### [62] [S2HAND: Accuracy-Preservation Trade-Offs for Hand Specialization in Whole-Body Pose Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10416)
*Singyu Muk,Xuanren Song,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S2HAND 基于 Sapiens2-5B 构建手部专用分支：MT 版仅新增 0.87M 参数热图路由以严格保持其余 268 个关键点；Pose 版微调三个 Fisher 选出的 Transformer 块（267.13M），将宏 AUC 从 57.83% 提升到 65.73%，COCO 手部 AP 提升 12.89。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一全身姿态估计器在小型、模糊、遮挡手上性能退化，而外接独立手部专家会带来额外检测开销、坐标对齐与手腕拼接伪影。

Method: S2HAND-MT 用 0.87M 参数的轻量姿态分支输出 40 张手指热图，共享 Transformer 与辅助任务头保持 268 个身体/足/脸热图不变；S2HAND-Pose 进一步微调三个 Fisher 选择的 Transformer 块；可选 TailGuard 再裁剪模块处理严重失败案例。

Result: 跨 HInt TEST、COCO WholeBody VAL、FreiHAND EVAL 宏 AUC 57.83%→65.73%；在五个 Native Pipeline 基准上超过 HInt 适配的 Hand5/HRNet 与拼接式 Hand5；COCO 手部 AP +12.89、身体+足 AP +0.19；512 图多任务审计中前景分割与公开权重一致率 99.60%，并量化了 normal 与 pointmap 漂移；2D 坐标降低冻结 Pose2Mesh 的 3D 网格误差；TailGuard 将 NewDays 严重失败率 13.45%→10.43%。

Conclusion: 通过"精确保持非手部输出（MT）"或"经实证审计的权衡（Pose）"两条路线，在原生 308 关键点接口内解决全身模型的手部瓶颈，可作为人体/手部先验模块接入上游流程。

Abstract: Unified whole-body pose estimators jointly predict body, face, and hand landmarks, but often degrade on small, blurred, or occluded hands. Attaching a standalone hand specialist introduces extra detection overhead, coordinate alignment, and wrist-stitching artifacts. We introduce S2HAND, a hand-specialized Sapiens2-5B framework that preserves the native 308-keypoint output interface. Specifically, S2HAND-MT adapts a lightweight 0.87M-parameter pose branch to route 40 finger heatmaps while strictly preserving the shared Transformer, auxiliary task heads, and the other 268 body, foot, and face heatmaps. S2HAND-Pose further fine-tunes three Fisher-selected Transformer blocks (267.13M parameters), trading exact preservation for stronger hand recovery: it lifts macro AUC from 57.83% to 65.73% across HInt TEST, COCO WholeBody VAL, and FreiHAND EVAL, and surpasses HInt-adapted Hand5/HRNet and stitched Hand5 systems on all five Native Pipeline benchmarks. On COCO, S2HAND-Pose improves hand AP by 12.89 points and body-plus-foot AP by 0.19 points. Across a 512-image multi-task audit, it maintains 99.60% foreground segmentation agreement with the public checkpoint, with quantified normal and pointmap drift. Its 2D coordinates also lower 3D mesh error in frozen Pose2Mesh transfer, while our optional TailGuard re-cropping module cuts S2HAND-MT's severe failure rate on NewDays from 13.45% to 10.43%. S2HAND thus resolves the whole-body hand bottleneck with either exact non-hand preservation (MT) or empirically audited trade-offs (Pose).

</details>


### [63] [Mental Imagery That Matters: Curing Latent Collapse in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10423)
*Mi Luo,Rohan Dugad,Zihui Xue,Alex Dimakis,Kristen Grauman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文通过扰动分析揭示潜在多模态推理模型的"心理模拟崩塌"(MSC)：生成的视觉潜变量几乎不影响答案，答案相关计算主要走文本通路；并指出该现象源于现有训练目标，提出对比蒸馏框架 AnchorSim 强制模型依赖视觉潜变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在多模态推理（文本与连续视觉潜块交错）被视为实现"心理模拟"能力的路径，但作者质疑生成的视觉潜状态是否真的被模型使用。已有工作只证明潜变量看起来像图像嵌入，却未验证其对最终预测的因果作用。

Method: 1) 对代表性潜在推理 MLLM 做直接扰动分析（丢弃/替换/打乱视觉潜变量 vs. 扰动语言推理轨迹），比较对最终答案概率的影响；2) 理论诊断：视觉对齐目标只让潜变量接近辅助图像嵌入，不要求解码器依赖它们，后续纯文本监督使潜通路的语义角色不可辨识；3) 提出 AnchorSim：基于对比蒸馏的训练框架，使生成的视觉潜变量对输出具有因果作用（anchored）。

Result: 扰动实验显示视觉潜变量扰动对答案概率影响很小，而文本轨迹扰动影响显著，证实 MSC 广泛存在。AnchorSim 在多个视觉推理基准上提升性能，且诊断性重评估显示视觉扰动此时能显著改变预测。

Conclusion: 潜在视觉推理存在结构性失效模式，仅"看起来在推理"不等于真的使用视觉工作空间；必须将心理模拟锚定到模型行为上，才使其真正起作用。提供了诊断方法与可操作的训练修正方案。

Abstract: Mental simulation, the ability to reason by constructing and updating internal visual states, is central to flexible human cognition, but remains elusive in current multimodal large language models. Latent multimodal reasoning offers a promising route toward this capability by interleaving text with continuous visual latent blocks, allowing models to maintain internal visual workspaces without decoding them into pixels. In this paper, we ask whether these latent visual states actually matter. Through a direct perturbation analysis across representative latent-reasoning MLLMs, we find that they often do not: dropping, replacing, or shuffling generated visual latents has only minor effects on the model's own final-answer probability, while equivalent perturbations to the linguistic reasoning trace are substantially more damaging. We call this failure mode Mental Simulation Collapse (MSC): the model appears to perform interleaved visual reasoning, but routes most answer-relevant computation through text. We further diagnose that MSC follows naturally from existing training objectives: visual alignment can make generated latents resemble helper-image embeddings, but it does not require the decoder to rely on them; subsequent text-only supervision further leaves the semantic role of the latent pathway unidentifiable. To address this, we introduce AnchorSim (Anchored Mental Simulation), a contrastive distillation framework that trains models to make their generated visual latents consequential. Across multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, AnchorSim improves performance, while diagnostic re-evaluation shows that visual perturbations now meaningfully affect predictions. Our results expose a fundamental failure mode of latent multimodal reasoning and demonstrate that mental simulation must be anchored to model behavior in order to matter.

</details>


### [64] [Split and Bridge: Multimodal Generation via Diffusion Bridging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10441)
*Ahmad Arrabi,Xiaohan Zhang,Xingyu Li,Safwan Wshah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SnB 提出自底向上的多模态生成框架：在采样时将多个预训练单模态扩散模型沿共享扩散轨迹耦合，先共享至分割点再分叉，由 bridge 模块引导，实现免联合训练的即插即用生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态生成多采用自顶向下范式，从头联合训练共享隐变量，需要大规模多模态配对数据且难以扩展、复用已有强预训练模型。作者希望用无需联合训练的方式获得一致且高质量的多模态样本。

Method: 以下采样采样期耦合为核心：多个预训练单模态扩散模型在采样前段沿同一共享扩散轨迹（到 split point），之后分叉为各模态专属轨迹，并由 bridge 模块在分叉阶段引导模态间一致性。方法不学习统一隐空间，因而保持各模型的即插即用性，可扩展到新模态组合。

Result: 在 PolyMNIST、CelebAMask-HQ 及更复杂的 PIE-Bench++、ROCO 上取得样本质量与跨模态一致性的良好平衡；并自然扩展到零样本交错联合生成、图像编辑、风格耦合/解耦等下游任务。

Conclusion: 自底向上、推理期耦合的生成范式可作为自顶向下多模态方法的实用补充，兼具可扩展性与模型复用的灵活性和良好的一致性表现。

Abstract: Visual data are often expressed through multiple complementary modalities (e.g., images and segmentation masks), each capturing different aspects of the same underlying structure. Most existing multimodal methods adopt a top-down paradigm, learning a shared latent variable through joint training from scratch, which limits scalability. We propose Split and Bridge (SnB), a bottom-up framework for multimodal generation that couples pretrained unimodal diffusion models at sampling time. Rather than learning a unified latent space, SnB generates coherent multimodal samples by following a shared diffusion trajectory up to a split point and then branching into modality-specific trajectories guided by a bridge module. This design enables plug-and-play reuse of powerful pretrained models without joint training, making it scalable and easily adaptable. Across standard benchmarks (PolyMNIST, CelebAMask-HQ) and more complex settings (PIE-Bench++, ROCO), SnB achieves a strong balance between sample quality and coherence. We show that SnB naturally extends to downstream zero-shot tasks such as interleaved co-generation, image editing, and style coupling/decoupling. Our results demonstrate that bottom-up generation provides a practical framework that complements existing top-down multimodal approaches. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [65] [ESTRA: Enabling Extreme Attention Sparsity for Training-Free Video Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10448)
*Enhuai Liu,Yunke Wang,Yutong Wang,Changming Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ESTRA: a training-free extreme-sparse attention method for video diffusion transformers, combining query clustering, cluster representatives, and variance-based correction to preserve fidelity at 1-5% attention density with up to 5.39x speedup.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Video DiT inference is expensive due to quadratic attention over long spatiotemporal sequences; existing training-free sparse attention degrades sharply at high sparsity, limiting achievable speedup.

Method: Training-free sparse attention: compute exact attention for a small set of important KV tokens; approximate the rest via cluster representatives; group similar queries and use their representatives to score keys efficiently; apply variance-based correction to refine representative attention weights.

Result: On Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B, 3.26x and 4.71x end-to-end speedup at 5% density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in dense-fidelity and most VBench metrics; at 1% density up to 5.39x speedup and still more faithful than Sol-Attn at 12.5%.

Conclusion: ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention in video diffusion transformers, enabling extreme sparsity without proportional quality loss.

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but attention over long spatiotemporal sequences makes inference computationally expensive. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of query-key interactions exactly, and recent training-free methods further approximate the remaining interactions. These methods, however, degrade quickly at high sparsity, which limits the achievable speedup. We present ESTRA (Extreme Sparsity Through Refined Attention), a training-free acceleration method that preserves generation quality even at extreme sparsity. ESTRA concentrates exact attention computation on a small set of important key-value tokens and approximates the remaining contributions with cluster representatives. To identify these tokens efficiently, it groups similar queries and uses their representatives to score individual keys. A variance-based correction further refines the attention weights of the cluster representatives, improving the accuracy of the approximation. Experiments on Wan2.1-14B and HunyuanVideo-13B show that ESTRA establishes a new quality-efficiency frontier for training-free sparse attention, achieving $3.26\times$ and $4.71\times$ end-to-end speedups at 5% attention density while surpassing Sol-Attn and SVG-EAR in fidelity to dense generation and on most VBench dimensions. Even at 1% density, ESTRA remains more faithful to dense generation than Sol-Attn at 12.5%, while reaching up to $5.39\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [66] [WordEval: Evaluating Word-Native Operation Fidelity in Document Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10475)
*Jinyoung Park,Yupan Huang,Shimin Zhang,Jiayu Ding,Yilin Jia,Yuzhong Zhao,Tengchao Lv,Wenshan Wu,Shaohan Huang,Nan Yang,Xiangyang Zhou,Dongdong Zhang,Li Dong,Lei Cui,Sun Mao,Xun Wang,Tao Ge,Huitian Jiao,Si-Qing Chen,Changick Kim,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WordEval：以"编辑操作保真度"为中心评测Word文档智能体的基准，含642个案例、15个功能域、原子/组合两条轨道，并用Word原生oracle校验对象属性与保持条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有办公/桌面自动化基准把Word文档视作众多任务域之一，依赖关键词匹配、逐任务属性检查或截图比对来验证结果，无法判定请求的编辑是否真正落实为Word对象模型中属性层面的预期变更。

Method: 构建基于"编辑单元规范"的受控输入文档、参考文档与对齐oracle检查；546个原子案例覆盖231条命令，96个组合案例在单文档中叠加多个编辑；组合案例与对应原子案例显式链接以支持细粒度失败诊断；评测8个智能体系统。

Result: 多个系统在原子轨道上表现不佳且随功能域波动；所有系统在组合轨道上均低于原子轨道，且系统间差距差异显著；原子意图链接与失败诊断记录提供了互补的分析视角。

Conclusion: Word编辑评测应转向对象/属性级操作保真度，而非文本或截图表层匹配；原子—组合双层结构可定位具体失败环节，为文档智能体提供可诊断的评测范式。

Abstract: Microsoft Word is a central environment for office automation, and the faithful execution of its editing operations is an important capability for document agents. Unlike plain-text editing, editing in Word modifies a structured object model, where the requested effect is realized in object properties. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate office workflows or desktop automation, treating word-processor documents as one task domain among many and verifying outcomes with keyword matching, per-task property checks, or screenshot comparison. We introduce WordEval, an operation-fidelity benchmark that instead centers evaluation on Word editing operations, testing whether each requested edit is realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties. It contains 642 cases across 15 Word feature areas, ranging from text and lists to charts, shape geometry, and SmartArt. 546 atomic cases cover 231 commands, 96 compositional cases combine multiple edits in a single document, and a Word-native oracle checks task-specific object properties and preservation conditions. Cases are constructed from editing-unit specifications, yielding controlled input documents, reference documents, and aligned oracle checks. Each compositional case is linked to corresponding atomic cases, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of editing failures. We evaluate eight agent systems and find that many struggle on the Atomic track, with performance varying across feature areas. Moreover, every system scores lower on Compositional than on Atomic, with gaps that vary substantially by system. Exact atomic-intent links and recorded failure diagnoses provide complementary views of this variation.

</details>


### [67] [They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10483)
*Mengyu Wang,Ken Deng,Yftah Ziser,Shay B. Cohen,Tiejun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了视觉语言模型(VLM)在视觉推理相对位姿识别(VRRPI)任务中的稳定输出偏差，并提出无需标注的自知识重表达+迭代去偏(SKR-ID)流程，将通用下一词预测改为任务专用分类头，用去偏的对象中心提示冷启动并结合中位数logit动态阈值做递归排名，显著提升开源VLM的Macro-F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VRRPI暴露了现代VLM在多视角3D空间推理上的严重缺陷；作者发现VLM存在与视觉证据无关的稳定预测偏差（倾向某些运动模式），需要在不依赖标注数据的前提下缓解这种偏差。

Method: 无标注流水线SKR-ID：仅用随机抽取的无标注图像对适配VLM。1) 将输出机制从通用next-token预测替换为任务优化分类头；2) 冷启动阶段用去偏的object-centric提示，使运动推理锚定到2D视觉证据；3) 递归logit-ranking机制，以logit中位数作为动态阈值强制统计均衡（statistical parity）。

Result: 在标准基准上对前沿VLM评测，SKR-ID显著缓解系统性偏差；开源VLM的Macro-F1从35.0–45.4%提升至53.7–58.0%，且完全不使用标注数据。代码已开源。

Conclusion: SKR-ID能在基线严重塌缩的情况下有效提升VLM的3D空间推理表现，说明输出机制改造+统计去偏是无标注适配VLM做几何推理的可行路径；但绝对性能仍不高（约55%），且未涉及真实机器人验证。

Abstract: The task of visual reasoning relative pose identification (VRRPI) has exposed critical weaknesses in the multi-view 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). We present a systematic analysis of VLMs' behavior in VRRPI, uncovering stable output biases where VLMs disproportionately predict specific motion patterns regardless of visual evidence. To mitigate these inherent biases, we propose self knowledge re-expression with iterative debiasing (SKR-ID), an annotation-free pipeline that adapts VLMs for VRRPI using only randomly extracted unannotated image pairs. SKR-ID transitions VLMs' output mechanism from generic next-token prediction to task-optimized classification heads. The pipeline proceeds in two stages: (1) a cold-start initialization using debiasing object-centric prompts to anchor motion inference in 2D visual evidence; and (2) a recursive logit-ranking mechanism that enforces statistical parity by using the median logit value as a dynamic threshold. Experimental evaluation across frontier VLMs on standard benchmarks demonstrates that SKR-ID significantly mitigates systematic biases. Our method improves open-source VLMs' Macro-F1 scores from 35.0-45.4% to 53.7-58.0%, without using any annotated data. These results show that SKR-ID can effectively improve 3D reasoning performance from a severely collapsed baseline. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [68] [Can General-Purpose Generative AI Supply Training Data for Medical Vision Models? A Multimodal Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10484)
*Jiachuan Peng,Kyle Lam,Jierui Qu,Lin Li,Haining Zheng,Bang Zheng,Aniruddha Agarwal,Zaki Almallah,Min Chen,Vicente Grau,Hagai Rossman,Eran Segal,Jianing Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 评估通用图像生成/编辑模型 Nano Banana 生成的合成医学图像能否替代或补充真实数据，用于模型训练、亚组增强与模型审计（四模态、多中心外部验证）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量、标注良好且多样化的医学影像数据集仍是视觉医疗 AI 的主要瓶颈，作者希望检验通用图像生成/编辑模型能否缓解数据稀缺与亚组不平衡问题，并为模型鲁棒性测试提供受控手段。

Method: 回顾性研究，覆盖四种成像模态：胸片、眼底照相、CT 仅用合成图像训练，并在真实数据上外部验证，与真实数据训练模型对比；颈动脉超声在私有 Human Phenotype Project 队列（40-75 岁）上做有无合成增强的对比训练；临床医生对图像可信度评分；采用 AUROC、AUPR、校准与决策曲线分析评估。

Result: 纯合成训练模型 AUROC：肺炎 0.877（95% CI 0.843–0.910，n=14863）、视网膜脱离 0.963（0.948–0.975，n=1149）、肾结石 0.711（0.600–0.823，n=4122），与真实数据训练模型可比，但校准与净获益未稳定更优；合成-真实混合训练的颈动脉超声模型产出序数血管年龄指数，将 633 名外部受试者分层，亚组 BMI 与血糖差异显著（p<0.01）。编辑实验：在眼底图中加入中等程度镶嵌纹理，使中心性浆液性脉络膜视网膜病变真实类概率由 0.996 降至 0.822，暴露捷径学习；医生引导编辑将低质 CT 可信度由 3.10/5 提升至 4.30/5。

Conclusion: 合成数据可在训练、亚组代表性与受控编辑测试三方面补充真实数据；但其临床价值需结合校准、决策曲线与临床医生审阅综合评估，不能仅看判别性能。

Abstract: Background: Well-annotated, diverse medical imaging datasets remain a major constraint for vision-based medical AI. We evaluated Nano Banana, a general-purpose image generation and editing model, as a source of synthetic medical images for model training, subgroup augmentation, and model auditing. Methods: In this retrospective study across four imaging modalities, chest radiography, fundus photography, and CT models were trained only on synthetic images and externally validated on real-world data against real-data-trained models. Carotid ultrasound models were trained on a private Human Phenotype Project cohort (aged 40-75 years) with and without synthetic augmentation. Clinicians rated image plausibility. Evaluation used AUROC, AUPR, calibration, and decision curve analysis. Findings: Synthetic-only models achieved AUROCs of 0.877 (95% CI 0.843-0.910) for pneumonia (n=14863), 0.963 (0.948-0.975) for retinal detachment (n=1149), and 0.711 (0.600-0.823) for renal calculus (n=4122), comparable to real-data-trained models, but their calibration and net benefit were not consistently more favorable. With mixed synthetic-real training, a carotid ultrasound model produced an ordinal vascular age index that stratified 633 external subjects into subgroups differing in BMI and glucose (both p<0.01), linking vascular aging to cardiometabolic health. To stress-test shortcut learning, editing a moderate tessellated pattern into fundus photographs reduced the true-class probability for central serous chorioretinopathy from 0.996 to 0.822. Clinician-guided editing raised low-quality CT plausibility from 3.10/5 to 4.30/5. Interpretation: Synthetic data can complement real data in model training, subgroup representation, and model testing via controlled editing, but its clinical value should be assessed with calibration, decision curve analysis, and clinician review, not discrimination alone.

</details>


### [69] [Decoupling Direction and Magnitude: Language-Steered Flow Matching for Super-Resolution in the Dark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10485)
*Jiaxin Gao,Ziyu Yue,Yaohua Liu,Danchen Cui,Zhihui Zhao,Zhixun Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeLang-SR单步流匹配框架，将暗光超分中的退化信息结构化为"退化语言"作为语义先验引导速度场方向，并用连续空间更新强度场作为局部变化欧拉步长控制幅度，实现按退化程度自适应的单步暗光图像超分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 暗光图像超分存在极端空间异质性：严重欠曝噪声区需激进生成式增强以恢复细节，较正常曝光区需保守更新以避免幻觉纹理。而标准扩散/流匹配模型采用全局均匀积分轨迹，无法适应空间变化的退化。

Method: 单步流匹配框架，显式解耦恢复方向与幅度。1) 将可测物理统计量翻译为结构化退化语言，借助预训练文生图模型的语义先验，与图像特定视觉token共同引导速度场（方向）趋向恢复相关流形；2) 设计连续空间更新强度场，作为局部变化的欧拉步长场（幅度），在重度退化阴影区施加更强积分步、在可靠区域保持保守更新。

Result: 在配对与真实暗光图像上实验，配合消融与诊断分析，验证该单步方法有效且可解释。

Conclusion: 通过退化语言引导方向、空间更新强度场控制幅度，DeLang-SR为暗光超分提供了一条高效、可解释的单步求解路径。

Abstract: Image super-resolution in the dark is fundamentally challenged by extreme spatial heterogeneity: severely underexposed and noisy regions demand aggressive generative enhancement to reconstruct missing details, while relatively well-exposed areas require conservative updates to prevent hallucinated textures. Standard diffusion and flow-matching models, however, rely on globally uniform integration trajectories, making them sub-optimal for such spatially varying degradations. In this paper, we propose DeLang-SR (Degradation-Language steered Super-Resolution), a one-step flow-matching framework that explicitly decouples the restoration direction and magnitude. Rather than treating low-light corruption as arbitrary latent features, DeLang-SR translates measurable physical statistics into structured degradation language, harnessing the semantic prior of pretrained text-to-image models. The degradation-language intent, complemented by image-specific visual tokens, steers the velocity field (direction) toward restoration-relevant manifolds. Simultaneously, a continuous spatial update-strength field acts as a locally varying Euler step-size field (magnitude), applying stronger integration steps in heavily degraded shadows while enforcing conservative updates in reliable regions. Experiments on paired and real dark images, together with ablations and diagnostic analyses, show that DeLang-SR provides an effective and interpretable one-step route to super-resolution in the dark. Code and pretrained models are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [70] [Disentangling Channel Semantics in Vision Transformers via Token Decorrelation and Composition-Aware Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10497)
*Daeun Kim,Hyesong Choi,Hyejin Park,Dongbo Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对多通道ViT上下文token在高通道冗余下坍缩到少数主导通道的问题，提出MuCa-ViT：用因子化Token学习（FTL）解相关上下文token，并用通道组合感知调制（CAM）生成样本级调制信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道图像需同时建模全局共享空间结构与通道特异变化；现有方法引入memory token组织多通道表示，但在通道间高冗余时上下文token坍缩至少数主导通道，产生冗余表示与有偏全局摘要，无法可靠支持组合感知的通道解释。

Method: 诊断分析上下文token坍缩现象；提出两个耦合机制：FTL在token层面对上下文token施加去相关约束，使[CLS]捕捉全局共享语义、memory token保留互补的通道特异线索；CAM以FTL精炼后的[CLS]作为语义锚点生成样本级调制信号，在统一骨干内实现通道组合感知解释，替代静态通道嵌入。

Result: 在JUMP-CP、CHAMMI、So2Sat三个基准上均优于先前多通道ViT；提升幅度与各数据集的通道间冗余度（ρ∈[0.19, 0.77]）一致，验证了动机中的诊断分析。

Conclusion: token解相关+样本级调制可有效缓解多通道冗余导致的表示坍缩，且增益与冗余程度正相关，说明该设计针对性强；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-channel images encode heterogeneous channel semantics aligned over a shared spatial structure, which requires models to jointly capture globally shared structure and channel-specific variations. Recent multi-channel Vision Transformers attempt to address this challenge by augmenting the [CLS] token with memory tokens to organize multi-channel representations under varying channel compositions. However, we find that these context tokens collapse onto a few dominant channels under high inter-channel redundancy, producing redundant representations and a biased global summary that fails to reliably support composition-aware channel interpretation. We propose MuCa-ViT (Multi-Channel Composition-Aware Vision Transformer), a unified framework that addresses these limitations through two coupled mechanisms. Factorial Token Learning (FTL) enforces token-level decorrelation among context tokens, encouraging the [CLS] token to capture globally shared semantics while memory tokens preserve complementary channel-specific cues. Channel Composition-Aware Modulation (CAM) uses the FTL-refined [CLS] as a semantic anchor to generate sample-wise modulation signals, which enable composition-aware interpretation of channels within a unified backbone rather than relying on static channel embeddings. Experiments on JUMP-CP, CHAMMI, and So2Sat show that MuCa-ViT outperforms prior multi-channel ViTs across all three benchmarks, and the magnitude of improvement aligns with the inter-channel redundancy of each dataset ($\rho \in [0.19, 0.77]$), validating the diagnostic analysis that motivates our design. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [71] [SRA: Spatial Reasoning Adapter via Evolving Social Interaction Graphs for Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10506)
*Jaewoo Jeong,Seonkyu Song,Hyeonwoo Park,Jegyeong Cho,Yujin Bae,Giwon Lee,Daehee Park,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SRA（Spatial Reasoning Adapter）是一个模块化的图去噪适配器，在每个逆向扩散/流匹配步骤，基于宿主当前未来预测轨迹重建稀疏欧氏交互图，并给出残差修正；在 LED、MID、MoFlow 三个宿主与 SDD/NBA/Soccer/Football 四个数据集上全面提升 ADE 5.8%、FDE 7.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机多智能体轨迹预测器只从观测历史中一次性读取交互，并在整个生成过程中保持固定，无法在联合未来逐步收敛时重新审视随未来而变化的互惠几何约束。

Method: 将 SRA 当作插件接入现有扩散/流匹配预测器，不改造其生成核心。每个反向步：读取宿主的当前未来估计，在预测轨迹上构建稀疏欧氏交互图，输出对宿主解码路径的残差修正。三个组件：(1) 用可学习 query-key 打分加几何偏置检索稀疏邻域；(2) 在演化中的预测上重算未来条件的关系特征；(3) 不确定性加权消息传递，让高置信度智能体为低置信度智能体提供锚点。

Result: 在三种结构迥异的宿主（LED、MID、MoFlow）与四个基准（SDD、NBA、Soccer、Football）上，SRA 对每个宿主、每个数据集均提升 ADE，平均 ADE 提升 5.8%、FDE 提升 7.0%；累积消融显示三组件作为单一机制协同工作，只有同时启用才能在全部体育数据集上一致提升。

Conclusion: 在模型自身演化中的未来上做空间推理、并按该未来的可信度加权，对多种去噪架构普遍有效；适配器式设计使其可即插即用地增强既有轨迹生成器。

Abstract: Predicting where multiple agents will move next is fundamental to autonomous driving, robotics, and any system that must share space with people safely. Modern stochastic predictors read off inter-agent interactions once from the observed past and keep that view fixed throughout the generative rollout, so the reciprocal geometric constraints that emerge as the joint future sharpens are not re-examined. We address this gap with SRA (Spatial Reasoning Adapter), a modular graph denoiser that is integrated into existing diffusion and flow-matching predictors without redesigning their generative cores. At every reverse step, SRA reads the host's current future estimate, builds a sparse Euclidean interaction graph on the predicted trajectories, and returns a residual correction to the host's decoding path. Our adapter consists of three core components: a sparse neighborhood retrieved with a learned query-key score and a geometric bias, a future-conditioned relational feature recomputed on the evolving prediction, and uncertainty-weighted message passing where confident agents act as anchors for uncertain ones. We instantiate SRA on three structurally different hosts (LED, MID, and MoFlow) across four multi-agent benchmarks: SDD, NBA, Soccer, and Football. SRA improves ADE for every host on every dataset, with average gains of 5.8% in ADE and 7.0% in FDE. A cumulative ablation shows that the three components act as one mechanism: only together do they improve every host on every sports dataset, indicating that spatial reasoning over the model's own evolving future, weighted by how far that future can be trusted, is broadly useful across denoising architectures. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [72] [Scaling Optimization-Oriented Hypernetworks for Implicit Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10509)
*Lulu Cai,Hanxiang Ren,Siyan Dong,Li Sun,Jiefeng Wu,Youyi Zheng,Yi Ma,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用注意力取代MLP作为超网络主体，单次前向生成INR网络参数，参数量与目标网络宽度无关，在2D/3D INR生成与NeRF生成上超越单次前向与优化导向基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用于INR生成的超网络要么忽略测试时优化（TTT/chain-rule）结构，要么保留该结构却用MLP实例化，导致参数随目标网络宽度四次方增长；作者欲证明该成本是MLP实例化的结构性问题，而非保留链式法则原则本身的问题。

Method: 注意力式超网络，含三项设计：(1) 以输出神经元为中心的分词，使token轴与每层输出神经元轴对齐；(2) 信息流一致性规则，依据每个交叉注意力模块输出应处的表示来固定其角色；(3) token空间迭代rollout，将目标INR一次优化步计算的五个量实现为五个交叉注意力模块，参数量与目标网络宽度无关。

Result: 在5个2D与3D INR生成基准上优于SOTA单次前向与优化导向基线；可扩展至MLP类优化导向范式显存耗尽的目标网络宽度；在无GT INR权重监督的NeRF生成任务上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 保留链式法则结构的超网络可用注意力实例化，从而摆脱MLP的四次方参数开销；方法在精度、可扩展性与NeRF生成泛化上均具优势。

Abstract: We present a hypernetwork that generates the parameters of an implicit neural representation (INR) for a given signal in a single forward pass, without test-time optimization. Existing hypernetworks for this problem either ignore the chain-rule structure of the test-time optimization that produces an INR or, when they preserve it, instantiate the structure with MLPs whose parameter count grows quartically in target-network width. Our central contribution is to show that this parameter-count cost is structural to the MLP instantiation, not to the optimization-oriented principle of preserving chain-rule structure, and to resolve it by replacing the MLP body with attention. The resulting hypernetwork combines three design choices: an output-neuron-centric tokenization that aligns the token axis with each layer's output-neuron axis; an information-flow consistency rule that fixes the role of every cross-attention module from the representation its output should occupy; and a token-space iterative rollout that realizes the five quantities one optimization step on the target INR computes as five cross-attention modules with parameter count independent of target-network width. Across five 2D and 3D INR generation benchmarks, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art single-pass and optimization-oriented baselines; scales to target-network widths at which the MLP-based optimization-oriented paradigm exhausts GPU memory; and produces the highest result on NeRF generation without ground-truth INR weights supervision.

</details>


### [73] [Beyond Row Alignment: Virtual-Camera-Aware Online Stereo Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10518)
*Yizhao Peng,Rui Gong,Zaiwang Gu,Xudong Jiang,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VirtualRect: 一种面向实际部署的在线双目校正方法,通过估计"虚拟校正相机"+全图形变监督,使校正图像与相机参数出自同一几何,克服仅做行对齐的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实部署中相机机械漂移、振动、安装变动会破坏标定/校正假设,导致深度估计退化,需要在线双目校正。现有在线校正方法只优化行对齐(左右同名点落在同一行),虽必要但不充分:少量匹配点对齐良好的同时可能裁掉有效区域、产生大面积空白、目标拉伸/压缩、全图尺度不均匀,从而损害标准立体匹配。

Method: 提出 VirtualRect。不把校正简化为行对齐,而是估计一个"校正后的虚拟双目相机"(含相机参数),并对图像形变行为施加全图范围的监督(图像级 warp 约束),使校正图像与相机参数来自同一几何,保证匹配所用图像与深度计算所用模型一致。

Result: 相比此前 SOTA 在线校正器:垂直光流误差在 Carla-Flowguided 降低 17%、Semi-Truck Highway 降低 7%;在下游三个立体匹配器上,Carla-Flowguided 的深度 MAE 降低 30–41%。

Conclusion: 仅行对齐不足以支撑可部署的立体深度估计;将校正视为虚拟相机估计并配合全图形变监督,能同时改善对齐质量与下游深度精度,适合真实部署场景。

Abstract: Stereo matchers estimate depth by comparing the left and right images from a stereo camera pair, but they assume that the two cameras are accurately calibrated and rectified. In real deployments, small physical shifts after calibration, caused by camera motion, mechanical drift, vibration, or installation changes, can break this assumption and degrade depth estimation. Online stereo rectification is therefore needed to correct the image pair during operation and recover a stereo geometry where standard stereo matching can work reliably. Recent online rectification methods mainly optimize row alignment, making the left and right views of the same scene point fall on the same image row. We show that this target, while necessary, is insufficient for deployable stereo depth estimation. A rectifier may make a small set of matched points look well row-aligned, but still distort the full images in ways that hurt stereo matching: useful image regions may be cut off, large blank areas may appear, objects may be stretched or squeezed, or image scale may change unevenly across the view. We propose VirtualRect, an online stereo rectification method designed for reliable real-world deployment. Rather than treating rectification as simply making the left and right image rows line up, this method estimates a rectified virtual stereo camera and combines image-wide supervision of image warp behavior. This makes the rectified images and the camera parameters come from the same geometry, so the images used for matching and the model used for depth computation remain consistent. Experiments on multiple datasets show that, compared with the prior state-of-the-art online rectifier, VirtualRect reduces vertical flow error by 17% on Carla-Flowguided and 7% on Semi-Truck Highway, and lowers depth MAE by 30-41% on Carla-Flowguided across three downstream stereo matchers.

</details>


### [74] [Action Transfer Across Character Body Plans in Latent-Action World Models: An Empirical Study of Animated Characters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10523)
*Amarnath R*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究2D角色间跨身体结构的潜在动作迁移，提出能对比"正确动作"与同源"错误动作"的迁移评分，发现现有模型学到的动作虽保留动作类别信息，但对新身体的预测仍明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨身体结构的动作共享在2D角色间研究不足；常用迁移指标把身体运动与屏幕位移混在一起，会让忽略动作的模型也拿满分，无法真实衡量动作迁移。

Method: 提出对比式迁移评分：在同一源角色的正确动作与错误动作之间比较，抑制单纯屏幕位移带来的虚假增益。在新构建的六个body plan的2D卡通角色合成基准、标准Sprites基准以及DeformingThings4D中431个动物/人类动画上，测试五种训练目标（含跟随相机与固定相机两种设置），并用线性探针检验隐动作的可分性。

Result: 固定相机下，仅复制源屏幕运动、无视动作的基线得0.71，与多数学习模型相当；改用跟随身体的相机后，最佳模型对未见动物科仅0.46、对人类仅0.20（近乎失败）。线性探针在未见动物科上达到66%–86%平衡准确率（随机17%），说明隐动作保留了动作类别信息，但正确动作只能弥补部分预测误差差。

Conclusion: 现有潜在动作世界模型具备一定的动作语义，但尚未实现真正跨身体的运动重映射；方法核心价值在于揭示旧指标的失效模式并给出更严格的评测协议。属基准+诊断性分析，缺少新的可迁移动作建模方法。

Abstract: Latent-action world models learn actions from video without labels, and recent methods aim to share these actions across bodies. Transfer between 2D characters with different body structures remains underexplored. In this paper, we study whether an action learned from one character can make a character with a different body perform the same action. A cat, a blob and a human can all jump, but each moves its body in its own way. The usual transfer gain mixes body motion with screen movement and can assign a perfect score to a model that ignores its action. To address this, we introduce a transfer score that compares the correct action with wrong ones from the same source. We test five training objectives on a new synthetic benchmark of 2D cartoon characters with six body plans, the standard Sprites benchmark, and 431 selected animal and human animations from DeformingThings4D. With a fixed camera, a baseline that only copies the source's screen movement scores 0.71, as high as most learned models. In contrast, with a camera that follows the body, the best model reaches only 0.46 for an unseen animal family and 0.20 for humans. With this camera, a linear probe identifies the action class of unseen animal families with 66% to 86% balanced accuracy (chance 17%). The learned actions therefore retain information about which action is performed, but the correct action closes only part of the prediction error gap for a new character.

</details>


### [75] [PrivMark: Pixel-Space Steering against Privacy Leakage in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10528)
*Ruofan Xing,Arman Akbari,Weikai Lin,Yuhao Zhu,Xuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PrivMark：通过在隐状态空间定位两条弱对齐的引导向量（分别对应开放式描述中的附带属性泄露与直接生物特征探测下的顺从而非拒答），将其编码为单个有界像素扰动，实现部署期无模型内部访问的图像级隐私保护；配套 BioleakBench（1600 VQA 对），跨三个白盒模型达 85.9% 抑制、保留 75% OK-VQA 效用，并零样本迁移至七个未见 VLM（含闭源 API）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 在文本输出中常规性泄露年龄、性别、种族等软生物特征，而上载图像通过下游 API 即可被任意用户获取这些属性。现有防御不匹配该场景：人脸去标识化保留分布式软生物特征线索；面向分类器的对抗扰动无法迁移到开放式生成；更强的 VLM 专用方法依赖重训练或运行时激活访问，下游 API 用户无权获得。

Method: 分析 VLM 激活，定位隐藏状态空间中两条弱对齐的引导向量方向，分别对应"开放式描述中的附带属性披露"与"对直接生物特征探针的顺从（未拒答）"两种泄露行为；将两个方向联合编码为单个有界像素扰动，使受保护图像本身即可在部署时实施隐私约束，无需侵入式访问模型内部。同时构建 BioleakBench：1600 组 VQA 对，覆盖自由描述与直接探测两种协议下的生物特征隐私属性评估。

Result: 在三个白盒源模型上，生物特征抑制率最高达 85.9%，同时保留 75% 的干净 OK-VQA 效用；隐私-效用权衡优于最强的纯像素基线最多 1.4 倍。同一一次性扰动可一致迁移到七个未见 VLM，包括闭源 API。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过激活空间引导向量可分解并联合压制多类泄露行为，且此类像素级扰动具备跨模型的实用可迁移性，为无法访问模型内部的下游用户提供了一条可行的视觉隐私保护路径；主要局限在于评测集中在软生物特征属性与静态图像 VQA 场景。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) routinely disclose soft-biometric attributes such as age, gender, and race in their text outputs, exposing demographic information from uploaded images to any downstream API user. Existing privacy defenses do not fit this setting: face de-identification leaves distributed soft-biometric cues intact, classifier-targeted adversarial perturbations do not transfer to open-ended generation, and stronger VLM-specific methods require retraining or runtime activation access unavailable to downstream APIs. We propose PrivMark, a framework that suppresses biometric leakage at the image level. By analyzing VLM activations, we identify two weakly aligned steering vector directions in hidden-state space, each tied to a distinct leakage behavior --- one corresponding to incidental attribute disclosure under open-ended descriptions, the other to compliance with direct biometric probes instead of refusal --- and encode both directions into a single bounded pixel perturbation, so the protected image alone enforces privacy with no invasive access to model internals at deployment. To support evaluation, we assemble BioleakBench, $1{,}600$ VQA pairs covering biometric privacy attributes under both free-form description and direct-probe protocols. Across three white-box source models, PrivMark achieves up to $85.9\%$ biometric suppression while retaining $75\%$ of clean OK-VQA utility, up to $1.4\times$ the privacy-utility tradeoff of the strongest pixel-only baseline. The same one-shot perturbations transfer consistently to seven unseen VLMs including closed-source APIs.

</details>


### [76] [CompositionEvidence: Controlling Geometric Evidence for Cinematic Composition Reasoning with Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10559)
*Yichen He,Xin Huang,Yuxi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CompositionEvidence: 从冻结的检测/深度/线条专家中提取9个可复现几何特征并融合为24维共享表征，通过"免训练门控文本通道"和"7.37M参数软token投影器"两种接口注入VLM，在ShotBench构图基准上把Qwen2.5-VL-7B从49.5%提升到56.2%/61.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM对影视构图所依赖的画面内几何关系使用不一致；直接提示注入外部感知工具的输出会覆盖模型原有的有效视觉预测（几何提示使49.5%降到46.3%，错误测量降到33.6%），因此需要一种既提供几何证据又不破坏原有视觉判断的注入方式。

Method: 用冻结的检测、深度、线条专家生成九种可复现构图特征，拼接成24维共享表征；提供两条接口：(1) 免训练通道——在问题之后追加带门控的中性证据文本；(2) 最小训练通道——用7.37M参数投影器把同一表征映射为4个软token，VLM主干保持冻结。另在9个VLM（含5个商业模型）上做跨模型鲁棒性分析。

Result: 免训练通道达56.2%（+6.7，精确McNemar p=0.0018），证据被污染时仍保持48.4%；软token通道达61.0%（+11.5）。9个VLM零样本成绩43.8%–63.0%，文本通道效应在+6.7到−6.9分之间，最强基线模型反而出现退化。

Conclusion: 显式几何证据的收益取决于测量可靠性和接收模型对证据的整合方式，不存在普适正增益；门控与软token适配是较稳健的注入路径。

Abstract: Cinematic composition questions depend on in-frame geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) use inconsistently. External perception tools can expose this geometry, but naive prompt injection can overwrite useful visual predictions. On ShotBench composition, pre-question geometry reduces Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 49.5% to 46.3%; corrupted measurements lower it to 33.6%. CompositionEvidence derives nine reproducible features from frozen detection, depth, and line experts and supplies their shared 24-dimensional representation through two interfaces. A training-free channel appends gated neutral evidence after the question, reaching 56.2% (+6.7, exact McNemar p=0.0018) and 48.4% under corrupted evidence. A minimal-training channel maps the same representation to four soft tokens with a 7.37M-parameter projector while leaving the VLM frozen; it reaches 61.0% (+11.5). Across nine VLMs, including five commercial models queried through official provider APIs, zero-shot accuracy ranges from 43.8% to 63.0%, and the text channel changes it by +6.7 to -6.9 points; the highest baseline is among the regressions. The effect of explicit geometry depends on measurement reliability and on how the receiving model integrates it.

</details>


### [77] [ZARA: Zero-shot Animatable and Relightable 3D Avatar reconstruction from a single image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10562)
*Yixiao Chen,Dongdong Weng,Chengfeng Zhao,Tao Gong,Zhihe Zhao,Zhe Zhu,Yue Liu,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZARA：零样本前馈式从单张图像重建可动画、可重打光的3D高斯人体avatar，并预测PBR材质（albedo等），支持材质编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大规模人体重建模型外观与光照耦合、无法重打光；而现有可重打光avatar方法需逐人优化（person-specific optimization），成本高、泛化差。

Method: 将预训练大规模人体重建模型与Material Transformer耦合，继承几何先验并学习材质感知高斯表示；提出Gaussian-aligned material feature fusion，将多尺度材质特征注入每个高斯并与几何token融合；因缺少真值材质图，使用伪材质标签作为条件输入与监督目标；提出MatFace正则项，在面部伪材质监督不可靠时保持反照率预测的面部结构与颜色。

Result: 数十秒内重建可动画、可重打光人体，无需逐人优化或后处理；在重打光质量与材质泛化能力上优于现有基线；可直接进行avatar外观的材质编辑。

Conclusion: 零样本前馈的统一几何-材质高斯avatar框架可作为人体PBR属性恢复的实用方案，兼具动画与重打光能力。

Abstract: Recent large human reconstruction models create remarkable animatable 3D avatars from a single image, but their appearance remains entangled with the illumination and cannot be relighted. In contrast, existing 3D relightable-avatar reconstruction methods typically require person-specific optimization. We present ZARA, a zero-shot feed-forward framework that reconstructs an animatable 3D Gaussian avatar together with its intrinsic attributes from a single image. ZARA couples a pretrained large-scale human reconstruction model with a Material Transformer to inherit geometry priors while learning material-aware Gaussian representations. To preserve localized details, we introduce Gaussian-aligned material feature fusion strategy, which injects multi-scale material features onto individual Gaussians and combines them with geometry tokens. As most human-avatar datasets lack ground-truth material maps, we use pseudo-material labels as conditioning inputs and supervision targets during training. We further introduce MatFace regularization to preserve facial structure and color in albedo prediction under unreliable facial pseudo-material supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZARA reconstructs animatable and relightable humans within tens of seconds without person-specific optimization or post-processing, outperforming existing baselines in both relighting quality and materials generalization ability. As the ability of recovering the physically-based-rendering attributes of the human, ZARA also enables direct material editing of the avatar's appearance.

</details>


### [78] [Understanding the Effect of Visual Attention in CNNs: A Decision-Space Alignment Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10571)
*Niladri B. Puhan,K. Kamala Priya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"决策空间"分析框架，将乘性视觉注意力建模为中间特征扰动，用一阶泰勒近似预测其对目标-竞争者分类间隔的影响，并引入决策对齐分数(DAS)度量扰动与局部间隔梯度的方向一致性；在CIFAR-100上对SimAM、CBAM与5种CNN骨干进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制通过调制中间特征增强CNN，但学界对其如何影响下游决策缺乏可解释的定量理解。

Method: 将乘性注意力视作中间特征扰动，做一阶展开得到分类间隔变化的预测；定义DAS衡量扰动的方向对齐性；在CIFAR-100上用SimAM/CBAM与ResNet-18/20/50/56、MobileNetV2做预测一致性、DAS-间隔相关性以及下游激活状态变化分析，并比较不同注意力插入位置的影响。

Result: 多数最终注意力配置下，预测与实际的间隔变化吻合良好；DAS与实际间隔变化呈正相关；单注意力实验显示预测一致性与DAS相关性依赖注意力位置，后层放置关联更强。

Conclusion: 为注意力机制提供了一个可解释的决策层分析工具（一阶预测+DAS），可用作注意力模块放置与设计的指导信号。

Abstract: Visual Attention enhances convolutional neural networks (CNNs) by modulating intermediate features, yet their effects on downstream decisions remain less understood. We present a decision-space framework that models multiplicative attention as an intermediate feature perturbation and derives a first-order prediction of its effect on the target-versus-competitor classification margin. We further introduce the Decision Alignment Score (DAS) to quantify the directional alignment between the perturbation and the local margin gradient. We evaluate the framework on CIFAR-100 using SimAM and CBAM across five popular CNN backbones, ResNet-18, ResNet-20, ResNet-50, ResNet-56, and MobileNetV2. The analysis examines prediction agreement, DAS margin correlations, and downstream activation-state changes. Across most final-attention configurations, predicted and actual margin changes show good agreement, while DAS exhibits positive correlations with actual margin changes. Single-attention experiments further show that prediction agreement and DAS margin correlations depend on attention placement, with stronger associations at later stages.

</details>


### [79] [ROLECUE: Diagnosing Cross-Lingual Role-Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10575)
*Niaz Mohaiman Abtahi,Evan Maksud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ROLECUE 诊断基准，用192张双人动作图配德/土/日/英/韩/孟加拉语（含患者前置语序）句子，将 VLM 的图文角色绑定拆分为图像角色识别、文本角色解析、直接图文匹配、响应合规与外部组件组合五项测试，在多语言条件下揭示组件—联合性能鸿沟与"语义顺从"偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 能识别图像事件、解析句子，但能否将视觉 Agent-Patient 结构与不同语言（依赖形态、语序或构式）的语义角色对应起来尚不清楚；聚合式基准无法定位错误来源，需要组件级诊断。

Method: 构建受控诊断集：192张经校验的双人动作图像 × 6种语言（德语、土耳其语、日语、英语、韩语、孟加拉语）的规范语序与患者前置语序句子。评测分为五个切入点：纯图像角色识别、纯文本角色解析、直接图文匹配、响应合规行为、以及用模型自身组件预测做外部模块化组合；对8个近期开权重 VLM 评测，并用 bootstrap 区间检验效应稳健性。

Result: 出现结构化谱系：部分模型在视觉或语言组件测试上失败；部分基本解决诊断；部分坍缩为恒定的"语义认可"响应；多家模型存在组件—联合鸿沟（可靠的纯图像与纯文本角色预测在直接联合推理时不复现），最大非退化差距达44.9个百分点，bootstrap 区间确认非点估计伪影。

Conclusion: 聚合基准会掩盖多语言下的组件—联合性能鸿沟与接受偏差；在解释多模态联合错误前，组件级诊断是必要前置步骤。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize events in images and parse sentences, but it remains unclear when they bind visual Agent-Patient structure to linguistic semantic roles across languages whose role cues depend on morphology, word order or construction. We introduce ROLECUE, a controlled diagnostic that pairs 192 validated two-person action images with German, Turkish, Japanese, English, Korean and Bangla sentences in canonical and patient-first orders. The evaluation separates image-only role recognition, text-only role parsing, direct image-sentence matching, response-compliance behavior and an external modular composition of the model's own component predictions. Across eight recent open-weight VLMs, ROLECUE reveals a structured spectrum: some models fail visual or linguistic component tests, some largely solve the diagnostic, some collapse to constant semantic assent and several show component-joint gaps in which reliable image-only and text-only role predictions do not survive direct joint inference. The largest non-degenerate gaps reach 44.9 percentage points, with final bootstrap intervals confirming that the effect is not a point-estimate artifact. These results reveal multilingual component-joint performance gaps and acceptance biases hidden by aggregate VLM benchmarks and show why component diagnostics are necessary before interpreting joint multimodal errors.

</details>


### [80] [MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10592)
*Jiaju Ma,Ashvini Kumar Jindal,Chuhua Wang,Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MotionGraphicsBench：100例专家标注的 SVG 运动图形编辑基准，用确定性、可读的验证程序（多智能体管线构建）代替参考动画或 VLM 评判，与人类判断原始一致率 93.3%，高于 GPT-6 Astra 的 83.3%；32 个 LLM 共 47 种配置 pass@1 仅 6.0%–67.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 已能从静态图与自然语言指令生成运动图形，但如何评价模型对"空间+外观+时序"组合要求的遵循程度缺乏可靠手段；现有做法依赖参考动画对比或 VLM 打分，难以接受多种合法实现且判断不可靠。

Method: 构建专家整理的基准：提供完整静态 SVG 与运动编辑提示，把运动生成与图形生成解耦；实例取自真实 Lottie 设计，覆盖多样时空动画行为组合。每个实例配套确定性、人类可读的验证程序（接受不同有效实现，逐条报告需求通过/失败），程序由多智能体管线结合人工标注动画与合成测试用例生成。
