Result: 在 180 个动画的平衡测试集上，验证程序与人类判断原始一致率 93.3%（VLM 基线 GPT-6 Astra 为 83.3%），且通过/拒绝召回率均更优。32 个模型、12 家供应商、47 种配置的 pass@1 为 6.0%–67.7%；15 个模型在最高推理档位、每例 32 次尝试下，pass@32 提升至 38.0%–95.0% 但仍未饱和。错误分析显示生成动画常无法匹配参考姿态、沿指定轨迹运动或协调相关事件。

Conclusion: 提出以可执行验证程序为核心的动图生成评测范式，兼顾多解合法性与可解释的细粒度失败定位，揭示了当前 LLM 在时空组合运动指令遵循上的显著短板。

Abstract: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at this https URL .

</details>


### [81] [The RenAIssance: Caption-Guided Diffusion Models for Historical-Art Visual Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10599)
*Zhanyu Tuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将欧洲历史艺术藏品（DEArt，约1.5万图文对）用BLIP生成场景级描述，训练Stable Diffusion v1.5的紧凑LoRA适配器，得到可复用的历史艺术风格文本到图像资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史艺术作品缺乏与现代图像生成器配套的成对文本描述，难以直接用于提示驱动的视觉媒体创作与文化藏品扩展。

Method: BLIP自动生成场景级caption构建图像-文本对；在DEArt上训练LoRA适配器注入SD v1.5；解耦可复用风格表示与基座生成器，保留基座对新概念的表达能力。

Result: 在历史与当代提示、不同提示长度下，对DEArt参考分布的FID均改善，CLIP文本-图像相似度仅小幅下降；定性显示可在统一历史视觉语言中生成时代性题材与当代概念。

Conclusion: 提供可扩展的历史艺术风格适配流程，作为可控历史艺术媒体创作、交互式作者工具与富媒体体验的可复用构建模块。

Abstract: Generative AI can expand cultural collections into prompt-responsive visual media, but historical artworks rarely provide the paired descriptions needed to adapt modern image generators. We present The RenAIssance, a scalable pipeline that turns a collection of historical European artworks into a reusable text-to-image media resource. The pipeline generates scene-level captions with BLIP and uses the resulting approximately 15,000 image--text pairs from DEArt to train a compact LoRA adapter for Stable Diffusion v1.5. The adapter shifts generated images toward the historical-art distribution while retaining the base model's ability to render novel concepts. On historical and contemporary prompts of different lengths, it improves FID to the DEArt reference distribution in every setting with only a modest decrease in CLIP text--image similarity. Qualitative results show that the same adapter can render both period-appropriate subjects and contemporary concepts in a coherent historical visual language. By decoupling a reusable style representation from the base generator, the approach offers a practical building block for controllable historical-art media creation, interactive authoring, and rich-media experiences.

</details>


### [82] [Reason First, Retrieve What Matters: Hypothesis-Guided Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10609)
*Yisong Hu,Junbo Wang,Yuke Li,Jiangbin Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练、即插即用的HypoKFS框架，将关键帧选择与MLLM迭代推理耦合：先在稀疏帧上构建初始假设空间，用答案分布决定是否追加选帧，再由保留假设引导选取判别性帧并重新推理，从而把额外视觉计算集中在未决假设上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解中稀疏证据在时间上分散，现有方法通常先在密集采样候选集上做全局图文匹配再推理，(1) 当少量均匀采样帧已足够时全局匹配带来冗余计算；(2) 仅凭查询相关性可能忽略能区分竞争答案的证据；(3) 一次性选帧无法纠错。

Method: HypoKFS：稀疏采样帧上由MLLM初步推理生成假设空间→依据答案分布的不确定性判断是否需要更多帧→已保留假设作为选择依据检索判别性帧→再次推理并细化假设，迭代进行；训练免费、可插拔，避免全局帧-假设匹配开销。

Result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench、MLVU上多个MLLM骨干取得一致提升，最高+6.7个百分点，Video-MME达72.9%，而帧-假设匹配成本仅为参考方法的1.3%。

Conclusion: 以假设驱动的主动选帧替代一次性全局匹配，可显著降低计算并提升长视频问答准确率；方法通用、无需训练，但属视频QA推理优化，与Physical AI/VLA/3D重建方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Long video understanding requires models to identify and reason over sparse, temporally distributed evidence within limited frame budgets. Existing keyframe selection methods typically retrieve query-relevant frames from a densely sampled candidate set before inference. However, global image-text matching incurs unnecessary computation when a small set of uniformly sampled frames already provides sufficient evidence. Query relevance alone may also overlook evidence that distinguishes competing answers, while one-shot selection offers no opportunity to correct earlier selection errors. We propose HypoKFS, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples keyframe selection with iterative inference by multimodal large language models (MLLMs). HypoKFS first reasons over sparsely sampled frames to construct an initial hypothesis space. The resulting answer distribution determines whether additional frame selection is needed. When needed, the retained hypotheses guide the selection of discriminative frames, followed by renewed inference and hypothesis refinement. This iterative process directs additional visual computation toward unresolved hypotheses while avoiding unnecessary global frame matching. Experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and MLVU demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple MLLM backbones. HypoKFS improves accuracy by up to 6.7 percentage points and achieves 72.9% accuracy on Video-MME at only 1.3% of the reference frame-hypothesis matching cost.

</details>


### [83] [EndoSCOP-V: A Multi-Turn Video Understanding Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Models in Endoscopy Reporting and Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10626)
*Abhishek Tyagi,Tanmay Jain,Vilas Biradar,Krithi Krishna Koduri,Misba Hul Bashir Masoodi,Swetha Rapolu,Hardik Rughwani,Rachana Kotha,Anjan Kumar Kaipa,Anudeep Katrevula,Rakesh Garlapati,Aniruddha Pratap Singh,Rajendra Patel,Abhay Tyagi,Sundeep Lakhtakia,Mohan Ramchandani,Rakesh Kalapala,D. Nageshwar Reddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EndoSCOP-V: 基于真实内镜/结肠镜视频的多轮结构化报告与临床推理评测框架，含1307段视频(63.2h)、20274轮问答，由临床结构化报告EHR确定性生成；采用Markov式上下文剪枝oracle-forcing逐轮评测，15名内镜医师专家基线78%，最佳27B开源LMM仅59.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内镜多模态基准仅测静态图像或单一疾病视频，无法覆盖真实报告所需的长时序、多步骤临床推理（定位—形态—严重度—干预）；且逐案人工标注成本高、易受LLM改写污染。

Method: 构建视频基础的多轮评测框架：1307段真实视频，问答轮次从医生填写的结构化内镜报告EHR中确定性实例化（1033份医师审阅模板，约18/病种），覆盖9任务×30子任务、54种WEO MST 3.0疾病；提出Markov式上下文剪枝的oracle-forcing协议，逐轮注入金标准答案以隔离单轮推理；以15名认证内镜医师建立严格准确率基线，横评14个开源权重LMM及3个前沿闭源模型。

Result: 专家小组严格准确率78%（1500题）；最佳27B级开源LMM达59.8%，剔除格式性拒诊题后降至53.4%；前沿闭源模型最好者严格NDR准确率落后专家23个百分点；子任务分析显示定量测量、多变量分级与长时程干预推理存在系统性短板。

Conclusion: 长时程视频内镜临床推理仍是LMM显著短板，该基准提供了高真实性、低标注偏差的可诊断评测平台与逐轮隔离协议。

Abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis unfolds over native video, where a single positive finding during traversal of the gastrointestinal tract sets off a multi-minute chain of reasoning over location, morphology, severity and intervention. Existing endoscopy multimodal benchmarks test only static images or single-disease videos, which miss the temporal and clinical reasoning that real-world reporting demands. We introduce EndoSCOP-V, a video-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for structured endoscopy reporting and clinical reasoning. It contains 1,307 real-world endoscopy and colonoscopy videos (63.2 h; 97% 1080p) averaging about 174 s. Its 20,274 question-answer turns are instantiated deterministically from clinician-filled structured endoscopy-reporting EHRs, so no per-case annotation is synthetic or LLM-rephrased. They come from 1,033 clinician-reviewed templates, about 18 per disease, that span a clinically aligned 9-task x 30-sub-task reporting taxonomy over 54 World Endoscopy Organization (WEO) MST 3.0 diseases. 22% of procedures carry co-existing pathologies, up to six per case. A Markovian context-pruned oracle-forcing protocol evaluates the dialogue turn by turn, injecting the gold answer before each subsequent turn so that per-turn reasoning is isolated from cascading dialogue errors. A panel of 15 board-certified endoscopists sets a 78% strict-accuracy baseline on 1,500 questions. Across 14 open-weight LMMs, the best 27B-class model reaches 59.8% strict accuracy, falling to 53.4% once format-trivial disease-rejection items are excluded. On a between-subjects spot-check, the best of 3 frontier proprietary models trails the clinician panel by 23 pp on strict NDR accuracy. Sub-task analysis reveals consistent gaps in quantitative measurement, multi-variable grading and intervention reasoning on long-horizon video. Data: Hugging Face (EndoSCOP-V). Code: GitHub (abhi25t/EndoSCOP-V).

</details>


### [84] [Latent-WAM++: Shaping World and Action Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10632)
*Yichen Zhang,Yupeng Zheng,Linbo Wang,Pengxuan Yang,Zebin Xing,Junli Wang,Shiwei Li,Kangwei Liu,Fan Ren,Qichao Zhang,Yifeng Pan,Ji Tao,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Latent-WAM++ 以"表征为中心"重构世界动作模型：对世界表征、轨迹规划、视觉-动作对齐三部分分别施加与其规划角色匹配的监督，在 NAVSIM v2 达 90.1 EPDMS，HUGSIM 零样本 47.0 RC / 30.1 HD-Score，端到端训练仅 190 GPU 小时（较 Latent-WAM 降 88.1%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶 WAM 主要只监督未来状态预测或最终动作，连接预测与规划的中间世界表征与动作表征只受间接约束，导致表征质量与规划需求错配；同时训练成本高。

Method: 三点设计：(1) 世界表征构建——场景-自车联合未来预测 + SIGReg 分布稳定化 + 冻结几何先验，去除 EMA target encoder，得到时序可预测、非退化、几何感知的世界表征；(2) 轨迹 MeanFlow 规划器——直接预测多模态轨迹提案，用改进的 MeanFlow 速度空间目标优化，支持单步采样；(3) 视觉-动作表征对齐——将输出前动作特征与当前视觉语义导出的 stop-gradient 目标对齐。

Result: NAVSIM v2 上 90.1 EPDMS 达 SOTA；HUGSIM 零样本 47.0 平均 RC、30.1 平均 HD-Score；规划器端到端训练 190 GPU 小时 vs Latent-WAM 1,600 小时，减少 88.1%。

Conclusion: 按规划角色定制表征监督可同时提升性能与训练效率；但验证均为仿真基准（NAVSIM/HUGSIM），缺少真实道路部署与闭环实车证据，且未开源/未展示感知失败模式分析。

Abstract: We introduce Latent-WAM++, a representation-centered World Action Model (WAM) for end-to-end autonomous driving. Existing WAMs are primarily trained to predict future states or final actions, leaving the intermediate world and action representations that connect prediction to planning only indirectly constrained. Latent-WAM++ matches the supervision of each representation to its role in planning. World Representation Construction combines scene-ego future prediction, SIGReg-based distribution stabilization, and frozen geometric priors to learn a temporally predictive, non-degenerate, and geometry-aware world representation without an EMA target encoder. Trajectory MeanFlow Planner directly predicts multimodal trajectory proposals while being optimized with an Improved MeanFlow velocity-space objective, enabling one-step sampling. Visual-Action Representation Alignment further aligns the resulting pre-output action features with a stop-gradient target derived from current visual semantics. Latent-WAM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM v2 and under zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM, reaching 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 47.0 average RC and 30.1 average HD-Score on HUGSIM. Training the planner end to end costs 190 GPU-hours for Latent-WAM++ versus 1,600 for Latent-WAM, a reduction of 88.1%.

</details>


### [85] [VAComp: View-Aware Full Projector Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10637)
*Kai Zhou,Qingyue Deng,Bingyao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VAComp: 首个面向移动观看者的视角感知全投影补偿框架，结合2D Gaussian视角条件几何校正与学习式光度补偿，解决SfM尺度歧义与反向相机标定问题，实现实时/交互式补偿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全投影补偿假设相机视角静止；移动观看者场景下，视角相关方法需重训练或重标定，NeRF/GS类视角无关方法存在SfM全局尺度未知及面向投影仪的反向相机标定难题。

Method: 以度量标定作为参考恢复SfM全局尺度；用两块棋盘格（分别朝向RGB相机与深度相机）标定反向相机；提出两个非迭代混合方法VAComp-SD与VAComp-SI，将2D Gaussian视角条件几何校正与学习式光度补偿结合，单次前向推理直接预测补偿图像，无需逐帧迭代优化。

Result: 真实场景实验表明两方法补偿质量均具竞争力；VAComp-SD支持实时更新，VAComp-SI达到交互级帧率；可在裸眼条件下让观看者看到虚拟物体替换真实物体，或观察视角一致的外观/材质修改。

Conclusion: VAComp为移动观看者的全投影补偿提供了可行且高效的视角感知方案，通过度量标定与双棋盘格设计解决标定瓶颈，非迭代架构兼顾质量与速度。

Abstract: Full projector compensation adjusts a projector's input image to compensate for both geometric and photometric distortions introduced by the projection surface. Existing methods generally treat the viewing condition as a static camera viewpoint. When applied to a moving viewer, existing methods face two key challenges: (1) view-dependent methods require model retraining or recalibration to compensate for novel viewpoints; and (2) NeRF/GS-based view-agnostic methods use structure from motion (SfM) to calibrate the projector-camera systems (ProCams) with an unknown global scale, while view-aware tracking requires calibrating a camera oriented opposite to the projector, which introduces an additional calibration challenge. To address these challenges, we introduce VAComp, the first view-aware framework for full projector compensation for a moving viewer in a naked-eye setting. Using a projector, VAComp enables the viewer to perceive a virtual object that visually replaces the real object or to observe view-consistent modifications of the real object's appearance and material properties. To resolve the SfM scale ambiguity, we use metric calibration as a reference to recover the global scale; to calibrate the oppositely facing camera, we use two checkerboards, one facing the RGB camera and the other facing the depth camera. To balance compensation quality and runtime efficiency, we develop two non-iterative hybrid methods, VAComp-SD and VAComp-SI. Both combine 2D Gaussian-based view-conditioned geometric correction with learned photometric compensation, predicting each compensation image through a single forward pass without per-frame iterative optimization. Real-world experiments show that both methods achieve competitive compensation quality, with VAComp-SD enabling real-time updates and VAComp-SI operating at interactive rates. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [86] [VisProve: Learning Typed Visual Provenance for Scientific Document Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10642)
*Jingxuan Wei,Zhengyang Wang,Zheng Guo,Xiaoming Wu,Fuqiang Wang,Xin Wang,Bihui Yu,Yining Wang,Junnan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReViE数据集与VisProve方法，研究科学文档问答中带类型标注的视觉溯源（引用/压缩/推断），通过可微空间证据读取与证据-答案关系反馈提升细粒度溯源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉引用只显示答案在何处被支持，却不说明被引内容如何支撑答案（直接读取、压缩多观察、还是组合推理）。科学文档QA需要显式的支持关系建模。

Method: 构建ReViE数据集：3,941个问题、完整科学文档、页面/章节/区域标注，关系类型为Quotation/Compression/Inference。提出VisProve：在联合答案与溯源生成中引入可微空间证据读取（Spatial Evidence Reading）和证据-答案关系反馈，通过门控有界范数残差将下一token预测条件于局部视觉证据及估计的支持关系。

Result: 在文档不重叠的ReViE测试集上，相较同骨干的联合SFT，Typed-F1从3.52提升至5.48，Section-F1从45.99提升至53.24，Page-F1基本不变。

Conclusion: 将视觉grounding与支持关系建模耦合可改善细粒度溯源，但Typed-F1绝对值偏低，揭示答案生成与精确视觉证据归因之间仍存在显著鸿沟。

Abstract: Visual citations show where an answer is supported, but not how the cited content contributes to it. In scientific document question answering, a model may read a value directly, compress several observations, or combine evidence to infer a conclusion. We study typed visual provenance, where a system generates an answer together with source regions and explicit support relations. We introduce ReViE, a dataset of 3,941 questions over complete scientific documents, with page, section, and region annotations labeled as Quotation, Compression, or Inference. We further propose VisProve, which augments joint answer and provenance generation with differentiable Spatial Evidence Reading and Evidence-Answer Relation Feedback. VisProve conditions next-token prediction on localized visual evidence and its estimated support relation through a gated norm-bounded residual. On the document-disjoint ReViE test set, VisProve improves Typed-F1 from 3.52 to 5.48 and Section-F1 from 45.99 to 53.24 over joint supervised fine-tuning with the same backbone, while Page-F1 changes only marginally. These results suggest that coupling visual grounding with support relation modeling mainly improves fine-grained provenance, while the low absolute Typed-F1 reveals a substantial gap between answer generation and precise visual evidence attribution.

</details>


### [87] [Agent2BIM: A Systematic Evaluation of Reality-Capture Configurations and Prior Models for As-Built Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10644)
*Boyu Wang,Borja García de Soto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Agent2BIM：智能体驱动的Scan-to-BIM框架，通过实验对比7种采集配置（全景图、手机视频、手机LiDAR、TLS等），量化视觉证据与度量证据在构件检测、几何精度和MEP连通性上的互补作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体已能从实景采集数据生成竣工BIM，但"什么样的采集证据才能保证重建精度"缺乏系统量化结论，工程实践中配置选择缺少依据。

Method: 提出Agent2BIM智能体框架，在实验室与MEP场景中评估7种采集配置：360°全景、手机视频、手机LiDAR、地面激光扫描(TLS)、TLS+位姿全景、以及先验IFC模型辅助影像；以TLS验证的参考模型为基准，比较构件检测召回率、几何定位精度与MEP连通性重建结果。

Result: 实验室场景构件召回率84%–100%，但全景图重建中仅9%构件位于参考位置20 cm内，手机LiDAR达86%；MEP场景中无尺度输入仅恢复11%–43%构件，度量输入为75%–93%；先验IFC可提升MEP重建但会传播误差。

Conclusion: 视觉与度量证据在智能体Scan-to-BIM中互补：视觉输入利于语义识别与召回，度量输入决定几何与连通性可靠性；先验模型需谨慎校验。

Abstract: AI agents can generate as-built Building Information Models (BIMs) from reality-capture data, but the evidence required for accurate reconstruction remains unclear. This paper presents Agent2BIM, an agent-based Scan-to-BIM framework, and evaluates seven capture configurations in a research laboratory and a mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) scene. Inputs include 360° panoramas, smartphone video, smartphone LiDAR, terrestrial laser scanning (TLS), TLS with posed panoramas, and imagery supplemented by prior IFC models. Outputs are compared against TLS-verified reference models for component detection, geometric accuracy, and MEP connectivity. In the laboratory, component recall ranged from 84% to 100%, but only 9% of components reconstructed from panoramas were within 20 cm of their reference positions, compared with 86% using smartphone LiDAR. In the MEP scene, scale-free inputs recovered 11 - 43% of components, versus 75 - 93% for metric inputs. Prior IFC models improved MEP reconstruction but could propagate inaccuracies. The results highlight the complementary roles of visual and metric evidence in agent-based Scan-to-BIM.

</details>


### [88] [SHIN: Scalable Hierarchy for INcremental 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10652)
*Reagan Koo,Yeong-Gyu Kim,Eun-Seok Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SHIN提出可扩展的分层3DGS表示：由可复用的Base层与可叠加的增强层组成，各质量档位解码为累积表示；通过多尺度位置-尺度敏感度确定统一高斯排序，并用按字节校准的梯度分数在每阶段预算内分配"新增高斯数 vs 保留SH阶数"，配合轻量不透明度更新；三个基准上取得最佳PSNR-尺寸效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽能实时高质量新视角合成，但部署设备与网络带宽差异大；现有紧凑化方法多针对单一工作点，换一个预算需重新训练一套表示，无法复用。

Method: 构建"Base + 增量增强层"的分层3DGS：以多尺度位置-尺度敏感度推导全局共享的高斯排序，使各阶段新增高斯在后续前缀中保持有效；每阶段在总预算内用按字节标定的梯度得分，联合决策新增高斯数量与保留的SH频带；仅对不透明度做轻量更新以改善合成，传输的几何与SH系数不变。

Result: 三个基准上，单一累积表示随阶段递进提升质量，并在所有重叠对比中相对多码率与渐进式基线取得最优PSNR-尺寸效率。

Conclusion: 通过共享排序与按字节敏感度分配，可在一次构建中覆盖多预算部署，避免为每个码率单独训练，为3DGS的内容自适应流式与多档位分发提供了可复用表示方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but deployment budgets vary across devices and network conditions. Most compact methods target one operating point, so another budget requires a separate representation. SHIN is a scalable 3DGS hierarchy with a reusable Base and additive enhancement layers, so each higher-quality operating point extends rather than replaces the decoded representation. Constructing this hierarchy requires deciding which Gaussians each stage adds and how much spherical-harmonic (SH) appearance each retains, because these choices remain fixed in later prefixes. SHIN derives one shared Gaussian order from multi-scale position-scale sensitivity and divides each stage budget between adding Gaussians and retaining SH bands using calibrated gradient-based scores per byte. Lightweight opacity updates adjust compositing while transmitted geometry and SH coefficients remain unchanged. Across three benchmarks, SHIN progressively improves one cumulative representation and achieves the best PSNR-size efficiency in every overlapping comparison with the multi-rate and progressive baselines.

</details>


### [89] [FG-DSA: Frequency-Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10653)
*Yiyao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FG-DSA 将 2D FFT 高通滤波先验显式注入深度可分离空间注意力，以线性复杂度恢复细粒度边界，用于高效密集预测与扩散生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限场景下密集预测与生成任务中，反复下采样导致空间细节丢失、边界退化；现有注意力机制虽缓解语义歧义，但难以保留高频特征或计算代价过高。

Method: 提出 FG-DSA 框架：采用 2D FFT 高通滤波模块提取频率域高频信息，并将其作为先验注入深度可分离（depthwise separable）空间注意力，实现线性复杂度的高频特征保留；该模块可插入分割网络及扩散 U-Net 中。

Result: 语义分割中边界恢复更精细并取得一致的性能提升；作为模块嵌入扩散生成 U-Net 后，生成图像细节显著改善，而参数量与 FLOPs 开销极小。

Conclusion: 频域高通先验与轻量注意力的结合是提升边界保真度的低成本通用手段，可跨任务复用于分割与生成式骨干网络。

Abstract: Dense prediction and generative modeling in resource-constrained scenarios remain challenging, as repeated downsampling substantially reduces spatial detail and degrades boundaries. Although recent attention mechanisms have alleviated the problem of semantic ambiguity, they often fail to preserve high-frequency features or do so at the expense of a very high computational cost. In this paper, we propose the Frequency Guided Depthwise Separable Attention for Efficient Dense Prediction (FG-DSA), a novel framework for efficient dense visual understanding and generation. FG-DSA employs a 2D FFT high-pass filtering module to explicitly inject frequency domain priors into the spatial attention mechanism, allowing lightweight networks to recover sharp boundary transitions with linear complexity. A range of experiments show that FG-DSA is effective at recovering fine object boundaries and leads to a consistent performance gain in the task of semantic segmentation. Importantly, we show that FGA-DSA can be used as a module in diffusion-based generative U-Nets, leading to a significant improvement in the detail of the generated images with very little additional parameter and Floating Point Operation (FLOP) cost.

</details>


### [90] [Dynamics-Informed Action Learning for Goal-Conditioned Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10660)
*Yinuo Jiang,Guangzhi Wang,Yiran Wang,Junfu Pu,Cheng Cheng,Honghao Chen,Cheng Cheng,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DIAL通过"rollout alignment"让前向世界模型暴露于自身自回归潜状态、用多步逆动力学监督训练轻量逆动力学头，并在测试时用逆-前向动力学自回归耦合生成动作序列以初始化CEM提议分布均值，再经CEM精化，在四个视觉控制基准上优于现有潜世界模型与规划基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型存在两处训练与使用的不一致：其一，teacher-forcing训练从未让动力学模型接触规划时递归预测的潜状态，导致误差累积；其二，采样式规划器（如CEM）从与目标无关的提议出发，浪费了世界模型已学到的动作条件动力学知识。

Method: 训练端：(1) rollout alignment，用模型自回归产生的潜状态进行对齐训练，缓解曝露偏差；(2) 多步逆监督，训练轻量逆动力学头由潜状态转移推断动作；(3) 将逆动力学头（参数冻结）施加于模型生成的转移上，促使预测rollout保留动作相关信息。测试端：自回归耦合逆动力学与前向动力学，朝目标构造"动力学知情"动作序列，作为CEM提议分布均值初始化，随后按标准采样-更新流程精化。

Result: 四个视觉控制基准上，在标准与长时程设定下均优于现有潜世界模型与规划基线（如CEM、无初始化的采样规划）。

Conclusion: 将训练时的动态模型与测试时的规划器通过逆动力学头显式桥接，可同时改善潜动力学的一致性与采样效率，为潜空间规划提供低成本、可即插即用的先验初始化方案。

Abstract: Latent world models enable visual control by planning action sequences in compact representation spaces, but a gap remains between how latent dynamics are learned and how they are used for planning. First, teacher-forced training does not expose the dynamics model to the recursively predicted latent states encountered during planning. Second, sampling-based planners typically initialize action search from goal-agnostic proposals, without exploiting the action-conditioned dynamics learned by the world model. We introduce Dynamics-Informed Action Learning (DIAL) to bridge these two gaps. During training, rollout alignment exposes the forward model to its own autoregressive latent predictions, while multi-step inverse supervision trains a lightweight inverse dynamics head to infer actions from latent-state transitions. We further apply the inverse head to model-generated transitions with its parameters held fixed, encouraging predicted rollouts to retain action-relevant information. At test time, DIAL autoregressively couples the inverse and forward dynamics to construct a dynamics-informed action sequence toward the goal, which initializes the mean of the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) proposal distribution. The subsequent CEM search then refines this initialization using the standard sampling and updating procedure. Experiments across four visual control benchmarks demonstrate that DIAL outperforms existing latent world models and planning baselines in both standard and long-horizon scenarios.

</details>


### [91] [Physically Guided TeX Generation for Low-Light Visual Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10665)
*Daoheng Li,Jianjun Qian,Mengkai Yan,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Te X-Gen 是一个物理引导框架,从低光场景下的可见光-红外图像对生成温度/发射率/纹理(TeX)三张物理量图,无需高光谱硬件或像素级物理标注;并配套无标签评估指标TeXMetric与任务微调策略TeX Tune。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有红外-可见光融合方法只优化图像外观或任务特征,未显式解耦热观测背后的耦合物理因子,在热退化条件下缺乏物理可解释性;高光谱测温需专用硬件且物理标注成本高,故需从普通配对图像中无监督地生成物理量图。

Method: TeX Generation:构建互补多视角特征,用独立分支专属门控分别路由线索至温度、发射率、纹理三张图;TeXMetric:结合辐射重建、通道结构与材质一致性,在无像素级物理标签下评估生成质量;TeX Tune:冻结生成器,联合优化调整模块与下游任务网络,进行任务引导微调。

Result: 在FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD、MSRS上,低光环境下取得有竞争力的下游任务性能;在HADAR数据上分析了TeXMetric分数与下游检测性能的相关性。

Conclusion: 通过物理量分解式生成与无标签物理一致性度量,TeX-Gen 为低光多模态视觉提供了可解释、低成本的热物理表示,并可通过任务引导微调提升性能。

Abstract: Low-light conditions reduce visible contrast and obscure details, while infrared images lack color and texture, motivating the fusion of infrared and visible information for visual tasks. Existing fusion methods primarily optimize image appearance or task-specific features without explicitly disentangling the coupled factors underlying thermal observations, limiting their physical interpretation under thermal degeneracy. Hyperspectral thermal measurements enable physical decomposition, but they require specialized imaging hardware, while pixel-level physical annotations for supervision or evaluation incur additional costs. We propose TeX-Gen, a physically guided framework for TeX generation from paired visible and infrared images in low-light visual tasks. TeX Generation constructs complementary multi-view features and employs independent branch-specific gates to route cues into the Temperature, Emissivity, and Texture maps. TeXMetric integrates radiometric reconstruction, channel structure, and material consistency to assess the generated maps without requiring pixel-level physical labels. TeX Tune improves performance through task-guided adjustments, jointly optimizing the adjustment modules and task network while keeping the generator frozen. Experiments show that TeX-Gen achieves competitive task performance in low-light environments on the FLIR, LLVIP, M3FD, and MSRS datasets. Experiments on HADAR also examine the association between TeXMetric scores and downstream detection performance.

</details>


### [92] [Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10672)
*Qi Wang,Jinjia Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HACD将异构蒸馏转化为共享单位超球面上的概率方向对比对齐，用批内互斥负样本传递教师的关系结构，无需额外参数，在CIFAR-100与ImageNet-1K跨架构蒸馏上普遍优于logit KD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer→CNN等跨架构蒸馏中，logit存在偏移、尺度与锐度差异，非目标类语义组织性弱，逐样本匹配logit值等于让学生模仿别人的表述方式。作者主张异构教师应传递预测的"关系结构"而非具体数值。

Method: 将教师与学生logit映射为去中心化、温度软化后的概率方向，投影到共享单位超球面，消除架构相关偏移并由温度控制峰值锐度；对每个学生输出构造批内实例判别任务，令其识别对应的教师目标，其余教师目标做负样本；教师目标在中等增强视图上计算，学生侧同时用中等与强增强视图与之对比。

Result: CIFAR-100上12组异构对中11组取得最优或次优，ImageNet-1K上15组中14组，且不使用真实标签；相较vanilla KD平均提升8.82与1.33个百分点；无新增可学习参数，每样本仅一次教师前向。

Conclusion: 以关系结构替代逐样本logit匹配，是跨架构蒸馏更匹配的有效范式，兼具零参数开销与良好泛化性。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) between architectural families, e.g., from a Transformer teacher to a CNN student, is difficult because the two networks learn different representations. Logits share a label space, but heterogeneous teachers differ in logit offset, scale, and sharpness, and their non-target classes are less semantically organized. Conventional logit distillation matches these values sample by sample, asking the student to imitate how another architecture expresses its predictions. We argue that a heterogeneous teacher should pass on the relational structure of its predictions, i.e., how it arranges samples relative to one another, and propose Heterogeneous Asymmetric Contrastive Distillation (HACD) to transfer this structure. HACD maps teacher and student logits to centered, temperature-softened probability directions on a shared unit hypersphere, which removes architecture-dependent offsets and lets the temperature control how sharply peaked outputs enter the representation while keeping informative non-target classes. Each student output must then identify its own teacher target within the batch. Because every teacher target also acts as a negative for the others, HACD computes the targets on a moderately augmented view and contrasts both a moderate and a strong student view against them. HACD adds no learnable parameters and needs one teacher pass per sample. It achieves the best or second-best accuracy on 11 of 12 heterogeneous pairs on CIFAR-100, without ground-truth labels, and on 14 of 15 pairs on ImageNet-1K, improving over the reported vanilla KD results by 8.82 and 1.33 percentage points on average. Checkpoints are available at this https URL the code will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [93] [MGE: A Membership Guided Data Extraction Attack against Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10678)
*Yuchang Mei,Longqiang Wang,Haoyang Jiang,Mingyang Yi,Shaolei Zhang,Keman Huang,Wuqiong Pan,Ju Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出成员引导提取（MGE）框架，将扩散模型训练数据提取攻击建模为以成员推理分类器输出为条件信号的条件生成，并用对抗梯度与并行分支解码提升成功率与效率，实验中成功提取数百张训练图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型对训练数据存在记忆性，带来训练数据泄露（数据提取攻击）的安全风险，需要显式揭示该风险以引起对扩散模型隐私保护的重视。

Method: 将数据提取形式化为条件生成问题：条件信号来自成员推理（membership inference）分类器；为提升成功率与效率，引入对抗梯度（adversarial gradient）与并行分支解码（parallel branch decoding）。在图像生成基准上做实验验证。

Result: 在图像生成基准上，MGE 可从预训练扩散模型中成功提取数百张训练图像，验证了记忆与数据泄露的实际风险。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的记忆性可被系统性利用实施数据提取攻击，需加强训练数据隐私保护；本文提供了一套有效的提取-评估范式，可作为隐私风险审计工具。

Abstract: Recently, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image generation. However, their inherent memory properties introduce a potential safety risk of training data leakage, i.e., data extraction attack. To illustrate such risk, we propose a membership guided extraction (MGE) framework to effectively extract training data from a pre-trained diffusion model. Our core idea is to formulate the data extraction as a conditional generation, where the condition signal is from a membership inference classifier. To improve the success rate and efficiency of MGE, we propose adversarial gradient and parallel branch decoding. Our experiments on image generation benchmarks demonstrate that our MGE can extract hundreds of images, which shows that more attention should be paid to privacy-preserving of diffusion model.

</details>


### [94] [JoVox: Joint Hierarchical Flow Matching for Lightweight Voxel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10690)
*Xiangjun Tang,Jianqi Chen,Peter Wonka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JoVox proposes a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of a voxel hierarchy, letting finer cells participate in coarse decisions; a two-level prediction head and an unmasking/re-decision strategy further boost fidelity-lightweightness trade-off.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing voxel generators are either high-fidelity but heavy, or lightweight but low-fidelity. Hierarchical voxel generators stay lightweight, yet their coarse levels—which determine all finer cells—are produced with the least shape information and are never revisited, yielding plausible-but-wrong coarse structure.

Method: Discrete flow matching over the joint distribution of all hierarchy levels (instead of per-level marginals), so coarse cells can be predicted conditioned on already-generated finer cells. Adds (1) two-level prediction that outputs cells two levels finer at once, halving processed levels; (2) an unmasking strategy that revisits early coarse decisions after finer cells appear and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models.

Result: Outperforms baselines on unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. vs. TRELLIS.2: 8x training throughput, 1/15 forward FLOPs, 4 vs 32 GPUs, and 11% lower Chamfer distance (higher quality).

Conclusion: Joint hierarchical flow matching with fine-to-coarse information reuse and revisiting of early decisions delivers high-fidelity yet lightweight voxel generation with large efficiency gains.

Abstract: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. Current generators are either high-fidelity but computationally heavy, or lightweight but of lower fidelity. Hierarchical methods keep the lightweight nature of voxels. However, their coarse levels, which decide where all finer cells can appear, are generated with the least information about the shape and are never revisited, so they are often plausible but wrong. Our key insight is to let finer cells take part in deciding coarse cells. To this end, we propose JoVox, a discrete flow matching framework that learns the joint distribution of all levels of the voxel hierarchy, instead of a separate distribution for each level, so that coarse cells can be predicted with finer cells already generated nearby. Within this framework, we further introduce a two-level prediction, which outputs the cells two levels finer at once instead of one level finer, halving the number of levels that the network processes and yielding voxels of higher fidelity. We also introduce an unmasking strategy that revisits early decisions once finer cells are generated and corrects inconsistencies in masked diffusion models. Our framework outperforms the baselines on both unconditional and image-conditioned voxel generation. Compared with the current state-of-the-art TRELLIS.2, we achieve 8x higher training throughput, 1/15 of the FLOPs in a forward pass, train on 4 vs. 32 GPUs, and obtain higher quality with an 11% lower Chamfer distance.

</details>


### [95] [Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10694)
*Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi,Syed Talal Wasim,Juergen Gall,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文认为视觉ToM（心理理论）任务的主要瓶颈在于感知前端：模型无法从视觉输入中提取可靠场景状态，而非缺乏信念推理能力；提出五条件解离协议与Perceptual Contribution Ratio量化感知贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs在文本虚假信念探测上接近人类，但换为视觉呈现后性能骤降20+个百分点；现有共识将其归因于概念/推理层面（需新增信念推理模块），作者主张应归因于感知层面——模型"看不见"而非"想不通"。

Method: 提出五条件解离协议：保持推理任务不变，仅改变感知保真度（纯视觉→纯文本连续谱），用Perceptual Contribution Ratio（视觉-文本差距中被某保真度弥合的比例）量化。测试场景包括Heider–Simmel式抽象2D面板与MuMA-ToM/MindPower自然3D游戏场景；评估7个VLM、约15.9万次API调用；对比真值脚手架与自动解析器（含前沿VLM）构建的脚手架。

Result: 真值脚手架在所有设置下显著缩小差距，在抽象面板与MuMA-ToM上达到或超过纯文本推理；自动解析器（含前沿VLM）构建的脚手架则失败。纯视觉条件下的主要错误为"现实偏差"（reality bias），占虚假信念失败案例的60%——模型报告物体实际位置而非缺失智能体所认为的位置，表明感知前端无法追踪各时刻在场的智能体。

Conclusion: 在所评估协议下，结构化视觉场景状态提取（而非信念推断）是视觉ToM的主导瓶颈；这挑战"缺推理模块"的共识诊断，并为VLM视觉心智归因提供了感知侧的分析框架。

Abstract: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

</details>


### [96] [PLS-GS: Probabilistic Lidar Scaffolds for Compact, Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10699)
*Krishnan Harikumar,Alejandro Fontan,Thierry Peynot,Emili Hernández,Niko Sünderhauf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PLS-GS 用分层高斯混合模型对「位置+颜色」联合拟合 LiDAR 点云，构造连续自适应的概率"脚手架"，再将每个可渲染 3DGS 高斯绑定到某个 GMM 分量并在其局部表面坐标系内约束，配合 Mahalanobis 支撑损失，使图元贴合测量表面，模型更紧凑、渲染更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 通常只从图像优化，几何松散；而机器人与建图场景往往同时提供相机与高清 LiDAR，二者互补（外观+精确几何）未被充分利用。现有做法要么忽略 LiDAR，要么依赖体素/八叉树等离散划分来做几何约束。

Method: 1) 对 LiDAR 点做联合位置-颜色分层高斯混合拟合，得到连续自适应 scaffold，免去体素/八叉树离散划分；2) 每个渲染高斯关联一个 GMM 分量，并在其协方差诱导的局部表面帧中约束（压扁到切平面）；3) 引入 Mahalanobis 支撑损失，限制渲染高斯相对 LiDAR 表面的偏离。

Result: 在五个大型室外场景上，相比纯图像初始化与 LiDAR 初始化基线，PLS-GS 的图元显著更贴近 LiDAR 测量，同时图元数量大幅减少，模型更紧凑、渲染更快；在等容量（matched capacity）对比下，图元更贴合 LiDAR 且渲染质量相当。代码开源。

Conclusion: 用概率隐式结构替代离散空间划分来注入 LiDAR 几何先验是有效且轻量的做法，能在更少图元下获得更准表面与更快渲染，适合机器人/建图等 LiDAR-相机融合场景；但属于户外大场景重建的原位优化（per-scene），泛化性与下游机器人任务验证有限。

Abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is typically optimized from images only, many robotics and mapping applications provide both camera and high-definition LiDAR data, combining rich visual appearance with accurate geometric structure. We introduce PLS-GS, a probabilistic LiDAR scaffold for Gaussian Splatting that exploits this complementary sensing setting to construct a compact 3DGS representation aligned to the measured surface. PLS-GS fits a Hierarchical Gaussian Mixture Model jointly over position and color, yielding a continuous and adaptive scaffold that eliminates the need for discrete scene partitioning such as voxel grids or octrees. The fitted mixture then guides the renderable 3DGS Gaussians: each rendering Gaussian is associated with a GMM component and constrained in the local surface frame induced by that component's covariance. A Mahalanobis support loss bounds the deviation of the rendering Gaussians from the corresponding LiDAR-derived surface. Across five large outdoor scenes, PLS-GS places primitives markedly closer to the LiDAR measurements than both image- and LiDAR-initialized baselines, while employing substantially fewer primitives, yielding a considerably more compact model and faster rendering. At matched capacity, PLS-GS places primitives closer to the LiDAR measurements, with comparable rendering quality. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [97] [Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10713)
*Jinfan Liu,Xuhan Zhan,Mengqin Zhao,Guangyi Deng,Wuze Zhang,Bingbing Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出模型引导的笔画审计渲染框架：以Quadratic Bezier Splatting解析建模连续曲线笔画并支持可微alpha合成，结合前馈多尺度笔画解码器（学习笔画尺度分配）与测试时笔画优化，并引入单笔画审计机制剔除局部缺陷基元。PSNR最高提升5.46 dB，表示紧凑16%，渲染前反向计算加速220.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于笔画的渲染被当作像素级重建任务优化，过度依赖全局误差下降，导致笔画缺乏结构化规划而退化为碎片化曲线，且局部缺陷基元会被重叠图层掩盖。需要引入结构化先验与逐笔画质量审计。

Method: 1) Quadratic Bezier Splatting：用二次贝塞尔曲线解析表示连续笔画，配合高效可微alpha合成作为渲染器；2) 前馈多尺度笔画解码器：提供结构化初始化并学习笔画尺度分配；3) 测试时笔画优化：补偿前馈网络的重建能力，实现高保真细化；4) 单笔画审计机制：显式评估局部笔画质量，阻止缺陷基元通过层级补偿在优化中存活。

Result: 相比现有方法，布局更连贯一致；PSNR提升最高5.46 dB；表示紧凑度提高16%；渲染器前向+反向计算整体加速220.3倍。

Conclusion: 将"前馈结构初始化+测试时优化+单基元质量审计"组合，可在笔画式可微渲染中同时获得更好的结构连贯性、重建精度与计算效率，为矢量/笔画类表示提供可审计的优化范式。

Abstract: Stroke-based rendering is often optimized as a pixel-level reconstruction task. This over-reliance on global error reduction not only degrades strokes into fragmented curves due to a lack of structured planning, but also allows locally defective primitives to be concealed by overlapping layers. To address these issues, we introduce a model-guided framework for stroke-audited rendering. Our framework uses Quadratic Bezier Splatting to analytically model continuous curved strokes with efficient differentiable alpha compositing. Built on this renderer, a feedforward multi-scale stroke decoder provides a structural initialization with learned stroke-scale allocation, while test-time stroke optimization supplies the reconstruction capacity needed for high-fidelity refinement. We further propose a single-stroke audit mechanism that explicitly evaluates local stroke quality, preventing defective primitives from surviving optimization through layer-wise compensation. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves coherent layouts, improves PSNR by up to 5.46 dB, yields a 16% more compact representation, and accelerates combined renderer forward and backward computation by a factor of 220.3.

</details>


### [98] [Permute-then-Adapt: Weak-to-Strong Contrastive Image-Text Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10714)
*Jinhao Li,Sarah Erfani,Lei Feng,Guangrui Li,James Bailey,Feng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Permute-then-Adapt (PTA) 框架：利用弱模型（教师）的相似度估计随机配对参考分布，以其上尾（由显著性水平 α 决定）选出校准的辅助正样本集，再用单一多正样本对比目标训练 CLIP 类图文对齐模型，从而在控制 Type-I 错误的前提下缓解"未配对即严格负样本"造成的假负问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 等图像-文本对齐模型采用对比学习，将未配对样本视为严格负样本；实际上许多未配对样本语义相关，构成假负噪声，会损害表征。现有修正方法多依赖启发式相似度阈值，既缺乏统计依据，也难以适应不同数据集的噪声分布。

Method: 以弱教师模型的相似度分数构建"随机置换配对"的条件参考分布，据此进行统计校准：取参考分布上尾（由 α 控制）作为选择辅助正样本的判据，理论上可将 Type-I 错误控制在置换参考水平附近（受校准近似误差影响）。被选出的校准正样本集与原始正样本共同用于多正样本对比损失——每个锚点最大化其分配给正样本集合的总概率质量。弱模型的离线校准几乎不增加训练开销。

Result: 在物体识别、跨模态检索与数据效率实验中相较启发式软标签方法取得提升；离线校准带来的额外训练开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 用置换参考分布替代任意阈值，为多正样本对比学习提供有统计依据的正样本发现机制，是 CLIP 类图文对齐训练的一种低成本、可泛化的改进。

Abstract: Image-text alignment models such as CLIP are typically trained with contrastive learning, where unpaired examples are treated as strict negatives. While this assumption introduces noise by penalising semantically related pairs, existing solutions often rely on heuristic similarity thresholds that lack statistical grounding and sensitivity to dataset-specific noise distributions. In this paper, we propose Permute-then-Adapt (PTA), a framework that leverages efficient weak models to identify missed positives while controlling Type-I error relative to a conditional permutation reference, up to calibration approximation error. Unlike standard distillation or arbitrary thresholding, PTA estimates a random-pairing reference distribution from the weak teacher's similarity scores and uses its upper tail, determined by $\alpha$, to select auxiliary positives. The calibrated positive set is then trained against by a single multi-positive contrastive objective: each anchor maximises the total probability mass it assigns to its positive set. Offline calibration with the weak model adds negligible training overhead. Experiments show gains over heuristic soft-label approaches in object recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and data efficiency. Project repository: this https URL .

</details>


### [99] [Disentangled Stylized Image Generation via IP-Cross-Attention Rearrangement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10717)
*Beibei Dong,Yueming Lyu,Yue Jiang,Jing Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出通过IP-Cross-Attention重排实现解耦风格化图像生成，并用受CFG启发的负内容引导减少风格迁移中的内容泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成风格化图像时，基于循环一致性的隐式风格表示学习成本高且不适配迭代生成；扩散隐空间属性耦合导致风格提取出现内容泄漏；自然语言提示或文本反演难以充分表达风格。

Method: 基于实验观察，对IP-Adapter类跨注意力中的特征进行重排以实现风格与内容解耦；并借鉴无分类器引导（CFG）提出负内容引导，在采样中抑制内容信息泄漏。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅声明可减少内容泄漏并获得解耦的风格化生成效果。

Conclusion: 提供了一种无需高成本循环一致性训练的风格化解耦生成思路，但缺乏数据实验与代码层面的可验证证据。

Abstract: With a solid theoretical foundation and pretraining on large-scale datasets, diffusion-based methods have achieved controllable generation leveraging text and image conditions, and generating excellent stylized images is possible using diffusion models. However, previous methods face significant challenges. First, because diffusion generation is iterative, the common approach of learning implicit style representations via cycle-consistency strategies is too costly and not well-suited to diffusion, even for LoRA-based methods. Second, decoupling style is difficult in the latent space of diffusion models. Representations of attributes are coupled in the latent space of diffusion models; thus, extracting style attributes with diffusion models usually suffers from the issue of content leakage. Furthermore, because style is hard to represent in natural language, capturing style using text prompts or textual inversion is deficient. In this paper, we propose a method for achieving disentangled stylized image generation through IP-cross-attention rearrangement, based on our experimental observations. We also propose negative content guidance, inspired by classifier-free guidance, to reduce content leakage in stylized image generation.

</details>


### [100] [Locating and Repairing Domain Shift in VLM Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10720)
*Zhihong Cui,Hengyu Liu,Michael Alexander Riegler,Guandong Xu,Amir Taherkordi,Tor Skeie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoLaRx：以激活修补发现VLM驾驶规划器的域偏移呈"模态×层"二维结构，据此定位并选择性修复（MMD/LoRA/冻结分区组合），跨城市轨迹误差最低且参数与延迟更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM作为端到端驾驶规划器存在跨城市域偏移；既有方法将其视为单一量、用统一对齐或单点编辑处理，作者认为该偏移本质上是跨模态与跨层的结构化现象，统一目标会失效。

Method: 用activation patching分析偏移规律：(F1)图像与文本token偏移模式不同；(F2)层间偏移划分依赖架构但在数据集间稳定。据此提出"定位-修复"框架MoLaRx：Causal Importance Score(CIS)估计模态-层张量形式的偏移并将层划分为功能区；CIS-Guided Selective Repair(CISR)对每个功能区施加匹配算子(MMD/LoRA/冻结)，组合随架构自动适配。

Result: 在LFM2-VL-1.6B、Qwen2-VL-2B、PaliGemma2-3B三种架构与nuScenes、Argoverse 2两个跨城基准的6个主表设置中，MoLaRx跨城轨迹误差差距最小，可训练参数减少50–60%，推理延迟降低8.4–10.9 ms；纯MMD统一对齐在6个设置中全部崩溃。

Conclusion: VLM规划器的域偏移应建模为模态-层二维张量并按结构选择性修复，优于所有统一目标基线；结构引导是跨城适配有效的关键。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly adopted as end-to-end driving planners, yet they suffer from cross-city domain shift. Existing methods treat this shift as a single quantity addressed by uniform alignment or single-site editing. We challenge this view on two counts: (i) domain shift in VLM trajectory planners is inherently structured across modality and layer, and (ii) a locate-then-repair recipe matched to this structure outperforms every uniform-objective baseline. We analyse domain shift via activation patching and uncover two regularities. (F1) Modality axis. Image and text tokens exhibit distinct shift patterns in each VLM. (F2) Layer axis. The layer-wise shift partition is architecture-dependent and dataset-stable. These findings recast domain shift as a two-dimensional tensor indexed by modality (image vs. text tokens) and layer, motivating a simple principle: locate where shift occurs, and repair only there. We instantiate this principle in MoLaRx (Modality-Layer Repair), a locate-then-repair framework. The Causal Importance Score (CIS) estimates the domain shift as a modality-layer tensor and partitions the layers into functional zones. CIS-Guided Selective Repair (CISR) then applies a matched operator (Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) / low-rank adaptation (LoRA) / freezing) to repair each zone, with the composition adapting automatically to each architecture. We evaluate MoLaRx on three architecturally distinct VLMs (LFM2-VL-1.6B, Qwen2-VL-2B, and PaliGemma2-3B) across two cross-city benchmarks (nuScenes and Argoverse 2). MoLaRx attains the lowest cross-city trajectory-error gap among adaptation methods in all six main-table settings, while using 50-60% fewer trainable parameters and 8.4-10.9 ms lower inference latency. In contrast, uniform MMD-only adaptation collapses in all six settings, highlighting the importance of structure-guided repair.

</details>


### [101] [3D Segmentation in the Clinic: A Grand Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10728)
*Bram van Ginneken,Tobias Heimann,Martin Styner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: A 2007 MICCAI workshop paper describing the setup of a liver (CT) and caudate nucleus (brain MRI) segmentation competition, including datasets and scoring system.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: To provide a standardized, objective benchmark for evaluating automatic and semi-automatic medical image segmentation methods, via an open challenge held at MICCAI 2007.

Method: Organize a workshop-level segmentation challenge: define two tasks (liver from CT, caudate nucleus from brain MRI), release training/test data, and specify a scoring/evaluation protocol for comparing submissions.

Result: Training and test datasets for both tasks and an evaluation/scoring system are established; the paper reports the competition design rather than a new segmentation algorithm.

Conclusion: Challenge-based benchmarking can standardize comparison of medical segmentation methods; the value lies in reusable data and metrics rather than methodological novelty.

Abstract: This paper describes the set-up of a segmentation competition for automatic and semi-automatic extraction of the liver from computed tomography scans and the caudate nucleus from brain MRI data. This competition was held in the form of a workshop at the 2007 Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention conference. The rationale for organizing the competition is discussed, the training and test data sets for both segmentation tasks are described and the scoring system used to evaluate the segmentation is presented.

</details>


### [102] [LIFT: Local Metric Alignment and Foundation-guided Propagation for Few-shot Depth Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10729)
*Xiang Li,Xiaojin Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LIFT利用冻结的单目深度估计(MDE)基础模型的深度先验与特征先验，实现少样本深度补全：先在粗网格上估计局部尺度与平移参数并插值为稠密参数场得到空间自适应度量深度初始化，再经基础特征引导的多尺度深度传播与轻量残差解码器逐步精化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度补全需稠密度量深度标注，成本高；少样本设定下仅用少量目标域标注完成适配，需在标注成本与模型迁移能力间取得平衡。现有方法未充分利用预训练MDE基础模型中蕴含的度量深度先验与表征特征。

Method: 冻结预训练MDE基础模型，双先验复用：(1) 粗网格局部尺度/平移参数估计并插值为平滑稠密参数场，作为空间自适应度量初始化；(2) 多尺度深度传播模块，以基础特征引导逐级精化；(3) 轻量残差解码器融合多层级基础特征与传播修正输出最终度量深度。

Result: 在NYUv2与KITTI-DC上进行大量实验，少样本设置下取得SOTA性能。摘要未给出具体量化指标与消融结果，代码尚未发布。

Conclusion: 将冻结MDE基础模型作为深度与特征双先验来源，并以"仿射参数场初始化+多尺度传播+残差精化"的解耦范式，是低成本少样本深度补全的有效路径。

Abstract: Few-shot depth completion aims to recover dense metric depth from sparse measurements using only a small number of target-domain annotations, offering a favorable balance between annotation cost and model adaptation. We propose LIFT, a framework that harnesses both depth and feature priors from a frozen pretrained monocular depth estimation (MDE) foundation model for few-shot depth completion. Specifically, LIFT first estimates local scale and shift parameters on a coarse grid and interpolates them into smooth, dense parameter fields, providing a spatially adaptive metric depth initialization. It then progressively refines this initialization through multi-scale depth propagation guided by foundation features. Finally, a lightweight residual decoder combines multi-level foundation features with propagation correction to refine the metric depth. Extensive experiments on NYUv2 and KITTI-DC demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art few-shot performance. The source code will soon be released.

</details>


### [103] [Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10734)
*Yujuan Pang,Wenhao Xu,Yinglei Teng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出选择性正负在线策略自蒸馏(SPN-OPSD)，同时利用证据区域与背景区域两视角监督，并进行token级选择性蒸馏，提升多模态大模型在细粒度视觉任务中抗无关区域干扰与关注证据区域的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在需要细微图像区域证据的细粒度视觉任务上表现不足；已有方法只用证据相关区域训练，忽略了大量背景区域的影响，导致模型难以抵抗无关区域干扰。

Method: 选择性正负在线策略自蒸馏：正样本对应证据区域视角、负样本对应背景区域视角，构建双视角on-policy自蒸馏监督；并在token级进行选择性蒸馏，提供信息量更高的监督信号，强化对证据区域的注意力。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，V* Bench从76.44%提升至84.82%，ZoomBench从45.92%提升至54.56%，MME-RealWorld-Lite从57.43%提升至59.56%；Qwen3.5-0.8B上观察到类似增益。

Conclusion: 联合建模证据与背景区域的对比式自蒸馏监督能有效增强模型抗干扰能力，token级选择性蒸馏进一步改善证据区域聚焦，为细粒度视觉任务提供可迁移的训练范式。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made progress in general visual tasks. However, limitations remain in fine-grained visual tasks requiring evidence from minute image regions. Existing methods primarily train models using evidence-related regions while overlooking the influence of extensive background regions, resulting in a limited ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. We propose selective positive-negative on-policy self-distillation (SPN-OPSD), which considers both evidence and background regions. Supervision from both views improves the model's ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. Furthermore, selective token-level distillation provides more informative supervision, improving the model's ability to attend to evidence regions in Fine-Grained Visual Tasks. On Qwen3.5-2B, SPN-OPSD improves accuracy on V* Bench, ZoomBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite from 76.44%, 45.92%, and 57.43% to 84.82%, 54.56%, and 59.56%, respectively. Similar gains are also observed on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

</details>


### [104] [Writer-independent handedness identification from offline Bangla handwriting under controlled acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10744)
*Tanzim Hasan Prappo,Sayeed Hassan,Sayem Ali,Sukhendra Nath Dhar,M. Shahidur Rahman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文用受控采集的 BanglaHand 数据集（42 名书写者，21 左利手 + 21 右利手，共享提示文本 + 自选文本）研究离线孟加拉文手写笔迹的利手识别，发现墨水梯度描述子对未见书写者达到 77.4% 平衡准确率，并指出笔画深浅（笔压）是部分信号来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 笔迹利手推断在法庭文件检验与书写者画像中有软生物特征价值，但现有离线笔迹研究很少同时隔离书写者、文本与图像采集条件，模型可能学到的是书写者身份或拍摄条件而非书写手；孟加拉文尤其缺乏此类受控证据。

Method: 构建 BanglaHand 数据集（42 人，均衡左右利手，6 个公共提示 + 2 篇自写文本，统一采集与拍摄）；评估协议采用按书写者整体留出（unseen writer）、全体书写者置换检验与光度（光照/亮度）对照；以墨水梯度描述子为主，对比冻结 ImageNet 嵌入与仅形状特征；事后回归去除墨水密度与亮度。

Result: 墨水梯度描述子对未见书写者 77.4% 平衡准确率（书写者 bootstrap 95% 区间 67.7–86.5%，p=0.001）；冻结 ImageNet 嵌入 69.5–72.0%；回归掉墨水密度与亮度后仍达 64.5%（p=0.027）；纯形状特征较弱，60.8%（p=0.090）；右上利手者在等笔画宽度下笔画中心更暗，符合更高笔压且不能用光照漂移解释。

Conclusion: 在受控采集条件下，离线孟加拉文笔迹可识别书写利手；但其信号显著依赖光度线索（笔压导致的墨深），因此光度控制对这类软生物特征结论的解释是必要的，纯形状线索贡献有限。

Abstract: Handedness is a soft-biometric cue for forensic document examination and writer profiling, yet reported accuracies from offline handwriting rarely keep writers, texts and image acquisition apart, so models may recognise the writer or capture conditions rather than the writing hand. Such controlled evidence is missing for Bangla. Using our BanglaHand dataset of 42 writers (21 left- and 21 right-handed), who each wrote six shared prompts and two own texts under controlled collection and photography, we evaluate handedness identification with all images of each test writer held out, whole-writer permutation tests and photometric controls. An ink-gradient descriptor identified the handedness of unseen writers with 77.4% balanced accuracy (95% writer-bootstrap interval 67.7-86.5%; p=0.001) and frozen ImageNet embeddings with 69.5-72.0%. Part of this signal is stroke darkness: in a post hoc analysis, right-handed writers' strokes were darker at their centres for equal stroke width, consistent with higher pen pressure and not explained by lighting drift. With ink density and brightness regressed out, the descriptor still reached 64.5% (p=0.027), whereas writing-only shape features were weaker (60.8%; p=0.090). Handedness is thus identifiable from offline Bangla handwriting under controlled acquisition, and photometric controls are essential to interpret such cues.

</details>


### [105] [RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10746)
*Deguo Xia,Zihan Li,Jiaqi Wang,Dong Xie,Xiyan Liu,Liuhui Zhang,Jizhou Huang,Mengmeng Yang,Diange Yang,Chen Zhu,Liwei Qian,Xin Pei,Shuanglong Li,Hanmeng Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoadState：生产部署的视觉语言系统，将序列道路观测转为结构化车道级语义；核心模型 RoadState-VLM 以自回归状态估计建模，引入基于语义依赖DAG的几何思维链(Geo-CoT)，六维度平均准确率94.33%，已支持360+城市地图更新并降本30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车道级地图更新需要在遮挡、标线歧义、临时障碍与视角变化下保持语义的时间一致性、物理合理性与可审计性，传统逐帧感知难以满足；同时大规模生产中需兼顾成本，不能对所有场景都用大模型。

Method: 将道路场景理解形式化为自回归状态估计：以历史观测与符号化状态作为上下文预测当前结构化道路状态；提出Geo-CoT，用语义依赖有向无环图作为领域先验约束相互依赖的道路状态维度推理；配合级联路由（常规样本走轻量模型，复杂样本走RoadState-VLM）与人在回路审核。

Result: 真实数据集上六维度平均准确率94.33%，优于最强微调VLM基线；消融验证Geo-CoT与时间转移上下文的互补性；2025年3月部署后支撑360+城市车道级更新，整体生产成本下降30%，压力测试下结合人工审核保持稳健。

Conclusion: 领域先验增强推理 + 结构化状态接口 + 选择性路由 + 人工质检，可弥合VLM道路场景理解与大规模车道级地图更新之间的落地差距。

Abstract: Lane-level map updating requires temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable road-scene semantics despite occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. Its core model, RoadState-VLM, formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, predicting the current structured road state from the previous observation and symbolic state together with the current observation. We introduce Geometric Chain-of-Thought (Geo-CoT), which uses a directed acyclic graph of semantic dependencies as a domain prior to improve semantic consistency and reasoning fidelity across interdependent road-state dimensions. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset show that RoadState-VLM achieves 94.33% mean accuracy across six road-state dimensions, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned VLM baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary effectiveness of Geo-CoT and temporal transition context. A cascaded routing pipeline directs routine cases to lightweight models while reserving complex cases for RoadState-VLM. Since its deployment in March 2025, RoadState has supported lane-level map updating across more than 360 cities and reduced overall production costs by 30%. Together with human-in-the-loop auditing, the system maintains robust performance under stress-test conditions. These results demonstrate how domain-prior-enhanced reasoning, structured state interfaces, selective routing, and human quality control can bridge the gap between VLM-based road-scene understanding and large-scale lane-level map updating.

</details>


### [106] [Unified Framework with Convex-Concave Decomposition and Sparse Topological Learning for Skeleton-Based Clinical Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10758)
*Quang-Anh N. D.,Duc Pham Minh,Minh-Anh Nguyen,Hien Quang Kha,Manh Hung Ha,Minhhuy Le,Oscal Tzyh-Chiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CC2-STG多流图卷积模型，用凸-凹几何分解、稀疏正则（近端优化）与自适应拓扑建模康复动作评估，在KiMoRe与UIPRMD上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于骨架的康复评估存在三大缺陷：固定骨架拓扑无法表达代偿性动作模式；对所有关节一视同仁，忽视临床关键偏差；缺乏几何层面的理解。

Method: 多流架构：1) 将关节关系分解为互补的凸距离与凹距离函数，分别刻画局部与全局运动特征；2) 采用带近端优化的稀疏正则，筛选临床相关的几何特征；3) 多尺度拓扑分析学习病理性运动中的非解剖学关节依赖（自适应图）。

Result: 在KiMoRe与UIPRMD两个临床康复数据集上验证有效，病理性运动评估达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 几何分解+稀疏特征选择+自适应拓扑的组合可有效替代固定骨架拓扑，提升康复动作临床评估能力；但仅在两个小规模临床数据集验证，缺乏真实部署与泛化性证据。

Abstract: Skeleton-based rehabilitation assessment faces fundamental limitations of fixed topologies which cannot model compensatory patterns, uniform joint treatments overlook clinically important deviations, and lack of geometric understand- ing. We propose Concave-Convex Decomposition Sparse Topological Graph Convolutional Network (CC2-STG), a multi-stream model that combines geo- metric decomposition, sparse feature learning, and adaptive topology. Our framework decomposes joint relationships into complementary convex-concave distance functions to model both local and global movement characteristics, with sparse regularization with proximal optimization selecting clinically relevant geo- metric features, while multi-scale topological analysis captures non-anatomical joint dependencies in pathological movements. Experiments on the KiMoRe and UIPRMD datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on clinical pathological movement assessment.

</details>


### [107] [BAPLe++: Cross-Model Transferability and Prompt-Level Defense of Backdoors in Medical Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10764)
*Ufaq Khan,Umair Nawaz,Satyajit Tourani,Awais Rauf,Fahad Shamshad,Asif Hanif,Rao Muhammad Anwer,Muhammad Haris Khan,Mohammad Yaqub*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究Med-FM提示学习中植入的后门能否跨模型迁移，并提出DePLe利用感染提示作为固定锚、在少量干净数据上学新提示以消除后门。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示微调因提示紧凑、易共享而带来安全风险：少量联合优化可植入后门，需回答后门提示能否迁移到其他Med-FM，以及能否在不重训骨干的前提下修复。

Method: 提出CAD/BAD两项指标量化跨模型迁移性；提出DePLe，将感染提示作为固定锚，在小规模干净集上学习新提示，保持干净任务性能并偏离被污染的嵌入区域，与四种免训练输入变换对比。

Result: 在4个Med-FM与6个胸部X光/组织病理数据集上，后门可跨模型迁移但呈非对称、依赖数据集；DePLe比四种免训练输入变换更稳定地降低后门准确率，且保持甚至提升干净准确率。

Conclusion: 提示型后门在医学基础模型间具可迁移风险，基于提示学习的锚定修复可在冻结骨干条件下有效去后门。

Abstract: Medical foundation models (Med-FMs) are increasingly adapted to clinical tasks through prompt learning, which tunes a small set of prompt tokens while the backbone remains frozen. Recent work has shown that this efficiency introduces a vulnerability: jointly optimizing learnable prompts and an imperceptible noise trigger during few-shot adaptation implants a backdoor that leaves clean performance intact but steers triggered inputs to an attacker-chosen class. Since prompts are compact and readily shared, this raises two questions: whether a backdoored prompt remains effective on a different Med-FM, and whether it can be repaired without retraining the backbone. We address both in BAPLe++. First, we present the first study of cross-model transferability of prompt-based backdoors, quantified by two proposed metrics, Clean Accuracy Difference (CAD) and Backdoor Accuracy Difference (BAD). Second, we propose DePLe (Defense via Prompt Learning), which uses the infected prompt as a fixed anchor and learns a new prompt on a small clean set that preserves the clean task while diverging from the compromised embedding region. Experiments on four Med-FMs and six chest X-ray and histopathology datasets show that backdoors transfer across models, but asymmetrically and in a dataset-dependent manner. Compared with four training-free input transformations, DePLe reduces backdoor accuracy more consistently while preserving, and in several settings improving, clean accuracy. Our code can be accessed on this https URL

</details>


### [108] [How reliable is an embedding of the seabed? Repeat-look measurement of frozen encoders on synthetic aperture sonar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10770)
*Harold Horsley,Oscar Pizarro,Hayat Rajani,Morten Omholt Alver*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对合成孔径声呐(SAS)海底图像,用重复观测(repeat-look)可靠性框架评估冻结的DINOv3 ViT-S/16嵌入:常规单视角指标(有效秩、聚类、珊瑚线性探针AUC 0.93)均正常,但dbICC仅0.20,说明嵌入不能稳定表征同一块海底;探针学到的是一个稳定子方向(ICC 0.60,为全嵌入的3.0倍),方差分解显示不到十分之一方差来自观测几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海底声呐目标在重叠航次的不同视角下被重复成像,每个嵌入只是该目标的一次测量,而现有自监督表征评估协议默认"一个目标一个嵌入",无法回答测量一致性(可靠性)问题,也无法区分波动来自图块本身还是采集几何。

Method: 将问题形式化为测量可靠性问题:在自建SAS测区上对同一海底patch的多次重复观测计算嵌入的distance-based intraclass correlation(dbICC)、最近邻/聚类跨视角一致性,并与有效秩、聚类、线性探针等单视角指标对比;用泛化理论(generalizability theory)做方差成分分解,量化采集几何的贡献;对比DINOv3、声呐预训练编码器BenthicDINO与经典SAS纹理描述子。

Result: 单视角指标全部稳健且探针性能良好(AUC 0.93),但dbICC仅0.20,跨视角最近邻与聚类几乎不一致;矛盾的解释是探针学到稳定方向,其ICC 0.60为全嵌入的3.0倍;方差成分分析显示细胞单元内不足1/10的离散度可归因于观测几何,其余为cell-specific、在几何不匹配的重复航次下不可分离;BenthicDINO与经典纹理描述子呈现同样模式。

Conclusion: 依赖patch身份的任务(跨航次比对、检索)在该数据与这些表征上失败,而栖息地类别级任务(如珊瑚分类)仍可行;由于标准指标检测不到这一问题,作者主张任何海底表征评估都应同时报告repeat-look可靠性。

Abstract: Pretrained encoders from self-supervised representation learning are increasingly applied to sonar imagery of the seafloor, where they are evaluated with protocols that take one embedding per target. A target patch of seabed, by contrast, is re-imaged from an alternate look on overlapping survey passes, so each embedding is one measurement of that target. Standard protocols cannot say how consistent those measurements are, or how much of their spread belongs to the patch and how much to the acquisition geometry. We treat this as a measurement-reliability problem. Using a synthetic-aperture sonar (SAS) survey, we measure the repeat-look reliability of embeddings from a frozen natural-image encoder (DINOv3 ViT-S/16). Standard single-look metrics, effective rank, clustering and a linear probe for coral, are all stable to the look, and the probe performs well (AUC 0.93). Yet the repeat-look reliability of the same embeddings is poor, with a distance-based intraclass correlation (dbICC) of 0.20 and nearest neighbours and clusters that barely agree across looks. This contradiction resolves as we find the probe learns a stable direction, whose ICC of 0.60 is 3.0 times that of the full embedding. Variance components, calculated from generalizability theory, attribute under a tenth of the within-cell spread to look acquisition geometry. The rest is cell-specific and cannot be separated without repeat passes at matched geometry. A sonar-pretrained encoder (BenthicDINO) and a classical SAS texture descriptor show the same pattern. For this dataset and the tested representations, uses that depend on patch identity fail, such as cross-pass comparison and retrieval, while uses at the level of habitat type (e.g. coral classification) do not. Because the standard metrics did not detect this, we argue that repeat-look reliability should accompany any evaluation of representations of the seafloor.

</details>


### [109] [WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10771)
*Juanxi Tian,Jiadong Hou,Baiang Li,Xin Lin,Zhengbo Jiao,Weijia Zhang,Yeying Jin,Truong Nguyen,Haitian Zheng,Zhifei Zhang,Jianfei Yang,Ming-Hsuan Yang,Felix Heide,Wei Xiong,Enze Xie,Wanhua Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出世界模型的形式化定义（持久状态、历史条件化表征、动作/干预更新、反事实一致轨迹），据此构建五维智能导向评估框架（感知接地、持久状态建模、可控变换、动力学预测、闭环交互），并发布WorldFoundry开源基础设施，统一模型/基准检索、运行时与资产准备、执行编排、产物管理与可视化，含270个模型、74个基准、62个指标条目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉生成模型常以视觉逼真度冒充"世界模型"，但缺乏持久状态、物理动力学与因果一致的动作响应，导致"感知合成"与"环境模拟"边界模糊、评估不可比、结论难以追溯。

Method: 先给出生成式世界模型的预测动力学系统定义并推导评估维度；再构建WorldFoundry平台，通过模态特定适配器（视频、3D/4D、具身动作、交互式世界）保留原生输入、执行语义、输出表示与评测协议，用显式manifest、持久化产物契约与证据感知评分卡将"可执行性"与"评估主张"分离。

Result: 形成覆盖270个模型、74个基准、62个指标的目录，可执行性与运行证据分列记录；实现跨异构系统的持久、可控动力学可复现比较，每条评估主张可追溯至支撑产物。

Conclusion: 世界模型评估应从视觉逼真转向可度量的"世界智能"：持久状态、可控性与因果一致动态需作为核心判据；开放基础设施有助于统一协议并提升可复现性。

Abstract: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. The catalog contains 270 model entries, 74 benchmarks, and 62 registered metric entries, with readiness and execution evidence recorded separately. WorldFoundry enables reproducible comparison of persistent, controllable dynamics across heterogeneous systems, advancing the field from perceptual synthesis toward measurable world intelligence.

</details>


### [110] [Same Measurements, Different Velocity Risk: Complementary Rolling-Shutter Readouts under Clock Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10774)
*Lunshuo Tian,Dongheng Liu,Mingwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究在未知曝光时钟下，滚动快门相机与两个标定运动锚点的速度估计问题；证明重复读取式机型的极小极大速度风险为 σρ 量级，而互补读取式可达到 σ² 量级，并识别两类设计均正则的安装构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相同测量预算的相机装置在曝光时序不确定时速度估计精度可能不同，需要从理论上刻画读取/曝光模式（repeated vs complementary readout）对滚动快门重建速度估计的根本性影响，并给出极小极大意义下的性能界限。

Method: 在滚动快门重建框架中设定两个标定运动锚点、未知场景点、独立未知辅助位姿与时钟（含独立 6 ms 时钟）；用有限物理补偿路径构造下界证明重复读取的极小极大平方速度风险 ≥ O(σρ_eff)，用非线性速度反演证明互补读取的稳定性（O(σ²)）；识别使两种设计均正则的安装构型并量化度量不确定性导致的风险下限；并用成对噪声与深度偏移干预进行域内重建实证与栅格（raster）成像/标定敏感性研究。

Result: 在固定局部物理类（近分离式侧向相机装置）上，重复读取的最坏情况平方速度风险至少为 σρ_eff 阶，互补读取的极小极大风险为 σ² 阶，其中 ρ_eff>0 为固定容许时钟位移；给出两类设计均正则的安装构型及由度量不确定性引起的风险下限，并完成独立 6 ms 时钟下的全参数域重建测试与成像/标定敏感性分析。

Conclusion: 曝光时序（读取模式）选择在滚动快门速度估计中是决定渐近风险阶的关键因素；互补读取具有统计效率上的本质优势，但需注意安装构型与度量不确定性引入的风险下限，实践中应据此选择相机布局与时钟标定策略。

Abstract: Camera rigs with identical measurement budgets can have different velocity estimation rates when exposure timing is uncertain. We establish this distinction for rolling-shutter reconstruction with two calibrated moving anchors, unknown scene points, and independently unknown auxiliary poses and clocks. On the same fixed local physical class near a separated lateral rig, repeated readouts have worst-case squared velocity risk at least of order $\sigma\rho_{\mathrm{eff}}$, whereas complementary readouts have minimax risk of order $\sigma^2$, for a fixed admissible clock displacement $\rho_{\mathrm{eff}}>0$ as the noise standard deviation $\sigma$ tends to zero. A finite physical compensation path gives the lower bound; a nonlinear velocity inverse proves complementary stability. All motion, structure, pose, and clock nuisances remain unknown. We identify mounting configurations in which both designs become regular and quantify the risk floor induced by metric uncertainty. We quantify full-parameter domains with independent 6-ms clocks and test in-domain reconstruction under paired noise and a depth-offset intervention. Raster studies examine image formation and calibration sensitivity.

</details>


### [111] [STAR-VF: Spatio-Temporal Aware Representation Condensation for Data-Efficient Video Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10811)
*Yuchen Xian,Yunqiu Xu,Guosheng Lin,Yang He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STAR-VF，首个将数据集缩缩（dataset condensation）用于视频融合的框架：将原始训练集压缩为可学习的时空表征，经解码器生成合成视频片段，并由冻结代理模型做特征级监督；融合模型采用无光流帧间时序建模与查询驱动的帧内聚合，在红外-可见光、多曝光、多聚焦与医学视频融合上用约1/16训练数据达到全量数据训练的融合质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频融合需同时学习跨模态互补性与时序依赖，通常依赖大规模高质量视频数据集，其存储与优化中的反复使用代价高昂，因此希望实现数据高效的视频融合学习。

Method: 将视频融合重新表述为数据集缩缩问题：把原训练集压缩成少量可学习时空表征，解码为合成视频片段，用冻结代理模型的特征级监督优化（无需真值融合视频）；融合网络引入无光流的帧间时序建模与查询驱动的帧内聚合，在表征空间直接进行时序交互与融合相关信息的选择性聚合。

Result: 在红外-可见光、多曝光、多聚焦、医学四类视频融合基准上，仅用约1/16的时序训练集即达到与全量训练方法相当的融合质量；消融验证了学习式缩缩与无光流时序建模的贡献，并显示缩缩监督在不同代理编码器与下游融合模型间具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 数据缩缩可作为数据高效视频融合的有效范式，且无需真值融合视频的合成监督可迁移、可泛化；但方法面向图像/视频融合任务，与机器人、具身智能或三维重建无直接关联。

Abstract: Video fusion aims to integrate complementary cues from heterogeneous sources, producing visually informative videos with coherent spatio-temporal structures. Jointly learning cross-modal complementarity and temporal dependencies typically relies on large-scale, high-quality video datasets, whose storage and repeated use during optimization incur substantial costs, making data-efficient learning highly desirable. To address this challenge, we rethink video fusion from the perspective of dataset condensation and propose STAR-VF, the first framework that condenses spatio-temporal representations for data-efficient video fusion. STAR-VF condenses the original training set into a compact set of learnable spatio-temporal representations, which are decoded into synthetic video clips and optimized using feature-level supervision provided by a frozen proxy model. The resulting condensed data preserves fusion-relevant spatial and temporal cues without requiring ground-truth fused videos as supervision. To adapt fusion learning to condensed representations, we equip the final fusion model with flow-free inter-frame temporal modeling and query-driven intra-frame aggregation, enabling direct temporal interaction and adaptive selection of fusion-relevant information in representation space. Extensive experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, multi-focus, and medical video fusion benchmarks demonstrate that STAR-VF, trained with only approximately 1/16 of the original temporal training set, achieves fusion quality comparable to methods trained on the full data. Further analyses validate the contributions of learned condensation and flow-free temporal modeling, and demonstrate the robustness of the condensed supervision across different proxy encoders and downstream fusion models. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [112] [AmodalBox: Automated 3D Bounding Box Annotation under Partial Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10821)
*In-Jae Lee,Namtae Kim,Robert Exley,Kwonyoung Ryu,Jaesik Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自动标注框架，利用图像生成的三维资产作为补全式（amodal）几何先验，对齐部分观测的LiDAR点云，实现开放词汇三维框自动标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏驾驶场景中LiDAR仅覆盖物体表面一小部分，现有基于VFM的开放词汇三维框自动标注在部分观测下常出现定位偏差或漏标。

Method: 以图像生成的三维资产为amodal几何先验，通过输入图像与资产渲染视图的对应关系，将规范空间几何与部分观测的世界坐标LiDAR点云对齐；每实例生成单一资产，动态实例在单帧估计一次度量尺度并跨帧传播，静态实例聚合多帧观测以提升时序一致性并降低计算开销。

Result: 用其标注训练的检测器在nuScenes上较强基线提升14.1 mAP；在Waymo Open Dataset上车类IoU 0.5的AP提升12.45。

Conclusion: 利用生成式三维资产的amodal先验可有效缓解部分观测难题，产出高质量开放词汇三维标注并显著增益下游检测，展示了三维生成模型赋能数据标注的可行路径。

Abstract: Recent progress in vision foundation models (VFMs) has made automated open-vocabulary 3D bounding box annotation increasingly feasible by jointly leveraging LiDAR point clouds and images. However, partial observations remain a major challenge in sparse driving scenes, where visible LiDAR points often cover only a small fraction of the object's surface and provide insufficient cues for estimating its full spatial extent. As a result, existing methods often produce mislocalized boxes or leave objects unlabeled. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{\Ours{}}, an automated annotation framework that leverages image-generated 3D assets as amodal geometric priors for partially observed objects. By establishing correspondences between input images and rendered views of 3D assets, \Ours{} robustly aligns canonical amodal geometry with partially observed world-space LiDAR point clouds. To improve temporal consistency and reduce computational cost, \Ours{} generates a single asset per instance, estimates its metric scale once at a single frame and propagates it across frames for dynamic instances, and aggregates multi-frame observations for static instances. 3D object detectors trained on annotations from \Ours{} improve performance over strong baselines by 14.1 mAP on the nuScenes dataset and by 12.45 AP at IoU 0.5 for the vehicle class on the Waymo Open Dataset (WOD). Our project page is available at: \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }

</details>


### [113] [Fine-resolution land-use segmentation and synthetic image-label augmentation in the Kathmandu Valley](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10847)
*Pranil Parajuli,Sugam Dahal,Kiran Chandra Dahal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建加德满都谷地408景RGB精细土地利用数据集(6类,202km²),揭示随机划分造成严重空间泄漏,提出SegFormer半分辨率细节残差路径+边界重加权/拓扑损失/存在性平衡采样(mIoU全线提升,参数+1.9%),并证明扩散合成数据在等算力下反而降精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球南方快速城市化城市缺少地块级土地利用数据;现有分割架构依赖多光谱影像与规划规整布局,难以迁移到高光谱相似、类极度不平衡、细窄结构(河流仅2-3像素)的RGB场景。

Method: 1) 人工标注6类土地利用语料,408景细分辨率RGB,覆盖202 km²;2) 对比5种架构并对照随机划分与严格序列块划分,量化空间泄漏;3) 改进SegFormer:半分辨率残差细节通路、边界可靠性重加权、拓扑感知损失、存在性平衡采样器;4) 扩散生成图文对增强对照实验;5) 外部LoveDA基准验证。

Result: 随机划分使性能虚高,严格序列块划分下mIoU最多下降0.095,该惩罚大于架构间差异;增强模型仅增1.9%参数,在所有测试折上mIoU提升,增益集中于稀有细结构类;两模型在LoveDA外部基准上结果相同;等算力扩散合成增强在所有架构上降精度,稀有类受损最重。

Conclusion: 地块级RGB土地利用分割中,数据划分协议的影响超过架构选择;轻量结构性设计可有效改善细窄稀有类;合成数据不可盲目使用,需严格评估与过滤。方法偏遥感/城市制图领域,与具身/3D核心方向关联有限。

Abstract: Parcel-scale land-use data is missing for most rapidly urbanizing Global South cities, as current segmentation architectures rely on multispectral imagery and planned layouts. We introduce a hand-annotated six-class land-use corpus covering 202 km$^2$ of Kathmandu Valley across 408 fine-resolution RGB scenes. The dataset is uniquely challenging: RGB spectral similarity is high, class imbalance approaches 100:1, and key structural features like rivers measure just two to three pixels wide at a standard hierarchical decoder's prediction stride. Evaluating five architectures reveals that standard random data splitting conceals massive spatial leakage. Switching to a strict sequence-block split drops performance by up to 0.095 mIoU. This penalty exceeds the performance gap between the architectures themselves. We modified the SegFormer baseline by integrating a half-resolution residual detail path, boundary-reliability reweighting, a topology-aware loss, and a presence-balanced sampler. Adding only 1.9% more parameters, the enhanced architecture improves mean IoU across every test fold, with gains concentrated in rare, thin-structure classes. However, both models achieve identical results on the external LoveDA benchmark. Finally, augmenting with diffusion-generated pairs at matched compute degraded accuracy across all architectures, especially harming rare classes it aimed to improve. This demonstrates that blindly incorporating synthetic data can severely damage performance, highlighting a critical need to rigorously evaluate and filter generated samples before training.

</details>


### [114] [Beyond Bit Matching: Orthogonal Watermarks for Collusion-Resistant Image Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10858)
*Zhakshylyk Nurlanov,Tobias Weißberg,Florian Bernard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VectorMark 用近正交高维单位向量编码用户密钥，通过余弦相似度做合谋溯源，并用球面几何推导 shifted-Beta 零分布实现解析式误报率控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散比特水印在平均合谋攻击下比特证据趋于模糊，易被抹除；需要一种在平均后仍保留可解析信号的指纹编码方式。

Method: 将用户密钥映射为近正交高维单位向量；理想 K 路平均后每个合谋者仍保留 O(1/√K) 量级余弦信号，非相关密钥集中于零附近；随机方向球面几何给出余弦相似度的 shifted-Beta 零分布，在无水印图像上验证后可解析控制逐密钥误报率；神经水印编码器 + 中心化提取器，采用 JND 掩码与渐进课程训练以覆盖光度、几何与合谋鲁棒性。

Result: 在 MS-COCO、OpenImages 及 AI 生成图像上，对光度与几何失真保持稳健归因，在严格全合谋者检测指标上优于对比方法，同时保持高视觉质量。

Conclusion: 用连续向量密钥替代离散比特是缓解平均合谋的有效途径，且球面几何提供了无需经验阈值的理论误报率保证；属于内容溯源/水印方法，与具身智能、3D 重建等核心方向无直接关联。

Abstract: Image fingerprinting assigns each distributed copy a user-specific watermark for source tracing. Averaging collusion is a central threat: several recipients can average their differently marked copies to suppress each individual mark. Discrete bit-string watermarks are especially vulnerable because averaging drives bit evidence toward ambiguous decisions. We introduce \textbf{VectorMark}, which maps user keys to near-orthogonal high-dimensional unit vectors and identifies colluders by cosine similarity to the extracted watermark direction.
