Under ideal averaging of $K$ vector keys, the normalized average preserves a cosine signal of order $1/\sqrt{K}$ for each colluder, while unrelated keys remain concentrated near zero. The spherical geometry of random directions gives a shifted-Beta null distribution for cosine similarities, enabling analytic per-key false-positive-rate control after validation on unwatermarked images. VectorMark uses a neural watermark encoder and centered extractor trained with JND masking and a progressive curriculum for photometric, geometric, and collusion robustness. Experiments on MS-COCO, OpenImages, and AI-generated images show that VectorMark maintains robust watermark attribution under photometric and geometric distortions, and achieves the best strict all-colluder detection among evaluated methods, while preserving high visual quality. Our code is publicly available: this https URL

</details>


### [115] [Interactive Person Retrieval with On-the-Fly Visual Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10869)
*Lyucheng Qian,John Yuehan Zhang,Pingyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视觉反馈交互式行人检索新范式VFI-PR，构建VFI-PEDES数据集与评测协议，并提出VFI-ReID框架（DAR动态累积证据检索器 + 检索感知问句优化）


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本行人检索假设目击者一次性给出完整描述；交互式行人检索（Inter-PR）通过问答逐步细化描述。但现有Inter-PR方法只学离线问句顺序：问者需查看已检索候选再决定下一问，而答者只有目击侧记忆、无法给出候选特定视觉差异，形成"视觉反馈回路"缺口。

Method: 1) 定义VFI-PR范式：检索到的候选产生视觉反馈，作为后续提问与重排序的证据；2) 构建VFI-PEDES数据集与交互评测协议；3) VFI-ReID框架：Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) 随证据状态演化自适应检索，配合检索感知问句优化，将视觉反馈转为互补证据。

Result: VFI-ReID在各交互阶段均稳定提升检索性能，优于现有Inter-PR基线，验证视觉反馈对交互式行人检索的有效性。

Conclusion: 将检索候选的视觉反馈显式纳入交互回路是可行且有效的；视觉反馈可作为互补证据持续驱动检索与问句生成。不过该工作属多模态检索/ReID领域，与物理AI、VLA、3D重建等核心方向关联较弱，主要提供"交互式证据累积检索"的方法思路参考。

Abstract: Traditional text-based person retrieval (TPR) assumes that a witness provides a complete description at once, whereas interactive person retrieval (Inter-PR) refines a partial description through question-answer exchanges. In this setting, the questioner inspects retrieved candidates to decide what evidence to request next, while the answerer sees only the witness-side memory and cannot report candidate-specific visual differences. Existing methods mainly learn offline question orderings, leaving this visual-feedback loop underexplored. To address this limitation, we introduce visual-feedback interactive person retrieval (VFI-PR), a new interactive retrieval paradigm in which retrieved candidates produce visual feedback that becomes evidence for subsequent questioning and re-ranking. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct VFI-PEDES, a dataset and evaluation protocol for visual-feedback interaction, and propose VFI-ReID, a framework that learns to use visual feedback during interactive person retrieval. Through the Dynamic Accumulated-evidence Retriever (DAR) and retrieval-aware question optimization, VFI-ReID adapts retrieval and question generation to evolving evidence states, turning visual feedback into complementary evidence for subsequent retrieval. Experiments show that VFI-ReID consistently improves retrieval across VFI-PR interaction stages, demonstrating the utility of visual feedback for interactive person retrieval and outperforming existing Inter-PR baselines.

</details>


### [116] [REDiff-AD: No Training and No Target Masks for Industrial Anomaly Image Generation via Diversity-Driven In-Context MMDiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10875)
*Chih-Yu Tsai,Chih-Heng Chang,Jian-Jiun Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REDiff-AD：无需训练、无需目标掩码的工业异常生成框架，基于Rectified Flow MMDiT做上下文学习式缺陷迁移，并复用注意力+边缘/颜色线索得到像素级伪掩码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实工业缺陷稀缺且多样，现有异常生成方法依赖产品特定微调、目标掩码标注或昂贵流程，难以大规模构建异常数据。

Method: 给定正常产品图与单个带掩码参考异常，用Rectified Flow MMDiT以少步采样实现in-context缺陷外观迁移；复用生成过程中的内部注意力信号定位合成异常，再用边缘与颜色线索细化成像素级伪掩码；两个免训练轻量模块——自适应参考条件化（提升缺陷保真度）与多样性引导（增强缺陷模式多样性）。

Result: 在真实性与多样性权衡上表现良好，下游异常分类、检测与定位性能具竞争力；无需训练与目标掩码，适合大规模异常数据增广与像素级数据构建。

Conclusion: REDiff-AD提供了简单、高效、有效的工业异常数据合成与像素级数据构建方案，可用于下游检测模型的规模化数据增广。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection is challenged by the scarcity and diversity of real defects, leaving insufficient anomalous data to effectively train downstream models. Existing anomaly generation methods often require product-specific fine-tuning, target mask annotation, or costly procedures to achieve realistic and diverse defects. We propose REDiff-AD, a framework that requires neither model training nor target masks and introduces Rectified Flow MMDiT into industrial anomaly generation for efficient sampling with fewer generation steps. Given a normal product image and a single masked reference anomaly, REDiff-AD employs in-context learning to transfer the defect appearance from the reference into the normal image. Internal attention signals generated during this process are further reused to localize the synthesized anomaly, while edge and color cues refine the localization into pixel-level pseudo-masks. Two lightweight modules further improve generation quality: adaptive reference conditioning enhances defect fidelity, while diversity guidance promotes varied defect patterns without additional training. Experiments demonstrate that REDiff-AD can well address the tradeoff between realism and diversity for anomaly pattern generation and achieve competitive downstream anomaly classification, detection, and localization performance. These results show that REDiff-AD is a simple, efficient, and effective solution for large-scale anomaly data augmentation and pixel-level data construction. Github code: this https URL

</details>


### [117] [Beyond Real or Fake: A Dual-Channel Authenticity and Reasoning Protocol for Photographic Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10908)
*Xiaoxiao Li,Ruinan Jin,Lili Meng,Miaosen Wang,Athula Balachandran,Pei Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双通道真实性分析框架（相机通道传感器指纹 + 语义通道场景一致性），实现2CAP协议：对比学习相机编码器 + 冻结语义编码器，支持四类真实性分类与VLM证据生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 取证验证长期停留在二元"真/假"标签，混淆了全合成、篡改、AI修图等后果迥异的操纵类型，需按操纵机制细分。

Method: 将GenAI操纵分解为相机通道（神经处理破坏传感器指纹）与语义通道（内容编辑破坏场景级连贯性）；2CAP共享骨干，对比训练相机编码器配冻结语义编码器；分类用交叉注意力融合 + 可学习可靠度权重；解释用两通道对齐分数与patch级显著性图作为特权上下文，经Observe-Generate-Refine循环注入冻结VLM，无需取证微调。

Result: 多来源基准上取得最佳分类性能，在现有方法失效的AI修图检测上表现突出，并提升解释质量。

Conclusion: 双通道分解为细粒度图像取证提供了统一且可解释的范式，分类与解释共享同一表征。

Abstract: Forensic verification has converged on a binary "real vs. fake" label that confates fully synthetic, tampered, and AI-retouched images despite their very different consequences. We argue that GenAI manipulations decompose along two complementary channels: a camera channel of sensor fingerprints (destroyed by neural processing), and a semantic channel of scene-level coherence (disrupted by content edits). Each manipulation type leaves a distinctive two-channel signature. We instantiate this taxonomy in 2CAP (2-Channel Authenticity Protocol), pairing a contrastively-trained camera encoder with a frozen semantic encoder to serve two applications on a shared backbone: (i) four-class authenticity classification via cross-attention fusion with learnable reliability weights; and (ii) evidence generation, where an authentic image serves as a reference for a query and the two encoders produce per-channel alignment scores together with a patch-level saliency map. These signals are supplied as privileged context to a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM) through an Observe-Generate-Refine loop, yielding explanations with localization without forensic fine-tuning. On a multi-source benchmark, 2CAP attains the best classification performance, including strong retouching detection where existing methods fail, and improves explanation quality.

</details>


### [118] [Remembering to Reason: Structured Memory for Scene and Workflow Understanding in Robot-Assisted Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10917)
*Zhiran Zhang,Hu Wang,Yichen Wu,Yutong Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemSurg：构建带时间戳的结构化记忆图（实体类别/位置/运动线索/交互摘要），用时间序链接与实体关联链接组织手术观测，并通过任务自适应检索生成证据化提示，支持冻结推理与记忆条件微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以帧为中心的提示方式无法访问历史观测，而相似手术视野可能对应不同动作或阶段，因而需要显式记忆机制。

Method: 结构化记忆图存储时间戳实体信息；时间序链接保留近期上下文，实体关联链接跨时序连接复现观测；任务自适应检索构建证据接地提示；支持冻结推理与记忆条件监督微调两种模式，亦可作为推理期插件。

Result: 机器人辅助前列腺切除术及两个手术基准上，较SurgRAW+GPT-4o提升10.43个百分点；同配置Qwen3-VL-8B微调下记忆条件化增益6.52；对EndoChat推理期插件增益7.04。

Conclusion: 结构化记忆可作为手术视频理解中可复用的程序性证据来源；但属医疗领域视觉应用，与Physical AI/VLA/3D重建核心方向关联较弱，仅为工具性参考。

Abstract: Surgical video understanding is an important foundation for intelligent assistance in robot-assisted surgery. Similar surgical views can reflect different actions or procedural stages. Interpreting these views requires access to earlier observations, yet frame-centric prompting leaves this history unavailable. We introduce MemSurg, a framework that remembers surgical observations before reasoning over them. Its structured memory graph stores timestamped entity categories, locations, motion cues, and interaction summaries. Chronological links preserve recent context, while entity-associated links connect recurring observations across the procedure. Task-adaptive retrieval then supplies evidence-grounded prompts for scene and workflow reasoning, supporting both frozen inference and memory-conditioned supervised fine-tuning. Evaluation on robot-assisted prostatectomy and two complementary surgical benchmarks shows a 10.43-percentage-point gain over SurgRAW with GPT-4o. Memory conditioning adds 6.52 points under matched Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning, and an inference-time plug-in adds 7.04 points to EndoChat. These results support structured memory as a reusable source of procedural evidence for surgical video understanding. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [119] [Semantic Synthesis over Brute-Force Search: LLM-Guided Transformation Design for Efficient Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10940)
*Usha Shrestha,Radu Timofte,Dmitry Ignatov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用代码LLM合成数据变换程序替代搜索式增强策略发现，并系统检验1-epoch低成本评估与20-epoch真实结果的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据变换流水线决定训练分布，但在预定义增强空间内做搜索计算代价高；同时增强搜索常用的少epoch评估是否可靠缺乏验证。

Method: 统一训练协议下比较9种策略：标准增强策略、暴力搜索、两个LLM直接代码生成、以及在准确率排序变换对微调后的LLM性能引导生成；对最优候选重训20 epoch，并计算1-epoch选择分数与20-epoch结果的相关系数，含正对照分析。

Result: LLM生成程序在所有数据集上领先：CIFAR-10 0.8877、CIFAR-100 0.5825、SVHN 0.9588，超过6000候选的暴力搜索；CIFAR-10/SVHN最佳来自微调生成器（270候选），CIFAR-100最佳来自现成生成器（10候选）；生成阶段候选评估分别减少22倍与600倍。1-epoch与20-epoch相关性随数据集/架构从0.756降至近零。

Conclusion: 语义合成（代码LLM）是搜索式变换发现的高效替代方案；但低成本评估的保真度需按数据集与架构逐一验证，不能默认短预算选型可靠。

Abstract: Data transformation pipelines shape the training distribution in computer vision, but designing them is a computationally expensive problem. We investigate whether large language models can enable efficient discovery by synthesizing executable transformation programs outside predefined augmentation spaces. We compare nine strategies under a unified training protocol, including standard augmentation policies, brute-force search, direct code generation with two LLMs, and performance-guided generation using LLMs fine-tuned on accuracy-ordered transformation pairs. When the best candidates are retrained for 20 epochs, LLM-generated transformation programs lead on every dataset, reaching 0.8877 accuracy on CIFAR-10, 0.5825 on CIFAR-100, and 0.9588 on SVHN, surpassing brute-force search over 6,000 candidates. The best transform on CIFAR-10 and SVHN comes from a fine-tuned generator using 270 candidates, while the best on CIFAR-100 comes from an off-the-shelf generator using only 10. This needs 22x fewer candidate evaluations in the generation step and 600x fewer for off-the-shelf generations, relative to brute-force search. Beyond transformation discovery, we analyze the reliability of the reduced-budget evaluation commonly used for augmentation search. Correlating one-epoch selection scores with 20-epoch outcomes reveals strong, weak, and absent predictive relationships depending on the dataset and architecture, with correlations ranging from 0.756 to near zero. A positive control indicates that range restriction alone is unlikely to explain the low correlations. Our results indicate that semantic synthesis with code LLMs provides an efficient alternative to search-based transformation discovery and highlight the importance of validating evaluation fidelity when optimizing data transformations.

</details>


### [120] [Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10960)
*Szymon Płotka,Gizem Mert,Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Wenxuan Li,Zongwei Zhou,Anna Marcinkiewicz,Wiktoria Romańczyk,Jarosław B. Ćwikła,Łukasz Struski,Ewa Szczurek,Jacek Tabor,Arkadiusz Sitek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 A²MoE，在医疗视觉-语言预训练中引入解剖学归纳偏置：用直方图表征路由器（HRR）基于全局视觉上下文与预测的器官组成直方图选择专家，并用器官查询多尺度投影器（OQMSP）以可学习查询提取器官级嵌入做细粒度对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 医学 VLP 编码器在解剖学上是"无感知"的：对所有体素块使用统一的稠密参数化，而 MoE 路由器仅基于孤立局部特征做门控，无法显式获知扫描/裁剪区域的器官组成，与依赖器官上下文的临床诊断不一致。

Method: 1) HRR：以全局视觉上下文与预测的解剖组成直方图为条件进行专家选择，实现解剖依赖的专家加权；2) OQMSP：用可学习查询提取器官级嵌入，推理时无需人工标注即可完成细粒度对齐；3) 在 patch 级而非 token 级路由，使路由复杂度降低数个数量级，并按构造满足负载均衡。

Result: 在 6 万余例多期 CT 上预训练，在分割、分类、检测基准上取得 SOTA；并证明解剖学归纳偏置可稳健迁移至 MRI 与超声，展现出良好的泛化性。

Conclusion: 将解剖结构先验注入计算路径可显著提升 3D 医学表征学习的精度与跨模态泛化能力，为可扩展的医学表征学习奠定基础。

Abstract: Medical Vision-Language Pre-training (VLP) leverages the semantic richness of radiology reports to learn 3D representations, yet current architectures remain fundamentally anatomy-agnostic. While clinical diagnostics rely on organ-specific context, standard encoders apply a uniform, dense parameterization to all volumetric patches, and existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers gate on isolated local features without explicit access to the organ composition of the scan or crop. We propose Anatomy-Activated Mixture-of-Experts (A$^{2}$MoE), a framework that incorporates anatomical inductive biases within the model's computational path. A$^{2}$MoE introduces two key components: (1) a Histogram Representation Router (HRR) that conditions expert selection on global visual context and a predicted anatomical composition histogram, encouraging anatomy-dependent expert weighting; and (2) an Organ-Query Multi-Scale Projector (OQMSP) that utilizes learnable queries to extract organ-level embeddings for fine-grained alignment without requiring manual annotations at inference. By routing at the patch level rather than the token level, A$^{2}$MoE reduces routing complexity by orders of magnitude while satisfying load balancing by construction. Pre-trained on over 60,000 multi-phase CT scans, A$^{2}$MoE achieves state-of-the-art performance across segmentation, classification, and detection benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our anatomically grounded inductive biases support robust generalization to MRI and ultrasound, establishing a scalable foundation for medical representation learning. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [121] [Sensitivity-Gated Accumulator Caching for On-Device Learning of Low-Bit Hand Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10991)
*Soroor Ghandali,Kanika Mamgain,Manjot Kaur,Akanksha Shukla,Shashira Guntuka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出敏感度门控累加器缓存（SGAC）：用8位累加器的组相联缓存仅为少数高敏感度权重组保留残差状态，实现极低内存（8.1 bit/权重）的部署后片上自适应量化训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型手部跟踪网络以4/8位编码部署，需在设备上以接近模型自身内存的预算持续适配用户相机；QAT需保留32位主副本与优化器状态（约96 bit/权重），代价过高；随机舍入直接训练码可省副本但每步引入舍入噪声，去噪方法又需为每个权重保留残差缓冲。

Method: SGAC仅对一小部分且动态变化的权重组保留残差状态：用组相联缓存（8位累加器）收集Fisher加权平方码步最大的组的子步更新，凑成整步写入码；被驱逐的行以随机舍入回写，未获行的组在被准入前不更新。理论上证明回写无偏，并在局部二次模型下分析子步舍入的损失与更新自身收益同阶，说明仅当期望梯度相对曲率较大时舍入才划算。

Result: 在383k参数手部关键点网络上以每权重8.1 bit状态完成训练；在两种模拟相机上，对设备实际运行的4/8位网络评分时，在九个部署低比特网络中平均准确率最高；在十二种ImageNet-C损坏上，七种部署方法的受损+干净平均准确率最高，优于PEQA式、ECO式与直接低比特基线（置信区间不含零），并以56%的状态量匹配全权重8位累加器。

Conclusion: 通过选择性保留残差状态的缓存机制，可在接近模型自身内存的预算内实现无偏的低比特片上自适应，显著优于低比特训练基线并逼近全累加器方案；但实验限于手部关键点与模拟相机/损坏基准，尚无真实设备长期部署验证。

Abstract: Small hand-tracking networks are deployed as 4- and 8-bit codes, and they should keep adapting to a user's camera after deployment, on the device and within roughly the memory of the model itself. Quantization-aware training cannot do this cheaply, because it keeps a 32-bit master copy of every weight together with its optimizer state, about 96 bits per weight. Training the codes directly with stochastic rounding needs no copy but injects rounding noise at every step, and the methods that remove this noise keep a residual buffer for every weight. We introduce sensitivity-gated accumulator caching (SGAC), which keeps residual state for only a small and changing set of weight groups. A set-associative cache of 8-bit accumulators collects the sub-step updates of the groups with the largest Fisher-weighted squared code step and writes them into the codes as whole steps; an evicted line is flushed by stochastic rounding, and a group without a line does not move until it is admitted. We prove that the write-back is unbiased and show, under a local quadratic model, that rounding a sub-step update costs loss of the same order as the update's own gain, so that rounding pays only where the expected gradient is large relative to the curvature. On a 383k-parameter hand-keypoint network, SGAC trains with 8.1 bits of state per weight. Scored on the 4/8-bit network that the device runs after adaptation, it has the highest mean accuracy of nine deployed low-bit networks on two simulated cameras. On twelve ImageNet-C corruptions it has the highest average of corrupted and clean accuracy of seven deployed methods, ahead of the PEQA-style, ECO-style and direct low-bit baselines with confidence intervals that exclude zero, and it matches an 8-bit accumulator kept for every weight with 56% of that state.

</details>


### [122] [Efficient 3D plant segmentation through multiscale graph learning and optimized geometric processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11007)
*Jesus Ivan Ruiz-Martinez,Andres Mendez-Vazquez,Eduardo Rodriguez-Tello*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出约78K参数的紧凑多尺度边缘图注意力模型用于植物点云器官分割，并结合几何预处理（PCA、采样、邻居查询）优化，实现精度与推理延迟的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑计算平台上的植物器官分割需要高精度预测与低成本的几何预处理，而现有层级/图/Transformer方法在边缘设备上的几何开销过大。

Method: 1) 多尺度边缘图注意力网络：局部形状描述子 + 两个邻域尺度 + 残差茎叶校正模块，约78K参数；2) 嵌套4变体消融（7个外部组、3个随机种子）分解几何信息与多尺度配置的贡献；3) 在不改变学习权重与描述子定义的前提下优化全点云PCA、采样与邻居查询；4) Raspberry Pi 5实机推理与PlantNet、TomatoWUR上1180组配对桌面对比验证logits一致性。

Result: 完整模型取得最高平均IoU 86.36%，但不确定性与边界误差限制了各组件的边际贡献；PointNeXt为最强外部精度参照且端到端仍更快。优化后多尺度流水线延迟从330.33降至96.82 ms（PlantNet）、从1054.52降至463.10 ms（TomatoWUR），1180组配对比较中logits与预测完全一致。

Conclusion: 结果支持带低几何开销的紧凑图学习路线，板级实测证明了推理可行性，但未验证能效或自主飞行可用性；方法面向农业点云，与具身智能/世界模型关联较弱。

Abstract: Plant organ segmentation on compact computing platforms requires accurate predictions and affordable geometric preparation. We develop and evaluate a multiscale edge based graph attention model that combines local shape descriptors, two neighborhood scales and a residual stem and leaf correction in approximately 78 thousand parameters. The engineering application is plant point cloud segmentation for precision agriculture, assessed through grouped accuracy experiments and physical Raspberry Pi 5 inference. Broad comparisons with hierarchical, graph and transformer baselines establish PointNeXt as the strongest external accuracy reference among the tested local recipes. A nested four variant ablation on a local maize collection separates geometric information from the combined multiscale configuration across seven outer groups and three seeds. The complete model achieves the highest mean intersection over union, 86.36%, although uncertainty and boundary errors qualify the contribution of each component. We then optimize full cloud principal component analysis, sampling and neighbor queries without changing learned weights or descriptor definitions. All 1,180 paired desktop comparisons on PlantNet and TomatoWUR preserve exact logits and predictions. Multiscale pipeline latency falls from 330.33 to 96.82 milliseconds on PlantNet and from 1,054.52 to 463.10 milliseconds on TomatoWUR. PointNeXt also benefits from optimized sampling and remains faster over the complete pipeline. These results support compact graph learning with reduced geometric overhead, while physical board measurements establish inference feasibility rather than energy efficiency or readiness for autonomous flight.

</details>


### [123] [Virtual Task Prompting for Multi-Task Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11041)
*Zedong Wang,Yucheng Wang,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VTP将多任务场景理解中的跨任务交互从编码器内部移出，改为在骨干网络的每一层维护一组“虚拟任务”状态，用可学习路由矩阵读写任务自适应组合，从而保持骨干纯净、可直接兼容现成的视觉基础模型，在Pascal-Context与NYUD-v2上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多任务场景理解模型依赖改造过的视觉编码器或复杂解码器来实现跨任务交互，导致灵活性与与现成视觉基础模型（VFM）的兼容性受限。作者希望在不污染预训练骨干的前提下实现任务间显式交互。

Method: 提出虚拟任务提示（VTP）：在骨干旁维护一组扩展的“虚拟任务”，每层通过可学习路由矩阵把任务特定组合读入，与图像token交互后再写回，形成编码器之外的显式任务通路；虚拟状态与路由过程均端到端优化。

Result: 在Pascal-Context与NYUD-v2上刷新SOTA；在Taskonomy的13个异构任务压力测试中表现稳健；消融与分析表明增益来自于自适应路由而非额外容量。

Conclusion: VTP提供了一种与预训练VFM无缝集成的通用多任务提示范式，说明跨任务交互可在编码器外以路由式虚拟状态实现，具有良好的可扩展性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multi-task scene understanding models typically rely on modified vision encoders or complex decoders for cross-task interaction, which limits their flexibility and compatibility with off-the-shelf vision foundation models (VFMs). We introduce Virtual Task Prompting (VTP), which frames multi-task prompting as retrieving task-adaptive compositions from a shared virtual state, where both the state and routing process are optimized in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, VTP maintains an expanded set of virtual tasks alongside the backbone. At each layer, learnable routing matrices read task-specific compositions as input to interact with image tokens and write the processed results back, forming explicit pathways that capture the intricacies among tasks outside the encoder. Since VTP keeps the backbone clean, it integrates seamlessly with pretrained VFMs, advancing the state of the art on Pascal-Context and NYUD-v2. Stress test on Taskonomy with 13 heterogeneous tasks further shows VTP's robustness in extreme settings. Ablations and analysis indicate that VTP's gains stem from adaptive routing rather than increased capacity. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [124] [Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning for Adaptive Tokenization in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11058)
*Gaoxiang He,Bin Zhu,Bo Xie,Xiaotong Yu,Yi Chen,Hongfei Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可微虚拟槽划分（DVSP），用单个插值权重α在粗token与其四个细子token间连续混合特征与注意力质量，α∈{0,1}时精确退化为规则网格，实现端到端可训的自适应分词。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应分词要么用固定/冻结评分规则（无法对齐任务损失），要么用直通估计器训练离散掩码（梯度噪声大），而全可微方案又偏离预训练规则网格，损害微调效果。

Method: 从规则网格视角出发，将2×2区域设为四个"虚拟槽"，用单一权重α在粗token与四个细子token之间对token特征和注意力质量做连续插值；训练全程不删除任何token，避免离散化与直通估计。

Result: EVA-02-B上COCO检测保留97.9%稠密Box AP，移除64.2%视觉token，端到端加速1.61×；在同预算下优于熵基APT、DART与均匀低分辨率稠密适配；注意力质量守恒是关键（去除后损失1.59 Box AP）；冻结Segmenter提升Cityscapes mIoU，冻结DeiT上同token数下优于熵选择。

Conclusion: 以连续插值连接两尺度网格可在训练中完全不删token的前提下实现有效的自适应分词，验证了注意力质量守恒机制的必要性，且具备跨检测/分割/分类的通用性。

Abstract: Adaptive tokenization aims to reduce the compute spent on uninformative image regions while preserving accuracy. Existing work relies on (i) fixed or frozen scoring rules, which cannot be trained toward the task loss, or (ii) discrete masks trained with straight-through estimators, which yield noisy gradients, while fully differentiable alternatives instead leave the pre-trained regular grid. We revisit adaptive tokenization from a regular-grid perspective and ask: can a two-scale quadtree be learned end-to-end without deleting a single token during training? We show that one coarse token and its four fine children can be made the two endpoints of a single continuous interpolation. We introduce Differentiable Virtual-Slot Partitioning (\dvsp{}), which keeps four \emph{virtual slots} per $2{\times}2$ region and blends their token features and attention mass with a single weight $\alpha$, exactly reproducing the discrete grid at $\alpha \in \{0,1\}$. On COCO detection with EVA-02-B, \dvsp{} retains $97.9\%$ of dense Box AP while removing $64.2\%$ of visual tokens, giving a $1.61\times$ end-to-end speedup, and it outperforms entropy-based APT, DART, and uniform lower-resolution dense adaptation at matched budgets; these gains depend on the conserved attention mass, whose removal costs $1.59$ Box AP. On a frozen Segmenter it also improves Cityscapes mIoU, and on frozen DeiT backbones it exceeds entropy selection at identical per-image token counts.

</details>


### [125] [What Does Multiple Choice Actually Measure? Disentangling Video Understanding from Option Exploitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11062)
*Elliott Piercy,Justin Chan,Sepand Dyanatkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示视频问答（VideoQA）评测中分数受选项先验与语言捷径严重污染，提出 Option-Delayed Replay（ODR）机制在开放-ended推理轨迹的受控阶段披露选项，以获得客观多选题分数与忠实推理，并发布修正LVBench标注的评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VideoQA基准依赖多选题答案引导、语言先验与脆弱打分流程，难以隔离模型真实的视频感知与任务求解能力；需要量化"多少分来自评测语境而非忠实感知"。

Method: 在六个不同时长的VideoQA基准上做无视觉输入与选项时序消融诊断，界定 option-exploitation 与 answer-conditioned reasoning 的不忠实性；提出ODR：延迟披露选项，在open-ended轨迹的受控阶段插入选项以获得MC分数；将诊断集与ODR形式化为可复现评测协议；重标注LVBench（修正20.5%答案键）。

Result: 无视觉输入时准确率显著高于随机水平，证明捷径与选项先验效应；采用ODR+忠实推理的agentic方法可达到与利用选项相当的性能。

Conclusion: VideoQA分数由语言先验、选项时序与打分转换共同决定；忠实、无选项推理可匹配选项利用式性能，ODR提供了可复现的评测范式。

Abstract: Video understanding evaluations are intended to measure a model's proficiency in video perception and task solving. However, current VideoQA benchmarks struggle to isolate these capabilities due to their reliance on multiple-choice (MC) answer guidance, language priors, and fragile scoring pipelines. Disentangling these confounding factors reveals how much of a model's score is supplied by the evaluation context rather than earned through faithful perception. Across six VideoQA benchmarks of varying length, we find that accuracy is significantly above chance without any visual input. This is caused by shortcutting and option-prior reliance. We express these effects in the language of faithfulness: option-exploitation and answer-conditioned reasoning traces are unfaithful even when they are correct. Together, our results show that a VideoQA score is jointly determined by language priors, option timing, and how outputs and labels are converted into correctness. We produce a novel Option-Delayed Replay (ODR) mechanism that discloses options at controlled stages of an open-ended (OE) trajectory, to obtain objective MC scores from faithful option-free inference. Our work demonstrates that agentic methods with ODR and faithful inference can match option-exploiting performance. Finally, we formalize our diagnostic collection and ODR as a reproducible evaluation protocol, and we release a human-relabelled edition of LVBench (correcting $20.5\%$ of keys) to remove annotation noise as a confounding variable.

</details>


### [126] [NanoNet: Ultra-Lightweight Network for MRI Brain Tumor Classification toward Edge AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11071)
*Tran Nguyen-Le,Huu-Thuan Huynh,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NanoNet 是一个仅 8132 参数、5 个倒残差块的超轻量 CNN，在 BRISC 2025 脑肿瘤 MRI 分类上达到 92.80% 准确率与 92.97% macro F1，10.498 MFLOPs；结合结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏与 INT8 QAT 后仍有 89.70% 准确率，TFLite 模型存储 27.7 KB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规深度学习模型超出高受限边缘 AI 平台的资源预算，作者希望在极小算力/存储条件下实现可用的 MRI 分类，服务于未来边缘 AI 部署场景。

Method: 以 MobileNetV2 为蓝本大幅裁剪深度、通道数、扩展比与末端特征维度，构建仅 5 个倒残差块的 NanoNet；并进一步探索依赖感知结构化剪枝、知识蒸馏与 INT8 量化感知训练（QAT）作为附加压缩手段。

Result: BRISC 2025 上 92.80% 准确率、92.97% macro F1，8132 参数、10.498 MFLOPs；三个压缩随机种子下，比 70% 剪枝的 MobileNetV2 平均准确率高 5.20 个百分点，参数少 60.2%、计算少 9.8%；INT8 QAT 后 89.70% 准确率、90.22% macro F1；TFLite 基线模型存储 27.7 KB。

Conclusion: 网络结构极简 + 剪枝/蒸馏/量化的组合可在医疗影像分类上维持较高精度同时极致压缩，为边缘 AI 部署提供可行基线；但实验限于单一医学影像基准，尚无真实硬件端到端部署结果。

Abstract: Automated brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can support accessible medical image analysis, but conventional deep learning models often exceed the resource budgets of highly constrained edge-AI platforms. We present NanoNet, an ultra-lightweight convolutional neural network designed for resourceconstrained MRI classification and motivated by future edge-AI applications. Inspired by MobileNetV2, NanoNet substantially reduces network depth, channel capacity, expansion ratios, and final feature dimensionality, resulting in only five inverted residual blocks and 8,132 parameters. We further investigate dependency-aware structured pruning, knowledge distillation, and INT8 quantization-aware training for additional compression. Experiments on the BRISC 2025 benchmark show that NanoNet achieves 92.80% accuracy and 92.97% macro F1 with 8,132 parameters and 10.498 MFLOPs. Across three compression seeds, it exceeds the mean accuracy of 70%-pruned MobileNetV2 by 5.20 percentage points while using 60.2% fewer parameters and 9.8% less computation. Converted INT8 NanoNet achieves 89.70% accuracy and 90.22% macro F1 across three QAT seeds. Earlier TensorFlow Lite measurements indicate 27.7 KB of baseline model storage, motivating future edge-AI deployment.

</details>


### [127] [ADC-RANet: Improving Resolution Adaptive Neural Networks with Attention, Distillation and Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11076)
*Jeferson Severino de Araujo,Lilian Hollard,Eric Granger,Marco Pedersoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ADC-RANet在RANet基础上融合自底向上通道注意力、自顶向下级联知识蒸馏与MixUp过置信校正三个组件，在不同计算预算下提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态神经网络可按样本难度分配计算量，RANet在图像分类中沿输入分辨率逐级分配资源较有效，但各退出分支的表示质量与置信度校准仍有提升空间，因此希望在保持效率的同时提高所有计算预算下的性能。

Method: 构建三个紧密耦合的模块：(1) 自底向上通道注意力，增强浅层/低分辨率分支的特征；(2) 自顶向下级联知识蒸馏，用深层高分辨率分支指导浅层分支；(3) 基于MixUp的过置信校正，改善早退分支的置信度校准，三者协同以协调两条计算路径。

Result: 在CIFAR-100与ImageNet上，方法在所有计算预算下取得一致的精度提升，同时保持RANet原有的计算效率。

Conclusion: 注意力、蒸馏与校准的协同设计可作为即插即用式改进，显著增强分辨率自适应网络的性能-效率权衡。

Abstract: Dynamic neural networks are a class of adaptive models in which the computation assigned to each input sample is determined dynamically, potentially reducing computational cost while maintaining similar performance. For image classification, the Resolution Adaptive Network (RANet) is a strong approach that progressively allocates computational resources across input scales based on sample difficulty. In this work, we introduce RANet with Attention, Distillation and Calibration (ADC-RANet), an enhanced version of RANet that improves performance across all computational budgets. Our approach combines three tightly connected components: bottom-up channel attention, top-down cascaded knowledge distillation, and overconfidence correction using MixUp, in a synergistic design that coordinates both pathways. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets show consistent gains while preserving the efficiency of RANet. Our code is available: this https URL

</details>


### [128] [SoftPAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Deformables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11087)
*Lei Shu,Alberta Longhini,Leonidas Guibas,Gordon Wetzstein,Jeannette Bohg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SoftPAT3D 提出物理增强的文本到三维场景生成框架，将布料、毛绒玩具、绳索等可形变物体生成为可仿真的物理合法物体，并在统一接触模型下建立无穿透的多体平衡场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理增强的 text-to-3D 流程仅支持刚体，生成的可形变物体网格几何非法（自交）、无静止形状、无材质参数、无合法初始状态，无法直接用于形变仿真。

Method: 从"制造方式"而非生成的不一致变形构型恢复静止形状；用材质库赋予初始弹性参数并可后优化；重建被遮挡的支撑物并转为水密碰撞网格；物体从可优化摆放位置释放，在同一接触模型下驱动整体至静态平衡；用几何检查与 VLM 验证完成度；失败时网格搜索摆放，并借同一接触能量的可微仿真伴随梯度联合摆放多体、恢复材质参数。

Result: 65 个提示词上均未出现任何非期望互相穿透，而所有对比系统均出现穿透；多体场景单次仿真即达平衡；支持仅凭文本运行；生成场景可直接用于场景编辑与机器人操作。

Conclusion: 通过从流程既有信息中构造形变仿真所需输入（静止形状、材质、水密碰撞体、合法初始态），把 text-to-3D 拓展到可形变物体并实现仿真就绪、无穿透的场景，为下游编辑与机器人操作提供直接可用的资产。

Abstract: We present SoftPAT3D, a physics-augmented framework for text-to-3D scene generation in which deformable objects, such as cloth, stuffed toys and ropes, are generated as physically valid, simulation-ready bodies and placed in intersection-free contact with the furniture that supports them, with one another and with themselves. Existing physics-augmented pipelines simulate rigid bodies only and cannot accommodate a generated deformable object, which text-to-3D generation returns as a geometrically invalid mesh, sometimes self-intersecting, that has no rest shape, no material model and no admissible initial state. These are the inputs a deformable simulation requires, and we construct each from information already in the pipeline. The rest shape comes from how the object is manufactured rather than from the generated physically inconsistent deformed configuration, and a material library assigns each deformable object its initial elastic parameters, which can then be optimized. The occluded support is regenerated and converted into a watertight collision mesh, each object is released from an optimizable placement above the supporting part that the prompt specifies, and the complete scene is driven to static equilibrium under one unified contact model, with completion verified by geometric checks and a vision-language model. When a scene fails the prompt, a grid search over placements corrects it, and the adjoint of a differentiable simulation of the same contact energy reaches the targets the grid does not, places several bodies jointly and recovers and optimizes material parameters. Multi-body scenes equilibrate in a single simulation, and the pipeline also runs from the text prompt alone. On all sixty-five prompts, SoftPAT3D produces no undesired interpenetration of any kind, whereas every other system does, and its scenes directly support scene editing and robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [129] [Does Pose Encoding Matter? Analyzing Geometric Representations for Discrete Motion Vocabulary Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11093)
*Amir Kimiyaie,Nahal Mafi,Hamed Tabkhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究四种骨骼运动编码（热图、根相对位置、SO(3)上的6D局部旋转、冗余全运动学编码）对VQ-VAE离散token词表有效性的影响，发现输入几何空间是运动tokenization的首要设计变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续人体运动压缩为离散token已成为运动理解与生成流程的第一步，但VQ的潜空间几何继承自输入姿态编码，何种编码更利于高效离散化尚不清楚。

Method: 在单位超球面上构建码本的VQ-VAE分词器，对四种编码分别训练，并系统改变码本大小、时间步长与码维度；除重建损失外，还评估码本利用率与"有效词表大小"（与观测token分布同熵的等概率球面Voronoi单元数）。理论上指出高斯关节热图等价于以二次结构函数对关节点点集做形态学膨胀。

Result: 旋转与位置编码能持续把新增码字转化为有效词表；全运动学编码在数百个有效单元处饱和，热图则不足60个。四种编码中三种在最小码维度下利用率最高；时间步长的影响依编码而异。同一姿态族的不同编码，有效词表可相差一个数量级，而重建损失无法揭示这一差异。

Conclusion: 选择输入几何是运动tokenization的一阶设计决策；仅以重建损失评估分词器不足以反映词表容量与可表达性，需引入利用率与有效词表指标。

Abstract: Compressing continuous human motion into a finite vocabulary of discrete tokens is now the first stage of many motion understanding and generation pipelines. Vector quantization partitions a latent space into Voronoi cells around a finite codebook, but the geometry of that latent space is inherited from the input pose encoding, and it is unclear which encoding admits an efficient discretization. We study four encodings that place skeletal motion in different geometric spaces: Gaussian joint heatmaps on the pixel lattice, which we show to be a morphological dilation of the joint point set by a quadratic structuring function; root-relative joint positions in Euclidean space; local joint rotations on $\SO$ through a continuous 6D embedding; and a redundant full kinematic encoding. For each, we train VQ-VAE tokenizers whose codebooks lie on the unit hypersphere, varying codebook size, temporal stride, and code dimension. Beyond reconstruction, we measure codebook utilization and the effective vocabulary size, i.e., the number of equiprobable spherical Voronoi cells with the same entropy as the observed token distribution. Rotation and position encodings keep converting additional codewords into effective vocabulary, whereas the full kinematic encoding saturates at a few hundred effective cells and heatmaps at fewer than sixty. The smallest code dimension gives the highest utilization for three of the four encodings, and the effect of temporal stride depends on the encoding. Encodings of the same pose family can thus yield effective vocabularies differing by an order of magnitude, a difference that reconstruction loss alone does not reveal, which points to input geometry as a first-order design choice in motion tokenization.

</details>


### [130] [MySign: A High-Fidelity Motion-Capture Dataset for 3D Sign Generation in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11115)
*Jiayu Shen,Kalin Stefanov,Lay-Ki Soon,Vee Yee Chong,Alpha Agape Gopalai,KokSheik Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MySign：首个马来手语（BIM）孤立词动作捕捉数据集，含5,000样本/1,000词条，提供真值SMPL-X序列，用于词汇条件3D手语生成基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D手语生成受限于高保真数据稀缺，低资源语言尤甚；现有数据集多依赖从视频回归的SMPL-X伪标签，存在深度歧义、手指姿态不准与时间抖动问题。

Method: 由五名聋人母语者采集专为手语定制的动捕数据，重定向得到真值SMPL-X序列；在同一词表与同一签署者上做受控对比（真值 vs 伪标签训练），并建立词汇条件3D手语生成基准，评估生成与识别基线。

Result: 真值序列在手部与手指细粒度关节运动上保真度更高；用其训练生成模型优于伪标签训练；SOTA生成模型输出视觉上合理但在细粒度关节处明显弱于真值，识别基线词级准确率高。

Conclusion: MySign可作为构建高难度词汇条件3D手语生成基准，揭示细粒度关节运动建模仍是持续存在的缺口，同时验证数据可靠支持监督学习。

Abstract: Progress in 3D sign generation is constrained by the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D sign language datasets, a limitation that is particularly severe for under-resourced languages. We introduce MySign, the first motion-capture dataset for isolated signs in Bahasa Isyarat Malaysia (BIM). Its 5,000 samples cover 1,000 lexical items (glosses) and were produced by five Deaf native signers. Prior datasets that rely on SMPL-X parameters regressed from video provide pseudo-labels, which are often affected by depth ambiguity, inaccurate finger poses, and temporal jitter. MySign instead provides ground-truth SMPL-X sequences retargeted from recordings made with a motion-capture setup tailored for sign language; these sequences offer higher-fidelity motion, particularly in fine-grained hand and finger articulation. A controlled comparison on the same glosses and signers indicates that training on these sequences improves generation over training on such pseudo-labels. We establish MySign as a challenging benchmark for gloss-conditioned 3D sign generation: state-of-the-art models produce visually plausible outputs but fall short of the ground truth, most notably in fine-grained articulation, revealing persistent gaps in modeling articulated sign motion. In contrast, recognition baselines consistently achieve high lexical accuracy, indicating that the dataset reliably supports supervised learning. The dataset is available at this https URL

</details>


### [131] [Query-Only Prompt-Agnostic Attacks on Visual In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11116)
*Xiao Hu,Muhammad Ibrahim,Hao Wen,Pin-Yu Chen,Jianliang Wu,Antonio Bianchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究仅查询访问、未知部署提示条件下的视觉上下文学习（VICL）定向攻击：将提示条件化的RGB渲染视为独立攻击面，提出颜色劫持（CH）与任务劫持（TH）两种外观空间攻击，并用自提示代理（SPS）实现跨未见提示的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VICL可通过视觉示例实现可提示分割，适合自动标注，但其在仅能观察到RGB输出、且部署提示未知的黑盒条件下的鲁棒性尚未被系统研究；现有攻击方法依赖模型内部信息或已知提示。

Method: 定义查询级、提示无关的定向攻击设定（仅见返回的RGB输出）。在RGB外观空间设计两种目标：CH使前景颜色趋向背景以抑制可见性；TH使实例区分色塌缩到统一色指派。为迁移到未见提示，用干净查询及其输出构造自提示代理SPS，与随机提示代理RPS在配对等预算下对比；在SegGPT及四种VICL模型、COCO与HierText上验证，并测试调色板解码与下游自动标注管线影响。

Result: 配对等预算下SPS优于RPS：CH前景实例保留率0.918→0.155，TH调色板感知容差距离0.345→0.225。CH在语义、实例、文本风格输出上均抑制前景；TH在留出部署提示下使实例颜色塌缩，调色板解码后实例数、掩码保留率下降、实例合并增加。30%污染率下，受CH污染的标注使下游YOLO-seg mAP50从0.761降至0.281。

Conclusion: VICL渲染输出构成可利用的独立攻击面，无需模型内部或部署提示即可实现强迁移攻击，并显著危害基于VICL的自动标注与下游分割训练，提示需关注该管线的安全风险。

Abstract: Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) enables promptable segmentation by conditioning RGB predictions on visual demonstrations, making it attractive for auto-labeling, but its robustness under query-only access and unknown deployment prompts remains underexplored. We study query-only, prompt-agnostic targeted attacks where the attacker observes only returned RGB outputs, without access to model internals or deployment prompts. Treating prompt-conditioned RGB rendering as a distinct attack surface, we introduce two appearance-space attacks: Color Hijack (CH) drives foreground colors toward the background to suppress visibility, while Task Hijack (TH) collapses instance-distinguishing colors toward a shared color assignment. To transfer across unseen prompts, we propose a Self-Prompt Surrogate (SPS) constructed from the clean query and its output. In a paired, matched-budget SegGPT comparison, SPS outperforms the Random-Prompt Surrogate (RPS), reducing CH instance foreground retention from 0.918 to 0.155 and TH palette-aware tolerance distance from 0.345 to 0.225. Across four VICL models on COCO and HierText, CH suppresses foregrounds across semantic-, instance-, and text-style outputs, while TH collapses instance colors under held-out deployment prompts. After palette-based decoding, TH also reduces the decoded instance count and mask retention while increasing instance merges. Finally, at 30% corruption, CH-corrupted annotations from a publicly accessible VICL-based auto-labeling pipeline reduce downstream YOLO-seg mAP50 from 0.761 to 0.281.

</details>


### [132] [What You Show Is Not What You Get: Rethinking Demonstration Following in Visual In-Context Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11122)
*Xiao Hu,Ilia Sucholutsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 分析 SegGPT 的视觉上下文分割偏差（背景色映射偏差、部分向父对象扩张），提出语义对比提示选择（SCPS）以改进示例引导效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SegGPT 类视觉上下文分割依赖视觉示例引导预测，但存在两类系统性偏差：非目标但共享背景标签的区域被赋予不同输出颜色；请求的分割部分会扩张至父对象。理解并缓解这些偏差可提升示例遵循能力。

Method: 通过控制示例颜色与请求目标做干预分析，论证示例在熟悉语义区域上引导角色与颜色分配，并受学习的语义/颜色偏好影响；提出 SCPS：语义对比编码将请求部分与其余父对象赋予不同颜色、场景其余部分置黑，结合检索得分与在开发集标注图像上估计的质量分数来选择示例及其二值或语义对比编码。

Result: 在三个基准、七种检索方法上平均，相比原始二值选择器，目标 IoU 提升 0.054，向父对象其余部分的泄漏降低 22.7%。

Conclusion: 提供了理解并改进视觉上下文分割中示例遵循的新视角：偏差源于示例驱动的角色/颜色分配，语义对比提示是对检索式示例选择的低成本有效增强。

Abstract: Visual in-context segmentation uses visual demonstrations to guide predictions for a new image. In SegGPT, we identify background color mapping deviation, where non-target regions sharing a background label receive different output colors, and part-to-parent expansion, where predictions extend beyond the requested part into its parent object. These deviations can occur even when the relevant regions remain distinguishable in internal features. Controlled changes to demonstration colors and requested targets support an account in which demonstrations guide role and color assignments over familiar semantic regions, influenced by learned semantic and color preferences. Building on these findings, we introduce Semantic Contrast Prompt Selection (SCPS). Its semantic contrast encoding assigns separate colors to the requested part and the rest of its object while keeping the remaining scene black. SCPS combines existing retrieval scores with quality estimates from labeled development images to select demonstrations and their binary or semantic contrast encodings. Averaged across seven retrieval methods on three benchmarks, SCPS improves target IoU by 0.054 and reduces leakage into the rest of the object by 22.7% relative to the original binary selectors. Our findings offer a new perspective on understanding and improving demonstration following in visual in-context segmentation.

</details>


### [133] [CrossLiDAR: Controllable Multi-Sensor LiDAR Sequence Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11131)
*Khanh Nguyen,Thomas Walker,Hichem Telli,Carlos de la Torre-Ortiz,Stefano Fiorini,Salah Eddine Bekhouche,Mohammed-En-Nadhir Zighem,Wassim Swaileh,Tinghuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CrossLiDAR：基于MM-DiT与rectified flow的潜空间(range image)多传感器LiDAR序列生成框架，支持跨传感器交互与BEV/3D框结构化控制，并通过自回归扩展实现长时4D一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真LiDAR仿真仍是自动驾驶系统可扩展开发与验证的瓶颈。现有生成器虽能合成逼真扫描，但通常局限于单一传感器配置、对结构与几何的控制有限，且长时4D生成存在漂移。目标是实现可控且时空一致的多传感器LiDAR序列生成。

Method: 在range image紧凑潜空间上构建基于Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT)骨干的rectified flow目标；引入Inter-sensor Module实现传感器间交互以支持多LiDAR配置；采用ControlNet式分支注入结构条件（BEV先验、3D bounding boxes）；时间维度上先生成短N帧序列再自回归外推以提升长时一致性。

Result: 在nuScenes与Waymo数据集上显著优于SOTA基线，JSD平均提升29.56%，MMD平均提升15.36%。

Conclusion: CrossLiDAR实现了标定一致的多传感器LiDAR长时rollout与可控场景化测试，向现代自动驾驶仿真迈进一步。抽象层面方法完整，但缺少下游感知/规划闭环验证、代码开放与推理效率信息。

Abstract: High-fidelity LiDAR simulation remains a bottleneck for scalable development and validation of autonomous systems. Existing generators can synthesize realistic scans, but they are typically constrained to a single sensor configuration, offer limited control over structure and geometry, and drift in long-horizon 4D generation. We present CrossLiDAR, a unified transformer-based framework capable of generating controllable and spatio-temporally consistent multi-sensor LiDAR sequences. Our approach leverages a rectified flow objective with a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) backbone, within a compact latent space of range images. To support multiple LiDAR sensors, an Inter-sensor Module enables interaction across sensors, while a ControlNet-style branch provides structural conditioning (e.g., BEV priors or 3D bounding boxes). For modeling the temporal consistency, CrossLiDAR generates short $N$-frame sequences and extends them autoregressively to improve long-horizon coherence. Our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 29.56\% in JSD and 15.36\% in MMD evaluated on nuScenes and the Waymo Dataset. CrossLiDAR bridges the gap to modern autonomous-driving simulation by enabling calibration-consistent multi-sensor LiDAR rollouts over long horizons for controllable, scenario-based testing.

</details>


### [134] [From Game Generation to Game Playing: Fully Automated Ability Training for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11136)
*Changran Liu,Qi Wu,Wenchao Ma,Sharon X. Huang,Haomiao Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出脚本化数据生成框架：LLM agent用游戏建造工具自动构建可执行的Minecraft/Roblox环境与任务，程序化专家利用特权状态生成对齐指令、渲染观测与键鼠动作，仅用150.3小时合成数据对4B VLM做行为克隆得到Script2Play。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练能跨多款游戏遵循玩法指令的VLA模型受限于人工演示采集成本过高，希望以自动化环境构建+专家脚本替代人类演示与强化学习。

Method: LLM驱动的agent调用游戏建造API，针对指定技能生成可执行环境与任务；程序化专家读取模拟器特权状态，输出语言指令、渲染观测和多模态键鼠动作序列；以行为克隆方式对4B VLM进行后训练。

Result: 在多个公开游戏基准上，Script2Play能有效执行 gameplay 指令并跨游戏引擎泛化，且全程未使用人类演示或强化学习，验证了定向合成监督的有效性。

Conclusion: 自动化环境生成+特权状态专家标注可作为低成本、可扩展的VLA训练数据来源，具备跨引擎迁移能力；但仅限游戏域，缺少真实机器人或物理操作验证。

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models to follow gameplay instructions across diverse games is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. We introduce a framework that automatically generates game environments and expert demonstrations. An LLM-powered agent uses game-building tools to construct executable environments and tasks targeting specified skills. Programmatic experts then use privileged simulator state to generate aligned instructions, rendered observations, and keyboard and mouse actions. We train our game policy, Script2Play, by post-training a 4B vision-language model with behavior cloning on 150.3 hours of synthetic Minecraft and Roblox gameplay, without human gameplay demonstrations or reinforcement learning. Evaluation on multiple public game benchmarks demonstrates that Script2Play follows gameplay instructions effectively and generalizes across game engines, highlighting the effectiveness of targeted synthetic supervision.

</details>


### [135] [Graphene: A Lightweight Transformer with Ising Mean-Field Refinement for Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11139)
*Seungki Hong,Taekwang Jang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Graphene: a lightweight image super-resolution architecture combining Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement (IRB) with stage-history-based refinement (HistAttn).


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing efficient SR transformers are parameter/FLOP-heavy and slow; the authors seek complementary refinement mechanisms (local signed interactions + cross-stage history) that improve quality without extra spatial pairwise attention cost.

Method: IRB reuses attention outputs and pre-softmax logits to build signed pairwise token couplings within local windows, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and does gated residual correction. HistAttn attends over current-stage output and earlier representations at the same token position, adaptively blending with a history-weighted aggregate, avoiding extra spatial pairwise attention.

Result: On Urban100 ×4, Graphene / Graphene-light beat IET / IET-light by 0.24 dB / 0.38 dB with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory; real-world SR recovers fine details across degradations.

Conclusion: Physics-inspired local coupling plus stage-history attention yields a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for efficient SR, with open code/checkpoints.

Abstract: This paper proposes Graphene, a lightweight image super-resolution architecture with two complementary feature refinement mechanisms: Ising-model-inspired local feature refinement using an Ising Refinement Block (IRB) and stage-history-based feature refinement using a History Attention (HistAttn) module. The IRB reuses attention output features and pre-softmax attention logits to construct signed pairwise token couplings within each local window, applies unrolled mean-field updates, and refines features through a gated residual correction. These signed couplings allow alignment and opposition between latent spins to modulate local feature refinement. HistAttn attends over the current stage output and earlier representations at the same token position and adaptively blends the current stage output with a history-weighted feature aggregate without adding spatial pairwise attention. On Urban100 at $\times4$, Graphene and Graphene-light improve over IET and IET-light by 0.24 dB and 0.38 dB, respectively, with 34.3%/13.7% fewer parameters, 44.8%/44.4% fewer FLOPs, 78.4%/71.5% lower latency, and 76.0%/85.5% lower peak memory. Real-world SR comparisons further show that Graphene recovers fine details and preserves textures across diverse degradations. Code and reference checkpoints are available at this https URL

</details>


### [136] [SurgWorld: Learning Surgical Representations Beyond Observation via Latent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11140)
*Jingkun Yue,Pengxiang Wang,Siqi Zhang,Zinan Jia,Yiyao Zhang,Huihuan Xu,Yichang Hao,Xiaohong Liu,Zongbo Han,Guangyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgWorld: 视频原生自监督手术表示学习框架，将空间/时间位移作为伪动作，预测视野外（out-of-sight）潜在动力学，并用几何视觉相似性正则化，在17个手术基准上超越现有视觉基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术本质上是部分可观测的，术者需持续推断演变的解剖动力学与未来手术状态。现有自监督方法仅从已观测视频通过掩码重建或预测当前视野内表示来学习，缺乏显式建模视野外手术动力学的能力。

Method: 借鉴潜在预测世界模型，提出SurgWorld：(1) Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling（OSDM）预训练目标，以指定的空间或时间位移为伪动作，从部分观测预测目标潜在表示；(2) Geometric Visual Similarity（GVS）目标，对齐预测与目标表示间的patch级关系结构，保持空间几何与局部视觉一致性；(3) 聚合式训练框架整合多教师互补监督信号，学习统一的动力学与视觉几何潜在表示。

Result: 在17个手术基准上的大量迁移学习实验表明，SurgWorld在手术流程识别、细粒度动作理解和稠密视觉感知任务上均稳定优于现有视觉基础模型；定性与定量分析显示其能通过潜在预测有效捕捉直接观测上下文之外的手术动力学。

Conclusion: 将手术视频自监督学习重构为“伪动作条件的潜在预测”问题，可显著扩展表示对视野外动力学的建模能力，为部分可观测场景下的手术基础模型提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Surgical procedures are inherently partially observable, requiring surgeons to continuously infer evolving anatomical dynamics and future surgical states beyond the current observation. However, existing self-supervised learning methods primarily learn from observed surgical videos through masked reconstruction or predicting representations within the camera's current field of view, lacking the capability to explicitly model the out-of-sight surgical dynamics. Inspired by latent predictive world models, we introduce SurgWorld, a video-native, self-supervised framework for surgical representation learning, which treats a specified spatial or temporal shift as a pseudo-action and learns to predict the target latent representation from a partial observation. Specifically, we propose Out-of-Sight Dynamics Modeling (OSDM) as the pretraining objective for predicting representations conditioned on relative spatio-temporal shifts. We further regularize the learned latent dynamics from OSDM with a Geometric Visual Similarity (GVS) objective by aligning patch-level relational structures between predicted and target representations, preserving spatial geometry and local visual coherence for dense perception. These two objectives are integrated through an agglomerative training framework that consolidates complementary supervisory signals from multiple teachers to learn a unified latent representation of surgical dynamics and visual geometry. Extensive transfer learning experiments on 17 surgical benchmarks show that SurgWorld consistently outperforms existing vision foundation models across surgical workflow recognition, fine-grained action understanding, and dense visual perception. We further conduct tailored qualitative and quantitative analyses, demonstrating that SurgWorld effectively captures surgical dynamics beyond the directly observed context through latent prediction.

</details>


### [137] [Not All Layers Are Equal in Image-to-Video Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11147)
*Thinesh Thiyakesan Ponbagavathi,Constantin Seibold,Alina Roitberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 层级敏感性分析揭示 Transformer 视频适配中时间敏感性随深度递增、且增长曲线由预训练范式决定；据此提出免训练的 STRAP 规则，按范式匹配模型导出的空间→时间切换边界分配空间/时间 Adapter，在四个细粒度动作识别基准上精度提升至 11.8%，可训练参数减少 29–48%，推理时间最多降低 10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数高效图像到视频迁移方法在每一层插入相同的 Adapter，隐含假设各层所需时间建模程度相同，缺乏对层级敏感性的实证检验。

Method: 对四类视频原生模型族与两种预训练范式做逐层敏感性分析；提出 STRAP：从范式匹配的视频模型中导出空间到时间的转换边界，边界前布置空间 Adapter、边界后布置时间 Adapter，不修改 Adapter 架构，且无需训练。

Result: 四个细粒度动作识别基准上，相对统一布置最多提升 11.8% 准确率，可训练参数减少 29%–48%，推理时间最多下降 10%；标准基准上以更少参数达到相当精度。

Conclusion: Adapter 布置应依层级敏感性而非统一分配，且敏感性剖面可由预训练范式预测，为视频适配提供零成本的即插即用改进。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient image-to-video transfer adapts frozen image foundation models to video via lightweight trainable adapters. Existing methods insert the same adapter at every transformer layer, implicitly assuming all layers require equal temporal modeling. A layer-wise sensitivity analysis across four video-native model families and two pretraining paradigms reveals that this assumption is wrong: temporal sensitivity increases with depth, and the pretraining paradigm determines its growth profile. Vision-only models exhibit a gradual rise, while vision-language models show early suppression followed by late recovery. This finding motivates STRAP, a training-free adapter placement rule that derives a spatial-to-temporal transition boundary from a paradigm-matched video model. Spatial adapters are assigned before this boundary and temporal adapters after it, without modifying the adapter architecture itself. On four fine-grained action recognition benchmarks, STRAP improves accuracy by up to 11.8% over uniform placement, reduces trainable parameters by 29 to 48%, and lowers inference time by up to 10%. On standard benchmarks, it matches accuracy with fewer parameters. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [138] [Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11169)
*Jian Gao,Lin-Zhuo Chen,Yihang Chen,Jiagang Chen,Jiacheng Dong,Xun Cao,Nan Xue,Yinghao Xu,Yao Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Map2SLAM 冻结流式 3D 基础模型（LingBot-Map），仅训练轻量检索头，将模型的流式推理输出作为外部持久 SLAM 状态的观测，通过关键帧写入与异步回访重推断实现回环纠正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式 3D 基础模型可在线估计相机位姿与稠密几何，但预测一经输出即固定，无法通过回环闭合纠正累积漂移；因此需要把这类模型的推理调度与结果可修订性纳入 SLAM 框架。

Method: 前端用模型因果流式推理跟踪每帧并决定关键帧写入持久状态；后端异步选择历史帧，携带新上下文重新执行联合推理，经验证的回环观测在线改正轨迹、分段观测在序列后细化稠密几何；每张图像仅一次编码器前向，缓存特征同时驱动回环检索，使频繁重调用无额外编码开销。

Result: 在 KITTI、VBR、Oxford Spires 上达到 SOTA，平均 ATE 相比最佳未标定基线降低 40% 以上；在 RTX 5090D 上 518×154 分辨率保持 28+ FPS 实时跟踪。

Conclusion: 将冻结的流式 3DFM 作为可重观测的观测源、外接持久可修订 SLAM 状态，是低成本激活基础模型 SLAM 能力的有效范式。

Abstract: Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at this https URL .

</details>


### [139] [Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression for Extreme Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11200)
*Bingxin Wang,Yuan Lan,Yang Xiang,Yiqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAVAR：在<0.01 bpp极低码率下，基于VAR的生成式图像编解码器，传输早期尺度token加紧凑caption，分别提供布局与全局语义，并以部分VQ-VAE latent初始化序列并调制caption嵌入，降低感知失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极低码率（<0.01 bpp）图像压缩本质是受约束生成：需在贴近原图的同时推断合理缺失细节。自回归token模型提供由粗到细的先验，但早期尺度token使物体身份与纹理欠定，易产生与源不一致的重建。

Method: 构建于Visual Autoregressive建模之上：传输早期尺度token（图像特定布局）与紧凑caption（全局语义）；由保留尺度重建部分VQ-VAE latent，同时用于(a)映射为序列起始初始化、(b)在自适应LayerNorm前条件化caption嵌入，从而分离VAR式生成中通常共享的两种条件角色。

Result: 在Kodak与CLIC2020极低码率区间，相较匹配的ARPC保留尺度工作点，LPIPS降低约8–9%，DISTS最多降低22%，且bpp更低；单张NVIDIA L20X GPU上512×512图像重建约218 ms。

Conclusion: 以"token定布局+caption定语义"的分工式条件机制可有效缓解极低码率自回归编解码的源不一致问题，并在保持快速解码的同时提升感知质量。

Abstract: In the extreme-low bitrate range below $0.01$ bpp, image compression becomes a constrained generation problem: the reconstruction depends on inferring plausible missing details while staying close to the input image. Autoregressive token models provide an efficient coarse-to-fine prior for this setting, but the transmitted early-scale tokens often leave object identity and texture underdetermined, which can lead to source-inconsistent reconstructions. We introduce Source-Anchored Visual Autoregression (SAVAR), a generative codec built on Visual Autoregressive (VAR) modeling. SAVAR transmits early-scale tokens and a compact caption. The tokens provide image-specific layout information, while the caption supplies global semantics. SAVAR reconstructs a partial VQ-VAE latent from the retained scales, maps it to the start-of-sequence initialization, and uses the same latent to condition the caption embedding before adaptive layer normalization, separating two roles that are typically driven by a shared condition in VAR-style generation. On the Kodak and CLIC2020 datasets in the extreme-low range, SAVAR reduces perceptual distortion relative to matched ARPC retained-scale operating points, lowering LPIPS by about $8$--$9\%$ and DISTS by up to $22\%$ at a lower bpp. It reconstructs a $512 \times 512$ image in about $218$ ms on one NVIDIA L20X GPU, retaining fast autoregressive decoding in the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [140] [Viscot-steer: Disentangling and Transferring Visual Chain-of-Thought via Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11209)
*Ningning Wang,Beier Zhu,Xingyu Zhu,Kaiyun Yang,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Viscot-steer：一种免训练激活引导框架，将视觉思维链拆解为定位向量与推理向量，跨异构LVLM迁移视觉-CoT能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-CoT能力需昂贵后训练且与特定backbone紧耦合，难以迁移；现有跨模型迁移把视觉-CoT视为单一能力，忽略grounding与reasoning的功能区分，并引入阶段无关的干预。

Method: 先从源模型对应能力层中分别抽取grounding向量与reasoning向量，再将向量对齐到目标模型激活空间，并在边界框预测阶段引导grounding层、在推理轨迹生成阶段引导reasoning层。

Result: 在高分辨率视觉理解、通用视觉感知与推理、数学视觉推理等基准上，从不同视觉-CoT源模型向架构各异LVLM迁移，主要指标平均超过最强基线1.86个百分点。

Conclusion: 按功能解耦并按阶段干预的激活引导，可在免训练条件下有效跨模型迁移视觉-CoT能力。

Abstract: Visual chain-of-thought (visual-CoT), also known as "thinking with images", equips LVLMs with the ability to locate and use key visual evidence for reasoning. However, acquiring such visual-CoT capabilities requires costly post-training and tightly couples them to a specific backbone, making transfer to other LVLMs difficult. Existing cross-model transfer methods typically treat visual-CoT as a monolithic capability, using a unified representation that ignores the functional distinction between grounding and reasoning and introduces stage-irrelevant interventions. To address this problem, we propose Viscot-steer, a training-free activation steering framework for transferring visual-CoT capabilities across heterogeneous LVLMs. Specifically, Viscot-steer first disentangles visual-CoT into grounding and reasoning vectors and extracts them from the source-model layers associated with the corresponding capabilities. It then aligns the vectors with the activation space of the target model and steers the grounding and reasoning layers during bounding-box prediction and reasoning-trace generation, respectively. Across benchmarks covering high-resolution visual understanding, general visual perception and reasoning, and mathematical visual reasoning, Viscot-steer transfers capabilities from different visual-CoT models to architecturally diverse LVLMs and outperforms the strongest capability-transfer baseline by an average of 1.86 percentage points on the primary evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [141] [DynOLAT: OLAT Video Prediction for Controllable Dynamic Full-Body Relighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11210)
*Taoming Liu,Yinji ShenTu,Guangzhao He,Yudong Jin,Yukang Ye,Siyu Zhang,Fan Jia,Wei Hua,Hujun Bao,Xiaowei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynOLAT 提出可泛化的 OLAT（单光源逐次点亮）视频预测框架，从平坦光照输入预测时序一致的全身体 OLAT 基视频，再按目标环境图的线性权重组合，实现方向与相对强度均忠实响应的可控动态人体重光照，并发布首个大规模动态全身体 OLAT 数据集（>2400 万帧，224 个身份-服装组合）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式重光照方法虽视觉合理，但光照响应不精确：阴影/高光偏离目标方向，亮度不随目标环境相对强度变化，实质接近"外观和谐化"而非可控重光照。需要一种使方向性响应显式化、强度由环境图权重决定的公式化方案。

Method: 以 OLAT 基视频作为中间表示：从 flat-lit 输入预测时序一致的逐光源基视频（使方向响应在基中显式），再依据目标环境图导出线性权重进行组合，从而强度和方向均由物理一致的线性模型决定。配套构建动态采集管线与大规模动态全身体 OLAT 数据集。

Result: 相比基线，DynOLAT 对目标光照方向与相对强度的变化响应更忠实，在保留细节外观与时序一致性的同时实现可控视频重光照；数据集与处理工具将开源。

Conclusion: 将重光照重构为 OLAT 基预测+线性组合，是把可控性交还给显式光照表示的可行路线，数据规模与开源有助于推动动态人体重光照与逆渲染研究。

Abstract: Accurate lighting response is essential for realistic dynamic human relighting, because shadows, highlights, and color changes should follow the target illumination in both direction and relative strength. Current learning-based relighting methods can generate visually plausible videos, but they often exhibit imprecise lighting responses: shadows and highlights may drift away from the target direction, and the output brightness may not faithfully follow the relative intensities in the target environment, making the result closer to appearance harmonization than controllable relighting. To address this issue, we propose DynOLAT, a generalizable OLAT video prediction framework for dynamic full-body humans. Instead of directly synthesizing a single relit appearance, our method predicts temporally consistent One-Light-At-a-Time (OLAT) basis videos from flat-lit inputs, and then linearly combines the predicted bases according to the target environment map. This OLAT-based formulation makes the directional response explicit in the predicted bases, while the relative lighting strength is determined by the linear weights derived from the environment map. We further introduce a dynamic capture pipeline and the first large-scale dynamic full-body OLAT dataset, comprising over 24 million frames from 224 identity-outfit combinations, where different outfits of the same person define separate combinations. Experiments show that DynOLAT responds more faithfully to variations in target lighting direction and relative intensity than the tested baselines, enabling controllable video relighting while preserving fine appearance details and temporal coherence. The dataset and processing tools will be publicly released to foster future research.

</details>


### [142] [Disentangling Where and When:Factored Spatio-Temporal Explanations for Video Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11214)
*Bhavan Vasu,Giuseppe Raffa,Prasad Tadepalli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扰动的后解释框架，将视频动作识别的解释解耦为空间外观掩码Ma与时间运动掩码Mm，联合优化并引入分离惩罚与ReLU面积约束，在三个数据集上取得最低删除AUC且掩码约稀疏5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频动作识别的后验解释方法将空间外观与时间动态混杂在单一显著性/重要性图中，无法区分两种贡献，缺乏可验证的分离性评估。

Method: 冻结动作识别模型，用因子化扰动架构联合优化两个掩码；采用最近帧替换以识别重要时间动态；分离惩罚抑制外观掩码在运动掩码已丢弃帧上分配预算；ReLU面积约束惩罚超预算解释；并提出独立扫描空间像素与时间帧的分离评估协议及理论证明。

Result: 在EPIC-Kitchens-55、EGTEA Gaze+、Something-Something V2上，删除AUC低于主流基线，掩码稀疏度约为基线的5倍。

Conclusion: 该工作为视频动作模型提供可解耦、可量化评估的时空解释，兼顾解释质量与稀疏性，但属可解释性分析工具，未涉及策略学习或机器人部署。

Abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods for video action recognition typically conflate spatial appearance and temporal dynamics into a single saliency or importance map. We propose a perturbation-based framework that disentangles these contributions into a spatial appearance mask ($M_a$) and a temporal motion mask ($M_m$). The two masks are jointly optimized against a frozen action recognition model through factored perturbation architecture, with nearest frame replacement to identify important temporal dynamics. A separation penalty discourages the appearance mask from spending budget on frames that the motion mask has already discarded. A ReLU-based area constraint penalizes explanations larger than an assigned budget. To evaluate these explanations, we introduce a separation protocol that sweeps spatial pixels and temporal frames independently, backed by proofs characterizing the proposed method. Across EPIC-Kitchens-55, EGTEA Gaze+, and Something-Something V2, our method attains the lowest deletion AUC against leading baselines while producing masks roughly five times sparser.

</details>


### [143] [Auto-GlaKG: Automated Biomarker Reasoning for Explainable Glaucoma Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11258)
*Cheng Huang,Zeyu Han,Yian Hu,Yaopeng Ding,Jingxi Qiu,Yadi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Auto-GlaKG：用ResNet50从眼底图预测CDR与6个形态学体征，再由固定临床先验规则的知识图谱推理器聚合"带符号规则贡献"得到青光眼评分；689张图、分组五折交叉验证AUC 0.951，与端到端图像分类器持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释青光眼检测需要在图像、临床生物标志物与诊断预测之间建立透明联系；KG推理能提供该结构，但以往在"标注生物标志物"条件下评测，无法证明仅有图像时的性能，因此需构建全自动图像→生物标志物→规则推理的闭环并如实评测。

Method: 两阶段自动化框架：(1) ResNet50在生物标志物监督下预测杯盘比CDR与6项形态学体征；(2) 知识图谱推理器按固定临床先验规则聚合各体征带符号的规则贡献，输出青光眼评分。采用分层、分组感知（group-aware）五折交叉验证，并与同等条件的端到端图像分类器对照，另做"用标注CDR替换预测CDR"的消融。

Result: 689张眼底图像上汇总AUC=0.951（95%CI 0.931–0.969），敏感度0.970，特异度0.779；匹配的图像分类器AUC同为0.951；规则推理阶段每图仅增约0.2 ms；用标注CDR替换预测CDR后折均AUC由0.953升至0.995。

Conclusion: 该框架为图像预测提供了显式的规则级解释路径，但"生物标志物标注下的高性能"并不等于"纯图像下的高精度"；预测CDR是性能瓶颈，应作为后续使用独立测量生物标志物验证的首要目标。整体属医学影像领域的可解释诊断工作，主任务指标未超越同参数图像分类器。

Abstract: Interpretable glaucoma detection requires a transparent connection between fundus images, clinically meaningful biomarkers, and diagnostic predictions. Knowledge graph (KG) reasoning provides this structure, but performance measured using annotated biomarkers does not establish performance when only images are available. We present Auto-GlaKG, an automated framework that combines image-based biomarker prediction with fixed clinical-prior rules. A ResNet50 network predicts the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR) and six morphological signs using biomarker supervision, and a KG reasoner aggregates their signed rule contributions into a glaucoma score. On 689 fundus images evaluated using stratified, group-aware five-fold cross-validation, Auto-GlaKG achieves a pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.951 (95\% confidence interval: 0.931--0.969), with sensitivity of 0.970 and specificity of 0.779. The matched image classifier also achieves an AUC of 0.951, while the rule stage adds 0.2~ms per image. Replacing predicted CDR with its annotation increases fold-mean AUC from 0.953 to 0.995. The framework provides an explicit rule-level account of image-based predictions and identifies CDR estimation as a priority for validation using independently measured biomarkers.

</details>


### [144] [DuSS-PET: Self-Supervised Low-Dose PET Reconstruction Using Pseudo-Dual-Domain Consistency Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11265)
*Shuijin Lin,Yuzhu He,Yongbo Wang,Jianhua Ma,Fan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DuSS-PET：基于 Noisier2Noise 范式的自监督低剂量 PET 重建框架，无需配对低/全剂量数据，通过 Bernoulli 腐蚀策略在图像空间模拟低计数噪声并生成伪正弦图，结合自适应 Swin Transformer、即插即用图像增强模块及伪正弦图-图像一致性约束进行训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PET 高质量成像需高辐射剂量；现有深度学习低剂量重建依赖配对低剂量/全剂量扫描进行全监督训练，而配对数据在临床上难以获取，成为根本性瓶颈。

Method: 构建于计算型 Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) 范式之上：采用 Bernoulli 腐蚀策略作为图像空间近似，在图像域派生的伪正弦图表示中模拟低计数噪声；框架包含三部分——用于伪正弦图恢复的自适应 Swin Transformer、即插即用的图像增强模块，以及强制伪正弦图与图像表示一致的自监督一致性约束策略。

Result: 多中心数据集实验显示，DuSS-PET 重建性能优于现有 SOTA 自监督方法，在多种剂量水平下达到与全监督方法相当甚至更优的效果，并在不同扫描仪厂商间表现出优异的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作是首批在重建图像与伪正弦图之间施加一致性的自监督低剂量 PET 重建框架之一，图像空间生成的伪正弦图可作为无需全剂量训练扫描的可靠计算一致性约束；代码将公开。

Abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) is pivotal in medicine and healthcare, but requires high radiation doses for quality imaging. Although deep learning has shown promise for low-dose PET reconstruction/enhancement, existing methods primarily rely on fully supervised learning, which requires paired low- and full-dose scans that are clinically impractical to obtain. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose DuSS-PET, a novel self-supervised PET reconstruction framework that operates without any paired low- and full-dose data. Our method is built upon a computational Noisier2Noise (Nr2N) paradigm, featuring a Bernoulli corruption strategy that serves as an image-space approximation to emulate low-count noise patterns in image-derived pseudo-sinogram representations. The DuSS-PET framework integrates three core components: an adaptive Swin transformer for pseudo-sinogram restoration, a plug-and-play module for image enhancement, and a consistency-constrained SSL strategy that enforces agreement between the pseudo-sinogram and image representations. Extensive experiments on multi-center datasets demonstrate that DuSS-PET achieves superior reconstruction performance, outperforming state-of-the-art SSL methods and achieving comparable or even better results than fully supervised approaches across various dose levels. In particular, it exhibits exceptional generalization across different scanner vendors. This work is among the first self-supervised low-dose PET reconstruction framework that enforces consistency between reconstructed images and pseudo-sinograms, where the pseudo-sinogram generated in the image space serves as a solid computational consistency constraint for enhanced imaging without full-dose training scans. The source code will be publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [145] [BiRefNet-V2: Rethinking Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11272)
*Peng Zheng,Deng-Ping Fan,Binglu Wang,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BiRefNet-V2 将二值图像分割重构为"受控信息恢复"范式（局部性决定空间信息存活、语义选择性决定进入信息、边界监督聚焦精化区域），通过保局部且语义引导的细节注入、无需边界标注的学习式边界流、以及融合深度可分离边界卷积与大核注意力的双分支解码器，实现高精度二值分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值图像分割（DIS）需像素级前后景分离并保留细丝、锐边、复杂纹理等精细结构。原 BiRefNet 的双边参考存在缺陷：内向参考丢失局部空间结构且缺乏语义引导，外向参考仅依赖单通道梯度注意力。作者据此把该范式重构为"受控信息恢复"框架以系统化修复上述信息损失。

Method: (1) 通过 space-to-depth 变换、重叠 patch 切分与 Semantically Guided Gate 实现保局部、语义引导的细节注入；(2) 学习式边界流，以聚焦监督生成全通道残差注意力，且不需边界标注；(3) 双分支解码器，将深度可分离边界卷积与大核注意力结合；(4) 工程现代化：LayerNorm、GELU、Lion 优化器与 DINOv3 主干。

Result: 在 DIS5K、伪装目标检测和高分辨率显著目标检测共 13 个评测集上均取得 SOTA；训练轮数由 600 降至 50。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，以"局部性—语义选择性—边界聚焦监督"三要素重构双边参考范式，可在显著降低训练成本的同时提升细结构分割精度，并具备跨任务泛化性。

Abstract: Dichotomous image segmentation requires pixel-accurate foreground-background separation while preserving fine structures such as thin filaments, sharp edges, and intricate textures. BiRefNet addressed this challenge through bilateral references, combining image patches and gradient information, but its inward reference loses local spatial structure and lacks semantic guidance, while its outward reference relies on single-channel gradient attention. We recast this paradigm as controlled information recovery - locality determines what spatial information survives, semantic selectivity what information enters, and focused boundary supervision where refinement occurs - and propose BiRefNet-V2 to implement it: (1) locality-preserving and semantically guided detail injection through space-to-depth transformation, overlapping patches, and a Semantically Guided Gate; (2) a learned boundary stream with focused supervision that generates full-channel residual attention without requiring boundary annotations; and (3) a dual-branch decoder integrating depth-wise boundary convolutions with large-kernel attention. A modernized framework - LayerNorm, GELU, the Lion optimizer, and a DINOv3 backbone - cuts training from 600 to 50 epochs. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on DIS5K, camouflaged object detection, and high-resolution salient object detection across all 13 evaluation sets. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [146] [TransArt3D: From Two States to Articulated 3D Reconstruction with Video Transition Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11304)
*Chenhao Guan,Liying Yang,Xinxing Yu,Hao Mo,Tianshun Han,Renjun Gao,Yanyan Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TransArt3D是一个基于优化的框架，从两张端点图像重建可交互的关节式3D资产，通过将视频扩散模型的时序先验转化为显式的部件结构与关节运动学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从少量图像重建可交互关节式资产问题高度欠约束。现有静态3D先验逐状态独立打分，导致单状态重建误差泄漏为虚假运动；视频扩散模型虽隐含2D运动信息，但未被显式利用。

Method: 1) 过渡耦合的3D一致性：对端点间生成的帧联合施加静态3D先验，稳定不变区域并初始化部件与关节；2) 校正流运动学细化：用视频先验监督整个过渡过程的3D运动场，同时用部件分配和共享关节约束该场，抑制逐状态误差；3) 运动感知的规范外观融合：利用恢复的关节将两端点图像映射到统一规范表面，补全仅单状态可见区域的纹理。

Result: 在PartNet-Mobility上，几何与关节精度优于使用相同两张端点图像的方法，并在关节状态几何、关节定位与外观上超过使用6个观测状态的方法。

Conclusion: 将视频扩散过渡先验显式蒸馏为部件结构与关节运动学，可有效缓解静态先验的误差泄漏问题，仅用两个端点视图即可实现高质量关节资产重建与外观补全。

Abstract: Reconstructing interactable articulated assets from a few images is key to robotics and simulation, yet highly underconstrained. Existing optimization-based methods fit an articulated asset under a static 3D prior that scores each state independently, so per-state reconstruction errors leak into the estimated moving part and joint as false motion. Video diffusion models capture how objects move between states, but only implicitly in 2D. To this end, we present TransArt3D, an optimization-based framework that reconstructs an articulated 3D asset from two endpoint images by translating this video transition prior into explicit part structure and joint kinematics. It first lifts frames generated between the endpoints with a transition-coupled 3D consensus that applies the static 3D prior jointly across frames, stabilizing unchanging regions and initializing the parts and joint. A rectified-flow kinematic refinement then lets the video prior supervise a 3D motion field over the whole transition, while part assignment and a shared joint constrain the field throughout optimization, keeping per-state errors out of the articulation. Finally, a motion-aware canonical appearance fusion uses the recovered articulation to map both endpoint images onto one canonical surface, texturing regions that only one state reveals. On PartNet-Mobility, TransArt3D outperforms methods given the same two endpoints in geometry and joint accuracy, and surpasses methods given six observed states in articulated-state geometry, joint localization and appearance.

</details>


### [147] [Beyond Similarity Entropy: A Rank-Guided Data-Free Quantization Framework for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11320)
*Runqing Jiang,Ye Zhang,Pengpeng Yu,Zhuo Song,Changjun Li,Longguang Wang,Yulan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RankQ-ViT: 一种秩引导的数据无关量化（DFQ）框架，通过块感知自对比目标促进合成校准样本的特征多样性，并按秩与语义一致性筛选样本进行分块重建，在低比特量化下提升ViT在分类/检测/点云任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT计算与内存开销大，移动端部署困难；DFQ可在无原始训练数据下压缩模型。现有方法依赖"patch相似度熵"来合成校准样本，但熵只刻画相似度数值的分散程度，不保证样本覆盖多样化的特征方向，因而限制了校准效果。

Method: 观察到高斯噪声生成的patch相似度矩阵秩低于真实图像，提出块感知自对比目标（block-aware self-contrastive objective），在生成数据时提升特征多样性而无需每步显式计算矩阵秩；随后基于秩与语义一致性挑选校准样本，对量化模型进行分块重建（block-wise reconstruction）。

Result: 在ImageNet、COCO、ModelNet40、ShapeNet上跨多种架构与任务验证，尤其在低比特量化下优于现有DFQ方法。

Conclusion: 以"相似度矩阵秩"作为特征方向多样性的可操作代理信号，是改进无数据量化校准生成的有效途径；方法通用、跨架构跨任务适用。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated remarkable performance, yet their computational and memory demands pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. Data-free quantization (DFQ) enables the compression of ViTs without access to their original training data. Existing DFQ methods often synthesize calibration samples by maximizing the entropy of patch similarity. However, similarity entropy describes the dispersion of similarity values without ensuring that the generated samples cover diverse feature directions, potentially limiting their effectiveness for quantization calibration. To address this limitation, we propose RankQ-ViT, a rank-guided DFQ framework for ViTs. We first observe that patch similarity matrices derived from Gaussian noise tend to have lower ranks than those derived from real images. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a block-aware self-contrastive objective that promotes feature diversity during synthetic data generation without explicitly computing matrix rank at each optimization step. We then select calibration samples based on their rank and semantic consistency and use them for block-wise reconstruction of the quantized model. Experiments on ImageNet, COCO, ModelNet40, and ShapeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of RankQ-ViT across multiple architectures and tasks, particularly under low-bit quantization. The code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [148] [Conditional Diffusion-Based Proxy Representation Recovery for BCVA Prediction with Missing SLO Modality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11326)
*Chuyi He,Hua Zou,Fei Luo,Zixian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出条件扩散模型在潜特征空间恢复缺失SLO代理表征，并与OCT图像、临床文本融合预测白内障术后BCVA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实临床数据中SLO图像缺失率高（本文58.80%），多模态输入不完整会削弱术后最佳矫正视力（BCVA）预测；直接重建原始SLO图像困难且不必要。

Method: 将SLO缺失建模为潜空间代理表征恢复：先融合OCT图像特征与临床文本特征构建OCT-文本条件表征，以其引导扩散模型反向去噪，生成样本特异的SLO代理表征；该表征替代缺失模态进入下游多模态融合预测网络完成BCVA回归。

Result: 在2,141例术前多模态白内障样本（SLO缺失率58.80%）上，绝对误差≤0.1 LogMAR准则下准确率0.9714，平均绝对误差0.0423，优于代表性术后视力预测与缺失模态学习方法。

Conclusion: 表征级代理恢复可有效缓解SLO模态缺失对术后BCVA预测的影响，为不完整多模态临床预测提供可行范式。

Abstract: Preoperative prediction of postoperative best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) can support prognosis assessment and individualized decision-making in cataract surgery. Multimodal learning can integrate preoperative optical coherence tomography (OCT) images, scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) images, and clinical text to characterize patient status. However, SLO images are often missing in real-world clinical data due to acquisition or data-management issues, resulting in incomplete multimodal inputs. To address this problem, this paper proposes a conditional diffusion-based method for SLO proxy representation recovery and fusion prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw SLO images, the proposed method formulates SLO missingness as proxy representation recovery in the latent feature space.
