Specifically, OCT image features and clinical text features are first fused to construct an OCT-text conditional representation, which guides the reverse denoising process of the diffusion model to estimate sample-specific SLO proxy representations. The recovered SLO proxy representation is then used as a substitute for the unavailable SLO modality and incorporated into the downstream multimodal fusion prediction network for postoperative BCVA prediction. Experiments were conducted on 2,141 preoperative multimodal cataract samples, with an SLO missing rate of 58.80%. The proposed method achieved an accuracy of 0.9714 under the criterion of an absolute prediction error within 0.1 LogMAR and a mean absolute error of 0.0423, outperforming representative postoperative visual acuity prediction and missing-modality learning methods. These results indicate that representation-level proxy recovery can alleviate the impact of SLO modality missingness on postoperative BCVA prediction.

</details>


### [149] [MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11334)
*Shijia Zhao,Xusheng Guo,Qiming Xia,Xun Huang,Kezheng Xiong,Zhihong Liu,Chenglu Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoT3DVG室外动态3D视觉定位数据集（基于nuScenes，850场景、31,128帧、144,568条含运动描述的文本提示），并提出DynaVG框架，通过SLIDE模块融合短期局部运动线索与长期全局时序上下文，在语言-点云对齐前实现动态感知编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D视觉定位研究集中于静态室内物体，难以适用于动态室外自动驾驶场景；引入运动描述以刻画运动物体的时序动态性是解决该问题的可行途径，但缺乏相应数据与方法。

Method: 构建MoT3DVG大规模时序-evolving运动描述数据集；提出DynaVG框架，在标准模态编码器与语言-点云对齐之间插入Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding（SLIDE）模块，以短时窗口编码捕捉局部运动线索、以长时窗口滑移获取全局时序上下文。

Result: 在MoT3DVG上取得SOTA性能，验证了运动感知编码的有效性，并揭示室外3DVG的开放挑战。

Conclusion: 动态感知的运动描述与时序编码对室外3D视觉定位至关重要，MoT3DVG与DynaVG为该方向奠定数据与方法基础，后续仍需攻克多项开放问题。

Abstract: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. In addition to the standard modality-specific encoders, DynaVG introduces a Short-Long Integrated Dynamic Encoding (SLIDE) module before the language-point cloud alignment. SLIDE models both local motion cues and global temporal context via short-term window encoding and long-term window shifting. Extensive experiments demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance on MoT3DVG, validating the effectiveness of motion-aware encoding. Our work reveals open challenges and promising directions for future research in outdoor 3DVG.

</details>


### [150] [NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11359)
*Yonghuang Wu,Pengfei Wang,Zhenyang Liang,Yize Ma,Pengfei Song,Guoqing Wu,Jinhua Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NuJEV extends Qwen3-VL-2B with a parallel nuclear perception head (presence/center/type) trained jointly with visual LoRA, so one image encoding serves both the structured head and the language decoder for countable, region/type-aware nuclear quantification.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nuclear quantification needs localization and typing, not just counts; free-form VLM generation is unreliable, so structured (JEV-style) decision heads are used instead.

Method: Joint training of visual LoRA plus a parallel head on Qwen3-VL-2B predicting nuclear presence, centers, and types; shared image encoding feeds head and language decoder; counts derived from predicted nuclei; decoder handles region/type queries. Matched-encoder ablation isolates visual adaptation.

Result: On 2,732 PanNuke test images: MAE5 = 1.844 overall, 5.268 on dense images; localization/typed F1 0.816/0.682; visual adaptation yields 41.0% lower dense error; request MAE reduced 76.2% vs. direct generation.

Conclusion: Structured heads with visual LoRA adaptation give reliable nuclear perception and counting in MLLMs, pointing to a general recipe for structured perception outputs over free-form generation; code to be open-sourced.

Abstract: Nuclear quantification requires locating and typing nuclei, beyond generating a count. Inspired by Jev's structured decisions in place of free-form generation, we introduce NuJEV for nuclear perception in Qwen3-VL-2B. We jointly train visual LoRA and a parallel head to predict nuclear presence, centers, and types. One image encoding feeds both the nuclear head and original language decoder. The decoder interprets region and type requests, with counts computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images, NuJEV achieves a five-query mean absolute error ($\mathrm{MAE}_5$) of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images, with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682. A matched encoder ablation shows 41.0\% lower dense error with visual adaptation. For language requests, NuJEV reduces request MAE by 76.2\% relative to direct generation. Our code will be released as open source.

</details>


### [151] [SegDis: Foreground Segmentation Followed by Type Discrimination for Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11378)
*Dingning Luo,Shuo Dou,Tong Jiang,Xianfeng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将显著/伪装目标检测联合输出分解为显式前景概率与条件类型概率（给定前景），实现SOD/COD两决策机制解耦与错误归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SOD/COD联合方法仅输出二值掩码，无法区分目标类型；USCNet虽区分两类，但将前景存在性与类型绑定于同一归一化，导致失败来源不可归因。跨任务实验显示前景定位可在SOD与COD间迁移，而类型判别不可迁移，故需分离机制。

Method: SegDis将输出因式分解为前景概率与条件类型概率：FLR模块提供高质量、任务无关的前景支撑；RTA基于前景-背景关系精炼SOD/COD分配，无需任务标识符。由于前景支撑显式化，可按正确类别/类型互换/漏检对GT前景像素分类，分别诊断前景恢复与类型分配误差。骨干为PVT-v2-B2。

Result: 在USC12K上达68.98% FG-mIoU、78.35% mIoU，参数量约为USCNet的1/8；CSCS为5.75。

Conclusion: 前景恢复与类型判别应由独立机制建模；显式因式分解带来可归因的误差诊断，并在更低参数量下取得更优性能。

Abstract: Salient and camouflaged object detection (SOD and COD) both recover foreground support, yet most joint methods output only a binary mask and therefore cannot distinguish the type. USC12K distinguishes the two types, but its baseline USCNet still binds foreground existence to the type within a single normalization, so the failure source cannot be attributed. Our cross-task study shows that foreground localization transfers between SOD and COD, whereas type discrimination does not: a COD-only model recovers foreground on SOD images but its type judgement follows the training distribution rather than the foreground-background relation, so the two decisions require separate mechanisms. SegDis factorizes the output into an explicit foreground probability and a conditional type probability given foreground: FLR provides high-quality task-agnostic support, and RTA refines the SOD/COD assignment from the foreground-background relation without a task identifier. Because support is explicit, each ground-truth foreground pixel is classified as correct-type, type-swapped, or missed, so foreground-recovery and type-assignment errors are diagnosed separately. With PVT-v2-B2, SegDis attains 68.98% FG-mIoU and 78.35% mIoU on USC12K at about one-eighth of USCNet's parameters; CSCS is 5.75.

</details>


### [152] [Let the Gallery Learn Itself: Training-Free Iterative Side-View Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11391)
*Zijun Huang,Suncheng Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSE：免训练的人脸识别 gallery 自演化框架，通过 dedup-FIFO 策展把测试时成功识别的新外观样本归档入 gallery（每人上限30条），永久锁定注册模板，在 CFP-FP 45° yaw 提升约23点、IJB-C TAR@FAR=0.001 提升9.4点，纯CPU开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸识别系统部署后通常冻结，无法从每次相遇中吸收新外观（侧脸、光照、姿态变化）；而全量重训练或微调代价高昂且存在模板漂移风险。作者希望在不更新任何参数的前提下让 gallery 在测试时自适应。

Method: 提出 Gallery Self-Evolution（GSE），一个 training-free 框架：核心机制为 dedup-FIFO 策展——当识别成功后将新颖外观样本去重后按先进先出策略归档进 gallery，每身份最多30个 embedding；同时永久锁定原始注册模板以保证身份锚点稳定。整个过程不做梯度更新、不重训练、不需GPU。

Result: 在 CFP-FP 与 IJB-C 基准上，45° yaw 的侧视差距缩小约+23点，TAR@FAR=0.001 提升+9.4点，计算成本仅为CPU级。

Conclusion: 测试时由 gallery 侧进行无参数自演化即可显著提升人脸识别鲁棒性，且部署成本极低；但属于人脸识别领域的推理期记忆管理技巧，与具身智能/3D/世界模型等核心方向关联薄弱。

Abstract: What if a face recognition system could learn from every encounter without a single gradient update? We present Gallery Self-Evolution (GSE), a training-free framework where the gallery itself adapts at test time. The core mechanism---dedup-FIFO curation---archives novel appearance samples after successful recognition while permanently locking the enrollment template, bounded at 30 embeddings per identity. On CFP-FP and IJB-C benchmarks, GSE closes the side-view gap by +23 points at 45° yaw and boosts TAR@FAR=0.001 by +9.4 points, all at CPU-level cost. No retraining. No GPU. Just a gallery that grows smarter every time it meets you.

</details>


### [153] [GenRM-Flow: Generators are Process-aware Reward Models in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11421)
*Siming Fu,Ruizhe He,Zheming Fu,Zeyue Xue,Fengkai Liu,Yufei Jiao,Jie Huang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Xuan Yang,Lihui Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenRM-Flow 提出把经过偏好微调的视频生成器的速度预测误差直接读作奖励，从而让生成器本身充当过程感知的过程奖励模型，并替代外部 VLM 打分器用于 FlowAWR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频奖励模型依赖 VLM 的表示能力或冻结生成器的辅佐打分头，未利用生成器自身的速度预测/去噪/生成能力，而离线偏好学习在数学上必然对应一个 KL 约束下的最优策略，因此奖励可从该解析解中被分离出来。

Method: 从离线偏好优化目标的 KL 约束最优策略解析解出发分离奖励项，将精确生成对数似然映射为 flow-matching 代理，得到奖励等于连续时间速度预测误差的相对差；形式化为 GenRM-Flow，在带噪隐空间直接读取过程奖励；理论上证明 DPO/IPO 等对比式与 RWR 等非对比式目标都是通向同一最优策略的不同优化路径，各自诱导出速度误差形式的奖励读出；并将该奖励嵌入 FlowAWR 替换外部 VLM 打分器。

Result: 无需辅助奖励网络、纯作用于原生隐输出即可给出奖励，并在下游视频生成上带来可测量的提升（摘要未给出具体数值与基准）。

Conclusion: 奖励建模可与生成建模在理论上统一：偏好微调后的生成器即是忠实的奖励源，为视频生成的对齐提供了一条自洽、轻量且与多种偏好优化目标兼容的路径。

Abstract: Aligning video generation models with human preference depends critically on the quality of the reward model that scores generated videos. Current video reward models, however, source their reward signal from a model's representational rather than generative capacity: they either repurpose vision-language models as pixel-space scorers, or train auxiliary scoring heads on top of frozen generator features. The generator's actual ability to predict velocities, denoise latents, and produce videos plays no role in scoring its own generations. We argue that this overlooks a structural property of offline preference learning. Any preference optimization objective that approximates an offline preference dataset mathematically targets a strictly defined KL-constrained optimal policy. By isolating the reward term from this analytical solution and mapping the exact generation log-likelihood to its flow-matching surrogate, the empirical reward emerges deterministically as the relative difference in continuous-time velocity-prediction errors. We formalize this equivalence into GenRM-Flow, a framework where a preference-tuned video generator inherently operates as a process-aware reward model directly in the noisy latent space. We further show theoretically that distinct fine-tuning objectives, whether contrastive like DPO and IPO or non-contrastive like RWR, are alternative optimization pathways toward the same optimal policy, each inducing a reward readout from the generator's velocity-prediction errors. Furthermore, the extracted process reward seamlessly substitutes external VLM scorers in FlowAWR. Operating purely on native latent outputs without auxiliary reward networks, this generative reward drives measurable improvements in downstream video generation.

</details>


### [154] [Flex-DDCM: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Image Compression via Diffusion Trajectory Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11427)
*Yixin Gao,Runsen Feng,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Flex-DDCM：基于扩散轨迹引导的零样本任务导向图像压缩框架，通过任务引导的噪声选择适配编码轨迹，实现保真度/感知质量/下游任务性能的灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本图像压缩借助预训练扩散模型先验可免训练获得高质量重建，但现有零样本编解码器缺乏灵活性，难以同时满足人眼观看与机器分析这两类应用的多样化重建需求。

Method: 在 Turbo-DDCM 基础上，将任务引导效应注入压缩表示：对编码扩散轨迹进行任务引导的噪声选择；引导项可单独或组合使用，并采用随时间步变化的强度在去噪全过程中控制其影响，从而在不增加额外解码复杂度的前提下实现任务自适应。

Result: 实验显示可在像素保真度、感知质量和下游任务性能之间实现灵活权衡，性能与经过训练的任务导向编解码器相当，且解码速度优于 Diff-ICMH。

Conclusion: 将任务引导内嵌至扩散编码轨迹，是零样本编解码器实现任务导向压缩的低成本有效途径；但其评估限于图像压缩任务，缺乏真实机器人/物理系统验证。

Abstract: Recent zero-shot image compression methods exploit the powerful priors of pretrained diffusion models to produce perceptually pleasing reconstructions without compression-specific training. However, image compression serves not only human viewing but also machine analysis, while existing zero-shot codecs have limited flexibility in meeting the diverse reconstruction requirements of these applications. In this paper, we propose Flex-DDCM, a framework for zero-shot task-oriented image compression via diffusion trajectory guidance. Building on Turbo-DDCM, we adapt the coded diffusion trajectory through task-guided noise selection, embedding the effects of task guidance into the compressed representation. Guidance terms can be applied individually or combined, with timestep-dependent strengths controlling their influence throughout denoising. This design enables task adaptation without introducing additional decoding complexity. Experiments demonstrate flexible trade-offs among pixel fidelity, perceptual quality, and downstream task performance, with competitive performance against trained task-oriented codecs and faster decoding than Diff-ICMH.

</details>


### [155] [Unlearning at Speed: Rapid Activation Dampening for Efficient Machine Unlearning in Real-World Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11433)
*Rouqaiah Al-Refai,Leo Scheubel,Philipp Terhörst*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAD：面向大规模开集人脸识别的快速定向机器遗忘方法，通过抑制与目标身份最相关的神经元激活实现遗忘，并提出适配开集表征的Forget Score指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GDPR等法规要求用户可请求删除个人数据，但现有人脸识别遗忘方法多为闭集分类、小模型小数据设定，难以迁移到真实大规模开集系统。

Method: Rapid Activation Dampening (RAD)：估计遗忘身份与保留身份的平均神经元激活差异，通过敏感性控制的抑制机制定位并选择性压制与目标身份最相关的神经元；同时提出Forget Score (FS)，在表征空间中给出遗忘的概率化解释，弥合现有遗忘指标与开集问题的失配。

Result: 在多个近期大规模人脸识别架构与数据集上，RAD在实现强遗忘的同时保持模型整体效用，并显著提升遗忘速度。

Conclusion: RAD为大规模开集人脸识别提供可扩展、实用的机器遗忘方案，并指出开集遗忘评测指标需要专门设计。

Abstract: Machine unlearning has become increasingly important in face recognition, where regulations like the GDPR empower users to request the removal of their personal data from deployed models. However, most existing unlearning methods are designed for closed-set classification with small-scale models and training data, and therefore do not generalize to real-world face recognition systems, which operate in an open-set setting with large-scale models and data. In this work, we propose Rapid Activation Dampening (RAD), a fast and targeted unlearning method tailored specifically for large-scale open-set face recognition. RAD approximates differences in average neuron activations between forget and retain identities, identifying and selectively suppressing neurons that are most associated with the targeted identity through a sensitivity-controlled dampening mechanism. We further propose the Forget Score (FS), which addresses the mismatch between existing unlearning metrics and open-set problems by providing a probabilistic interpretation of forgetting directly in the representation space. Experiments across several recent large-scale face recognition architectures and datasets show that RAD achieves strong forgetting while preserving overall model utility and substantially improving unlearning speed. These findings establish RAD as a scalable and practical approach to machine unlearning in face recognition systems.

</details>


### [156] [How to "train" a surgeon? Benchmarking generalist agents in surgical scene understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11437)
*Gengyuan Zhang,Xiao Han,Shijie Zhou,Abdullah Koukash,Jingpei Wu,Jindong Gu,Yuqicheng Zhu,Nassir Navab,Volker Tresp,Ghazal Ghazaei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 两阶段手术场景理解评估框架：Stage I 构建 SurgKnowBench 诊断基准统一公开手术数据集，刻画通用 MLLM 的预训练手术能力边界；Stage II 提出 SurgAgentGym 智能体环境，通过受约束的 SurgWiki 知识检索与通用视觉定位工具，实现推理时增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术数据稀缺且评测协议碎片化，通用多模态大模型在手术场景下的能力边界不明；受外科培训"脚手架式"教学启发，探索无需额外手术训练即可在推理阶段提升手术理解的可能性。

Method: Stage I：SurgKnowBench 跨术式、跨任务统一公开手术数据集，评测闭源与开源 MLLM，定位其失败前沿（视觉先验尚存，关系/流程理解薄弱）。Stage II：SurgAgentGym 智能体环境，允许通用 MLLM 智能体调用 SurgWiki 有界知识搜索与通用视觉 grounding 工具完成手术任务，仅靠工具介导的证据使用在推理时提升表现。

Result: 智能体式推理主要收窄感知密集型任务的差距；细粒度定位与专家式评估仍是持续瓶颈。

Conclusion: 建立了"诊断基准—智能体增强"的失败前沿驱动范式，为智能体化手术理解研究铺路；但工作为基准与评估框架性质，缺乏可迁移的方法创新。

Abstract: Evaluating general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for surgical scene understanding remains limited due to scarce surgical data and fragmented evaluation protocols. We address these challenges through a two-stage evaluation framework for surgical scene understanding. In Stage I, we introduce SurgKnowBench, a diagnostic benchmark that harmonizes public surgical datasets across procedures and tasks and evaluates proprietary and open-source MLLMs to map the boundary of pretrained surgical competence. SurgKnowBench reveals that current models retain partial visual priors but remain weak on relational and procedural understanding and workflow assessment. Building on this failure frontier and motivated by the scaffolded nature of surgical training, we introduce SurgAgentGym, an agentic environment where general-purpose MLLM agents can use bounded knowledge search over SurgWiki and general-purpose visual grounding for surgical tasks. SurgAgentGym evaluates whether generalist agents can improve surgical understanding at inference time through tool-mediated evidence use, without additional surgical training. Our results show that agentic inference narrows the gap mainly for perception-heavy tasks, while fine-grained localization and expert-style assessment remain persistent bottlenecks. This opens a path toward future studies of agentic surgical understanding.

</details>


### [157] [Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11452)
*Weizhong Huang,Huaijia Kou,Tianyu Xie,Xiawu Zheng,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemanticKV：一种免训练的 KV cache 压缩方法，利用 agentic 视频生成中 planner 提取的语义约束来引导缓存保留，实现语义对齐的 token 选择，在几乎不损失视频质量的前提下大幅降低显存并加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic 自回归视频生成中，逐步增长的视觉历史导致 KV cache 膨胀，显存与注意力开销随候选 rollout 剧增。现有压缩方法只针对单个生成器优化，忽略了 planner 的语义约束，可能丢弃支撑用户所需属性/动作的关键状态。

Method: 免训练方法：先用文本 cross-attention 定位与约束相关的视频位置，将这些位置对应的 self-attention query 聚为多个组；组内平均注意力权重、组间取最大值，使任一约束强使用的缓存条目获得高分；在内存预算下做单次 top-k 选择，保持 key/value/位置不变。理论上，在固定 query 分组与等条目代价下，该选择最小化"最差组被丢弃注意力"的可加上界。各候选独立执行，无需重训或额外生成。

Result: 在 4 个 AR 视频骨干、3 个基准、5/30/60 秒生成上评测。Causal Forcing 骨干、压缩率 0.7 时 VBench Total 为 84.10，对比最强压缩基线 84.05、Full KV 83.99；相对 Full KV 加速 1.22×，KV cache 显存从 6.04 GB 降至 1.81 GB（3.35× 缩减）。

Conclusion: 将 planner 语义约束注入 KV cache 淘汰准则，可在几乎不掉点的条件下显著降低 agentic 视频生成的显存与延迟，且免训练、即插即用，为长时程生成的可扩展性提供轻量方案。

Abstract: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

</details>


### [158] [ForeAct: Geometry-Guided Action Learning from World Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11500)
*Wei Lu,Jiaxi Zhang,Yunheng Wang,Taowen Wang,Yuetong Fang,Zhenhui Zhang,Shuning Zhang,Zizhao Yuan,Yixiao Feng,Zecui Zeng,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ForeAct 将预训练视频世界模型改造为单次前向（single-pass）表示骨干用于低延迟机器人控制：跳过未来帧合成与迭代去噪，仅处理当前观测的干净 latent；并用可学习 token 通过下一帧相对深度监督，经双向自注意力把几何知识注入共享视频表示，训练后移除轻量几何读出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）依赖扩散/整流流迭代推理，计算开销大且表示缺乏显式空间结构；显式几何建模通常需辅助几何模块，增加参数量与算力；几何中心策略只恢复当前观测空间结构，缺少对交互中未来几何变化的显式监督。作者希望用单一骨干同时获得时空动态先验与几何感知，且无需深度输入或外部几何骨干。

Method: 把预训练视频世界模型当作单程表示骨干，直接在一步前向中编码当前观测的干净 latent，不做未来帧生成与迭代去噪。在共享表示上引入可学习 token，以"下一帧相对深度"为监督信号，通过双向自注意力塑造视频表示；仅训练期使用轻量几何读出模块，部署时移除。动作生成直接基于该未来感知表示。

Result: 未使用额外大规模预训练：LIBERO 平均成功率 96.6%，SimplerEnv-Bridge 63.5%，90 次真实世界 rollout 成功率 74.4%。

Conclusion: 通过复用视频世界模型先验并以未来相对深度作为轻量几何监督，可在几乎不增加参数与延迟的情况下获得几何感知、未来感知的动作表示；该接口在仿真与真机均取得有竞争力结果，说明"单程表示 + 训练期几何探针"是可替代重迭代世界动作模型与独立几何骨干的实用路线。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires representations that capture both scene geometry and its evolution during interaction. Existing approaches have largely treated these two aspects separately. World action models capture such dynamics by coupling action prediction with future video generation, but their reliance on iterative diffusion or rectified-flow inference leads to high computational cost, while their representations lack explicit spatial structure. Explicitly modeling scene geometry typically requires auxiliary modules that increase both parameter count and computational cost. Conversely, geometry-centric policies primarily recover observed spatial structure and often lack explicit supervision for anticipating future geometric changes during interaction. To address these limitations, we introduce ForeAct, which repurposes a pretrained video world model as a single-pass representation backbone for low-latency control. ForeAct directly processes the clean latent of the current observation in one forward pass, eliminating future-frame synthesis and iterative denoising while retaining the backbone's pretrained spatiotemporal priors. Rather than introducing a separate geometry backbone, ForeAct uses learnable tokens supervised by next-frame relative depth to shape the shared video representation through bidirectional self-attention. This compact interface turns the spatial knowledge already encoded in the backbone into a future-aware representation for action generation, with little parameter overhead. The lightweight geometry readout is used only during training and removed at deployment, enabling low-latency, geometry-aware control without depth input or an external geometry backbone. Without additional large-scale pretraining, ForeAct achieves 96.6% average success on LIBERO, 63.5% on SimplerEnv-Bridge, and a 74.4% success rate across 90 real-world rollouts.

</details>


### [159] [AgentCT: A Vision-Language Agent for Universal CT Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11503)
*Zhihao Chen,Qi Gao,Chuang Niu,Qiegen Liu,Yi Zhang,Hongming Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AgentCT：用LoRA微调的Qwen3-VL-4B作为视觉语言控制器，识别CT退化类型与严重程度并路由到专用修复模型（LDCT扩散模型；SVCT/MAR为投影域校正+数据一致性+可微FBP+图像精修）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低剂量CT、稀疏视角CT与金属伪影的退化物理机制不同，现有方法常用单一网络统一处理，难以兼顾各任务特性。

Method: 视觉语言智能体框架：控制器预测退化类型（95.7%）与严重程度（93.9%），选择专家模型并在修复后复评；LDCT专家为图像域扩散模型，SVCT/MAR专家为投影域双域流程（校正+数据一致性+可微FBP+图像细化）。

Result: Mayo 2020腹部CT患者不交叉评估：使用真值标签路由时整体PSNR/SSIM 46.18 dB/0.984，优于AMIR（44.93/0.976）与TAMP（44.29/0.979），九个设置全部最优；SVCT双域专家以4.2M参数达46.04 dB，优于AMIR单任务（44.43 dB）与全一体（43.57 dB，23.5M参数）。

Conclusion: 支持“退化特异+控制器选模”的CT修复范式；但自动路由端到端评测与独立临床数据验证尚待完成。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) restoration methods often use a single network for low-dose CT (LDCT), sparse-view CT (SVCT), and metal artifact reduction (MAR), despite the distinct physics of these degradations. We propose AgentCT, a vision-language agent that identifies the degradation and routes images to task-specific restoration models. A LoRA-adapted Qwen3-VL-4B controller predicts degradation type and severity, selects a specialist, and reassesses the restored image. The LDCT specialist uses an image-domain diffusion model, whereas the SVCT and MAR specialists combine projection-domain correction, data consistency, differentiable filtered back-projection, and image refinement. We evaluated the controller and specialists separately on patient-disjoint Mayo 2020 abdominal CT data across three severity levels for each degradation. The controller achieved 95.7% accuracy for degradation type and 93.9% for severity, with a 100% JSON parse rate. Using ground-truth degradation labels for routing, AgentCT achieved an overall PSNR/SSIM of 46.18 dB/0.984, compared with 44.93 dB/0.976 for AMIR and 44.29 dB/0.979 for TAMP, and attained the highest PSNR in all nine settings. For SVCT, its dual-domain specialist achieved 46.04 dB with 4.2 million parameters, compared with 44.43 dB for single-task AMIR and 43.57 dB for all-in-one AMIR with 23.5 million parameters. These results support degradation-specific CT restoration with controller-based model selection; evaluation under automatic routing and on independent clinical data remains necessary. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [160] [Reaching Is Not Finding: Map-Anchored Visual Prompting for the Last Mile of Aerial Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11510)
*Ningbo Li,Kebin Liu,Jingcan Chen,Weichen Zhang,Rong Ding,Yunhao Liu,Mo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAP-VP：即插即用模块，用地图地标轮廓在无人机当前视图上叠加标注，再由微调4B VLM完成"最后一步"目标定位，无需重训导航器，HETT成功率25.9%→54.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中VLN导航器（从模仿学习到7B VLM微调）普遍只学到"到达地标"，而非"识别被描述目标"，导致停在目标附近却找不到目标；替换指令中目标物体后导航行为几乎不变即为证据。

Method: MAP-VP：任意导航器停止后，利用benchmark提供的地图地标轮廓，将指令中命名的地标投影/绘制到无人机当前视角图像上；再用一个微调4B VLM据此在视图中定位目标相对地标的位置。训练数据由benchmark标注自动生成，无需修改或重训导航器。

Result: 在CityNav上，对六个导航器均有显著提升；HETT由25.9%提升至54.6%，FlightGPT由24.2%提升至48.9%（约翻倍）；而CityNav官方基于检测器的最后一步对HETT仅提升不到2个点。消融显示单独绘制地标或单独微调效果有限，二者结合才高效。

Conclusion: 空中VLN的瓶颈在末端目标指认而非路径规划；通过显式地标几何先验+轻量VLM重定位的模块化"最后一步"可低成本、可插拔地大幅提升现有导航器性能。

Abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) asks a drone to find an object described in natural language. The description usually locates the object relative to named landmarks, such as streets and buildings. We observe that current navigators often bring the drone close to the target and then stop at the wrong place: they reach the target without finding it. This gap is shared by navigators of very different designs, from imitation learners to a fine-tuned 7B vision-language model. A simple test reveals the cause. When we replace the target object in the instruction with another one next to the same landmarks, no navigator goes to it, and most stop where they did before. Navigators learn to reach the landmarks, not to identify the described object. We therefore propose MAP-VP, a plug-and-play module for the last step. After any navigator stops, MAP-VP draws the landmarks named in the instruction onto the drone's current view, using the landmark outlines that the benchmark provides on a map. A fine-tuned 4B vision-language model then locates the target relative to these landmarks. The training data are generated automatically from the benchmark annotations. Neither drawing the landmarks nor fine-tuning helps much alone, but together they are highly effective. Without retraining any navigator, MAP-VP significantly improves all six navigators we test on CityNav. It roughly doubles the success rate of the two strongest trained navigators, raising HETT from 25.9% to 54.6% and FlightGPT from 24.2% to 48.9%, whereas CityNav's official detector-based last step adds less than two points to HETT.

</details>


### [161] [InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11517)
*Yude Zou,Yifei Yao,Yiwei Hao,Hanqing Wang,Xing Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首字母限制已消失。论文提出闭链规划-控制协同学习框架 InfCoiL，通过共享形态接口连接形态感知的 flow-matching 规划器与统一多形态控制器，并用 SFPO 对生成规划器做在线强化微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本/目标条件HOI需要生成式规划器与物理控制器协作，但现有系统要么开环执行，要么闭环时保持规划器固定，执行反馈无法改变规划内容。

Method: 形态感知 flow-matching 规划器与统一多形态控制器经共享形态接口组成自回归 plan-and-execute 闭环；二者用同一物理 rollout 的 RL 交替微调；提出 SFPO，对选定去噪转移做随机化，在异构 HOI 特征上构造通道级语义协方差，并基于完整闭环执行给予组相对、序列级奖励。

Result: 在留出的 OMOMO 序列上，目标达成任务成功率与物理跟踪精度均优于开环分层基线。

Conclusion: 闭环反馈重建规划是提升物理 HOI 可执行性的关键，SFPO 为 flow-matching 规划器提供了可用的在线 RL 优化手段。

Abstract: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [162] [Dropping Tokens Without Dropping Them: Causal Attribution for Diabetic Retinopathy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11547)
*Pramath Girish Haritz,Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作将视觉Transformer的注意力分解为满足完整性公理的贡献图 $c_t$ 与量化因果解释的 pull 图 $p_t$，在糖尿病视网膜病变分类任务上验证 $p_t$ 的因果忠实性显著优于 Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM 与 AttnLRP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究ViT中基于注意力的归因图是否真正提供因果解释，区分"完备性"与"因果忠实性"两种解释性质，为安全关键医疗诊断提供可靠的可解释性工具。

Method: 提出注意力分解为贡献 $c_t$（满足xAI完整性公理）和 pull $p_t$（因果解释量），给出刻画 $c_t$ 失效条件的恒等式；在 MAPLES-DR 数据集上通过 token 删除/插入实验，报告 Necessity、Sufficiency 与 Faithfulness Correlation 三项指标。

Result: $p_t$ 取得最佳因果对齐（FC=0.53, N=0.71%, Su=3.0%），优于 Attention Rollout、Grad-CAM、AttnLRP；遮挡法充分性更优（Su=1.6%）但慢约800倍；$p_t$ 在无像素级监督下达到 HRDecoder 病灶分割平均精度（AP）的70%。

Conclusion: $c_t$ 与 $p_t$ 共同构成计算高效且因果可靠的归因图，适用于安全关键医疗诊断的可解释性需求。

Abstract: In this work, we investigate whether attention-based attribution maps in a vision transformer provide causal explanations for diabetic retinopathy (DR) classification. We introduce a principled decomposition of attention into two attribution maps: the contribution ($c_t$), which satisfies the completeness axiom in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), and the pull ($p_t$), which quantifies causal explanations. We define an identity relating $c_t$ and $p_t$ that characterizes when $c_t$ fails to capture causality. We test whether each map is causally faithful on the MAPLES-DR dataset by dropping/inserting tokens, and report Necessity ($N$), Sufficiency ($Su$), and Faithfulness Correlation ($FC$). The pull $p_t$ achieves the highest causal alignment ($FC = 0.53$, $N = 0.71\%$, $Su = 3.0\%$), outperforming Attention Rollout, Grad-CAM, and AttnLRP. Occlusion retains better sufficiency ($Su = 1.6\%$) but is about 800 times slower. Furthermore, on MAPLES-DR, $p_t$ achieves $70\%$ of the average precision (AP) of HRDecoder, a state-of-the-art supervised lesion segmentation model, despite the absence of pixel-level supervision. Together, these findings show that the pull $p_t$ and the contribution $c_t$ form computationally efficient attribution maps for reliable causal interpretation in safety-critical medical diagnostics. The code and demo are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [163] [NightSteps: A Night-Time Dataset and Benchmark for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11583)
*Sjoerd Takken,Shaodi You*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NightSteps：基于全球六城市夜间行车记录仪视频构建的夜间/低光行人过街意图预测(PCIP)基准数据集，含点视角视频、带track id的行人位置原始数据与过街行为真值标签，并用Gemini、ChatGPT与人工评估验证可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PCIP模型多在光照充足的白天条件下训练，因缺少夜间数据，其在夜间与低光场景下的鲁棒性未知；而夜间行人是道路安全的关键风险场景。

Method: 采集六个城市的夜间行车记录仪视频，构建含POV视频、行人位置原始数据与track id、以及精确过街行为真值的NightSteps数据集；以Gemini、ChatGPT和人工标注在数据片段上做过街预测并与初始真值比对，作为基线评测。

Result: 人工评估准确率88.17%、F1 80.21%；Gemini准确率60%、F1 42.50%；ChatGPT准确率79.13%、F1 63.64%，二者均低于人工水平。

Conclusion: NightSteps可作为夜间PCIP的基线评测数据集，用于后续模型鲁棒性评估，目标是提升夜间道路安全；但论文本身未提出新的PCIP方法。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles use pedestrian crossing intention prediction (PCIP) to participate safely in traffic. Existing models are largely trained under favourable daytime conditions with sufficient daylight. Little is known about the robustness of these models under night-time and low-light conditions, due to the lack of datasets containing night-time footage. This paper investigates how a dataset, named NightSteps, can be constructed and evaluated as a baseline benchmark. The dataset is based on nighttime dashcam footage collected from six different cities around the world, capturing a wide variety of road conditions. The dataset consists of dashcam-recorded point-of-view footage, raw data of pedestrians' locations with corresponding 'track ids' and ground-truth labels containing accurate information about pedestrian crossing behaviour, resulting in a diverse dataset. Gemini, ChatGPT, and human assessment are used to demonstrate the usability of the dataset by predicting crossings in clips from the dataset and comparing the results with the initial ground-truth labels. These results show that human input achieves an accuracy of 88.17% and an F1-score of 80.21%. Predictions from Gemini and ChatGPT perform lower, with accuracies of 60% and 79.13% respectively, and F1-scores of 42.50% and 63.64%. The evaluation demonstrates that the NightSteps dataset can be used for future model evaluation to test the performance of PCIP, with the aim of improving road safety at night.

</details>


### [164] [FastGRT: Accelerating Training of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11586)
*Meet Banthia,Xiaoteng Liu,Hexu Zhao,Aurojit Panda,Jinyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FastGRT通过解耦光线遍历与混合、复用前向计算于反向传播、快速梯度累积和混合BVH更新策略，将基于高斯的体渲染训练加速1.9–4.97倍，并给出首个支持训练与渲染的Vulkan实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于高斯的Ray Tracing（GRT）能实现光栅化方法（如3DGS）难以达到的渲染效果，但其训练开销远高于3DGS，限制了实用性。作者希望从GPU执行与计算组织层面找出训练瓶颈。

Method: 分析GPU上GRT的执行过程，定位计算组织（而非算法本身）为开销主因。FastGRT：(1) 解耦光线遍历与颜色混合；(2) 在前向中保存中间结果供反向复用，避免重复遍历；(3) 快速梯度累积；(4) 混合BVH更新策略处理更新瓶颈。基于Vulkan实现。

Result: 相较3DGRT，训练时间缩短1.9×–4.97×，同时保持原始渲染公式不变；为已知首个支持训练的Vulkan GRT实现，代码开源。

Conclusion: GRT训练成本很大程度上源于计算组织方式，通过解耦遍历与混合、复用前向计算及系统级优化可获数倍加速，且不牺牲渲染正确性。

Abstract: Ray Tracing enables rendering capabilities that are difficult to achieve with rasterization-based approaches such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, the training cost of Gaussian-based ray tracing (GRT) is much higher than that of 3DGS. In this paper, we study how ray tracing using Gaussians executes on GPUs and show that a considerable fraction of the training cost arises from how the computation is organized. We develop FastGRT, which decouples ray traversal from blending and reuses work done in the forward pass for the backward pass. FastGRT further incorporates optimizations such as fast gradient accumulation and a hybrid BVH update strategy to tackle other major bottlenecks in the training pipeline. We implement FastGRT in Vulkan. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first Vulkan-based GRT implementation that supports both training and rendering. Compared to 3DGRT, FastGRT improves training time by 1.9$\times$ to 4.97$\times$, while preserving the original rendering formulation. Our code is open source.

</details>


### [165] [Martine: Benchmarking Multi-View 3D Surface Reconstruction Across Viewpoint Coverage, Resolution, and Lighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11602)
*Robin Bruneau,Baptiste Brument,Frederic Giraud,Bastian Sigrist,Sascha Jecklin,Philipp Fürnstahl,Bjoern Menze,Lilian Calvet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Martine 基准：28 个含透明材质与精细结构的物体，84 视角球冠采集、9568×6376 分辨率、单光源与多光源两种光照，配独立相机标定、精确 GT 扫描、量化图像-几何对齐及材质/可见性/曲率/精细结构属性掩膜，用于受控多视角表面重建的规范化评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有受控采集类基准常限制视角覆盖、分辨率或光照条件，导致比较偏向特定设定下的方法；且缺乏精确 3D GT 与量化的图像-几何对齐，难以进行度量级表面评估。重建精度同时依赖重建范式、物体属性与采集条件，需要可解耦这些因素的基准。

Method: 构建 Martine 数据集（28 物体、84 视角、球冠分布、单/多光源），提供与物体无关的相机标定、3D GT 扫描与测试图像上的对齐精度量化、属性掩膜；横向评测摄影测量、经典 MVS、神经隐式表面、Gaussian Splatting 重建与多视角光度立体五类范式，并按光照/材质/曲率分层分析误差。

Result: 可分辨亚毫米级重建差异，在评估的可见表面上最佳 Chamfer 距离为 0.058 mm；实现具备参考数据精度显式控制的"采集条件感知"评测。

Conclusion: Martine 为受控多视角 3D 物体表面重建提供了高分辨率、多光照、带精确 GT 与属性标注的评测平台，支持按范式与采集条件解耦比较，适合作为表面重建精度评测的参考基准。

Abstract: Controlled acquisition setups are widely used for high-accuracy multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, as they allow sensor configuration, image resolution, viewpoint distribution, and illumination to be specified. Yet benchmarking remains difficult, since reconstruction accuracy depends jointly on the reconstruction paradigm, object properties, and acquisition regime. Existing benchmarks often restrict viewpoint coverage, resolution, or illumination, which can bias comparisons towards methods suited to the chosen setting. Others lack accurate 3D ground truth or quantified image-to-geometry alignment, limiting their use for metric surface evaluation. We introduce Martine, a benchmark for controlled 3D object surface reconstruction. Martine comprises 28 objects, including transparent materials and fine structures, captured at 9568 x 6376 pixels from 84 views over a spherical cap under both single-light and multi-light regimes. It provides object-independent camera calibration, accurate 3D ground-truth scans, calibration and image-to-geometry accuracy quantified on test images, and 3D property masks for analysing errors by material properties, visibility, curvature and fine structures. Experiments across photogrammetry, classical multi-view stereo, neural implicit surfaces, Gaussian-splatting-based reconstruction, and multi-view photometric stereo show that Martine enables regime-aware evaluation with explicit control over reference-data accuracy. The benchmark resolves sub-millimetric reconstruction differences, with a best observed Chamfer distance of 0.058 mm over the evaluated visible surface.

</details>


### [166] [Rethinking Geometric Depth in Monocular 3D Object Detection: A Projection-Consistent Reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11607)
*Zhihao Zhang,Abhinav Kumar,Huaizhi Qu,Tianlong Chen,Xiaoming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MonoPCA揭示单目3D检测中 z≈f·H/h_2D 公式存在系统性前表面偏差（恢复的是可见前表面深度而非中心深度），提出PCDepth投影一致重表述与GeoAlign教师-学生几何表征迁移框架，在四个基准上取得SoTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典几何式 z≈f·H/h_2D 用2D框高替代物体高度，实际恢复的是可见前表面深度而非物体中心深度，导致与尺寸相关的系统性低估，即使在真值输入下仍存在。作者希望消除这一由投影假设引入的偏差，而不引入病态回归目标。

Method: 提出MonoPCA统一框架：核心PCDepth保留可测量的h_2D，基于透视几何推导与朝向、尺寸相关的校正项，将前表面深度映射到中心深度；由于该校正耦合预测的物体尺寸与朝向，进一步提出GeoAlign——教师-学生框架，将视觉基础模型（VFM）中的几何表征蒸馏到轻量学生网络，增强属性感知且不增加推理开销。

Result: 在四个挑战性基准上达到SoTA；KITTI排行榜AP_3D提升+1.44%，Omni3D_OUT提升+2.80%。

Conclusion: 单目3D检测中的前表面深度偏差是可建模、可校正的系统性问题；通过投影一致的几何重表述配合几何先验蒸馏，可在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升深度与3D框精度。

Abstract: Monocular 3D detection (Mono3D) hinges on recovering depth from a single image, for which the geometric formulation $z \approx f \cdot H / h_{2D}$ is widely adopted due to its simplicity and direct grounding in projective geometry. We show that this formulation harbors a systematic, projection-induced bias: substituting the 2D bounding-box height $h_{2D}$ recovers the depth of an object's visible front surface rather than its center, causing size-dependent underestimation that persists even under ground-truth inputs. We address this front-surface bias with MonoPCA, a unified framework built on a projection-consistent reformulation. At its core, PCDepth retains the measurable $h_{2D}$ and closes the gap to center depth through an orientation- and size-aware correction derived from perspective geometry, eliminating the bias without introducing ill-posed regression targets. Because PCDepth couples depth to predicted object size and orientation, attribute perception becomes essential. We therefore introduce GeoAlign, a teacher-student framework that transfers geometric representations from Vision Foundation Models into a lightweight student, strengthening attribute perception at no inference cost. Across four challenging benchmarks, MonoPCA achieves SoTA performance, including a +1.44% AP$_{3D}$ gain on the KITTI leaderboard and +2.80% on Omni3D$_{OUT}$. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [167] [MICE: Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder - A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Mouse Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11644)
*Yen-Shuo Su,Weihan Li,Anqi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MICE，一个面向小鼠行为的多动物交互上下文编码器基础模型，联合在六个小鼠姿态数据集上预训练，用分层个体编码器+Perceiver式社会编码器支持任意动物数量，单一权重适配1-4只小鼠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督姿态模型独立编码每只动物、丢弃交互信号、硬编码动物数量、且一次只在一个数据集上预训练，无法处理攻击、求偶、爬跨、异体理毛等本质多动物行为。

Method: 分层架构：个体编码器在多时间尺度上建模单鼠运动学；社会编码器采用Perceiver式结构，通过学习到的潜在码本将参数量与动物数量解耦，实现任意群体规模共享单一检查点。六个姿态语料联合预训练，覆盖1-4只小鼠、7-27个关键点。

Result: 在六个数据集、四种评测协议上与既有基于关键点的基线持平或更优；逐层探针实验显示社会编码阶段在个体编码器基础上进一步增量提升特征可判别性。

Conclusion: MICE为多动物姿态行为建模提供了可扩展、群体规模无关的自监督基础模型范式，代码权重数据均已开源。

Abstract: Quantifying mouse behavior from pose is a foundational tool in neuroscience, ethology, drug discovery, and animal welfare. Self-supervised foundation models are a natural fit, but a foundation model for mouse behavior must handle social behavior - many behaviors that matter (aggression, courtship, mounting, allogrooming) are inherently multi-animal. Existing self-supervised pose models fall short: they encode each animal independently and discard interaction signal, hard-code the animal count, and pretrain one dataset at a time. We introduce MICE (Multi-animal Interaction Context Encoder), a hierarchical foundation model for mouse behavior that pretrains jointly on six mouse-pose corpora spanning one to four mice and 7 to 27 keypoints. MICE combines a hierarchical individual encoder capturing per-mouse kinematics at multiple temporal scales with a Perceiver-style social encoder whose learned latent codebook decouples parameter count from animal count, so a single checkpoint serves any group size without retraining. Across four evaluation protocols spanning six datasets, MICE matches or exceeds prior keypoint-based baselines, and layer-wise probing shows the social stage incrementally improves discriminability beyond the individual encoder. Code, weights, and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [168] [SurfScaff3D: Bridging Geometric and Semantic Representations for LLM-based 3D Object Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11678)
*Anay Loya,Rishi Gupta,Arnav Samal,Anirban Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HPS（分层补丁脚手架）以语义化、可解释的部件级B样条补丁表示3D，兼容LLM原生推理；基于此构建SurfScaff3D，实现免微调的可编辑文本/图像到3D生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D内容创作门槛高；LLM原生推理与传统3D参数化（网格/隐式/Nerf）不匹配，现有方法依赖昂贵微调或强结构先验（牺牲表达力、排除有机形体）。作者认为该表示失配是LLM驱动3D生成的核心瓶颈。

Method: 提出Hierarchical Patch Scaffold表示：分层、部件级的B样条补丁集合，附带语义标签，既被人也易被LLM理解；利用基础模型开放世界能力生成补丁布局，以补丁为接口生成3D；支持逐补丁表面细节控制与任意粒度自然语言局部编辑，无需重跑生成。框架SurfScaff3D支持文本与图像条件输入。

Result: 与SOTA LLM-based 3D生成方法对比，在多类物体上展示更强的几何保真度、语义对齐与灵活编辑能力（摘要未给出定量指标）。

Conclusion: 以语义化部件级补丁表示弥合LLM与3D参数化之间的鸿沟，可在免微调条件下实现开放域、可编辑、高表达的3D生成，为LLM原生3D创作提供可行范式。

Abstract: Creating high-quality 3D content has traditionally required specialist expertise and experience with complex tools. The growing ecosystem of AI-assisted creativity demands accessible and intuitive 3D generation systems. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising directions, yet extending their generative capabilities to 3D remains fundamentally challenging because existing 3D representations are not naturally compatible with language-based reasoning. Current approaches either depend on expensive fine-tuning or impose restrictive structural priors that sacrifice expressiveness and exclude organic shapes. We argue that the mismatch between LLM-native reasoning and conventional 3D parameterizations is a core bottleneck of LLM-driven 3D generation. To address this, we introduce the Hierarchical Patch Scaffold (HPS), a representation designed around semantically meaningful, interpretable part-level abstractions that are naturally understood by both humans and LLMs, enabling expressive, editable, and open-domain 3D generation without imposing restrictive geometric priors or expensive fine-tuning. Building upon HPS, we introduce SurfScaff3D, an interactive framework for text and image-to-3D generation. HPS inherits the flexibility of B-spline patches, while exposing an interface that leverages open-world capabilities of foundation models to reliably generate 3D. Its hierarchical part-level semantic labels enable targeted, natural-language edits at any level of granularity without re-running generation. Further, HPS offers explicit per-patch control over surface detail, enabling more expressive geometry capable of representing arbitrary objects. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art LLM-based 3D generation methods demonstrate strong geometric fidelity, semantic alignment, and flexible editing across diverse object categories.

</details>


### [169] [LocateAnyMesh: Grounding 3D Mesh Queries in 2D Images with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11692)
*Chris Choy,Zhiding Yu,Jan Kautz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LocateAnyMesh 将纹理网格本身作为提示输入，用冻结 3D 编码器把彩色表面点编码为 token，与图像、指令 token 一起送入视觉语言模型做图像内目标定位（LAM-Select 选区域提案，LAM-Direct 直接回归坐标）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在图像中找某个特定 3D 资产时，渲染查询视图再匹配模板既昂贵又受视角/光照影响；希望直接用网格几何+外观作为查询表示，实现免渲染、免逐物体微调的泛化定位。

Method: 提出 PPAT 网格 token 化：冻结 3D 编码器处理点云彩色表面点，经可学习 connector 压缩为紧凑 token 序列，与图文指令 token 拼接。两种接地模型：LAM-Select 在候选区域提案上做选择；LAM-Direct 直接预测坐标。均无需渲染查询视图或模板匹配，新物体仅需一次编码前向。

Result: LAM-Select 在所用真实图像数据集及官方 BOP YCB-V 评测上提升定位性能；消融比较了不同 3D 网格编码器，并用 LAM-Direct 研究表面颜色作用；单种子继续实验提供指向与仅网格描述的初步证据。

Conclusion: 网格 token 可作为有效的查询表示；局限在于存在性判定、身份绑定、提案覆盖度与描述保真度。

Abstract: Textured 3D meshes specify object geometry and appearance, making them a natural query for finding a particular asset in an image. We introduce LocateAnyMesh, a vision-language model that uses the mesh itself as part of its prompt. A frozen 3D encoder maps colored surface points to a compact token sequence, which a learned connector places alongside image and instruction tokens. We evaluate two grounding models with PPAT mesh tokens: LAM-Select selects image-region proposals, while LAM-Direct predicts coordinates directly. Neither requires rendered query views or view-template matching. New objects require a single encoder pass and no object-specific fine-tuning. LAM-Select improves localization on the reported real-image suites and the official BOP YCB-V evaluation. Secondary experiments compare mesh encoders, and a LAM-Direct study isolates surface color. A single-seed LAM-Select continuation supplies pointing and mesh-only description evidence without replacing the reported localization model. The results support mesh tokens as a query representation, with remaining limitations in presence decisions, identity binding, proposal coverage, and descriptive fidelity.

</details>


### [170] [SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11697)
*Jiaxin Guo,Wenzhen Dong,Taoyu Wu,Haomin Kuang,Mengya Xu,Kejian Shi,Ziyi Wang,Tongfan Guan,Mingkai Jia,Yue Wang,Qi Dou,Yun-Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgTAP-3D：大规模活体手术伪3D运动跟踪数据集与基准（520K帧、4,549段动作、1.4M条2D/3D点轨迹），并提出统一的术中3D点跟踪标注框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术（MIS）3D场景动态理解是物理智能与自主手术系统的基础，但现有公开数据集在真实临床场景下规模与多样性不足，且标注通常只针对组织或器械之一，忽略器械-组织交互，难以支撑VLA模型与世界模型所需的大规模高质量3D监督。

Method: 构建SurgTAP-3D数据集，覆盖机器人辅助与手工手术、统一动作类别；设计可扩展的自动标注流水线：接触区域提示（contact-region prompting）→ 活动器械分割 → 动态光束法平差（dynamic bundle adjustment）→ 全局4D精化，将未标定单目手术视频转为结构化4D标注，输出时序一致轨迹、伪尺度几何、相机位姿与器械掩码；并适配手术视频上的基础模型先验。

Result: 数据涵盖遮挡、烟雾、出血、器械快速运动等真实挑战；在SurgPose、SurgT、STIR上建立覆盖器械与组织跟踪的综合基准，并验证器械位移估计、可变形表面重建与基础模型微调；实验显示该数据集与标注框架在3D手术点跟踪、重建和手术动作理解上有效。

Conclusion: 该工作通过规模化伪3D标注缓解手术域3D监督稀缺问题，为术中器械-组织交互建模及VLA/世界模型训练提供数据基础与基准，但标注为伪尺度、非真实度量几何。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: this https URL

</details>


### [171] [Correctness Metric Matters: NWD-Based Calibration Loss for Tiny Person Detection in UAV Infrared Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11735)
*Tian Zhang,Zhirong Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文指出UAV红外小目标检测中，基于IoU硬阈值的二值预测校准(BPC)目标在几何上病态，提出用连续、尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离(NWD)替代IoU作为校准目标，降低LaECE且mAP不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有校准损失沿用框回归的correctness定义（IoU对硬阈值），而UAV红外图像中人占画面<0.1\%。相同像素误差随目标变小被罚更重，导致BPC反而压低本应高的置信度，LaECE在HIT-UAV上反而变差。

Method: 将BPC的IoU校正目标替换为连续、尺度不变的归一化Wasserstein距离(NWD)，作为置信度校准的几何度量；并用中心偏移锚点实验验证增益来自几何校正而非其他因素；另考察在NWD之上叠加验证集拟合的保序回归(isotonic)映射的叠加效应，并界定方法边界（目标-背景热配对、逐图检测数异质性下的检测级聚合）。

Result: HIT-UAV上BPC+IoU使LaECE在Low/Mid/High SCR组分别由0.0689→0.0761、0.0649→0.0733、0.0653→0.0682恶化；NWD目标在三组上均显著降低LaECE(p<1e-7)，mAP基本持平(0.9356 vs 0.9347)，在较宽的校准权重平台上稳定，且推理时无需映射层；叠加isotonic映射可进一步降低校准误差，两种修正作用于同一误差的不同成分。

Conclusion: 校准目标应与尺度不变几何度量对齐，IoU阈值化目标对小目标病态；NWD是有效的度量级修正，但无法覆盖训练分布的目标-背景热配对与检测级聚合问题。

Abstract: Detection calibration aligns predicted confidence with empirical correctness. Existing calibration losses inherit their correctness definition from box regression, specifically IoU against a hard threshold. We show that this target is geometrically ill-posed for tiny objects in UAV infrared imagery, where persons occupy less than 0.1\% of the image. The same pixel error is penalized more heavily as the target shrinks, so binary prediction calibration (BPC) actively suppresses confidences that should be high. On HIT-UAV, BPC with an IoU target degrades image-level localization-aware ECE (LaECE) from 0.0689 to 0.0761, 0.0649 to 0.0733, and 0.0653 to 0.0682 across Low, Mid, and High signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) groups. We replace the IoU target with a continuous, scale-invariant normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD). The NWD target reduces LaECE\(_{\mathrm{NWD}}\) relative to BPC+IoU on all three groups (\(p<10^{-7}\)) with mAP neutral (0.9356 vs.\ 0.9347), and an independent center-offset anchor confirms that the gain is a genuine geometric correction. The improvement holds across a broad plateau of calibration weights. The NWD formulation requires no inference-time mapping layer. If a validation-fitted isotonic map is applied on top of it, calibration is lowered further, and the two corrections act on different components of the same error. The metric-level remedy has a measurable boundary. Target-background thermal pairing in the training distribution and detection-level aggregation under per-image detection-count heterogeneity lie outside it. Both are quantified independently of the NWD target.

</details>


### [172] [Dense Flow from Adaptive Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11738)
*Cheng-Lin Hsieh,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FATE 将匹配尺度与流分辨率解耦：用自适应 token 支持区（区域内扩张、运动边界处收缩）做匹配，再通过共享的像素- token 关联重建稠密光流，无需分组标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如 WAFT）在相同粗网格上匹配并估计流，再靠学习式上采样恢复稠密流，匹配所需的视觉支撑与稠密流重建之间缺乏显式联系；而稠密像素级流并不需要同等稠密的匹配。

Method: 提出 Flow from Adaptive Token Estimation (FATE)：依据图像结构自适应调整空间支持区的大小与形状，token 支持区在连贯区域内扩展、在运动边界附近收缩；共享的像素到 token 关联既用于特征池化以匹配，又用于从 token 运动重建像素流；流监督联合训练像素分组、token 匹配与流估计，无需分组标注，使模型仅凭外观即可预判哪些像素倾向一起运动。

Result: 在 FlyingChairs/FlyingThings3D 上训练后，FATE 在 Sintel Final 与 KITTI 上取得最佳零样本精度；在可见像素上连贯区域内精度提升，运动边界附近提升更大；最大增益来自无直接匹配的位置——遮挡或出界像素约占有效像素 10%，却占 WAFT 总误差约 50%。

Conclusion: 通过像素-to-token 分组的自适应对应关系，可在保证匹配可靠性的同时获得精确像素级光流，并提升对未见真实场景的泛化能力。

Abstract: Optical flow requires reliable matching from sufficient visual context and precise motion at every pixel. Existing methods such as WAFT match and estimate flow on the same coarse grids, then recover dense flow through learned upsampling, without explicitly linking visual support for matching to dense flow reconstruction. Our key insight is that dense pixel-level flow does not require equally dense matching. We decouple correspondence scale from flow resolution by adapting the size and shape of spatial supports to image structure for reliable matching, while reusing these supports for precise dense flow reconstruction. We realize this in Flow from Adaptive Token Estimation (FATE), whose token supports expand within coherent regions and contract near motion boundaries. Shared pixel-to-token associations pool features for matching and reconstruct pixel flow from token motions. Flow supervision jointly trains pixel grouping, token matching, and flow estimation without grouping labels, allowing FATE to anticipate which pixels are likely to move together from appearance alone. Trained on FlyingChairs/FlyingThings3D, FATE achieves the highest zero-shot accuracy on Sintel Final and KITTI, a critical setting given scarce real-world flow labels. For visible pixels, FATE improves accuracy within coherent regions, and more near motion boundaries. Its largest gains occur where direct matches are unavailable: Occluded or out-of-frame pixels account for roughly 10% of valid pixels but 50% of WAFT's total error. Experiments show that adaptive correspondence through pixel-to-token grouping enables reliable matching and precise pixel-level flow, improving generalization to unseen real scenes.

</details>


### [173] [GeoPilot: Diagnosis-Guided Interventions and Geometric Evaluation for Aerial Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11751)
*Pengyu Yin,Jie Pan,Junxiang Tan,Mengqi Fu,Kun Cheng,Yifan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoPilot：用LLM把诊断结论转化为可执行的摄影测量/相机配置干预（如共享内参、固定已知相机），由数值工具重建网格、外部评估器在明确坐标与参考协议下评估几何；在Metashape航空影像上共享内参降低平均面到参考距离7.04%，固定发布相机降低12.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空遥感的网格重建与参考几何不一致时，缺少"该改什么"的诊断依据；作者希望把重建诊断与先验观测闭环为可执行的程序或相机配置变更。

Method: LLM提出配置变更 → 数值工具（Metashape）重建 → 外部评估器在指定坐标系与参考协议下量化几何误差。主实验检验预注册的"共享内参"假设：224张开发影像上比较六项原生坐标度量；另做参考辅助对齐实验（棋盘格样本分离拟合/评估）、发布级去畸变影像上的匹配对照（固定发布相机 vs 其他配置），以及第二场景327张影像的三次端到端运行。

Result: 共享内参在六项度量上全部改善，平均面-参考距离降7.04%；但参考辅助对齐在独立棋盘格样本上反转了平均距离排序，收益限于原生坐标系交付。去畸变影像上固定发布相机在六项度量上全面占优，平均距离降12.11%（该相机保留上游影像与激光扫描平差信息）。三次端到端运行均产出网格与六度量评估。

Conclusion: 提供一种可执行、可评估的"诊断—干预—度量"摄影测量工作流，对相机处理方式给出条件性证据（每配置仅一次重建，单样本证据强度有限）；结论依赖坐标系/参考协议设定。

Abstract: When a mesh reconstructed from aerial remote-sensing imagery disagrees with reference geometry, deciding what to change requires a diagnosis of the reconstruction process. We present GeoPilot, a workflow that turns diagnostics and prior observations into executable program or camera-configuration interventions. A large language model proposes the change, numerical tools reconstruct the mesh, and an external evaluator measures its geometry under a stated coordinate and reference protocol. The main case tests a shared-intrinsics hypothesis proposed before the comparison. On 224 Metashape-raster development images, shared intrinsics improved all six native-coordinate measures and reduced mean surface-to-reference distance by 7.04%. Reference-assisted alignment fitted and evaluated on separate within-scene checkerboard samples reversed the mean-distance ranking, limiting that gain to native-frame delivery. A separate matched comparison on publisher-undistorted images favored fixed published cameras on all six measures, reducing mean distance by 12.11%; the cameras retain upstream image and laser-scanning adjustment information. With one reconstruction per configuration, these comparisons provide conditional evidence for camera handling. Three end-to-end runs each delivered a mesh and six-metric evaluation from all 327 images of a second development scene.

</details>


### [174] [SpinSCI: Mask-Conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11753)
*Seungki Hong,Zhishuai Zhang,Taekwang Jang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpinSCI：掩码条件化的时空 Spin Transformer，其掩码条件 Ising 精化块（MC-IRB）用注意力 logits 与感知信息构造有符号自旋耦合，以有限平均场更新门控残差特征精化，并结合物理引导初始化与末端数据一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频快照压缩成像（SCI）需从单帧时空编码测量中恢复多帧；现有重建网络体积大、算力与内存开销高，且缺乏对测量物理模型的显式利用。

Method: 掩码条件化的时空 Spin Transformer（SpinSCI）。核心是 Mask-Conditioned Ising Refinement Block：由注意力 logits 与感知信息构成有符号自旋耦合，进行有限步平均场更新以生成门控信号，对残差特征做精化；此外使用物理引导初始化，并引入最终数据一致性层嵌入测量模型。

Result: 相比 HiSViT₉，在小规模灰度、中规模彩色、大规模彩色基准上平均 PSNR 分别提升 0.51/0.23/0.04 dB，参数量减少 16.9%，FLOPs 减少 21.0–21.6%，延迟降低 17.1–49.9%，峰值内存降低 62.3–63.3%。相比 DU-9stg，PSNR 差异不超过 0.13 dB，FLOPs 减少 28.2–28.7%，推理延迟降低 64.6–71.7%，峰值内存降低 30.1–35.0%。真实基准定性对比显示细纹理细节恢复更好。

Conclusion: 将 Ising 型平均场迭代作为注意力特征精化的门控机制，可在显著降低算力、内存与延迟的同时保持或提升视频 SCI 重建质量，并为物理引导结构设计提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Video snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) recovers multiple frames from one spatiotemporally coded measurement. This paper proposes SpinSCI, a mask-conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer whose Mask-Conditioned Ising Refinement Block (MC-IRB) combines attention logits and sensing information to form signed spin couplings. Finite mean-field updates gate residual feature refinement. Physics-guided initialization and final data consistency incorporate the measurement model. Compared with HiSViT$_9$, SpinSCI achieves average PSNR gains of 0.51 dB, 0.23 dB, and 0.04 dB on small-scale gray, mid-scale color, and large-scale color benchmarks, respectively, with 16.9% fewer parameters, 21.0-21.6% fewer FLOPs, 17.1-49.9% lower latency, and 62.3-63.3% lower peak memory. Relative to DU-9stg, average PSNR differs by at most 0.13 dB across these benchmarks, with 28.2-28.7% fewer FLOPs, 64.6-71.7% lower inference latency, and 30.1-35.0% lower peak memory. Qualitative comparisons on the real benchmark further show recovery of fine details and textures. Code and reference checkpoints are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [175] [Calibrated Alarm Thresholds for Compact Fire and Smoke Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11757)
*Vikas Sandireddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在D-Fire测试集上以图像级评估两个紧凑型火灾/烟雾检测器，比较三种把框输出转为单张警报分数的规则，并用split conformal从留出图像校准报警阈值以控制漏报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑检测器常用mAP与固定置信阈值（0.25/0.5）评估，但火灾监控系统实际是每张图做一次"报警/不报警"的二分类决策，框级指标与固定阈值无法保证图像级漏报率可控。

Method: 在两个公开紧凑检测器（如YOLOv8n类）于D-Fire上做图像级评估；比较三种由框检测聚合为图像级警报分数的简单规则；采用split conformal prediction，在留出集上选取阈值，使期望漏报图像比例低于给定目标（10%/5%/1%），并统计无误报率与失败案例。

Result: 同一固定阈值0.5下两检测器漏报率差异显著（17.3% vs 8.4%）；校准后两检测器、三种规则均能达到10%、5%、1%的漏报目标；5%目标时无火无烟图像的误报率在1.2%–3.0%；纯烟雾图像在整体目标满足时仍低于目标；并总结主要失败模式。

Conclusion: 图像级决策应采用分布无关的conformal校准阈值替代固定置信阈值，可实现跨检测器一致的漏报率保证，代价是可接受的误报率；固定阈值在部署中不具可比性与可靠性。

Abstract: Compact object detectors such as YOLOv8n are a common choice for camera-based fire and smoke detection on low-power devices. These detectors are usually evaluated with box-level metrics such as mean average precision, and their outputs are turned into decisions with a fixed confidence threshold such as 0.25 or 0.5. A fire monitoring system, however, makes one decision per image: raise an alarm or not. In this paper we evaluate two publicly available compact detectors on the D-Fire test set at the image level. We compare three simple rules for turning box detections into one alarm score per image, and we use a split conformal procedure to choose the alarm threshold from held-out images so that the expected fraction of missed fire and smoke images stays below a chosen target. We find that the same fixed threshold leads to very different miss rates for the two detectors, 17.3 and 8.4 percent at a threshold of 0.5, while the calibrated threshold meets miss-rate targets of 10, 5 and 1 percent for both detectors and all three rules. At a 5 percent target, the false alarm rate on images without fire or smoke stays between 1.2 and 3.0 percent. We also find that smoke-only images stay below the target even when the overall target is met, and we describe the main failure cases.

</details>


### [176] [LangDepth: Vision-Language Scene Priors for Semantic Binning and Cross-Domain Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11763)
*Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay,Jie Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LangDepth (SemanticBins) 用冻结CLIP与可学习场景概念键生成紧凑场景描述子，经场景先验模块(SPM)预测场景条件化的度量深度区间作为全局锚，再由DINOv2-L+FPN与逐像素分箱分配网络(PPAN)完成稠密预测，置信门融合二者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 度量深度对场景级尺度高度敏感：室内与室外驾驶场景的深度范围差异巨大，而多数深度解码器只能从视觉特征中隐式推断这一全局结构。作者希望将场景级语义结构显式作为上游先验，在稠密预测之前塑造度量输出空间。

Method: 冻结CLIP编码器+可学习场景/几何概念键库，将图像特征转为紧凑场景描述子（无需逐图文本或外部captioner）；SPM将描述子映射为场景条件化度量深度区间，提供全局范围锚；DINOv2-L骨干+轻量FPN提取稠密特征，PPAN将像素分配到场景指定的分箱结构；置信门融合稠密估计与SPM先验。仅在NYU Depth V2与KITTI联合监督训练，不使用网络级深度监督或伪标签。

Result: 单模型在NYU δ1=0.960、KITTI 0.960、DIODE indoor 0.887、iBims-1 0.946、SUN RGB-D 0.861；SPM对室内预测紧凑区间、对KITTI预测显著更宽区间，门控在室外场景偏向SPM主导，扰动路由的场景上下文会在KITTI与iBims-1上造成大幅性能下降。

Conclusion: 场景条件化的输出空间是一种实用且可解释的跨域单目度量深度估计机制，可用于室内外统一建模并具备良好的分布外泛化与可解释性。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has advanced through large-scale pretraining and strong visual backbones, yet metric depth remains sensitive to scene-level scale. Indoor rooms and outdoor driving scenes occupy very different depth ranges, but most depth decoders infer this global structure implicitly from visual features. We ask whether scene-level semantic structure can instead act as an upstream prior that shapes the metric output space before dense prediction. We present LangDepth (SemanticBins), a monocular depth architecture that couples strong visual features with a scene-conditioned output space. A frozen CLIP encoder and a learnable bank of scene- and geometry-oriented concept keys convert image features into a compact scene descriptor, without requiring per-image text or an external captioner. A Scene Prior Module (SPM) maps this descriptor to a scene-conditioned metric depth interval, providing a global range anchor before dense decoding. In parallel, a DINOv2-L backbone with a lightweight FPN extracts dense visual features, and a Per-Pixel Assignment Network (PPAN) assigns pixels to the scene-prescribed bin structure. A confidence gate fuses the dense visual estimate with the SPM prior. We train LangDepth jointly on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI under a modest supervised depth budget, without web-scale depth supervision or pseudo-labelled depth data. A single model achieves delta_1 = 0.960 on NYU, 0.960 on KITTI, 0.887 on DIODE indoor, 0.946 on iBims-1, and 0.861 on SUN RGB-D. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the SPM predicts compact indoor ranges and much wider outdoor KITTI ranges, the gate becomes SPM-dominant on outdoor scenes, and perturbing the routed scene context causes large drops on KITTI and iBims-1. These results support scene-conditioned output spaces as a practical and interpretable mechanism for cross-domain monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [177] [Towards Rotation-Only Imaging Geometry: Multi-View Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11770)
*Xinrui Li,Qi Cai,Yuanxin Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRAM用单阶段最小化边级旋转代数残差直接从相对旋转与内点匹配估计全局旋转，替代两视图位姿优化+旋转平均；MORE将旋转-only重投影误差扩展到多视图做非线性精化；ART由LiGT约束得到局部尺度三视图平移并用加权最小二乘恢复全局平移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局SfM通常先在单图像对上精化相对位姿，再做旋转平均，成对精化未在旋转初始化阶段显式结合特征级约束与多视图一致性，流程分阶段、信息利用不充分。

Method: 1) GRAM：以初始相对旋转和内点匹配为输入，直接最小化边级旋转-only代数残差，统一相对位姿优化与旋转平均为一个阶段；2) MORE：把旋转-only成像几何推广到多视图，用旋转-only重投影误差做全局旋转非线性精化；3) ART：从LiGT线性全局平移约束推导局部尺度的三视图平移，再用加权最小二乘恢复全局平移。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据实验中，所提方法在精度、鲁棒性和效率上均得到验证（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 以匹配约束直接驱动全局旋转估计并配合多视图旋转-only精化，可简化SfM旋转/平移初始化管线并保持精度与效率，是面向全局SfM初始化阶段的实用改进。

Abstract: Global structure-from-motion (SfM) commonly refines relative poses on individual image pairs and then estimates global rotations by rotation averaging. Pairwise refinement does not explicitly combine feature-level constraints with multi-view consistency during rotation initialization. We introduce Global Rotations from Aggregated Matches (GRAM), which estimates global rotations directly from initial relative rotations and inlier matches by minimizing edge-wise rotation-only algebraic residuals. GRAM replaces two-view relative-pose optimization and rotation averaging with a single stage. We further extend rotation- only imaging geometry to multiple views and develop Multi-view Optimization with Rotation-only Reprojection Error (MORE) for nonlinear global rotation refinement. Analytical Rotation-guided Translation (ART) derives locally scaled triplet translations from Linear Global Translation (LiGT) constraints and recovers global translations using weighted least squares. Synthetic and real-world experiments demonstrate the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [178] [FMA-Net: Flexible Modality Adaptation for Robust Multimodal Face Presentation Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11790)
*Yuhao Gao,Yichen Shi,Zitong Yu,Hongyang Wang,Hongrui Li,Ruixin Zhang,Shouhong Ding,Jun Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FMA-Net：用指令引导的隐空间翻译补全缺失模态，实现灵活模态人脸活体检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态人脸呈现攻击检测（fPAD）在模态缺失或不完整时，多采用零填充或直接丢弃模态，会丢失跨模态信息并引入模态依赖偏差，影响部署鲁棒性。

Method: 提出统一框架Flexible Modality Adaptation Network：1）Face Modality Instruct Translator（FMIT）从RGB输入估计目标模态（深度/红外）观测，实现指令引导的隐空间翻译补全；2）上下文感知类别增强，用可学习文本提示作为模态无关语义锚点；3）Facial Feature Adapter（F2A）融合全局人脸结构与局部攻击相关线索；4）Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment（SR-FDA）缩小翻译模态与真实模态的特征差异。

Result: 在WMCA与PADISI-Face上验证。WMCA 70%模态缺失率下，四种域内缺失协议平均ACER 3.22%（最强基线4.24%）；深度与红外完全缺失时ACER 5.23%（最佳对比5.99%）。跨域实验揭示了合成到真实对齐在数据集偏移下的局限。

Conclusion: FMA-Net为灵活/不完整模态下的fPAD提供了实用方案；但合成-真实对齐在跨域场景仍需改进。

Abstract: Multimodal face presentation attack detection (fPAD) improves robustness using complementary RGB, depth, and infrared (IR) cues, but deployment remains challenging when modalities are unavailable or incomplete. Existing flexible-modality methods mainly use zero-filling or modality omission, potentially discarding cross-modal information and introducing modality-dependent bias. We propose the Flexible Modality Adaptation Network (FMA-Net), a unified framework that compensates for missing modalities through instruction-guided latent-space translation. The Face Modality Instruct Translator (FMIT) estimates target modality observations from RGB inputs, while context-aware category enhancement uses learnable text prompts as modality-invariant semantic anchors. A Facial Feature Adapter (F2A) integrates global facial structure and local spoof-relevant cues to enhance discriminative representations. Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment (SR-FDA) reduces feature discrepancies between translated and real modalities, with benefits depending on the missing-modality pattern and data domain. Experiments on WMCA and PADISI-Face validate the framework. On WMCA with a 70% modality missing ratio, FMA-Net achieves a mean ACER of 3.22% across four intra-domain missing-modality protocols, compared with 4.24% for the strongest baseline by the same criterion. When both depth and IR are entirely unavailable, it achieves 5.23% ACER, compared with 5.99% for the best competing result. Cross-domain experiments also reveal limitations of synthetic-to-real alignment under dataset shifts. These results support FMA-Net as a practical approach to fPAD with flexible and incomplete modalities.

</details>


### [179] [Benchmarking CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Models for Explainable Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Calibration, Decision Analysis, and External Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11793)
*Akwasi Asare*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究对6种架构（2 CNN、2 ViT、2 基础模型）在7,216张公开脑肿瘤MRI上做四分类基准，发现像素级查重后36%测试图与训练集近重复；去重测试集上各模型无显著差异（90.3–91.7%），而外部BDNeuro-MRI数据集上差异显著（ViT-L/16 95.0% vs MedSigLIP-448 77.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑肿瘤MRI分类模型的比较通常只报告准确率，且所用公开数据集独立性很少被检验，导致内部准确率可能因近重复样本而虚高；作者希望建立一套包含校准、可解释性、集成与决策曲线的多维、去重与外部验证的严谨评测框架。

Method: 在7,216张公开MRI上四分类基准6个架构；评估准确率、校准（calibration）、可解释性、集成、决策曲线，且所有拟合量仅用验证集估计；用像素级查重（pixel-verified duplicate screening）筛查测试集与训练集近重复；另用1,675张外部BDNeuro-MRI图像做独立验证。

Result: 测试集36%图像在训练集中存在近重复；内部测试准确率94.5%–95.6%，Holm校正后无任一对差异显著；在773张无重复、无共享患者的测试图上降至90.3%–91.7%；集成未超越最佳单模型；归因图通过模型随机化检验但对专家标注肿瘤定位差；外部集准确率77.6%（MedSigLIP-448）至95.0%（ViT-L/16），15对中有12对显著。

Conclusion: 公开医学数据集上的内部准确率无法区分架构优劣，去重后的外部测试才能揭示真实泛化差异；医学影像基准研究必须报告重复筛查与外部验证，仅凭准确率比较结论不可靠。

Abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumor MRI classification are usually compared by accuracy alone, on public datasets whose independence is rarely checked. We benchmarked six architectures: two convolutional networks (EfficientNetV2-M and ConvNeXt-V2-Tiny), two vision transformers (Swin-V2-S and ViT-L/16), and two foundation models (DINOv2-L and MedSigLIP-448), for four-class classification of 7,216 public MRI images. We assessed accuracy, calibration, explainability, ensembles, and decision curves, with every fitted quantity estimated on validation data only. Pixel-verified duplicate screening showed that 36% of the test images had a near-duplicate in the training data. Test accuracy ranged from 94.5% to 95.6%, with no pairwise difference after Holm correction, and fell to 90.3% to 91.7% on the 773 test images free of duplicates and shared patients. Ensembles did not outperform the best single model. Attribution maps passed a model-randomization test but localized expert-annotated tumors poorly. On 1,675 external BDNeuro-MRI images that did not duplicate the training data, accuracy ranged from 77.6% (MedSigLIP-448) to 95.0% (ViT-L/16), and 12 of 15 pairwise differences were significant. Internal accuracy on this public collection therefore did not distinguish the architectures, whereas the duplicate-filtered external test did.

</details>


### [180] [Direct Trajectory Optimization for Inference-Time Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11821)
*Huixuan Zhang,Xiaojun Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DTO：免训练的文生图扩散奖励对齐框架，直接优化采样轨迹中的中间去噪分数与采样噪声，避免反传大去噪网络，并提出 Reward-Optimized Score Guidance 稳定采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励对齐方法需优化模型输入或微调去噪网络，须对大型去噪网络做高成本反向传播，效率低。

Method: 将采样轨迹上的中间去噪分数与采样噪声作为优化变量，无需穿过去噪网络求梯度；引入 Reward-Optimized Score Guidance，在优化分数与预训练预测间插值以缓解分布外问题，并在受限分布下给出奖励提升的理论保证。

Result: 在两个基准、三个扩散模型上提升对齐表现，优于现有推理时对齐方法且保持高效率。

Conclusion: 轨迹级优化是实现高效、有效扩散模型对齐的有前景方向。

Abstract: Alignment of text-to-image diffusion models with reward functions is a key challenge in controllable generation. Existing approaches typically rely on optimizing model inputs or fine-tuning denoising networks, which requires computationally expensive backpropagation through large denoising models. In this work, we propose Direct Trajectory Optimization (DTO), a training-free framework that performs alignment by directly optimizing the sampling trajectory of diffusion models. Specifically, DTO treats intermediate denoising scores and sampled noise as the optimization variables, eliminating the need for gradients through the denoising network. To mitigate the out-of-distribution problem, we introduce Reward-Optimized Score Guidance, which interpolates between the optimized scores and the pretrained model predictions to stabilize sampling, while providing a provable theoretical guarantee of reward improvement under constrained distributions. Empirically, DTO improves alignment performance across three diffusion models on two benchmarks, outperforming existing inference-time alignment methods while maintaining high efficiency. These results suggest that trajectory-level optimization is a promising direction for efficient and effective diffusion model alignment.

</details>


### [181] [When to Trust Adaptation: Contextual Fusion for Transferable Vision-Language Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11824)
*Zhenyuan Chen,Wenshuo Tao,Zhuo Huang,Shuo Chen,Mingming Cheng,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAF（Contextual Adaptive Fusion）通过组合冻结与提示的视觉/文本表示得到四个预测分支，并利用"局部置信度 + 全集频率偏置修正"的融合系数进行仲裁，实现对新类/新域的提示可靠性自适应加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型面对新类或新域时，源域适配（prompt tuning / test-time adaptation）有时能纠正预训练错误，有时却破坏原本正确的预测，需要判断"何时该信任学到的提示"。

Method: 保留四条预测分支（冻结/提示化的视觉与文本表示两两配对）；对每个样本，将各分支的预测置信度与其在无标签目标集上支持该类别的频率结合，形成对"局部自信但不受全集频率主导"预测的加权偏好；融合系数仅在源数据上学一次，推理时固定不变。

Result: ImageNet 训练下，十个跨数据集基准平均 69.96%（高于 ManiPT 1.92 个百分点）；四个 ImageNet 变体上保持竞争力，ImageNet-S 达 52.21%（新最佳）；十一个数据集 base-to-novel 迁移中，新类准确率 79.77%，调和平均 82.81%。

Conclusion: 轻量、无需目标域训练的静态融合策略即可稳定增益 VLM 跨域与 base-to-novel 迁移性能，说明对提示可靠性的分支级仲裁比单一适配更稳健。

Abstract: When a vision-language model encounters a new class or domain, how much should it trust its learned prompts? Because source adaptation can correct pretrained errors on some target images while disturbing valid predictions on others, we introduce Contextual Adaptive Fusion (CAF), which retains four prediction branches by pairing frozen and prompted visual and textual representations. To arbitrate when branches disagree on an image, CAF combines each branch's predictive confidence with how frequently the branches favor its proposed class across the unlabeled target collection, placing greater trust in predictions that are locally confident yet less dominated by collection-wide frequency bias. The fusion coefficients are learned once on source data and remain fixed at inference. Trained on ImageNet, CAF achieves 69.96% average accuracy across ten cross-dataset benchmarks (1.92 percentage points above ManiPT) and remains highly competitive across four ImageNet variants, setting a new best of 52.21% on ImageNet-S. In base-to-novel transfer across eleven datasets, CAF further reaches 79.77% novel-class accuracy and an 82.81% harmonic mean. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [182] [End-to-End Joint Training of Super-Resolution and Compression Artifact Removal for Industrial Machine Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11831)
*Dang BuiDinh,Sang NguyenQuang,Anh NguyenPhuong,Wen-Hsiao Peng,Xiem HoangVan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出端到端联合优化超分辨率与压缩伪影去除的工业机器视觉图像质量增强框架，用于提升下游缺陷检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备采集的工业图像常被降采样与压缩，导致分辨率损失与压缩伪影，严重损害缺陷检测等下游任务；现有方法将SR与CAR独立或串行处理，且以人眼保真度而非机器感知为优化目标。

Method: 端到端框架统一集成SR与CAR，采用同时优化人类感知与机器感知目标的联合训练策略；对比固定权重与基于不确定性的动态权重损失函数，以平衡重建质量与下游任务性能；在PCB Defect、DeepPCB、NEU-DET上评测。

Result: 联合训练的模型总体优于单独训练及串行SR-CAR流水线；严重JPEG压缩下，PCB Defect上的缺陷检测mAP@50从0.461提升到0.887，PSNR仅有轻微下降。

Conclusion: 联合优化是面向压缩感知工业机器视觉系统的关键，重建指标与机器感知目标需协同设计。

Abstract: In industrial machine vision, images captured by edge devices are often downsampled and compressed to reduce bandwidth, introducing resolution loss and compression artifacts that severely degrade the performance of downstream tasks, such as defect detection. Existing quality enhancement methods typically apply super-resolution (SR) or compression artifact removal (CAR) independently or in a sequential manner and are largely optimized for human visual fidelity rather than machine perception. This paper proposes an end-to-end quality enhancement framework that integrates SR and CAR with a unified training strategy that optimizes both human-perception and machine-perception objectives. We investigate fixed-weight and uncertainty-based dynamic-weight loss functions to balance reconstruction quality and machine vision task performance. Extensive experiments on PCB Defect, DeepPCB, and NEU-DET datasets show that the proposed jointly trained model generally outperforms standalone and separately trained SR-CAR pipelines. In particular, under severe JPEG compression, our method improves defect detection performance from 0.461 to 0.887 mAP@50 on PCB Defect over sequential SR-CAR baselines, with only a slight reduction in PSNR. These results demonstrate that joint optimization is critical for compression-aware industrial machine vision systems.

</details>


### [183] [Answer or Defer? Testing VLMs' Stated Confidence on Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11833)
*Amir Sabbaghziarani,Parsa Ghazvinian,Sepehr Salem,Sergey Plis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 八种开源视觉语言模型在脑MRI切片上测试"置信度阈值化"能否筛出低错误率子集：BraTS胶质瘤上无任何模型能在5%错误预算下选出非空集合，10%预算下最佳仅保留24.4%，原因是置信度方差主要来自"答案类别"而非"对错"，导致跨人群置信度-正确性关系反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM用于医学影像解读时，必须决定接受哪些解读、把哪些影像转交临床医生。作者想检验"用模型自报置信度做阈值筛选"能否在限制错误率的同时保留有用覆盖率，并分析该策略对人群分布的依赖性。

Method: 构建3888张脑MRI切片评测集：治疗后胶质瘤患者（BraTS 2024，标签来自分割mask）与健康志愿者（IXI，全部视为阴性）。测试8个开源权重VLM（含2个推理模型）做肿瘤/大体异常判断；对每个模型做retrospective阈值扫描，评估固定错误预算（5%/10%/20%）下的覆盖率；用大病灶-远距离阴性子集做对照；将置信度差异分解为"答案间差异"与"答案内差异"，对4个提供outcome-level摘要的模型做协方差分解，解释置信度-正确性关联在人群间的反转。
