Result: BraTS上，即使事后选阈值，任何模型都无法选出错误率≤5%的非空子集，大病灶-远距离阴性子集亦然；10%错误预算下Gemma-4-12B仅保留24.4%切片，其余模型≤2.5%；四模型中答案间的合并平均置信度差异大于同一答案内正确/错误响应间差异；协方差分解显示该结构可产生跨人群相反的置信度-正确性关联；20%预算下"全部接受tumor答案"在2个模型上覆盖率高于任何置信度阈值。

Conclusion: 未经校准的自报置信度不宜作为独立的分诊/deferral信号；置信度筛选的有效性高度依赖人群构成，部署前必须做人群特异性的验证与阈值标定。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) could support medical-image interpretation, but their use requires deciding which interpretations to accept and which images to refer to a clinician. We test whether thresholding stated confidence can retain useful coverage while limiting errors among accepted answers, and how this depends on the population. Eight open-weight VLMs, including two reasoning models, assess 3,888 brain MRI slices from post-treatment glioma patients (BraTS 2024) and healthy volunteers (IXI) for tumor or gross abnormality. BraTS labels are mask-derived; IXI slices are treated as negatives. On BraTS, no threshold selects a nonempty set with at most 5% empirical error for any model, even when chosen retrospectively. This also holds for four models evaluated on a large-lesion, distant-negative subset. At a 10% error budget, Gemma-4-12B retains 24.4% of slices and every other model at most 2.5%. To investigate this limited selection ability, we separate confidence differences between predicted answers from differences within each answer. For four models with available outcome-level summaries, pooled mean confidence differs more between answers than between correct and incorrect responses within each answer. A covariance decomposition explains how this pattern can produce opposite confidence-correctness associations across populations. At a 20% error budget, accepting every "tumor" answer covers more slices than any confidence threshold for two models. These findings caution against using unvalidated stated confidence as a standalone deferral signal and support population-specific validation before deployment. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [184] [MDA framework: multi-architecture domain adaptation for unsupervised person re-identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11836)
*Wei Zhang,Peijun Ye,Dihu Chen,Tao Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MDA框架：将Mamba封装为复合算子(MDA operator)，并在算子与框架两个层级构建多架构域自适应能力，可即插即用地嵌入CNN或Transformer骨干用于无监督行人重识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督行人重识别同时面临域间差异大、且现有方法普遍绑定单一网络架构、难以迁移部署的问题；作者希望在统一框架下实现跨架构的域自适应。

Method: 两层设计：第一层设计MDA operator，把Mamba作为增强域自适应的组件封装成通用复合算子；第二层基于该算子构建Mamba增强的多架构域自适应框架，支持多种集成位置与部署策略，从而兼容CNN与Transformer骨干。

Result: 在多个行人重识别基准上验证了一致性与灵活性；单一部署配置下优于多种SOTA；CUHK03→Market-1501任务上CNN骨干提升10.2% mAP，Transformer骨干提升19.8% mAP。

Conclusion: Mamba可作为架构无关的域自适应增强模块，显著提升无监督行人重识别的跨域性能与部署灵活性。

Abstract: Unsupervised person re-identification not only faces the challenge of domain gaps, but existing methods also rarely support multiple network architectures. To tackle both issues, this paper proposes a multi-architecture auto-adaptive domain adaptation method: Mamba augmented multi-architecture domain adaptation framework. Specifically, this paper constructs the multi-architecture domain adaptation capability at two levels. At the first level, we propose a composite operator(MDA operator) that encapsulates Mamba as a component for enhancing domain adaptation. At the second level, based on this operator, we propose a Mamba-enhanced multi-architecture Domain Adaptation framework(MDA framework). Comprehensive experiments on person re-identification benchmarks validate the consistency and flexibility of the proposed framework. The MDA framework supports versatile deployment strategies without being confined to a single integration point. Under a single deployment configuration, it surpasses several SOTA methods. Moreover, it demonstrates substantial performance improvements across both CNN and Transformer architectures. When embedded into a CNN backbone, the framework achieves a 10.2% mAP improvement on the adaptation task from CUHK03 to Market-1501. Integrated with a Transformer backbone, it yields a 19.8% mAP improvement on the same task.

</details>


### [185] [Aggregation-Induced Calibration Failure in Sum-Based Label Expansion for Multi-Label Facial Expression Recognition: A Diagnostic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11843)
*Weihang Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统分析了多标签表情识别中"标签空间扩展(预测更大联合空间再求和回原标签)"这一设计的失效模式：在7个骨干网、自建数据集与RAF-DB/RAF-ML上发现，方法成败取决于聚合规则而非表征；未校准的求和聚合导致固定阈值0.5下F1类分数在5个骨干间横跨28倍，而无阈值mAP仅1.28倍，故障被定位在求和步骤；两个7维sigmoid基线(BCE/ASL)达到mAP 0.5055/0.5175，ASL超过5个CALE配置中的3个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标签空间扩展（扩展到更大联合标签空间再聚合回原标签）被视为多标签面部表情识别的自然设计，但其失败模式尚未被刻画。作者希望明确该范式的收益来源与失效环节，是对既有设计的批判性诊断。

Method: 在自建数据集（30,240张训练图像、3,460张多标签测试图像）上评估Condition-Aware Label Expansion (CALE)，覆盖7个骨干网络，并在公开基准RAF-DB与RAF-ML上验证。通过对比固定阈值0.5下的聚合分数与无阈值mAP的跨骨干波动幅度来定位故障；进一步测量主分支与三个非主分支的激活值，验证聚合规则（主分支分数 + 非主分支之和的一半）未校准这一机制；并与7维sigmoid基线BCE、ASL对比，辅以配对t检验、Benjamini-Hochberg校正与Wilcoxon检验。

Result: 在10%训练数据下，聚合分数在5个骨干间跨度达28倍（0.24–6.79），全量数据下收缩至1.9倍；而mAP在同样骨干间仅在1.28倍内波动，说明故障局部化于求和步骤。ASL(mAP 0.5175)超过5个CALE配置中的3个，最佳CALE亦仅领先其0.03。单标签FER上相较7维基线的提升名义显著（p=0.0436），但经BH校正后不显著（p_BH=0.2055），Wilcoxon检验亦不显著（p=0.1250）。

Conclusion: 基于求和的标签扩展在多标签决策前必须进行部署数据规模下的阈值校准，或改用可学习的聚合方式；其表征本身并非瓶颈。该结论对标签扩展类多标签方法具有普遍警示意义。

Abstract: Label-space expansion - predicting a larger joint space and summing back to the original labels - is a natural design for multi-label facial expression recognition, but its failure modes have not been characterised. We evaluate Condition-Aware Label Expansion (CALE) on a self-built dataset (30,240 training images, 3,460 multi-label test images), on seven backbones, and on the public RAF-DB and RAF-ML benchmarks. The central finding is that the aggregation rule, not the representation, decides whether the method works. With a fixed threshold of 0.5, the aggregate score spans 28x across five backbones at 10% of the training data (0.24 to 6.79) and collapses to a 1.9x range at full data, while threshold-free mAP stays within 1.28x over the same backbones, which localises the fault to the summation step. The mechanism is the uncalibrated aggregation rule, which adds the main-branch score to half the sum of the three non-main branches; we verify it by measuring main- and non-main-branch activations. Two plain seven-dimensional sigmoid baselines (BCE, ASL) reach mAP 0.5055 and 0.5175; ASL exceeds three of the five CALE configurations and falls within 0.03 of the best. On single-label FER the gain over a seven-dimensional baseline is nominally significant (paired t-test, p = 0.0436) but does not survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction (p_BH = 0.2055) or a Wilcoxon test (p = 0.1250). We conclude that sum-based label expansion requires threshold calibration at the deployment data scale, or a learned aggregation, before it can support multi-label decisions.

</details>


### [186] [Where Does Proposal Selection Fail? Diagnosing Frozen Vision-Language Queries over Detector Proposals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11873)
*Bo Ma,Weiqi Yan,Jinsong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在固定冻结检测器提案的前提下，系统剖析模块化指代定位（VLM 选择框）的失效位置：选择器"读什么"比"怎么建"更重要，图像条件查询显著优于纯文本查询；分布外（Ref-L4/Objects365）与推理类基准上，训练过的选择头远落后于 VLM 直接解码坐标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化 grounding（检测器提 proposal + VLM 选一个）比让 VLM 直接解码 box 更省算力，但缺少对其失败模式的受控诊断，因此需要固定感知、逐因素变化选择接口来定位瓶颈。

Method: 受控消融实验：冻结提案集（对 RefCOCO/+/g 至少 99.8% 的查询包含指代目标），对同族两个 VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B，另含 InternVL3-8B 部分实验）逐一改变选择接口；比较图像条件查询 vs 文本查询、不同 head 结构、跨注意力选择器监督信号（全部有效框）、更宽检测器 prompt、类别无关提案器，并分析验证器是否退化为存在性探针。

Result: RefCOCOg 上图像条件查询比纯文本查询高 0.15–0.18（各 head 一致）；交叉注意力选择器配全有效框监督可在 RefCOCOg 与 VLM 坐标解码持平，在 RefCOCO/+ 上配合数据训练后也可持平；但在 Ref-L4 的 Objects365 图像上所有训练 head 掉到 0.19–0.28，而 Qwen 解码约 0.8；更宽 prompt 与类别无关提案器都无法弥补；Ref-Adv-s 与 RefBench-PRO 上全预算 head 落后解码 0.19–0.37；训练验证器退化为对 VLM 查询状态的存在性探测，不优于 VLM 自身 yes/no。

Conclusion: 模块化 grounding 的瓶颈在分布外泛化与细粒度排序，而不在提案质量或 head 结构；VLM 原生坐标解码在开放类别与推理型基准上仍显著更鲁棒，模块化方案的价值仅限于训练分布内且以图像条件查询为输入时。

Abstract: In modular grounding a frozen detector proposes regions and a vision-language model (VLM) selects one, at lower cost than letting the VLM decode a box, but it is unclear where such systems fail. We hold perception fixed---every trained selector chooses among the same frozen proposals, which contain the referent for at least $99.8\%$ of RefCOCO/+/g queries---and vary the selection interface one factor at a time for two VLMs of one family (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B). On RefCOCOg, what the selector reads matters more than how it is built: the VLM's image-conditioned query encodes the referent's location and beats a text-only query by $0.15$--$0.18$ with every head tested (by less for InternVL3-8B, whose vision encoder differs; one head tested). The remaining errors are rankings among a few top candidates; a cross-attention selector supervised with every valid box reaches the VLM's coordinate decoding on RefCOCOg, and with Qwen2.5-VL on RefCOCO/+ when also trained on their data. Beyond that distribution it does not: on Ref-L4's Objects365 images, mostly of categories outside training, every trained head falls to $0.19$--$0.28$ while Qwen decoding keeps about $0.8$ (InternVL3's drops too), neither a wider detector prompt nor a class-agnostic proposer closes the gap, and on public reasoning benchmarks Ref-Adv-s and RefBench-PRO full-budget heads trail decoding by $0.19$--$0.37$ although proposals cover most referents. A trained verifier reduces to an existence probe on the VLM's query state and does not beat the VLM's yes/no answer on public no-target benchmarks.

</details>


### [187] [Beyond Head Importance: Collective Computation in Video Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11875)
*Yi Yang,Siyuan Liu,Bingbing Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文研究视频Transformer中注意力头的集体计算机制，从"下游如何使用头输出"和"跨层交互组合"两个角度，发现高重要性头可跨任务迁移并维持表征结构，短时空注意力距离头集合的联合消融损伤超过同等数量的高重要性头。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原有以单头重要性排序理解视频Transformer注意力功能的方式不完整，需要考察头在集体计算中的参与方式，包括下游调用与跨层组合。

Method: 对四个视频Transformer做消融分析；比较消融后表征响应与重要性排序在注意力模块后与MLP后的相关性差异；采用仅MLP微调使下游处理适配；分析跨层头的组合，依据时空注意力距离分组并比较扰动响应与联合消融效果。

Result: 单任务上识别的高重要性头也支持其他视频理解任务并保持区分不同视频的表征结构；消融响应与重要性在MLP后相关性更强；仅MLP微调可提升低重要性头输出的利用；短注意力距离头集合对远距离token扰动响应更强，联合消融损失大于等高重要性头集合。

Conclusion: 功能性贡献取决于头输出被下游如何使用以及局部交互如何跨层组合，集体计算是理解注意力头功能的关键视角。

Abstract: Attention heads in video Transformers vary greatly in functional importance. Understanding their contributions requires examining not only which heads are important, but also how they participate in collective computation within the network. We study this collective computation from two perspectives: the downstream use of head outputs and the composition of interactions across layers. Ablation analyses of four video Transformers show that high-importance heads identified on a single task also support other video understanding tasks and help preserve the representational structure that distinguishes different videos. Representational responses to head ablation correlate weakly with head importance after the attention module, but more strongly after the MLP in the same block. Adapting this downstream processing through MLP-only fine-tuning further improves the use of lower-importance head outputs. Meanwhile, through composition across layers, sets of heads with shorter spatiotemporal attention distances support stronger perturbation responses at distant tokens than sets with longer distances. Their joint ablation causes even greater performance loss than ablating equally sized sets of high-importance heads, revealing collective contributions not fully captured by individual importance rankings. These findings highlight collective computation as a key perspective for understanding attention head function: functional contributions depend on both how head outputs are used downstream and how local interactions compose across layers.

</details>


### [188] [Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11890)
*Yuji Nozawa,Yu-Chieh Lin,Youyang Ng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两种视觉聚焦损失函数，利用ViT内部多头注意力引导DINO自监督训练时的注意力与图像特定区域建立对应，无需标注即可诱导注意力头空间专门化与多样化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DINO等ViT自监督模型训练时缺乏聚焦机制，导致感知表征模糊、注意力头之间过度相似，空间选择性差。

Method: 设计两个视觉聚焦损失（visual focusing loss），借助模型内多头注意力机制施加约束，使各注意力头的响应对齐到图像中的具体区域，从而形成空间专门化的注意力头。

Result: 定性与定量实验显示注意力头的空间选择性与多样性显著提升，可解释性增强，零样本图像分割等密集预测任务性能改善。

Conclusion: 无需标注的注意力聚焦损失可有效提升ViT自监督特征的空间判别性，为密集预测提供更优的预训练表征。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.

</details>


### [189] [Developing a Street View Imagery Processing Pipeline for Building-Level Vacant House Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11893)
*Dongjoon Park,Sunjae Lee,Jung Woo Kim,Bumjoon Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可复现街景图像(SVI)处理流程，显式化图像适用性筛选与目标房屋对齐，用于韩国空置房屋评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SVI自动评估普遍假设图像清晰拍摄目标建筑，但实际图像常缺乏任务证据或拍到邻屋，导致模型评分无法说明是否评对了建筑。

Method: 1) 任务适用性过滤：按图像构图与行政区自适应调整准则；2) 目标房屋对齐：利用相机元数据与地块边界识别该地块的房屋，无需建筑轮廓或额外训练；3) 在10,311张图像、1,609个独栋住宅地块上做空置分类，并用Grad-CAM分析模型关注区域。

Result: 过滤在保持与统一过滤相同图像量下多出101个可用地块；对齐与人工标注一致率85.6%（最佳简单规则79.8%）；过滤+对齐将AUROC从0.684提升至0.719，但仍低于同图误标他屋的0.709；Grad-CAM显示模型常关注目标房屋外部区域。

Conclusion: 图像适用性、目标识别与模型证据是三个独立问题，仅靠分数无法区分；记录所用图像与所选房屋可支持复核与人工虚拟审计。属于遥感/城市审计应用型数据管线工作，方法洞察有限。

Abstract: Street view imagery (SVI) is widely used to audit urban environments remotely. Automated assessments usually assume that each image shows the target building clearly. In practice, an image may lack task-relevant evidence or show a neighboring house. If this goes unchecked, a model's score cannot show whether it judged the correct building. We present a reproducible SVI processing pipeline that makes image suitability and target identity explicit and checkable. We apply it to vacant house assessment in South Korea, using 10,311 images of 1,609 detached-house parcels. Task-suitability filtering adapts its criteria to image composition and administrative area. This keeps coverage even across areas. While keeping as many images as a single uniform filter, our filtering left 101 more parcels with a usable image. Target-house alignment identifies the parcel's house from camera metadata and parcel boundaries. It needs no building footprints or additional training. Alignment matched human labels for 85.6% of images, compared with 79.8% for the best simple rule. In vacancy classification, filtering and alignment raised AUROC from 0.684 to 0.719, but marking a different house in the same image still gave 0.709. Grad-CAM showed that the model often looked at areas outside the target house. Image suitability, target identification, and model evidence are therefore separate problems, and scores alone do not resolve them. Recording which images were used and which house was selected lets reviewers verify each assessment and can support human virtual audits.

</details>


### [190] [RBA: A Read-out Basis Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Interactive OCTA Vessel Segmentation with SEEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11906)
*Jaafar M. Al-Ghabban,Mohammad Reza Mohammadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA)，在 SEEM 的分割读出端生成 32 张半分辨率图像特定基图，配合编码器端 rank-1 LoRA，仅增加 0.47M 参数即可高效适配 OCTA 血管与 FAZ 分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SEEM 类可提示模型在视网膜 OCTA 血管分割上零样本表现差、需大量点击；全量微调 342M 参数成本高且易过拟合，现有 LoRA 类方法只适配编码器，而 SEEM 的候选掩码全部来自 1/4 分辨率的单一特征图，对 1–3 像素宽的细血管过粗。

Method: 读出分支额外生成 32 个图像特定的半分辨率基图，每个候选掩码通过各自的向量与零初始化投影访问这些基图（初始等价于原 SEEM）；编码器分支使用标准 rank-1 LoRA，提供区分动静脉所需信息；总可训练参数约 0.47M。

Result: 在模拟误差驱动点击下超过 LoRA、Conv-LoRA、AdaptFormer：OCTA-500 3mm 大血管三随机种子平均 IoU 85.16%、Dice 91.93%，较 Conv-LoRA 分别高 2.90 与 1.72 个百分点；6mm 子集单次运行增益 4.35/2.76 个百分点；增益延伸至动脉、静脉与 ROSE-O，但 FAZ 无提升。

Conclusion: 在 SEEM 中，适配容量投入到掩码读出端比投入编码器收益更大；在极少参数下实现细血管分割的显著提升，但结论局限于医学影像分割，未验证通用视觉或具身场景。

Abstract: Retinal disease monitoring with optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) relies on segmentation of vessels and the foveal avascular zone (FAZ). Promptable models such as SEEM (Segment Everything Everywhere All at Once) allow click-based refinement, but without adaptation SEEM segments thin vessels poorly and needs many clicks. Fully fine-tuning its 342 million parameters on a few hundred images is costly and risks overfitting, and parameter-efficient methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) usually adapt only the encoder. Yet SEEM reads every candidate mask from one feature map at quarter resolution, too coarse for vessels one to three pixels wide. This study introduces the Read-out Basis Adapter (RBA), whose read-out branch generates 32 image-specific basis maps at half resolution. Each candidate accesses them through its own vector and a zero-initialised projection, so the model starts exactly as SEEM. The encoder branch, a standard rank-1 LoRA, supplies the information needed to tell arteries from veins. RBA adds 0.47 million trainable parameters. Under simulated error-driven clicks, with the ground truth used only to place them, RBA outperforms LoRA, Conv-LoRA andAdaptFormer on OCTA-500 3mmlarge vessels. Averaged over three seeds, it reaches an intersection over union (IoU) of 85.16% and a Dice score of 91.93%, 2.90 and 1.72 percentage points above Conv-LoRA. On the 6 mm subset, one run gives margins of 4.35 and 2.76 points. The gain extends to arteries, veins and ROSE-O but not to the FAZ. In SEEM, adaptation capacity pays more at the mask read-out than in the encoder.

</details>


### [191] [LO-World: Unified BEV Latent Modeling for Joint 4D Occupancy and LiDAR Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11912)
*Zhimin Liao,Ping Wei,Kai Mao,Shuaijia Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LO-World：在共享BEV隐空间中以单流4D世界模型联合预测LiDAR点云与3D语义占据，实现跨模态互为正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LiDAR点云（精细度量几何）与3D语义占据（稠密体素语义）具备天然互补性，但现有世界模型要么独立预测、要么启发式级联，错失互为正则的机会，且多管线冗余。

Method: 统一单流架构：混合range-voxel自编码器（高效编解码两种模态）+ flow-matching生成器，并缓存历史上下文以降低迭代采样延迟。

Result: 占据预测IoU提升10.9%，LiDAR Chamfer Distance降低30.1%；单张RTX 4090上>25 FPS实时吞吐，开源代码。

Conclusion: 单流共享隐空间显式优于独立/级联预测，兼顾精度与实时性，为自动驾驶4D场景建模提供统一高效范式。

Abstract: LiDAR point clouds and 3D semantic occupancy represent two distinct modalities capturing fine-grained metric geometry and dense volumetric semantics, respectively, holding natural potential for mutual complementarity. However, existing world models typically forecast these modalities independently or cascade them heuristically, missing the opportunity for reciprocal cross-modal regularization. To address this, we propose \textbf{LO-World}, a unified 4D world model that forecasts both modalities within a shared BEV latent space. This single-stream formulation enables dense semantics and metric geometry to mutually reinforce each other, while eliminating multi-pipeline redundancy. Specifically, LO-World couples an efficient hybrid range-voxel autoencoder with a flow-matching generator that caches historical context to reduce iterative sampling latency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LO-World outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines, improving occupancy forecasting IoU by 10.9% and reducing LiDAR Chamfer Distance by 30.1%. Meanwhile, it sustains a real-time throughput exceeding $25$~FPS on a single RTX 4090. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [192] [Text Alone Predicts Which Classes a Segmentation Readout Keeps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11926)
*David Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示了开放词汇分割读出层存在"静默类别坍塌"：仅凭类名列表与训练词表的文本相似度即可在未见图像前预测哪些类别会坍塌，机理是词表距离导致近名类别抢占投票，降低读出幅度或早停可在不重训下恢复至多+16点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇分割模型在部署到训练类别之外的类别时会静默失效：仍输出高置信掩码但该类从不获胜，训练损失照常下降、mIoU甚至上升，掩盖了类别死亡现象。作者希望事前预测坍塌类别并给出可操作的恢复手段。

Method: （1）仅用类名文本相似度（与训练词表的距离）在无图像条件下对各类别坍塌风险排序，在9个模型族、12种骨干、8种预训练配方上以AUROC 0.69–0.96验证，另有2个族事后落在同一区间；（2）类表干预实验：训练列表中移入/移出近名对照类可翻转该类相对冻结基线的增益达21 IoU点，替换无关名称无影响；（3）机理分析：坍塌类在投票中全部输给近名邻居，但在冻结特征中仍可区分；（4）无需重训的修复：降低读出幅度或早停，恢复至多+16点；训练时压制幅度则不会坍塌。

Result: 坍塌风险排序可事前由类名列表预测（AUROC 0.69–0.96，跨九个模型族、十二骨干、八预训练配方）；类表移动对应名称可让该类IoU相对冻结基线变化21点，换无关名称无变化；降幅/早停无需重训恢复至多+16点，训练中抑制幅度可完全避免坍塌。

Conclusion: 开放词汇分割的类别坍塌是可预测、可解释、可修复的词表距离现象：类名列表本身"写入"了坍塌，也能被"改写"。该结论对开放词汇/开放世界感知系统在机器人等部署场景中的可靠性具有直接警示与方法性指导。

Abstract: An open-vocabulary segmentation readout silently loses a class deployed beyond its training categories. It still emits masks with high confidence, but the class never wins a single pixel. The training loss falls anyway, and mIoU can even rise while classes die. We show that which classes collapse is written in the class-name list alone. Before any image is seen, we rank each class's collapse risk from its text similarity to the training vocabulary alone. The ranking holds at AUROC 0.69-0.96 across nine model families, twelve backbones and eight pretraining recipes. Two further families, measured only after the predictions were written down, land in the same band. What the list writes, it can rewrite. With identical images and a class's counterpart moved in or out of the training list, retraining flips that class's gain over the frozen baseline by 21 IoU points; swapping in unrelated names changes nothing. We find a vocabulary-distance mechanism behind the collapse. Collapsed classes lose every vote to near-name neighbors, but in the frozen features they survive. Turning down the readout's amplitude, or stopping training early, brings them back, up to +16 points, without retraining; trained with its amplitude held down, the readout never collapses.

</details>


### [193] [Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11934)
*Wanhui Luo,Hongbo Zhao,Yi Zhou,Qijun Chen,Yiming Nie,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: S²D-FVO将球面光束法平差（SBA）与无监督深度学习结合，用球面对数映射构造切空间角度重投影残差并加入中值深度尺度正则，实现尺度一致的单目鱼眼视觉里程计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目鱼眼VO视角大、结构简单，但长轨迹上尺度漂移严重；无监督深度可缓解该问题，然而鱼眼强畸变使深度估计不准。此外，像素重投影残差不能均匀反映视线夹角偏差，而标量角度残差的线性化在某些切向扰动下不敏感。

Method: (1) SBA采用基于球面对数映射的切空间角度重投影残差，保留两个切向的敏感性且范数等于标量角度残差；(2) 在SBA中加入基于中值深度的尺度正则项约束重建尺度；(3) 用SBA替代无监督深度学习中的位姿估计网络以提供更可靠相对位姿用于视图合成，反之训练好的深度网络为SBA提供尺度参考，从而联合优化尺度一致性与三维路标位置。

Result: 在多个公开数据集及两个新采集的大规模数据集上，所提框架在深度估计与轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并可适用于不同相机模型。

Conclusion: 将几何优化（SBA）与无监督深度学习双向耦合，可有效缓解鱼眼单目VO的尺度漂移并提升深度精度，具备跨相机模型的通用性。

Abstract: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.

</details>


### [194] [Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11949)
*Rohan Dugad,Mi Luo,Kristen Grauman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VIOS：一种视觉感知的在线自蒸馏后训练框架，通过"有/无视频"下 next-token 分布散度度量每个 token 对视觉证据的依赖度，用学生-教师依赖度差（reliance gap）做稠密门控监督，单次 rollout、无需外部奖励或裁判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频推理中真正起视觉决定作用的 token 极少，其余推理链主要由语言驱动；GRPO 等后训练方法只在轨迹级给粗粒度奖励，需多次 rollout 和昂贵外部判官，浪费了这种稀疏结构。

Method: 以"带视频 vs 不带视频"的下一 token 分布 KL/散度定义 per-token 视觉依赖度；对答案特权教师与学生分别计算，得到依赖差；三部分组成：(1) 与学生协同进化的 EMA 教师；(2) 对比目标，鼓励预测依赖视频；(3) reliance-gap 门控，把学习集中在视觉未被充分利用的 token 上。仅需单模型单次 on-policy rollout。

Result: 在通用、时序、空间、知识密集、长视频理解等 12 个基准上，跨 3 个骨干模型一致提升，优于当代视频推理系统；训练步数减少 9x 以上、FLOPs 减少 60x、生成 token 减少 111x。

Conclusion: 逐 token 的视觉依赖度差是一种廉价且有效的自监督稠密信号，可替代轨迹级 RL 与外部判官，实现高效视频推理后训练。

Abstract: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [195] [UltraVoxelGS: Voxel-First Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11951)
*Yue Wang,Haoxin Chen,Xiaoqing Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraVoxelGS 提出前馈式 3D 超声重建，将带位姿的超声切片提升到固定尺寸体素支撑后直接预测高斯参数，并引入超声感知外观分解与渲染时外观自适应，实现约10秒重建、>35倍加速且支持千帧级序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有超声重建方法依赖逐场景优化，耗时10-20分钟，无法在2D超声扫查过程中提供实时空间反馈。而已有前馈高斯方法依赖稠密视角重叠与光度一致性假设，超声切片最多仅一维相交且存在声学传播/衰减导致的视角依赖外观，无法直接套用。

Method: 1) 前馈体素到高斯（voxel-to-Gaussian）通路：将所有带位姿切片提升至固定尺寸体素支撑，使表示规模与输入帧数解耦，再由网络直接回归高斯参数，绕过逐场景优化；2) 训练中显式分解反射与累积衰减以建模超声视角依赖外观；3) 利用空间相邻切片的外观连续性，在渲染阶段进行高效外观自适应（Render-time Appearance Adaptation）。

Result: 在真实与仿真数据集上，PSNR/SSIM 均优于逐场景优化基线；推理时间由10–20分钟降至约10秒（35倍以上加速），并可扩展至1000帧以上序列；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在超声场景中同时实现快速前馈重建与物理一致渲染，为扫描过程中的实时空间反馈提供可行方案，核心贡献在于用固定体素支撑解耦表示规模与帧数，并以超声物理先验处理稀疏相交与视角依赖外观。

Abstract: We present UltraVoxelGS, a 3D ultrasound reconstruction method that achieves both fast reconstruction and physically faithful rendering for the first time, bringing live spatial feedback during 2D ultrasound scanning within reach. This is made possible by a feed-forward design that predicts a complete Gaussian scene representation from posed ultrasound images directly, entirely bypassing the per-scene optimization bottleneck that has confined prior methods to offline use. Realising such feed-forward prediction in this setting is non-trivial: unlike natural images, ultrasound slices share at most one-dimensional intersections and exhibit view-dependent appearance due to acoustic propagation and attenuation, violating the dense overlap and photometric consistency assumed by existing feed-forward Gaussian methods. Hence, to achieve fast reconstruction, we introduce a feed-forward voxel-to-Gaussian pass that decouples representation size from input count by lifting all posed slices into a fixed-size voxel support and predicting Gaussian parameters directly. For faithful rendering, we propose ultrasound-aware appearance rendering strategy factorize reflection from cumulative attenuation during training and exploit appearance continuity among spatially adjacent slices for efficient Render-time Appearance Adaptation. On both real-world and simulated datasets, UltraVoxelGS achieves best PSNR/SSIM compared with per-scene optimization baselines while reducing inference from 10-20 minutes to approximately 10 seconds (over 35 times faster) and scales to sequences exceeding 1,000 frames. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [196] [3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11964)
*Zixiang Ai,Zhenyu Cui,Xu Zou,Jiahuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出3R-Adapter，一种面向长尾3D重建场景的参数高效微调范式，将域偏移下的适配建模为"对应关系恢复"问题，通过可变形检索、关系重连与一致性精修三模块修复跨视图关系注意力结构坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D重建模型在大规模预训练下泛化良好，但在低光照重建、人-场景联合重建、测试时自适应等长尾场景中失效。作者观察到主因是关系注意力的关系结构坍缩导致跨视图对应失败；现有PEFT仅做通道级特征调整，缺乏显式重建关系结构的机制。

Method: 1) Deformable Retrieval：任务自适应的关系候选检索；2) Relational Rewiring：重建跨视图关系结构；3) Consistency Refinement：将重连后的关系注入稳定预测。整体以轻量PEFT形式实现，仅微调少量参数。

Result: 在低光照重建、人-场景联合重建及测试时自适应三类任务上，相较现有PEFT方法显著提升鲁棒性，同时保持高效轻量的适配开销；代码开源。

Conclusion: 将长尾场景适配重新表述为域偏移下的对应关系恢复问题，是一种有价值的视角；关系结构级PEFT优于通道级PEFT，为前馈3D重建的鲁棒部署提供轻量方案。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at this https URL .

</details>


### [197] [AnyBreak: Towards Jailbreaking Any T2I Model for Any Concept](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11980)
*Qi Lu,Zehui Guo,Yucheng Zhao,Zijing Li,Chuhan Song,Wenrui Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnyBreak：利用多尺度渐进语义对齐构造对抗图像，在纯黑盒、纯文本提示条件下把任意T2I模型越狱到任意恶意概念；AnyBreak-V加入补偿项绕过事后安全检查器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型可被对抗提示诱导生成NSFW内容，但既有攻击依赖提示过滤器规避与白盒假设，缺乏在黑盒、干净文本约束下的通用越狱手段。

Method: 提出AnyBreak框架：在生成过程中构造多尺度渐进语义对齐的对抗图像，通过跨模态语义转移将恶意概念从文本模态注入图像模态，从而在潜空间中把生成轨迹导向不安全数据流形；推理时仅需干净文本提示+对抗图像，黑盒适用。AnyBreak-V引入补偿项以规避后验安全检查器。

Result: 在黑盒与干净文本约束下取得高攻击成功率，同时保持视觉保真度与与输入提示的语义一致性；显示现有防御在跨模态攻击面上存在明显缺口。

Conclusion: T2I安全防御需正视跨模态攻击面；纯图像侧扰动即可在无恶意文本情况下实现通用的黑盒越狱。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in image generation and editing, yet this progress has also introduced significant security risks. Prior work has shown that adversarial prompt can induce the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, including pornographic, violent, and graphic imagery. However, such attacks are typically mitigated by prompt filters and often rely on white-box assumptions. In this paper, we propose AnyBreak, a novel jailbreak framework that constructs adversarial images via multi-scale progressive semantic alignment. During the generation process, these adversarial images steer the generation trajectory in latent space towards unsafe data manifolds, enabling cross-modal transfer of malicious concepts from the text modality to the image modality. AnyBreak operates using only clean textual prompts and adversarial images at inference time, and can jailbreak any T2I models towards any malicious concepts in a fully black-box setting. We further introduce AnyBreak-V, an enhanced variant that incorporates a compensation term to bypass post-hoc safety checkers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyBreak achieves high attack success rates while preserving visual fidelity and semantic consistency with the input prompts under black-box and clean-text constraints. Our findings reveal that existing T2I defense leave critical cross-modal attack surfaces insufficiently addressed. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [198] [HIST3R: Decomposing and Rectifying State Updates with History for Streaming 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12011)
*Kenneth Yang,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HIST3R提出免训练框架，在CUT3R式流式3D重建中将循环状态更新分解为"幅度（写入增益）+方向（几何意图）"，利用历史状态修正更新方向、依据视觉差异调制更新幅度，在长视频下显著降低几何漂移且不增加内存与时间开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式循环重建把场景理解转化为状态演化问题：每帧对紧凑记忆的更新会覆盖历史上下文，不可靠更新会累积成长程几何漂移。现有免训练扩展仅做幅度控制，能衰减不可靠更新却无法纠正方向，因此需要一种同时控制幅度与方向的通用机制。

Method: 通过方向—幅度分解统一刻画CUT3R及其变体的循环更新（幅度=更新增益，方向=几何意图）；提出HIST3R：用局部一致的历史状态对更新方向进行校正（rectify），并根据当前观测与其历史的视觉差异调制更新幅度，抑制冗余更新、保留互补证据；全程免训练，保持原有内存占用与推理速度。

Result: 在相机位姿估计、3D重建与视频深度估计上一致提升长程性能；1000帧输入时相对最强对比方法ATE在ScanNet降低23.87%、TUM-Dynamics降低33.65%；500帧时中位重建精度相对最强CUT3R类变体在7-Scenes提升56.52%、NRGBD提升33.96%，且内存与速度与CUT3R持平。

Conclusion: 将循环状态更新显式拆解为幅度与方向并分别用历史信息约束，是抑制长程漂移的有效且低成本的通用策略，可免训练即插即用于CUT3R类流式重建主干。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction with recurrent states enables long-video scene understanding under bounded memory, but turns reconstruction into a state-evolution problem: each incoming frame updates a compact scene memory on which all subsequent predictions depend, so unreliable updates overwrite historical context and accumulate into long-horizon geometric drift. We analyze CUT3R-style recurrent updates through a direction--magnitude decomposition, in which the magnitude sets the update gain, i.e., how strongly an observation is written into the state, and the direction encodes the geometric intent, i.e., where the update drives the state. This decomposition provides a unified view of CUT3R and its variants, revealing that existing training-free extensions perform magnitude-only control: they can attenuate an unreliable update but cannot correct its direction. We propose HIST3R, a training-free framework built on CUT3R that controls both components using history. HIST3R rectifies the update direction using locally consistent historical states, and modulates the update magnitude according to the visual discrepancy between the current observation and its history, suppressing redundant updates while preserving complementary evidence. Across camera pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, and video depth estimation, HIST3R consistently improves long-horizon performance while retaining the memory footprint and inference speed of CUT3R. With 1000 input frames, it reduces ATE by 23.87% on ScanNet and 33.65% on TUM-Dynamics relative to the strongest competing method; with 500 frames, it improves median reconstruction accuracy over the strongest CUT3R-based variant by 56.52% on 7-Scenes and 33.96% on NRGBD.

</details>


### [199] [TIRAD: Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12023)
*Seongsu Lee,Seunghyun Oh,Seungjae Moon,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TIRAD：用文本残差（正常/异常状态的文本表征差异）门控图像残差特征的通用异常检测框架，在工业与工业→医学迁移上优于纯图像残差方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于残差的异常检测依赖图像表征的视觉差异，而可由语言显式表达的语义差异（正常与异常状态的文本对比）尚未被利用。

Method: 提出多模态残差学习框架：定义"文本残差特征"为正常与异常提示文本表征之差；Text Fusion Module 将 patch 级文本残差转换为门控，逐 patch 调制图像残差特征，保留文本判定为缺陷相关的视觉差异、抑制其余部分。

Result: 在工业异常检测基准及工业到医学的迁移实验中，性能超过以图像为中心的残差学习方法。

Conclusion: 文本引导的语义残差可有效增强残差特征的判别力，为通用异常检测提供多模态残差学习范式。

Abstract: Recent anomaly detection studies have shown that residual features, which model the discrepancy between normal and abnormal patterns, provide strong generalization to anomalies unseen during training. However, existing residual-based approaches mainly rely on visual discrepancies derived from image representations, while semantic discrepancies that can be explicitly expressed through language remain largely underexplored. To address this problem, we propose TIRAD, Text-guided Image Residual Learning for Generalist Anomaly Detection, a multimodal residual learning framework that defines the discrepancy between textual representations of normal and abnormal states as a Text Residual Feature and uses it to guide the Image Residual Feature. Specifically, a Text Fusion Module converts patch-level text residuals into a gate that modulates the image residual of each patch. The gate retains the visual discrepancies that the text residual identifies as defect-related and attenuates the others, leading to more discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments on industrial benchmarks and industrial-to-medical transfer demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing image-centric residual learning methods.

</details>


### [200] [Single Image Super-Resolution via Semantic Prompt and Cross-Modal Training on Content Area](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12025)
*Xiao Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将像素强度与语义信息（文本描述、空间定位）融合的超分辨率方法，含跨模态特征融合模块与Prompt Traction Head，以语义先验增强骨干网络细节恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN/Transformer超分模型擅长像素级增强，但忽略图像中的丰富语义上下文，导致细节恢复受限。

Method: 提取并编码语义数据（文本描述符+空间位置）；设计Cross-Modal Feature Fusion模块，通过多模态训练生成语义特征图；设计Prompt Traction Head将语义洞见注入骨干网络以精化图像细节。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验验证了方法的优越性（摘要未给出量化指标）。

Conclusion: 语义-像素联合建模可提升超分辨率细节恢复效果，跨模态语义引导是有效的超分增强范式。

Abstract: Enhancing image quality through super-resolution is crucial in image and video processing. While contemporary deep learning models, such as CNNs and Transformers, excel in pixel-level enhancements, they often overlook the rich semantic context within images. To address this, we introduce a novel approach that synergizes pixel intensity with semantic information for superior detail recovery. Our method involves extracting semantic data, including textual descriptors and spatial positioning, and encoding this information. We also present a Cross-Modal Feature Fusion module for generating semantic feature maps via multimodal training, and a Prompt Traction Head to augment the backbone network with semantic insights, thereby refining image details. Our empirical results across various datasets validate the superiority of our approach.

</details>


### [201] [SAFE-Hair: Scalp-Anchored Fields for Exportable Single-View Hair Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12037)
*Yucheng Wang,Zedong Wang,Yuetong Wu,Yue Ma,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SAFE-Hair从单张肖像重建可直接用于梳理/编辑/仿真的显式发丝资产：在规范头皮UV域上，用条件Rectified Flow生成潜在头皮场，在固定毛囊集合解码占据、段方向、长度分配与总长，并引入附着/碰撞/弯曲先验；同时提出HairBench-3D基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有单视图3D头发重建方法多追求视觉合理性，输出难以直接用于grooming、编辑或仿真管线。作者希望获得具有毛囊ID、发根固定在头皮、可导出的显式发丝资产，并缺少同时评估重建精度与资产可用性的基准。

Method: 以拟合的模板头部为参照，将自监督图像特征投影到头皮；用条件Rectified Flow模型生成潜在头皮场；在固定毛囊集合上解码occupancy、分段方向、长度分配与总长，从构造上保证发丝根植于头皮并支持毛囊ID与guide-family元数据导出；加入attachment、collision、bending三种先验提升几何有效性，无需逐受试者测试时优化；构建HairBench-3D，统一对齐、渲染、重采样，并定义几何、方向一致性、不可见区域补全、轮廓一致性、碰撞等指标。

Result: 相较最强基线：Chamfer距离由3.74 mm降至3.28 mm，F-score由77.9提升至81.7，不可见区域F-score由66.1提升至69.8，穿透比例由4.8%降至3.9%。

Conclusion: 将头发重建表述为规范头皮UV毛囊域上的生成式解码，可在单视图条件下直接产出具备拓扑身份的发丝grooms，兼顾几何有效性与下游可编辑性；配套基准为资产级评估提供了标准化协议。

Abstract: Single-view 3D hair reconstruction has progressed rapidly, but many methods optimize for visual plausibility rather than producing strand assets that can be directly used in grooming, editing, or simulation pipelines. We propose SAFE-Hair, a framework that reconstructs explicit strand grooms from a single portrait by decoding hair from persistent follicles in a canonical scalp-UV domain. Given a fitted template head, SAFE-Hair projects self-supervised image features onto the scalp, uses a conditional Rectified Flow model to generate latent scalp fields, and decodes occupancy, segment directions, length allocation, and total length at a fixed set of scalp follicles. This representation enforces scalp-rooted strand identities by construction and enables direct export with follicle IDs and guide-family metadata. We further introduce attachment, collision, and bending priors to improve geometric validity without per-subject test-time optimization. To evaluate both reconstruction fidelity and asset usability, we introduce HairBench-3D, a benchmark built from public 3D hair assets with standardized alignment, rendering, resampling, and metrics for geometry, direction consistency, invisible-region completion, silhouette agreement, and collision. SAFE-Hair improves Chamfer distance from 3.74 mm to 3.28 mm, F-score from 77.9 to 81.7, invisible-region F-score from 66.1 to 69.8, and penetration ratio from 4.8% to 3.9% over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [202] [Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12040)
*Wentao Wu,Xiao Wang,Yi Wang,Chenglong Li,Yonghong Tian,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CM3AE 2.0统一RGB帧与事件体素/帧的多模态预训练框架，通过事件引导的时空掩码重建与分层跨模态生成（扩散模型RGB生成+视频级文本生成）学习跨模态依赖，在四个下游任务上稳定涨点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB与事件相机模态互补，但缺乏能同时建模多模态时空表征与潜在跨模态依赖的统一预训练范式；现有方法对模态交互与生成式互监督利用不足。

Method: 1）Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR)：用事件响应对动态显著区域引导掩码，在连续RGB-Event观测上做时空掩码重建，并融合多模态重建与跨模态对比学习；2）Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG)：视觉层用预训练扩散模型做事件条件RGB生成，语言层用联合RGB-Event表征生成视频级文本描述。

Result: 在四个多样化下游任务上均取得一致性能提升，验证预训练框架的有效性与泛化性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 事件感知掩码+分层跨模态生成是有效的统一多模态预训练范式，可迁移到多类下游视觉任务。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose CM3AE 2.0, a unified RGB Frame and Event-Voxel/-Frame pre-training framework. By jointly learning multimodal spatiotemporal representations and exploiting latent cross-modal dependencies through cross-modal generation, the framework enhances multimodal information interaction and collaborative modeling capabilities. Specifically, we first propose an Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR) strategy to learn unified multimodal spatiotemporal representations. It leverages event responses to guide masking toward dynamically salient regions. Through spatiotemporal masked reconstruction, it learns spatial structures and their temporal variations from continuous RGB-Event observations. In addition, it incorporates multimodal fusion reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning to facilitate the modeling of cross-modal complementary information and the learning of shared representations. Building upon this, we further propose a Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG) strategy to learn latent cross-modal dependencies through visual and language generation. At the visual level, Event-conditioned RGB generation is performed using a pre-trained diffusion model to capture visual associations between the two modalities. At the language level, video-level text description generation based on joint RGB-Event representations establishes connections between multimodal visual features and linguistic semantics, further enriching the learning of cross-modal dependencies. Extensive experiments on four diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that CM3AE 2.0 consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed pre-training framework.

</details>


### [203] [Four-Step Text-Bearing Image Generation via Distillation with Local Response Regularization and Teacher-Guided Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12042)
*Kairui Wen,Sheng Ye,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出四步蒸馏框架（局部响应正则化+路径长度惩罚+教师引导文本训练），在保持GLM-Image DiT自回归视觉先验、字形编码器与VAE的前提下加速文字图像生成，1.742s出图、3.34倍加速且显存不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文字图像生成需同时保证场景连贯与字符准确，多步去噪采样成本高；少步蒸馏虽降本，但学生模型需在极短轨迹内完成场景组织与字形精修，易损失文本保真度。

Method: 基于分布匹配蒸馏GLM-Image DiT：1) 路径长度惩罚促使条件去噪场局部响应一致；2) 渐进式训练，将合成字符串与教师生成图像混合以兼顾字符准确与场景融合排版；3) 系数消融确定正则权重1e-5；并在Qwen-Image上验证泛化。

Result: 四步学生模型GenEval Overall 0.84、CVTG-2K词准确率0.5045，对比四步TDM的0.81与0.1690；单图推理1.742s vs 教师5.818s，3.34倍加速，显存同为40GB。

Conclusion: 局部响应正则化与教师引导文本训练可显著缓解少步蒸馏中的字形退化，实现近教师质量的高效文字图像生成；属生成模型加速的通用CV工作。

Abstract: Generating text-bearing images requires coherent scenes and accurate characters. Large text-to-image models improve both capabilities through repeated denoising, at substantial sampling cost. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but requires the student to organize scenes and refine glyphs within a short trajectory. We present a four-step distillation framework combining local response regularization with teacher-guided text training. Built on distribution matching, the framework distills the GLM-Image DiT while retaining its autoregressive visual prior, glyph encoder, and VAE. A path-length penalty promotes consistent local responses of the conditional denoising field. Progressive training combines synthetic strings with teacher-generated imagery to preserve character accuracy and scene-integrated typography. The student achieves GenEval Overall 0.84 and CVTG-2K word accuracy 0.5045, compared with 0.81 and 0.1690 for four-step TDM. A coefficient study favors $10^{-5}$, and Qwen-Image experiments show additional gains from response regularization and text supervision. Single-image inference takes 1.742 s, compared with 5.818 s for the teacher, yielding a $3.34\times$ speedup at the same 40 GB GPU memory requirement.

</details>


### [204] [Attention-Guided Sequence Feature Fusion and Mixed-Space Metric Learning for Cross-View Image Sequence Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12051)
*Nan Wu,Chunfang Yang,Jiangshan Li,Xiangyang Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ASML：用注意力引导的序列融合（SCF）、空间特征聚合（SFA）与Geo-InfoNCE度量学习实现跨视角地面图像序列↔卫星影像的地理定位，并发布CrossRoad-66K数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面图像序列虽有互补信息，但相邻帧高度重叠导致特征冗余；常规融合（均值/拼接）会削弱跨视角匹配所需的空间关系，且难区分地理上接近的难负样本。

Method: 1) Sequential Content Fusion (SCF)：建模跨帧特征相关性，抑制冗余、保留地理上有信息量的非重叠区域；2) Spatial Feature Aggregation (SFA)：聚合局部特征的空间与语义信息以维持序列空间布局；3) Geo-InfoNCE损失：联合特征距离与地理距离的混合空间度量学习，增强难负样本判别；构建 CrossRoad-66K 序列数据集（更复杂场景）。

Result: 在SeqGeo与CrossRoad-66K上R@1分别较SOTA提升3.37%与2.10%，并给出大量实验与可视化。

Conclusion: 注意力引导的序列融合+几何感知度量学习能有效缓解序列冗余并提升跨视角序列定位精度；新数据集补充了复杂道路场景基准。

Abstract: Cross-view image sequence geo-localization aims to determine the geographic location of a sequence of ground images by matching it against geo-tagged satellite imagery. Although sequential observations provide complementary scene information, substantial overlap between adjacent images introduces feature redundancy, while conventional fusion strategies may weaken spatial relationships essential for cross-view matching. Therefore, we propose a cross-view image sequence geo-localization method via Attention-guided Sequence fusion and Metric Learning (ASML). Specifically, a Sequential Content Fusion (SCF) module models cross-image feature correlations to suppress redundant content and adaptively preserve geographically informative non-overlapping regions. Next, a Spatial Feature Aggregation (SFA) module is used to capture and aggregate the spatial and semantic information of local features, so as to maintain the spatial layout of the image sequence. Finally, a Geo-InfoNCE loss function is proposed, which comprehensively considers the feature distance and geographic distance for mixed-space metric learning, thus improving the ability of the model to distinguish hard negative samples. A new cross-view image sequence dataset CrossRoad-66K is established to provide more complex scenarios. Extensive experiments and visualizations on the SeqGeo and CrossRoad-66K datasets demonstrate that compared to state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, the proposed method ASML achieves an improvement of 3.37% and 2.10% at R@1, respectively.

</details>


### [205] [Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12066)
*Maximilian Lindholz,Richard Ruppel,Annette Milnik,Sebastian Halskov,Semil Eminovic,Charlie A. Hamm,Robin Schmidt,Anika Knupfer,Jana Hutter,Johanna P. Müller,Carolina Dominguez Aleixo,Jawed Nawabi,Jens Vogel-Claussen,Tobias Penzkofer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 weight-space programming (WSP)：让 LLM（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra）在无数据、无工具、无图像的情况下直接写出小型 LeNet 式 CNN 的全部权重，用于医学图像分类，并与零样本 MedSigLIP 及 Adam 训练同架构网络对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分类器通常依赖昂贵且常不可得的标注数据；作者想探究 LLM 是否能仅凭医学知识“凭空”写出分类器参数，从而规避训练数据依赖。

Method: 在权重空间编程范式下，两个 LLM 单次回复即生成小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的权重与偏置（无优化、无工具调用、无图像输入）；在 4 种模态 7 个任务（MedMNIST 的胸片、乳腺超声、腹部 CT 共 6 个任务 + SynthUterus 盆腔 MRI）上测试，基线为零样本 MedSigLIP 与用 256 张标注图经 Adam 训练的相同架构。

Result: LLM 写出网络在 6 个 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机，平均测试 AUC 为 Opus 0.719、Astra 0.711；二者在 5/6 任务上超过 MedSigLIP 且参数量少逾 10⁴ 倍；但仅用 256 张图 Adam 训练的同架构在每个任务上更优（平均 AUC 0.828）。SynthUterus 上 Opus 达 0.764，Astra 因系统性错误低于随机（0.136）。

Conclusion: LLM 能写出可用的医学分类器权重，但远不能替代训练数据；报告显示模型间差异显著且存在系统性失效，需谨慎对待“零数据”泛化能力。

Abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at this https URL .

</details>


### [206] [MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12069)
*Dennis Menn,Tianpei Gu,Guande He,Aryan V S,Yanke Song,Nan Liu,Desai Xie,Xun Huang,Chenfeng Xu,Diana Marculescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MPEG-Diffusion 通过双分辨率注意力、混合分辨率解码器和自选 HR 区域三项设计，解决视频 DiT 混合分辨率生成的三大根因，仅处理 30% 全分辨率 token 即可在 Wan2.1 14B 上提速 4.8×，且质量接近全分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）生成视频逼真但计算开销巨大，限制实际部署。混合分辨率（HR 关键区域 + LR 其余区域）可降本，但现有方法在视频上质量严重退化，且需预先给定 HR 区域位置。

Method: 指出失败源于三个根因并提出对应设计：(1) dual-resolution attention，每个 query 只读取自身分辨率的 K/V，缓解"混合分辨率诅咒"；(2) mixed-resolution decoder，在解码前融合 HR 与 LR latent 以消除畸变；(3) 利用 DiT 自身知识自选视觉重要区域，无需事先指定 HR 位置。

Result: 仅处理 30% 全分辨率 token，去噪加速 4.8×（Wan2.1 14B）与 3.8×（1.3B），在几乎全部指标上优于先前方法；用户研究中 90% 以上成对比较中优于已有混合分辨率方法，评分接近全分辨率。

Conclusion: 混合分辨率视频生成的质量损失并非本质问题，通过针对根因的架构与解码设计可同时获得大幅加速与接近全分辨率的视觉质量，为该方向的效率优化提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. We show that these failures are not inherent to mixed resolution, and propose $\textbf{MPEG-Diffusion}$ to address their three root causes: (1) dual-resolution attention to mitigate the curse of mixed resolution, where each query reads the K/V of its own resolution, (2) a mixed-resolution decoder to blend the HR and LR latents before decoding and resolve distortion, and (3) a self-selected HR region using the DiT's knowledge to find the visually important region without requiring it in advance. Processing only $30\%$ of full-resolution tokens, MPEG-Diffusion speeds up denoising by $4.8\times$ on Wan2.1 14B ($3.8\times$ on 1.3B), outperforming prior methods on nearly every metric. In the user study, we demonstrate the high quality of MPEG-Diffusion, with raters preferring it over prior mixed-resolution methods in over $90\%$ of pairs and rating it close to full resolution.

</details>


### [207] [Color wave: A systematic evaluation of active screen illumination for injection attack detection in remote face authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12070)
*Daniyar Kurmankhojayev,Elmurat Nigmatov,Dmitrii Gordin,Andrei Shadrikov,Mikhail Shkorin,Danijar Gabdullin,Vyacheslav Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文将主动屏幕光照（color wave）方法用于远程人脸认证中的注入攻击检测（IAD），按静态图、预录视频、实时deepfake三类注入内容分类，并建立系统性IAD评估协议，考察检测有效性、跨工况泛化、信号退化鲁棒性与典型规避策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程人脸认证需同时防御呈现攻击与生物特征注入攻击。主动屏幕光照因引入随机视觉刺激并分析面部响应，对两类攻击均有潜力，但现有研究多集中于PAD，对IAD缺乏系统评估。

Method: 先依据对挑战信号的预期响应将注入内容分为静态图像、预录视频、实时deepfake三类；将主动屏幕光照方案实现为"color wave"，并设计针对注入攻击的评估协议，覆盖检测效果、跨操作条件泛化、信号退化鲁棒性及选定规避策略的可利用性。

Result: 受控条件下呈现强判别信号；但在过曝光、低屏幕亮度与受试者运动条件下性能下降，并对部分规避策略存在脆弱性。

Conclusion: 通过将检测结果与攻击类型及操作条件关联，给出主动屏幕光照作为IAD机制何时成功、为何失败的可解释评估。

Abstract: Remote face authentication requires protection against both presentation attacks and biometric data injection attacks prior to face matching. Methods based on active screen illumination appear promising for both by introducing randomized visual stimuli through the user's device screen and evaluating the corresponding facial responses. Although such methods have been more studied for presentation attack detection (PAD), their systematic evaluation for injection attack detection (IAD) remains limited. To address this gap, we first classify injected content into static images, prerecorded videos, and real-time deepfakes based on their expected responses to the challenge. We then adapt an active screen-illumination approach into an implementation we term color wave and develop a systematic, injection-specific evaluation protocol. The protocol examines detection effectiveness, generalization across operating conditions, robustness to signal degradation, and susceptibility to selected evasion strategies. The findings demonstrate a strong discriminative signal under controlled conditions but also reveal performance limitations under overexposure, low screen brightness, and subject motion, as well as vulnerabilities to selected evasion strategies. By relating detection outcomes to attack types and operating conditions, this study provides an interpretable assessment of when and why active screen illumination succeeds or fails as an IAD mechanism.

</details>


### [208] [How a Model's Architecture and Performance Influences Explainability: A Study of Grad-CAM and CRAFT in CNN-Based Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12075)
*Kilian Göller,Haadia Amjad,Steffen Seitz,Carsten Knoll,Ronald Tetzlaff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 系统性研究了CNN模型精度提升与架构复杂度对两类XAI方法（Grad-CAM与CRAFT）在Faithfulness、Correctness、Sensitivity、Simplicity四项指标上的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险场景需可信XAI，但鲜有工作系统分析模型精度和架构复杂度如何影响解释质量。

Method: 在10个ImageNet-1K子集（各80类）上训练VGG16、ResNet50、ConvNeXt-Tiny，每个模型取10个逐步升高的精度checkpoint，用Grad-CAM与CRAFT两种XAI方法在四类指标上评估。

Result: 随训练推进，复杂架构（ResNet50、ConvNeXt-Tiny）Faithfulness提升、Sensitivity下降，解释更鲁棒；VGG16给出更简单但faithfulness与correctness较低的归因。

Conclusion: 模型精度与架构复杂度显著影响解释质量，XAI评估需结合模型状态与容量进行条件化分析。

Abstract: Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), are widely adopted in computer vision, yet their opaque decision-making raises concerns in high-risk applications like healthcare and autonomous systems, where trust and accountability are critical. Therefore, robust explainable AI (XAI) methods are desirable to provide transparent insights into model decisions. To ensure these methods are reliable and effective across diverse scenarios, it is important to understand how model performance and architectural complexity influence explanation quality. Our study takes an initial step toward systematically investigating the impact of these two factors on key XAI evaluation metrics. We constructed a pipeline using 10 subsets of ImageNet-1K, each containing 80 unique classes, on each of which we trained three CNN architectures of increasing structural complexity: VGG16, ResNet50, and ConvNeXt-Tiny. For each individual model, we analyzed 10 training checkpoints representing increasing levels of model accuracy using two XAI methods: Grad-CAM (feature-attribution-based) and CRAFT (concept-based). We assessed these methods across four evaluation categories: Faithfulness, Correctness, Sensitivity, and Simplicity. Our findings reveal that as training progresses, the complex architectures (ResNet50 and ConvNeXt-Tiny) exhibit improved Faithfulness and lower Sensitivity, indicating more robust explanations. In contrast, VGG16's simpler architecture yields simpler but less faithful and correct explanations.

</details>


### [209] [Compass 1: Towards Open-World and Persistent Embodied Navigation from Monocular RGB Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12087)
*Hai Zhang,Siqi Liang,Yanjun Guo,Shoufeng Zhang,Yunhao Wang,Hangyu Du,Haoguang Mai,Hongchen Li,Jiazhi Yang,Jialong Zeng,Yu Hu,Chen Chen,Gangcheng Jiang,Zishun Zhuo,Lirui Zhao,Zhigang Li,Yu Qiao,Zhenjie Yang,Fu Zhang,Hongyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Compass 1：首个统一语言理解与视频生成、支持近2分钟视觉历史回溯的具身导航基础模型，通过History Representation与History Utilization实现长时程稳定导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有导航架构仅能利用最近少数帧，难以同时维持持续空间感知与长时程执行稳定性；需在不改动基础架构的前提下，为模型注入长时程时空记忆并有效利用该记忆。

Method: 提出History Representation：稀疏视觉关键帧 + 显式History Representation Map，在原有架构上无需修改即保留长期时空上下文；提出History Utilization：包含任务阶段定位、探索一致性、时空目标检索三类任务的结构化VQA监督协议，实现基于地图的推理；构建单目RGB视频标注流水线，开源500+小时真实交互数据与2000+小时带标注网络视频。

Result: 开放世界评测总体成功率79.4%（最强基线17.8%）；基础任务零样本执行超90%，探索能力提升250%，持久历史回溯从0%提升至58%；在1m相机高度分布上训练，可泛化至0.35m轮式机器人、0.5m四足、0.85m人形、1.5m无人机及室内至行人密集街道场景。

Conclusion: 以关键帧记忆+显式历史地图+结构化VQA监督的组合，可在不改架构条件下显著提升长时程具身导航的稳定性与跨本体验证，并配套大规模标注数据（含机器人本体与真实场景泛化证据）。

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to achieve persistent spatial awareness and long-horizon execution stability in open-world environments. However, existing navigation architectures struggle to sustain both capabilities, remaining effective only over a handful of recent frames. We present Compass 1, the first embodied navigation foundation model to unify language understanding and video generation while enabling memory backtracking through nearly 2mins of visual history. Without altering the underlying architecture, we introduce History Representation, which integrates sparse visual keyframes with an explicit History Representation Map to preserve long-term spatiotemporal context. To effectively leverage this history, we further introduce History Utilization, a structured VQA supervision protocol comprising three categories: task-stage grounding, exploration consistency, and spatiotemporal target retrieval, enabling map-grounded reasoning and stable persistent long-horizon navigation. To fuel this system, we establish a complete annotation pipeline for monocular RGB videos and open-source a massive dataset featuring over 500 hours of high-quality real-world interactions and over 2,000 hours of annotated web videos. Trained mainly on the distribution of 1m height camera, Compass 1 generalizes seamlessly across diverse embodiments and scenarios, ranging from indoor environments to pedestrian-dense streets, spanning wheeled robot at 0.35m, quadruped dog at 0.5m, humanoid at 0.85m, and aerial drone at 1.5m. Compass 1achieves a dominant overall success rate of 79.4% across open-world evaluations, compared to 17.8% for the strongest baseline. It demonstrates exceptional zero-shot execution exceeding 90% on foundational tasks, a 250% boost in exploration, and an unparalleled leap from 0% to 58% in challenging persistent history backtracking.

</details>


### [210] [RAPA: Ray-Aware Physics Augmentation for Robust Camera-LiDAR Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12129)
*Kyung-Rin Oh,Ji-Hoon Kim,TaeJoon Ha,Jae-Sang Hyun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出射线感知物理增强(RAPA)，将标定板定位转为LiDAR反射率柱状图的2D检测问题，用单次观测合成多样样本，提升检测器鲁棒性，实现仅需单个标注样本的自动化LiDAR侧标定板定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 棋盘格相机-LiDAR标定中，LiDAR点云稀疏导致3D角点特征提取不可靠；现有方法依赖人工标注3D角点或几何特征提取，在观测不足时失效，且深度检测器缺乏标注训练数据。

Method: 把标定板定位重构为柱状LiDAR反射率图像上的2D目标检测；提出射线感知物理增强(RAPA)，基于单次标定板观测物理地合成多样样本（建模射线入射角、距离、反射率等），用于训练并增强检测器在多种传感条件下的泛化能力。

Result: 在四个独立采集的室内外场景中，RAPA的mAP@0.5比最强图像空间增强基线高16.1-43.1个百分点；在242次观测上，返回检测中96.4%得到有效标定板位姿，数量上为无训练目标类方法中最优；可靠定位支持四个场景的下游相机-LiDAR标定。

Conclusion: RAPA以单张标注观测实现自动化LiDAR侧标定板定位，解决了基于目标标定的关键瓶颈，可作为数据高效感知增强的可迁移范式。

Abstract: Camera-LiDAR calibration is essential for reliable perception in robotic and autonomous systems. Most target-based calibration methods rely on checkerboard observations, but accurate checkerboard feature extraction from LiDAR point clouds remains challenging due to measurement sparsity. Existing approaches either require manual annotation of 3D corners or depend on geometric feature extraction methods, both of which can become unreliable when checkerboard features are insufficiently observed. In this paper, we formulate checkerboard localization as a 2D detection problem using cylindrical LiDAR reflectivity images. To overcome the limited availability of labeled training data, we propose ray-aware physics augmentation (RAPA), which generates diverse synthetic samples from a single checkerboard observation. The generated data are used to improve detector robustness and generalization under varying sensing conditions. Across four independently captured indoor and outdoor locations, the proposed synthetic augmentation exceeds the strongest evaluated image-space augmentation baseline by 16.1-43.1 percentage points in mAP@0.5. Compared with training-free target-based methods on 242 observations, RAPA yields the largest number of valid target localizations, with 96.4% of its returned detections yielding valid target poses. These reliable localizations support downstream camera-LiDAR calibration across all four evaluated locations. Overall, RAPA addresses a key bottleneck in target-based calibration by enabling automated LiDAR-side target localization with only a single annotated target observation.

</details>


### [211] [DisasterVL: Evidence-Based Visual Reasoning Dataset and Model for Disaster Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12144)
*Ali Diba,Aisha Al-Mohannadi,Yin Yang,Muhammad Imran,Ferda Ofli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DisasterVL发布120万张灾害影像、2500万条证据对齐标注的基准，9B DisasterVLM在描述/VQA/定位上超通用基线，但文本指标增益大于证据得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害影像缺乏证据可溯的推理基准，现有VQA/描述任务与视觉证据脱节，难以评估模型是否基于可观察线索作答。

Method: 构建DisasterVL数据集：约120万张来自142个国家的影像，配2500万条结构化标注（场景描述、事件与地点判断、空间关系、VQA），VQA答案链接可见证据并含缺失线索问题、多答案格式与难度标签；区域级标注把描述短语绑定到框与空间关系。测试集38,254张影像，覆盖75国28类灾害，Gemini 3.1 Pro审计加人工分层验证；基于该基准训练9B DisasterVLM。

Result: DisasterVLM（9B）在图像描述、开放式VQA、事件推理与区域级定位上优于所评测的通用基线；且文本重叠类指标（如CIDEr等）提升幅度大于证据一致性得分提升，提示证据可溯性仍为瓶颈。

Conclusion: 提供了大规模、证据对齐的灾害视觉推理基准与领域模型，但本质为数据集/基准工作，缺乏新方法洞察，对物理AI核心方向（VLA、世界模型、3D重建、具身导航）关联度低。

Abstract: We introduce DisasterVL, a dataset and benchmark for evidence-grounded reasoning about disaster imagery. It contains approximately 1.2 million images from 142 countries, paired with 25 million structured annotations covering scene captions, incident and location assessments, spatial relationships, and visual question answering (VQA). The VQA annotations link answers to visible evidence and include questions about both present and absent cues, multiple answer formats, and difficulty labels. Region-level annotations link caption phrases to bounding boxes and spatial relationships to the regions they connect. The test set contains 38,254 images spanning 75 countries and 28 hazard types. Gemini 3.1 Pro audited the test annotations, and human reviewers validated a stratified subset. On this benchmark, the 9B DisasterVLM model outperforms the evaluated general-purpose baselines on captioning, open-ended VQA, incident reasoning, and region-level grounding. Gains in text overlap are larger than gains in evidence scores. We plan to publicly release the dataset, trained models, and code.

</details>


### [212] [EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12149)
*Xiaozhi Zhang,Changjia Xu,Yaoyuan Yan,Haoxiang Jie,Bingjie Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoLabel：零样本组合现成模型的自我中心自动标注流水线，提供跨模态配准与一致性诊断；每手深度锚定使手-深度残差中位数均值降低23%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心自动标注需深度、相机位姿、物体与人体姿态在相互独立开发的模型间几何一致，但单位、坐标系与尺度差异会导致各模型单独看似合理、联合却几何矛盾。作者希望在无目标域标注下暴露并量化这些不一致。

Method: 零样本流水线：MonST3R 提供几何/深度与相机位姿；LocateAnything + GMC-BoT-SORT + SAM 2 处理物体；V-HPOT 估计手部；FisheyeViT 作全身兼容性演示。加入显式跨模态配准与一致性诊断，并提出按手部单独的深度尺度锚定（对比单一全局尺度）。H2O 序列上以传感器深度为主评测，另用 RGB 序列测相机 ATE（Sim(3) 对齐后）。

Result: 20 个序列上，每手深度锚定将各序列手-深度残差中位数的均值相对单一全局尺度降低 23%，汇总中位数 84.6 mm（真值参考 20.5 mm）；手部 PA-MPJPE 14.53±1.29 mm，而绝对 MPJPE 达 119.1±31.3 mm；三条纯 RGB 序列相机 ATE 1.40±0.29 cm。作者还指出滑窗实现问题会使传感器初始化深度在优化中漂移，且残差与锚定共用同一深度图，故残余量衡量的是内部一致性而非独立精度。

Conclusion: 该工作刻画了零样本跨模型配准流水线的实用价值与当前局限：一致性可诊断、可改善，但绝对度量精度仍差，且自证性残差不能替代独立评测。属系统集成与诊断性工作，方法新颖度有限。

Abstract: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.

</details>


### [213] [CADMA: Capacity-Aware Coverage Decomposition for Generative Model Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12243)
*Debin Meng,Zheng Gao,Ziquan Liu,Yanran Li,Ioannis Patras,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CADMA框架，用局部容量匹配将几何覆盖与有效覆盖分离，为生成模型提供可区分mode dropping与mode collapse的多维覆盖率诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向recall的分布级评估指标将分布覆盖简化为几何覆盖，只给出单一聚合分数，既无法区分mode dropping与mode collapse，又会给覆盖很差的生成分布打出虚高分，削弱诊断价值与可解释性。

Method: CADMA通过真实样本与生成样本之间的local capacity matching衡量分布覆盖，将geometry-based coverage与effective coverage解耦，输出多维覆盖诊断量以量化模式缺失与模式坍缩。

Result: 在玩具数据、真实数据集与多种生成模型上的实验表明，CADMA的覆盖估计更可靠，对多样性失效给出的诊断信号更细粒度、更可解释，并缓解了几何类指标的过度乐观偏差。

Conclusion: 覆盖率评估应从纯几何覆盖转向考虑生成容量的有效覆盖，多维诊断指标能更准确地刻画生成模型的多样性失效模式。

Abstract: Evaluating generative models requires measuring not only sample fidelity but also how well a generated set covers the real data distribution. Recent work has therefore introduced recall-oriented metrics for distribution-level evaluation. However, existing recall metrics often reduce distributional coverage to geometry-based coverage. This simplifying assumption weakens their diagnostic value and interpretability in two ways: these metrics provide only a single aggregate score that cannot distinguish essential diversity failures such as mode dropping and mode collapse, and geometry-based coverage can provide unreliable estimates by assigning high scores to poorly covered generative distributions. We therefore introduce CADMA, a capacity-aware framework for recall-oriented evaluation and diagnosis. CADMA evaluates distributional coverage through local capacity matching between real and generated samples, separating geometry-based coverage from effective coverage. This yields multi-dimensional coverage diagnostics that quantify mode dropping and mode collapse while reducing the overly optimistic estimates produced by geometry-based metrics. Through extensive experiments on toy data, real-world datasets, and generative models, we show that CADMA provides more reliable coverage estimates and more fine-grained, interpretable diagnostic signals of diversity failures than existing metrics. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [214] [A forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models: an EFM3D case study for crime scene reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12259)
*Davidson Chisom Onwubiko,Shahana Bano,Carlos Francisco Moreno-García*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向法医场景的自我中心基础模型评估框架，并以EFM3D在四个模拟室内犯罪现场上做描述性测试，定位其为情境记录与复核的辅助工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何、语义与空间上下文融合的三维基础模型发展迅速，但其在法医犯罪现场重建中的适用性缺乏结构化评估方法。

Method: 用Meta Project Aria Gen 1在法医训练设施录制四个模拟室内犯罪现场，构建涵盖房间级重建、语义理解、计算性能与法医适用性的四维评估框架，并在一套七准则能力表上刻画EFM3D。

Result: 网格平均12,668±2,430顶点、24,838±4,903面，记录39,529条语义预测（21–24类，平均置信度0.40）；每场景最终推理1,388±203个snippet，吞吐0.69±0.01 samples/s，单次录制耗时50.77±6.12分钟。

Conclusion: 因缺少参考网格与专家标注3D真值，结果仅为描述性输出；EFM3D在房间几何、家具定位、场景语境与空间关系上较强，细尺度痕迹物证较弱，适合作补充性情境文档工具而非高保真取证采集的替代。

Abstract: Foundation models increasingly combine geometry, semantics, and spatial context for three-dimensional scene understanding, but their suitability for forensic crime scene reconstruction remains unclear. This study presents a structured forensic evaluation framework for egocentric foundation models and demonstrates it using the Egocentric Foundation Model for 3D (EFM3D). Four simulated indoor crime scenes were recorded with Meta Project Aria Gen~1 at Robert Gordon University's East Lodge House forensic training facility. The framework evaluates room-scale reconstruction, semantic scene understanding, computational performance, and forensic suitability. Across the four scenes, EFM3D generated meshes averaging $12{,}668\pm2{,}430$ vertices and $24{,}838\pm4{,}903$ faces, with 39,529 recorded semantic predictions spanning 21--24 categories at a mean confidence of 0.40. Because reference meshes and expert-labelled 3D ground truth were unavailable, these statistics are treated as descriptive outputs rather than measures of geometric or detection accuracy. Final inference runs processed $1{,}388\pm203$ snippets per scene at $0.69\pm0.01$ samples/s and required $50.77\pm6.12$ minutes per recording. A seven-criterion capability profile indicated stronger support for room geometry, furniture localisation, scene context, and spatial relationships than for fine-scale forensic evidence. The results position EFM3D as a complementary tool for contextual documentation and scene review rather than a replacement for high-fidelity forensic capture. The framework provides a reproducible basis for evaluating future egocentric foundation models in specialised forensic settings.

</details>


### [215] [HumanSightBench: A Benchmark for Human Visual Perception in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12305)
*Zixin Su,Yangguang Lin,Zegang Peng,Yuntong Sun,Xuanyi Wang,Jiahao Wang,Qiankai Xu,Bing Yuan,Jinze Bai,Youbin Wu,Jingjia Huang,Ruyang Liu,Yanxu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建 HumanSightBench：2,876 道人类易解、模型难答的视觉短答题基准，经五重纳入关卡过滤歧义与文本捷径，八款 MLLM 最佳 pass@3 仅 65.6%，Counting 子类均不超 27.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端评测混合了视觉感知、语言先验、背景知识、问题歧义与答案欠定义等多种因素，导致难以判断 MLLM 与人类视觉感知的真实差距，且单项题目有效性存疑。

Method: 提出"构造上人类可解、评测上模型困难"的设计准则；构建覆盖 7 个顶层感知类别、21 个子类别的 2,876 道短答视觉题；每题须通过五道纳入关卡：问题清晰性、答案唯一性、视觉可定位性、人类可解性、纯文本捷径过滤；错误定义为人机验证任务在指定接口下的错答。

Result: 八个评测 MLLM 中最佳 pass@3 为 65.6%；所有模型在 Counting 类别上均未超过 27.5%。

Conclusion: 该基准揭示了总体分数所掩盖的能力缺口，可指导后续训练实验与留出集评测，但本身为基准/数据集类工作，缺乏可迁移的方法洞见。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on knowledge-intensive and reasoning-based vision-language benchmark datasets, but still struggle to solve the visual questions that people can solve easily. Evaluating the differences between MLLMs and human-level visual perception is challenging due to end-to-end evaluation which combines various skills, or because we are uncertain if individual items are valid. Specifically, observed errors may reflect visual perception, language priors, background knowledge, question ambiguity, and underspecified answers. Our guideline for HumanSightBench is that we construct items that are human-easy by construction and model-hard by evaluation. HumanSightBench contains 2,876 visual questions with short answers across 7 top-level perceptual categories and 21 subcategories. We only include items that pass five inclusion gates: question clarity, answer uniqueness, visual grounding, human solvability, and text-only shortcut filtering. According to the protocol, errors are defined as incorrect answers on human-validated visual tasks with the evaluated interface. The inclusion gates are intended to reduce confounds from ambiguity and external knowledge. The best pass@3 score is 65.6% across eight evaluated MLLMs. No evaluated model exceeds 27.5% on Counting. These results identify capability gaps that are hidden by overall scores and can help future training experiments and held-out evaluation.

</details>


### [216] [TMT: Adapting CLIP to Infrared Imagery via Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12345)
*Ruofan Wang,Puzuo Wang,Xin Chen,Zibo Yu,Jungang Yang,Yi Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TMT，用文本嵌入差异定义的红外→可见方向引导 CLIP 图像编码器的跨模态知识迁移，仅依赖成对红外-可见图像，无需红外-文本标注，并结合扩散噪声预测提供生成-感知协同监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 等视觉-语言模型预训练数据以可见光为主，导致红外图像与文本的对齐不可靠；而红外-文本标注成本高，因此希望仅用成对红外-可见图像进行适配，同时既要保留场景内容与 CLIP 的图像-文本对齐能力，又要注入红外特有的模态知识。

Method: 发现模态差异可由对应文本嵌入之间的差异方向刻画，据此用文本嵌入差方向作为红外→可见的知识迁移方向，避免抹除红外特有信息；再引入 Generative-Perceptual Co-Supervision，将 CLIP 可见图像编码器的语义对齐监督与扩散模型的噪声预测反馈结合，增强红外图像的语义与细节表征。

Result: 在四个源域不重叠的红外分类基准上取得最高平均零样本准确率 48.92%；在不使用红外-文本监督的适配条件下取得对比方法中最优的红外-文本检索结果；在 CART 与 SemanticRT 上取得 CLIP 类方法中最高的开放词汇分割 mIoU。

Conclusion: 文本定义的模态方向可作为无红外-文本标注条件下跨模态知识迁移的有效引导，配合生成与感知双重监督，可在保持 CLIP 对齐能力的同时显著提升红外零样本分类、检索与开放词汇分割性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP achieve strong performance across computer vision tasks, yet their image-text alignment is less reliable for infrared (IR) imagery because large-scale pre-training is dominated by visible-spectrum data. Due to the high cost of the infrared-text labeling, we investigate adapting CLIP to IR through only paired infrared-visible images, which requires considering modality-specific knowledge while preserving scene content and CLIP's image-text alignment. To achieve this, we propose TMT (Text-Derived Modality Knowledge Transfer), which adapts CLIP's image encoder through a text-defined infrared-to-visible direction and supervision from paired IR-visible images. First, we found that modality discrepancy can be described by corresponding text embeddings, thus using the direction of text embedding differences to guide the knowledge transfer between visible and infrared modalities without erasing infrared-specific information. To enhance the representation of semantics and details of infrared images, we introduce Generative-Perceptual Co-Supervision that combines semantic alignment from CLIP visible image encoder with diffusion noise-prediction feedbacks. On four source-disjoint IR classification benchmarks, TMT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the compared methods (48.92%). It also achieves the best IR-text retrieval results among the compared methods without infrared-text supervision during adaptation and the highest open-vocabulary segmentation mIoU on both CART and SemanticRT among the CLIP-like methods.

</details>


### [217] [ReVMap: Vectorized Global Mapping via Connectivity-Aware Local Map Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12346)
*Hongjae Shin,Jungho Kim,Donghyuk Kwak,Myeongjun Kim,Seunghoon Yu,Jiyong Oh,Jun Won Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVMap：以逐点定位不确定性引入全局地图先验修正局部预测，并预测局部到全局连通性、做不确定性感知融合来选择性更新全局地图，迭代耦合局部预测与全局修订，在nuScenes/Argoverse 2上取得局部地图预测与全局建图双SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矢量化高精地图大规模标注昂贵，现有"局部预测→增量式全局建图"的自动标注方法忽略预测不确定性、依赖启发式拼接，易造成误差传播与拓扑不一致。

Method: 可靠局部-全局框架：①利用逐点定位不确定性将全局地图先验注入局部预测，提升对不准确先验的鲁棒性；②预测局部-全局连通性，并依据局部预测可靠度做不确定性感知融合，选择性更新全局地图；③迭代耦合局部预测与全局修订，逐步改善局部精度与全局一致性。

Result: 在nuScenes与Argoverse 2基准上，局部地图预测与全局地图构建均达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 不确定性建模与连通性引导的融合是抑制局部→全局自动标注误差累积、提升拓扑一致性的有效途径，可作为HD地图自动标注的可靠范式。
