Abstract: Large-scale annotation of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is labor-intensive and costly, motivating local-to-global auto-labeling approaches that incrementally construct global maps from local vectorized predictions. However, existing approaches often overlook prediction uncertainty and rely on heuristic map integration, potentially propagating errors and introducing topological inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose ReVMap, a reliable local-to-global framework that iteratively refines local map predictions and global map construction through uncertainty-guided prior utilization and connectivity-guided global map revision. Specifically, ReVMap leverages point-wise localization uncertainty to incorporate global map priors into local map prediction, improving robustness against inaccurate prior information. It then predicts local-to-global connectivity and selectively updates the global map through uncertainty-aware fusion based on the reliability of local predictions. By iteratively coupling local prediction and global revision, ReVMap progressively improves both local map accuracy and global map consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 benchmarks demonstrate that ReVMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both local map prediction and global map construction.

</details>


### [218] [QCC-WM: Linking Macro-State Dynamics and Visual Generation via Quotient Causal Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12353)
*Zhizhong Fu,Wei Zhou,Zhaoyang Jiang,Yudong Lin,Songlun Li,Zhi Li,Feifan Chen,Gaoming Li,Xiaorong Ding,Yifan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QCC-WM：以动作响应引导“因果抽象”构建宏观节点（quotient/reference 度量），在共享参考度量下递归预测节点内容与运动，并用节点级误差回传到对应空间区域校正视觉生成，实现宏观预测与生成观测的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界建模的关键难点：需从高维观测中构造支持动作条件下递归预测的宏观状态，同时保证预测状态的演化与生成观测的视觉变化一致。

Method: 提出 Quotient-based Causal Construction 的视觉世界模型：利用平移/旋转动作及其预测响应，将局部视觉特征经因果抽象聚合为具空间对应的宏观节点；用共享参考商（reference quotient）度量约束预测状态与观测变化的一致性；递归预测节点内容与运动，宏观预测约束未来生成，预测运动搬运历史外观信息；再将生成观测与宏观目标间的节点级误差映射回空间区域进行修正。

Result: US-VLA 数据集上四步预测 ROI-MSE 0.01861；相较各预测步长最优基线，四步预测 LPIPS 降低 48.59%，八步与十六步递归外推分别降低 41.68% 与 30.23%。消融显示运动引导的参考搬运主要提升像素重建，节点级误差反馈进一步改善感知质量与宏观-观测一致性。

Conclusion: 宏观节点 + 共享参考度量 + 误差回传的闭环设计可有效兼顾递归动作条件预测的长期一致性与生成视觉质量；两机制分工明确（重建 vs 感知一致性）。

Abstract: A key challenge in action-conditioned world modeling is to construct macro-states from high-dimensional observations that support recursive prediction under actions, while keeping their predicted evolution consistent with visual changes in generated observations. We propose QCC-WM, a visual world model based on Quotient-based Causal Construction. QCC-WM uses action responses to guide macro-variable construction for recursive action-conditioned prediction. A shared reference quotient measurement constrains the consistency between predicted states and observed changes, allowing macro-level predictions to provide structured constraints for future visual generation. Using translational and rotational actions and their predicted responses, the model aggregates local visual features into macro-nodes with spatial correspondence through causal abstraction, and recursively predicts node content and motion under a shared reference measurement. Macro-level predictions guide future observation generation, while predicted motion transports historical appearance information. Node-level errors between generated observations and macro-level targets are then mapped back to the corresponding spatial regions for correction, improving consistency between visual generation and macro-level predictions. On the US-VLA dataset, QCC-WM achieves an ROI-MSE of 0.01861 for four-step prediction. Compared with the best baseline at each prediction horizon, it reduces LPIPS by 48.59%, 41.68%, and 30.23% for four-step prediction and eight- and sixteen-step recursive extrapolation, respectively. Ablation studies and mechanism analyses show that motion-guided reference transport mainly improves pixel reconstruction, while node-level error feedback further improves perceptual quality and consistency between generated observations and macro-level predictions.

</details>


### [219] [TRIAD: Multimodal Retrieval across Abstraction, Constraints, and State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12364)
*Xiangyang Wu,Chen Ju,Xu Chen,Likang Peng,Jinsong Lan,Haihong Tang,Yang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRIAD是面向智能体式系统的多模态检索基准，含抽象层级、正负约束联合、跨对话轮次状态更新三个track，共6个子集，各1,000查询×1,000候选，用多正例mAP评测17个系统的20种配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向agentic系统的多模态检索请求常涉及跨层级关系、多约束组合与跨轮演化；高相似度结果仍可能违反用户要求，而检索内容会直接影响下游动作，现有基准缺乏对此类复杂、动态请求的评测。

Method: 构建TRIAD基准：(1) abstraction——视觉实例与不同层级概念的双向检索；(2) constraints——正负条件联合满足；(3) state——跨对话轮次需求整合与条件更新。每子集1,000查询、每查询固定1,000候选池，统一多正例mAP协议；配套更简单的参照任务与按违反需求分组的hard negatives以刻画具体检索难点；评测20种系统配置。

Result: 无任何系统在六个子集全面领先；性能随层级距离增大而下降；约束数量相同时纯负向查询普遍弱于纯正向查询；在表达同一最终意图的配对任务中，40个配置-领域对比里有39个多轮检索mAP更低；显式推理的收益因模型与任务而异。

Conclusion: 检索"相似内容"与"满足完整请求"之间存在显著差距，多轮演化与约束组合是当前多模态检索系统的薄弱环节，亟需针对性方法。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval increasingly supports agentic systems, where user requests can involve cross-level relations, combine multiple constraints, and evolve across dialogue turns. In these settings, a highly similar result may still violate the user's requirements, while retrieved content may directly inform downstream actions without human screening. We introduce TRIAD, a multimodal retrieval benchmark for evaluating how well retrieval systems satisfy these complex, evolving requests. TRIAD comprises three tracks: abstraction, testing bidirectional retrieval between visual instances and concepts at different hierarchical levels; constraints, testing the joint satisfaction of positive and negative conditions; and state, testing the integration of requirements across dialogue turns and the updating of earlier conditions when users revise their requests. The benchmark contains six subsets, each with 1,000 queries and a fixed pool of 1,000 candidates per query, evaluated using a common multi-positive mean average precision (mAP) protocol. Simpler reference tasks and hard negatives grouped by the requirements they violate help characterize specific retrieval difficulties. We evaluate 20 configurations of 17 systems and find that no system leads across all six subsets. Performance declines with hierarchical distance, and negative-only queries generally underperform positive-only queries with the same number of constraints. Across paired tasks expressing the same final intent, multi-turn retrieval yields lower mAP in 39 of 40 configuration-domain comparisons. The benefits of explicit reasoning also vary across models and tasks. These findings highlight the gap between retrieving similar content and satisfying a complete request.

</details>


### [220] [PTC-IoU: CPU-Friendly Detection Quality Estimation for Edge Video Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12405)
*Wei Geng,Hyerin Kim,Chang Lu,Zhenghao Lu,Joerg Ott*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PTC-IoU 将检测框历史压缩到 CPU 上做确定性评分，预测时序一致性 IoU，用于边缘视频分析中判断何时把帧升级到云端大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘端检测器只能给置信度分数，无法反映漏检与框定位错误；而运行时无真值可用，因此需要质量估计器来产生"是否需要升级到云端"的决策信号。神经网络估计器会与检测器争抢 GPU，而 CPU 通常仍有空闲算力。

Method: 提出 Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU：把历史检测框序列压缩为紧凑表示，在 CPU 上以确定性算法（基于时序一致性预测的 IoU 代理）给出结果质量评分，从而把估计负载从 GPU 迁移到 CPU。

Result: 在 Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano 上：单帧估计时延从神经网络方法的 10.3 ms 降至 2.2 ms（4.7 倍加速），流水线吞吐提升 13.6%，估计器能耗最多降低 95%，同时在多个数据集上最终检测质量与神经方法相当。

Conclusion: 用轻量确定性时序一致性评分替代神经质量估计器，可在几乎不损失检测质量的前提下显著降低时延、能耗并提升吞吐，适合资源受限边缘设备的级联式升级（cascade escalation）调度。

Abstract: An edge video analytics system must estimate the quality of local detections since there are no ground-truth labels available during runtime. Detectors usually provide confidence scores for their results, but these scores can not reveal every missed object or misplaced bounding box. So a quality estimator is necessary to provide a decision signal indicating which frame has potential detection failures that need to be escalated to a more powerful model in the cloud. Neural network based estimators add workload to the GPU already running detection, while CPU capacity may remain available. We present Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU (PTC-IoU), which moves this workload to CPU by compacting detection boxes histories to support deterministic result scoring. Comparing to neural counterparts, experiments on representative edge hardware, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, show that our method reduced per-frame estimator latency from 10.3 ms for neural counterparts to 2.2 ms (4.7x faster), increased pipelined throughput by 13.6%, and cuts estimator energy consumption by up to 95%, while maintaining competitive final detection quality verified on multiple datasets.

</details>


### [221] [PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12411)
*Harold Haodong Chen,Rui Peng,Lingteng Qiu,Kejie Qiu,Chao Xu,Zilong Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysOPSD，用可执行代码作为特权物理上下文，驱动On-Policy自蒸馏后训练视频生成模型，使其生成符合物理的动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型视觉保真度高但物理动力学脆弱；SFT存在离线状态失配，RL的物理奖励稀疏且定义不清；OPSD把问题转为核心的特权上下文设计，而文本提示是声明式的、参考视频把物理规律与外观纠缠且缺乏参数化控制。

Method: 以可执行代码替代静态视觉观察作为可编辑、可参数化控制的物理世界表示；构建PhysOPSD-Engine将真实物理场景转译为可验证仿真程序；采用(i)双层级物理特权，通过中间瓶颈弥合信息鸿沟；(ii)在共享rollout噪声下施加受控物理变化，暴露因果动力学差异。

Result: 在多种骨干网络上显著提升物理合理性，仅用3K样本即超越SFT与RL基线，同时保持通用视频生成质量。

Conclusion: 可执行代码是一种高效且可控的特权物理上下文模态，配合on-policy蒸馏可在小数据下有效改善视频模型的物理一致性。

Abstract: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

</details>


### [222] [dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12426)
*Xiaotong Li,Zhengrong Yue,Xu Huang,Jialv Zou,Minhao Jing,Wenhao Yan,Haodong Li,Hai Huang,Bo Zhao,Yan Feng,Peng Pei,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: dNaViT：基于冻结预训练编码器+轻量残差调制与双分支目标，生成原生分辨率的离散视觉token，用分组乘积量化在不增大序列长度的前提下扩展离散容量，作为统一离散视觉tokenizer兼顾理解与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散自回归建模（next-token prediction）是语言模型基石，若视觉也能用有限离散词表表示，则视觉与语言可统一到同一框架、共享方法与基础设施。核心问题：有限离散词表能在多大程度上表征视觉世界的丰富性。

Method: 构建于冻结预训练编码器之上，施加轻量残差调制（residual modulation）；采用双分支目标（重建感知 + 语义）将像素级线索注入语义特征；用分组乘积量化（grouped product quantization）扩展离散码本容量而不增加空间序列长度；配合平衡训练配方同时保留语义与像素信息，支持原生分辨率输入与高保真解码。

Result: 在12个视觉理解基准、4个生成基准和1个图像编辑基准上匹配或超越任务专用基线；单一离散tokenizer同时实现统一编码与高保真图像重建。

Conclusion: 紧凑离散词表可作为通用视觉"货币"，支撑完全统一的原生多模态方法论，说明离散视觉token路线具备可行性。

Abstract: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.

</details>


### [223] [Occupancy Modelling of Biased Landslide Inventories: When Does Separating Occurrence from Recording Improve on Neutralisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12437)
*Abdirashid Omar,Abdikadir Ugaas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将生态学占有-探测模型(occupancy-detection)引入滑坡易发性制图,把多个滑坡编录视为对同一事件的不完美观测者,分离"发生"与"记录"过程,并与传统偏差变量拟合并中性化(neutralisation)的方法作系统比较,给出基于交互间隙(interaction gap)的适用性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滑坡编录只记录"被看见"的滑坡而非"真实发生"的滑坡,道路等可达性造成抽样偏差;既有做法是拟合偏差描述变量并在制图时中和,但缺乏对其失效条件的定量刻画。

Method: 借鉴生态学占有-探测建模,把多份编录当作同一滑坡事件的不完美观测者,在潜变量框架下同时估计真实滑坡占有概率与各编录的探测(记录)概率;实验用2018北海道胆振东部、2015尼泊尔Gorkha、2010海地地震的近完备编录并人工注入报告偏差,另用三份真实Gorkha编录,并与基线及"锚定面积重缩放"基线对比;进一步提出可由偏差记录计算的交互间隙指标作为选择依据。

Result: 相比标准做法,占有模型在25组配对抽样中24组降低道路偏差;AUC在Gorkha提升0.08–0.14、海地0.03、胆振仅0.01–0.02;预测-真实滑坡率中位数0.99(范围0.44–1.89),基线为0.24–0.30,锚定重缩放可校正中位数但误差更大(0.20–4.34);单元级概率过度极端(校准斜率0.59)。与最优中性化模型相比,胆振AUC高0.03–0.07,Gorkha与海地反而低0.01–0.05;替换实验表明胆振优势源于其真实滑坡格局结构而非地形或路网。全部8个低交互间隙设定(含海地预注册检验)中中性化至少同样准确,高间隙并不保证占有模型占优;真实Gorkha编录呈坡度偏差而非道路偏差,故无实质增益。

Conclusion: 占有-探测建模可显著改善绝对滑坡率估计与道路偏差抑制,但对相对排序(AUC)的增益高度依赖真实滑坡格局结构与偏差类型;当交互间隙较低时应优先使用中性化,基于记录的滑坡目录仍是尚未检验的主要情形。

Abstract: Landslide susceptibility models are trained on inventories that record where landslides were seen, not where they occurred. The established remedy fits bias-describing variables and neutralises them when mapping. We adapt occupancy-detection modelling from ecology, treating several inventories as imperfect observers of one event and separating occurrence from recording, and ask when this improves on neutralisation. We use near-complete inventories of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi, 2015 Gorkha and 2010 Haiti earthquakes with simulated reporting bias, and three real Gorkha inventories. Compared with standard practice, the occupancy model reduces road bias in 24 of 25 paired draws and raises AUC by 0.08-0.14 on Gorkha and 0.03 on Haiti, but only 0.01-0.02 on Iburi. Its median predicted-to-true landslide rate is 0.99 (range 0.44-1.89), against 0.24-0.30 for the baselines. Rescaling the baselines with the same anchor area corrects their median but leaves larger errors (range 0.20-4.34). Cell-level probabilities remain too extreme (calibration slope 0.59). Compared with the best neutralised model, AUC is higher on Iburi (by 0.03-0.07) and lower on Gorkha and Haiti (by 0.01-0.05). Transplant experiments tie the Iburi advantage to the structure of its true landslide pattern, not to its terrain or road network. In all eight settings with a low interaction gap, computable from biased records, neutralisation was at least as accurate, including a prespecified test on Haiti; a high gap did not guarantee an advantage. The real Gorkha inventories are slope-biased, not road-biased, and there the model brings no meaningful gain. Report-based catalogues remain the main untested case.

</details>


### [224] [MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12443)
*Charbel Yahchouchi,Nabyl Quignon,Noemi Roggero,Laurent Saroul,Antitza Dantcheva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoSTE，一种基于时空混合专家（MoE）的CLIP参数高效适配框架，通过无监督token级路由让空间与时间专家池各自专精互补伪造线索，实现可泛化的深度伪造视频检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造伪影随篡改类型差异极大，且常混合多种时空不一致性；现有参数高效适配方法依赖单一共享表征，易产生篡改类型偏置，难以迁移到未见伪造类型。

Method: 在CLIP主干上做适配，将适配分解为并行的空间专家池与时间专家池；采用无监督的token级路由机制，动态把token分配给最相关专家，无需篡改标签或多阶段训练，即可将CLIP表征迁移至视频域并形成专家专业化。

Result: 在跨数据集与跨篡改基准上取得平均泛化性能的新SOTA，同时在各篡改类别上保持较强表现；专家路由与注意力分析显示专家多样性自发涌现。

Conclusion: 条件化、专家化的适配优于单一共享表征，是提升深度伪造检测泛化性的有效路径；MoSTE可学习到互补的时空取证特征，代码已开源。

Abstract: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [225] [LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12445)
*Yu Tang,Zhiyuan You,Zhixiao Wang,Fanghua Yu,Qingyu Zhang,Xiang Yin,Chao Dong,Jinjin Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LongSCOP：面向长视频外扩（out-painting）的自强制训练+潜空间校准+未来参考，配合VLM智能体从全视频中自动挑选信息量最大的参考帧，维持主体/场景/背景语义一致；并构建62K片段训练集与LVO-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频外扩研究集中于短视频，长视频外扩几乎空白。朴素的分块迭代外扩存在两类问题：块间不一致导致生成不稳定/误差累积，以及长时序上的语义漂移。

Method: 1) 提出三项训练配方保证长程平稳生成：self-forcing训练、潜空间校准（latent calibration）、未来参考帧（future references）；2) 设计基于VLM的智能体，从整段视频中自动选取最具信息量的参考帧，以维持主体、场景与背景一致；3) 构建62K高质量视频片段训练数据集；4) 提出由人类专家标注的LVO-Bench基准，评估长程稳定性与语义一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在生成稳定性与语义连贯性上均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 长视频外扩需同时解决跨块一致性与长程语义漂移；自强制训练+参考帧选择+VLM智能体驱动的信息帧检索是可行路径，配套数据集与基准可推动该方向研究。

Abstract: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.

</details>


### [226] [Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12477)
*Yongho Son,Junyeong Yun,Je Hyeong Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAR：面向多视角工业异常检测的重建框架，用特征扰动+一致性聚合生成视角一致的伪异常，为每视角配专属解码器，并在解码器中加傅里叶注意力防止恒等映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单视角重建式异常检测已很强，但多视角场景下重建方法研究不足；核心难点在于难以生成视角一致的伪异常（现有扰动往往产生跨视角不一致的异常表征）。

Method: 1) 特征扰动策略 + 共识聚合模块，跨视角整合扰动特征，抑制视角不一致异常、构造高对齐伪异常表征；2) 视角专用多解码器架构，每视角一个专用解码器，提升表征复杂度以生成局部化、可行度高的异常图，取代视角无关的粗糙重建；3) 解码器中引入傅里叶注意力，强调全局频域结构而非局部 token 证据，防止恒等映射。

Result: 在 Real-IAD 数据集上，样本级、图像级、像素级异常检测指标均持续优于 SOTA；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将重建式范式扩展到多视角时，关键在于伪异常的视角一致性与解码器的视角特化；频域注意力是防止重建退化的有效正则。方法为工业多相机检测提供可复用的设计范式，但验证仅限单一工业数据集，未涉及机器人/具身场景。

Abstract: Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection. First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [227] [MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12508)
*Ahmed Y. Radwan,Shaina Raza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MARS是一个双路径视频deepfake检测器：残差路径用固定的时空DoG算子作用于冻结中间特征建模多重尺度特征差，语义路径通过适配BN归一化参数进行帧级分类，clip级门控融合二者预测，在7个数据集上平均AUROC达91.43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪造痕迹随操纵方法与场景内容变化，跨面部操纵与全生成视频的泛化困难；显式时空特征差异虽能捕捉变化，但也会响应自然纹理与运动，因此需与外观特征联合解读。

Method: 两路径结构：(1) 残差路径对冻结的中间特征施加固定的空域与时域Difference-of-Gaussians算子，并跨帧结合外观上下文对特征差建模；(2) 语义路径适配编码器的归一化参数做帧分类；(3) 由clip相关的门控单元融合两路预测。另提供带符号的patch级与帧级贡献可视化。

Result: 统一协议下7个数据集平均AUROC 91.43%，优于7个对比检测器；仅在面部操纵数据上训练时，GenVideo达93.99%、DF26达75.50%，实现无生成视频训练数据的迁移；通过受控的空间/时间移除实验验证解释贡献的可信度；代码开源。

Conclusion: 将固定多尺度时空差分特征与自适应外观表示联合，可有效统一跨伪造类别的deepfake检测并具备跨类别迁移能力，同时提供可验证的局部解释。

Abstract: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: this https URL Github: this https URL

</details>


### [228] [EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12524)
*Jens Parslov,Marco Schouten,Dim P. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EditJudge-Bench：1,382 对 Blender 渲染的合成前后图像对，覆盖 9 类真实用户编辑请求，具备精确 3D 参数级 ground truth，用于把 VLM 判官作为二元校验器进行受控审计；发现 VIEScore 仅 69.0% AUROC、微调判官 51.7–66.3%、提示格式可造成 14.1 点波动，且判官排名与两个真实图像人类偏好基准强相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 已广泛被用作图像编辑基准的自动判官，但其可靠性缺乏系统理解。真实编辑图像缺少受控真值，且把"请求的修改"与"模型伪影""非预期副作用""模糊的成功程度"纠缠在一起，导致无法定位判官感知失败的具体来源。

Method: 用 Blender 渲染合成前/后图像对，编辑由已知 3D 场景参数干预生成，按真实用户请求归纳为 9 类编辑参数化，获得精确 ground truth；将判官任务定义为"指令是否被正确执行的二元校验"，从而把判官感知能力与编辑器质量解耦；共评测 25 种判官配置，并做与真实图像人类偏好基准的排名相关性分析。

Result: (a) 广泛采用的 VIEScore 模板搭配 GPT-4o 仅达 69.0% AUROC；(b) 微调判官仅 51.7–66.3%；旋转、形状等空间编辑仍然困难；(c) 图文顺序等提示格式选择可导致最高 14.1 个百分点波动；(d) 合成基准上的判官排名与两个真实图像人类偏好基准高度相关（ρ=0.95、ρ=0.71）。

Conclusion: 受控合成审计能暴露对真实评测同样适用的判官失效模式，为图像编辑评测中的 VLM-as-judge 提供了可诊断、可复现的替代基准。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($\rho$=0.95 and $\rho$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

</details>


### [229] [WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12557)
*Yuhang Chen,Jiheng Li,Jiale Wang,Zai Wang,Guangyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WanderBench：以单镜头视频为条件的动态世界模型探索基准（745段、三级难度、键盘相机路线、6维24项人工校验指标）；发现模型长序列下保持静态场景与画质却丢失相机控制与源动态、回访一致性全无；提出免训练WanderLand（逐帧条件于同一时刻源帧+回访时条件于自身早前静态内容），使5个模型全维度提升，源动态保真最高+8.3分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频条件的世界模型用于重拍、自由视点回放、real-to-sim 等场景时，rollout 必须忠实于被记录的真实世界；但现有基准从单图或文本出发，视频条件生成仅评估感知质量与相机跟随，无法直接衡量探索过程中主体身份、事件演进与回访场景一致性是否保持。因此需要一个专门的视频条件动态世界探索基准与配套改进方法。

Method: 构建 WanderBench：745 段真实与AI生成单镜头源视频，分3个难度档（3–25s），配有以键盘动作表示的相机路线，6个维度、24个经人工校验的子指标。评测8个模型。提出 WanderLand：训练无关框架，对冻结模型逐帧施加同一时刻源帧条件，并在回访位置额外以其自身早期生成的静态内容作为条件。

Result: 8模型评测显示：片段变长时静态场景与视觉质量尚可维持，但相机控制与源动态逐渐丢失；没有任何模型能保持回访地点的一致性。WanderLand 在5个模型上实现全维度提升，源动态保真度最高提升8.3分。

Conclusion: 视频条件世界模型的长程可控性与时序一致性（尤其回访一致性）是当前系统性短板；免训练、以同刻源帧+自身历史静态内容为重条件的推理期框架可跨模型稳定带来增益。基准与评估维度为视频条件世界模型提供了更贴合实际用途的评测角度。

Abstract: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

</details>


### [230] [GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12564)
*Isaac Xu,Devi Ayyagari,Martin Gillis,Benjamin Misiuk,Craig J. Brown,Thomas Trappenberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GHiML：从VLM中提取概念潜变量并生成样本相关字幕，将其文本嵌入经交叉注意力与逐节点门控路由与图像嵌入融合；同时提出基于图遍历距离与基数惩罚的inverted HML评分d_inv。在BenthicNet/FathomNet/iNaturalist上，门控路由较仅视觉基线宏F1最高+6.7pp、d_inv最高+21.1pp，分布漂移下仍有增益；消融显示文本主要影响预测基数而非节点判别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs权重中蕴含专家知识，但直接用于底栖生物等专门分类领域效果有限；此类领域训练的ViT多依赖颜色/纹理/形状等低层视觉隐变量，缺乏人类识别时的高层推理；且现有层次多标签评价指标对稀疏深层层次结构中的退化不敏感。

Method: 提出GHiML流程：以训练数据为条件从VLM抽取概念潜变量→生成基于这些变量的样本相关字幕→用交叉注意力与逐节点门控路由器（per-node gated router）将文本嵌入与图像嵌入融合；并引入inverted HML score d_inv，以图遍历距离加基数惩罚衡量层次多标签预测，作为可解释评价指标。

Result: 在BenthicNet、FathomNet、iNaturalist上，门控路由使域内底栖数据的宏F1提升最多6.7pp、d_inv提升最多21.1pp，且在分布偏移下增益保持。消融表明：多标签生物层次中去掉逐样本文本信号会使d_inv下降而宏F1不变（文本通过预测基数起作用）；单标签的iNaturalist则损失18.7%宏F1。

Conclusion: VLM中确实存在可被恰当引导利用的专门知识，在直接视觉学习不足的领域可增强分类性能；文本信号的作用机制更多体现在预测基数而非细粒度节点判别上。

Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

</details>


### [231] [Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12574)
*Rebeca Nam,Chase M. Fensore,Christian A. Fauria-Robinson,Judy Gichoya,Joyce C. Ho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文跨四个视觉语言模型、两个乳腺钼靶数据集，通过扰动提问、选项顺序与图像，系统评估答案—置信度—解释三者的一致性，指出仅凭准确率无法捕捉模型推理与答案自相矛盾的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 输出已从单一标签扩展到置信度与文字理由，但领域仍以准确率作为主要评价指标，无法反映输出之间是否自洽，而这直接决定 AI 答案可否被信任。

Method: 在乳腺密度与 BI-RADS 分类任务上对多个 VLM 做受控扰动实验（问题表述、多跳选项排列、图像替换），同时记录并比对答案、置信度与解释三项输出的变化。

Result: 图像被替换后模型置信度并未下降；打乱选项顺序会改变多数模型的答案；并存在模型自述推理与其最终答案相互矛盾的案例。

Conclusion: 需以一致性（答案/置信度/解释）补充纯准确率评估，作为可信医疗 VLM 的必要诊断维度。

Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.

</details>


### [232] [Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12624)
*Roman Pflugfelder,Michael Lindenbaum,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于单相机灰度图像序列的“去遮挡/重建”框架：通过联合配准与对比度最大化对齐多帧，将多帧平均得到“积分图像”作为被高密度碎片遮挡物体的重建表示，遮挡率>90%仍可重建并可用于分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉可透过枝叶等碎片化遮挡感知物体，而计算机视觉在此类高密度、碎片化遮挡下仍难以重建物体；合成孔径（synthetic aperture）方法虽有效但仅限静态物体且需复杂相机标定，故需要更通用的去遮挡重建方案。

Method: 输入单相机（可静止或运动）拍摄的运动物体灰度图像序列；联合估计帧间相对位姿，通过最大化平均图像（integrated image）的对比度来优化配准参数；该积分图像即作为重建结果，可用于下游分类。

Result: 在合成与真实视频序列上验证，遮挡密度超过90%仍可准确重建；性能与合成孔径技术相当（且无需复杂标定、不限于静态物体）；积分图像输入现成分类器可在严重遮挡下实现可靠分类。

Conclusion: 对比度最大化配准+多帧积分是一种无需标定、适用于高密度碎片遮挡的运动物体去遮挡重建方法，并可作为遮挡鲁棒分类的预处理表示。

Abstract: Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

</details>


### [233] [When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12657)
*Stefan Becker,Jens Bayer,David Münch,Wolfgang Hübner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文重新审视SAHI式切片推理，指出其收益主要来自分辨率效应，并提出覆盖率感知的稠密融合方法SCAHI，在VisDrone与DOTA上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 切片推理（如SAHI）被广泛用于高分辨率图像小目标检测，但其增益通常是与低分辨率基线对比得出的，作者希望将"尺度"作为显式变量，厘清何时切片真正有益，并弥补框融合（box fusion）丢弃瓦片互补信息的问题。

Method: 在VisDrone与DOTA上，跨四类检测器家族共七个稠密检测器，采用预注册假设、仅校准调参、留出测试集单次评估的严格实验协议；分析分辨率与切片的关系，并提出SCAHI：对全部推理通路的稠密输出按"每个图像位置总覆盖一致"的权重累加，并在足够精细的峰值网格上读取目标以分离拥挤近邻。

Result: VisDrone上，单次高分辨率推理在所有可高分辨率训练的检测器上均优于配框融合的切片，等算力下提升分辨率比增大模型更有效；SCAHI在相同推理通路上对所有YOLO检测器在两个数据集上均优于框融合，与FCOS持平；DOTA上2048px时切片+SCAHI比最佳单次推理高4.3–5.6 mAP50，仅替换SAHI合并步骤即提升2.3–4.0 mAP50；消融显示增益来自边界加权与峰值网格分辨率。

Conclusion: 切片收益需与分辨率收益解耦；当单次推理训练分辨率不足（如DOTA）时切片才有独特价值，此时用覆盖率一致的稠密融合比框融合更能利用瓦片互补信息。

Abstract: Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [234] [What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12674)
*Minheng Wu,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Kailun Yang,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文审计了12,031条PASCAL VOC 2012手工scribble标注，提出六种受控扰动算子（类篡改、空间偏移、方向扰动、笔画长度缩减、随机丢弃、碎片化），系统评测弱监督分割对语义与几何标注缺陷的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有scribble弱监督分割通常在固定标注集上评估，对语义错误与几何缺陷两类标注不完美的鲁棒性缺乏理解，缺少可复现的诊断协议。

Method: 基于手工标注审计与既有工作设计6个扰动算子，每个算子报告请求变化与实际达成变化；在2个图像域、2种主干（含ResNet101/Transformer）与多种训练管线（含TEL）上对人工与自动scribble进行5随机种子评测，并附加MiT-B1 PFA锚点实验。

Result: TEL-ResNet101在VOC上5种子平均mIoU从70.08降至类篡改下1.46，空间偏移35.57、方向扰动52.20、笔画长度缩减63.24；语义锚点破坏造成最大退化，几何与支撑扰动响应依管线与数据集而异。

Conclusion: 提供可复现的标注鲁棒性诊断基准，揭示干净集精度之外的失效模式，算子代码开源。

Abstract: Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [235] [National-Scale Crop Type Mapping in Morocco Using Google AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings and the Fields of the World Field Boundary Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12681)
*Walid Elbarz,Mohamed Bourriz,Vincent Simonneaux,Hamd Ait Abdelali,François Bourzeix*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用Google AlphaEarth Foundations的64维预训练嵌入，配合轻量下游分类器与全球田块边界图，实现摩洛哥全国作物类型制图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统大范围作物制图需处理原始卫星影像，计算与工程成本高；作者探索地理空间基础模型嵌入能否作为可直接复用的表征，免去训练与推理阶段的原始影像流水线。

Method: 直接以公开的64维AlphaEarth嵌入作为输入特征，训练轻量分类器完成冬谷物、木本作物、其他作物三类划分；推理阶段用Fields of the World全球田块边界图将预测约束到地块尺度，实现全国范围高效推断。

Result: 独立测试集、10次重复运行平均分类精度87.17±0.42%；摩洛哥全国推理约5小时，主要开销为云端嵌入检索而非模型计算。

Conclusion: 预训练地理空间嵌入可支撑计算高效的国家级作物制图，下游仅需轻量模型，瓶颈转向数据获取环节。

Abstract: Recent geospatial foundation models have introduced a new paradigm for large-scale Earth observation by providing pretrained embedding representations that can be directly exploited for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate the use of Google AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco. The proposed workflow operates directly on publicly available 64-dimensional pretrained embeddings using lightweight downstream classifiers, eliminating the need to process raw satellite imagery during model training and inference. The approach targets three crop categories, namely winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. For nationwide inference, the Fields of the World global field boundary map is used to constrain predictions to agricultural parcels, enabling efficient large-scale mapping. Experimental evaluation on an independent test set over ten repeated runs achieved an average classification accuracy of (87.17 +/- 0.42%). Nationwide inference over Morocco was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the embeddings rather than model execution. These results demonstrate the potential of pretrained embedding representations for computationally efficient national-scale crop type mapping.

</details>


### [236] [Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12686)
*Ajay Manicka,Karim Kadry,Sebastian Ruiz-Lopera,Maryam Alsharqi,Sanjana Arji,Samuel Ruiperez-Campillo,Nestor Uribe-Patarroyo,Brett E. Bouma,Farhad Nezami,Elazer R. Edelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可微分逆渲染框架：通过基于物理的OCT前向模型梯度下降，从单幅OCT图像逐像素恢复光衰减系数，无需训练数据或分割，跨平台可迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像中的组织内在属性（如光衰减系数）与成像系统物理过程纠缠，传统闭式反演受限于简化光-组织模型，学习方法又绑定特定成像配置，缺乏通用、免训练的参数恢复手段。

Method: 构建可微分物理前向模型，对单个OCT图像以梯度下降反演逐像素衰减系数；与前向模型解耦，替换前向模型或更换目标光学参数时优化流程不变；并用解析解与5个体模验证，再零改动应用于128名患者的29,269张临床血管内OCT图像。

Result: 与解析解一致，体模实验验证有效，临床大规模数据上无需微调即可运行；表明梯度信息可使高维逐像素反演变得可解，而无梯度方法在此规模不可行。

Conclusion: 工作将OCT图像反演为定量组织表征，提供跨模态、跨器官系统的可微分逆渲染通用框架，但属医学影像领域，与具身智能/3D重建核心方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.

</details>


### [237] [GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12699)
*Guohui Deng,Yuhang Jiang,Chengjun Wang,Zhongwen Hu,Zhaocong Wu,Linsheng Huang,Jinling Zhao,Chao Ruan,Miaozhong Xu,Chi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 测试8个开源VLM在超高分辨率遥感图像中的计数能力，发现约5个目标的"计数地平线"，提出幂律响应模型并据此设计按测量极限切分视图的免训练框架GeoScope。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感图中被计数的目标往往仅占几像素，现有方法默认"选一个视图然后信任VLM答案"，但作者发现该假设在计数任务上失效，需要量化VLMs的失效边界。

Method: 将VLM当作传感器进行标定：系统测试8个开源VLM，发现视图中目标数超过阈值(约5个)即开始欠计数，且该"计数地平线"随视图增大、目标变小而收窄；建立经验幂律响应模型预测切分的欠计数补偿与虚假计数；GeoScope用纯文本LLM将问题解析为带类型的空间程序，固定区域与分辨率，VLM只在其工作范围内定位和计数，方向关系由定位框显式计算；无训练。

Result: XLRS-Bench上Qwen3-VL-8B区域计数+16.3、空间关系+10.5；区域计数与按问题统计的整榜准确率均为已报最高(含训练方法)。UHR-Micro全局/区域计数+16.8/+36.2(其中15.6来自切分)。MME-RealWorld计数+11.4，并揭示某几乎从不出错却被频繁选择的选项会扭曲该基准比较。

Conclusion: 以实测VLM容量上限驱动视图切分与显式空间推理，是无训练条件下提升UHR遥感计数与空间关系的有效范式，也提示需谨慎对待基准的选项偏差。

Abstract: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [238] [Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12716)
*George Shramko,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Rudy Lam,Yizheng Xie,Daniel Rebain,David B. Lindell,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Spaghetti Splatting，用折线（polyline）作为基元做体渲染重建 3D 曲线几何，将低通核卷积体渲染配方从点/三角形推广到曲线，且是 3DGS 的严格超集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产系统的 3D 几何常用点、线、三角形等基元表示，但曲线（线状/毛发/细丝状）几何学习尚缺统一框架；Dirac 质量难以直接体渲染，需借助核卷积，而该配方中"核"和"基元"两个维度上的曲线情形尚未被系统研究。

Method: 以折线段近似连续曲线，其卷积收敛到连续曲线的卷积；对每段做体渲染，并保证相邻段在连接处合成时不重复计数；对每段的相机投影做线性化以加速训练与推理，从而支持高斯之外的核（如 Beta 核）。零长度曲线即点，故表示涵盖 3DGS。

Result: 在通用场景上与 SOTA 竞争力相当，优于面向线状几何的专用方法，原生支持抗锯齿，并能输出可直接用于物理仿真的长连续纤维/丝状结构。

Conclusion: 曲线基元 + 核卷积的体渲染配方可行且具通用性，为线状几何（毛发、电缆、纤维、缝线等）的可微重建与仿真提供统一、可扩展的表示。

Abstract: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.

</details>


### [239] [OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12727)
*Guillaume Guy,Mihajlo Grbovic,Joe Mills,Selen Uguroglu,Liwei He,Pratiksha Kadam,Nalini Kartha,Qian Aria Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Airbnb 提出 OptiCover：面向电商视觉营销中封面图选择的冷启动优化框架，结合候选生成、基于冻结 CLIP 的轻量视觉头、VLM 跨模态语义校验与随机探索日志模块，在百万级/天级上传规模下实现多场景封面图自动优选，线上部署每日千万次换图，首页互动 +1.5%、搜索预订者 +0.35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Airbnb 房源照片超 90% 无互动标签（严重冷启动），主图又被复用到多个异质产品面（首页、搜索等），而各面用户偏好与搜索意图不同；同时视觉吸引力强但语义不匹配的照片会误导用户。人工选图无法在数亿照片、日增数十万上传的规模下扩展。

Method: 四模块流水线：(1) 候选照片生成器，通过多种代理信号筛出候选；(2) 在冻结 CLIP 嵌入上接轻量视觉头，做大规模语义/吸引力打分；(3) 基于 VLM 的跨模态 grounding 校验器，强制语义代表性约束；(4) Exploration Logging Module（ELM），跨异质产品面与上下文搜索意图编排随机化互动数据采集，缓解冷启动与选择偏差。

Result: 大量离线研究与首页、搜索多场景线上实验；已上线生产，每日执行数千万次换图；首页互动提升 1.5%，搜索端预订者数提升 0.35%，带来数百万美元增量收入。

Conclusion: 在冷启动、语义约束与多场景信号下，封面图优化可行且可规模化；作者强调动作空间整形（action-space shaping）与语义约束是性能提升的首要驱动因素，而非单纯提升视觉打分模型的精度。

Abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day. We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents. We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.

</details>


### [240] [Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12739)
*Zane K. J. Hartley,Yong En Kok,Lewis A. G. Stuart,Andrew P. French,Michael P. Pound*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Plant Orbiter 利用视频扩散模型从单张图像生成高质量植物 3D Gaussian Splats，实现精确的 3D 植物形态重建与文生 3D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字表型流水线需要高通量获取植物 3D 形态性状；从 2D 转向 3D 仍受复杂形态、细薄结构和遮挡限制，且多视角采集成本高、对齐困难。

Method: 基于视频扩散模型从单张图像合成多视角视频，再重建为 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示；结合 2D 扩散模型扩展为文本提示生成 3D 植物。

Result: 在所有基线中取得最高 3D F-score，形态重建更准确；相机布置成本低、对齐更简单，更适合高通量流程；文生 3D 植物达到 SOTA。

Conclusion: 单图视频扩散 + 3DGS 为植物提供高通量、低成本、高精度的 3D 数字化双胞胎方案，并可自然扩展到文本驱动生成。

Abstract: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.

</details>


### [241] [Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12798)
*Lukun Wu,Jie Li,Ziqi Ren,Ruiyang Xia,Yan Gao,Xinbo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双教师分层对齐框架DTHA：用冻结的多模糊CLIP与浅层DINOv2分别监督共享EEG编码器的双分支对比对齐，并提出AMSPBE编码器（时空间注意力+可学习头皮模式库），THINGS-EEG零样本检索Top-1达92.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码方法仅与CLIP族视觉基础模型对齐，忽视了神经响应中从外观到语义的分层视觉信息，未利用不同范式VFM（纯图像模型如DINO与图文模型如CLIP）的互补偏置。

Method: 建立"机制—范式对应"观点，将分层视觉处理映射到跨范式VFM的互补偏置；构建DTHA：共享EEG编码器由冻结的多模糊CLIP与浅层DINOv2双教师做双分支对比对齐；引入融合检索目标学习自适应权重用于零样本EEG→图像检索；编码器AMSPBE结合时空间注意力与可学习头皮模式库，建模区域时序动态与滤波器组地形图。

Result: THINGS-EEG零样本检索Top-1为92.4%，较此前SOTA提升12.4个百分点；空间、频谱与表征相似性分析及THINGS-MEG评测验证了有效性、生物合理性及跨模态泛化性。

Conclusion: 跨范式VFM的互补性监督可从脑活动中更完整地提取分层视觉信息，为脑机接口与类脑智能中的视觉解码提供新视角。

Abstract: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.

</details>


### [242] [2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12805)
*Aarya Bhave,Anushka Ajay Bhave*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将原用于冷冻电镜3D子断层对齐的Gum-Net迁移为2D全无监督稠密弹性配准网络，以控制点网格+DCT谱池化回归形变场，在指纹数据上零样本验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习式稠密非刚性配准受制于真实数据缺少像素级形变场真值；需在无监督框架下仍能保持细粒度准周期结构并给出拓扑正确的形变。

Method: 端到端无监督2D弹性配准：三模块二维重设计，刚性变换头替换为Dense Spatial Transformer，回归稀疏控制点网格并用双三次插值上采样为全分辨率场Φ；用冻结基矩阵乘法实现的DCT谱池化替代max/avg池化（约50倍GPU加速），保留高频纹理结构。仅在合成指纹上训练，真实基准零样本评测，并用独立匹配器以细节点为地标外部验证形变拓扑正确性。

Result: FVC2004上结构相关性提升最高15.7%；独立匹配器下真匹配分数上升、假匹配分数基本不变，说明形变恢复了真实结构而非伪造对应关系。

Conclusion: 无监督稠密形变预测可在无真值标签下取得可用精度，控制点+DCT谱池化的设计值得在更广的非刚性配准任务中推广。

Abstract: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $\Phi$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.

</details>


### [243] [What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12852)
*Tianze Luo,Haofeng Huang,Yuan Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文通过patch-wise PCA分析像素空间Flow Matching中v-prediction训练困难的带宽瓶颈，指出x-prediction提供raw-input bypass并自发聚焦主成分、相当于隐式条件均值解码器，据此提出Raw-injected Transformer (RiT)，用轻量raw-conditioned解码器加输出端短路恢复有效v-prediction，在ImageNet 256×256取得有竞争力结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Latent Diffusion存在两阶段训练复杂性与预训练自编码器重建瓶颈；像素空间Flow Matching虽端到端简洁，但用标准v-prediction目标训练困难。已有解释归因于noised target偏离流形，本文要验证这一解释并给出机制性刻画与架构解法。

Method: 1) 用patch-wise PCA诊断噪声目标：发现速度在次成分上主要由原始噪声输入决定，形成"带宽瓶颈"，迫使深骨干同时承担高频原始状态传递与主成分语义建模；2) 受控实验与表征分析，说明x-prediction的raw-input bypass及输入表征自发向主方向集中的现象；3) 在低秩观测下证明x-prediction诱导的流等价于隐式条件均值解码器，可从保留分量重建被丢弃分量；4) 提出RiT：轻量raw-conditioned解码器+输出端shortcut，将语义建模与原始状态传播解耦。

Result: RiT恢复有效的v-prediction训练，在ImageNet 256×256上以像素空间端到端方式达到与主流生成模型可竞争的性能，并给出预测目标与架构带宽交互关系的分析视角。

Conclusion: 像素空间生成的可训练性瓶颈本质是架构带宽分配问题，而非单纯目标函数选择；通过将raw-state传递从深骨干中剥离，可在保持v-prediction优势的同时避免其训练不稳定，为像素空间流匹配提供了可解释的机制与可落地架构。

Abstract: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

</details>


### [244] [AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12855)
*Arne Schmidt,Justin Nieder,Cornelius Boehm,Julika Ribbat-Idel,Marius Teodorescu,Marie-Lisa Eich,Simon Schallenberg,Gabriel Dernbach,Katja Lingelbach,Miriam Haegele,Timo Milbich,Adam Narai,Maria Stoelben,Hans Pinckaers,Lukas Ruff,Kai Standvoss,Christian Watermann,Christiane Kuempers,Sven Perner,Verena Sailer,Jasmin Tiebach,Torsten Goldmann,Sebastian Marwitz,Johannes Braegelmann,Frederick Klauschen,Marija Pezer,Rosemarie Krupar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究用深度学习H&E组织分析模型量化新辅助治疗与未治疗肺鳞癌患者的肿瘤及近/远端淋巴结，发现新辅助治疗患者成熟三级淋巴结构(TLS)与成熟次级淋巴结构(SLS)减少、间质浆细胞与淋巴细胞密度显著降低，且浆细胞-淋巴细胞耦合减弱；间质浆细胞密度及细胞共定位与更长的生存相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成熟TLS和淋巴结滤泡支撑的浆细胞反应影响肺癌预后与免疫治疗获益，但新辅助治疗前后这一"局部-区域轴"的差异缺乏明确定义。

Method: 配对分析肺鳞癌切除肿瘤及近远端淋巴结H&E全片（新辅助治疗组neoLUSC n=20，未治疗组naivLUSC n=20）；使用Aignostics Atlas HETA模型按组织分区定量细胞密度与细胞-细胞共定位；专用深度学习模型（经病理学家标注验证）检测TLS/SLS并分级成熟度；在独立队列（n=458，其中46例接受治疗）中检验预后价值。

Result: neoLUSC组间质浆细胞密度降低72%(p=0.004)、间质淋巴细胞密度降低48%(p=0.015)，巨噬细胞与粒细胞无显著差异；总TLS及未成熟TLS无差异，但肿瘤内成熟TLS(p=0.034)与远端淋巴结成熟SLS(p=0.003)减少；TLS周围浆细胞密度与肿瘤淋巴细胞密度仅在naivLUSC相关(rho=0.54, p=0.017)，neoLUSC无相关(rho=0.07)；验证队列中间质浆细胞密度(HR 0.69, p=0.011)与淋巴细胞-浆细胞共定位(HR 0.66, p=0.004)关联更长生存，新辅助治疗状态关联更短生存(HR 1.50, p=0.026)。

Conclusion: 新辅助治疗并非普遍降低免疫读数，而是与成熟淋巴结构减少及体液免疫区室与肿瘤耦合减弱相关；间质浆细胞/细胞共定位轴可作为候选预后生物标志物。

Abstract: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.

</details>


### [245] [SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12870)
*Yu Zhou,Xinyuan Xia,Xuankun Yang,Yinghao Yang,Wendi Chen,Bowen Liu,Jianhan Ma,Weicheng Duan,Jun Lv,Cewu Lu,Yanwei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作系统研究了世界动作模型（WAM）中语言-视频对齐在引入动作学习后的保持问题，构建约47,000小时多源数据并给出联合训练配方与架构结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WAM研究聚焦架构与训练机制，默认视频预训练获得的语言-视频对齐仍然稳固；但引入动作学习可能破坏该对齐，目前缺乏关于数据与监督设计的原则性指导。

Method: 整理约4.7万小时通用视频、自我中心视频、UMI示教与机器人示教数据池，系统对比语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督及二者联合使用对WAM性能的影响；分析语言标注质量对预训练语言-视频能力的作用，以及UMI与机器人示教中动作监督如何将该能力扩展至语言-视频-动作建模；并进一步研究联合训练配方与模型架构的扩展性。

Result: 固定训练预算下，混合自我中心视频与UMI示教可提升控制泛化；架构影响经验利用效率，按所选配置扩展预训练带来额外增益。仅在RoboTwin Clean示教上后训练即达Easy(Clean-to-Clean) 88.10%、Hard(Clean-to-Random) 61.56%成功率；真实世界三项任务平均SR 40.00%，最强基线为23.33%。

Conclusion: 语言标注质量与动作监督形式共同决定WAM的阶段迁移效果；数据混合配方与架构选择是维持对齐、提升未见条件泛化的关键，并开源数据、训练代码与权重。

Abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

</details>


### [246] [Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12875)
*Hao Gu,Jin Yao,Zezhou Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Click3R 通过少量人工跨视图点击对应点，以轻量点对应适配器将几何约束注入前馈式 3D 重建网络，实现对失败重建的交互式纠错，并构建了专门的失败模式基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈式大规模 3D 重建模型只输出单一且不可修改的预测，一旦失败便缺乏纠正机制。作者希望以最少的人工交互（稀疏对应点击）弥补这一缺陷，解决重复纹理、对称结构、大视角变化、无纹理区域等歧义场景。

Method: 提出 Click3R 框架：输入图像对加少量用户提供的跨视图点对应，通过轻量的 point correspondence adapter 把几何约束注入现有前馈 3D 重建主干网络；同时构建了一个专门暴露现有前馈方法失败模式的挑战性基准用于评估交互式重建。

Result: 实验显示，仅需一次对应点击即可降低重建误差，在标准基准与自建挑战基准上均取得性能提升，验证稀疏人工交互能有效修正几何重建错误。

Conclusion: 稀疏人工交互是一种有效且实用的前馈 3D 重建几何纠错机制，把一次性前馈预测转变为可交互修正的重建流程。

Abstract: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

</details>


### [247] [Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12879)
*Rustin Soraki,Matthew Wallingford,Ryan Aby,Brandon Chee,Jason Ren,Ali Farhadi,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Roozbeh Mottaghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Grasping-the-Future统一生成模型，用掩码时空补全+flow matching联合预测3D手-物运动（腕部、手指关节、物体位姿），并构建从互联网视频恢复完整交互轨迹的可扩展监督管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与物体交互需同时预判物体运动与手的协同运动；日常人类视频天然包含丰富手物交互，但缺乏直接的3D监督，且需要统一框架同时覆盖多种预测任务（预测未来交互、给定物体预测手、给定手预测物体、生成到目标物体位姿的轨迹、补全部分观测）。

Method: 1) 单一联合生成模型建模腕部运动、手指articulation与物体位置+朝向；2) 以掩码时空补全（masked spatiotemporal completion）配合flow matching训练，将多任务统一为一个条件生成问题；3) 显式建模手-物关系并引入接触约束以在运动中保持抓握关系；4) 数据侧构建可扩展管线：预训练感知模型+联合几何优化，从互联网视频重建完整交互轨迹，并与带标注的交互数据集合并作为全部任务的训练数据；5) 通过重定向到机器人本体验证几何与物理合理性。

Result: 在所有任务上表现强劲，在具备3D标注的数据集上优于已发布的预测方法；预测轨迹重定向到机器人本体后表现出良好的几何与物理可行性。

Conclusion: 统一的掩码补全式手-物运动生成框架可作为从人类视频学习交互预测的通用范式，接触约束与几何优化得到的数据管线是其关键支撑，且输出可直接用于机器人执行。

Abstract: To interact with an object, we need to anticipate both how it will move and how our hands should move with it. Human videos capture these relationships across everyday activities, offering a natural source for learning to predict future interactions. Learning from them requires recovering motion from completed interactions and using it to anticipate what could happen next. We present $\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$, a unified generative model of joint 3D hand-object motion, including wrist motion, finger articulation, and object position and orientation. Through masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching, we train a single model for several prediction tasks: forecasting future interactions, predicting hand motion given object motion or vice versa, generating both trajectories toward a desired final object pose, and completing partially observed interactions. We explicitly model hand-object relations and incorporate contact constraints to help preserve grasp relationships during motion. To obtain 3D supervision from internet videos, we develop a scalable pipeline that combines pretrained perception models with joint geometric optimization to reconstruct completed interactions. We combine these recovered trajectories with annotated interaction datasets as training data for all tasks. We demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, outperforming released forecasters on datasets with 3D annotations. Moreover, we show geometric and physical plausibility of the predicted trajectories by retargeting them to a robotic embodiment. Videos are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [248] [Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12883)
*Zhaoying Pan,Shenyu Lu,Jun Hui Wong,Junyi Chai,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现MLLM中存在少量"仲裁注意力头"(arbitration heads)，因果决定预测偏向视觉还是文本证据，并提出一种无需训练、轻量的推理时干预，将这些头偏向指定的可信模态，实现模态依赖的双向控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在模态冲突输入下会不可靠地偏向并非任务最可信的模态，需要推理时控制模态仲裁能力。

Method: 通过因果分析定位一组影响视觉/文本证据取舍的注意力头；在推理时对这些头施加轻量偏置，无需训练即可将预测导向指定可信模态；验证头在不同校准集规模下的稳定性与跨设置泛化性。

Result: 识别的仲裁头对校准集规模稳定、跨设置泛化，在多个基准上可有效双向调控模态依赖，使预测对齐任务指定的模态优先级。

Conclusion: 注意力头级干预是控制MLLM模态仲裁的有效机制，为模态优先级的推理时对齐提供可操作手段。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [249] [World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12885)
*Heng Fang,Zehui Guo,Yuehan Zhang,Mingyang Du,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出World In-Context Learning (WICL)范式：冻结模型从单条演示出发，在仿真世界中排练任务并将反馈写入上下文而非权重，构建RoboScript基础设施，在RoboTwin 2.0全部50个任务上达到83.4%平均成功率，超越最强训练型策略20+分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练式动作策略把操作技能写入网络权重，导致能力与训练分布耦合；而现有in-context learning（ICL）虽避免耦合，却因演示来自其他场景、缺乏当前世界反馈而难以匹敌训练策略。作者观察到上下文中习得的知识本质是语义性的（记录任务步骤与物体角色而非视觉外观），因此可跨世界迁移。

Method: WICL范式：冻结基础模型以单条演示为起点，在仿真等世界中进行任务排练，将世界反馈写入上下文而非权重。实现系统RoboScript为模块化基础设施，通过仿真排练学习每个任务，将所学知识固化为Task Memory，并在新场景部署该冻结记忆，采用数据隔离确保部署输入均可在真实机器人上获得；支持反思迭代与跨本体记忆自适应。

Result: RoboTwin 2.0全部50个任务、每任务仅一条演示、无梯度更新条件下，干净与随机化设置平均成功率83.4%，超过最强训练型策略20分以上；跨视觉分布泛化、通过反思自我提升、随基础模型规模提升，并经跨本体记忆适配迁移至真实双臂机器人。

Conclusion: 将"世界"置于回路中，机器人可以在上下文中学习操作任务，效果与在权重中学习相当；权重自由、单演示、可迁移是可行的操作学习新路径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [250] [Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12886)
*Haozhi Yuan,Handong Li,Yifan Zhang,Qianshan Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Reframe 提出以"观测状态"而非仅输出分布为对齐对象的后训练框架：GD-GRPO 用证据感知奖励与随机丢弃原始视觉输入，训练空间/时间专家依赖工具返回观测；OG-MOPD 在 rollout 中用规范动作替换劣质工具调用并从修复后的观测继续蒸馏。14 个图像/视频基准优于 Mix-RL 与 MOPD，且无需任务特定 SFT 冷启动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉智能体的后训练存在两个互补但各自不足的路径：智能体 RL 与多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（MOPD）。核心痛点是工具使用中的两类问题——模型倾向忽略工具返回的观测证据；动作缺乏 grounding 导致后续蒸馏所依赖的证据质量低下。作者认为应把"观测状态"本身作为对齐对象。

Method: 两阶段后训练框架：(1) Ground-Drop-GRPO：以证据感知奖励 + 随机移除原始视觉输入的"丢弃"策略，训练空间与时间两类专家学会获取 grounded 证据并利用工具返回观测；(2) Observation-Gated-MOPD：在 rollout 中途以规范（canonical）工具动作替换劣质动作，并从修复后的观测恢复蒸馏。两阶段互补，且均不依赖任务特定 SFT 冷启动。
