# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [255] [Process then Retrieve: Investigating the Origins of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09897)
*Arpita Shanbhag,Julia Tran,Dhruv Mandala,Ayda Sultan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作研究视觉语言模型"模态差距"的成因，指出文本token在嵌入层语义密度远低于视觉token，导致早期层优先处理文本表示；将视觉token位置替换为其语义最近邻文本token可提升早期层注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM中模态差距（modality gap）的起源尚不清楚；作者假设模态特定token在嵌入层的信息密度差异是造成表征不平衡的关键因素。

Method: 信息密度分析 + 机制性分析（mechanistic analysis）：量化文本/视觉token的语义密度，并通过将视觉token位置替换为语义最邻近的文本token做干预实验，观察早期层注意力变化。

Result: 文本token进入模型时语义密度显著低于视觉token，使早期层集中于文本表示处理；干预实验显示语义密集化后的位置在早期层获得更高注意力。

Conclusion: 为缓解模态差距、改进VLM多模态推理架构提供了解释性基础；属于机制理解类工作，缺少可直接用于机器人/具身系统的实证方法。

Abstract: Understanding the origins of the modality gap in vision language models remains a significant challenge. This work investigates whether differences in information density between modality specific tokens at the embedding layer contribute to this imbalance. We show that text tokens enter the model with much lower semantic density than visual tokens, driving early layers to focus on processing text representations before combining them with vision. Through mechanistic analysis, we demonstrate that replacing vision token positions with their semantically closest text token counterparts elicits increased attention to those positions in early layers. These findings provide a foundation for addressing the modality gap and provide insight to improve multimodal reasoning in VLM architectures.

</details>


### [256] [On the universal structure in deterministic generative diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10338)
*Defang Chen,Zhenyu Zhou,Can Wang,Zeyu Zheng,Siwei Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现扩散模型确定性采样轨迹具有与数据模态和模型实现无关的普适几何结构，并用以最优线性去噪器为基础的可解模型加以解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成模型的内部生成机制尚不清晰，缺乏原理性理解，限制了训练与推理的进一步改进。

Method: 分析确定性采样（如概率流ODE）轨迹的几何形态，提出基于最优线性去噪器的精确可解模型来解释该结构。

Result: 实证显示不同数据模态与不同扩散实现下确定性采样轨迹共享统一的几何结构，且该结构大部分可由线性去噪器解析模型刻画。

Conclusion: 确定性扩散采样轨迹具有普适几何规律，为扩散模型训练与推理的原理性设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: Diffusion-based generative modeling has emerged as a general computational framework for simulating high-dimensional, structured data across various domains. Understanding its generative mechanisms is paramount for advancing model training and inference in a principled way. Here, we demonstrate that deterministic sampling trajectories share a universal geometric structure invariant to data modalities and diffusion model implementations. This structure can be largely explained by an exactly solvable model based on the optimal linear denoiser.

</details>


### [257] [Learning a Unified Cross-Model Semantic Dictionary via Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10503)
*Jinchi Zhu,Tie Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GB-SAE通过门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器同时学习跨模型共享字典与各模型私有字典，实现统一且可复用的跨模型可解释表征分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同架构与预训练目标的基础模型虽学习到重叠语义结构，但表征各异，导致无法统一解释与跨模型特征复用；现有方法仅在潜空间坐标上对齐，概念本身仍模型专属。

Method: 将统一跨模型可解释性建模为表征因子分解问题，提出门控瓶颈稀疏自编码器（GB-SAE）：共享字典编码跨模型共性概念并可跨模型复用，多个私有字典捕捉各模型特异性残差概念，通过门控瓶颈结构联合训练。

Result: 在ViT、SigLIP、DINOv2、ConvNeXt等基础模型上评估，GB-SAE在重建能力、统一且忠实的可解释性、对未见模型与下游任务的可复用性与泛化性上均优于基线。

Conclusion: GB-SAE提供了可共享概念的跨模型机制可解释性框架，超越仅在潜坐标对齐的既有方案，具备良好的迁移与复用潜力。

Abstract: Foundation models pretrained on similar data distributions tend to learn overlapping semantic structure, but their representations are distinct due to different model architecture, pretraining objectives and protocols. This prevents unified interpretability and cross-model feature reuse. Existing approaches extract interpretable concepts from individual models and align these concepts in a shared coordinate system using cross-reconstruction objectives, but the alignment only applies to latent coordinates while the concepts themselves remain model-specific and cannot be shared or reused. This paper introduces the Gated Bottleneck Sparse Autoencoder (GB-SAE), which casts unified cross-model interpretability as a representation factorization problem and solves it by simultaneously learning a unified shared dictionary and multiple private model-specific dictionaries via a gated bottleneck sparse autoencoder framework. The shared dictionary encodes the cross-model common semantic structure in unified concepts that are reusable across all participating models (and beyond), while each private dictionary comprises residual concepts that capture model-specific biases. We evaluate GB-SAE with distinct foundation models including ViT, SigLIP, DINOv2, and ConvNeXt. GB-SAE demonstrates superior reconstruction capability, unified and faithful interpretability, strong reusability and generalization to unseen models and downstream tasks. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [258] [STABLE: A Continual Learning Optimizer with Adaptive Drift Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10655)
*Xiaoyan Li,Lanpei Li,Massimo Coppola,Vincenzo Lomonaco,Antonio Carta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STABLE：一种原对偶优化器，通过自适应漂移预算控制参数漂移，从优化器层面缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，无需回放缓冲或额外正则项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法依赖回放缓冲区、结构改动或正则项；作者认为遗忘源于学习动态不稳定，应可从优化器层面解决，但难点在于学习动态具有时间依赖性（如stability gap现象）。

Method: 对距离类分类器形式化证明：在局部得分稳定性条件下，有界参数漂移保证有界间隔侵蚀。据此设计STABLE原对偶优化器，带自适应漂移控制：预算被违反时增大对偶变量，否则减小，从而在不牺牲可塑性的前提下获得高稳定性。

Result: 在长时程单模态任务流与基于CLIP的多模态任务流上，使用STABLE训练的vanilla PEFT基线达到或超过专门的持续学习方法；多模态场景下还能保持零样本迁移能力，匹配或超越专用多模态持续学习方法。

Conclusion: 遗忘可通过优化器级的漂移控制有效缓解，STABLE为持续学习提供了不依赖回放与正则的通用、即插即用方案，且保持零样本迁移。

Abstract: Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, leading to the loss of past knowledge and unstable adaptation across task streams. Existing approaches typically address this issue through replay buffers, architectural changes, or additional regularization terms. We argue that forgetting is a consequence of unstable learning dynamics, which may benefit from an optimizer-level solution. The main challenge is that learning dynamics are time-dependent, as demonstrated by empirical phenomena such as the stability gap. First, we formally prove that, for distance-based classifiers, bounded parameter drift guarantees bounded margin erosion under a local score-stability condition. Based on this insight, we propose STABLE, a primal-dual optimizer with adaptive drift control. STABLE enforces a drift budget by increasing the dual variable when the budget is violated and decreasing it otherwise. This results in high stability without penalizing plasticity. Experiments on long-horizon unimodal streams and CLIP-based multimodal streams show that vanilla PEFT baselines trained with STABLE match or outperform specialized continual learning methods. In the multimodal setting, STABLE further preserves zero-shot transfer, matching or exceeding dedicated multimodal continual learning methods.

</details>


### [259] [Constrained Look-ahead Guidance for Interference-Aware Flow Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10751)
*Doudou Zhang,Qi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种免反演的流模型图像编辑框架：用一步前瞻（one-step look-ahead）评估候选更新对编辑奖励与保真奖励的影响，在显式保真约束下进行奖励驱动修正，从而缓解编辑与保真目标间的梯度干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流模型生成能力强，但受控编辑困难：需在生成轨迹上平衡源图保真与编辑遵循度。现有方法依赖反演（inversion）或启发式引导，易产生不稳定与目标冲突。

Method: 以轨迹为中心、免反演。每步通过去噪估计编辑奖励与保真奖励，执行一步前瞻以预测候选更新在下一状态上对两目标的影响；据此对当前更新施加奖励驱动修正，并以显式保真约束裁剪，抑制编辑与保真梯度干扰。

Result: 实验显示相较现有强基线，语义编辑更强、源内容保持更好，轨迹演化更稳定连贯。

Conclusion: 前瞻式奖励评估提供了可控轨迹编辑的通用范式，可作为引导机制扩展至视频与3D生成编辑，但摘要未给定量指标与代码。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models enable powerful generative modeling, but controlled editing remains challenging due to the need to balance source fidelity and edit compliance along the generative trajectory. We propose a principled, inversion-free framework for flow-based image editing from a trajectory centric perspective. Rather than relying on inversion or heuristic guidance, we introduce a one-step look-ahead mechanism that evaluates the effect of candidate updates on both edit and fidelity rewards estimated via denoising, and adjusts the current update based on this evaluation. At each step, our method applies reward-driven corrections guided by the look-ahead evaluation under an explicit fidelity constraint, resulting in stable and coherent trajectory evolution. This look-ahead design mitigates gradient interference between edit and fidelity objectives by anticipating their interaction in future states, leading to improved trade-offs. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves stronger semantic edits while better preserving source content compared to existing strong baselines.

</details>


### [260] [Learning When to Think: Adaptive Internal Computation for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10822)
*Rohit Kumar Salla,Simon Stepputtis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自适应内部计算(AIC)：迭代策略联合学习动作选择与"何时停止细化隐表示"，用期望深度惩罚与中间价值预测做辅助监督，平均3.3步即达固定8步策略的效果，延迟降低31–44%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式神经策略对每个决策都耗费相同计算量，但额外迭代带来的收益随状态而异，存在计算分配冗余。

Method: 构建迭代策略，将动作选择与停止决策联合训练；引入期望深度惩罚（对计算量计价）与中间层价值预测作为辅助监督；并从理论上分析状态相关分配器在同一期望深度下优于任何状态无关的停止调度。

Result: 在12个基准任务上平均执行3.3步（上限8步）；4个控制与机器人任务单决策延迟降低31–44%；7个任务平均回报超过最佳固定深度策略，4个略低。消融显示PickCube与AntMaze的收益主要来自自适应停止（且步数更多），RareEvent的收益主要来自价值监督。

Conclusion: 状态自适应的计算分配可在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低推理开销；停止机制与价值监督的贡献随任务特性不同而分化。

Abstract: Iterative neural policies usually spend the same computation on every decision, although the benefit of additional processing varies across states. We introduce Adaptive Internal Computation (AIC), an iterative policy that learns when to stop refining its latent representation and act. In AIC, we train action selection and stopping jointly, an expected-depth penalty values computation and intermediate value predictions provide auxiliary supervision. We show that when only some states benefit from further refinement, an ideal state-dependent allocator outperforms every state-independent stopping schedule at the same expected depth. With at most eight refinement steps per decision, AIC executes 3.3 steps on average across twelve benchmark tasks and lowers per-decision latency by 31--44% relative to a fixed eight-step policy on four control and robotics tasks. Its mean reward exceeds the best fixed-depth policy on seven tasks and trails it on four. Ablating adaptive stopping and value supervision separately shows that stopping accounts for most of the reward gain on PickCube and AntMaze, where it also executes more refinement steps and that supervision accounts for most of it on RareEvent.

</details>


### [261] [Elastic Representations via Hyperbolic Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11001)
*Arjun Ramesh Kaushik,Rudrasis Chakraborty,Nalini Ratha,Venu Govindaraju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HERL：用轻量适配器把编码器输出非线性映射到双曲（Lorentz）空间，实现可压缩亦可扩展的维度自适应嵌入，无需重训练基座编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入表示按固定维度训练，无法适配下游资源/任务约束；MRL 需昂贵的端到端重训练且不支持事后扩展，CSR 依赖轻量适配器但需 4 倍维度；且以往框架只支持压缩。

Method: 在编码器与下游之间插入简单 MLP，先降采样表示再投影到 Lorentz 双曲空间，学习服从双曲几何的自适应表示；利用双曲空间指数容量，适配器训练，基座编码器冻结；模型无关，适用于有监督与无监督设置。

Result: 在图像与文本模态的广泛实验中，HERL 在较大嵌入尺寸范围内保持下游性能，维度间插值平滑，计算开销远低于重训练方案。

Conclusion: 轻量适配器 + 双曲几何可在不重训练的前提下同时支持嵌入压缩与扩展，为维度自适应表示提供低成本通用方案。

Abstract: Learned representations (or embeddings) are the foundation of modern machine learning systems, yet they are typically trained as fixed-size embeddings, without accounting for varying downstream resource or task constraints. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) addresses this limitation by learning nested representations, but requires costly end-to-end retraining and does not support post hoc expansion, while Contrastive Sparse Representations (CSR) reduce training overhead via lightweight adaptors but operate at a 4x larger dimensionality. Additionally, all prior works restrict their framework towards compression only. In this work, we introduce Hyperbolic Elastic Representation Learning (HERL), a framework for learning dimension-adaptive embeddings (compression and expansion) through a lightweight adaptor without retraining the base encoder. Our key idea is to exploit the exponential capacity of hyperbolic geometry by learning a non-linear mapping from the encoder space to hyperbolic space. We train a simple MLP to downsample the representations before projecting them onto a Lorentzian and learn adaptive representations that respect the Lorentzian geometry. Our approach is model-agnostic and effective in both supervised and unsupervised settings. Through extensive experiments across image and text modalities, we show that HERL preserves downstream performance across a wide range of embedding sizes, exhibits smooth interpolation between dimensions, and achieves these benefits at a fraction of the computational cost. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [262] [Full Fine-Tuning is not the Problem: Why Adam Fails and SGD Succeeds in Few-Shot CLIP Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11152)
*Nairouz Mrabah,Ismail Ben Ayed,Eric Granger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出少样本CLIP适配的失败主因不是"稠密全微调"，而是优化器诱导的不可靠预条件：用普通SGD做全参数微调在11个数据集、3个CLIP骨干、5种shot设置下优于代表性PEFT方法，而Adam/AdamW因少样本二阶矩低估导致自适应更新过大而崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本CLIP适配领域普遍把问题当作"参数化问题"，认为全微调必然过拟合、故偏好PEFT。作者要澄清此前结论混淆了参数化与优化，重新审视失败根源。同理，作者想解释为何Adam系优化器在少样本下崩溃，而这是否可由"稠密参数化"本身解释。

Method: 跨11个数据集、3个CLIP骨干、5个shot水平的系统性对照实验：稠密全微调+SGD vs 代表性PEFT方法 vs Adam/AdamW；诊断二阶矩估计偏差（初始化即存在系统性低估）；将Adam首步更新预算匹配到SGD做干预实验（并对比分子侧对齐）；测试Shampoo、SOAP等更强预条件器；理论分析少样本估计误差如何被放大为不安全更新；插值探针检验低损失连通性、曲率探针检验方向曲率。

Result: 稠密全微调+SGD在报告评测协议下全面优于代表性PEFT，而Adam/AdamW显著崩溃；把Adam首步更新预算对齐SGD即可消除大部分崩溃，分子侧对齐无法解释失败；Shampoo与SOAP同样失败，说明更丰富预条件不能解决问题；插值探针显示测试方向上存在低损失连接，曲率探针显示良好的方向曲率。

Conclusion: 少样本CLIP适配的主要失败来源是优化器诱导的预条件（少样本二阶统计不可靠），而非稠密全微调本身；SGD因避免不可靠预条件并保持接近预训练CLIP而有效。这提示研究应重新评估PEFT的默认优势假设与优化器选择、更新预算校准的设计。

Abstract: Few-shot CLIP adaptation is often treated as a parameterization problem. Full fine-tuning is assumed to overfit, so parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are preferred. In this paper, we show that this conclusion conflates parameterization with optimization. Across 11 datasets, 3 CLIP backbones, and 5 shot levels, dense full fine-tuning with plain SGD outperforms representative PEFT methods under the reported evaluation protocol, whereas Adam/AdamW collapses. We trace this collapse to unreliable support-set preconditioning. The few-shot second moment systematically underestimates the corresponding full-data statistic, already at initialization. Adam's inverse-square-root normalization converts this error into an oversized adaptive update. Matching Adam's first-step update budget to SGD resolves most of the collapse, whereas numerator-side alignment does not explain the failure. Shampoo and SOAP also fail, so richer preconditioning alone does not resolve the problem. Theory formalizes how few-shot estimation error is amplified into unsafe updates. SGD succeeds because it avoids unreliable preconditioners and stays close to pretrained CLIP. Interpolation probes show low-loss connections along tested directions, and curvature probes show favorable directional curvature. These results identify optimizer-induced preconditioning, not dense full fine-tuning itself, as the main source of failure in few-shot CLIP adaptation.

</details>


### [263] [Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11261)
*Yibo Miao,Yichuan Cao,Xiao-Shan Gao,Yinpeng Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Chatter Attack，通过优化对抗提示诱导短小预设短语（self-doubt），避免搜索空间爆炸同时引发超长输出，并用贝叶斯提示优化(BPO)扩展到黑盒场景，响应长度最多增至31.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理成本高，恶意用户可通过诱导超长输出来放大延迟与费用。已有资源消耗攻击靠强制重复或压低EOS logit，但在自回归采样生成下搜索空间随长度指数增长、轨迹不稳定，攻击效果与稳定性受限。

Method: Chatter Attack：优化对抗提示使模型输出预设的短目标短语（诱发自我怀疑），而非直接优化整段长输出；用推理注意力损失与全局熵损失在生成过程中维持该状态。黑盒场景提出贝叶斯提示优化(BPO)，通过构造离散token核全局建模目标函数，利用先验信息高效探索搜索空间。

Result: 在多个模型与数据集上优于基线，最大响应长度提升至31.5倍，揭示真实LLM推理服务的资源耗尽风险。

Conclusion: 将长输出攻击转化为短目标短语诱导+生成态维持是更稳定有效的资源消耗攻击范式，BPO使其在黑盒下可行。

Abstract: LLMs are powerful but incur substantial inference cost, which can be exploited by malicious users to induce overly long outputs, increasing latency and operational expense. Prior resource consumption attacks either coerce repetition or suppress the end-of-sequence token by lowering its logit value. However, with autoregressive, sampling-based generation, the search space grows exponentially with length and small deviations or unstable trajectories can derail optimization, limiting attack effectiveness and stability. To address this issue, we introduce Chatter Attack, a novel class of resource consumption attacks that optimize adversarial prompts to induce predefined short target phrases, thereby avoiding search-space explosion while still eliciting long responses. Specifically, Chatter Attack triggers self-doubt using short doubt-inducing phrases as the target, and sustains this state throughout generation via inference attention loss and global entropy loss. To extend to black-box settings, we further propose a novel Bayesian Prompt Optimization (BPO) method, which models the objective function globally by constructing a discrete token kernel, efficiently exploring the entire search space using prior information. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method outperforms baselines, with maximum response length increases to 31.5$\times$, and revealing practical resource-depletion risks for real-world LLM inference services.

</details>


### [264] [A Unified Framework for License Plate Identification and Character-Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11289)
*Saurabh Kumar,Dewant Katare,Prakriti Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 统一的边缘端车牌检测+字符识别框架：共享CSP-Darknet+PANet编码器、无锚框定位头与RoIAlign序列识别分支，在特征图上直接解码字符；INT8 TensorRT部署于Jetson Orin Nano，mAP50 97.8%、整串准确率90.7%、147 FPS、6.8 ms时延、315 MB显存、9.4 W。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有车牌识别多采用"检测裁剪+独立CRNN识别骨干"两阶段管线，参数与内存开销大、难以在低功耗边缘设备上满足实时性；需要一套端到端、可INT8量化且覆盖全美50州车牌版式变化的统一方案。

Method: 单一共享特征编码器（CSP-Darknet + PANet）同时供两条分支使用：无锚框定位头做车牌检测，RoIAlign对齐后的特征图送入序列识别分支直接解码字符，省去图像空间裁剪与第二识别骨干；数据集约3.7万张人工核验图像，覆盖光照、视角、天气、模糊、遮挡与版式差异；模型转换为INT8 TensorRT引擎，在Jetson Orin Nano 8GB上评测。

Result: INT8下mAP50 97.8%、整序列准确率90.7%；147 FPS、端到端6.8 ms、推理内存315 MB、平均功耗9.4 W；相比YOLOv8s+CRNN基线吞吐提升7.1倍、推理内存降低77.8%。

Conclusion: 以共享特征+RoIAlign免裁剪解码的融合架构，配合INT8 TensorRT部署，可在低功耗边缘硬件上同时取得高精度与高吞吐、低内存，验证了检测-识别一体化在嵌入式车牌场景中的可行性。

Abstract: This paper presents a unified framework for license plate detection and character recognition on low-power edge hardware. The proposed network uses a shared CSP-Darknet and PANet feature encoder with an anchor-free localization head and a RoIAlign-based sequence-recognition branch. Character decoding is performed directly on aligned feature maps, avoiding image-space plate cropping and a second recognition backbone. The model is trained on an AI-assisted dataset of approximately 37,000 manually verified images covering license plate layouts from all 50 United States. The dataset includes variations in illumination, viewpoint, weather, blur, occlusion, and plate design. The framework is converted to an INT8 TensorRT engine and evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano with 8 GB memory. The INT8 model shows an mAP50 of 97.8% and a full-sequence accuracy of 90.7%. It records 147 FPS at 6.8 ms end-to-end latency, with 315 MB inference memory and 9.4 W average power consumption. Relative to the YOLOv8s+CRNN baseline, the proposed deployment provides a 7.1x throughput increase and a 77.8% reduction in allocated inference memory

</details>


### [265] [Decomposing Earth Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11398)
*Vitus Benson,Fanny Yang,Markus Reichstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用稀疏自编码器(SAE)把AlphaEarth/Tessera地球观测基础模型的全局米级嵌入分解为稀疏、近似单语义特征，并提出针对卫星像素的评测协议（匹配稀疏度下的重构、参考概念对齐、空间尺度）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型产出的嵌入不透明：每一维纠缠无关物理概念，难以解释且难以评估鲁棒性；同时LLM式的解释评判不适用于卫星像素，且空间自相关使常规评测失效。

Method: 将embedding分解为过完备字典上的稀疏编码；设计定制评测协议，从三方面打分：匹配稀疏度下的重构质量、与20个参考概念组的对齐（单语义性）、细空间尺度上的方差占比；基线包括解码器为冻结随机字典的SAE、BatchTopK与Matryoshka等变体。

Result: SAE在匹配稀疏度下重构优于所有基线（AlphaEarth上未解释方差少8倍）；AlphaEarth上88%的SAE特征最多对齐1个概念组、多数不对齐任何组，而原始维度中位数对齐12个；23–32%方差位于640m patch内（对照9%）。冻结随机解码器的SAE也具备稀疏性与单语义倾向，说明这两点源于稀疏性，而精确重构需可学习字典。

Conclusion: 用稀疏特征做了两个应用（土地覆盖子概念发现、基于适用域估计的OOD像素检测），展示了潜力但尚不足以实用；整体是可解释地球观测模型的一步进展。

Abstract: Earth observation foundation models produce global metre-resolution embeddings that underpin work across agriculture, ecology, hydrology, and beyond. Yet these embeddings are opaque: each dimension entangles unrelated physical concepts, which makes them difficult to interpret and their robustness hard to assess. Here, we propose sparse autoencoders (SAEs) as a principled way to decompose Earth embeddings into sparse, approximately monosemantic features over an overcomplete dictionary. Because LLM judges of interpretations do not transfer to satellite pixels, and spatial autocorrelation matters, we introduce a tailored evaluation protocol. It scores any SAE on reconstruction at matched sparsity, alignment with reference concepts, and spatial scale, each against baselines that include an SAE whose decoder is a frozen random dictionary. On this protocol, SAEs reconstruct AlphaEarth and Tessera embeddings better than every baseline at matched sparsity. Their features align with far fewer reference concepts than raw embedding dimensions (on AlphaEarth, 88% align with at most one of 20 concept groups, most with none, against a median of 12 per raw dimension). They also carry more of their variance at fine spatial scales (23 to 32% within a 640 m patch for BatchTopK and Matryoshka, against 9%). An SAE with a frozen random decoder shares both properties, which therefore follow from sparsity, whereas only a learned dictionary reconstructs the embedding accurately: on AlphaEarth, trained SAEs leave eight times less variance unexplained. We test the sparse code on two applications, discovering land-cover sub-concepts and detecting out-of-distribution pixels by area-of-applicability estimation. Both indicate how sparse features could be used, but neither is yet reliable enough for practical use. Together, these results are a step toward Earth observation models whose features can be inspected.

</details>


### [266] [DeltaForge: A Post-hoc Mixture-of-Experts VLA for Multi-Domain Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11856)
*Bingzhang Wang,Mo Poorsartep,Yasaman Esfandiari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeltaForge 通过联合 SVD 分解多个同源微调模型权重增量，分离共享基与微小域特异分量，并训练两个 clip 级盲路由（VLM 推理专家 + flow-matching 动力学专家），实现事后 MoE 式多域驾驶 VLA 合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶 VLA 模型按域逐一开发，各运营方在同一基座上微调出专门专家，合并成本高；权重平均随异构域增多而掉点，稠密 MoE 路由在合并时算力代价过高。目标是仅凭权重与少量 proxy 数据事后整合 N 个独立专家。

Method: 1) 观察到同基座微调的权重更新共享大量结构；2) 对所有 ΔW 联合做 SVD，分解为全体共享部分 + 极小域特异部分，路由只在低维域特异子空间上运算；3) 在 proxy 集软标签上训练两个协同的 clip 级盲路由，分别负责 VLM 推理专家与 flow-matching 动力学专家；4) 新域仅需把权重更新投影到共享基上，无需端到端重训。

Result: 在覆盖城市、越野、高速的 6 个域（轿车、卡车、全地形车）上，精度接近各域专家，超过所有权重合并、路由、集中式与联邦基线，参数与计算接近单模型；未见过的域组合亦具备泛化能力。

Conclusion: 权重增量的低秩共享结构可作为高效事后 MoE 合并的先验，使多域驾驶 VLA 具备可扩展的增量扩展能力，代价接近单模型。

Abstract: Fleets of driving vision-language-action (VLA) models are developed one domain at a time: each operator finetunes a shared base model on private data, producing specialized experts that are costly to consolidate into a single model. Weight merging loses accuracy as heterogeneous domains accumulate, and dense mixture-of-experts routing is prohibitively expensive to combine them. We present DeltaForge, to our knowledge the first post-hoc mixture-of-experts VLA for driving, which consolidates N independently finetuned per-domain models into a single multi-domain model from their weights and a small proxy set alone. When different operators finetune the same base model, their weight updates end up sharing a lot of structure. We exploit this by decomposing all the updates together using singular value decomposition (SVD), splitting each one into a shared part (the same across all domains) and a tiny domain-specific part. The router then only needs to work with those tiny domain-specific pieces, not the full expert weights, which is what keeps the approach efficient. Then two cooperating clip-level blind routers, one over the VLM reasoning experts and one over the flow-matching dynamics experts, are trained from soft labels on the proxy dataset. Across six diverse domains spanning urban, off-road, and highway driving on cars, trucks, and all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), DeltaForge approaches the accuracy of the per-domain experts and surpasses every merging, routing, centralized, and federated baseline at close to single-model parameter and compute cost. Adding a new domain requires only projecting its weight update onto the shared basis with no end-to-end retraining needed. The resulting model also generalizes to domain combinations it was never explicitly trained on.

</details>


### [267] [How Many Candidates Does a One-Step World Model Need? A Random-Codebook Account of Nearest-of-m Training on Frozen DINO Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11887)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文在冻结DINOv2/v3 patch token上系统验证“一步式”随机世界模型：m=16的nearest-of-m(IMLE)在模式型不确定性下覆盖枚举未来优于50步flow matching且延迟仅约1/30，并用“随机码本的期望失真”理论统一解释其记忆化、模式概率平坦化与连续高维欠离散三大现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步式随机世界模型可避免确定性特征预测的模式平均问题，又无需diffusion/flow每步数十次网络评估。学界有两个未证实猜想：小m足够用于特征空间世界模型；应以严格proper energy score替代硬最小值目标。作者旨在用可枚举未来的基准同时检验这两点。

Method: 以冻结DINOv2/v3 patch token为特征空间训练一步式世界模型，在可枚举未来的基准上对比nearest-of-m(IMLE)、50步flow matching、一步flow生成器与energy-score生成器（参数对齐）。理论分析将nearest-of-m目标解释为m个生成样本构成随机码本的期望失真，由此预先给出三条可检验预测；并用随机Push-T变体上的self-rollout逐步匹配与消融实验分离流形与覆盖收益。

Result: 模式型不确定性下m=16的nearest-of-m比50步flow matching覆盖更优（延迟约1/30），优于一步flow与energy-score生成器，且rollout留在token流形上而flow会漂移。三项预测均被证实：记忆化强度由码本miss失真I(m)而非miss概率决定，energy-score生成器提高m也无法规避；模式概率随m平坦化，与已知最优吻合在0.01以内；连续高维结果欠离散，构成其在真实机器人视频上的上界。Push-T上逐步self-rollout匹配将长时程误差降低约三分之一；规划成功率未提升（阴性结果并给出诊断）。

Conclusion: nearest-of-m是高效且理论可刻画的单步随机世界模型目标，但受限于连续高维欠离散；作者对该方法的适用边界（真实机器人视频、下游规划）给出诚实评估，属分析性强、方法洞见明确但未展示强真实机器人下游收益的工作。

Abstract: One-step stochastic world models avoid the mode averaging of deterministic feature predictors without the tens of network evaluations per step that diffusion and flow matching require. The simplest such objective is nearest-of-m matching (conditional implicit maximum likelihood estimation, IMLE): draw m candidate futures and pull only the one closest to the observed outcome. Recent work conjectures that a small m suffices for feature-space world models and that a strictly proper energy score should replace the hard minimum. We test both claims with one-step world models on frozen DINOv2/v3 patch tokens, using benchmarks whose futures can be enumerated. Under mode-like uncertainty, nearest-of-m with m=16 covers the enumerated futures better than 50-step flow matching (at about 1/30 of its latency), one-step flow generators and an energy-score generator at matched parameter counts, and its rollouts stay on the token manifold where flow rollouts drift. One quantity governs the choice of m: the nearest-of-m objective is the expected distortion of a random codebook of m draws from the generator. This view yields three predictions, recorded before the corresponding runs: (i) memorization of the realized outcome in contexts that never repeat, whose strength is governed by the codebook's miss distortion I(m) rather than its miss probability, and which an energy-score generator does not escape by raising m; (ii) a flattening of mode probabilities with m, matching a known optimum within 0.01; and (iii) under-dispersion on continuous high-dimensional outcomes, which bounds the method on real robot video. Per-step matching on self-rollouts cuts long-horizon error by a third on a stochastic Push-T variant; an ablation separates its manifold and coverage benefits. Planning success does not improve despite accurate risk estimates, a negative result we report with its diagnosis.

</details>


### [268] [Shaping Useful Noise: Energy Distributions Predict Visual Pretraining Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11962)
*Ching Lam Choi,Antonio Torralba,Phillip Isola,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用数据集在归一化真实图像密度模型下的"能量分布"（能量水平分布）作为合成数据的审计与筛选原则，并给出能量水平分布距离 ELD 度量，用于评估和重采样合成数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据可扩展视觉预训练，但现有筛选准则（如 FID、特征召回）只能部分解释哪些合成数据能训练出强表征，缺乏对数据分布覆盖性的原则性刻画。

Method: 在归一化真实图像密度模型下定义能量剖面（似然对数值的分布），提出 ELD 比较真实与合成数据的能量分布；利用 ELD 对合成源进行重采样与混合，使其能量直方图匹配真实图像，同时保持多样性。

Result: 在多种合成数据集上，ELD 揭示了 FID 遗漏的分布失配，并在 CNN 与 ViT 自监督预训练设置下，其预测预训练性能的能力超过 FID、LPIPS 变化与特征空间召回；基于 ELD 的重采样与混合提升了多样性并改善下游迁移表现。

Conclusion: 数据的能量剖面可作为合成数据审计与策展的有效原则，ELD 是优于现有指标的选择信号，可用于指导合成数据的筛选与配比。

Abstract: Synthetic data can scale visual pretraining, but current selection criteria only partially explain which datasets train strong representations. We propose using the energy profile of a dataset--the distribution of log-probability levels it occupies under a normalised real-image density model--as an audit and curation principle for synthetic data. To operationalise this view, we introduce Energy-Level Distribution Distance (ELD), which compares real and synthetic energy distributions. Real images span sparse high-likelihood scenes and dense low-likelihood textures, so useful synthetic data should cover this energy range rather than collapse to likely but low-variation samples. Across diverse synthetic datasets, ELD exposes mismatches missed by FID and predicts pretraining performance beyond FID, LPIPS variation, and feature-space recall, including across CNN and ViT self-supervised settings. We then use ELD to resample and mix synthetic sources, matching the real-image energy histogram while preserving diversity and improving downstream transfer.

</details>


### [269] [Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Federated Unsupervised Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12187)
*Jian Liang,Kuangpu Guo,Ran He,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedUR：首个面向联邦无监督视觉识别的框架，借助CLIP零样本能力，通过类感知数据选择的伪标签机制、类别权重与负伪标签、以及个性化提示聚合协议应对数据异构与不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦无监督研究集中于聚类与自监督表征学习，缺少联邦无监督视觉识别这一关键问题的系统方案；同时联邦场景下客户端无标签且数据异构。

Method: 基于预训练视觉语言模型（CLIP）实现零样本识别；类感知数据选择策略先估计全局伪标签分布再向客户端分配伪标签数据以缓解数据异构；引入类别权重与负伪标签策略应对正伪标签不确定性；提出个性化提示聚合协议——通用视觉提示在服务器聚合，编码本地知识的个性化文本提示保留在客户端。

Result: 在标签级与特征级分布偏移两种设定下一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: FedUR为联邦无监督识别提供了可行范式，可作为后续研究基础。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising research paradigm that enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without data sharing. To handle unlabeled data in local clients, existing unsupervised FL research has primarily focused on tasks like clustering and self-supervised representation learning, leaving the critical problem of unsupervised visual recognition largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FedUR, the first framework designed for unsupervised recognition by leveraging the zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models like CLIP. Specifically, FedUR addresses data heterogeneity through a pseudo-labeling mechanism with a class-aware data selection strategy. This strategy first estimates a global pseudo-label distribution, then allocates pseudo-labeled data to clients accordingly. To handle the uncertainty of conventional positive pseudo-labels, FedUR further incorporates class weights and a negative pseudo-labeling strategy. Furthermore, FedUR proposes a personalized prompt aggregation protocol where general visual prompts are aggregated on the server, and personalized text prompts encoding local knowledge are retained on clients. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedUR consistently outperforms baseline methods under both label-level and feature-level distribution shifts. We believe this work paves the way for further advances in federated unsupervised recognition. Code will be available at { this http URL }}.

</details>


### [270] [Controlling Temporal Pseudo-Label Marginals for Stable Online Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12242)
*Rani Amar,Ofir Lindenbaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCALAR: a plug-and-play module that buffers recent pseudo-labels and uses Sinkhorn balancing over a short temporal window to match a target class marginal, mitigating distribution drift/collapse in continual test-time adaptation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTTA updates models online on unlabeled streams and is unstable: early prediction biases get reinforced, pseudo-label class usage narrows, causing drift and collapse. Existing fixes (sample selection, loss re-weighting) do not explicitly enforce a class marginal over a temporal window.

Method: Diagnose narrowing pseudo-label class usage as an instability indicator; maintain a buffer of recent predictions, apply the Sinkhorn algorithm to balance their class distribution toward a specified target marginal, and use the resulting balanced soft targets for adaptation. No architecture change.

Result: Preserves per-step runtime and adds only ~10 MB peak GPU memory on ImageNet-C; significantly alleviates drift and collapse especially on skewed, non-stationary streams with severe shifts, when combined with entropy- or diversity-based stabilization methods.

Conclusion: Explicitly regularizing the pseudo-label class marginal over a temporal window is a cheap, effective stabilization for CTTA and composes with existing methods.

Abstract: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) methods update models online using a stream of unlabeled data to overcome distribution shifts encountered at test time. However, CTTA is often unstable, as it can reinforce biases in early predictions and increasingly predict only a few classes, resulting in drift or even collapse. In this paper, we identify narrowing pseudo-label class usage as an indicator of CTTA instability and quantify this behavior. Most existing methods have attempted to address this issue by either selecting reliable adaptation samples or re-weighting the loss to encourage diverse pseudo-labels, but they do not explicitly enforce a class marginal over a temporal window. Instead, we propose Sinkhorn Class-Marginal Regularization (SCALAR), a simple plug-and-play module that controls the pseudo-label distribution over a short temporal window. SCALAR works by maintaining recent predictions in a buffer, balancing their class distribution via the Sinkhorn algorithm to match a specified target distribution, and using the balanced soft targets for adaptation. Without changing the model architecture, SCALAR maintains the per-step runtime and increases the peak allocated GPU memory by only 10 MB on ImageNet-C. Our method is particularly effective on skewed, non-stationary data with severe distribution shifts, where SCALAR significantly alleviates drift and collapse when combined with existing stabilization methods based on entropy or diversity.

</details>


### [271] [RAIL: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning for Student-Compatible Teacher Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12251)
*Meraj Mammadov,Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires,Johannes Andreas Stork*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAIL 在教师策略训练阶段引入共享隐空间：用对比学习对齐教师(特权观测)与学生(原始观测)的表征，并直接在该共享空间中训练教师策略，从而保证教师行为可由学生可观测量复现，显著缩小模仿差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从原始高维观测(图像/机载传感器)做RL面临高维输入与稀疏奖励难题。特权信息教师+蒸馏到学生的范式存在“不可约模仿差距”问题：教师依赖学生无法获取的信息，精确模仿不可能。已有方法靠奖励塑形或事后学生再RL修补，均属被动缓解。

Method: Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning：(1) 用对比学习在教师与学生观测之间学习共享潜表征；(2) 将教师策略直接约束在该共享空间上训练，使教师学到“可被学生观测复现”的行为；(3) 随后蒸馏到仅用原始输入的学生策略，无需奖励修改或事后学生微调。

Result: 在多个环境中，RAIL 在不修改奖励、不做事后学生微调的情况下优于强基线，并超过直接从原始观测做RL；共享表征还支持仅训练教师即可零样本迁移到新任务。

Conclusion: 将跨模态表征对齐前置到教师训练环节是消除模仿差距的有效途径，且共享潜空间可复用为任务迁移的接口。局限在于摘要未给出实机实验细节与对比学习对观测模态差异的敏感性分析。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from raw sensory inputs such as images or onboard sensors can be challenging due to high-dimensional observations and sparse rewards. A common strategy is to train a teacher policy with access to privileged state information and then distill it into a student policy that acts from raw inputs alone. However, when the teacher relies on information unavailable to the student, exact imitation may be impossible, creating an irreducible imitation gap. Existing approaches typically mitigate this mismatch through careful reward shaping or additional reinforcement learning on the student policy after the teacher has been trained. Instead, we introduce Representation-Aligned Imitation Learning (RAIL), which addresses the mismatch during teacher training itself. RAIL learns a latent representation shared across teacher and student observations using contrastive learning, and trains the teacher policy directly in this space. Because the teacher policy is constrained to operate on this shared space, it learns behaviors that are reproducible from student observations. This substantially reduces the imitation gap while preserving task performance. Across multiple environments, RAIL outperforms strong baselines without reward modification or post-hoc student fine-tuning, and surpasses direct reinforcement learning from raw observations. The learned representations further enable zero-shot transfer to new tasks through teacher-only training. Project site: this https URL .

</details>


### [272] [How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12324)
*Ku Onoda,Haruto Kawano,Shota Takashiro,Kohei Hayashi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MechEval（基于ARC-AGI-3游戏程序标注20个游戏中的69种机制）与WARC（35M参数ViT世界模型，每个转移后全参数测试时训练），量化世界模型预测新环境机制所需"暴露次数"，约80次暴露内半数机制达80%+精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型可在"想象"中规划学习，但面对陌生环境须从有限交互中学习其机制（动作如何改变环境）。作者追问一个此前未被量化的问题：世界模型需要多少次"暴露"（每次机制发生的一次观测）才能预测新环境机制的效果。

Method: 1) 在ARC-AGI-3这一由程序定义的交互式游戏基准上，提出MechEval：依据游戏程序标注20款游戏中69种反复出现的机制，仅在机制改变的单元格上评估预测。2) 构建WARC，一个35M参数视觉Transformer世界模型，在其他游戏上预训练，并在每次环境转移后更新全部参数（测试时训练）。3) 结合固定图搜索器构成WARC-Agent进行闭环游玩。

Result: 留出游戏上，WARC能对五分之四的机制在机制变化单元格上达到≥80%精度并保持到录制结束；其中一半在单次游玩约80次暴露内达标，而不做更新时仅七分之一能达到。闭环公开游戏中，WARC-Agent将探索器官方效率分从0.15提升到0.46（主要来自测试时训练）；Kaggle隐藏游戏榜单得分0.20。

Conclusion: 在机制层面而非整帧像素层面对世界模型进行细粒度评估是有效且可诊断的；对预训练模型进行全参数测试时训练，能显著加速对新环境机制的习得，并转化为下游智能体探索效率的实际提升，说明"暴露次数"可作为衡量世界模型样本效率的实用指标。

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As a test bed, we build WARC (World model for ARC-AGI-3), a 35M-parameter vision transformer that is pretrained on other games and updates all of its parameters after each transition. On held-out games, WARC learns to predict four in five mechanics with at least 80% accuracy on the cells they change and keeps that accuracy to the end of the recordings. Half of them reach that accuracy within about 80 exposures, in a single play of the game, and without updates only one in seven does at all. In closed-loop play on the public games, WARC-Agent, which pairs WARC with a fixed graph explorer, triples the explorer's official efficiency score from 0.15 to 0.46, mostly through test-time training. On the hidden games of the Kaggle leaderboard, our entry scores 0.20.

</details>


### [273] [LawKAN: Group-Law Layers for Composition -- When Imposing a Known Law Pays Off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12567)
*Anna Mishchenko,Nikolai Gavrilin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“已知结构 + 学习残差”的群结构嵌入层：节点内置精确非交换群合成律，边学习局部增量，零初始化修正项ψ学习硬件偏差；给出可精确表示性的预训练判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务需按已知规则合成变换（如机器人/导航中的链式旋转）。端到端学习会重复学习规则并累积误差；经典估计器硬编码规则却无法建模硬件偏差。二者均有缺陷，作者希望显式施加已知结构、只学剩余部分。

Method: 在自包含层的节点中放入精确非交换群合成律，层边（如54参数的稠密边）学习局部增量，另设零初始化修正项ψ学习群律的未知偏差；提出预训练判据用于判定精确可表示性；在固定角SU(2)合成任务与真实机械臂上验证，并与最强固定矩阵基线及Gauss-Newton比较。

Result: 固定角SU(2)合成中，54参数稠密边为最精确的稠密模型，参数量比最强固定矩阵基线少27倍，距Bayes下界仅0.05°；真实机械臂上，孤立306参数ψ在N≥60时达1.12–1.14 mm，优于Gauss-Newton的1.29–1.33 mm，且在三家厂商、两种协议间可迁移。

Conclusion: 该方案在数据遵循群律时与经典拟合相当，在施加的群律与任务不符时性能下降；即“结构嵌入+学习残差”适用于规则已知且存在偏差的实际场景。

Abstract: Many tasks compose transformations by a known rule: chained rotations in robotics and navigation. Learned models relearn it, compounding error; classical estimators hardcode it and miss hardware deviations. We impose the known structure and learn only the remainder: an exact non-commutative group law sits in the node of a self-contained layer, its edges learn local increments, and a zero-initialized correction psi learns unknown deviations of the law. A pre-training criterion predicts exact representability. On fixed-angle SU(2) composition, a 54-parameter dense edge is the most accurate dense model, at 27x fewer parameters than the strongest fixed-matrix baseline, and lies 0.05 deg above the Bayes floor. On real robot arms, an isolated 306-parameter psi reaches 1.12-1.14 mm versus 1.29-1.33 mm for Gauss-Newton at N >= 60, and the recipe transfers across three vendors and two protocols. The recipe matches classical fits where the data obey the law and loses where the imposed law is not the task's.

</details>


### [274] [Simulation-aided Reinforcement Learning with Control Variates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12643)
*Omer Hemo,Ido Sefi,Mirco Mutti,Aviv Tamar,Kfir Y. Levy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于控制变量的保守仿真辅助强化学习：仿真数据仅用于降低学习方差而不直接塑造学习目标，先在策略评估中实现，再嵌入actor-critic与离线RL，MuJoCo任务优于标准仿真混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境数据昂贵且有噪声，仿真器可大量生成数据，但直接混合仿真与真实经验会因仿真不准确而退化性能，甚至把解偏置离最优策略。

Method: 以控制变量（control variates）为框架，将仿真数据作为方差缩减项：用仿真与真实数据构建无偏/低方差的估计器进行策略评估；再结合到actor-critic中用于策略改进，并扩展到离线RL设定。

Result: 在多个MuJoCo基准任务上相较标准仿真混合方法取得性能提升，验证控制变量可作为仿真辅助RL的有效工具。实验主要为仿真基准，缺乏真实机器人验证。

Conclusion: 仿真数据"只减方差、不改目标"的思路可缓解仿真偏差带来的负面影响，为仿真辅助RL提供了一条保守而通用的技术路径；但需真实系统与深度仿真偏差场景的进一步验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms often rely on data collected from a target environment, which can be expensive and noisy. Although simulators can generate large amounts of additional data, standard simulation mixing approaches, which directly combine simulated and real experience, can degrade performance due to simulator inaccuracies, especially when they bias the solution away from the optimal policy. We propose a conservative simulation-aided learning method based on control variates, where simulated data is used solely to reduce variance in the learning process rather than directly shaping the learning target. We develop our approach for Policy-Evaluation, which is a fundamental building block of RL algorithms. Then we combine it within the actor-critic framework towards policy improvement, as well as extend it towards offline RL scenarios. Experiments on multiple MuJoCo benchmark tasks demonstrate improvements over standard simulation mixing approaches, highlighting control variates as an effective tool for simulation-aided reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [275] [Controlled Binary Assignment Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12668)
*Paul Fröhling,Christoph Schnörr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种几何方法，用于表示和学习图上二值标注的时变深度赋值流（assignment flow）参数化：每条边携带一个在二维全测地子流形上最优控制的参数流，并以非局部线性尺度空间目标为基础，三流之聚合在五维全测地子流形中的学习由数据驱动，通过几何积分得到二值深度赋值流各层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度赋值流（assignment flow）是高维参数空间上的几何化标签学习框架，但其参数化与层间传播的训练代价高、结构约束不明确，需要一种可并行的局部几何合成方式来构造与学习时变参数化。

Method: 几何方法：每条边定义在二维全测地子流形上、由非局部线性尺度空间表示导出的目标函数驱动的最优控制参数流；三元组流聚合到五维全测地子流形中并从数据学习融合权重；融合决定高维对称参数空间中的轨迹，采用几何积分实现深度赋值流的各层。

Result: 数值实验展示了该“高度并行、几何局部合成”方案对高维深度赋值流参数化的表达能力，同时也揭示了其局限性。

Conclusion: 该工作为深度赋值流提供了一种结构化、可并行的几何局部合成参数化与学习框架，但局部合成方式在高维参数化上存在表达瓶颈，后续需进一步扩展。

Abstract: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

</details>


### [276] [$Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12732)
*Xinrui Zu,Michael Przystupa,Zhao Yang,Shujian Yu,Kevin Sebastian Luck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在LeWorldModel上额外引入后向动力学预测器与逆动力学动作预测器两项潜空间损失，强化潜表征结构，从而同时提升世界模型的控制性能与规划效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无解码器的世界模型（如JEPA、LeWorldModel）仅依赖前向潜动力学预测器与熵正则来避免模式塌缩，潜空间结构约束较弱，导致规划性能与实时性不足以支撑真实机器人控制。

Method: 在LeWorldModel框架上叠加两个额外的潜空间损失：后向动力学预测器（由下一状态与动作回推当前状态嵌入）与逆动力学动作预测器（由状态转移对推断动作），与原有前向动力学预测器和熵项联合训练，形成前向-后向-逆向一致的结构化潜空间。

Result: 在标准世界模型基准以及两个仿真机器人操作任务上，性能与规划效率均有进一步提升。

Conclusion: 额外的潜动力学一致性损失可为无解码器世界模型提供有效结构正则，改善模型基控制的可行性与实时性；但证据限于仿真环境，真实机器人验证尚缺。

Abstract: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [277] [Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12777)
*Duy-Cuong Bui,Trung-Anh Dang,Vincent Nguyen,Duc V. Le,Ngoc-Son Vu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TEA-Prompt：单提示词持续学习新框架，用输入条件的 token 相关性打分（注入 attention logits）实现软性任务特化，并用基于高斯查询统计的注意力行为锚定损失约束旧类行为，仅 0.38M 参数在 CIFAR-100/ImageNet-R/CUB-200 上取得 SOTA 且遗忘显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单提示词（one-prompt）持续学习最大化参数效率，但共享提示在更新新任务时会漂移并破坏旧类功能。现有方法在参数空间做保护（冻结任务提示、扩展新组件、稀疏门控梯度），牺牲可塑性，且仍无法阻止共享 token 漂移。作者主张应保护提示的"行为"而非参数。

Method: (1) Token 评估模块：为每个 prompt token 赋予连续的、输入条件相关的得分，并将其注入 attention logits，从而在不丢弃任何 token 的前提下实现对任务的软性特化；(2) 注意力行为锚定损失：仅用紧凑的高斯查询统计（不存储旧图像），按 token 的过往相关性加权，将每个 token 的注意力输出约束在类特定查询区域附近，使参数可自由更新而交互行为保持不变。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、CUB-200 上取得 SOTA 精度，遗忘率明显降低，仅需 0.38M 可训练参数；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 从"保护参数"转向"保护行为"是解决单提示词持续学习稳定-可塑性矛盾的有效途径，且通过仅存高斯统计即可避免回放旧数据，兼具隐私友好与参数高效。

Abstract: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at this https URL

</details>


### [278] [Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12884)
*Zhaoying Pan,Yipei Wang,Shenyu Lu,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将高斯特征模型推广到任意子群分布，理论刻画了鲁棒子群泛化的性能景观，证明平衡数据并非唯一最优，并给出基于梯度的子群比例调整方向以更高效地提升调整准确率与最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子群偏移下模型平均精度高但泛化差，常用做法是强制子群比例平衡，但全平衡成本高、未必可行，也未必必要；作者希望检验“平衡训练数据是否为鲁棒子群泛化的唯一最优配置”。

Method: 扩展高斯特征模型（Gaussian feature-model）框架，对一般训练子群分布下的性能景观进行理论建模与分析；推导基于梯度的子群比例调整方向，用于定向优化调整准确率与最差组准确率。

Result: 理论分析显示存在多种配置（包括显著不平衡的配置）可与完全平衡配置的性能相当；梯度引导的比例调整方法在提升调整准确率与最差组准确率上更高效。

Conclusion: 平衡训练数据并非鲁棒子群泛化的唯一最优解，策略性地分配数据比简单均衡更灵活且更有理论依据，为数据中心化的鲁棒性方法提供了新视角。

Abstract: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [279] [Benchmarking Neural Image Compression with DCT-Based Spectral Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10000)
*Nikolay I. Kalmykov,Razan Dibo,Yujun Du,Yipeng Liu,Ivan Oseledets,Anh-Huy Phan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出用DCT基矩阵与单频测试图像探测神经图像压缩编解码器频域行为的基准，测量离靶能量泄漏与目标频率增益，并提出仅解码器微调方法大幅降低泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量率失真指标无法揭示编解码器对单个空间频率的处理方式，缺乏对NIC频域保真度的诊断手段。

Method: 以DCT基矩阵和单频图作为探针输入，定义相对离靶能量（泄漏）与目标频率增益，并用精确分解与误差界将其与重建误差关联；同时提出解码器端仅微调，使用自然图像损失与泄漏损失，保持码流不变。

Result: 约1 bpp处，BMSHJ、MBT、Cheng2020重建高频能量的80–97%落在目标频带之外，目标增益仅0.02–0.23；TCM与FTIC接近经典编解码器水平；Cheng2020-Anchor在孤立单频输入上出现极端预截断输出；微调后八种架构泄漏降低90–99.8%，Kodak PSNR代价0.09–0.59 dB。

Conclusion: 频域探针基准揭示了标量指标掩盖的失效模式，并提供了低代价的解码器端缓解方案；属分析方法类工作，与物理AI/3D/机器人核心方向关联有限。

Abstract: Neural image compression (NIC) models are commonly evaluated with scalar rate-distortion metrics, which do not show how a codec treats individual spatial frequencies. We propose a benchmark that probes codecs with the DCT basis matrix and single-frequency test images. We measure relative off-target energy (leakage), the fraction of reconstruction energy outside the probed frequency, together with target-frequency gain. Exact decompositions and bounds relate these measurements to reconstruction error. At operating points nearest 1 bpp, the BMSHJ, MBT, and Cheng2020 models leave 80-97% of their reconstructed high-band energy outside the target bin and have target-frequency gains of 0.02-0.23, whereas TCM and FTIC attain off-target energy in the classical-codec range. Both probe types identify behavior absent from scalar metrics: released Cheng2020-Anchor models produce extreme pre-clamp outputs on isolated single-frequency inputs. Finally, decoder-only fine-tuning with natural-image and leakage losses reduces basis off-target energy by 90-99.8% across all eight evaluated architectures while keeping the bitstream fixed, at a Kodak PSNR cost of 0.09-0.59 dB.

</details>


### [280] [Covariate-Conditioned One-Step Diffusion for Multi-Horizon 3D Brain MRI Prediction in Aging and Neurodegeneration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10043)
*Natenaile Asmamaw Shiferaw,Ali Farki,Deepika Koundal,Jussi Tohka*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出协变量条件的一步扩散框架，通过残差预测单步去噪实现3D灰质密度图的多时间跨度纵向预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从MRI预测纵向脑结构变化有助于刻画衰老与神经退行性变的进程，但扩散模型需迭代去噪，推理效率低；需在保证预测精度的同时实现高效单步预测。

Method: 不直接生成未来解剖，而是对纵向GMD变化做残差预测，单步去噪后将变化叠加到基线GMD图重建未来解剖；条件包括基线解剖、年龄、诊断、APOE4等位基因数及连续随访时间；训练结合MSE与Pearson相关损失以提升空间一致性；单一模型支持2–10年多个预测时域。

Result: ADNI测试集Δ-Pearson 0.478、MSE 5.176e-3、SSIM 0.979（10年Δ-Pearson 0.582）；未重训练外推AI​​BL：Δ-Pearson 0.450、MSE 4.016e-3、SSIM 0.985；消融验证残差预测、协变量条件与相关性监督的有效性。

Conclusion: 条件化单步扩散残差预测可在单次去噪下实现多时域脑结构变化预测，效率高且具跨队列泛化能力。

Abstract: Predicting longitudinal brain changes from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can help characterize structural progression associated with aging and neurodegeneration. However, diffusion-based forecasting typically requires iterative denoising, limiting inference efficiency. We propose a covariate-conditioned one-step diffusion framework for multi-horizon prediction of 3D gray-matter density (GMD) maps. Rather than directly generating future anatomy, the model predicts longitudinal GMD changes through residual prediction in a single denoising step. The predicted changes are added to the baseline GMD map to reconstruct future anatomy. The model is conditioned on baseline anatomy, age, diagnosis, APOE4 allele count, and continuous follow-up time. Training combines mean squared error with a Pearson correlation loss to improve the spatial agreement between predicted and observed GMD changes. A unified model supports prediction horizons from 2 to 10 years. On the held-out ADNI test set, our method achieves a $\Delta$-Pearson of 0.478, mean squared error (MSE) of $5.176 \times 10^{-3}$, and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.979, with $\Delta$-Pearson reaching 0.582 at 10 years. Without retraining, external evaluation on AIBL yields a $\Delta$-Pearson of 0.450, MSE of $4.016 \times 10^{-3}$, and SSIM of 0.985. Ablation studies further demonstrate the benefits of residual prediction, covariate conditioning, and correlation-based supervision. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [281] [Frequency-consistent synthesis and selective transfer for medical image analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10070)
*Zhuhui Wang,Jianwei Zuo,Xin Peng,Kai Zhong,Xuliang Deng,Jiajia Luo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出将医学图像合成与下游任务学习耦合的训练框架，通过自适应频率一致性约束与选择性特征迁移，并用任务误差边际门控特征蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 互补成像（如多模态MRI）并非总能获得，且"视觉上逼真的合成"不一定提升下游分析；需要让合成直接服务于任务目标。

Method: 训练框架：①自适应频率一致性损失（image-specific frequency constraints）保证结构与细节一致；②选择性特征迁移——仅在"用合成图像训练的教师模型在标记训练样本上按任务专属边际比学生模型任务误差更低"时才迁移其特征；在五个数据集上以三种无配对监督的对抗与扩散翻译器评测。

Result: 翻译保真度提升；在含肿瘤切片上的脑肿瘤分割与病灶中心点检测上取得增益；105 项配对比较的点估计均支持所提方法，含 36 项在未重训练情况下的治疗后MRI外部翻译比较。

Conclusion: 合成模态可作为面向任务的有益补充，在互补成像不可获得时替代/辅助真实采集。

Abstract: Complementary imaging is not always available, and realistic synthesis does not necessarily improve downstream analysis. Here we introduce a training framework linking medical image synthesis to task learning through adaptive frequency consistency and selective feature transfer. Image-specific frequency constraints encourage consistency of structure and detail. Features are transferred only when a teacher using synthetic images achieves a lower task-error score than the student by a task-specific margin on a labelled training sample. Evaluations across five datasets show improved translation fidelity with three adversarial and diffusion-based translators trained without paired supervision, alongside gains in brain-tumour segmentation on tumour-containing slices and lesion centre-point detection. All 105 reported paired comparisons yielded point estimates favouring the proposed methods, including 36 external translation comparisons on post?treatment MRI without retraining. These findings support synthetic modalities as task-oriented complements to acquired scans when complementary imaging is unavailable.

</details>


### [282] [Noise-Regularized Training for Learned Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10073)
*Renjie Zou,Zhiwei Huang,Dong Jiang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该论文为学习式图像压缩（LIC）引入"噪声正则化训练"：在编码器输入加高斯噪声、保持失真目标与熵编码流程不变，架构无关且几乎零开销，可稳定获得BD-Rate增益，并从二阶展开给出信息加权雅可比惩罚+端到端Frobenius收缩惩罚的理论解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LIC训练几乎只用干净图像，唯一的随机扰动是潜域注入的均匀代理以便熵模型可微。作者借鉴Tikhonov正则、contractive autoencoder、denoising score matching与扩散模型中"输入高斯噪声是数据流形的结构化探针而非数据增强"的观点，希望为LIC引入有明确理论依据的正则化来提升率失真性能。

Method: 训练时向编码器输入加高斯噪声、保持失真目标/均匀潜域代理/超先验/熵编码管线不变；架构无关、无显著训练与推理开销。理论侧用噪声RD损失的二阶展开证明等效为结构化O(σ²)正则项：速率侧为信息加权编码器雅可比惩罚，失真侧为端到端重建映射的Frobenius收缩惩罚；并用有限差分Lipschitz分析（编码器约12%、端到端约8%敏感度下降）与精确JVP检验验证高信息方向被优先收缩。

Result: 在复现的ELIC上BD-Rate -2.60%；在变码率DMCI编解码器Base/Medium/Large规模上分别为-0.85%/-1.05%/-2.38%，DMCI-Large相对VTM-22.0达-22.02%。敏感度分析显示编码器约12%、端到端编解码器约8%的Lipschitz敏感度下降，JVP实验显示高信息方向被优先压缩。代码与模型已开源。

Conclusion: 简单、通用的输入噪声正则化可为LIC带来一致且可解释的编码效率提升，其收益可归因于结构化的雅可比/Frobenius收缩正则；该思路对任何LIC骨干均适用。

Abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) is trained almost exclusively on clean images: the only stochastic perturbation in the loop is an additive uniform proxy injected in the latent domain to keep the entropy model differentiable. Outside compression, by contrast, a long line of work---from Tikhonov regularization and contractive autoencoders through denoising score matching and modern diffusion models---has established that Gaussian noise at the input of a network with a clean target acts as a structured probe of the data manifold rather than as data augmentation. Building on this view, we introduce noise-regularized training for LIC: at every training step we add Gaussian noise to the encoder input while keeping the distortion target, the latent uniform proxy, the hyperprior, and the entropy coding pipeline unchanged. The recipe is architecture-agnostic and adds essentially no training or inference overhead. Across backbones and operating regimes it yields consistent BD-Rate gains: -2.60% on a reproduced ELIC and -0.85% / -1.05% / -2.38% on the Base/Medium/Large scales of a variable-rate DMCI codec, with DMCI-Large reaching -22.02% against VTM-22.0. A second-order expansion of the noisy RD loss accounts for these gains: because the noise enters upstream of the analysis transform, it converts the clean RD objective into a structured $O(\sigma^{2})$ regularizer comprising an information-weighted encoder-Jacobian penalty (rate side) and a Frobenius contractive penalty on the end-to-end reconstruction map (distortion side). A finite-difference Lipschitz analysis shows corresponding sensitivity reductions of ~12% for the encoder and ~8% for the end-to-end codec, while an exact-JVP test further shows preferential contraction of high-information directions. Code and trained models are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [283] [Polarization Aware Deep Learning Framework for SAR Despeckling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10091)
*Gianpaolo Passarello,Sergio Vitale,Hossein Aghababei,Giampaolo Ferraioli,Vito Pascazio*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出统一深度学习去斑框架：用单一CNN、九通道极化协方差矩阵表示与极化感知掩码策略，同时处理单/双/全极化SAR去斑，无需改动网络结构或分别训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习SAR去斑方法受限于特定极化配置，往往需要专用网络架构或独立训练流程，跨极化配置适用性差，缺乏统一方案。

Method: 采用极化协方差矩阵的统一九通道表示，并设计极化感知掩码策略，使同一卷积神经网络在单极化、双极化和全极化数据间共享权重，无需修改架构或重新训练。

Result: 在来自不同传感器的三个场景上进行定性定量对比，各实验配置下均取得有竞争力的去斑性能。

Conclusion: 统一的、极化灵活的去斑框架在多种极化配置下可行，为SAR图像去斑提供单一模型的通用解决思路。

Abstract: Speckle is an inherent characteristic of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery that complicates image interpretation and the extraction of reliable information. Although deep-learning-based despeckling methods have demonstrated promising performance, their applicability across different polarimetric configurations is often limited by the need for specialized architectures or separate training procedures. This paper presents a unified deep-learning framework for despeckling single-, dual-, and full-polarization SAR data using a single trained convolutional neural network. The proposed approach adopts a common nine-channel representation of the polarimetric covariance matrix and a polarization-aware masking strategy to accommodate different configurations without modifying the network architecture. Qualitative and quantitative comparison on three different scenes from different sensors demonstrate competitive performance across the considered experiments and support the feasibility of a unified, polarization-flexible approach to SAR despeckling across different polarimetric configurations.

</details>


### [284] [Dataset Collections: Challenges of Large-Scale Data Aggregation in 3D Medical Image Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10144)
*Yannick Kirchhoff,Saikat Roy,Elisa Stegmeier,Hamideh Haghiri,Constantin Ulrich,Maximilian Rouven Rokuss,Tassilo Wald,Karol Gotkowski,Benjamin Hamm,Raphael Stock,Nico Disch,Michael Baumgartner,Dimitrios Bounias,Anand Deshpande,Stefan Dinkelacker,Stefan Dvoretskii,Katharina Eckstein,Selen Erkan,Jessica Kächele,Kim-Celine Kahl,Balint Kovacs,Lucas Kulla,Moritz Langenberg,Philipp Schader,Stephen Schaumann,Dasha Trofimova,Shuhan Xiao,Sebastian Ziegler,David Zimmerer,Marco Nolden,Fabian Isensee,Klaus Maier-Hein,Ralf Floca*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 在56.5万张3D医学影像、1034个公开数据集上揭示广泛的重复复用（≥11.8万对重复），并提出可溯源的MAP元数据规范与公开哈希工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集构建受限于专家标注成本，高质量医疗数据集规模有限，故研究者倾向于聚合大量公开数据集；但大规模聚合掩盖了数据来源与溯源，带来重复复用传播、无意泄漏、偏置放大和分布扭曲等风险。

Method: 将"数据集集合（dataset collections）"形式化为医学图像分析中的独立范式并刻画其结构性挑战；在56.5万张3D影像、1034个公开数据集上进行大规模实证，用感知哈希与人工追溯检测重复；提出轻量可移植的元数据规范MAP（Metadata for Aggregation and Provenance）记录溯源、已知重叠与去重决策，并公开哈希供比对。

Result: 发现跨公开数据集存在大量精确与近重复复用，识别出至少11.8万对重复样本（下界）；公开感知哈希与MAP规范及配套网页工具。

Conclusion: 该工作推动数据集集合从粗粒度聚合转向可溯源、可靠的数据扩展机制，提升医学AI数据治理的透明度。

Abstract: The development of deep learning-based medical AI depends on high-quality annotated data. Yet, dataset creation remains constrained by the need for expert radiologist annotations, limiting curated datasets to relatively small cohorts. To overcome this limitation, recent efforts increasingly aggregate disparate public datasets into large-scale dataset collections. However, combining datasets at scale often obscures data provenance, introducing substantial risks of reuse propagation, unintended leakage, bias amplification and distorted data distributions. In this work, we study these problems on a massive collection of 565k 3D radiological images across 1034 public datasets and provide practical resources to address them. Firstly, we formalize dataset collections as a distinct paradigm in medical image analysis and characterize their structural challenges, including reuse propagation, duplication, and provenance fragmentation. Secondly, we perform a large-scale empirical study of duplication on this collection and demonstrate extensive exact and near-duplicate reuse across public datasets via perceptual hashing and manual tracing, identifying a lower bound of 118k duplicate pairs. We make the perceptual hashes publicly accessible for comparison through our website, providing researchers with a standardized reference for identifying potential overlaps and shared provenance. Thirdly, since hashing alone cannot detect all duplicates, we introduce MAP (Metadata for Aggregation and Provenance), a lightweight, portable metadata profile for documenting provenance, known overlaps, and deduplication decisions in dataset collections. Our contributions help dataset collections shift from coarse aggregations to reliable and provenance-aware data scaling mechanisms in medical image analysis. A web tool supporting our work is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [285] [Leveraging High-Activity Post-Therapeutic I-131 Scans for Deep Learning Reconstruction of Extremely Sparse Planar Images in Differentiated Thyroid Cancer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12044)
*Boyang Pan,Hang Yang,Jianchen Pan,Cui Gan,Lanxi Zhang,Hongmin Li,Nan-Jie Gong*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究提出以治疗后高计数 I-131 全身平面扫描作为训练参考，通过跨域迁移学习与输入图像相加策略（PT_DLx2、PT_DLx1+、PT_DLx2+，基于 Restormer），增强分化型甲状腺癌低计数诊断平面图像，并在34例配对测试队列上用PSNR/SSIM与双读者盲评验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 诊断性 I-131 平面显像受限于给药活度低、采集快，光子统计不足导致图像质量差；而直接在计数受限诊断数据上训练的模型其监督目标本身缺乏光子统计，无法学到高质量先验，因此需要更优的训练参考源。

Method: 单中心前瞻性研究，111 例患者分为 PT 训练集（n=19）、诊断随访训练集（n=58）与随访配对测试集（n=34）。训练五个 Restormer 模型：FU_DLx2（仅用诊断标签）、PT_DLx2（在高计数 PT 数据上迁移学习）、PT_DLx1+/PT_DLx2+（引入输入图像相加）、PT_DLx6（仅 PT 参考）。测试阶段采用两步反归一化与泊松重标定以保留噪声统计，评估 PSNR、SSIM 及 34 例测试患者全体双读者盲评。

Result: PT_DLx2 取得最高 PSNR（34.4±3.6 dB）与 SSIM（0.81±0.07）；PT_DLx1+ 与 PT_DLx2+ 相当（33.8/33.3 dB，SSIM 0.80）；FU_DLx2 甚至低于未处理的快速扫描（30.3 vs 32.0 dB，0.76 vs 0.79）。主观评价 PT_DLx2+ 图像质量（4.54±0.60）与诊断信心（4.54±0.60）最高，优于参考标准（4.19±0.83、4.31±0.81；P=0.005、P=0.008）；FU_DLx2 与 PT_DLx6 得分最低。

Conclusion: 高计数 PT 扫描可为极稀疏图像重建提供有效训练先验；输入图像相加与跨域迁移学习优于直接在计数受限诊断数据上训练，支持 2 倍采集加速且图像质量匹配或超过未加速标准扫描。

Abstract: Background: Diagnostic I-131 whole-body planar imaging in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) is count-limited by low administered activity, and quality worsens under rapid acquisition. Models trained on such data struggle because their targets lack photon statistics. Purpose: To test whether high-quality post-therapeutic (PT) I-131 scans can serve as superior training references for enhancing sparse diagnostic planar images, using transfer learning and input-image addition. Methods: In this single-center prospective study, 111 patients were enrolled in PT training (n = 19), diagnostic follow-up (FU) training (n = 58), and FU paired test (n = 34) cohorts. Five Restormer-based models were trained: FU_DLx2 on FU labels; PT_DLx2 transfer-learned on PT data; PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ with input-image addition; PT_DLx6 as a PT-only reference. Test-time processing used two-step denormalization and Poisson re-scaling to preserve noise statistics. Quality was assessed by PSNR, SSIM, and a blinded dual-reader evaluation of all 34 test-cohort patients. Results: PT_DLx2 achieved the highest PSNR (34.4 +/- 3.6 dB) and SSIM (0.81 +/- 0.07). PT_DLx1+ and PT_DLx2+ were comparable (33.8 and 33.3 dB; SSIM 0.80). FU_DLx2 ranked below the unprocessed fast scan (30.3 vs. 32.0 dB; 0.76 vs. 0.79). Subjectively, PT_DLx2+ scored highest in image quality (4.54 +/- 0.60) and diagnostic confidence (4.54 +/- 0.60), surpassing the reference standard (4.19 +/- 0.83 and 4.31 +/- 0.81; P = 0.005 and P = 0.008). FU_DLx2 and PT_DLx6 scored lowest. Conclusion: Count-rich PT scans provide effective training priors for reconstructing extremely sparse images. Input-image addition and cross-domain transfer learning from PT data outperformed direct training on count-limited diagnostic data, supporting 2x scan acceleration with quality matching or exceeding the unaccelerated standard scan for selected PT-derived configurations.

</details>


### [286] [A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12682)
*Mariela Talavera-Muñoz,Cecilia Diana-Albelda,Miguel Antonio Sampedro-Nuñez,Victor Rodriguez-Laval,Jesus Bescos,Álvaro García-Martín*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出面向小样本放射组学生存分析的四步验证协议（FDR校正特征选择、双路径策略比较、重复嵌套交叉验证、高斯噪声阴性对照），在78例GEP-NET患者L3层面CT体成分放射组学上验证，发现预后信号存在但不确定性显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEP-NET缺乏预后生物标志物，L3层面CT体成分放射组学有潜力，但小样本导致高维模型易过拟合、单次划分评估方差大且偏乐观，缺乏可靠的验证方法学。

Method: 78例患者、5个L3解剖分区共535个放射组学特征，评估5种生存模型；协议包含：FDR校正特征选择、先验特征选择 vs 嵌入式正则化双路径对比、重复嵌套交叉验证、高斯噪声特征阴性对照；以Harrell C-index、时间依赖AUC和IBS评价。

Result: 噪声下18%外层折选出特征（名义水平20%），放射组学特征为84%；两种特征策略无一致性差异；重复嵌套CV使C-index标准差中位下降41%但不足以区分模型；真实特征C-index超出随机0.07–0.15，噪声下不明确（0.40–0.42 / 0.47–0.55）；高频入选特征提示皮下脂肪较多、骨骼肌致密度与纹理较好者预后更佳。

Conclusion: L3放射组学存在中等强度预后信号，但不确定性很大，该协议可量化该不确定性，并可迁移至其他小样本放射组学生存研究。

Abstract: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic. This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS). Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis. These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: this https URL .

</details>

### [287] [Cable construction effects on the lateral forces and wakes of helically stranded cables under oblique inflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11286)
*Tielin Ma,Junlin Zhang,Jingcheng Fu,Chongwen Jiang,Chuan Ye*

Main category: physics.flu-dyn

TL;DR: 用LES与SPOD研究倾斜来流下光滑圆柱与四种绞缆（Re≈1e4，倾角22.5°–90°），发现气动差异主要由截面对称性与股槽深度控制，并据此解耦侧向力均值与脉动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中拖曳系统中的螺旋绞缆常遭遇斜向来流，但建模时多简化为光滑圆柱，忽略三维横向耦合与表面纹理，导致气动载荷预测不准。

Method: 对光滑圆柱与四种绞缆在四个倾角下做静止状态大涡模拟，并用谱本征正交分解（SPOD）分析尾流；通过力源分解量化表面压力与黏性摩擦对法向/侧向力的贡献。

Result: 表面压力贡献平均法向力的94.9%–98.3%并主导平均侧向力；高对称准圆截面保持周向压力平衡与展向同步卡门脱落、能量集中于低秩主导模态；深槽三瓣截面破坏脱落相干性、使回流区侧偏、能量宽带分散。准圆(1×19)缆平均侧向力极小但脉动强，深槽(3×7)缆脉动弱但平均侧向力可观。

Conclusion: 侧向力的均值与脉动并不耦合，绞缆气动特性取决于构造（对称性与槽深），为按构造选缆及更精细的气动载荷建模提供依据。

Abstract: Helically stranded cables in aerial towing systems experience oblique inflow, but are often modeled as smooth cylinders, neglecting three-dimensional cross-stream coupling and surface texture. We perform large-eddy simulations and spectral proper orthogonal decomposition for a smooth cylinder and four stranded cables at four inclinations from $22.5^\circ$ to $90^\circ$, all stationary, with $Re \approx 1.0 \times 10^4$. Aerodynamic differences are governed mainly by cross-sectional symmetry and strand-scale groove depth. Force-source decomposition shows that surface pressure contributes 94.9%--98.3% of the mean normal force and dominates the mean lateral force. High-symmetry, quasi-circular envelopes maintain balanced circumferential pressure, whereas deep-grooved, low-symmetry tri-lobed geometries produce asymmetric separation and a persistent lateral pressure imbalance. In the wake, high-symmetry cables sustain spanwise-synchronized Karman shedding at moderate-to-high inclinations, concentrating fluctuation energy in a dominant low-rank mode. Deep grooves disrupt shedding coherence, deflect the recirculation zone laterally, and spread energy across broadband scales. Mean lateral force and lateral-force fluctuations are therefore decoupled: the quasi-circular $(1 \times 19)$ cable has minimal mean lateral force but strong periodic fluctuations, while the deep-grooved $(3 \times 7)$ cable has weak fluctuations but appreciable mean lateral force. These results support construction-dependent cable selection and aerodynamic load modeling.

</details>
