### [288] [Multi-Node Transformers for Object Detection and Captioning Across Distributed Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11291)
*Saurabh Kumar,Dewant Katare,Prakriti Jain*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出统一的Transformer框架，用共享视觉编码器完成目标检测与区域稠密描述，去除解耦流水线的二次图像编码；并建模跨边缘节点的阶段/码流分配（时间、显存、功耗、传输），六设备Jetson+RPi5测试平台INT8下Orin Nano达38.1 FPS/3.5GB/11.8W，四路流35.2 FPS、28.4ms端到端时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解耦的检测与描述流水线需重复编码图像特征，且大模型难以在资源受限边缘设备上部署，需要同时解决结构冗余与跨设备执行调度问题。

Method: 共享视觉编码器 + 检测头 + 区域特征提取 + 自回归语言解码的统一架构；形式化工作负载分配问题，将模型阶段与输入流映射到分布式边缘节点，约束执行时间、内存容量、处理器利用率、功耗上限与中间张量传输开销；采用TensorRT FP16/INT8量化部署。

Result: 四块Jetson Orin Nano/NX与两块Raspberry Pi 5组成的六节点测试平台上，Orin Nano单设备INT8达38.1 FPS、3.5GB峰值显存、11.8W实测功耗；四路并发时35.2 FPS、平均端到端时延28.4ms、节点间传输率6.8MB/s。

Conclusion: 统一编码显著降低内存与算力开销，配合跨节点负载分配可在低成本边缘集群上实现实时检测+区域描述，属于工程系统类贡献，不涉及机器人本体实验或3D/世界模型。

Abstract: This paper presents a unified transformer-based framework for object detection and dense region captioning across distributed edge networks. The architecture uses a shared visual encoder followed by detection, region extraction, and autoregressive language-decoding stages, allowing localization and region description to reuse the same image features. This design removes the second image-encoding path required by decoupled detection and captioning pipelines. To support execution on resource-limited devices, a workload-allocation formulation assigns model stages and input streams across connected edge nodes while accounting for execution time, memory capacity, processor utilization, power limits, and intermediate tensor transfer cost. The framework is evaluated on a six-device edge testbed comprising four NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and Orin NX inference nodes and two Raspberry Pi 5 auxiliary CPU nodes, with TensorRT FP16 and INT8 execution on the NVIDIA devices. On a Jetson Orin Nano, the unified INT8 model achieves 38.1 FPS with 3.5 GB peak memory use and 11.8 W measured power. Under four concurrent streams, the proposed allocation achieves 35.2 FPS and 28.4 ms mean end-to-end latency with an internode transfer rate of 6.8 MB/s.

</details>


### [289] [Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12319)
*Junha Ryu,Hoi-Jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 针对3DGS渲染中屏幕瓦片负载不均导致的SM级负载失衡与长尾执行问题，提出软件定义的GPU调度方案：持久化内核优先调度重瓦片，并按每帧统计信息选择性切分离群瓦片，无需重训练或专用硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS加速要么依赖需要重训练的算法改动，要么依赖缺乏通用性的专用加速器；作者发现大规模城市场景中瓦片间计算量差异造成严重的SM级负载不均衡，形成长尾执行，使多数SM空闲。

Method: 软件定义的GPU调度：使用persistent kernel将重瓦片优先调度，并对离群瓦片跨多个CTA进行选择性chunk切分；通过渲染管线中已有的瓦片统计信息，以轻量级逐帧策略决定何时切分及切分粒度。保持原始alpha blending公式，与已有优化正交。

Result: 单场景平均加速alpha blending最高2.93倍；在最不均衡的帧上最高达5.6倍，且保持原始alpha blending公式不变。

Conclusion: 3DGS渲染的瓶颈部分来自调度而非算法本身；软件层面消除执行长尾可显著提速，且无需重训练/专用硬件，可与各类3DGS变体的现有优化叠加使用。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS variants. Averaged per scene, it accelerates alpha blending by up to 2.93x on a large-scale urban scene, and by up to 5.6x on its most imbalanced frames, while retaining the original alpha blending formulation.

</details>


<div id='cs.HC'></div>

# cs.HC [[Back]](#toc)

### [290] [KR A1: Design and Preliminary Evaluation of a Humanoid-Robot Interaction Prototype Integrating Personalized Voice Synthesis, Contextual Dialogue, and Emotion-Aware Response Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09900)
*Mahek Aanthu,Om Aanthu,Aaryan AK Aanthu*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: KR A1人形机器人交互原型：本地LLM(Qwen2.5-3B)+OpenVoice v2零样本音色克隆+两级情感识别+人脸识别与FAISS记忆，实验仅评估音色克隆的8项声学相似度，非正式小样本自测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向潜在心理健康照护场景，构建具备个性化语音、情境对话与情感感知的人形机器人交互系统。

Method: 系统集成：Ollama本地部署Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct做NLU与回复生成；OpenVoice v2零样本说话人自适应合成；关键词启发式+LLM推理两级情感处理；InsightFace人脸识别与FAISS向量记忆检索实现个性化。评估仅针对语音克隆，用MFCC、基频、谱质心、谱对比度、谱滚降、过零率、共振峰、说话人嵌入余弦相似度共8项指标，配合同说话人/跨说话人基线对比。

Result: 仅报告声学相似度的初步对比结果，样本量小且非正式；未做统计显著性检验，情感识别准确率、端到端时延及临床/疗愈效果均未评估。

Conclusion: 属早期原型演示，缺乏严谨评测与真实场景验证，工程集成清单可作参考，但无方法学贡献，与物理AI/3D/具身操作核心方向关联弱。

Abstract: This paper presents the design and preliminary evaluation of KR A1, a humanoid-robot interaction prototype that integrates personalized voice synthesis, contextual dialogue processing, and emotion-aware response generation for potential mental-healthcare applications. The system architecture combines a locally hosted large language model (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, served via Ollama) for natural-language understanding and response generation, OpenVoice v2 for zero-shot speaker-adaptive speech synthesis, and a two-tier emotion-processing pipeline comprising a keyword heuristic and LLM-based inference. Face recognition (InsightFace) and vector memory retrieval (FAISS with sentence-transformer embeddings) enable user-personalized interaction. The experimental evaluation reported here is limited to the voice-cloning component: cloned voices were evaluated against reference recordings using eight acoustic similarity measures - mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, pitch, spectral centroid, spectral contrast, spectral rolloff, zero-crossing rate, formants, and speaker-embedding cosine similarity - supplemented by a same-speaker versus cross-speaker baseline comparison. All tests were conducted on a small, informal development sample; no statistical significance testing against a held-out baseline was performed. The emotion-recognition accuracy, end-to-end response latency, and therapeutic or clinical impact of the integrated system have not yet been formally evaluated and are identified as directions for future work. All testing was informal and self-conducted by the development team; no patients or external human participants were involved, and the system has not been evaluated or deployed in a clinical setting.

</details>


### [291] [Building Rapport with Self-Disclosure in Human-Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09905)
*Haritha Anupindi,Chayan Sarkar,Tapas Nayak,Marynel Vazquez*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出RADIA对话系统，用RAG检索"模拟自传体记忆"，使机器人能在面谈对话中自然地做第一人称自我披露；真人用户实验表明自我披露显著改变对话动态并提升用户感知的亲和度(rapport)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会机器人需建立亲和关系(rapport)以支持长期交互；人际沟通中自我披露是建立亲和的关键机制，但在HRI中作用不明。现有LLM对话机器人多为反应式信息提供者，缺乏社会互惠与关系深度。

Method: 提出RADIA：基于检索增强生成(RAG)的对话系统，让机器人检索并引用模拟的自传体记忆，将第一人称自我披露自然嵌入持续对话；随后开展面对面真人用户研究，与不进行自我披露的基线机器人对比。

Result: 自我披露显著影响对话动态，并提升用户对机器人的感知亲和度；作者据此认为自我披露是面向长期、社会性HRI的有价值社会行为。

Conclusion: 将人际沟通中的自我披露机制迁移至HRI可行且有效，RAG式"记忆检索"为机器人提供了一种低成本的关系深度构建手段，可作为社会对话机器人设计原则。

Abstract: As social robots become increasingly present in everyday environments, establishing rapport with users is critical for enabling sustained and meaningful human-robot interaction. In human-human communication, self-disclosure is a well-established mechanism for building rapport; however, its role and impact in human-robot interaction (HRI) are not yet well understood. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved the linguistic competence of conversational robots, such systems are typically deployed as reactive information providers, offering limited social reciprocity and relational depth. In this article, we investigate the role of robot self-disclosure in fostering rapport during face-to-face human-robot interaction. We propose a dialogue system, called RADIA that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enable a robot to retrieve and reference simulated autobiographical memories, allowing first-person self-disclosure to be incorporated naturally into ongoing conversations. We evaluate the proposed approach through an in-person user study, comparing interactions with a self-disclosing robot against a baseline non-self-disclosing robot. Our results show that robot self-disclosure significantly influences conversational dynamics and enhances users' perceived rapport with the robot, suggesting that self-disclosure is a valuable social behavior for long-term and socially engaging human-robot interaction.

</details>


### [292] [How to start a conversation proactively?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09906)
*Mohit Nathani,Aaditya Gupta,Eshwar Dhande,Chayan Sarkar*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出情境变量图式与CCO数据集，通过微调小语言模型实现社交机器人主动开启对话的情境化开场白生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM主要为"轮次反应式"，主动发起对话时缺乏对情境的原则化定义，生成的开场白泛化、单调，在具身社交机器人场景下不当或时机错误会损害用户参与度与亲和感。

Method: 构建联合刻画感知、情境与交互线索的上下文变量图式，用以结构化输入；构建覆盖多元日常场景的上下文对齐开场白数据集CCO；在此基础上微调小语言模型（SLM）生成主动对话开场白，并与零样本LLM、现成SLM进行对比评测。

Result: 显式上下文结构化与针对性数据策划显著提升开场白质量与情境适配性；微调SLM在对比中优于零样本LLM和现成SLM。

Conclusion: 上下文建模是主动社交互动的关键，所提出的图式与数据集为对话机器人提供可操作的构建模块。

Abstract: Proactively initiating a conversation is a fundamental social competence and a critical capability for social robots. However, determining how and when to start a conversation in a given situation remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of a principled definition of conversational context. While recent large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive conversational fluency, they are predominantly turn-reactive and often produce generic or monotonous openers when tasked with initiating interaction, even when contextual information is available. Such limitations are particularly problematic for embodied social robots, where inappropriate or poorly timed initiations can negatively affect user engagement and rapport. In this work, we propose a schema of contextual variables that jointly characterize situations relevant for proactive conversation initiation. The schema is designed to structure perceptual, situational, and interactional cues such that they can be effectively exploited by language models. Furthermore, motivated by the absence of suitable training data, we introduce a curated dataset of contextually-aligned conversation openers (CCO) covering diverse everyday scenarios. Using this dataset, we fine-tune small language models (SLMs) to generate proactive conversation initiations. Through a comparative evaluation involving zero-shot LLMs, off-the-shelf SLMs, and our fine-tuned models, we demonstrate that explicit contextual structuring and targeted data curation substantially improve the quality and contextual appropriateness of conversation openers. Our results highlight the importance of context modeling for proactive social interaction and provide actionable building blocks for conversational robots.

</details>


### [293] [Engagement Estimation in Human-Robot and Human-Human Interactions across Domain, Age and Culture: MultiMediate'26 Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09913)
*Marius Funk,Daksitha Withanage Don,Michal Balazia,Victor Oei,Shogo Okada,François Brémond,Andreas Bulling,Elisabeth André,Philipp Müller*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: MultiMediate'26 挑战赛综述：将参与度（engagement）估计扩展到儿童-儿童/儿童-机器人游戏场景（PInSoRo），与 NoXi、NoXi-J、MPIIGI 一起构成多域、多模态（任务型与社交型参与度）基准，并给出跨域基线模型与公开数据/特征/排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与度建模对辅助型与情境感知 AI 系统至关重要；既往工作只覆盖成人对话中的连续参与度值，而参与度的度量形式与表现随年龄、交互对象（人 vs 机器人）、文化而变化，缺乏儿童与机器人交互域。

Method: 构建 MultiMediate'26 挑战：整合 PInSoRo（英式儿童-儿童、儿童-机器人游戏会话，类别式任务/社交参与度标注）与 NoXi/NoXi-J/MPIIGI（成人对话），抽取多模态特征，提供统一跨域基线模型与评测协议、公开基线与排行榜。

Result: 摘要为挑战赛与基线描述，未给出定量结果；贡献为数据集域扩展、标注形式（类别 vs 连续）与交互类型多样化，以及可复现的基线/特征/榜单基础设施。

Conclusion: 该工作将参与度估计从成人对话推广到儿童与社交机器人交互的多域设定，为情境感知人机交互研究提供标准化基准，但本身属挑战赛/数据集类工作，不含新的建模方法突破。

Abstract: Understanding engagement in human interaction is essential for modelling assistive and context-aware AI systems. Previously, the MultiMediate challenge has focused on estimating momentary continuous engagement values in adult conversation across cultures, achieving high levels of generalisability across domains. However, engagement can be measured in different metrics and manifest differently between children and adults. MultiMediate'26 therefore expands the evaluated domain set to include the PInSoRo dataset of Child-Child and Child-Robot play sessions in English. These sessions were annotated categorically with task and social engagement, diversifying engagement types, age ranges and interaction types. In this paper, we describe the MultiMediate'26 challenge and its goals, introduce the NoXi, NoXi-J, MPIIGI, and PInSoRo datasets, showcase extracted multi-modal features, present our baseline model for engagement estimation across all domains, and discuss challenge submissions and approaches. In an effort to provide a transparent and welcoming challenge environment, baseline code, leaderboard, datasets, and extracted features are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [294] [Industry case studies of adapting TTS for smooth interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09914)
*Paige Tuttösi,Eléonore Ferrier-Barbut,Anais Scipioni,Olivia Yung,Ha Eun Shim,Ajla Basic,Yue Wang,H. Henny Yeung*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 综述并实践了面向特殊听众人群（养老院老人、机场噪声环境）的TTS自适应调制（音高、时长、强度），报告两项真实HRI案例研究的定性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经TTS/ASR系统多面向理想场景的平均用户设计，对有特殊聆听需求或非标准口音的用户表现不佳；同时工业级、生产级自适应TTS实现稀缺。

Method: 基于已有研究对TTS系统实施改造（音高、时长、强度等韵律参数的简单自适应调整），并在两个真实HRI场景中部署：养老院（老年人）与机场（高噪声导致理解困难）。

Result: 两项案例均显示，相对简单的韵律修改能带来可感知的改善迹象，定性结果指向有前景的HRI自适应方向。

Conclusion: 自适应TTS在真实HRI中具有实用价值，作者提出后续更大规模、更正式研究的框架；但当前结论以定性证据为主，缺乏定量评测与开源实现。

Abstract: Modern, neural-based ASR and TTS systems for speech communication are now very sophisticated, but they are frequently designed for average users in more idealized scenarios, which can underperform when interacting with users having specialized listening needs, or who speak in non-standard ways. Here we review recent TTS research, and note that industrial, production-level implementations of adaptive TTS systems are scarce. We describe how we implemented changes to TTS systems based on prior research, and then report qualitative results from two case studies, where adapted TTS techniques are applied to real-world HRI settings: First, in an older adult care home, and second, in an airport, where noise levels create comprehension problems. Results suggest promising directions using relatively simple modifications to pitch, duration, and intensity of the robot's speech, and offer a framework for larger, more formal studies of how TTS adaptations can improve HRI.

</details>


### [295] [Semantic-Enhanced Sparse Temporal Modeling for Dynamic Engagement Estimation in Multimodal Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09916)
*Yangchen Yu,Taoliang Wang,Jia Li,Nor Mazlina Ghazali,Mohd Nazim Mohtar,Bingkun Bao,Richang Hong*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: SEST：用MLLM提取多模态语义嵌入做对话感知上下文，并用稀疏到稠密的时间建模（帧序列→紧凑时间动态→融合语义→上采样回原标签分辨率）替代稠密逐帧建模，实现动态参与度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态参与度估计把声学、姿态、视觉表示与时间模型结合，但对话语义难以像连续音视频信号那样与帧级参与度标注对齐，导致对话上下文利用不足；同时参与度标注随时间平滑演化，稠密帧级建模计算冗余且易受局部标注噪声影响。

Method: Semantically-Enhanced Sparse Temporal (SEST) 框架：1) 用 Multimodal Large Language Model 抽取多模态语义嵌入，提供超出帧级特征的对话感知上下文；2) sparse-to-dense 路径：先将连续帧序列编码为紧凑时间动态表示（降低冗余计算、扩大时间覆盖），再与语义上下文融合，并恢复到原始标签分辨率做稠密预测。

Result: 在 MEE2026 benchmark 上验证有效性，取得挑战赛第一名。

Conclusion: SEST 表明语义级 MLLM 特征与稀疏–稠密时间建模的组合可有效弥补帧级对齐困难与稠密建模冗余；本质仍是人际参与度/对话行为识别，属人机交互感知邻域，与具身智能核心（操作、导航、3D/世界模型）关联较弱，方法可迁移但需自行验证。

Abstract: Dynamic engagement estimation aims to infer participants' evolving engagement states from continuous multimodal interaction streams. Existing approaches typically combine acoustic, pose, and visual representations with temporal models to capture observable interaction patterns. However, conversational semantics are difficult to align with frame-level engagement annotations in the same manner as continuous audio-visual signals, leaving dialogue context less effectively exploited in existing temporal modeling pipelines. Moreover, engagement annotations often evolve smoothly over time, making dense frame-level modeling computationally redundant and potentially sensitive to local annotation noise. To address these issues, we propose SEST, a Semantically-Enhanced Sparse Temporal framework that models engagement-related information from both semantic and temporal perspectives. SEST leverages Multimodal Large Language Models to extract multimodal semantic embeddings, providing dialogue-aware contextual information beyond conventional frame-level features. In parallel, SEST replaces dense-to-dense temporal modeling with a sparse-to-dense pathway, where continuous frame sequences are first encoded into compact temporal dynamics to reduce redundant computation and broaden temporal coverage, then fused with semantic context and recovered to the original label resolution for dense engagement prediction. Experiments on the MEE2026 benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of SEST, which achieved first place in the challenge.

</details>


### [296] [EgoVeil: Personalized Privacy Reasoning for Egocentric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10578)
*Xue Wang,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: EgoVeil：面向智能眼镜第一视角视频的个性化隐私推理系统，将局部视觉区域转为结构化语义观察，结合隐私推理器与用户特定记忆实现个性化、持续自适应的内容遮挡


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一视角持续视觉采集带来普遍且因人而异的隐私泄露风险，现有VLM无法进行用户个性化隐私判断

Method: 局部区域结构化语义观察 + 隐私推理器 + 显式用户记忆；支持随偏好证据累积的持续适应；在10名智能眼镜用户的真实数据上采用跨用户时序协议评估

Result: 平衡准确率91.93%，Mask召回84.42%，优于直接VLM基线及受控隐私推理基线

Conclusion: 个性化自适应隐私推理可在保护用户偏好的同时保留下游辅助所需的视觉上下文

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) enable AI systems to interpret egocentric video. Yet continuous visual capture raises privacy concerns because sensitive content is pervasive and varies across users and contexts. We present EgoVeil, a personalized privacy reasoning system that determines which visual content to obscure based on individual preferences while retaining context useful for downstream assistance. It converts localized visual regions into structured semantic observations and combines a privacy reasoner with an explicit user-specific memory for personalized privacy reasoning. This design supports personalization and continual adaptation as preference evidence accumulates. We evaluate on in-the-wild data from 10 smart-glasses users under a cross-user chronological protocol. EgoVeil achieves 91.93% balanced accuracy and 84.42% Mask recall, outperforming direct VLM baselines and other controlled privacy reasoning baselines. Our results show that personalized, adaptive privacy reasoning better aligns privacy preservation with individual preferences while retaining the visual context needed for effective smart-glasses assistance.

</details>


### [297] [Feel My Focus: Gaze-Triggered Digital Twin Creation for Remote Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11640)
*Shih-Yu Ma,Suibi Che-Chuan Weng,Ming-Yuan Pai,Tom Yeh,Ellen Yi-Luen Do*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: Feel My Focus：以持续注视作为生成动作，触发单图采集、注意力引导分割与one-shot三维重建，在MR远程协作中快速生成并共享轻量3D数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注视交互多将gaze仅用作指示/指针；作者希望把"持续视觉注意（fixation）"本身变为生成性动作，让远程协作者能就地查看与讨论物理对象，优先保证响应速度与体验连续性而非光度保真。

Method: 系统集成眼动追踪眼镜、模块化分割与重建服务、MR客户端（运行时流式传输与交互）；流程为注视点触发单图捕获→注意力引导分割→one-shot三维重建→MR端流式呈现与协同交互。

Result: 为公开演示类工作，报告了现场观察：设计权衡、失效模式以及真实协作部署中用户控制方面的考量；未给出定量精度/时延指标。

Conclusion: 验证了"注视即生成"的交互范式在真实协作场景中的可行性与体验价值，但需在保真度与响应性之间权衡，并重视失效情形与用户控制机制的设计。

Abstract: We present Feel My Focus, a gaze-triggered mixed reality (MR) demonstration that enables rapid creation and sharing of lightweight 3D digital twins during remote collaboration. Unlike systems that use gaze primarily as a referential pointer, Feel My Focus treats sustained visual attention as a generative action: a fixation on a physical object initiates single-image capture, attention-guided segmentation, and one-shot 3D reconstruction, allowing a remote partner to inspect and discuss the object in situ. The system integrates gaze-tracking glasses, modular segmentation and reconstruction services, and an MR client for runtime streaming and interaction. This design prioritizes responsiveness and experiential continuity over photometric fidelity. We report observations from a public demonstration, highlighting design trade-offs, failure modes, and user control considerations for deploying gaze-triggered generative systems in real-world collaborative settings.

</details>


### [298] [ROS2MR: Connecting ROS 2 Motion Planning to Mixed-Reality Trajectory Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11830)
*Santiago Berrezueta-Guzman,Habiba-Loai Khalil,Andrei Koshelev,Stefan Wagner*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: ROS2MR 将 YAML 序列化的 ROS 2 关节轨迹（含 MoveIt 规划）转换为 MR-Robotics LAB 的 JSON 回放格式，实现无实时 ROS 连接的混合现实轨迹检视。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MR 可在真实环境中检视机器人规划运动，但机器人软件输出的轨迹格式与 MR 应用回放格式不兼容，缺少直接可用的转换通路。

Method: 转换器校验输入、按名称映射机械臂关节，以 30 Hz 名义频率重采样：有速度时用三次 Hermite 插值，无速度时用线性插值；夹爪二值指令以零阶保持单独采样。Python 导出辅助工具拼接多段规划与夹爪状态并校验段边界位置一致性；应用同时适配 Apple Vision Pro 与 Meta Quest 3。

Result: 密集、稀疏与不规则时间输入下归一化时长与端点构型均被保留；有速度时位置 RMSE 约 2.91×10⁻⁵ 度，无速度时稀疏输入升至 0.85 度；位置一致性不保证速度廓线准确；抓放序列保持开—闭—开夹爪顺序，非网格对齐切换被移至输出采样网格。

Conclusion: 基于文件的通路使 ROS 生成轨迹可在 MR 中检视，无需实时 ROS 连接，属实用工具型贡献。

Abstract: Mixed reality (MR) allows users to inspect planned robot motion within their physical surroundings, but displaying trajectories from robotics software requires converting their joint configurations and timing into a format the MR application can play back. This paper presents ROS2MR, an extension of the MR-Robotics LAB platform that converts YAML-serialized ROS 2 joint trajectories, including MoveIt motion plans, into the platform's existing JSON playback format. The converter validates the input, maps arm joints by name, and resamples the trajectory at a nominal rate of 30 Hz, using cubic Hermite interpolation when joint velocities are supplied and linear interpolation otherwise, while binary gripper commands are sampled separately using a zero-order hold. A Python export helper combines sequences of motion plans and gripper states into a single trajectory and checks positional agreement at segment boundaries. The MR application was also adapted for Apple Vision Pro in addition to Meta Quest 3. A technical evaluation showed that the converter preserved the normalized duration and endpoint configurations for dense, sparse, and irregularly timed inputs. With supplied velocities, the position RMSE was approximately 2.91x10^-5 degrees for all sampling patterns; without them, sparse input increased it to 0.85 degrees, and close positional agreement did not guarantee accurate velocity profiles. A pick-and-place sequence retained its open--closed--open gripper order, although off-grid transitions were shifted to the output sampling grid. The resulting file-based pathway enables inspection of ROS-generated trajectories in MR without a live ROS connection.

</details>


### [299] [Co-Creating Neurorehabilitation Technology Alongside Lived Experience Experts: A Participatory Design Workshop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12202)
*Irene L. Y. Beck,Salvatore L. Cucinella,Johannes B. J. Bussmann,Natacha Léon,José López-Sánchez,Francesca Lunardini,Katherine L. Poggensee,Cristina Vázquez-González,Joost de Winter,Laura Marchal-Crespo*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 本文报告在神经康复会议开展的一次参与式设计（PD）工作坊：5位卒中亲历者作为"生活经验专家"与18名参会者分5组，按Double Diamond的Discover–Define–Develop流程，借助Journey Maps与数据采集手册共创解决方案；Journey Maps做主题分析，小组录音转写用大语言模型做结构化抽取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生活经验（LE）在神经康复技术设计中早期介入可提升方案相关性与有效性，但现实中LE专家往往只在原型完成后才被纳入测试。作者希望提出并评估一种能在早期就引入LE的参与式设计工作坊，并厘清LE贡献如何影响设计过程与产出。

Method: 在第六届国际神经康复大会上举办PD工作坊：5名卒中亲历者（LE专家）与18名参会者（含其照护者）组成5个小组，按Double Diamond的Discover、Define、Develop三阶段推进；每组使用Journey Map和数据采集笔记本，针对由LE专家指定的目标共创解决方案。对Journey Maps做主题分析，对小组录音转写用LLM进行结构化信息抽取，并收集参与者满意度与工具/协议的可复用性。

Result: LE输入使讨论从基于学科的假设转向扎根于生活经验的优先项，涵盖恐惧、信心、感官不适、疲劳、美学与独立性；狭窄目标（如打开泡罩包装）产出任务特定方案，宽泛目标产出器械概念（如骑行感觉反馈、带刺激的烹饪夹板）；参会者与LE专家满意度均高。

Conclusion: 该工作坊为在神经康复技术开发早期纳入LE专家提供了可操作基础；后续迭代应更好捕捉心理与社会维度、留出更多反思时间，并通过研究者与LE社群之间持续的超学科协作纳入完整相关利益相关方。所有工具与协议已公开以促进采用。

Abstract: Involving patients' lived experience (LE) early in neurorehabilitation technology design can improve the relevance and effectiveness of solutions, yet LE experts are often involved only when finished prototypes are tested. We present and evaluate a participatory design (PD) workshop for early LE involvement, examine how LE contributions influence design processes and outcomes, and provide recommendations for similar approaches. We conducted a PD workshop at the 6th International Conference on NeuroRehabilitation. Five people who have had a stroke (LE experts) and 18 workshop attendees (including the LE experts' caregivers) were organized into five groups. Following the Discover, Define, and Develop phases of the Double Diamond model, each group used Journey Maps and Data Collection Notebooks to co-create a solution for an objective specified by an LE expert. Journey Maps were thematically analyzed, and group audio transcripts underwent structured extraction using a large language model. LE input shifted discussions from discipline-based assumptions toward priorities grounded in lived experience, including fear, confidence, sensory discomfort, fatigue, aesthetics, and independence. Narrow objectives, such as opening a blister pack, produced task-specific solutions, whereas broader objectives generated device concepts, including sensory feedback for cycling and a stimulation-equipped cooking splint. Satisfaction was high among attendees and LE experts. All workshop tools and protocols are shared to support adoption. The workshop offers a practical foundation for involving LE experts early in neurorehabilitation technology development. Future iterations should better capture psychological and social dimensions, allow more reflection, and include the full range of relevant stakeholders through sustained transdisciplinary engagement between researchers and the LE community.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [300] [Confidence-driven adaptive semantic transmission for task-oriented communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11132)
*Suman Das,Prajnyajit Mohanty,Siddhartha S. Borkotoky*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出置信度驱动的自适应传输（CDA）：边缘端先用轻量分类器打分，按置信度在“文本标签／压缩ROI／原始ROI”三档传输模式间切换，服务器端据此直接采纳或调用强分类器复核，在带宽受限、有丢包的链路上兼顾通信开销与分类准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线网络下图像远程监控存在通信成本与分类可靠性之间的权衡：传整图带宽开销大，仅靠边缘轻量分类器则精度不足。需要一种能按需分配信息量的自适应机制。

Method: 边缘设备先对捕获图像跑轻量分类器，依据其置信度选择三种传输模式：（1）高置信——只发送预测类别的短文本串；（2）中等置信——发送压缩的ROI区域；（3）低置信——发送未压缩ROI。服务器在高置信时直接接受边缘预测，其余两种情况使用更强的分类器。

Result: 在带宽受限、有链路丢包及延迟约束的数值仿真中，CDA相较“仅传边缘分类结果”与“始终传未压缩ROI”两类非自适应基线，在接收端取得更高的任务准确率，同时控制通信量。

Conclusion: 基于置信度的模式切换是图像远程监控中通信—精度权衡的有效且低成本方案；但实验限于数值仿真，缺少真实网络/硬件部署验证，且强分类器与置信度阈值设计细节较简。

Abstract: Image-based remote monitoring over wireless networks faces a trade-off between communication cost and classification reliability. Transmitting complete images is communication-intensive, whereas relying solely on lightweight edge classifiers may compromise accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose Confidence-Driven Adaptation (CDA) for image transmission and classification. An edge device (ED) captures images and applies a lightweight classifier before transmission to a remote server. Based on its classification confidence, the ED selects among three transmission modes with varying levels of information: a short text string reporting its predicted class when confidence is high, a compressed Region of Interest (ROI) at intermediate confidence levels, or an uncompressed ROI when confidence is low. The server accepts the predicted class directly in the first case and performs classification using a more powerful classifier in the other two cases. Numerical evaluations under bandwidth-limited, lossy links and latency-constrained settings demonstrate that CDA achieves high task accuracy at the receiver compared with non-adaptive baselines that transmit only the edge-classifier outcome or the uncompressed ROI.

</details>


### [301] [Edge Computing for Computer Vision in IoT: Feasibility and Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11218)
*Panagiotis Savvidis,George A. Papakostas*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该综述性论文探讨边缘计算作为去中心化IoT架构（融合ML、CV与LoRaWAN/卫星通信）的可行性，从LoRaWAN与卫星IoT通信策略、边缘硬件上CV负载分析、以及支持低延迟能效IoT应用的未来方向三方面展开评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化架构与ML/CV/LPWAN的融合日益普及，但边缘计算在这一格局中的技术可行性、策略与流程尚未被系统梳理，作者希望建立技术可行性同实际与社会经济相关性之间的明确联系。

Method: 在真实动态条件下开展实验，评估技术层面、策略与流程流；研究路径涵盖未来6G多接入边缘拓扑、模型量化、卫星增强通信平台，并讨论了零样本学习、多模态感知与去中心化生成式AI等高级AI功能。

Result: 摘要未给出量化结果，仅概述三类研究目标（通信策略评估、边缘硬件CV负载分析、未来方向），属定性论述与观察性结论。

Conclusion: 边缘计算可成为低延迟、高能效、具社会影响力IoT应用的基础支柱，其价值需结合通信、算力与AI能力的协同演进加以评估。

Abstract: The convergence of decentralized architectures integrating Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Low Power Wide Area Networks is increasingly becoming an integral part of our daily existence. Internet of Things serves as a real-time data conduit enhancing decision making via embedded technology and continuous data exchange. This paper explores the feasibility of Edge Computing as a foundational pillar in this evolving landscape. We experiment under real world, dynamic conditions, evaluate the technological aspects, strategies, process flows and key observations under the broad Edge Computing domain. Research pathways include Multi-access Edge topologies in future 6G networks, model quantization, and satellite-enhanced communication platforms. Additionally, a discussion is added supporting the advanced AI functionalities, including zero-shot learning, multi modal perception, and decentralized generative AI, thereby broadening the scope of intelligent applications across various domains. The significance and research objective of this study are threefold: (1) evaluation of LoRaWAN and satellite IoT communication strategies, (2) analysis of CV workloads on edge hardware and (3) future research directions where Edge Computing can support low-latency, energy-efficient and socially impactful IoT applications. By explicitly addressing these aspects, we aim to establish a clear link between the technological feasibility, ultimately with a practical and socioeconomic relevance.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [302] [Maximizing Detection Probability in UAV Search Missions using Random-Key Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12317)
*Antonio Dantas,Elcio Shiguemori,Antonio Chaves*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种可配置的数据驱动智能路由架构，将闭环概率更新与 Random-Key Optimizers (RKO) 结合，用于搜救(RAR)场景下无人机路径规划；问题建模为开放车辆路径问题(OVRP)的动态概率变体，可自适应在两个目标（概率最大化与资源最小化）间切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜救任务中无人机路径规划同时面临随机性与实时性约束，需要在不确定先验信息下动态平衡"找到目标的概率"与"资源消耗"，而现有方法难以兼顾自适应性、可扩展性与噪声鲁棒性。

Method: 把问题形式化为 OVRP 的动态概率变体；采用 configurable 的 data-driven 路由架构，以闭环方式随观测更新目标概率图，并用 Random-Key Optimizers 做随机键编码的元启发式求解，从而在两目标间自适应切换。

Result: 框架在有噪声先验下性能优雅退化，但在系统性偏置先验下显著失效：偏置地图的表现约为完全无先验飞行的一半。计算测试显示方案可扩展，在多路径情形下与单路径场景性能相当。

Conclusion: 该架构可作为不稳定环境下 SAR 智能规划的强决策指引；核心启示是概率先验的质量（尤其是否系统性偏置）比噪声水平更关键，偏置先验甚至不如无先验。

Abstract: This paper focuses on the stochastic and real-time constraints of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) path planning in Search and Rescue (SAR) missions. We introduce a configurable data-driven and intelligent routing architecture that combines a closed-loop probability update with the Random-Key Optimizers (RKO). Our problem is mathematically modeled as a dynamic probabilistic variant of the Open Vehicle Routing Problem (OVRP), enabling the solver to switch adaptively between two objectives, thereby balancing probability maximization and resource minimization. The framework degrades elegantly under noisy priors but not under biased ones: a systematically biased map performs about half as well as flying with no prior at all. Computational tests show that the proposed scheme is scalable and competitive with single-path scenarios in terms of solution performance and serves as a strong decision guide for intelligent planning in SAR operations in unstable environments

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [303] [The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10316)
*Prerana Ramkumar,Suhas Suresh Bharadwaj,Fazal Hameed*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文从信息论与布尔电路复杂度推导潜空间状态转移的算术下界与CMOS动态能耗下界，并对DreamerV3-style RSSM进行剖析，发现每个rollout操作均受内存带宽限制，GPU能耗至少为CMOS理论下限的5.9e10倍；据此提出世界模型规划加速器WMPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入式AI从感知转向预测，机器人在执行前需在芯片上以严格功耗/散热预算运行世界模型进行规划；但每步预测所必需的能耗下界及真实硬件与该下界的差距此前未被刻画。

Method: (1) 基于信息论与布尔电路复杂度推导潜状态转移的最小算术操作数与CMOS动态能耗下界；(2) 对RSSM rollout进行带宽/能耗profiling；(3) 瞬态3D热仿真评估毫米级硅片的温升；(4) 提出WMPA架构：近存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度rollout单元、copy-on-write潜状态scratchpad，设计目标功耗降低40x。

Result: GPU能耗≥CMOS下限5.9e10倍；连续规划可使1mm级硅片在理想铜均热板下升至556 K；40x降功耗设计下同硅片仿真温度约306 K（接近环境温度）。

Conclusion: 能耗与热瓶颈源于内存带宽受限的低算术强度；通过近存、自适应精度与熵感知计算可显著拉近硬件与理论能耗下限的距离，为热受限机器人上的实用世界模型规划提供路径。

Abstract: Embedded AI is moving from perception to prediction. Robots now use world models$\unicode{x2014}$learned simulators that predict the outcome of candidate actions in a compressed latent space before any is executed. Every predicted step must be computed on board within a tight power and thermal budget, yet the energy these steps fundamentally require, and how far real hardware sits from it, have not been characterized. We derive lower bounds on the arithmetic operations and the CMOS dynamic energy of a latent state transition from information theory and Boolean circuit complexity. Profiling a DreamerV3-style Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) shows that every rollout operation is memory-bandwidth bound and that a GPU consumes at least $5.9\times10^{10}$ times the CMOS energy floor. Transient 3D thermal simulations show that this inefficiency is also a thermal one, since sustained back-to-back planning heats a millimeter-scale silicon tile to 556 K even behind an ideal copper heat spreader. Guided by this chain from bound to bottleneck, we propose the World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA), a chip architecture for embedded world model planning that combines near-memory computation, real-time entropy estimation, variable-precision rollout units, and copy-on-write latent scratchpads. With a design target of 40x lower power, the same tile stays near ambient at 306 K in simulation, pointing toward practical planning on thermally constrained robots.

</details>


### [304] [Efficient VLA Inference via Retrieval-Based Speculation and Hardware Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11098)
*Zhengyang Cheng,He Zhu,Zeyu Guo,Zihan Liu,Anbang Wu,Yiming Gan,Jingwen Leng,Yu Feng,Minyi Guo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Zora：面向VLA自回归动作生成的软硬协同加速框架，用基于RAG的轻量草稿模型替代神经草稿模型，配合运动学引导的接受策略与KV-cache共享注意力，并设计Zora core硬件应对RAG内存不规则访问，实现3.4×（纯软件）至7.6×（含硬件）GPU级加速且精度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在资源受限机器人平台上自回归生成动作时延迟高；现有投机解码依赖昂贵草稿模型，在边缘平台效率低。

Method: 检索增强生成（RAG）草稿模型，利用机器人动力学而无需额外神经草稿网络；运动学引导的动作接受策略；KV-cache共享注意力以降低批量验证开销；软硬协同的Zora core硬件加速RAG检索的内存不规则访问。

Result: 在LIBERO基准、4个VLA模型上验证，精度保持可比，纯软件最高3.4×、含硬件最高7.6×相对GPU加速。

Conclusion: 以RAG替代神经草稿模型并结合专用硬件，可显著降低VLA推理延迟，为边缘端VLA部署提供可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and execute complex instructions, but their autoregressive (AR) action generation introduces significant latency on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Speculative decoding can accelerate AR-based inference by parallelizing action generation and verification; however, existing approaches rely on costly draft models, which are inefficient on edge platforms. In this paper, we propose Zora, a hardware-software co-design framework for accelerating AR-based VLA inference. Specifically, Zora introduces a lightweight retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based draft model that exploits robotic dynamics without additional neural draft models. We further reduce batch verification overhead through a kinematics-guided action-acceptance strategy and a KV-cache-sharing attention mechanism. To address the retrieval overhead introduced by RAG-based drafting, we co-design dedicated hardware support, Zora core, to address the memory irregularity in RAG-based drafting. We evaluate Zora on four VLA models with the LIBERO benchmark. Zora retains comparable accuracy while achieving up to 3.4$\times$ speedup with software-only optimization and up to 7.6$\times$ speedup with hardware support over GPUs.

</details>

### [305] [FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Dataset and Cosmological Inference Competition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10228)
*Biwei Dai,Po-Wen Chang,Erwan Allys,Wahid Bhimji,Boris Bolliet,Thomas Borrett,Paolo Calafiura,Ragansu Chakkappai,Yuan-Tang Chou,Noé Dia,Sascha Diefenbacher,Ibrahim Elsharkawy,Steven Farrell,Sacha Guerrini,Isabelle Guyon,Chris Harris,Shih-Chieh Hsu,Wassim Kablan,François Lanusse,Celia Lecat,Julia Linhart,Yuezhou Ma,Benjamin Nachman,Shubhojit Naskar,Andy Nilipour,Laurence Perreault-Levasseur,Sébastien Pierre,Benjamin Remy,David Rousseau,Uroš Seljak,Haonan Shangguan,Sammy Nasser Sharief,Yuanxu Sun,Andreas Tersenov,Ihsan Ullah,Huikun Weng,Licong Xu,Justine Zeghal,Yulei Zhang,Hang Zhou*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 介绍 NeurIPS 2025 "FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge"：面向弱引力透镜宇宙学的基准数据集与不确定性评估研究，汇总优胜方案（条件最优传输数据增强、AI agent 参数推断、集成学习、ViT 架构、物理先验特征融合）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱引力透镜是直接测绘物质分布、约束结构形成参数的有力手段，机器学习有潜力超越传统统计量提取信息；但缺少能反映真实数据复杂度、模拟器不完美与系统偏差的标准化基准，阻碍方法对比与稳健性评估。

Method: 构建融合多种系统偏差的类真实弱透镜观测数据集作为受控测试平台；围绕不确定性下的稳健宇宙学推断设计竞赛评测；系统总结优胜方案的五个方法方向：基于条件最优传输的数据增强、AI agent 驱动的参数推断流程、集成学习、Vision Transformer 架构、物理信息特征融合。

Result: 给出可供社区复用的基准数据集与评测协议，并汇总竞赛中验证有效的多种方法与不确定性量化表现（摘要未提供具体数值指标）。

Conclusion: 以基准数据集与优胜方案统一的形式，为弱透镜宇宙学的机器学习方法开发与评估提供公共资源，并推广至更一般的系统不确定性下科学推断。属天体物理领域基准/竞赛总结性质，与具身智能、VLA、3D 重建等方向关联弱。

Abstract: Weak gravitational lensing is a powerful cosmological probe that enables direct mapping of the matter distribution and precise constraints on the fundamental parameters governing structure formation in the universe. In recent years, machine learning has shown strong potential for extracting cosmological information from weak-lensing data beyond traditional summary statistics. However, progress has been limited by the lack of standardized benchmarks that capture the complexity of the dataset, simulator imperfections, and various systematic biases encountered in realistic analyses. To address this gap, we present the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge, one of the NeurIPS 2025 competitions, as a benchmark dataset and evaluation study. Our dataset reflects realistic weak-lensing observations, incorporating multiple systematic biases, and thereby providing a controlled testbed for robust cosmological inference under uncertainties. We summarize the main methodological advances developed by the winners of our challenge, including data augmentation with conditional optimal transport, an AI-agent-driven approach for parameter inference, ensemble learning, Vision Transformer-based architectures, and physics-informed feature integration. By unifying the benchmark dataset and the winning solutions, this work provides a community resource for developing and evaluating machine learning methods for weak lensing cosmology and, more broadly, for scientific inference under systematic uncertainties.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [306] [Evaluating classification and explainability in multimodal petrographic image analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10331)
*Thomas James Wood,Oktay Karakuş,Can Eyüpoğlu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对LITHOS双流ViT岩相薄片分类器进行误差结构、模态敏感性与XAI归因的联合分析，发现误差沿矿物类别层级聚集、XPL模态更关键、五种归因图互不一致且超像素删除检验不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分类准确率无法揭示模型错误是否反映矿物学关系、预测对PPL/XPL两种互补光学视图的依赖程度，以及归因图是否真的定位了影响决策的区域；作者希望用这三条互补线索更全面地刻画模型行为。

Method: 基于已发布的LITHOS双流视觉Transformer与105,802颗专家标注颗粒（25类）的既有评估结果：统计误分类与标签分类学的关系；用逐通道空间均值替换XPL或PPL输入做消融，比较真类概率下降幅度（25类逐类计数）；用5种XAI归因方法对同一输入生成热图并做一致性比较；对来自29个薄片的30颗粒做超像素删除分析，计算的方法-随机对比及41个同时95%置信区间。

Result: 72.6%的斜长石/微斜长石/透长石误分类落入泛化"长石"标签；石英族颗粒87.1%被预测为族内标签，而精确匹配仅66.6%。XPL替换在25类中20类造成真类概率下降更大，但三个石英类例外。五种XAI图视觉上差异明显；超像素删除的方法-随机对比为-0.043至0.057，全部41个同时置信区间均含零，即归因方法未显示优于随机的定位能力。

Conclusion: 误差结构、模态敏感性与归因行为是彼此独立、不可由准确率或热图目视检查推断的性能维度；岩相分类模型存在层级化错误与对XPL的强依赖，而现有归因方法在此任务上缺乏可验证的忠实性。

Abstract: Automated thin-section classifiers increasingly combine plane-polarised and cross-polarised light (PPL and XPL), two complementary views central to petrographic identification. Classification accuracy alone does not reveal whether model errors reflect mineralogical relationships, how predictions depend on each optical view, or whether attribution maps identify regions that influence model decisions. Here, we examine these complementary aspects of the released LITHOS dual-stream vision transformer using outputs from an earlier evaluation of 105,802 expert-annotated grains across 25 categories. Classification errors frequently followed the label taxonomy: 72.6\% of misclassified plagioclase, microcline and sanidine grains were assigned the generic Feldspar label, while 87.1\% of quartz-family grains received a label within that family, compared with 66.6\% assigned their exact label. Replacing the XPL input with its per-channel spatial means produced a greater reduction in true-class probability than equivalent PPL replacement in 20 of 25 categories, but not in the three quartz categories. Five explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) attribution procedures generated visually distinct maps for identical inputs. In a superpixel-deletion analysis involving 30 grains from 29 thin sections, method-minus-random contrasts ranged from $-0.043$ to $0.057$, with all 41 simultaneous 95\% confidence intervals including zero. Together, these findings show that error structure, modality sensitivity and attribution behaviour capture distinct aspects of model performance that cannot be established from classification accuracy or visual inspection of attribution maps alone.

</details>


### [307] [SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10349)
*Jingtong Yang,Dongding Lin,Jian Wang,Wenjie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SituRecBench，一个在3D高保真环境中评测视觉语言模型作为"具身推荐助手"的交互式基准，要求模型在共享用户第一人称视角下进行偏好引导、环境视觉落地与空间导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统研究把推荐视为静态检索，忽略了空间导航、视觉落地与多轮社交交互三者的耦合复杂性，缺乏能在真实购物场景中评测"具身助手"的统一协议。

Method: 构建基于高保真3D环境（超市、家居店）的交互基准，将推荐重构为"具身协助"过程：助手与用户共享第一人称（egocentric）视角，需通过对话引出偏好、在环境中落地推荐对象并引导用户到达对应位置；通过统一交互协议同时评测对话质量、推荐效用与导航有效性。

Result: 大量实验显示前沿VLM在空间落地与偏好引导上持续失败，暴露出其难以将全局上下文信息与局部观测整合的局限。

Conclusion: SituRecBench为真实世界具身助手的发展提供了严格评测基础，但作为基准型工作未提出可迁移的方法论洞见。

Abstract: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.

</details>


### [308] [Compact Quantum Channel Attention for Static ASL Recognition: A Controlled Study with Parameter-Matched Baselines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10544)
*Ronak Bhalgami,Deep Kothadiya,Nikita Bhatt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QCA-DenseNet 用 8 量子比特变分电路作为 DenseNet121 特征上的通道注意力门（17,464 参数，比 SE 少 7.51 倍），在 5 折留一说话人手写 ASL 字母识别上达到 94.50% 平均准确率，略高于 SE（93.72%），但与同规模经典 MLP 及无注意力模型无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合量子-经典模型常在图像任务上报告较好精度，但很少厘清增益是否真正来自量子部分；作者希望以严格消融检验"量子通道注意力"是否带来量子优势，同时降低注意力门参数量。

Method: DenseNet121 提取特征，接 8-qubit 变分量子电路构成通道注意力门（QCA），对通道加权；以 1,815 张 MU HandImages 图像按 5 位受试者留一法评估，并用 Kaggle ASL Alphabet 小样本做冻结骨干消融；对照 SE 块、同参数量经典 MLP 及无注意力模型，检验显著性。

Result: 未见受试者上 QCA-DenseNet 平均 94.50%，高于 SE 的 93.72%，与最佳模型差 0.28 个百分点；但匹配参数的经典 MLP 与无注意力模型表现相当，差异均不显著。

Conclusion: QCA 能在不产生可检测精度损失的前提下显著压缩注意力门参数，但未体现量子优势；论文自身的消融即是其核心负面结论的证据。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical models often report good accuracy on image tasks, but it is rarely clear whether the quantum part is responsible. This paper proposes QCA-DenseNet, a static American Sign Language (ASL) recognition pipeline in which an eight-qubit variational circuit acts as a channel-attention gate on DenseNet121 features. The quantum channel attention (QCA) gate has 17,464 parameters, 7.51 times fewer than a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) block. The pipeline is tested on 1,815 MU HandImages images by holding out one of five signers at a time, and a frozen-backbone ablation uses small parts of the Kaggle ASL Alphabet data. On unseen signers, QCA-DenseNet reaches 94.50% mean accuracy, above SE (93.72%) and within 0.28 points of the best model. A matched classical MLP and a model without attention perform about the same, and no difference is significant. QCA gives a much smaller attention gate without a detectable loss in accuracy, but no quantum advantage.

</details>


### [309] [Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10552)
*Gregory Kang Ruey Lau,Minh Huynh Nguyen,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"模态推理访问缺口"概念：MLLM 能读图内文字却无法直接基于图像推理，并提出 TIGER 用合成图文反事实对+GRPO 后训练打通视觉到推理通路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 继承文本推理能力，但对视觉输入表现明显下降；作者想证明这不只是感知失败，而是感知到的视觉内容无法被路由进已有推理机制（reasoning-access gap）。

Method: 先在语义等价的文本 / 渲染文字图像上对比模型表现，分离感知与推理；再挖掘"文本成功、渲染图失败"的合成模态反事实样本，用 GRPO（及 SFT、DPO 变体）在这些图像输入上后训练，无需任何多模态标注。

Result: 仅在合成渲染文字图像上训练，即在 MathVerse、EMMA、MMMU、ChartQAPro、RoboSpatial-Home 等真实视觉基准上提升；可与现有 RLVR 视觉推理方法叠加；推理子空间激活与激活补丁分析显示视觉→推理路径被对齐到文本推理状态。

Conclusion: 模态推理访问缺口是 MLLM 视觉推理退化的关键原因之一；针对该缺口的合成反事实 RL 训练可在零多模态标注下迁移到广泛真实视觉任务，并为机制层面的通路对齐提供证据。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) inherit strong textual reasoning capabilities from their language backbones and text pretraining, but often fail to apply the same level of competency to visual inputs. We show that this degradation cannot be attributed to only perception failures, by evaluating models on semantically-equivalent text and rendered-text image inputs: models can accurately read text in the images and recover near-text performance when provided their own transcriptions, but just cannot reason well on the images directly. We characterize this discrepancy as a modality reasoning-access gap, where models fail to route perceived visual content into existing reasoning machinery accessible with text. To bridge this, we propose TIGER (Text-to-Image Gap-targeted training for Enhanced Reasoning), which first mines synthetic modality counterfactuals where a model succeeds on a text problem but fails when provided the corresponding rendered image, and post-trains the model on the image input via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), along with SFT and DPO variants. Importantly, although trained exclusively on synthetic rendered-text images with no multimodal annotations, TIGER results in model performance improvements across diverse real-world visual benchmarks including geometric diagrams (MathVerse), multi-disciplinary sciences (EMMA, MMMU), complex charts (ChartQAPro), and embodied spatial reasoning (RoboSpatial-Home). TIGER also complements existing state-of-the-art RLVR visual reasoning methods, yielding further performance gains. Analysis involving reasoning-subspace activation and activation patching provide support indicating that TIGER helps to align visual-to-reasoning pathways toward text reasoning states. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [310] [SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12120)
*Hong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCALE框架：小模型负责常规预测，预测错误与跨回合证据选择性触发LLM反思，LLM生成正负反事实样本并提炼可复用概念假设，经验证后内化进分层神经表示，同时把已掌握经验归档实现记忆压缩。十随机种子实验显示历史召回使留出准确率从87.11%升至98.28%，分层概念将困难样本准确率从55.33%升至66.47%，活跃经验记录由6000降至1528。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体需要从经验中持续获得可复用知识，而不能每个决策都依赖昂贵的大模型推理；已有经验驱动方法难以把累积的观察与推理压缩为轻量模型可独立应用的紧凑知识。

Method: 小模型优先框架：轻量模型承担日常预测；预测错误与跨回合累积证据选择性触发LLM反思；LLM分析相关历史经验、生成正负反事实样例、提出可复用概念假设；经独立验证的概念逐步并入分层神经表示；已掌握经验移出活跃记忆但保留于完整档案。

Result: 10个随机种子：历史召回将留出准确率从87.11%提升至98.28%；分层概念知识将困难样本准确率从55.33%提升至66.47%；抽象归档将活跃经验记录从6000降至1528。

Conclusion: 选择性LLM调用+概念抽象+知识内化可使小模型独立复用经验，并显著压缩记忆；但抽象未说明具体任务/环境与基线，"准确率"指标性质及是否涉及具身任务不明，缺少真实机器人与部署证据。

Abstract: Autonomous agents must continually acquire reusable knowledge from experience without relying on costly large language model (LLM) reasoning for every decision. However, existing experience-based approaches often struggle to transform accumulated observations and reasoning into compact knowledge that lightweight models can independently apply. This paper proposes SCALE, a small-model-first framework that integrates selective LLM reasoning, experience-driven concept abstraction, and knowledge internalization. A lightweight model handles routine predictions, while prediction errors and accumulated cross-episode evidence selectively trigger LLM reflection. The LLM analyzes relevant historical experiences, generates positive and negative counterfactual examples, and proposes reusable concept hypotheses. Independently validated concepts are progressively incorporated into hierarchical neural representations, enabling lightweight models to exploit increasingly abstract knowledge. Meanwhile, mastered experiences are excluded from active memory while their original records remain available in a complete archive. Experiments across ten random seeds show that historical recall improves held-out accuracy from 87.11% to 98.28%, hierarchical concept knowledge increases difficult-case accuracy from 55.33% to 66.47%, and abstract archiving reduces active experience records from 6,000 to 1,528.

</details>


### [311] [Rethinking Radar 3D Perception: Representation Learning from Raw Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12334)
*Miao Zhang,Mohamed Abdelsamad,Bin Yang,Sherif Abdulatif,Benedikt Loesch,Marco Altmann,Abhinav Valada,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Leakage-aware Spectral MAE：以"局部corruption下仍可重建者为结构、不可重建者为噪声"的自监督准则直接建模稠密原始雷达谱，并将多普勒作为x-y-D的主空间维度、高度编码为特征，避免手工降维，性能优于SOTA雷达检测器与点云SSL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始雷达谱因杂波与噪声被认为难以直接表征学习，主流做法依赖手工降维（稀疏点云、紧凑多普勒描述子）；但这类刚性假设会丢弃弱而有用的结构、保留符合降维模型的伪影，且信息一旦被丢弃便无法由监督学习恢复。作者认为瓶颈在于缺乏区分结构信号与噪声的学习目标，而非表征本身。

Method: 核心观点：结构＝在局部corruption下仍可重建的谱分量，噪声＝不可重建分量。据此对稠密雷达cube做自监督掩码建模，实例化为Leakage-aware Spectral MAE，corruption策略受谱泄漏引起的跨bin能量扩散启发。同时提出Doppler组织方式：以x-y-D三维表示把多普勒视为主空间维度、高度编码为特征通道，取代朴素通道堆叠，从而使稠密4D谱可被有效学习。

Result: 在不使用手工降维的前提下，方法一致优于最先进的基于雷达的检测器和基于点云的自监督学习对应方法；Doppler作为主空间维度的x-y-D表示显著优于朴素通道堆叠，并可有效利用稠密4D谱。

Conclusion: 原始雷达谱在配套恰当的预训练目标时，可作为3D感知的有效表征，挑战"原始雷达谱不可直接学习"的既有假设。

Abstract: Raw radar spectra are widely viewed as too cluttered and noisy for direct representation learning, motivating handcrafted reductions, sparse point clouds, or compact Doppler descriptors in radar perception. We challenge this assumption and argue that the main limitation lies not in the raw representation itself, but in the absence of a learning objective that separates structured signal from noise. Handcrafted reductions partially address this problem but impose rigid assumptions about what constitutes signal, discarding weak yet informative structure while retaining artifacts that fit the reduction model. Once removed, such information cannot be recovered by supervised learning. We propose an alternative: structure is the component of a radar spectrum that remains reconstructable under localized corruption, while noise is the component that does not. This perspective motivates self-supervised masked modeling for dense radar spectra without predefined signal-noise separation. We instantiate it with Leakage-aware Spectral MAE, a masked autoencoder for raw radar cubes using a corruption strategy inspired by cross-bin energy spreading caused by spectral leakage. We also demonstrate the importance of Doppler organization: treating Doppler as a primary spatial dimension in an x-y-D representation, with height encoded as features, substantially outperforms naive channel stacking and enables effective learning from dense 4D spectra. Without handcrafted reductions, our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art radar-based detectors and point-cloud-based self-supervised learning (SSL) counterparts. These results establish raw radar spectra as an effective representation for 3D perception when paired with an appropriate pretraining objective.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [312] [Preference-Augmented Distributional Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Sensitive Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09932)
*Zhaofan Zhang,Yue Chang,Rufeng Chen,Hechang Chen,Sihong Xie,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将风险偏好变化建模为分位数权重分布的偏移，训练时用偏好引导探索覆盖多种偏好，部署时对最坏偏好分布优化得到保守策略，在IQN-DistRL导航中减少碰撞并提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IQN导航工作训练时使用固定或随机采样的单一CVaR水平，部署时靠手工调参或外部传感器信号调整风险，导致训练偏好暴露与部署风险调节不匹配，学习被限制在狭窄的尾部风险偏好族内。

Method: 以分位数权重分布（而非标量CVaR）表征风险偏好，训练阶段通过偏好引导探索让智能体接触多样化偏好分布；部署阶段针对最坏情况偏好分布进行优化，导出对多种风险画像稳健的保守策略，降低超参调优与部分可观测下对有限传感器信号的依赖。

Result: 在仿真环境与真实车辆平台实验中，方法相较基线降低碰撞率并提升任务成功率。

Conclusion: 用分布层面的风险偏好表征替代标量CVaR，并配合偏好引导探索与最坏情况偏好优化，可有效弥合训练-部署风险偏好差距，为不确定性下的安全导航提供低调参、弱传感器依赖的方案。

Abstract: Ensuring safe and reliable navigation under diverse sources of uncertainty remains a central challenge for autonomous systems. Within distributional reinforcement learning (DistRL), Implicit Quantile Networks (IQN) have attracted interest for navigation under uncertainty because they enable risk adaptation through flexible quantile sampling. Existing approaches, however, typically use a fixed or randomly sampled Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) level during training and adjust the risk level during deployment using hand-tuned hyperparameters or external sensor signals. This scalar-CVaR formulation confines learning to a narrow family of tail-risk preferences, creating a mismatch between training-time preference exposure and deployment-time risk adjustment. We instead represent variations in risk preference as shifts in quantile-weight distributions and expose the agent to diverse preferences through preference-guided exploration. At deployment, we optimize against the worst-case preference distribution to derive a conservative policy that accounts for multiple risk profiles. This reduces hyperparameter tuning and reliance on limited sensor signals under partial observability. Experiments across simulated environments and vehicle platforms show that our method reduces collisions while improving task success.

</details>


### [313] [Efficient Learning of Differentiable MPC Policies on the GPU via Smoothed ADMM and First-Order Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09937)
*Jianghan Zhang,Roland Schwan,Gabriel Bravo-Palacios,John Zhang,Thomas Lew,Brian Plancher*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SmoothedTurboMPC——GPU并行的可微MPC求解器（SQP + log-barrier平滑ADMM内层），配合SHAC一阶强化学习复用rollout解，实现平滑梯度与训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微MPC端到端训练存在两大瓶颈：活跃集切换处的不可微敏感性问题，以及每次策略评估都需在线求解优化问题带来的高成本。

Method: 1) SmoothedTurboMPC：SQP框架外层 + log-barrier平滑的ADMM内层求解器，GPU并行，提供平滑梯度且在收敛点给出精确敏感度；2) 与Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC)一阶RL结合，复用rollout中的MPC解而非重复评估。

Result: 端到端训练吞吐最高提升4.4倍；车辆竞速任务中回报高于MPC PPO且加速46倍，7分钟训练330万条transition；结合域随机化训练更可靠的MPC竞速策略并在全尺寸赛车上验证。

Conclusion: 平滑可微MPC+一阶RL是训练约束感知策略的高效范式，且具备真车部署可行性；成果已集成到开源TurboMPC求解器。

Abstract: Differentiable model predictive control (MPC) enables structured, constraint-aware policies to be optimized end-to-end. However, learning MPC policies faces two bottlenecks: (1) nonsmooth sensitivities at active-set transitions and (2) expensive policy evaluation, since each requires an optimization solve. We first introduce SmoothedTurboMPC, a GPU-parallel differentiable MPC solver combining sequential quadratic programming (SQP) with a log-barrier-smoothed alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) inner solver. Its design enables smooth gradients, exact sensitivities at convergence, and efficient execution on GPUs. Second, to efficiently train MPC policies, we pair our solver with first-order reinforcement learning (FORL) using Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC), which reuses rollout MPC solutions instead of repeatedly re-evaluating them. Comparisons with state of the art solvers show that the approach achieves up to $4.4\times$ higher end-to-end training throughput. On a vehicle racing task, our method achieves higher returns than MPC PPO with a $46\times$ speedup, training on 3.3 million transitions in only 7 minutes. Finally, we use the framework to train a more reliable MPC racing policy via RL with domain randomization, and validate it on a full-scale race car. We integrate our advances into the open-source TurboMPC solver.

</details>


### [314] [UniLatent: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Latent Observation Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10061)
*Yufei Ding,Yi Du,Weiduo Yuan,Hao Jiang,Dylan Goetting,Lawrence Yunliang Chen,Daniel Seita,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: UniLatent：用仿真中配对渲染的源-目标机器人观测，将源视觉编码器对齐到冻结的目标编码器，实现共享隐空间上的跨具身迁移，无需像素级图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人数据采集成本高且与特定具身绑定，几何、外观、运动学差异导致演示难以跨机器人复用；核心障碍是具身引起观测间隙。

Method: 在仿真中渲染成对的源/目标机器人观测，训练源视觉编码器通过隐空间对齐损失逼近冻结的目标编码器；随后在编码后的源演示上训练策略，直接在目标观测上零样本执行，避免图像翻译。

Result: 三个仿真任务、两种目标机械臂上零样本成功率最高93%，平均超出最强像素翻译基线30+点；真实xArm→Franka迁移仅用每任务10条目标演示微调即达27/30成功。

Conclusion: 隐空间对齐是比像素翻译更有效、更轻量的跨具身数据复用途径，配合少量目标演示可完成真实部署。

Abstract: Robot datasets are costly to collect and are usually tied to a specific embodiment, making it difficult to reuse demonstrations across robots with different geometry, appearance, and kinematics. We introduce UniLatent, a cross-embodiment transfer framework that reduces the embodiment-induced observation gap in a shared latent space. UniLatent renders paired source-target robot observations in simulation and aligns a source visual encoder to a frozen target encoder. A policy trained on encoded source demonstrations can then run directly on target observations, with no pixel-level image translation. Across three simulation tasks and two target robot arms, UniLatent reaches up to 93% zero-shot success, exceeding the strongest pixel-translation baseline by over 30 points on average. In real-world xArm-to-Franka transfer, fine-tuning with only 10 target demonstrations per task yields 27/30 successful rollouts. Code, videos and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [315] [Beyond Semantic Classes: Online Physical Parameter Estimation via Embedding-Conditioned Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10107)
*Alexander Borca-Tasciuc,Prayag Sharma,Franck Djeumou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种实时视觉物理属性估计器：以交互反演得到的局部高斯参数估计为混合分量，用连续视觉嵌入的相似度检索并加权历史交互，配合支持度感知的条件生成先验与嵌入精炼，输出多模态物理参数后验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触前从视觉推断与交互相关的物理属性（摩擦、刚度、下陷）可改善规划与控制，但外观本身存在歧义：视觉相似区域接触后可能表现不同的物理响应。既有方法将歧义压缩为单点估计，或用固定语义类别聚合经验，无法保留彼此不同的物理状态。

Method: 用交互驱动的高斯混合后验替代语义类别索引，直接以连续视觉嵌入为条件。将来自逆建模的交互高斯参数估计作为混合分量；以嵌入相似度检索并加权相关历史交互；设计支持度感知的融合机制，在交互历史稀疏时引入条件生成先验模型；并通过学习式嵌入精炼提升检索相关性，且不对表示做离散化。

Result: 实验显示该估计器能恢复多模态物理信念、拒绝无关交互历史、避免空间地图离散化，并以控制器频率实时评估。在高保真自动驾驶赛车仿真中，面对未知的低/高摩擦路面区域，后验使控制器随交互证据累积在重复圈中逐步适应，性能提升同时保持摩擦感知行为。

Conclusion: 以交互锚定的高斯混合后验替代语义类别的视觉物理属性估计，在保留多模态歧义、检索相关经验与实时运行方面有效，并在仿真竞速任务中验证了闭环适应价值；但证据主要为仿真，缺乏真机验证。

Abstract: Enabling robots to infer interaction-relevant physical properties from vision before contact would improve planning and control in unstructured environments. Vision provides useful pre-contact information, but appearance alone is often ambiguous: visually similar regions can induce different friction, stiffness, or sinkage responses upon contact. Existing approaches often collapse this ambiguity to a point estimate or aggregate experience through fixed semantic classes, limiting their ability to preserve distinct physical regimes. Instead, we propose a real-time estimator that replaces semantic class indexing with an interaction-grounded Gaussian-mixture posterior over latent physical parameters, conditioned directly on continuous visual embeddings. Our approach maintains interaction-derived Gaussian parameter estimates, typically from inverse modeling, as mixture components while using embedding similarity to retrieve and weight relevant past interactions for each new query region. A support-aware fusion mechanism incorporates a conditional generative prior model when interaction history is sparse, while a learned embedding refinement improves retrieval relevance without discretizing the representation. Our experiments show that the estimator recovers multimodal physical beliefs, rejects unrelated interaction history, avoids spatial map discretization, and evaluates at controller rates. In a high-fidelity autonomous racing simulation with unknown low- and high-friction surface regions, the posterior enables the controller to adapt over repeated laps as interaction evidence accumulates, improving performance while maintaining friction-aware behavior.

</details>


### [316] [A Unified Inertial Encoder for Human and Humanoid Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10137)
*Yutian Chen,Shibo Zhao,Rocky Duan,Karen Liu,Carmelo Sferrazza,Guanya Shi,Yuheng Qiu,Koushil Sreenath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一惯性编码器，用运动学IMU合成把人体与类人机器人运动映射到同一惯性接口，联合训练速度估计与运动-文本对齐，零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人自采数据受限于自身动作库，人体运动数据集覆盖更广，但存在身体几何、传感与物理扰动差异，需要一种可迁移的统一表征。

Method: Kinematic IMU synthesis在对应身体部位生成人体与运动学重定向类人机器人的IMU信号，构建共享惯性接口；在此空间内联合训练速度估计与motion-text对齐，采用连续时间编码与传感器/运动随机化；无物理仿真、无真机数据、无微调即零样本部署。

Result: 在五个数据集上取得最低速度误差，真实Unitree G1上0.099 m/s；运动描述检索可扩展到仅在人体训练中出现的重定向G1动作类别。

Conclusion: 人体运动知识可通过统一惯性接口有效泛化到类人机器人的惯性里程计与语言接地运动理解，避免仿真与真机微调。

Abstract: Learning humanoid state estimation and language-grounded motion understanding from robot recordings ties training coverage to the robot's motion repertoire. Human motion datasets offer broader coverage, yet transferring this knowledge requires overcoming differences in body geometry, sensing, and physical disturbances. To enable this transfer, we propose a unified inertial encoder whose shared inertial interface uses kinematic IMU synthesis to represent human and humanoid motion at corresponding body sites. Within this common input space, joint training on human and kinematically retargeted humanoid motion combines velocity estimation and motion--text alignment with continuous-time encoding and sensor and motion randomization. The resulting model transfers zero-shot to a physical Unitree G1 without physics simulation, real-robot training trajectories, or fine-tuning, achieving the lowest velocity error among evaluated methods across five datasets, including 0.099m/s on real G1. Its motion-description retrieval also extends to retargeted G1 motion categories observed only in human training, demonstrating how human motion knowledge can support the generalization of humanoid inertial odometry and language-grounded motion understanding.

</details>


### [317] [BATCH: Behavior Alignment for Cross-Embodiment Learning from Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10148)
*Zeyi Liu,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BATCH：跨具身学习框架，用循环一致性自监督时序表征对齐人类与机器人行为，并在自回归视频-动作扩散模型中联合"行为对齐协同训练"与"人→机风格迁移"目标，提升真实操作任务的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示数据规模大、多样性高，但存在具身形态、视角、动作空间与时序结构差异，直接用于机器人策略学习效果有限；需要显式建立人-机行为对应关系。

Method: 1) 以循环一致性目标学习自监督时序表征，无需人工标注即可建立跨具身对应；2) 在该对应关系基础上，于自回归 video-action diffusion 模型中加入两个互补训练目标：行为对齐协同训练（behavior-aligned co-training）与人类到机器人的风格迁移；3) 在真实世界操作任务上评估。

Result: 在真实操作任务上，相比使用未对齐数据训练及既有跨具身基线，BATCH 对未见任务配置的泛化更好；风格迁移目标带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 显式行为对齐可显著提升人类演示向机器人策略的迁移效率；循环一致性表征加协同训练/风格迁移是可复用的跨具身数据利用范式。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation data, but leveraging them for robot learning remains challenging due to differences in embodiment, viewpoint, action spaces, and temporal structure. We introduce BATCH, a cross-embodiment learning framework that explicitly aligns human and robot behaviors. BATCH learns self-supervised temporal representations with a cycle-consistency objective to establish cross-embodiment correspondences without manual annotation. We further introduce two complementary training objectives that leverage these correspondences within an autoregressive videoaction diffusion model: behavior-aligned co-training and human-to-robot style transfer. On real-world manipulation tasks, BATCH improves generalization to unseen task configurations compared with training on unaligned data and prior cross-embodiment baselines, with additional gains from the style-transfer objective. Our results demonstrate that explicit behavior alignment enables more effective transfer from human demonstrations to robot policies.

</details>


### [318] [Capturability-Aware Footstep Planning in Cluttered Environments: A Recursively Feasible Sequential MPC on Axis-Aligned Safe Corridors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10169)
*Athanasios Kyriakopoulos,Shubham S. Kumbhar,Kunal S. Narkhede,Abhijeet M. Kulkarni,Ioannis Poulakakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种考虑可捕获性(capturability)的序列MPC框架，用于LIP模型下的人形机器人落脚点规划，通过相交矩形序列构造安全走廊来联合保证避障与运动稳定性，并具有递归可行性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人落脚规划需同时满足避障与动态稳定，二者通常被分开处理；且在真实执行中障碍（如被误设为开启的门）可能突然阻塞前进，规划器需具备鲁棒自适应能力。

Method: 在LIP动力学上构建序列MPC：将避障与可捕获性约束统一编码为相交矩形序列构成的安全走廊，形成带递归可行性保证的分层序列MPC规划层；在受阻时自动切换为原地踏步策略。

Result: 性能基本不依赖预测时域长度，可在低计算成本下取得高成功率；在高保真仿真中以Digit人形机器人验证，可在杂乱环境中生成可捕获的落脚序列。

Conclusion: 该工作为人形机器人提供了一个兼顾可行性保证与计算效率的避障落脚规划实用方案，并展示了面对执行期意外阻塞的适应性，但尚未给出真实硬件部署结果。

Abstract: A fundamental aspect of humanoid footstep planning is to jointly guarantee obstacle avoidance and locomotion stability. This paper presents a capturability-aware sequential Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based humanoid footstep planning in the presence of obstacles. The proposed method combines obstacle avoidance with capturability constraints through safe corridors constructed as sequences of intersecting rectangles, yielding a sequential MPC framework with recursive feasibility guarantees for the LIP-based planning layer. The planner autonomously adapts to constrained scenarios, switching to in-place walking when obstructions---such as doors assumed to be open during planning but unexpectedly found to be closed during execution---block forward motion. Performance is largely independent of the prediction horizon, allowing high success rates while keeping the computational cost low. The approach is validated in high-fidelity simulations with the humanoid robot Digit, demonstrating a practical solution for capturable humanoid footstep planning in cluttered environments.

</details>


### [319] [Agibot: An Open-Source Modular Swerve-Drive Robot Platform for Agricultural Robotics Research and Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10235)
*Moeen Ul Islam,Bishal Adhikari,Kori Edwards,Lorien Harvey,J. Alex Thomasson,Dong Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Agibot：开源、模块化、低成本的四轮独立转向农业机器人平台，集成多模态感知、可换计算与可配置操作，在统一 sense-plan-act-verify 框架下完成行作物导航与播种/植保类操作验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业劳动力短缺与自动化需求增长，但农业机器人研究受限于昂贵、封闭、灵活性差的研究平台，缺乏可负担、可重构、可复现的实验载体，同时兼具教学用途的实践平台稀缺。

Method: 硬件上采用四轮独立转向（swerve）底盘、可替换计算单元、分布式嵌入式控制、多模态传感与可配置机械臂；软件上构建统一的 sense-plan-act-verify 闭环框架，模块化划分感知、控制、导航、操作与任务成功验证组件，支持各组件独立测试与快速原型迭代；并通过控制器调参研究与集成试验评估行间导航、目标识别、播种与植株操作等代表性任务。

Result: 在不同光照与土壤条件下实现稳定的车道线跟随、行间自主切换导航、目标识别、播种投放、植株操作及任务成功闭环验证；概念验证任务、控制器调参与集成试验共同展示了平台的研究能力。

Conclusion: Agibot 以低成本、模块化、开源与端到端自主验证为特点，可作为农业机器人研究、技术开发与教学实训的实用平台；但贡献偏系统集成与平台工程，缺乏新算法与大规模真实田间量化基准。

Abstract: Agricultural production faces persistent labor shortages and increasing demand for automation, yet progress in agricultural robotics remains constrained by the limited availability of affordable, flexible, and accessible research platforms. This paper presents Agibot, an open-source, modular, low-cost agricultural robotics platform designed for autonomy research and experimentation, with potential applications in hands-on robotics education. The platform integrates four-wheel independent swerve drive, swappable computing, distributed embedded control, multimodal sensing, and configurable manipulation within a unified sense-plan-act-verify framework supporting perception, control, navigation, manipulation, and autonomous task verification. The platform was evaluated through representative row-crop navigation and manipulation tasks under varying lighting and soil conditions. Experiments demonstrated reliable lane following, autonomous row-to-row navigation, target identification, seed dispensing, plant manipulation, and closed-loop verification of task success. Its modular architecture supports independent testing, modification, and validation of autonomy components for rapid prototyping and experimentation. These proof-of-concept tasks, controller-tuning studies, and integrated trials demonstrate the platform's research capabilities, while its accessible and reconfigurable design supports its use for hands-on robotics education. By combining affordability, modularity, open-source accessibility, configurable manipulation, and end-to-end sense-plan-act-verify autonomy, Agibot provides a practical platform for agricultural robotics research, technology development, and workforce training.

</details>


### [320] [DASH-SLAM: Calibration-Free Metric Monocular SLAM via Depth Scale Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10239)
*Otavio Ribas,Jacopo Panerati,Pierre-Yves Lajoie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DASH-SLAM：将 Depth Anything 3 的度量深度以“共享关键帧尺度修正”形式融入单目位姿图 SLAM，无需微调，在 TUM/Replica/7-Scenes 与退化环境序列上优于现有基础模型 SLAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何基础模型可从单目图像估计稠密几何与相机参数，但可靠 SLAM 还需跨连续重建的一致尺度与准确数据关联。现有基础模型 SLAM 缺乏统一的度量尺度约束。

Method: 构建共享关键帧位姿图；在共享锚点图像上由深度比值推导尺度修正，沿重建序列累积并引入阻尼因子控制其影响；修正量统一作用于里程计平移、回环约束与地图几何；使用预训练 Depth Anything 3，无需任务特定微调。

Result: 在 TUM、Replica、7-Scenes 上优于 SOTA，并分别用刚体对齐与相似变换对齐评估，区分度量尺度保真度与仅到尺度的精度；在 Unified Autonomy Stack 野外数据集的四条感知退化序列（隧道、雾、冰湖）上超过基础模型 SLAM SOTA，并在经典 SLAM 失效时保持跟踪。

Conclusion: 以轻量尺度累积+阻尼的位姿图融合即可把基础模型深度转为可用度量尺度 SLAM，兼具精度与退化环境鲁棒性；未来可扩展到更复杂动态与多传感器场景。

Abstract: Geometric foundation models estimate dense geometry and camera parameters from monocular images, but reliable SLAM also requires consistent scale and accurate data association across successive reconstructions. We present DASH-SLAM, a monocular SLAM system that integrates metric depth predictions from pretrained Depth Anything 3 into a shared-keyframe pose graph without task-specific fine-tuning. DASH-SLAM derives scale corrections from depth ratios at shared anchor images and accumulates them across reconstructions, with a damping factor controlling their influence. These corrections rescale odometry translations, loop constraints, and map geometry. Experiments on TUM, Replica, and 7-Scenes show that DASH-SLAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods. We evaluate performance using both rigid and similarity alignment to distinguish metric-scale fidelity from accuracy up to scale. We further evaluate DASH-SLAM on four challenging sequences in perceptually-degraded environments from the Unified Autonomy Stack field dataset, covering tunnels, fog, and a frozen lake. On these sequences, DASH-SLAM outperforms the foundation-model SLAM state-of-the-art and maintains tracking where classical SLAM methods fail.

</details>


### [321] [OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10241)
*Quanyun Wu,Kyle Gao,Daisy Li,Kshitij Goyal,Dayou Mao,David A. Clausi,Jonathan Li,Yuhao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OfficeTwin：面向机器人原生采集的办公场景，将前馈单目重建的稀疏/不完整点云通过度量与结构约束、重复工位配准到共享规范坐标系，互补观测恢复遮挡几何，输出每个工位独立水密、度量一致的仿真就绪数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D重建虽快且对弱纹理表面稳健，但输出的是无物体身份、无物理属性、非水密的点云，无法直接用于机器人学习；而机器人受限自由度采集导致每个物体仅部分可见，办公环境的重复弱纹理结构使不同工位难以区分，现有image-to-3D方法在不完整视角下产生幻觉几何并混淆重复实例。

Method: 机器人原生框架：(1) 施加度量与结构约束，锚定尺度与场景结构；(2) 利用办公室结构冗余性，将重复立方隔间（cubicle）配准至共享规范坐标系，借助跨实例互补观测恢复单视角中被遮挡的几何，避免生成式幻觉；(3) 输出各隔间独立的度量水密实体。

Result: 在真实办公室扫描上，OfficeTwin 将每个隔间恢复为单独水密、度量一致的实体，优于前馈重建与生成式基线（后者无法生成仿真就绪资产）。

Conclusion: 利用场景结构化冗余替代生成先验，是解决机器人原生不完整观测下仿真就绪资产构建的可行路径；摘要未提供定量指标与大规模泛化验证。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.

</details>


### [322] [Look Only Where You Plan for Real-Time End-to-End Urban Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10264)
*Haohua Que,Tianle Zhu,Qianyi Wu,Zhipeng Bao,Handong Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LOWP：仅用两组各16个可学习查询，通过相机标定直接采样/射线注意力读取图像特征做规划，完全不构建稠密BEV、不做目标或地图监督；nuScenes L2 0.296m、参数量为稠密BEV对照的53%、同GPU速度快1.7倍，NAVSIM 85.9 PDMS，闭环Bench2Drive 65.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强驾驶规划器中稠密BEV构建占约60%参数，冗余且昂贵；作者主张"只在实际规划区域感知"（look only where you plan），以紧凑表示替代稠密BEV及显式目标/地图监督。

Method: 两组各16个可学习查询：(1) anchor-based reader 依据已知相机标定在投影的3D锚点处采样图像特征；(2) global reader 通过带视线射线（viewing ray）标签的特征做注意力聚合；两组查询直接输出规划，不做稠密BEV重建，无目标/地图监督信号。

Result: nuScenes开环L2由0.302降至0.296 m，参数为稠密对应方案53%，同GPU速度1.7×；转弯场景anchor reader优于global reader。NAVSIM伪仿真下以"候选词表评分"方式对自身轨迹打分达85.9 PDMS且无需重训。闭环Bench2Drive 218条路线得分65.5，存在刹车导致的静止失败，其释放规则聚合收益不确定。作者强调测得的延迟与硬件迁移估计不可作为同硬件排名依据。

Conclusion: 稀疏查询式感知-规划一体化可替代稠密BEV，在保持或提升开环精度的同时大幅降参提速，并具备零重训的轨迹重打分能力；但闭环鲁棒性（静止失败、硬件可比性）仍是未解问题。属自动驾驶规划架构的效率型改进，非具身/3D核心方向。

Abstract: Dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) construction accounts for 60% of the parameters in a strong recent driving planner. This paper presents LOWP, a planner that looks only where it plans: two sets of sixteen learnable queries read the cameras through the known calibration, one by sampling image features at projected 3D anchors and one by attending to features labeled with their viewing rays, so no dense BEV is built and no object or map is supervised. Evaluations on open-loop nuScenes, pseudo-simulated NAVSIM and closed-loop Bench2Drive show competitive planning with a compact representation. On nuScenes, average L2 changes from 0.302 to 0.296 m with 53% of the dense counterpart's parameters and 1.7 times its speed on the same GPU; the anchor-based reader performs better on turns than the global reader. On NAVSIM, scoring the planner's own trajectories alongside a vocabulary gives 85.9 PDMS without retraining. The closed-loop control configuration scores 65.5 on 218 routes, with a brake-induced standstill failure whose release rule has an inconclusive aggregate benefit. We distinguish measured latency from hardware-transferred estimates, which do not establish a common-hardware ranking.

</details>


### [323] [Who Taught the Robot That? Removing One User's Corrections from a Robot Policy That Learns Online](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10280)
*Eshika Pathak,Leela Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究机器人部署后经多人轮流纠错、其中一人日后要求删除其影响时的“精确遗忘”问题：能否删干净取决于纠错方式——接管式纠错只需按原顺序重训日志即可逼近“此人从未存在”的机器人；单步微调式纠错则因他人纠错已携带被删者影响而无法恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在部署后持续学习，可能被多位用户依次纠正，其中某人事后要求撤回其贡献（数据删除/被遗忘权）。现有研究缺少对“删除目标”的精确定义与可行性的系统性检验：能否得到“该用户从未出现过”的等价模型，以及这一结果如何依赖用户纠错的方式。

Method: 将删除目标形式化为反事实模型（该用户从未参与时训练所得的机器人），在两个仿真任务中配合脚本化用户给出精确解。对比三类策略：(1) 按原始顺序重放剩余会话的日志重训；(2) 一次性删除该用户数据后单遍重训；(3) 不含该用户继续在线训练；并分别在“接管控制式纠错”和“仅微调动作（nudge）”两种交互模式下评估，同时检验日志对有害用户识别与用户影响力排序的能力。

Result: 在接管式纠错设定下，按原顺序重放剩余会话的训练结果与目标机器人差异仅剩训练噪声水平，即达到可实现的最近似；删除数据后单遍重训即使其他用户纠错与目标用户无关也失败，原因是丢失训练顺序。在仅微调动作的设定下，其他用户的纠错本身携带被删者影响，所测方法均无法恢复目标机器人。继续训练可消除大部分行为习惯，但训练缓冲区中残留数据所维持的行为仍在；日志能识别出明显有害用户，但用户影响力排序不如直接统计纠错次数。

Conclusion: 机器人“遗忘”某用户的可实现性由纠错界面与数据依赖结构决定：顺序信息是精确删除的关键资源，单步微调引入的相互污染会使精确删除不可得。工程启示是保留有序训练日志、优先采用接管式纠错接口，并对影响力排序方法保持谨慎（日志不如简单计数）。

Abstract: A robot that keeps learning after deployment is corrected by several people in turn, and one of them may later ask to be removed. We show that whether the robot can forget that person depends on how people correct it. The goal of removal is the robot that would exist if the person had never been there, which we compute exactly in two simulated tasks with scripted users. When users correct the robot by taking over control, an ordered log of training updates is enough: retraining on the remaining sessions in their original order gives a robot as close to the goal as training noise allows. Deleting the person's data and retraining in one pass does not, even when the other users' corrections do not depend on the removed person, because it loses the order of training.
