Motivation: 现有操作基准默认机器人是唯一行动体、任务语义只由指令与物体状态决定，忽略了真实世界中"共享工位的人类"这一常见变量——人类可隐含目标、完成部分子任务、临时改变物体可用性、或限制安全运动空间。作者希望把人类活动建模为操作问题的一部分而非背景扰动。

Method: 提出HARP-Bench：按四种人-在场条件（Cueing提示、Contribution贡献、Interruption中断、Co-presence共处）组织任务，在日常操作任务上构建与人-缺席标准版本配对的人-在场变体以支持受控对比；并给出面向动态人-在场场景的演示生成管线（管线细节摘要未展开）。在基准上评测VLA模型、模仿学习方法与启发式策略。

Result: 人-在场变体显著挑战现有策略；任务成功率提升并不伴随安全性的一致提升；定量失败分析显示主要残余难点为操作与中断后恢复两类；用HARP-Bench演示训练可提升仿真中人-在场表现；单一任务族的真机研究显示Contribution条件下性能提升、Interruption条件下未见提升，初步验证数据效用并揭示迁移局限。

Conclusion: 人类主动性应被视为操作问题的一等变量而非场景噪声；现有VLA/IL策略在人-在场条件下存在成功率-安全性失配与恢复能力不足；基准数据有一定可迁移价值但受任务族限制，需在中断/恢复类条件上补强。

Abstract: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [361] [From Festival Video to the Stage: A Sim-to-Real Ladder for Long-Horizon Expressive Whole-Body Dance on a Commercial Humanoid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11127)
*Hesham Shehata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Awa Odori传统舞蹈经单目视频动捕、运动学重定向、仿真RL跟踪与ONNX机载部署，迁移至Unitree G1 EDU，实现无绳连续9.7分钟表演及与厂商行走控制器的无缝切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将人类舞蹈这类富有表现力、非平衡约束强的高动态动作迁移到商用双足人形上，并解决仿真训练到真机部署中的隐性故障，验证端到端管线的工程可行性。

Method: 四阶段管线：单目视频人体网格恢复（HMR）→人体到机器人的运动学重定向→仿真中基于强化学习的运动跟踪→ONNX导出与机载推理。通过11级部署阶梯在硬件上评估三项干预：修复部署产物静默损坏、建模训练中的状态估计器漂移、编辑参考动作以获得稳定执行与可控收尾。

Result: 单卡RTX 5070训练。最终策略实现43秒动作连续三次无绳完成、46秒带自动交接的表演，以及由捕获动作拼接的9.7分钟无绳连续表演；现场单次远程请求即可从厂商行走控制器切换并返回，实测无扭矩窗口45–140 ms。还给出训练动力学与失败边界（软地面、单目遮挡）。

Conclusion: 端到端"视频动捕→重定向→RL跟踪→机载部署"流水线可在商用小型人形上稳定复现长时程表现性舞蹈，部署阶梯式硬件评估与静默损坏/状态估计器漂移的系统辨识是sim-to-real成功的关键。

Abstract: We present a pipeline for transferring Awa Odori, a traditional Japanese festival dance, from monocular video to a commercial Unitree G1 EDU humanoid. The pipeline combines human mesh recovery, kinematic retargeting, reinforcement learning for motion tracking in simulation, and onboard deployment via ONNX. Training ran on a single RTX 5070 GPU. An eleven-version deployment ladder evaluated on hardware examines three interventions. We detect and repair silent corruption of deployment artifacts, model state-estimator drift during training, and edit the reference motion to support stable execution and a controlled ending. The final policies achieved three consecutive rope-free completions of a 43-second routine, a 46-second performance with automatic handoff, and a continuous 9.7-minute rope-free performance composed from the captured motion. In a live handover, a single remote request let the robot start from and return to the manufacturer's walking controller on stage, with a measured torque-free window of 45-140 ms. We report the training dynamics and hardware outcomes and discuss failure boundaries involving compliant flooring and occlusion in monocular capture.

</details>


### [362] [MOSU2: Long-range Navigation System with Multi-modal Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11148)
*Jing Liang,Zhenyu Hou,Senthurbavan Kirubaharan,Md Safwan Mondal,Ashok Gudivada,Xuesu Xiao,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MOSU2提出两阶段轨迹选择的长距离户外导航系统：第一阶段用上下文推理判断交互是否已消解、需要在何时检索何种证据，仅在未消解时触发第二阶段检索几何与动态信息并与场景上下文对齐，再结合GPS路径规划与多模态可通行性分析筛选轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外长距离导航不仅要避障，还要判断地形适配性并决定前进、让行或绕行（行人、自行车、车辆、信号灯、临时管制）；这类决策的正确答案依赖场景演化（如车辆是否减速、骑行者是否横穿）。VLM能解读线索但缺乏度量几何与运动信息，逐步提供证据太慢，手工触发规则无法覆盖开放式户外情形。

Method: 两阶段轨迹选择：(1) 第一阶段上下文推理决定是否需要额外证据及检索什么；(2) 仅当交互仍未解决时触发第二阶段，检索几何与动态信息并与场景上下文对齐以做导航决策。系统沿用MOSU，基于GPS路线规划取路径，通过多模态可通行性分析过滤候选轨迹后选定执行轨迹。

Result: 真实世界实验覆盖停止手势、施工场地、人行横道及与车辆/自行车/行人共享的道路：平均导航成功率由单图像前身的61.8%提升至94.2%，条件检测准确率由72.2%提升至91.4%，平均决策延迟约为前身的2.2倍。

Conclusion: 按需触发、按需检索的"惰性证据获取"策略能在实时约束附近（约2.2倍延迟）换来显著的成功率与条件检测提升，说明多模态证据与几何/动态信息的选择性融合是户外长程导航的有效范式。

Abstract: Robots that travel long distances through public outdoor spaces must do more than avoid obstacles: they must remain on terrain suited to their mobility and decide when to proceed, yield, or detour around pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic signals, and temporary restrictions. These decisions are difficult because their correctness often depends on how a scene evolves, such as whether an approaching car is slowing or a cyclist will cross the robot's path. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret such cues, but they reason over images that lack metric geometry and motion. Supplying this evidence at every step is too slow for real-time navigation, and hand-crafted triggers cannot anticipate the open-ended variety of outdoor situations. We present MOSU2, a long-range navigation system with two-stage trajectory selection, in which first-stage contextual reasoning determines when additional evidence is needed and what to retrieve. Only when an interaction remains unresolved does the first stage trigger the second stage to retrieve geometric and dynamic information and align it with scene context to make navigation decisions. Building on MOSU, MOSU2 follows routes from GPS-based route planning and filters candidate trajectories through multi-modal traversability analysis before selecting a trajectory to move the robot. In real-world experiments spanning stop gestures, construction sites, crosswalks, and roads shared with vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, MOSU2 raises mean navigation success from 61.8% to 94.2% and condition-detection accuracy from 72.2% to 91.4% over its single-image predecessor, at about 2.2 times its mean decision latency. Project website: this https URL

</details>


### [363] [Tutorial: Vision-Based Formation Control with Differential-Drive Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11164)
*Christian Marowski,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本教程给出基于差速驱动机器人、顶置相机与 Python 的多机器人编队控制完整实现流程：用 ArUco 标记估计位姿，以期望相对位移向量定义圆形编队，通过反馈控制生成轮速指令，并配合近距传感器避障，附开源代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弥补机器人教育中理论学习与实际实现之间的鸿沟，展示如何将数学概念（编队几何、反馈控制）转化为物理机器人上的协同行为。

Method: 顶置相机 + ArUco 标记估计各机器人位姿；以期望成对位移向量参数化圆形编队；比较实测与期望相对位置，计算运动向量并转换为差速驱动轮速指令；加入基于近距传感器的简易避障；给出硬件/软件配置、位姿估计、编队几何、反馈控制、系统集成与编队误差评估的完整步骤。

Result: 提供可复现的教学实现与演示：开源 GitHub 仓库包含 Python 代码、搭建说明与实验演示，可实现圆形编队与编队误差评估；方法可迁移至其他差速平台与仿真环境。

Conclusion: 该工作属教学性教程，方法经典、未见新算法贡献，但对多机器人系统的入门实践与课程设计有直接参考价值，优先级为背景/工具类。

Abstract: This tutorial presents a step-by-step introduction to multi-robot formation control using differential- drive robots, an overhead camera, and Python. ArUco markers are used to estimate robot positions and orientations, while desired pairwise displacement vectors define a circular formation. By comparing measured and desired relative positions, the controller computes movement vectors that are converted into differential-drive wheel commands, with basic proximity-sensor-based obstacle avoidance. The tutorial guides readers through hardware and software setup, robot pose estimation, formation geometry, feedback control, system integration, and formation-error evaluation. Motivated by the need to bridge the gap between theoretical understanding and practical implementation in robotics education, we emphasize how mathematical concepts are translated into coordinated behaviors on physical robots. Although the implementation uses a specific robotic platform, the underlying perception and formation-control principles can be adapted to other differential-drive robots and simulation environments. The accompanying open-source GitHub repository provides the Python implementation, setup instructions, and demonstrations to support hands-on learning and further exploration of multi-robot systems.

</details>


### [364] [DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11166)
*Zhongxi Chen,Yi Yang,Xinyi Chen,Mingzhe Ye,Yaping Li,Zhihong Liu,Congsheng Xu,Haonan Wang,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexForesight 通过将动作条件化的空间世界模型隐式注入灵巧操作策略的潜空间，在部署时仅用 RGB/语言/本体状态即获得空间预测能力，仿真成功率 49.4%→60.5%，真机 58.3%（基线 50.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 world-action 模型依赖显式未来预测（如未来图像/深度生成）来获得空间前瞻，代价高且部署时需额外输入（深度、预测解码），难以用于遮挡严重的灵巧手场景。作者希望在不做显式预测的前提下，把动力学感知的世界表征迁移进策略潜空间。

Method: 离线阶段：用场景深度、运动学手部几何与示范轨迹训练动作条件空间世界模型，预测 3D 手部点运动与视觉特征变化（含被摄像头遮挡的手指运动）。随后冻结世界模型，将策略的 query 与世界模型的预测 query 对齐，从而把空间动力学隐式蒸馏进策略 latent，并用于条件化动作生成。部署时仅保留策略，输入 RGB、语言、机器人状态，无需深度或显式未来预测。

Result: 11 个 DexJoCo 仿真任务上整体成功率由基线 49.4% 提升至 60.5%；3 个真机灵巧操作任务达到 58.3%，优于最强基线的 50.0%。

Conclusion: 隐式注入的世界表征可有效替代显式未来预测，为灵巧操作提供空间前瞻，并具备真实机器人可部署性；核心贡献在于世界模型→策略潜空间的表征对齐范式。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injecting dynamics-aware world representations into the latent space of a dexterous policy. During training, DexForesight learns an action-conditioned spatial world model from offline scene depth, kinematic hand geometry, and demonstration trajectories. The world model predicts 3D hand-point motion and visual feature changes, capturing both articulated hand dynamics and scene changes under demonstrated actions, including the motion of fingers occluded from the cameras. We then freeze the world model and align policy queries with its predictive world queries, transferring the learned spatial dynamics into policy latents and using them to condition action generation. At deployment, only the policy is retained, operating on RGB observations, language, and robot state without depth input or explicit future prediction. On 11 DexJoCo simulation tasks, DexForesight improves the overall success rate of the base policy from 49.4% to 60.5%. On three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks, DexForesight achieves 58.3% success, compared with 50.0% for the strongest this http URL page this https URL

</details>


### [365] [DeepSoMo: Deformable Object Motion Estimation under Proprioceptive Partial Observability via Predictive Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11242)
*Hanwen Zhao,Weicheng Dai,Luoyao Chen,Chen Feng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DeepSoMo：从本体感知部分可观测条件下，以潜在动力学视角估计软体形变运动，通过自监督潜在预测约束强化潜在时间一致性，在有限元仿真中优于同架构循环基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人本体感知仅提供间接内部观测，存在部分可观测性，单帧观测不足以恢复全局运动、接触与形状演化，长时序估计需要时间一致的潜在表征。

Method: 基于学习的框架 DeepSoMo，在潜在动力学中引入自监督潜在预测约束（未来观测可预测性），强制潜在状态具备预测结构；以高保真有限元仿真作为受控真值源，在典型形变动力学设定下评估。

Result: 在轨迹估计、姿态恢复、形状重建和接触推断四项任务上，相对架构匹配的循环基线取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 潜在时间一致性（潜在状态对未来观测的可预测性）是本体感知长时序形变估计的关键需求；结果仅为仿真验证，缺少真实软体平台实验与代码/部署证据。

Abstract: Estimating the motion of deformable bodies in soft robotics from proprioceptive sensing is challenging due to partial observability, as internal observations provide only indirect access to global motion, contact, and shape evolution. In such settings, instantaneous observations are insufficient, and accurate estimation requires temporally consistent latent representations. This paper studies deformable motion estimation under proprioceptive partial observability from a latent dynamics perspective. We argue that a key requirement for long-horizon estimation is latent temporal consistency, where latent states remain predictive of future observations. To this end, we present DeepSoMo, a learning-based framework that enforces predictive structure in latent dynamics through a self-supervised latent prediction constraint. We evaluate the approach in a canonical deformable dynamics setting using high-fidelity finite-element simulation as a controlled source of ground truth. Results demonstrate consistent improvements in trajectory estimation, orientation recovery, shape reconstruction, and contact inference over architecture-matched recurrent baselines.

</details>


### [366] [Single-Radar Bilateral 3D Near-Field Imaging for Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11296)
*Yingqi Wang,Tingwei Chen,Zhongqin Wang,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种运动辅助框架，用单个前向安装的毫米波MIMO雷达在一次前进行驶中重建机器人路径两侧的3D散射结构，均值定位误差约4.7–6.0 cm，PBR>13 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家用移动机器人需要感知邻近家具与两侧结构，但单颗前向毫米波雷达受近场波前曲率、视角依赖的可见性以及俯仰维多样性不足限制，难以双侧重建。

Method: 近场球面传播模型关联场景反射率与步进频率MIMO观测；双侧Tx合并提供宽带方向加权；滑动孔径反投影按近场距离相干聚焦；Top-K功率融合合并不同可见性的局部图像；再做多层高度提取与基于原始MIMO通道的带保护自适应高度精修。

Result: 在受控环境、办公/书房、走廊三类场景中横向-前向定位平均误差分别为4.65、5.63、5.98 cm，PBR均超过13 dB；无需学习式场景表征。

Conclusion: 该框架证明单颗低成本前向毫米波雷达结合运动可恢复双侧3D结构，为移动机器人近场感知提供无需训练数据的几何化方案。

Abstract: Mobile robots operating in homes need reliable 3D perception of nearby furniture and surrounding structures, yet recovering this information on both sides of the robot's path with a single forward-mounted millimeter-wave radar remains challenging because of near-field wavefront curvature, viewpoint-dependent target visibility, and limited elevation diversity. This paper presents a motion-assisted framework for reconstructing structures on both sides of a robot's trajectory. Our near-field model relates scene reflectivity to stepped-frequency multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) observations across frequencies and robot positions using spherical paths from transmitter (Tx) to scatterer to receiver (Rx). Bilateral Tx combining provides wideband directional weighting, while sliding-aperture back-projection coherently focuses the measurements using near-field propagation distances. Top-K power fusion combines local images with different visibility. The reconstruction provides lateral-forward support for multi-layer height extraction, followed by guarded adaptive height refinement using the original MIMO channels. Experiments in controlled, office/study, and corridor environments produce mean lateral-forward localization errors of 4.65, 5.63, and 5.98 cm, respectively, with peak-to-background ratios (PBRs) exceeding 13 dB. The framework recovers bilateral 3D scattering structure from one forward pass using a single radar, without relying on learned representations of the scene.

</details>


### [367] [When Coding Agents Get Arms: Safety Risks Across the Digital-Physical Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11438)
*Yiming Sun,Mi Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ArmedAgent，首个系统评测"代码智能体零样本端到端控制真实机械臂"安全风险的基准，覆盖鲁棒性、恶意使用与间接提示注入三类风险，共 36 个任务、5 个场景，含仿真与实体机械臂验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型的空间理解能力使其可驱动代码智能体零样本控制真实机械臂，无需任务演示或再训练。这带来两类新风险：(1) 模型能力扩展使智能体可执行早期 VLA/WAM 范式无法完成的有害任务；(2) 智能体可访问网页、邮件等数字资源，间接提示注入等威胁可传导至物理世界。现有基准未覆盖这两类风险。

Method: 构建基准而非方法：设计 36 个任务、5 个场景，覆盖鲁棒性、恶意使用、间接提示注入三个维度；其中部分任务针对早期 VLA 范式无法完成的有害行为；在仿真中评测并在实体机械臂上验证；在多个主流智能体框架下测试包括 GPT-6-Astra 在内的多个前沿模型。

Result: 当前系统存在显著安全风险：在主流 agent 框架下，多个前沿模型在能力滥用与间接注入传导至物理世界两方面均表现出明显脆弱性。

Conclusion: 零样本代码智能体控制机械臂是新兴且真实的攻击面，亟需在能力与数字—物理耦合两个层面建立安全评测与防护；ArmedAgent 提供了可复用的评测框架。

Abstract: Advances in spatial understanding have enabled frontier models to power coding agents that control a real robot arm zero-shot and end-to-end, without task-specific demonstrations or retraining. This brings two new safety challenges. First, the extensive knowledge of frontier models lets these agents perform tasks that earlier VLA and WAM paradigms could not, opening the door to new forms of capability misuse. Second, coding agents can access digital resources such as web pages and emails. Threats in these resources, such as indirect prompt injection, can carry over into the physical world when the agent controls a robot. We therefore introduce ArmedAgent, the first systematic benchmark to evaluate both risks for coding agents performing zero-shot robot control. It covers robustness, malicious use, and indirect injection across 36 tasks in 5 scenarios, evaluated in simulation and validated on a physical robot arm. A distinctive portion of the tasks target harmful behaviors that earlier VLA paradigms could not perform. Testing several frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra, under widely used agent frameworks, we find substantial safety risks in current systems.

</details>


### [368] [Off-Policy RL with Online Inference Tuning: My Solution to the CoRL 2026 RoboEval Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11464)
*Ilia Larchenko*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出在 π0.5 策略上做"策略即价值函数"的离群策略强化学习，以官方评分精确优势为奖励信号，用 AWR+RECAP 训练，并在 rollout 中同时进行约 20 个推理参数的 Thompson 采样；再补充生成式满分演示与基于自身失败的回放恢复数据，最终在 RoboEval 2026 八项双臂任务上达到官方种子 0.987 RDS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoRL 2026 RoboEval 挑战不仅评估任务是否成功，还按过程评分（安全、效率、双臂协调，与人类演示对比），因此需要直接优化细粒度阶段分数的策略学习与数据获取方法，而非仅优化二值成功率的模仿学习。同时，通用 RL 微调难以自行发现高奖励行为（如满分演示与失败恢复）。

Method: (1) 通用部分：在 π0.5 基座策略上做离群策略 RL，令策略自身兼作价值函数，使用 AWR 与 RECAP，以官方评分的精确优势为训练信号；rollout 循环中同步进行约 20 个推理超参的 Thompson 采样以兼顾探索与推理时集成。(2) 任务专属部分：补充本地探索难以获得的数据——可达成满奖励的生成式演示，以及从策略自身失败状态出发的恢复片段。两部分叠加后提交。

Result: 仅通用部分在两天内、尚未收敛的情况下，于留出种子达到 0.85 RDS；加入生成演示与恢复数据后，留出种子 0.990 RDS，官方种子 0.987 RDS。

Conclusion: 将过程级评分直接作为 RL 优势目标，并配合"策略即价值"的高效离群训练与推理参数 Thompson 采样，是双臂精细任务上可行的方案；同时说明纯在线探索存在行为盲区，需以合成高奖励演示与失败恢复数据补足，二者结合才能逼近满分 RDS。

Abstract: The CoRL 2026 RoboEval challenge has eight bimanual tasks, and it ranks a policy not only on whether it succeeds but on how: every stage of the task, done safely, efficiently and with both arms in coordination, scored against human demonstrations. My solution has two parts. The generic part, carried over from my LeHome challenge solution, is off-policy RL on a $\pi_{0.5}$-based policy that is also its own value function. It is trained with AWR and RECAP on advantages of the exact official score, in a loop where every rollout is at the same time a Thompson-sampling trial of about 20 inference parameters. Out of the box, it took the policy to 0.85 RDS on held-out seeds in two days (and it was still very far from convergence). The competition-specific part adds data that local exploration cannot find: generated demonstrations that reach the full reward, and recovery episodes that start from the policy's own failures. The submitted policy reaches 0.990 RDS on held-out seeds and 0.987 on the official seeds.

</details>


### [369] [Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11489)
*Yizhe Zhang,Jianping Li,Yilun Gao,Liangliang Yin,Pengfei Wan,Bisheng Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FLAVOR：以机器人中心局部密图 + 稀疏全局观测/任务上下文的层次化时空框架，实现恒定内存的自主无人机探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机探索系统维护全局可查询的稠密几何地图，内存与查询开销随探索范围增长；而纯机器人中心局部建图虽能限制开销却会丢失长时程任务所需的全局上下文。

Method: 观测层用轻量LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留射线级前沿证据；任务层将局部图范围外未解决前沿存为带里程计锚点的紧凑待办任务；稀疏拓扑图通过保留路径连接锚点。返回任务区域时，从观测重建前沿与探索视点，并在执行前用当前局部图对拓扑路径进行实例化与校验。

Result: 仿真中相较完成全部三个场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98–41.88%，地图内存降低94–99%；真实部署中，森林降低92.67%、工地降低62.42%（对比显式点云ikd-tree）。

Conclusion: 稠密地图容量保持固定，随探索增长的内存开销被限制在紧凑的观测与任务表示上，在机载资源受限条件下保持长时程任务连续性。

Abstract: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon this http URL present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future this http URL returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task this http URL achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.

</details>


### [370] [Review the Episodes, Refine the Lessons: Simple Memory Evolution for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11509)
*Yifei Yao,Yude Zou,Xing Gao,Guanbo Jiao,Yukai Wang,Jianming Ma,Weinan Zhang,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SimplEvo 让前沿 MLLM 在直接控制具身智能体时仅靠自写文本记忆（一次演示生成的无坐标任务记忆 + 训练回合上迭代精炼的有界工作记忆）提升性能，无需权重更新、后训练策略或特权信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体研究大量在 MLLM 外围构建 harness（后训练策略、递归自改进循环等），但尚不清楚这些附加组件是否真的超越了 MLLM 的原生能力。论文希望探究在保留执行经验于自写文本记忆的条件下，MLLM 直接控制能达到多高的上限。

Method: 提出 SimplEvo：不做权重更新、无后训练策略与特权信息。MLLM 从单次演示写出一份无坐标的任务记忆；在严格训练-测试协议下，仅在训练回合上建立有界工作记忆，并在每个回合后依据流程、完成与恢复三方面的经验教训进行精炼。两类记忆在测试时保持固定。

Result: 在 EBench 上将 GPT-6-Astra 直接控制下的成功率从 46.7% 提升至 81.7%；在 RoboDojo 榜单以 69.63% SR、75.32 分登顶。相较同时存储历史视觉帧的记忆方案，仅用文本记忆即可达到相近 SR 且 token 更少。记忆固定时仍可泛化到未见布局与随机化场景配置；工作记忆可跨模型迁移，由 GPT-6-Astra 撰写后直接被较弱 MLLM 复用并提升其表现，无需自身适配。

Conclusion: 文本记忆是释放 MLLM 原生具身能力的有效且轻量途径，可在不改变模型权重的情况下显著提升成功率和泛化性，并具备跨模型可迁移性，为审视 harness 工程的必要性提供了基线参照。

Abstract: Recent studies of embodied agents based on frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) develop harness engineering around the MLLM, such as harnesses with post-trained policies and recursive self-improvement loops. Yet whether these additions exceed the native capability of the MLLM remains unexplored. We introduce SimplEvo to explore how far an MLLM can improve under direct control when it retains its execution experience in self-written text memories. It requires no weight updates, post-trained policies, or privileged information. The MLLM writes a coordinate-free task memory once from a single demonstration. Under a strict train-test protocol, it then creates a bounded working memory on training episodes only and refines it after each episode with lessons on procedure, completion, and recovery. Both memories stay fixed at test time. On EBench, SimplEvo lifts the success rate (SR) of GPT-6-Astra under direct control from 46.7% to 81.7%, and tops the RoboDojo leaderboard with 69.63% SR and a score of 75.32. Compared with memories that also store past visual frames, SimplEvo reaches a similar SR with text memory alone while using fewer tokens. With its memories fixed, SimplEvo also generalizes to unseen layouts and randomized scene configurations. Moreover, the working memory transfers across models: written by GPT-6-Astra, it can be reused as is by weaker MLLMs and improve their performance without any adaptation of their own.

</details>


### [371] [Breaking survivorship bias in driving world models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11516)
*Zihao Sheng,Zilin Huang,Yuhao Luo,Zhengyang Wan,Boyue Wang,Soyoung Ahn,David A. Noyce,Sikai Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"中性世界模型"(NWM)，用常规驾驶数据与真实事故视频混合训练，并以边界框引导目标学习安全关键的未来，纠正现有驾驶世界模型的"幸存者偏差"，进而作为想象引擎用于轨迹评估与安全关键决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶数据集记录的未来几乎都以安全结束，导致世界模型存在幸存者偏差：即使碰撞迫近，模型也倾向于想象出良性结果，从而在安全关键决策中失真。作者希望世界模型能同时刻画常规与安全关键的未来。

Method: 构建NWM：以常规驾驶数据与真实事故视频构成混合训练集，采用边界框引导（bounding-box-guided）的目标函数进行训练；推理时将其作为"想象引擎"，对多条自车候选轨迹分别预测未来，再用奖励函数评估想象结果并选择动作。

Result: NWM能更真实地预测即将发生的碰撞，同时在常规驾驶中保持较低的误报碰撞率和有竞争力的生成质量；在NAVSIM挑战性场景中比基线世界模型更可靠地选出更优轨迹；使用自动驾驶研究车采集的真实行人假人横穿数据做零样本实验，显示出对未见传感器观测的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 纠正世界模型中的幸存者偏差可显著提升其对未来演化的忠实推理能力，并有效支撑自动驾驶中的安全关键决策；该偏差修正思路对世界模型训练数据构建具有普遍意义。

Abstract: World models allow autonomous vehicles to imagine the consequences of candidate actions before execution, but their reliability depends on the futures represented in their training data. We identify a survivorship bias in driving world models: because the futures recorded in prevailing driving datasets almost always end safely, existing models often imagine benign outcomes even when a collision is imminent. We introduce a neutral world model (NWM) that learns both routine and safety-critical futures from a mixture of routine driving and real accident videos with a bounding-box-guided objective. The NWM more faithfully anticipates imminent collisions, while maintaining a low false collision rate and competitive generation quality in routine driving. We further use the model as an imagination engine for decision-making. Given multiple ego trajectories, the NWM predicts the future associated with each candidate, and a reward function evaluates these imagined outcomes before selecting an action. On challenging NAVSIM scenarios, this procedure selects the better trajectory more reliably than the baseline world model. Zero-shot experiments with real-world pedestrian dummy crossing data collected using an autonomous research vehicle further demonstrate transfer to unseen sensor observations. These results show that correcting survivorship bias enables world models to more faithfully reason about futures and support safety-critical decision-making in autonomous driving.

</details>


### [372] [K-PWM: Control-Oriented Structured Bilinear World Models under Partial Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11521)
*Santosh Mohan Rajkumar,Sriram Narayanan,Samuel E. Otto,Debdipta Goswami*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: K-PWM：面向部分可观测系统的Koopman双线性潜动力学+非线性解码器概率世界模型，用EKF/平滑做无独立推断网络的潜状态推断，GECM闭式训练，支撑不确定性感知MPPI控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型多聚焦像素观测，而许多物理系统只提供部分揭示真实状态的向量测量，且数据有限、含噪、部分可观测，学习可靠的内部模拟器仍困难。

Method: Koopman双线性潜动态耦合非线性观测解码器；通过学到的模型用扩展卡尔曼滤波与平滑进行概率潜状态推断（无需单独训练推断网络）；双线性结构使高斯信念精确传播并支持高效 rollout 用于 MPPI 控制；训练采用广义期望条件最大化(GECM)，生成器、噪声协方差、潜先验有闭式更新，解码器梯度学习；Koopman一致性初始化从数据选潜维度并初始化动作相关动力学。

Result: 在部分可观测 Gymnasium MuJoCo 上有限数据下长时预测误差低于基线，训练时间显著低于最强预测基线；在高维 MuJoCo Menagerie 机器人上跟踪精度有竞争力且单步计算开销低，具备实时部署潜力。

Conclusion: 结构化概率动力学是部分观测下数据与算力高效的世界建模与控制路径。

Abstract: World models learn internal simulators of environment dynamics for prediction, planning, and control, yet learning them from limited, noisy, and partial observations remains challenging. While much progress has focused on pixel-based observations, many physical systems instead provide vector-valued measurements that reveal only part of the underlying state. We introduce K-PWM, a probabilistic world model for prediction and control under partial observation. K-PWM couples Koopman-bilinear latent dynamics with a nonlinear observation decoder and performs probabilistic latent-state inference through the learned model via extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, without a separately trained inference network. Its bilinear structure enables exact propagation of the maintained Gaussian belief through the latent transition and efficient rollouts for uncertainty-aware model predictive path integral (MPPI) control. For training K-PWM, we present a generalized expectation conditional maximization (GECM) procedure with closed-form updates for the generators, noise covariances, and latent prior, complemented by gradient-based decoder learning. A Koopman-consistent initialization selects the latent dimension from data and initializes the action-dependent dynamics. With limited training data, K-PWM achieves lower long-horizon prediction error than the evaluated baselines on partially observed Gymnasium MuJoCo systems, while substantially reducing training time relative to the strongest prediction baseline. On high-dimensional MuJoCo Menagerie robots, it achieves competitive tracking accuracy with low per-step computation times, demonstrating potential for real-time deployment. These results support structured probabilistic dynamics as a data- and compute-efficient approach to world modeling and control under partial observation.

</details>


### [373] [Kimodo-Policy: Learning Kinematic Action Models for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11554)
*Yunheng Wang,Jiaxi Zhang,Wei Lu,Yuetong Fang,Taowen Wang,Yixiao Feng,Shuning Zhang,Junzhe Xu,Yichi Wang,Zizhao Yuan,Kailun Huang,Lusong Li,Mingqian Zhou,Zecui Zeng,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Kinematic Action Models（KAM）范式，将全身运动生成本身作为预训练目标，用预训练运动生成器作为动作生成主干；实例化Kimodo-Policy：冻结的文本到运动主干+轻量ControlNet视觉条件，根-身-手层级协调，运动历史条件与重复动作块预测实现闭环控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA/世界动作模型迁移的是语义与视觉动力学先验，并未显式刻画机器人运动结构；作者希望直接以全身运动为预训练目标，把运动时序与跨身体协调先验注入策略。

Method: KAM范式：以预训练运动生成器为主干；Kimodo-Policy结合冻结Kimodo text-to-motion主干与ControlNet视觉条件；root-body-hand层级分解协调移动与操作；motion-history conditioning与重复action-chunk预测桥接运动合成与闭环控制；大规模loco-manipulation预训练，678M参数（92M可训练）。

Result: HumanoidArena多任务总体成功率最高72.14%；SIMPLE上具竞争力；八个真实任务平均成功率60%；消融支持预训练运动主干的贡献。

Conclusion: 运动生成可作为人形动作学习的互补基础（foundation），为whole-body loco-manipulation提供新的预训练范式，初步证据充分。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires continuous coordination of high-dimensional whole-body motion to realize task objectives. While vision-language-action models and world action models transfer semantic and visual-dynamics priors to robot control, these priors do not necessarily capture the structure of robot motion. We introduce Kinematic Action Models (KAMs), a paradigm that treats whole-body motion as a direct pretraining target and uses a pretrained motion generator as the primary action-generation backbone. KAMs ground learned temporal and cross-body coordination priors through task conditioning, visual observations, and execution feedback. We present Kimodo-Policy as an initial instantiation, combining a frozen Kimodo text-to-motion backbone with lightweight ControlNet-based visual conditioning. A root-body-hand hierarchy coordinates locomotion and manipulation, while motion-history conditioning and repeated action-chunk prediction bridge motion synthesis and closed-loop control. Following large-scale loco-manipulation pretraining, the policy achieves the highest overall success among compared policies on multi-task HumanoidArena (72.14%), competitive performance on SIMPLE, and 60% mean success across eight real-world tasks, with 678M parameters (92M trainable). Ablations support the contribution of the pretrained motion backbone. Together, these results provide initial evidence for motion generation as a complementary foundation for humanoid action learning.

</details>


### [374] [Qubit-to-Motion: Traceable Action Provenance in Hybrid QRL for Robotic Bin-Packing Sequencing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11580)
*Hassen Nigatu,Howard Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Qubit-to-Motion 框架：以 4 个 Pauli-Z 读出作为 actor/critic 唯一学习输入，配合支撑掩码约束物体选择，并建立决策到 MuJoCo 接触回放的 SHA-256 可追溯链路，验证量子电路输出对动作的实际影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合量子强化学习用于机器人决策时多只报告任务成功率、回报或收敛性，未解决两个关键问题：量子电路输出是否真正影响受约束动作，以及决策能否在机器人执行链条中被追溯。

Method: 以证据为中心的框架，包含支撑约束的序列决策与仿真机器人放置；4 个 Pauli-Z 读出为唯一学习输入，支撑掩码保证可行物体选择；每步决策通过步索引与 SHA-256 指纹链接到密封路线、确定性笛卡尔/逆运动学航点、关节运动及 MuJoCo 接触回放；用冻结 checkpoint 在五个确定性 30 物体场景变体上评估，并做固定状态零读出干预实验。

Result: 150 次放置全部满足支撑、包围和稳定判据；零读出干预改变 90.0±0.0% 的决策；平均宏行程 34.537±0.206 m，每条路线推理耗时 8.60±1.27 ms；回放平均末端位置误差 8.764±0.220 μm，最大互穿透 0.356 mm。

Conclusion: 实现了可复现的"决策—接触"可追溯性，并证明决策依赖联合电路表示；但验证限于仿真与固定场景，量子优势与真实机器人部署尚未给出。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum reinforcement learning has been explored for robotic decision-making, but evaluations often emphasize task success, return, or convergence, leaving unresolved whether quantum circuit outputs influence constrained actions and remain traceable through robot execution. We present \texttt{Qubit-to-Motion}, an evidence-centered framework for support-constrained sequencing and simulated robotic placement. Four Pauli-$Z$ readouts provide the sole learned input to the actor and critic, while a support mask enforces admissible object selection. Each decision is recorded and linked via step indices and SHA-256 fingerprints to a sealed route, deterministic Cartesian and inverse-kinematics waypoints, prescribed joint motion, and MuJoCo contact replay. A frozen checkpoint is evaluated across five deterministic 30-object scene variants. All 150 placements satisfy support, containment, and settling criteria. A fixed-state zero-readout intervention changes $90.0\pm0.0\%$ of decisions, demonstrating dependence on the joint circuit representation. Mean macro travel is $34.537\pm0.206$~m, inference requires $8.60\pm1.27$~ms per route, and replay achieves $8.764\pm0.220~\mu$m mean final position error with 0.356~mm maximum interpenetration. These results establish reproducible decision-to-contact traceability. The implementation is available at \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{linkpink}{the anonymous repository}}.

</details>


### [375] [Kinora: A Versioned Workflow for Text-to-Motion Generation, Robot Retargeting, and Interactive Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11601)
*Fangcheng Jin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Kinora：以版本化构件串联文本生成运动、动作库、本地智能体工具、机器人重定向与轨迹细化的交互式创作系统；当前版本为52关节作者骨架+程序化预览，通过156项回归测试、4个CUDA用例、G1重定向与3600帧合成夹具验证集成与保存契约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到运动生成工具只输出候选轨迹，但交互式机器人创作还需要可恢复的执行、可追溯的编辑、显式几何与针对具体模型的校验，这些能力尚未被统一到同一工作流中。

Method: 系统由服务端0.5.1与Gadget 0.15.2组成：文本到运动生成、动作库、本地智能体工具、机器人重定向、轨迹细化均通过版本化制品连接；采用独立指定的52关节作者骨架与程序化骨骼预览，将人体几何与外部生成模型/机器人资产解耦；人体编辑保留选定区间外的帧，机器人编辑生成不可变候选，由报告决定接受与导出。

Result: 4个CUDA用例全部通过数值门限，但转向拼接仍保留14.3 cm支撑脚漂移代理告警；G1正样本完成有界仿真回放，悬挂负对照在回放前被隔离；共执行156次核心回归测试与49次Gadget执行。

Conclusion: 结果仅支持部分集成与保持性契约，未证明语义质量提升、群体级可行性或硬件安全性；系统工程价值大于算法创新。

Abstract: Motion generation tools produce candidate trajectories, but interactive robot authoring also requires recoverable execution, traceable edits, explicit geometry, and model-specific validation. We present Kinora, a system that connects text-to-motion generation, a motion library, local agent tools, robot retargeting, and trajectory refinement through versioned artifacts. The current release uses an independently specified 52-joint authoring rig and procedural skeleton previews, separating the distributed human geometry from externally installed generation models and robot assets. Human-motion edits preserve frames outside a selected interval, while robot edits create immutable candidates whose reports govern acceptance and export. We evaluate server 0.5.1 and Gadget 0.15.2 with 156 core regression test executions, 49 Gadget executions, four CUDA generation/editing cases, a 30-frame G1 retargeting check, and a 3,600-frame synthetic G1 fixture paired with a suspended negative control. All four CUDA cases passed their numerical gates; the turning splice nevertheless retained a 14.3 cm support-foot drift proxy warning. The G1 positive fixture completed bounded simulation replay, whereas the suspended control was quarantined before replay. These results support selected integration and preservation contracts. They do not establish semantic-quality improvements, population-level feasibility, or hardware safety.

</details>


### [376] [ScanDreamer: A Map-Grounded World Model for Quadrotor Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11605)
*Yunyi Gao,Yixing Shi,Yize Liu,Hai-Duong Tran,Nhat-Hoang P. Nguyen,Shuai Wang,Yi Deng,Shengming Liu,Sim Kuan Goh,Duc-Thinh Pham,Sameer Alam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ScanDreamer 提出以 2D 扫描记忆地图为条件的世界模型导航框架，用前向锥惩罚约束视野，训练 80 万步即在 Isaac Sim 达到 96.3% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前向深度相机视野受限，导致场景理解与避障困难；现有世界模型智能体（如 AirDreamer）数据密集、缺乏显式几何记忆与可观测性意识。

Method: 由深度图与位姿在线构建 2D 扫描记忆地图；世界模型、actor、critic 均以该地图为条件；地图定义测地进展奖励；引入前向锥惩罚抑制相机视野方向外的水平运动；想象阶段在冻结地图上传播位姿，从地图几何导出进展与撞墙信号。

Result: 训练 80 万步（单 GPU 5.5 小时），Isaac Sim 上 1560 个未见布局/参数片段：成功率 96.3±0.3%、碰撞率 3.6±0.3%；同等在线交互预算下 AirDreamer 为 59.6±3.0% / 28.8±2.8%；去除前向锥惩罚碰撞升至 9.9±3.1%。

Conclusion: 显式地图记忆 + 地图接地想象 + 感知感知运动三者结合显著提升导航成功率与数据效率；开源代码。

Abstract: Quadrotors inspecting buildings and tunnels must navigate unknown clutter with a forward-facing depth camera whose limited field of view constrains scene understanding and collision-avoiding navigation. Recent world-model agents learn navigation through imagined experience (e.g., AirDreamer), but remain data-intensive and often lack explicit geometric memory and awareness of what the camera can observe. We propose ScanDreamer, a map-grounded world model that constructs an online 2D scan-memory map from depth images and vehicle pose. Our world model, actor, and critic are conditioned on this map, which also defines a geodesic progress reward. Moreover, a forward-cone penalty discourages horizontal motion outside the camera's viewing direction. During imagination, ScanDreamer propagates the quadrotor pose over a frozen map and derives progress and wall-contact signals from the mapped geometry. We train ScanDreamer for 0.8 million environment steps (5.5 h on one GPU) and evaluate it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim over 1560 episodes spanning unseen layouts and parameter ranges. Across three seeds (mean $\pm$ SD), ScanDreamer achieves 96.3 $\pm$ 0.3% success with 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3% collision, compared with 59.6 $\pm$ 3.0% success and 28.8 $\pm$ 2.8% collision for AirDreamer at the same online-interaction budget. Removing the forward-cone penalty increases collisions to 9.9 $\pm$ 3.1%. These results show that combining explicit map memory, map-grounded imagination, and perception-aware motion substantially improves navigation performance and data efficiency. The source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [377] [ColNav: Uncertainty-Aware Spacetime Collision Checking with Bounding Volume Hierarchies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11646)
*Sanjeev Ramkumar Sudha,Lars Ivar Hatledal,Erlend M. Coates*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ColNav: 将目标与自车位置/速度的不确定性编码为时空管道(spacetime tubes)，用包围体层次(BVH)做整段horizon的连续碰撞检测，返回鲁棒几何证书与碰撞时间估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统forward propagation + 离散采样点的碰撞检测会漏掉采样点之间的碰撞，且对状态估计不确定性不鲁棒；需要在动态不确定环境中给出连续的、带不确定性保证的碰撞判定。

Method: 把目标与自车位置和速度的不确定性分别用有界集合与高斯两种描述编码成spacetime tubes；将这些tube组织成bounding volume hierarchies，用一次树遍历覆盖整个预测时域，取代逐时刻采样测试；静态与动态障碍共享同一表示。

Result: 在预测模型失配下成功率100%，最佳基线65%；密集交通中保持约3倍的clearance；并在实体机器人上验证实时运行。

Conclusion: 基于几何管的连续鲁棒碰撞检测可作为移动机器人动态避障规划中的可靠碰撞检查模块，兼顾鲁棒性、保守性与实时性。

Abstract: Safe navigation for mobile robots in dynamic and uncertain environments requires planning paths that avoid collisions with other moving targets. Typically this involves forward propagating the robot motion and checking for collisions at sampled points in space and time. Such methods can miss collisions between sampled points and are not robust to uncertainty in the state estimates. We propose ColNav, a robust collision check formulation with geometric volumes. The key aspect of our approach is encoding the uncertainty in the targets' and the ego robot's positions and velocities into spacetime tubes, in two variants that consume bounded-set and Gaussian uncertainty descriptions, respectively. The tubes are organised in bounding volume hierarchies, so that a single tree traversal covers the entire horizon, rather than testing sampled time instants, and returns a robust geometric certificate together with an estimate of the time to collision. Static and dynamic obstacles share the same representation. Our approach reaches the goal with a 100% success rate under prediction model mismatch, where the best baseline reaches 65%, and maintains up to three times the clearance in dense traffic. We also validate real-time operation on a physical robot.

</details>


### [378] [PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11648)
*Jocubas Dimsa,Maria Grouev,Filip Keerberg,Nicolas Laplagne,Tigo Schutgens,Sven Schoonebeek,Anahita Jamshidnejad*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PA-SaR框架，将异构局部控制、学习式探索、监督式任务分配与自适应引导式受害者救护统一在任务级目标下，并在单/多机器人仿真中分析各模块交互与权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主搜救中提升单个机器人能力未必改善任务结果（安全运动限制探索、更快发现增加救援需求、引导效果依赖受害者响应），缺乏统一框架来整合互补机制并分析其交互。

Method: 数学与架构框架PA-SaR，明确区分环境真值、机器人个体感知与模拟受害者行为；集成MPC与学习式探索、基于感知的安全屏蔽、事件驱动任务分配、自适应approach-lead引导；以单机器人与多机器人仿真实验验证。

Result: 发现避撞与搜索完成度之间的权衡；监督式分配优于仅信息共享；探索增加不必然带来更多救援；自适应引导相较持续领航提升救援数，但未检测到受害者信任均值/终值改善或死亡率降低。

Conclusion: 局部控制、团队协调与疏散应作为自主搜救中相关但可区分的三个层面分别评估；框架仅在所考虑的仿真环境中成立，缺乏真实机器人验证。

Abstract: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.

</details>


### [379] [FlowEval: How Much Adaptation Does an Embodied Foundation Model Need at Deployment?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11650)
*Zhang Xi-Jia,Roman Yakunin,Shivang Chopra,Chengyue Huang,Che Chen,Siddharth Karamcheti,Zsolt Kira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlowEval：用少量成功示范、基于流匹配目标的无训练度量，量化预训练具身基础模型与目标部署的匹配度，并预测后续适配所需数据量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练减少了具身基础模型部署时的适配量，但预训练模型未必已达到各部署场景所需的性能。实践者需要在适配前判断模型与目标部署的匹配程度，以及还需采集多少目标域数据。

Method: 提出 FlowEval，一组训练无关（training-free）指标：利用流匹配（flow-matching）目标，用一小组成功的目标域示范对具身基础模型进行探针式评估，并通过量化模型在这些成功示范上的预测分歧（predictive disagreement）来刻画模型对目标部署的拟合程度。

Result: 在 Pi-0.5、MolmoAct2、GR00T、DreamZero 四个具身基础模型家族上，FlowEval 在真实世界与仿真操作任务中均能区分已见与未见部署；在 17 个 RoboCasa365 操作任务上微调 Pi-0.5 与 GR00T，FlowEval 与随适配数据增加而提升的成功率具有相关性。

Conclusion: FlowEval 可作为轻量、免训练的诊断工具，预判模型—部署之间所需的适配程度，指导目标域数据采集量。

Abstract: Large-scale pretraining is reducing the amount of adaptation required to deploy embodied foundation models, but it is not guaranteed that a pretrained model already provide the level of performance required in every deployment. Practitioners therefore need to understand how well a pretrained model matches a target deployment and how much adaptation data is left to be collected. We study whether a small set of successful target-domain demonstrations can reveal whether and how much target-domain data will be required before any adaptation. We introduce FlowEval, a set of training-free metrics that use the flow-matching objective to probe an embodied foundation model with a set of demonstrations. FlowEval quantifies predictive disagreement on successful target demonstrations to assess how well a pretrained model fits a target deployment. Across four embodied foundation model families: Pi-0.5, MolmoAct2, GR00T, and DreamZero, FlowEval distinguishes seen from unseen deployments across real-world and simulated manipulation. Further, by finetuning Pi-0.5 and GR00T on 17 RoboCasa365 manipulation tasks, we showed that FlowEval correlates with how success rate improves as additional adaptation data is provided. Together, these results suggest that FlowEval can serve as a lightweight, training-free diagnostic of how much model--deployment adaptation may be required.

</details>


### [380] [Enhancing Balance and Posture in Material Handling Tasks with a Wearable Robotic Tail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11662)
*Eisa Anwar,Sajeeva Abeywardena,Stuart C. Miller,Ildar Farkhatdinov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 可穿戴机器人尾巴作为动态配重，在模拟货架装卸任务中显著改善平衡并降低腰背与小腿肌电活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频繁负重搬运导致肌肉骨骼劳损，下背痛影响高达40%的人工搬运工；受动物用尾巴维持平衡的启发，探索用可穿戴机器人尾巴提供动态配重与平衡辅助。

Method: 10名被试执行模拟货架装卸任务，对比主动尾巴、被动尾巴与无尾巴三种条件；测量运动学、压力中心(CoP)及腓肠肌、竖脊肌、胫骨前肌、肱二头肌的表面肌电。

Result: 相较无尾巴，主动尾巴使CoP峰值位移减少>20 mm、躯干运动减少4.3°、竖脊肌活动降低>9%、腓肠肌活动降低>20%；被动尾巴收益较小，说明被动配重有效而主动运动进一步增强；肱二头肌活动在主动尾巴条件下升高；踝关节运动学与胫骨前肌活动无显著变化。

Conclusion: 可穿戴机器人尾巴能改善物料搬运中的平衡并降低关键肌群负荷，但样本仅10人、为实验室模拟任务，缺少长期/现场验证与尾巴控制策略细节。

Abstract: Frequent heavy lifting is linked to musculoskeletal strain, with lower back pain affecting up to 40% of manual labourers. Inspired by animals using tails for balance, we developed a wearable robotic tail as a dynamic counterbalance. Ten participants performed an imitated shelf loading/unloading task across three conditions: active tail, passive tail, and no tail. Kinematics, centre of pressure, and muscle activation (gastrocnemius, erector spinae, tibialis anterior, biceps brachii) were measured. Compared with no tail, the active tail achieved >20 mm reduction in centre of pressure peak displacement, 4.3 degree reduction in trunk motion, and >9% and >20% reductions in erector spinae and gastrocnemius activity, respectively. The passive tail produced smaller reductions, suggesting passive counterbalancing helps while active movement augments it further. Biceps brachii activation increased with the active versus passive tail. The ankle kinematics and tibialis anterior activation were unchanged. These findings support wearable robotic tails for improving balance during material handling.

</details>


### [381] [HINT-VLM: Humanoid Interactive Navigation over Rough Terrain with Embodiment-Grounded Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11665)
*Ziwon Yoon,Seok Hwan Kim,Yiyu Chen,Quan Nguyen,Lu Gan,Ye Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出混合规划框架：用VLM语义先验给出物体可移动性先验，再用高斯过程（GP）残差模型以本体交互数据校正，得到具身校准的概率可移动性估计，并嵌入分层不确定性感知规划，实现人形机器人在杂乱户外崎岖地形中的可移动障碍导航（NAMO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统导航假设环境不可交互、只做通行；现有NAMO研究多限于平坦环境与反应式交互，缺乏对物体可移动性的预测与前瞻规划。户外崎岖地形下人形机器人需联合推理地形可通行性与物体可移动性，属空白问题。

Method: VLM提供物体可移动性语义先验；GP残差模型学习本体实际交互数据对先验的偏差，输出具身锚定的概率可移动性；将该概率接入分层、不确定性感知的规划器，联合调用行走与操作能力。

Result: 摘要未给出定量指标，仅声称可提升户外杂乱地形导航的效率与安全性，并称是首个面向崎岖地形NAMO、基于预测式可移动性推理与概率化VLM集成的人形机器人方案。

Conclusion: 将VLM语义先验与具身交互数据概率融合、并纳入不确定性感知分层规划，是人形机器人户外NAMO的可行范式；其有效性仍需真实机器人实验与基线对比验证。

Abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved significant progress in locomotion and manipulation, enabling traversal over rough terrain and richer interaction with the environment, such as moving obstacles. However, most traditional navigation methods assume non-interactive environments and focus only on traversal. While Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches relax this assumption, prior efforts have largely focused on flat environments and reactive interaction, rather than predicting object movability and planning ahead. These limitations become critical in outdoor rough-terrain scenarios, where robots must jointly reason about terrain traversability and object movability. In this work, we address NAMO for humanoid robots in cluttered outdoor rough terrain by proposing a hybrid planning framework that combines semantic priors from a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with embodied robot interaction data through a Gaussian process (GP) residual model. The GP corrects the VLM-derived movability prior to produce embodiment-grounded probabilistic movability estimates, which are then incorporated into hierarchical uncertainty-aware planning. The proposed approach allows humanoids to jointly leverage locomotion and manipulation for efficient and safe navigation, representing the first solution to NAMO in rough terrain through predictive movability reasoning and probabilistic VLM integration.

</details>


### [382] [Brain-Aligned Latent Actions: Imposing Premotor Cortex Geometry on a Robot's Action Vocabulary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11674)
*Amit Jadhav*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 离散潜动作 tokenizer 的码字分配极不稳定，作者利用这一自由度，用猕猴 PMv 皮层的表征几何通过直通相似度损失约束机器人视频 tokenizer，使其在未见过形状类别上表征相似度达 0.52。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略越来越多地依赖从无标签视频中学到的离散潜动作，但"哪段运动对应哪个码"在训练中是自由且高度不稳定的（不同随机种子 ARI 仅 0.001，bf16 与 fp32 推理间 74% token 被重分配）。作者试图利用这一分配自由度，注入生物先验。

Method: 在 Moto 潜运动 tokenizer 上，于重建目标之外并联一个直通（straight-through）相似度损失，把猕猴腹侧前运动皮层（PMv）在画形状任务中的神经表征几何施加到码字分配上；每一目标仅训练一次，并在未参与损失的五个形状类别上评测 RSA；对照包括官方发布 tokenizer、无先验 tokenizer、随机运动学编码器、语言/运动学/随机目标、标签打乱的 PMv 对照，以及人工挑选的运动学描述子（笔画初始方向）。下游操纵测试在可复现 Moto 结果的 CALVIN 流水线上预先注册。

Result: PMv 训练 tokenizer 与 PMv 表征相似度 0.52，基线 0.20–0.26，随机运动学编码器 95 分位为 0.42；语言、运动学、随机目标不迁移（−0.17 至 −0.03）。但两个负面结果削弱结论：笔画初始方向这一手工运动学描述子达 0.65，高于 PMv 目标；标签打乱 PMv 对照为 0.41。

Conclusion: 潜动作 tokenizer 的码字分配是可塑的，可被外部表征几何（含神经数据）引导，且能泛化到未训练类别；但目前优势幅度有限、被简单手工描述子和打乱对照部分解释，真正的验证需依赖作者预先注册的下游操纵实验。

Abstract: Robot policies increasingly act through a small vocabulary of discrete latent actions learned from unlabeled video, yet training leaves open which motion receives which code. We find this choice highly unstable: two independently trained runs of Moto's latent motion tokenizer assign the same robot clips to nearly unrelated codes (adjusted Rand index 0.001), and evaluating one tokenizer in bf16 instead of fp32 reassigns 74% of its tokens. We use this freedom to impose the representational geometry of macaque ventral premotor cortex (PMv), recorded while a monkey drew shapes, on the tokenizer's code assignment, with a straight-through similarity loss trained alongside its reconstruction objective on robot video. In one training run per target, on five shape categories the loss never saw, the PMv-trained tokenizer reaches a representational similarity of 0.52 with PMv, against 0.20-0.26 for released and no-prior tokenizers and 0.42 for the 95th percentile of random kinematic encoders. Kinematic, language, and random targets do not transfer (-0.17 to -0.03). Two results limit the claim: a hand-picked kinematic descriptor, the stroke's initial direction, matches PMv better (0.65), and a label-shuffled PMv control scores 0.41. We specify the downstream manipulation test, on a CALVIN pipeline that reproduces Moto's published results, before running it.

</details>


### [383] [Streaming Failure Forecasting: VLA Failure Monitors That Keep Learning After Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11688)
*Amit Jadhav,Shaurya Beriwala,David Q. Liu,Yanfei Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Streaming Failure Forecasting（SFF）：冻结离线失败的监测器网络主干，仅用每条 episode 的成功/失败标签在线重拟合最后一层线性读出，实现部署后持续自适应的 VLA 失败监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 策略的失败监测器离线训练后即被冻结；部署后光照、物体、相机漂移，策略本身也会更新或迁移任务，导致旧任务上训练的冻结监测器在新任务/新版本上排序失败的能力接近随机。

Method: 保持离线监测器的网络固定，每条 episode 结束后仅用其提供的二元成功标签重拟合最后一层线性层（Jetson CPU 单核 2.18 ms/次策略调用）；告警阈值仅在成功 episode 后移动，以控制误报。

Result: 在 5 个未预告漂移的仿真测试套件中，锁定全部超参后 SFF 在 4 个套件上优于冻结监测器，且在所有套件上优于"检测到漂移就重置"；在真实 SO-101 机械臂上 4 种 VLA 共 434 条记录轨迹、跨任务/策略版本切换的重放中，对所有 VLA 均优于冻结监测器，探索性对比中也优于在真实切换点整体重置。

Conclusion: 部署中的失败监测器无需保持冻结：用结果标签低成本重拟合其读出层即可在任务/策略变化后维持失败排序能力，代价极低。

Abstract: Failure monitors for vision-language-action (VLA) policies are trained offline and then frozen. After deployment, lighting, objects and cameras drift, and the policy itself is updated or moved to new tasks. On recorded real-robot runs, after a switch of task or policy version, a frozen monitor fit on the old task ranks failures little better than chance. We present Streaming Failure Forecasting (SFF), a monitor that keeps learning from the one label every episode provides: whether it succeeded. SFF keeps the offline monitor's network fixed and refits only its last linear layer after each episode, at 2.18 ms per policy call on a Jetson CPU core. Its alarm threshold moves only after successes, which in simulation kept false alarms near target except when two drifts came at once. With every setting locked before testing, SFF ranks failures better than the same monitor kept frozen on 4 of 5 simulated test suites under unannounced drift, and above resetting on detected drift on every suite. Carried with its locked learner settings to 434 recorded runs of four VLAs on real SO-101 arms, replayed across unannounced switches of task or policy version, it ranks failures better than the frozen monitor for every VLA and, in an exploratory comparison, above a full reset at the true switch. A deployed failure monitor need not stay frozen: refitting its readout from outcomes is cheap and helps after the changes we tested.

</details>


### [384] [A Physical Testbed for Self-Driving Laboratories: Comparing Bayesian and Agentic Optimization in a Minimal Closed-Loop Color Formulation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11690)
*Tony Qin,Ziheng Wu,Maximilian Schommer,Roya Amini-Naieni,Aldair Gongora*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 搭建集成商用实验室仪器与AI决策的闭环自驱动实验室（SDL）物理测试台，连续无人值守运行24小时，在染料配比吸收光谱匹配任务上比较贝叶斯优化与LLM智能体优化，智能体迭代次数最多减少52%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SDL缺乏将商用硬件与AI整合为可运行闭环工作流的物理测试台，且与商业实验室自动化的集成度较低；同时需要一个参考平台来在实际部署前评估各类AI优化策略（含LLM驱动的智能体方法）。

Method: 整合商用现有实验室自动化仪器构建物理测试台；在固定总体积约束下自主配制水溶液染料混合体系以匹配目标吸收光谱；完成6次独立实验活动，每次48轮闭环迭代（约4小时），由AI算法在无人工干预下决定下一组配方；对比传统贝叶斯优化（BO）与智能体式（agentic）优化器。

Result: 累计24小时无人值守闭环运行成功；智能体优化器在匹配目标光谱时迭代次数少于BO，最高减少52%，并在BO在48轮内未能匹配的某一目标上收敛出解。

Conclusion: 提供了一个可复用的SDL参考物理平台，能在昂贵、耗时的真实实验部署前评估已有与新兴AI策略（包括LLM导向优化），验证了智能体式决策在闭环实验发现中的效率优势。

Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) integrate laboratory robotics and automation with AI-driven decision-making to close the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) cycle. However, physical testbeds that combine off-the-shelf hardware and AI into a functioning closed-loop workflow remain in early stages of development, and their integration with commercial laboratory automation is comparatively less developed. In this work, we develop a physical testbed that assembles and integrates commercially available laboratory automation instruments and demonstrate continuous, closed-loop, autonomous operation over 24 cumulative hours of unattended experimentation. We validate this platform on a minimal closed-loop discovery task in which the system autonomously formulates aqueous dye mixtures to match a target absorbance spectrum. The system completed six independent campaigns, each consisting of 48 closed-loop iterations over approximately four hours. In every campaign, the system autonomously selected, dispensed, and measured each mixture, with an AI-driven decision-making algorithm determining subsequent formulations without human intervention. Using this testbed, we compared the performance of two AI-driven decision-making algorithms, traditional Bayesian optimization (BO) and an agentic approach, in selecting mixtures under a fixed total-volume constraint. The agentic optimizer matched target absorbance spectra using fewer iterations than BO, with reductions up to 52%, and converged on a solution for one target that BO failed to match within 48 iterations. These results demonstrate a reference physical platform for SDLs that can evaluate both established and emerging AI strategies, including large language model (LLM)-directed optimization, before their deployment in real-world applications where experiments may be costly and time-consuming to prepare.

</details>


### [385] [Compute Regeneration through Re-Productization: Reorganizing Retired Edge AI Silicon into a Delivered Multilingual Service Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11698)
*Hongyu Luo,Sun Tie,John Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 以退役32GB Jetson AGX Xavier为核心的GEdgeBot多语言服务机器人「计算再生/再产品化」案例：重建隔离推理栈，测量AI负载与实时控制边界，发现主机-MCU队列不匹配等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘硬件失去产品支持但仍具可观算力，作者将其视为系统设计问题——保留计算模块、重构周边产品组织（re-productization），以论证「计算再生」的可行性与架构假设。

Method: 单案例系统构建与审计：Xavier承载AI与编排（YOLO/Whisper-small/NLLB-200常驻），STM32F407负责有限脉冲生成；以6,000个实测50ms帧间隔对比两种执行组织方式，辅以六模式状态机审计、就绪屏障与声源定向检查、六项静态审计（暴露主机-MCU队列不匹配）与14场景replay（零物理设备打开、54帧契约校验）。

Result: 历史测量：GPU占用1,782MB；并发AI负载下直控p99偏差由0.24ms升至49.93ms（约208倍）；六次触发-跟随演示平均4.35s延迟，对话语音不可用。11月campaign恢复隔离推理栈并复测；有限脉冲边界消除脉冲串上的主机抖动但不消除指令起始相位，停止界限由主机强制，MCU 16位脉宽字段未做钳位。

Conclusion: 结果仅支持存在性主张与可复现的架构假设，不构成机队级可靠性证据；208倍直控比值未被复现，MCU波形捕获与现场故障注入仍待完成。

Abstract: Useful edge hardware can lose product support while retaining substantial computation. We treat this as systems design: compute regeneration here means re-productization, retaining the compute module while redesigning the surrounding product organization. Our case is GEdgeBot, a multilingual service robot built around a retired 32 GB Jetson AGX Xavier. A source-grounded inventory shows the box alone supplies inference, while the combined system exposes five on-device AI services, a seven-language speech chain, three sensing domains, and one deterministic seven-byte control boundary. AI and orchestration stay on the Xavier; finite motor-pulse generation on an STM32F407. Audits cover the six-mode control state machine, readiness barriers and sound orientation. Historical single-prototype measurements report 1,782 MB GPU memory with YOLO, Whisper-small, and NLLB-200 resident, a direct-control p99 deviation rising from 0.24 to 49.93 ms under concurrent AI load, and six of six trigger-to-follow demonstrations at 4.35 s mean latency, with conversational voice unavailable. A November campaign restores an isolated inference stack, re-measures AI workloads, and repeats control-frame runs. Driving two execution organisations with the same 6,000 measured 50 ms frame intervals shows the finite-pulse boundary removes host jitter from the pulse train but not the command start phase; its stopping bound is host-enforced, while the MCU 16-bit pulse field is unclamped. A six-check static audit exposes a host--MCU queue mismatch, and a 14-scenario replay executes the audited main() dispatcher across six modes with zero physical device opens and 54 contract-checked frames. Results support an existence claim and a reproducible architectural hypothesis, not fleet-level reliability. The 208 direct-control ratio remains unreplicated; MCU waveform capture and on-site fault injection remain open.

</details>


### [386] [Data-Driven Precision Control of Soft Helicoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11709)
*Roshan S. Kaundinya,Mark Leone,Roberto Sabella,Hugo Buurmeijer,Luis Pabon,John Irvin Alora,Marco Pavone,George Haller*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 从软体机器人硬件数据中学习5维绝热谱子流形（aSSM）约化的非线性ODE模型，并用于模型预测控制实现高精度轨迹跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前aSSM纯数据驱动方法仅在软体机器人仿真器中验证，本文旨在将该方法推广到真实软体硬件平台，检验其在真实数据下建模与控制的有效性。

Method: 基于绝热谱子流形理论，用硬件采集数据学习5维aSSM约化非线性ODE描述软螺旋躯干机器人动力学；再将该ODE嵌入模型预测控制（MPC），完成带静态与动态约束的2D/3D闭环轨迹跟踪。

Result: 在所有闭环轨迹跟踪任务中，相比现有数据驱动线性方法及无模型强化学习，该方法在精度与准确度上均有提升。

Conclusion: aSSM约化建模仅依赖硬件数据即可在真实软体机器人上实现实时高精度MPC，方法可推广到更广泛的软体机器人系统。

Abstract: A purely data-driven method grounded in the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) was recently used to model and control nonlinear soft robotic simulators. Here, we extend the methodology to learn aSSM-reduced models from data collected from hardware soft robotic platforms. Specifically, we learn a five dimensional (5D) aSSM-reduced nonlinear ordinary differential equation (ODE) that accurately models the dynamics of a soft-helicoid trunk robot. We then use this ODE in a model predictive control scheme to demonstrate real-time precision control across various challenging closed-loop trajectory-tracking tasks, ranging from 2D to 3D trajectories with static and dynamic constraints. We find that our methodology enhances accuracy and precision across all control tasks compared to available data-driven linear methods and model-free reinforcement learning. While we focus here on a soft-helicoid trunk robot, our methodology relies solely on hardware data and is therefore applicable to a broader class of soft robotic systems.

</details>


### [387] [Accelerated Reinforcement Learning for Soft Robotics: Hours Instead of Years](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11718)
*Roshan S. Kaundinya,Hehui Zheng,Robert K. Katzschmann,George Haller*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Learned adiabatic spectral submanifold (aSSM) reduced 6-DOF polynomial ODE model of a pneumatic soft arm serves as RL training environment; policy trained in 3 h, deployed zero-shot, 40% lower tracking error than RNN/transformer baselines, with model identified in 5 min using 6,924 parameters.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Soft robotic hardware dynamics are nonlinear and high-dimensional; RL requires abundant interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain on real soft hardware. Time-scale separation in soft dynamics suggests low-dimensional invariant manifolds can be exploited to build cheap, faithful surrogates for policy training.

Method: Use adiabatic spectral submanifold reduction: learn a low-dimensional aSSM and its polynomial ODE dynamics purely from pre-collected trajectory data (small parameter count, closed-form/invariant-manifold justification). A 6-DOF polynomial ODE is used as the RL environment; a trajectory-tracking policy is trained on it and deployed directly on a pneumatically actuated soft arm without fine-tuning, compared against RNN (4.8M params) and transformer (1.7M params) dynamics baselines.

Result: Policy trained in ~3 h on the aSSM model (equivalent to ~3 years of hardware interaction); zero-shot deployment yields 40% lower tracking error than identical policies trained on RNN or transformer surrogates; aSSM model identification takes 5 min with 6,924 parameters versus 13 h (RNN) and 100 h (transformer).

Conclusion: Mathematically grounded low-dimensional invariant-manifold reduction offers a dramatically cheaper and more accurate training environment for RL on soft robots than large black-box sequence models, with real-hardware zero-shot transfer.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) requires large amounts of interaction data or a reliable simulator, both hard to obtain for nonlinear soft robotic hardware. Recent work shows that a time-scale separation inherent to soft robot dynamics justifies their reduction to low-dimensional invariant manifolds, known as adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs). We demonstrate that an aSSM-reduced model, a simple polynomial ordinary differential equation learned purely from pre-collected data, can serve as an RL training environment. On a pneumatically actuated soft arm, we train a trajectory-tracking policy in 3 hours on a six-dimensional aSSM-reduced model and deploy it without fine-tuning, whereas reproducing this policy training extrapolates to 3 years of hardware interaction. Our policy tracks dynamic targets with 40% lower error than otherwise identical policies trained on a 4.8-million-parameter recurrent neural network (RNN) or a 1.7-million-parameter transformer, which take 13 and 100 hours to identify, against 5 minutes for our mathematically justified 6,924-parameter model.

</details>


### [388] [Particle Filtering with Generative Trajectory Models for State Estimation and Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11732)
*Lukas Lao Beyer,Samvit Das,Sertac Karaman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用预训练扩散模型（不改参数）配合粒子滤波，同时维护多组状态历史假设，以预测观测与实测的匹配度重加权粒子，并将该权重用于引导动作选择，在部分可观测导航与视觉操作任务中同时提升状态估计与任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合建模状态、动作与观测的生成模型既能当策略直接采样动作，也能预测机器人状态与环境演化。作者希望在不修改预训练模型的前提下，通过改变推理过程（而非重新训练）来利用这些预测提升状态估计与控制。

Method: 以单个预训练扩散模型为生成器，在粒子滤波框架中采样多条状态历史假设及其预测观测和动作提议；新测量到来后按预测观测与实测的一致性对粒子重加权；不同于传统仅用于状态估计的做法，额外将权重用于动作选择，偏向能更好解释观测的假设所对应的动作提议。

Result: 在部分可观测导航与基于视觉的抓取操作仿真实验中，与不滤波的直接动作生成相比，状态估计精度与任务成功率均提升，且使用同一预训练模型、无额外测试时信息。

Conclusion: 联合生成式模型可通过纯推理层的粒子滤波后验加权，把预测能力转化为更好的状态估计与动作选择，是一种免训练、可复用的测试时增强手段；局限在于仅在仿真中验证，未涉及实机部署与计算开销分析。

Abstract: Generative models can support both state estimation and control in robotics. For control, a common approach is to use the model as a policy that directly samples actions conditioned on observation histories. However, models that jointly represent states, actions, and observations can also predict how the robot state and its environment evolve. We investigate whether these predictions can improve state estimation and control through a change in inference procedure, without modifying the pretrained model. To this end, we use particle filtering to maintain competing hypotheses about state histories. A single pretrained diffusion model generates these hypotheses along with their predicted observations and associated action proposals. As new measurements arrive, particles are reweighted according to how well their predicted observations match the measurements. While particle filtering conventionally uses these weights only for state estimation, we also use them to guide action selection, favoring proposals associated with hypotheses that better explain the observations. Simulation experiments in partially observed navigation and vision-based manipulation demonstrate improvements in both state estimation and task performance compared to action generation without filtering, using the same pretrained model and no additional test-time information.

</details>


### [389] [Graph-Sparse Distributed Predictive Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning vianEdge-Consensus ADMM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11755)
*Josep Borras-Borras,Pablo Segovia,Carlos Ocampo-Martinez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出分布式MPC架构，用预测冲突图+ADMM边共识分解QP，并以集中式HOCBF-QP做安全监督，实现平面双积分器机器人的无碰撞运动规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式多机器人MPC的碰撞约束随机器人数量平方增长且需全局协调，计算与通信开销难以扩展；需要一种保持安全性的可扩展分布式方案。

Method: 时变预测冲突图筛选有效成对交互以降低协调需求；每步MPC更新用warm-start轨迹将非凸避碰约束一次性凸化为固定QP；用ADMM的边共识（edge-consensus）形式分解该QP，使各机器人并行求解并在分离半空间上做闭式投影；当分布式解不满足直接执行条件时，由集中式HOCBF-QP选择性监督接管。

Result: 在8/16/32机器人的C++仿真中实现无碰撞执行，计算可扩展性显著提升，任务级性能与集中式全连接图基线相当。

Conclusion: 稀疏冲突图+单次凸化+边共识ADMM分解，加上按需HOCBF监督，可在多机器人避碰规划中兼顾可扩展性与安全性；但仅在平面双积分器仿真中验证，缺乏真实平台与更复杂动力学验证。

Abstract: This paper presents a distributed model predictive control (MPC) architecture for collision-avoiding motion planning of planar robots with double-integrator dynamics. To reduce coordination demands, a time-varying predicted conflict graph selects relevant pairwise interactions. The associated collision-avoidance constraints are convexified once per MPC update using warm-start trajectories, yielding a fixed convex quadratic program (QP). The resulting QP is then decomposed using an edge-consensus formulation of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), enabling parallel robot-local optimization and independent closed-form projections onto separating half-spaces. Execution is selectively supervised by a centralized high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) QP when the distributed candidate does not satisfy the direct-execution conditions. Evaluated in C++ simulations involving 8, 16, and 32 robots, the proposed architecture achieves collision-free execution and substantially improves computational scalability while maintaining task-level performance comparable to a centralized complete-graph baseline.

</details>


### [390] [Planners Exploit Deterministic Error: Dithered Low-Bit World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11780)
*Yong Hwi Song,Keon Myung Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 低比特世界模型在MPPI/CEM规划中可能崩溃，原因不是舍入误差大小，而是误差是否跨规划迭代持续且被所有候选共享；用每次迭代重抽样的共享dither（随机化舍入）可在同比特宽度下消除大部分损伤，且几乎无额外延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于采样的规划器（MPPI、CEM、TD-MPC2）每步要查询世界模型上千次，低比特量化是降低机器人上模型基控制成本的直接手段；但实践者发现低比特世界模型潜在一阶预测误差看似不变，规划成功率却可能掉100个点，需要解释并修复这一"误差指标—控制性能"解耦现象。

Method: 对比舍入到最近（RTN）与随机舍入（stochastic rounding/shared dither）两种激活量化方案；通过固定同一step或同一episode内的dither、以及按候选共享并每迭代重抽dither等受控干预，分离"误差幅度"与"误差的持续性/共享性"；在TD-MPC2（Meta-World 19个受影响cell、317M多任务模型）、DINO-WM上验证；并测试block-scaled NVFP4与MXFP4；以CUDA graph在Ampere GPU上测量W8A4的实际延迟。

Result: RTN激活量化且无校准可使规划成功率下降多达100点，而潜在一阶预测误差不高于规划良好的随机舍入方案；候选共享、每迭代重抽的dither在全部19个受影响Meta-World cell中挽回至少一半损伤（中位数95%），DINO-WM 5个cell中4个有效，317M多任务TD-MPC2全部8个受影响任务有效；W8A4整数TD-MPC2的规划rollout快1.9–3.3×、整步规划快1.3–1.5×（仍不及预转换权重的BF16），共享dither仅增加≤2.3%延迟；NVFP4可消除大部分损伤、MXFP4仅部分，说明粗网格+共享scale是根源。假设、阈值与分析代码均先于数据固定，并报告了失败的假设。

Conclusion: 低比特世界模型的规划失败由"误差被规划器反复利用"机制决定：持久且候选共享的量化偏差会被迭代优化器放大成系统性偏向；通过无训练的共享随机dither即可在相同比特宽度下大幅恢复性能，且开销可忽略。该结论具有可操作的工程指导意义（低比特WAM/模型基控制的量化设计），但实验限于仿真基准，未含真实机器人部署或真机增益。

Abstract: Sampling-based planners such as MPPI and CEM query a learned world model thousands of times per control step, so low-bit world models are an obvious way to make model-based control cheaper on a robot. With round-to-nearest activation quantization and no calibration, we find that planning can collapse, by up to 100 points of success, while the world model's latent one-step prediction error stays no larger than that of a stochastic rounding scheme that plans well. At the same bit width, what decides the outcome is not the size of the rounding error but whether it persists across planner iterations and is shared across candidates. Round-to-nearest leaves an error that persists, and an iterating planner drifts toward the candidates that this error favors; in TD-MPC2, holding the same dither fixed within a step or an episode brings the drift back. Dither shared by all candidates and redrawn at every iteration removes most of the damage at the same bit width and without training: at least half of it in all 19 affected Meta-World cells (task $\times$ bit width) of TD-MPC2 (median 95%), in 4 of 5 DINO-WM cells, and in all 8 affected tasks of a 317M-parameter multi-task TD-MPC2. Captured as CUDA graphs on an Ampere GPU, a W8A4 integer TD-MPC2 world model runs its planning rollouts 1.9-3.3$\times$ and the whole planning step 1.3-1.5$\times$ faster than FP32, though not faster than BF16 with pre-converted weights; shared dither adds at most 2.3% latency. In TD-MPC2, block-scaled NVFP4 removes most of the damage and MXFP4 part of it, which ties the failure to coarse grids with a shared scale. Hypotheses, thresholds and analysis code were fixed before the data that test them, and the hypotheses that failed are reported.

</details>


### [391] [HolidayFactory 1.0: Simulating, Generating, and Evaluating Industrial Robot Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11789)
*Holiday Robotics,Jeongmin Lee,Taehyeon Kim,Dohyun Jang,Minji Lee,Seonghun Oh,Dongwoo Park,Geonhyup Lee,Jaehyung Kim,Jaemin Yoon,Jinseop Bok,Jungwoo Kim,Minseok Yang,Philsik Chang,Soomin Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0工业机器人工作仿真/生成/评估框架：含扩展水弹性接触与半隐式primal-dual求解器、有状态执行器动力学的HOLIDAY-SIM，智能体驱动的世界构建，以及不重置场景的7任务24/7-BENCH。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人评估多以episode重置为起点，而工业工作是多工序连续、结果影响后续操作的长时任务；大规模评估需任务关键物理交互仿真、工业场景构建与持久场景状态下的度量。

Method: HOLIDAY-SIM：在Newton的SDF水弹性接触基础上增加本构律与半隐式primal-dual求解器，将状态化执行器动力学耦合到关节运动，并从仿真状态导出触觉与关节观测；智能体化世界构建：用几何与交互检查生成仿真就绪资产与场景变体，提出任务条件化评估供人工确认与可执行检查；24/7-BENCH：7个工业任务，不重置场景地度量完成/失败/未完成任务数、吞吐、时延与电机能耗。

Result: 受控实验刻画了接触、执行器与触觉模型，并验证验证引导的世界构建有效性；场景与评估生成实验暴露模型critic的局限及生成评估忠实捕获任务需求的困难；仅用脚本轨迹（code-as-policy）做任务级评估，尚未在持久运行中比较策略。

Conclusion: 该工作把工业机器人评估从重置式episode推进到持久场景的任务级评估，并开源框架式地整合仿真、场景生成与基准，但尚未包含持久运行下的策略对比。

Abstract: Robots are typically evaluated in episodes that begin from a reset, while industrial work consists of repeated jobs whose outcomes affect subsequent operations. Evaluating such work at scale requires simulation of task-critical physical interactions, construction of industrial environments, and measurements of performance as scene state persists. We present HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0, a framework for simulating, generating, and evaluating industrial robot work. Given a human-specified workplace and task, the framework defines a world pairing a scenario of scene variants and process logic with an evaluation defining a job, metrics, and a rubric. HOLIDAYFACTORY 1.0 comprises three components. HOLIDAY-SIM extends Newton's SDF-based hydroelastic contact with additional constitutive laws and a semi-implicit primal-dual solver, couples stateful actuator dynamics to articulated motion, and derives tactile and joint observations from simulated states. Agentic world construction generates simulation-ready assets and scene variants using geometric and interaction checks, and proposes task-conditioned evaluations for human confirmation and executable checks. 24/7-BENCH introduces seven industrial tasks in which jobs are evaluated without resetting the scene, measuring completed, failed, and unfinished jobs, throughput, latency, and motor energy. Controlled studies characterize the proposed contact, actuator, and tactile models and examine the effectiveness of verification-guided world construction. Experiments on scene and evaluation generation further reveal the limitations of model critics and the difficulty of ensuring that generated evaluations faithfully capture task requirements. We examine job-level evaluations with scripted trajectories (e.g., code-as-policy) but have not yet compared policies over persistent runs.

</details>


### [392] [PAIR: Proprioception-Aligned Image-Ray Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11798)
*Sung-Wook Lee,Xuhui Kang,Dylan Losey,Yen-Ling Kuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PAIR：用机器人本体感知对齐图像-射线联合表示的对比学习框架，缓解视点变化下的视觉歧义，提升操作策略的视点泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习中的视点鲁棒性仍是瓶颈：图像在视点变化下信号歧义（相似场景外观差异大、不同状态视觉重叠），策略需同时推断任务相关状态与其投影方式。既有做法各有缺陷——仅将相机信息作为附加上下文并不能让视觉表示真正落地到任务的视觉投影方式；而无相机上下文的几何对齐会忽略视点相关投影，引入伪对应。

Method: 提出PAIR对比学习框架，将图像表示与相机射线表示联合对齐，并以机器人本体感知（proprioception）作为监督信号：使机器人状态相近的观测在表示空间中跨视点保持接近，从而形成结构化的接地信号。框架通用，可训练Diffusion Policy，也可对VLA模型做后训练。

Result: 在带相机变化的仿真与真实世界操作基准上，PAIR较无射线条件的行为克隆基线分别提升12.7和26.7个百分点，对未见视点泛化更强。

Conclusion: 以本体感知桥接图像与射线几何的对比预训练，是获得视点鲁棒视觉运动策略的有效且可插拔的途径；但对比目标对相机位姿外推与强遮挡场景的适用性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: While imitation learning has made substantial progress toward generalizable robot manipulation through scaling, viewpoint robustness remains a major bottleneck. Visuomotor policies rely heavily on visual inputs, yet images provide an inherently ambiguous signal under viewpoint change: similar scenes may appear markedly different across viewpoints, while distinct states may share certain visual overlaps. A policy must therefore infer not only the task-relevant state, but also how it is visually projected under a particular camera configuration. This entanglement of viewpoint-dependent appearance and task-relevant state can make learning inefficient and limit generalization to unseen viewpoints. Recent work has begun to address this challenge through camera-ray conditioning and representation learning using geometric cues to induce invariance. However, providing camera information as additional context does not by itself ground visual representations in how the task scene is visually projected, while geometric alignment without camera context can introduce spurious correspondences by ignoring viewpoint-dependent projection. We propose PAIR, a contrastive learning framework that aligns joint image-ray representations using robot proprioception. PAIR encourages observations with similar robot states to remain close in representation space across viewpoints, providing a structured grounding signal for learning viewpoint-robust features. PAIR is a highly adaptable framework: it can be used to train Diffusion Policy (DP) or post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. In simulated and real-world manipulation benchmarks with camera variation, PAIR consistently outperforms the behavior cloning baseline without ray conditioning by 12.7% and 26.7% points, respectively, demonstrating stronger generalization to unseen viewpoints. Project website: this http URL .

</details>


### [393] [Budget-aware Correspondence-driven View Selection for Real-time 3D Perception of Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11809)
*Vaishnav Ramesh,Jacob Carter,Shivali J. Patel,Sanjeev J. Koppal,Md Jahidul Islam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BCVS is a pose-free, correspondence-driven, budget-aware view selection algorithm (~22+ FPS on CPU) that filters redundant image sequences online for efficient 3D perception, reducing redundancy up to 16% while preserving SfM registration and reconstruction quality.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Real-world robot and ITS deployments generate long, redundant image sequences that burden downstream 3D perception; existing view selection relies on full SfM or pose estimation, which is too costly for online mobile-robot filtering.

Method: Pure correspondence-based scoring that favors view novelty while enforcing sufficient overlap for geometric stability; iterative greedy selection of most distinct frames with near-duplicate suppression under a user-specified budget, no pose or SfM required, CPU-only.

Result: Outperforms CPU-friendly baselines at tight budgets and stays competitive as budgets scale; field trials on large aerial and marine robotics datasets show up to 16% redundancy reduction with robust SfM registration and high-quality 3D reconstructions.

Conclusion: A lightweight, pose-free front-end view selector that makes online 3D perception pipelines practical on mobile platforms; useful tooling for SfM/reconstruction rather than a new reconstruction method itself.

Abstract: 3D visual perception and scene reconstruction are critical for autonomous robots and intelligent transportation, yet real-world deployments often generate long, redundant image sequences that hinder downstream processing. This report investigates BCVS (budget-aware correspondence-driven view sampling), a pose-free view selection algorithm that offers 22+ FPS on a CPU, enabling online filtering for efficient 3D perception by mobile robots.
