We further integrate this representation directly into a Diffusion Policy and evaluate it on three real-robot manipulation tasks. Across 90 physical rollouts, PCTac Hue achieves 68 successes (75.6\%), compared with 60 (66.7\%) for PCTac RGB, 57 (63.3\%) for Wedge RGB, and 29 (32.2\%) for vision-only. PCTac Hue also achieves the highest observed success rate on each evaluated task, including Perturbed Test-Tube Insertion, where it achieves 16/30 successes versus 13/30 for tactile RGB baselines and 1/30 for vision-only. These results demonstrate the potential of mechanochromic structural color as a compact, load-sensitive tactile representation for robot learning and closed-loop manipulation. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [428] [Bridging Task Planning and Execution for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12409)
*Emanuele Cuzzocrea,Giuseppina Iannotti,Luca Rossini,Arturo Laurenzi,Nikos Tsagarakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出零样本视觉-语言框架，将执行可行性推理嵌入双臂人形机器人操作的任务规划，用结构化场景表示+分层校验器实现局部恢复与定向重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实家庭与物流场景中杂乱环境要求同时推理任务目标与执行可行性；双臂人形平台还引入协同与运动学约束，现有非执行感知基线难以应对。

Method: 结构化场景表示融合语义物体关系与执行约束；将兼容动作组织为带显式前/后条件的并行双臂阶段；分层校验器在感知不确定性下评估条件，并利用阶段级执行历史触发局部恢复或定向重规划。

Result: 在CENTAURO轮腿混合人形机器人上，9个语言条件操作场景成功率高于非执行感知基线；在专门构造的失败场景中，分层校验以更少的模型查询次数从执行失败中恢复。

Conclusion: 将执行推理直接纳入任务规划能提升双臂杂乱环境操作的成功率与失败恢复效率，校验与重规划的结合是可行路径。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly expected to execute natural-language manipulation tasks in real-world environments. This is particularly relevant in household assistance and logistics, where clutter requires reasoning about both task objectives and execution feasibility. This challenge becomes even more pronounced for bimanual humanoid platforms, where coordinating two manipulators introduces additional interaction and kinematic constraints. We present a zero-shot vision-language framework for execution-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about task objectives and physical feasibility. Planning is grounded in a structured scene representation that combines semantic object relations with execution constraints, enabling the selection of obstacle relocations and execution choices while preserving task semantics. Compatible actions are organised into parallel bimanual stages with explicit pre- and post-conditions. A hierarchical validator evaluates these conditions under perceptual uncertainty and uses stage-level execution history to support local recovery or targeted replanning. Experiments on the CENTAURO hybrid wheeled-legged humanoid robot across nine language-conditioned manipulation scenarios show higher task success than a non-execution-aware baseline. In dedicated failure scenarios, hierarchical validation recovers from execution failures with fewer model queries than always replanning. These results demonstrate the benefits of combining execution reasoning directly into task planning. Videos and additional material are available on the Project Webpage: this https URL .

</details>


### [429] [V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12452)
*Maolin Ye,Dongqing Zhao,Linyang Li,Shuai Xue,Yuan Liu,Yiyuan Wang,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: V3DSAM 结合 VGGT-SLAM 2.0 的前馈几何与 SAM3 的开放词汇语义，通过语义-几何双尺度回环验证与几何锚定的持久实例建图，提升长序列稠密 SLAM 的跨视角关联可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列前馈式稠密 SLAM 中跨视角关联不可靠，现有系统依赖骨干内部特征与时序 ID 传播，易产生错误回环和实例身份漂移。

Method: 前馈几何估计（VGGT-SLAM 2.0）+ 开放词汇语义观测（SAM3）双模态融合；语义-几何双尺度回环验证：像素级双向重投影 + 物体级 3D 空间对应，无需访问骨干内部特征；几何锚定的持久实例建图：在优化后的全局坐标系中用类别约束的 3D 连通性定义物理实例，直接分配全局 ID，无需跨帧身份传播。

Result: TUM RGB-D 上拒绝全部 4 个错误回环候选；ScanNet 长序列实验显示实例身份一致性提升。

Conclusion: V3DSAM 降低了对骨干内部特征与时序 ID 传播的依赖，实现了更鲁棒的长期跨视角关联；但实验规模与消融有限，缺真实机器人部署与公开代码信息。

Abstract: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.

</details>


### [430] [Galilean Robots, Aristotelian Sensors: Joint Spatiotemporal Trajectory Estimation and Extrinsic Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12526)
*Abhishek Goudar,Jonathan Kelly,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出用特殊伽利略群（Galilean群）表示机器人轨迹、亚里士多德子群表示传感器外参，实现轨迹估计与时空标定的联合求解，把运动与时间偏移的耦合内生到群结构中，无需单独参数化连续时间轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将外参视为刚体变换加标量时间偏移，空间与时间参数通过不同机制进入估计问题：空间变换可与位姿直接复合，而时间偏移需通过运动补偿、插值或连续时间轨迹在偏移时刻求值，导致参数化复杂、耦合不自然。

Method: 以特殊伽利略群建模机器人轨迹、以其亚里士多德子群建模传感器外参，使时间偏移通过群结构直接与运动耦合；设计了基于twist和IMU的运动先验，兼容理想与非理想时钟，并在相机、位置、测距测量上完成联合估计。

Result: 仿真与真实实验中，在多种异构传感器配置下的标定与轨迹估计精度与现有成熟方法相当，同时框架显著简化。

Conclusion: 该群论表述在不牺牲精度的前提下简化了时空标定流程，作为对现有方法的"体验改善"型贡献，实用价值明确但方法新颖度与实验规模属常规水平。

Abstract: Multi-sensor state estimation requires accurate spatial and temporal calibration between heterogeneous sensors. Existing spatiotemporal calibration methods typically represent sensor extrinsic parameters as a rigid-body transformation together with a scalar temporal offset, causing the spatial and temporal parameters to enter the estimation problem through separate mechanisms. While the spatial transformation composes directly with the robot pose, accounting for the temporal offset requires evaluating the trajectory at a shifted time, typically through motion compensation, interpolation, or a continuous-time trajectory representation. In this work, we formulate joint trajectory estimation and spatiotemporal calibration using the special Galilean group for the robot trajectory and the Aristotelian subgroup for sensor extrinsics. This representation incorporates the coupling between motion and temporal offset directly through the group structure, avoiding the need for a separately parameterized continuous-time trajectory. We develop twist- and IMU-driven motion priors, accommodate both ideal and non-ideal clocks, and evaluate the framework with camera, position, and range measurements. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate calibration and trajectory-estimation performance comparable to established methods across heterogeneous sensor configurations. Our simplified framework therefore offers a quality-of-life improvement over existing methods without compromising performance.

</details>


### [431] [Modeling and Estimation of a Towed Marine System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12568)
*Josef Matouš,Simon Hoff,Damiano Varagnolo,Marius S. Rundhovde,Kristin Y. Pettersen,Martin Saska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对由两艘自主水面艇（ASV）、脐带缆、拖曳体与尾拖环形缆组成的拖曳式海洋系统，建立集总质量建模并基于Lyapunov分析验证稳定性，进而提出降阶观测器与完美测量扩展卡尔曼滤波（PMEKF）两种仅依赖ASV船载传感器的状态估计方法，并通过仿真与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拖曳式海洋系统的完整状态（缆绳形状、拖曳体位置姿态等）难以直接测量，且水下部分缺乏传感器；需要仅依靠水面ASV自身可测信息实现可靠的建模与状态估计，以支撑后续控制与作业。

Method: 采用集总质量（lumped-mass）法对缆绳与拖曳体建模，兼顾关键动力学与计算可行性；用Lyapunov方法分析模型的稳定性与收敛性；在此模型基础上设计降阶观测器与前馈/完美测量扩展卡尔曼滤波（PMEKF），仅使用ASV船载传感器测量作为输入。

Result: 通过数值仿真与（水池/海上）实验验证了所提模型与两种状态估计方法的有效性，估计结果与真实状态一致性良好。

Conclusion: 集总质量模型配合降阶观测器或PMEKF，可在无水下传感器条件下有效重构拖曳系统状态，为海洋拖曳系统的观测与控制提供可行方案。

Abstract: This paper addresses the modeling and state estimation of a towed marine system consisting of two autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs), a pair of umbilical cables, towfish, and a trailing loop cable. Inspired by the existing literature, we employ a lumped-mass modeling approach for the cables and towfish, capturing the essential dynamics while maintaining computational tractability. A Lyapunov-based analysis is conducted to verify the stability and convergence properties of the proposed model. Building on this model, we propose two state estimation methods, namely a reduced-order observer and a perfect-measurement extended Kalman filter (PMEKF), using only the measurements from the ASVs' onboard sensors. Numerical simulations and experimental results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [432] [Correctness Boundaries of Typed Plans for Natural-Language Robot Fleet Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12654)
*Artem Tuzov,Dmitrii Vizitei,Evgenii Shlomov,Senya Belykh,Anastasia Malakhova,Alexander Maloletov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文研究自然语言机器人集群控制中，计划验证与执行报告究竟能证明什么，并发现结构上被接受的计划仍可能出现错误编队、遗漏机器人等结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言指令经LLM转成计划后，"通过验证"与"任务完成"常被混为一谈；作者希望区分可执行动作的变更与完成报告所覆盖需求的变更，明确验证与报告的证据边界。

Method: 在ROS 2上实现三层架构（类型化计划、确定性校正、集群协调与结果检查），配合20个仿真机器人；离线44例基准检查计划结构与命令要求，另做五次本地配置（无响应schema）测试及18次仿真系列（含软件变更后两次替换性重跑），并用保存的计划、日志、编队轨迹与到达报告做案例分析。

Result: 无schema下五次配置的响应通过率70.0%–87.3%；所选18次仿真全部满足基于位姿的任务条件；但日志记录了重复取货指派与目标区调整，另有结构被接受却编队形状错误、路径被拒、重规划后到达报告漏报机器人等案例。

Conclusion: 验证通过不等于任务正确：需将有效指派、目标与报告结果回溯对照原始指令；作者据此提出将执行动作层与完成报告需求层分离审查的原则。研究为仿真集群系统的自评估与分析，缺少真实机器人部署与基线对比。

Abstract: We examine what plan validation and execution reports establish in natural-language robot fleet control. Commands are traced through typed plans, deterministic corrections, fleet coordination and outcome checks in a three-level Robot Operating System 2 implementation with twenty simulated robots. An offline benchmark of 44 cases checks plan structure and selected command requirements. Across five local configurations without a response schema, 70.0-87.3% of responses pass. All runs in a selected 18-run simulation series meet their pose-based task conditions. This series includes two successful repeats that replaced incomplete runs after a software change. Saved plans and logs document duplicate pickup assignments and goal adjustments within the original task zones. Separate formation traces show a structurally accepted plan with the wrong formation shape and a rejected route, and an arrival report that omitted a requested robot after replanning. Carry completion records pickup and subsequent drop-off zone presence for the same robot. The cases distinguish changes to executable actions from changes to the requirements covered by a completion report. They motivate checking the effective assignments, goals and reported outcome against the original command.

</details>


### [433] [VLA Adaptation with Real and Simulated Data: A Case Study on Robotic Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12676)
*Matěj Kripner,Milan Straka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在"按名称（如e4/a5）将棋子移动"的精确操作任务上，系统研究π0.5 的微调数据量、训练步数、检查点选择与仿真数据预训练的作用，并报告负结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 作为通用机器人基础模型仍需对每个下游任务与机器人本体微调，但"需要多少数据/多少更新、如何选检查点、仿真能否降低真实数据成本"缺乏实证答案。

Method: SO-101 机械臂将 chess king 在两个坐标格之间移动；用遥操作演示与"随机化脚本专家"仿真演示，在不同数据规模与更新预算下微调 π0.5；对比学习率 cool-down、检查点选择指标（验证损失、动作误差），并在真机上对最多 256 条遥操作演示做微调、每策略 25 次试验评估 10 个策略；另测试 RECAP 式优势条件、自动教练纠正、残差 RL 等自我改进方法。

Result: 仿真中成功率随数据与更新单调提升；短学习率 cool-down 最高带来 +31 个百分点，且是检查点可比的前提；验证损失与动作误差对模型选择不可靠；真机初步结果显示仿真预训练显著有帮助，真实数据稀缺时最明显；自 rollout 训练（滤波 BC、优势条件、纠正、残差 RL）相对纯 BC 无可测提升。

Conclusion: VLA 微调实践中检查点选择与学习率调度被低估，仿真预训练是低成本增益手段，而复杂自改进方案在此设置下收益有限；发布模拟器、专家与真实演示。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $\pi_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.

</details>


### [434] [Library of Hands: Fix the Hands, Not the World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12678)
*Hasaan Ahmad,Qizhen Ying,Yuxuan Sun,Tianjin Huang,Guangming Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LoH：冻结世界模型，仅在线辨识"手"（指令到实际动作的映射），通过双帧图像反解最可能的动作并存入库，实现免训练、免额外传感器的快速适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型+规划的闭环系统对执行器/相机标定变化极敏感（指令旋转90°时成功率从77.5%降到7.8%）；现有方案需重新训练、需数据或存在灾难性遗忘，无法在返回旧配置时复用。

Method: Library of Hands（LoH）：保持世界模型与规划器冻结，把失配归因到"手"（命令→施加动作的映射）。用冻结模型对两次相机观测间的变化进行反演读取（reading），选出最能解释该变化的动作；将每次辨识出的手存入记忆库，旧配置再现时直接检索而非重学。

Result: 闭环测试中三个仿真任务平均成功率由28.6%提升至62.3%，超过两倍；环境不变时仅损失0.6个百分点；无需改动即可迁移至另外两个世界模型，并在三个真实机器人预训练模型中的两个上有效；性能增益随reading质量提升。

Conclusion: 将"自适应"与"世界模型学习"解耦是可行且高效的：免训练地纠正动作接口即可显著恢复规划性能，并具备可缓存、可迁移、可渐进改进的工程优势。

Abstract: A world model predicts how a scene changes after an action, and a planner uses it to search for actions that reach a goal. If the camera moves or the controller changes, the same command moves the robot differently: when its commands are turned by 90 degrees, a frozen planner with the LeWM world model that succeeds in 77.5% of episodes succeeds in only 7.8%. Current fixes retrain the model, need training data, or forget a set-up when it returns. We propose Library of Hands (LoH), a training-free method that keeps the world model frozen and corrects only the map from commands to applied actions, which we call the hand. LoH reads the hand through the frozen model, with no extra sensor: it finds the action that best explains the change between two camera images (a reading). It stores every hand it identifies, so a returning set-up is recognised rather than re-learnt. In closed-loop tests, LoH more than doubles success on three simulated tasks, from 28.6% to 62.3%, and loses only 0.6 percentage points when nothing changes. It also works, unchanged, with two other world models and on two of three models pretrained on real robot data, and its gain grows with the quality of its readings.

</details>


### [435] [Sliding into Balance: Benefits of a Sliding Payload for Load Distribution and Disturbance Rejection in Dual-UAV Transportation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12754)
*Jorge Vicente-Martinez,Francisco José Mañas-Álvarez,Edgar Ramirez-Laboreo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 双无人机吊挂载荷沿单绳滑动的协同运输：建立含粘性摩擦的平面无量纲动力学模型，并证明滑动载荷可均衡两侧绳段张力、扩大可达域与抗扰集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双机吊挂采用两根独立绳索，容易出现某段绳索张力丢失（松弛），限制载荷可达范围与抗扰能力。作者希望用"单绳+可滑动载荷"这一构型改善张力分配与可达性。

Method: 建立载荷在单一绳索上滑动（带粘性摩擦）的平面无量纲动力学模型；在无人机静止假设下，与总绳长相同的固定载荷构型进行对比，分析平衡态、张力分布、可达域与可容许扰动集，并进行含阵风剖面的动态仿真。

Result: 解析结果表明：对任意无人机相对位置，滑动载荷都能使两段绳张力相等，平衡时无绳索失张；载荷可达区域扩大一倍；除"低摩擦+大间距"组合外，可容许扰动集增大；在真实阵风剖面下，双机间平均张力不平衡显著小于固定载荷方案。

Conclusion: 单绳滑动载荷是一种低结构复杂度、可改善多机协同吊挂张力均衡与作业范围的构型，适合作为固定吊挂的替代方案；局限在于仅平面模型、无人机静止假设与摩擦参数敏感性。

Abstract: This paper analyzes the cooperative transportation of a payload suspended from two drones in which, instead of being attached to two independent ropes, the payload is allowed to slide along a single rope connecting both UAVs. First, a planar nondimensional dynamical model of the sliding motion with viscous friction is presented. Then, considering stationary drones, this configuration is compared with a fixed payload with the same total rope length, both at equilibrium and under disturbances. The analytical results show that the sliding payload equalizes the tension in both rope segments for any relative position of the drones, so that no rope loses tension at equilibrium; it doubles the region reachable by the payload and, except for low friction combined with a large drone separation, it enlarges the set of admissible disturbances. Finally, a dynamic simulation also shows that under realistic gusty wind profiles, the average tension imbalance between the drones is reduced with respect to the fixed-payload solution.

</details>


### [436] [Benchmarking Real-World Robotic Manipulation through Stochastic Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12804)
*Elias Gläßer,Gülhan Şikaroğlu,Pavlo Kupyn,Marc Pollefeys,Zuria Bauer,Hermann Blum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"随机挑战"(stochastic challenges)机器人评测范式：基于可复现真实场景（类似YCB），以同一分布的随机任务采样计算成功率，实现跨实验室、跨平台的系统级可比评测，并实现了一个移动操作基准，在两实验室两台机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 操作任务是交互式的，无法用静态观测数据集评估；仿真基准无法覆盖真实世界的全部复杂性，而真实环境实验的可复现性与方法可比性差。需要一个既有真实场景可复现性、又具备隐藏测试集般严谨性与随机性的评测方式。

Method: 构建基于可复现真实场景的随机挑战：从相同任务分布中多次随机采样场景与任务实例，统计成功率作为可比指标；据此实现一个移动操作(mobile manipulation)基准，并在两个实验室的两台不同机器人上执行同一分布采样进行对比。

Result: 在两实验室、两台机器人上完成同一随机挑战基准的实机评测，证明了基于同分布随机采样的成功率可以在不同平台与不同实验室之间进行有意义的横向比较。

Conclusion: 随机挑战可作为机器人基准测试的通用范式：结合真实场景可复现性与隐藏测试集式的随机严谨性，为跨平台/跨实验室的系统级创新与可比性提供基础。

Abstract: A challenging bottleneck in manipulation research is reproducibility and comparability of methods in real-world environments. Since manipulation is an interactive task, it cannot be evaluated on a static dataset of observations. Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB objects, it is based on reproducible real-world scenes and therefore allows system-level innovation and comparability between different platforms. Due to their stochastic nature, our challenges however, mimic the rigor and surprise of hidden test sets. To this end, we show how different robots in different labs can be compared based on their success rate over different random task samples, if these samples come from the same distribution. We propose stochastic challenges as a general paradigm for robot benchmarking and implement this paradigm in a novel benchmark for mobile manipulation, on which we compare two robots tested in two different labs.

</details>


### [437] [Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12806)
*Bing Han,Yichuan Peng,Haoyu Dong,Yuanmeng Hu,Yongyi Jia,Fangjing Wang,Kecheng Zheng,Yiming Zhang,Yanhong Zeng,Xiaoqing Zhang,Chen Song,Rundong Zou,Anqi Dong,Yuan Guan,Ka Leong Cheng,Xing Zhu,Yujun Shen,Nan Xue,Wei Ning*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LingBot-Touch：跨传感器（压阻/磁/视触觉）统一触觉基础模型，产出可插拔触觉token，可接入diffusion policy及π0.5、LingBot-VLA等VLA策略，提升复杂操作灵巧性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用触觉传感器类型各异、各有优劣，触觉理解被传感器物理特性绑定，难以利用异构触觉数据规模化训练具身模型。

Method: 构建跨传感器统一触觉表征的基础模型（覆盖压阻、磁、视触觉，并易于扩展新传感器），输出统一tactile token，作为即插即用模块接入多种策略范式（diffusion policy、VLA）。

Result: 在仿真与多硬件平台真机部署的广泛实验中，触觉表征显著提升复杂操作任务表现，同时保持较强计算效率；接入不同策略均可一致提升灵巧性。

Conclusion: 跨传感器触觉数据可用于规模化触觉学习，为未来触觉硬件设计与具身基础模型提供启示；但摘要未给出量化指标与具体架构细节。

Abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

</details>


### [438] [Simulating Vein Compressibility for Ultrasound-Guided Femoral Access: Speed, Accuracy, and Phantom Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12818)
*Amit Manicka,Laurent Coulon,Darwin Ang,Michael Loushin,Timothy M. Kowalewski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中测试基于物理的超声引导股动脉穿刺仿真可行性：Stable Neo-Hookean组织+Vertex Block Descent单GPU求解，验证精度并实现976倍加速，全栈56.4 ms/帧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人超声引导穿刺时探头压力会使组织形变并改变血管解剖结构，仿真器需在机器人交互的实时尺度上复现这些力学过程；但产生"静脉先于动脉塌陷"这一临床意义信号所需的计算代价尚不明确。

Method: 在Isaac Sim for Healthcare中用Stable Neo-Hookean本构、Vertex Block Descent求解器单GPU仿真低保真度圆柱台式体模受机器人按压；扫描单元尺寸、时间步与迭代次数，考察求解工作量与精度/耗时关系；并以文献机械参数构建数字腿部模型测试塌陷行为。

Result: 各深度处动脉预测误差≤5个百分点，25.4 mm按压前11 mm内静脉误差≤3个百分点，并复现物理体模塌陷行为；精度不随计算量增加而提升，选定配置使单帧求解时间从29,700 ms降至30.4 ms（976×），与最精细参考设置相差1.03个百分点；求解器30.4 ms/帧，含超声与渲染的完整管线56.4 ms/帧；数字腿在各设置下静脉压缩均显著大于动脉。

Conclusion: Isaac Sim平台在实时性上具备用于自主学习股动脉穿刺的强化学习训练增强或在线仿真的可行性，但精度主要受保真度（几何/材料/低模体模）而非求解工作量限制。

Abstract: In ultrasound-guided femoral access, probe pressure deforms the tissue and changes the vascular anatomy a robot observes. A simulator must reproduce these mechanics fast enough for robotic interaction, yet the computational effort needed for a clinically meaningful signal like vein collapse before artery is unclear. We test the feasibility of a physics-based simulation in NVIDIA's Isaac Sim for Healthcare, with Stable Neo-Hookean tissue solved by Vertex Block Descent on one GPU. A simulation of a low-fidelity cylindrical benchtop phantom with known geometry and mechanical properties, pressed by a robot, predicted its artery within 5 percentage points at every depth. It matched the vein within 3 points through 11 mm of a 25.4 mm press and followed the collapse behavior of the low-fidelity physical phantom. Across element size, time step, and solver iterations, wall clock time per frame scaled linearly with solver work, but accuracy did not improve with more work. The chosen setting reduced solver time per frame by a factor of 976, from 29,700 ms to 30.4 ms, while remaining within 1.03 points of the finest reference setting. The physics solver alone took 30.4 ms per frame, while the full stack, including ultrasound and graphics rendering, took 56.4 ms per frame. Finally, when seeded with realistic literature-based mechanical properties, the digital leg model compressed the vein far more than the artery at every setting, reproducing the expected clinical signal of vein collapse before artery, which is used to distinguish them. In total, these results suggest that the NVIDIA Isaac Sim platform may be suitable for augmenting reinforcement learning training or online simulation for autonomous femoral access with ultrasound.

</details>


### [439] [DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12824)
*George Nehma,Patrick Quinn,Madhur Tiwari,Camilo Riano-Rios*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DreamLander：基于 DreamerV3 的模型强化学习算法，为真实 6 自由度进入-下降-着陆（EDL）问题生成最优制导与控制，仅用状态观测，着陆误差<2 m、速度范数<0.3 m/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软着陆对载荷投送精度与安全性至关重要，但燃料受限使行星着陆必须依赖最优轨迹与高样本效率的控制方法；传统优化求解复杂，需可泛化的学习式替代方案。

Method: 以 DreamerV3 为基础的世界模型式 MBRL：通过学习潜在动力学模型在想象中优化策略，输入为状态传感器观测而非图像，面向 6-DoF EDL 动力学场景训练，追求样本效率与跨场景泛化。

Result: 在真实 EDL 场景中实现距目标着陆区 2 m 以内、速度范数小于 0.3 m/s 的软着陆，并保持较高样本效率与可泛化性。

Conclusion: 表明 MBRL 可作为 EDL 最优制导控制的可扩展方案，并朝端到端 EDL 迈进一步；但当前基于状态观测，尚未实现视觉端到端，与具身导航/3D 感知主线关联较弱。

Abstract: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.

</details>

### [440] [Real-Time Volumetric Light Transport Inference without a Path](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12103)
*Ludwic Leonard,Ruediger Westermann*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于注意力增强的图像到图像网络的实时体积介质像素辐射度重建方法，利用低成本主射线与环境采样特征直接推断最终光传输结果，无需蒙特卡洛去噪所需的昂贵路径追踪辐射度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体积渲染中的蒙特卡洛去噪依赖昂贵的路径追踪辐射度估计，且计算开销与体积密度强相关；需要一种低成本的实时高精度重构方案。

Method: 用少量主射线与环境采样统计量构建近乎充分（near-sufficient）的场景特征表示，再用注意力增强的图像到图像网络直接由这些辅助特征回归完整像素辐射度，无需原始辐射度信号；在图像空间操作使代价对相机缩放更稳定。

Result: 在挑战性体积云场景中实现实时性能与高重建精度，计算成本显著低于路径追踪去噪，且对体积密度依赖更小。

Conclusion: 低成本辅助特征加图像域网络可有效替代昂贵路径追踪估计，实现实时体积介质光传输的稳定高效重建。

Abstract: We present a real-time method for reconstructing fully integrated pixel radiance in rendered volumetric media under direct and ambient environmental illumination, using compact, low-cost scene features and statistics. Unlike Monte Carlo denoising pipelines for volumetric rendering, which depend on computationally expensive path-traced radiance estimates, our approach directly infers the final light-transport solution from inexpensive primary-ray and environment sample evaluations. We show that these features form a near-sufficient representation of the scene, enabling accurate reconstruction at substantially lower computational cost. Using an attention-augmented image-to-image network, we demonstrate that complete pixel radiance can be inferred directly from these auxiliary features, without requiring the original radiance signal. Operating in image space also provides a more stable computational cost as the camera zooms into or out of the volume, with substantially less dependence on volume density than approaches based on explicit multiple-scattering simulation. We demonstrate real-time performance and high reconstruction accuracy in challenging volumetric cloud scenarios.

</details>


### [441] [Same Physics, Different Gradients: A State-of-the-Art Report on Differentiable Physics Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12162)
*Lei Shu,Zizhou Huang,Yunuo Chen,Yifei Li,Tao Du,Minchen Li,Tuur Stuyck,Miles Macklin,Kui Wu,Bo Zhu,Yin Yang,Ming C. Lin,Alberta Longhini,Rika Antonova,Leonidas Guibas,Gordon Wetzstein,Jeannette Bohg,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文把"可微物理仿真"拆成两个正交维度：referent（导数的目标对象：有限计算图、收敛后的方程、还是连续动力学）与 realization（反向传播的组织方式：自动微分、方程级伴随求解、定制伴随），并另设非光滑接触的正交分类；论证精度与内存的"权衡"源于实现习惯而非本质约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献长期混淆"对什么求导"和"如何求导"两个问题，导致精确性声明、内存代价与梯度可用性讨论相互交叉、难以比较；同时存在"梯度正确就一定能优化成功"的隐含假设未被检验。

Method: 提出 referent×realization 二维分类框架，按状态保存/重算策略刻画成本；对接触非光滑映射给出第二套正交分类；系统归纳四种"有用梯度丢失"机制并在统一测试床（testbed）上测量；梳理零阶方法在此类情形下可能优于仿真梯度的证据；最后给出报告清单与已发布的诊断工具。

Result: 统一测试床上，精确导数相对方程级伴随求解的优势取决于拟合目标来源与求解器预算，而不仅是梯度精度本身；四种梯度失效机制被具体测量；多数"精确性—内存"权衡可由实现方式解释。

Conclusion: 可微仿真领域需要区分 referent 与 realization 的标准化报告；精确梯度并非充分条件，需结合梯度失效机制选择方法；附带报告清单、诊断工具与研究议程。

Abstract: Differentiable simulation propagates derivatives through a physics simulator, turning animation, system identification, control, and computational design into gradient-based optimization. Engines differ in the physics they model and, less visibly, in which mathematical object they differentiate. We separate two questions the literature conflates. The referent is which object the returned derivative belongs to: the finite computation that executed, the converged equation it approximates, or the continuous dynamics. The realization describes the organization of the backward pass: automatically generated differentiation, an equation-level adjoint solve, or a custom adjoint. The referent defines the target against which exactness is assessed; the implementation determines how accurately that target is approximated. Cost depends on the realization together with how the states needed by the backward pass are retained or recovered. Crossing the axes places every method and engine we classify in a cell, separates claims the literature merges, and shows that the apparent trade-off between exactness and memory follows from how methods have been built rather than from a constraint. A second, orthogonal taxonomy covers contact, where the map is non-smooth. We then ask whether a correct gradient helps. Four mechanisms by which useful gradients are lost are cataloged and measured on one testbed, where the advantage of the exact derivative over the equation-level adjoint depends on where the fitting target comes from as much as on the solver budget, and we review the evidence that zeroth-order methods can outperform simulator gradients in the regimes where those mechanisms act. The model classes, systems techniques and applications are surveyed through this lens, and we close with a reporting checklist, a released diagnostic that computes it, and a research agenda.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [442] [Beyond Prompt Attacks: Least-Action Auditing of Concept Erasure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10106)
*Yifei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出"最小作用量审计"(least-action auditing)：用最小控制代价（等于路径空间KL、事件负对数概率）测量被冻结的扩散生成器对已擦除概念的残差概率，无需重训练或对抗提示，可预测部署泄漏并能指导修复补丁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念擦除的现有审计依赖提示攻击，只检验某条文本条件是否仍能检索到被擦除概念，无法度量冻结生成器对该概念分配的概率，导致审计结果不能预测真实部署泄漏。

Method: 将审计形式化为最小作用量障碍：计算把冻结反向过程驱动到检测器定义的概念事件所需的最小控制代价 ΔS_rob，该值等于以事件为条件的路径空间KL散度，即负对数概率。终判据用CLIP∧DINOv2共识，无需重训练与对抗提示。在Stable Diffusion擦除检查点上，对18组"概念-机制"配对、每模型1500个新样本，用审计外检测器统计部署泄漏做相关性验证；并用同批轨迹构造闭式修补。

Result: 在18组配对（物体类别与NSFW裸体）上，ΔS_rob预测部署泄漏：合并Spearman ρ=-0.76，p=5e-4；每个概念内障碍越高泄漏越少（18/18）。NSFW上障碍精确排序各标准擦除器：UCE 3.9(泄漏16.4%) < ESD 75.5(9.8%) < RECE 224.5(1.4%)；SLD接近零、显式提示下泄漏85.5%。审计引导的闭式补丁把UCE裸体泄漏从16.2%降到0/1500，RECE教堂泄漏降3.3倍，方向计数匹配的随机编辑无效。

Conclusion: 最小作用量审计提供了不依赖提示攻击的概率化擦除度量，具备跨机制、跨概念的预测效度与因果可操作性（可修复检查点），可作为概念擦除的统一审计与修补工具。

Abstract: Concept erasure, or concept unlearning, in text-to-image diffusion models is usually audited with prompt attacks. A prompt attack tests whether one conditioning string still retrieves the erased concept. It does not measure the probability that the frozen generator still assigns to that concept. We introduce least-action auditing of this residual probability, and evaluate it on Stable Diffusion concept-erasure checkpoints. The least-action barrier is the minimum control cost of driving the frozen reverse process into a detector-defined concept event. This cost equals the path-space KL divergence of conditioning the model on the event, and therefore the event's negative log-probability. The estimate $\Delta S_{\mathrm{rob}}$ uses a CLIP$\wedge$DINOv2 consensus terminal, with no retraining and no adversarial prompt. Across $18$ erased concept-mechanism pairs spanning object classes and NSFW nudity, $\Delta S_{\mathrm{rob}}$ predicts deployment leakage counted on $1{,}500$ fresh samples per model by detectors excluded from the audit (pooled Spearman $\rho{=}{-}0.76$, $p{=}5{\times}10^{-4}$). Within every audited concept, the eraser with the higher barrier leaks less ($18/18$). On NSFW nudity the barrier orders the standard erasers exactly: UCE $\Delta S_{\mathrm{rob}}{=}3.9$ (leak $16.4\%$) $<$ ESD $75.5$ ($9.8\%$) $<$ RECE $224.5$ ($1.4\%$), while Safe Latent Diffusion (SLD) stays near zero and leaks $85.5\%$ under explicit prompts. The same trajectories repair deployed checkpoints. An audit-guided closed-form patch reduces UCE nudity leakage from $16.2\%$ to $0/1{,}500$ and RECE church leakage by $3.3\times$, where direction-count-matched random edits fail.

</details>

### [443] [MUTE: Multi-Level Alignment Uncoupling Against Talking-Head Exploitation for Voice Protection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11989)
*Donghyun Kim,Jin Hong,Seungmin Kim,Dain Kim,Junseok Kwon,Daeseon Choi*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: MUTE：通过多层级策略解耦音视频对齐的音频保护框架，用于防御 talking-head 深度伪造生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Talking-head 生成模型可被滥用于多模态深度伪造，但针对音频端的保护方法研究不足；同时这类模型依赖精确的音视频对齐，构成可利用的脆弱点。

Method: 提出 MUTE 框架：(1) 对齐层破坏——直接扰动跨模态注意力以破坏结构对齐；(2) 表征层退化——扰动时序音频嵌入以降低表征质量；扰动约束在 STFT 域高能量区域以抵抗后处理、去噪与自适应攻击；可选说话人层目标以防范 TTS 重合成绕过。

Result: 在白盒与黑盒 talking-head 模型上一致地降低唇形同步质量，同时保持感知音频质量；在真实世界变换下仍然有效，并可与图像域方法组合形成更强的多模态保护。

Conclusion: 音频端多层级扰动是防御 talking-head 深度伪造的有效且鲁棒的补充路径，可与视觉保护方法协同。

Abstract: Talking-head generation models, which synthesize realistic facial animations from audio, are increasingly vulnerable to misuse in multimodal deepfake scenarios. Protecting such systems remains challenging, as talking-head models fundamentally rely on precise audio-visual alignment, while effective audio protection methods remain largely underexplored. In this work, we propose MUTE, an audio protection framework that uncouples the underlying audio-visual alignment through a multi-level strategy. Specifically, MUTE combines (1) Alignment-level Disruption, which directly perturbs cross-modal attention to disrupt structural alignment, and (2) Representation-level Degradation, which perturbs temporal audio embeddings to degrade their representations. To improve robustness, perturbations are constrained in the STFT domain to high-energy regions, making them resistant to post-processing, denoising, and adaptive attacks. An optional speaker-level objective further mitigates potential bypass via TTS-based resynthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MUTE consistently degrades lip synchronization across both white-box and black-box talking-head models while preserving perceptual audio quality. The proposed method remains effective under real-world transformations and can be combined with image-based approaches to provide stronger multimodal protection. The source code and project page are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [444] [Direct Conditioning of Audio Diffusion Transformers on fMRI Reveals Cortical Contributions to Sound Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12603)
*Matteo Ciferri,Tonio Weidler,Matteo Ferrante,Nicola Toschi,Elia Formisano*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: MAAS：端到端 fMRI→音频扩散框架，按ROI投影fMRI响应+可学习brain token，经专用cross-attention直接条件Stable Audio，无需先训练解码器回归外部声学表征；并提出基于听觉神经计算模型的保真度指标量化各听觉皮层区贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑→音频流程普遍是两阶段的：先把神经响应映射到预定义刺激表征（如mel谱/语义嵌入），再合成音频，中间表征成为瓶颈且可能丢失脑活动中的信息。视觉领域已尝试直接在脑活动上条件生成，但音频扩散模型尚未被该思路覆盖。

Method: 以预训练音频扩散Transformer（Stable Audio）为骨干，冻结骨干并在其中引入独立cross-attention通路；对7T fMRI按ROI划分，用区域特定投影层和可学习brain token编码各脑区响应后作为条件注入。不设中间刺激表征监督目标。另构建基于听觉神经计算模型的保真度指标，用于归因各听觉皮层区对重建音频的贡献。

Result: 在7T fMRI数据集上，相对基线（含两阶段fMRI→latent条件化方法）在声学与语义两类评价指标上均取得一致提升；神经计算保真度指标可量化单一听觉皮层区域对重建音频表征的贡献。

Conclusion: 验证了"直接以ROI级fMRI条件化音频扩散模型"的可行性，绕过中间刺激表征回归；ROI分解+区域归因分析为理解听觉皮层编码提供了可解释工具。局限是单一7T小样本数据集、音频重建质量仍受扩散先验与fMRI信噪比限制。

Abstract: Reconstructing audio from brain activity remains challenging. Existing brain-to-audio pipelines typically map neural responses to predefined stimulus representations before synthesis. While recent work in the visual domain has explored direct conditioning on brain activity, this approach has not yet been extended to audio diffusion models. We introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework that conditions a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses without first supervising a decoder to predict an external stimulus representation. MAAS uses region-specific projections and learned brain tokens to condition Stable Audio through a dedicated cross-attention pathway. On a 7T fMRI dataset, we demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, including two-stage fMRI-to-latent conditioning, across both acoustic and semantic evaluation metrics. In addition, we introduce a fidelity metric grounded in a computational model of auditory neural processing, which allows us to quantify the contribution of individual auditory cortical regions to reconstructed audio representations.

</details>

### [445] [Concurrent Learning-Based Inertial Parameter Estimation and Control of Quadrotors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11555)
*Sandesh Thapa,He Bai*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对质心偏移且惯性矩阵非对角四旋翼，提出基于积分并行学习(ICL)的几何控制器，在线估计质量、质心偏移与完整惯性矩阵并跟踪修正轨迹，无需加速度计或数值微分，有限激励条件下证明参数收敛，仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机载载荷（IMU、相机、电池）难以严格置于几何中心，飞行中扰动还可能使其移动，导致质心偏移与惯性矩阵非对角，而多数控制器假定参数已知或对角化，易造成跟踪性能下降。

Method: 构造集成在线参数估计（质量、质心偏移、全惯性矩阵）与轨迹跟踪的几何控制器，采用积分并行学习(ICL)避免依赖加速度计和数值微分；利用在线估计的质心偏移对参考轨迹进行平移修正；在有限激励(finite excitation)条件下给出参数收敛与跟踪误差稳定性证明。

Result: 理论上证明估计参数收敛至真值、闭环跟踪误差有界并收敛；仿真实验显示所提算法能有效补偿质心偏移与非对角惯性，跟踪给定轨迹。

Conclusion: 该工作为存在未建模质心偏移的四旋翼提供了一套不依赖加速度计的自适应几何跟踪方案，但验证仅限仿真，缺乏实机与对比实验，属于经典自适应控制范畴而非一线具身智能重点方向。

Abstract: In this letter, we consider trajectory tracking control and inertial parameter estimation of a quadrotor UAV whose center of mass (CoM) does not coincide with its geometric center. Onboard payloads like an IMU, a camera, or a battery are not necessarily placed at its geometric center. Moreover, during the flight these sensors might move because of external disturbances and cause a CoM offset. Thus, these events and equipment introduce an offset and cause the inertia matrix to be non-diagonal. We develop an integral concurrent learning (ICL)-based geometric controller that estimates the mass, the CoM offset, and the full inertia matrix online, without an accelerometer or numerical derivatives, and tracks a given trajectory corrected by the offset estimated online. We prove that the estimated parameters converge to their true values under a finite excitation condition. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm using a simulation example.

</details>


### [446] [Generalizable Output Feedback Optimal Control via Transformers Without Explicit State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11815)
*Maitham F. AL-Sunni,Turki Bin Mohaya,John M. Dolan,Peter Seiler*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出用单个 Transformer 在运行时仅凭短窗口含噪测量、无需已知系统矩阵与状态估计器，即可统一控制一整个异构 MIMO LTI 部分可观测系统的家族；理论上刻画最优 LQG 策略与静态 Transformer 的关系并把闭环超量代价写成偏离最优动作的"能量"；28 个仿真系统上已见系统代价中位差 0.4%，未见系统经轻量微调后为 1.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典最优控制需为每个被控对象单独设计控制器；作者追问能否用一份学习到的策略覆盖整族参数、维度、代价与噪声各异的噪声部分可观测线性系统，从而摆脱依赖已知模型矩阵和在线状态估计器的传统范式。

Method: 在异构 MIMO LTI 家族上以模仿学习逼近最优 LQG 控制；采用系统级标准化、零填充、掩码以及代价/噪声协方差编码的共享表示，使一套权重适配全族对象；运行时仅输入短窗口含噪测量直接输出控制量；并给出最优 LQG 动态状态空间策略与有限窗口静态 Transformer 间的关系刻画，以及以"偏离最优动作的能量"表达任意因果策略闭环超量代价的分析。

Result: 在 28 个仿真系统上，已见系统中位相对代价差 0.4%；未见系统经轻量微调后中位差 1.0%；运行时不需对象矩阵与显式状态估计，短测量窗口即可闭环。

Conclusion: 单一 Transformer 可作为覆盖异构线性系统族的通用策略，且理论分析给出了可解释的性能损失度量；但证据完全基于仿真，尚无硬件验证、也未给出与经典 LQG 在鲁棒性/稳定性裕度上的系统对比。

Abstract: Classical optimal control is used to design a separate controller for each plant. This paper asks a different question. Can one learned policy serve a whole family of partially observed, noisy linear systems? We show that one transformer can. The policy is trained to imitate optimal LQG control on a heterogeneous family of Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems with Multiple Inputs and Multiple Outputs (MIMO), whose dimensions, cost matrices, and noise levels all vary. A shared representation with system-wise standardization, zero-padding, masking, and an encoding of the cost and noise covariances lets one set of weights control every member of the family. At run time, a short window of noisy measurements is all the policy needs to produce a control action, with no plant matrices and no state estimator. We characterize the relation between the optimal LQG policy (represented as a dynamic state-space model) and a static transformer acting on a finite window of measurements. We then express the closed-loop excess cost of any causal policy as the energy of its deviation from the optimal action. Finally, we evaluate the approach on 28 simulated systems. The trained policy reaches the optimal cost to within a median gap of $0.4\%$ for seen systems. For unseen systems, a light fine-tuning step brings the median gap to $1.0\%$.

</details>


### [447] [Certified Zonotopic Reachability Analysis for Trajectory Tracking on Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12767)
*Yanliang Huang,Peng Xie,Zhen Zhang,Zhuoqi Zeng,Amr Alanwar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于李群群仿射误差动力学与zonotope的连续时间跟踪误差管（tube），用闭式包络处理逆右雅可比对扰动的作用，通过混合坐标实现非线性项匹配与精确前馈消去，给出比不变椭球更紧的安全认证界，并在平面飞行器、全驱动多旋翼仿真与四旋翼实飞中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶/飞行器沿障碍附近的规划轨迹跟踪时，未知扰动导致偏离；只有给出扰动能造成的跟踪误差上界，轨迹才能在执行前被认证为安全。现有集合方法（全程单一不变椭球或区间）过于保守。对于李群上的非线性误差动力学，需在保持严格性同时收紧上界。

Method: 利用群仿射系统在参考输入下误差动力学在李代数坐标中线性、扰动与输入经逆右雅可比进入的结构：用zonotope传播线性部分，并对逆右雅可比作用于扰动的项做闭式包络，得到连续时间且可证明包含所有可达误差的误差管；对部分误差分量无输入导致的未匹配非线性项，采用混合坐标使其匹配，从而控制器消去所有不含扰动的非线性项。

Result: 平面飞行器与全驱动多旋翼仿真、四旋翼实飞中误差管均比不变椭球方法更紧，且实飞中管包含全部实测姿态误差；在更大扰动、相同反馈增益下，椭球法无法给出有效椭球，而所提管仍有效；未作混合坐标时其他方法均无法认证该类闭环。

Conclusion: 基于zonotope+闭式逆右雅可比包络的连续时间误差管为李群上的轨迹跟踪提供了更紧、可证明的安全认证，混合坐标是处理未匹配非线性项的关键；适用于空中与空间飞行器的安全轨迹验证。属控制/形式化安全认证方向的扎实工作，非视觉-语言-动作或3D重建类，故优先级中等。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles track planned trajectories close to obstacles. Unknown disturbances make them deviate from these trajectories. With a bound on the tracking error that disturbances can cause, a planned trajectory can be certified as safe before execution. Existing set-based methods bound the tracking error by one invariant ellipsoid for the whole trajectory or by intervals, which are both conservative. For aerial and space vehicles, the tracking error evolves on a matrix Lie group with nonlinear dynamics. However, for group-affine systems, the error dynamics are linear in Lie algebra coordinates when the vehicle receives the inputs of the reference. The control input and the disturbance enter through the inverse right Jacobian, a matrix that depends on the error. We propagate the linear part of the error dynamics with zonotopes and enclose the effect of the inverse right Jacobian on the disturbance in closed form. The resulting tubes are tight and provably contain all reachable tracking errors in continuous time. When some error components have no input, the inverse right Jacobian leaves unmatched nonlinear terms in the closed loop. None of the tested methods certifies such a closed loop. Hybrid coordinates make these terms matched, so that our controller cancels every nonlinear term that does not contain the disturbance. Our tubes give tighter bounds than the ellipsoid method in simulations of a planar aircraft and a fully actuated multirotor and in real flights of a quadrotor, where the tube contains every measured attitude error. Under larger disturbances and the same feedback gain, the ellipsoid method yields no valid ellipsoid, whereas our tubes remain valid.

</details>
